verses.original: וַ/יַּקְהֵ֣ל דָּוִ֣יד אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁבָטִ֣ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מַּחְלְק֣וֹת הַ/מְשָׁרְתִ֪ים אֶת הַ/מֶּ֟לֶךְ וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/אֲלָפִ֣ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֵּא֡וֹת וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י כָל רְכוּשׁ וּ/מִקְנֶה֩ לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ וּ/לְ/בָנָ֜י/ו עִם הַ/סָּרִיסִ֧ים וְ/הַ/גִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וּֽ/לְ/כָל גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqhl dvyd 't khl shry yshr'l shry hshbtym vshry hmchlqvt hmshrtym 't hmlkh vshry h'lpym vshry hm'vt vshry khl rkhvsh vmqnh lmlkh vlbnyv 'm hsrysym vhgbvrym vlkhl gbvr chyl 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֤יד הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל רַגְלָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּ/נִי אַחַ֣/י וְ/עַמִּ֑/י אֲנִ֣י עִם לְבָבִ֡/י לִ/בְנוֹת֩ בֵּ֨ית מְנוּחָ֜ה לַ/אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֗ה וְ/לַ/הֲדֹם֙ רַגְלֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ וַ/הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לִ/בְנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqm dvyd hmlkh 'l rglyv vy'mr shm'vny 'chy v'my 'ny 'm lbby lbnvt byt mnvchh l'rvn bryt yhvh vlhdm rgly 'lhynv vhkhynvty lbnvt
verses.translation: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֣מַר לִ֔/י לֹא תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֖יִת לִ/שְׁמִ֑/י כִּ֣י אִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמ֛וֹת אַ֖תָּה וְ/דָמִ֥ים שָׁפָֽכְתָּ
verses.translit: vh'lhym 'mr ly l' tbnh byt lshmy khy 'ysh mlchmvt 'th vdmym shpkht
verses.translation: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְחַ֡ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בִּ֜/י מִ/כֹּ֣ל בֵּית אָבִ֗/י לִ/הְי֨וֹת לְ/מֶ֤לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י בִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ בָּחַ֣ר לְ/נָגִ֔יד וּ/בְ/בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑/י וּ/בִ/בְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔/י בִּ֣/י רָצָ֔ה לְ/הַמְלִ֖יךְ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vybchr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l by mkhl byt 'by lhyvt lmlkh 'l yshr'l l'vlm khy byhvdh bchr lngyd vbbyt yhvdh byt 'by vbbny 'by by rtsh lhmlykh 'l khl yshr'l
verses.translation: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/כָּ֨ל בָּנַ֔/י כִּ֚י רַבִּ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים נָ֥תַן לִ֖/י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּבְחַר֙ בִּ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔/י לָ/שֶׁ֗בֶת עַל כִּסֵּ֛א מַלְכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vmkhl bny khy rbym bnym ntn ly yhvh vybchr bshlmh bny lshbt 'l khs' mlkhvt yhvh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔/י שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בִנְ/ךָ֔ הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה בֵיתִ֖/י וַ/חֲצֵרוֹתָ֑/י כִּי בָחַ֨רְתִּי ב֥/וֹ לִ/י֙ לְ/בֵ֔ן וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה לּ֥/וֹ לְ/אָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr ly shlmh bnkh hv' ybnh byty vchtsrvty khy bchrty bv ly lbn v'ny 'hyh lv l'b
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

verses.original: וַ/הֲכִינוֹתִ֥י אֶת מַלְכוּת֖/וֹ עַד לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם אִם יֶחֱזַ֗ק לַ/עֲשׂ֛וֹת מִצְוֺתַ֥/י וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhkhynvty 't mlkhvtv 'd l'vlm 'm ychzq l'shvt mtsvty vmshpty khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה לְ/עֵינֵ֨י כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל קְהַל יְהוָה֙ וּ/בְ/אָזְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ שִׁמְר֣וּ וְ/דִרְשׁ֔וּ כָּל מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽירְשׁוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה וְ/הִנְחַלְתֶּ֛ם לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֥ם אַחֲרֵי/כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'th l'yny khl yshr'l qhl yhvh vb'zny 'lhynv shmrv vdrshv khl mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm lm'n tyrshv 't h'rts htvbh vhnchltm lbnykhm 'chrykhm 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD , and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה בְנִ֡/י דַּע֩ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֨י אָבִ֜י/ךָ וְ/עָבְדֵ֗/הוּ בְּ/לֵ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ וּ/בְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ חֲפֵצָ֔ה כִּ֤י כָל לְבָבוֹת֙ דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/כָל יֵ֥צֶר מַחֲשָׁב֖וֹת מֵבִ֑ין אִֽם תִּדְרְשֶׁ֨/נּוּ֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא לָ֔/ךְ וְ/אִם תַּֽעַזְבֶ֖/נּוּ יַזְנִיחֲ/ךָ֥ לָ/עַֽד
verses.translit: v'th shlmh bny d' 't 'lhy 'bykh v'bdhv blb shlm vbnpsh chptsh khy khl lbbvt dvrsh yhvh vkhl ytsr mchshbvt mbyn 'm tdrshnv ymts' lkh v'm t'zbnv yznychkh l'd
verses.translation: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה עַתָּ֗ה כִּֽי יְהוָ֛ה בָּ֧חַר בְּ/ךָ֛ לִ/בְנֽוֹת בַּ֥יִת לַ/מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ חֲזַ֥ק וַ/עֲשֵֽׂה
verses.translit: r'h 'th khy yhvh bchr bkh lbnvt byt lmqdsh chzq v'shh
verses.translation: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן דָּוִ֣יד לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֡/וֹ אֶת תַּבְנִ֣ית הָ/אוּלָם֩ וְֽ/אֶת בָּ֨תָּ֜י/ו וְ/גַנְזַכָּ֧י/ו וַ/עֲלִיֹּתָ֛י/ו וַ/חֲדָרָ֥י/ו הַ/פְּנִימִ֖ים וּ/בֵ֥ית הַ/כַּפֹּֽרֶת
verses.translit: vytn dvyd lshlmh bnv 't tbnyt h'vlm v't btyv vgnzkhyv v'lytyv vchdryv hpnymym vbyt hkhprt
verses.translation: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

verses.original: וְ/תַבְנִ֗ית כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה בָ/ר֨וּחַ֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ לְ/חַצְר֧וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֛ה וּ/לְ/כָל הַ/לְּשָׁכ֖וֹת סָבִ֑יב לְ/אֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/לְ/אֹצְר֖וֹת הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vtbnyt khl 'shr hyh brvch 'mv lchtsrvt byt yhvh vlkhl hlshkhvt sbyb l'tsrvt byt h'lhym vl'tsrvt hqdshym
verses.translation: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD , and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

verses.original: וּֽ/לְ/מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וּֽ/לְ/כָל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה וּֽ/לְ/כָל כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlmchlqvt hkhhnym vhlvym vlkhl ml'kht 'bvdt byt yhvh vlkhl khly 'bvdt byt yhvh
verses.translation: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: לַ/זָּהָ֤ב בַּ/מִּשְׁקָל֙ לַ/זָּהָ֔ב לְ/כָל כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדָ֣ה וַ/עֲבוֹדָ֑ה לְ/כֹ֨ל כְּלֵ֤י הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ בְּ/מִשְׁקָ֔ל לְ/כָל כְּלֵ֖י עֲבוֹדָ֥ה וַ/עֲבוֹדָֽה
verses.translit: lzhb bmshql lzhb lkhl khly 'bvdh v'bvdh lkhl khly hkhsf bmshql lkhl khly 'bvdh v'bvdh
verses.translation: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁקָ֞ל לִ/מְנֹר֣וֹת הַ/זָּהָ֗ב וְ/נֵרֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ זָהָ֔ב בְּ/מִשְׁקַל מְנוֹרָ֥ה וּ/מְנוֹרָ֖ה וְ/נֵרֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/לִ/מְנֹר֨וֹת הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף בְּ/מִשְׁקָל֙ לִ/מְנוֹרָ֣ה וְ/נֵרֹתֶ֔י/הָ כַּ/עֲבוֹדַ֖ת מְנוֹרָ֥ה וּ/מְנוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vmshql lmnrvt hzhb vnrtyhm zhb bmshql mnvrh vmnvrh vnrtyh vlmnrvt hkhsf bmshql lmnvrh vnrtyh kh'bvdt mnvrh vmnvrh
verses.translation: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֥ב מִשְׁקָ֛ל לְ/שֻׁלְחֲנ֥וֹת הַֽ/מַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְ/שֻׁלְחַ֣ן וְ/שֻׁלְחָ֑ן וְ/כֶ֖סֶף לְ/שֻׁלְחֲנ֥וֹת הַ/כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v't hzhb mshql lshlchnvt hm'rkht lshlchn vshlchn vkhsf lshlchnvt hkhsf
verses.translation: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מִּזְלָג֧וֹת וְ/הַ/מִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְ/הַ/קְּשָׂוֺ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְ/לִ/כְפוֹרֵ֨י הַ/זָּהָ֤ב בְּ/מִשְׁקָל֙ לִ/כְפ֣וֹר וּ/כְפ֔וֹר וְ/לִ/כְפוֹרֵ֥י הַ/כֶּ֛סֶף בְּ/מִשְׁקָ֖ל לִ/כְפ֥וֹר וּ/כְפֽוֹר
verses.translit: vhmzlgvt vhmzrqvt vhqshvt zhb thvr vlkhpvry hzhb bmshql lkhpvr vkhpvr vlkhpvry hkhsf bmshql lkhpvr vkhpvr
verses.translation: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִזְבַּ֧ח הַ/קְּטֹ֛רֶת זָהָ֥ב מְזֻקָּ֖ק בַּ/מִּשְׁקָ֑ל וּ/לְ/תַבְנִ֣ית הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה הַ/כְּרֻבִ֤ים זָהָב֙ לְ/פֹ֣רְשִׂ֔ים וְ/סֹכְכִ֖ים עַל אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlmzbch hqtrt zhb mzqq bmshql vltbnyt hmrkhbh hkhrbym zhb lprshym vskhkhym 'l 'rvn bryt yhvh
verses.translation: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD .

verses.original: הַ/כֹּ֥ל בִּ/כְתָ֛ב מִ/יַּ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה עָלַ֣/י הִשְׂכִּ֑יל כֹּ֖ל מַלְאֲכ֥וֹת הַ/תַּבְנִֽית
verses.translit: hkhl bkhtb myd yhvh 'ly hshkhyl khl ml'khvt htbnyt
verses.translation: All this, said David , the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֗/וֹ חֲזַ֤ק וֶ/אֱמַץ֙ וַ/עֲשֵׂ֔ה אַל תִּירָ֖א וְ/אַל תֵּחָ֑ת כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֱלֹהַ/י֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ לֹ֤א יַרְפְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֔/ךָּ עַד לִ/כְל֕וֹת כָּל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lshlmh bnv chzq v'mts v'shh 'l tyr' v'l tcht khy yhvh 'lhym 'lhy 'mkh l' yrpkh vl' y'zbkh 'd lkhlvt khl ml'kht 'bvdt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/כָל עֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/עִמְּ/ךָ֙ בְ/כָל מְלָאכָ֜ה לְ/כָל נָדִ֤יב בַּֽ/חָכְמָה֙ לְ/כָל עֲבוֹדָ֔ה וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֥ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם לְ/כָל דְּבָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnh mchlqvt hkhhnym vhlvym lkhl 'bvdt byt h'lhym v'mkh bkhl ml'khh lkhl ndyb bchkhmh lkhl 'bvdh vhshrym vkhl h'm lkhl dbrykh
verses.translation: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָ֔ל שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְנִ֥/י אֶחָ֛ד בָּֽחַר בּ֥/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נַ֣עַר וָ/רָ֑ךְ וְ/הַ/מְּלָאכָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְ/אָדָם֙ הַ/בִּירָ֔ה כִּ֖י לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd hmlkh lkhl hqhl shlmh bny 'chd bchr bv 'lhym n'r vrkh vhml'khh gdvlh khy l' l'dm hbyrh khy lyhvh 'lhym
verses.translation: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

verses.original: וּֽ/כְ/כָל כֹּחִ֞/י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְ/בֵית אֱלֹהַ֗/י הַ/זָּהָ֣ב לַ֠/זָּהָב וְ/הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף לַ/כֶּ֜סֶף וְ/הַ/נְּחֹ֣שֶׁת לַ/נְּחֹ֗שֶׁת הַ/בַּרְזֶל֙ לַ/בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְ/הָ/עֵצִ֖ים לָ/עֵצִ֑ים אַבְנֵי שֹׁ֨הַם וּ/מִלּוּאִ֜ים אַבְנֵי פ֣וּךְ וְ/רִקְמָ֗ה וְ/כֹ֨ל אֶ֧בֶן יְקָרָ֛ה וְ/אַבְנֵי שַׁ֖יִשׁ לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vkhkhl khchy hkhynvty lbyt 'lhy hzhb lzhb vhkhsf lkhsf vhnchsht lnchsht hbrzl lbrzl vh'tsym l'tsym 'bny shhm vmlv'ym 'bny pvkh vrqmh vkhl 'bn yqrh v'bny shysh lrb
verses.translation: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

verses.original: וְ/ע֗וֹד בִּ/רְצוֹתִ/י֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֔/י יֶשׁ לִ֥/י סְגֻלָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב וָ/כָ֑סֶף נָתַ֤תִּי לְ/בֵית אֱלֹהַ/י֙ לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה מִ/כָּל הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לְ/בֵ֥ית הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'vd brtsvty bbyt 'lhy ysh ly sglh zhb vkhsf ntty lbyt 'lhy lm'lh mkhl hkhynvty lbyt hqdsh
verses.translation: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

verses.original: שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מִ/זְּהַ֣ב אוֹפִ֑יר וְ/שִׁבְעַ֨ת אֲלָפִ֤ים כִּכַּר כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מְזֻקָּ֔ק לָ/ט֖וּחַ קִיר֥וֹת הַ/בָּתִּֽים
verses.translit: shlsht 'lpym khkhry zhb mzhb 'vpyr vshb't 'lpym khkhr khsf mzqq ltvch qyrvt hbtym
verses.translation: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

verses.original: לַ/זָּהָ֤ב לַ/זָּהָב֙ וְ/לַ/כֶּ֣סֶף לַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/לְ/כָל מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֣ד חָרָשִׁ֑ים וּ/מִ֣י מִתְנַדֵּ֔ב לְ/מַלֹּ֥אות יָד֛/וֹ הַ/יּ֖וֹם לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: lzhb lzhb vlkhsf lkhsf vlkhl ml'khh byd chrshym vmy mtndb lml'vt ydv hyvm lyhvh
verses.translation: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָ/אָב֜וֹת וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/שָׂרֵ֤י הָ/אֲלָפִים֙ וְ/הַ/מֵּא֔וֹת וּ/לְ/שָׂרֵ֖י מְלֶ֥אכֶת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vytndbv shry h'bvt vshry shbty yshr'l vshry h'lpym vhm'vt vlshry ml'kht hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֞וּ לַ/עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֣ים חֲמֵֽשֶׁת אֲלָפִים֮ וַ/אֲדַרְכֹנִ֣ים רִבּוֹ֒ וְ/כֶ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/נְחֹ֕שֶׁת רִבּ֛וֹ וּ/שְׁמוֹנַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים כִּכָּרִ֑ים וּ/בַרְזֶ֖ל מֵֽאָה אֶ֥לֶף כִּכָּרִֽים
verses.translit: vytnv l'bvdt byt h'lhym zhb khkhrym chmsht 'lpym v'drkhnym rbv vkhsf khkhrym 'shrt 'lpym vnchsht rbv vshmvnt 'lpym khkhrym vbrzl m'h 'lf khkhrym
verses.translation: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נִּמְצָ֤א אִתּ/וֹ֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ לְ/אוֹצַ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה עַ֥ל יַד יְחִיאֵ֖ל הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי
verses.translit: vhnmts' 'tv 'bnym ntnv l'vtsr byt yhvh 'l yd ychy'l hgrshny
verses.translation: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמְח֤וּ הָ/עָם֙ עַל הִֽתְנַדְּבָ֔/ם כִּ֚י בְּ/לֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם הִֽתְנַדְּב֖וּ לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/גַם֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂמַ֖ח שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vyshmchv h'm 'l htndbm khy blb shlm htndbv lyhvh vgm dvyd hmlkh shmch shmchh gdvlh
verses.translation: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD : and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔י/נוּ מֵ/עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vybrkh dvyd 't yhvh l'yny khl hqhl vy'mr dvyd brvkh 'th yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'bynv m'vlm v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

verses.original: לְ/ךָ֣ יְ֠הוָה הַ/גְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְ/הַ/גְּבוּרָ֤ה וְ/הַ/תִּפְאֶ֨רֶת֙ וְ/הַ/נֵּ֣צַח וְ/הַ/ה֔וֹד כִּי כֹ֖ל בַּ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וּ/בָ/אָ֑רֶץ לְ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְ/הַ/מִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְ/כֹ֥ל לְ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: lkh yhvh hgdlh vhgbvrh vhtp'rt vhntsch vhhvd khy khl bshmym vb'rts lkh yhvh hmmlkhh vhmtnsh' lkhl lr'sh
verses.translation: Thine, O LORD , is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD , and thou art exalted as head above all.

verses.translit: vh'shr vhkhbvd mlpnykh v'th mvshl bkhl vbydkh khch vgbvrh vbydkh lgdl vlchzq lkhl
verses.translation: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑/ךְ וּֽ/מְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְ/שֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th 'lhynv mvdym 'nchnv lkh vmhllym lshm tp'rtkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּ/מִ֣י עַמִּ֔/י כִּֽי נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְ/הִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּ/זֹ֑את כִּֽי מִמְּ/ךָ֣ הַ/כֹּ֔ל וּ/מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhy my 'ny vmy 'my khy n'tsr khch lhtndb khz't khy mmkh hkhl vmydkh ntnv lkh
verses.translation: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

verses.original: כִּֽי גֵרִ֨ים אֲנַ֧חְנוּ לְ/פָנֶ֛י/ךָ וְ/תוֹשָׁבִ֖ים כְּ/כָל אֲבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ כַּ/צֵּ֧ל יָמֵ֛י/נוּ עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/אֵ֥ין מִקְוֶֽה
verses.translit: khy grym 'nchnv lpnykh vtvshbym khkhl 'btynv khtsl ymynv 'l h'rts v'yn mqvh
verses.translation: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ כֹ֣ל הֶ/הָמ֤וֹן הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲכִינֹ֔נוּ לִ/בְנֽוֹת לְ/ךָ֥ בַ֖יִת לְ/שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑/ךָ מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ היא ה֖וּא וּ/לְ/ךָ֥ הַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv khl hhmvn hzh 'shr hkhynnv lbnvt lkh byt lshm qdshkh mydkh hy' hv' vlkh hkhl
verses.translation: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

verses.original: וְ/יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔/י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּ/מֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּ/יֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִ/י֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/עַתָּ֗ה עַמְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/נִּמְצְאוּ פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְ/שִׂמְחָ֖ה לְ/הִֽתְנַדֶּב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyd'ty 'lhy khy 'th bchn lbb vmyshrym trtsh 'ny byshr lbby htndbty khl 'lh v'th 'mkh hnmts'v ph r'yty bshmchh lhtndb lkh
verses.translation: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵי אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ שֳׁמְרָ/ה זֹּ֣את לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם לְ/יֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/הָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖/ם אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'brhm ytschq vyshr'l 'btynv shmrh z't l'vlm lytsr mchshbvt lbb 'mkh vhkhn lbbm 'lykh
verses.translation: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

verses.original: וְ/לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֗/י תֵּ֚ן לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם לִ/שְׁמוֹר֙ מִצְוֺתֶ֔י/ךָ עֵדְוֺתֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/חֻקֶּ֑י/ךָ וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הַ/כֹּ֔ל וְ/לִ/בְנ֖וֹת הַ/בִּירָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר הֲכִינֽוֹתִי
verses.translit: vlshlmh bny tn lbb shlm lshmvr mtsvtykh 'dvtykh vchqykh vl'shvt hkhl vlbnvt hbyrh 'shr hkhynvty
verses.translation: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things , and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ לְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָ֔ל בָּֽרְכוּ נָ֖א אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יְבָרֲכ֣וּ כָֽל הַ/קָּהָ֗ל לַ/יהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹֽתֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּקְּד֧וּ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה וְ/לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lkhl hqhl brkhv n' 't yhvh 'lhykhm vybrkhv khl hqhl lyhvh 'lhy 'btyhm vyqdv vyshtchvv lyhvh vlmlkh
verses.translation: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD , and the king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבְּח֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֣ה זְ֠בָחִים וַ/יַּעֲל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת לַ/יהוָ֗ה לְֽ/מָחֳרַת֮ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/הוּא֒ פָּרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף אֵילִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף כְּבָשִׂ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֑ם וּ/זְבָחִ֥ים לָ/רֹ֖ב לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyzbchv lyhvh zbchym vy'lv 'lvt lyhvh lmchrt hyvm hhv' prym 'lf 'ylym 'lf khbshym 'lf vnskhyhm vzbchym lrb lkhl yshr'l
verses.translation: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD , on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאכְל֨וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֜וּ לִ/פְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַ/יַּמְלִ֤יכוּ שֵׁנִית֙ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן דָּוִ֔יד וַ/יִּמְשְׁח֧וּ לַ/יהוָ֛ה לְ/נָגִ֥יד וּ/לְ/צָד֖וֹק לְ/כֹהֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'khlv vyshtv lpny yhvh byvm hhv' bshmchh gdvlh vymlykhv shnyt lshlmh bn dvyd vymshchv lyhvh lngyd vltsdvq lkhhn
verses.translation: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב שְׁ֠לֹמֹה עַל כִּסֵּ֨א יְהוָ֧ה לְ/מֶ֛לֶךְ תַּֽחַת דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖י/ו וַ/יַּצְלַ֑ח וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshb shlmh 'l khs' yhvh lmlkh tcht dvyd 'byv vytslch vyshm'v 'lyv khl yshr'l
verses.translation: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ וְ/הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֔ים וְ/גַ֕ם כָּל בְּנֵ֖י הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד נָ֣תְנוּ יָ֔ד תַּ֖חַת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vkhl hshrym vhgbrym vgm khl bny hmlkh dvyd ntnv yd tcht shlmh hmlkh
verses.translation: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

verses.original: וַ/יְגַדֵּ֨ל יְהוָ֤ה אֶת שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָי/ו֙ ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֔וּת אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא הָיָ֧ה עַל כָּל מֶ֛לֶךְ לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vygdl yhvh 't shlmh lm'lh l'yny khl yshr'l vytn 'lyv hvd mlkhvt 'shr l' hyh 'l khl mlkh lpnyv 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִיד֙ בֶּן יִשָׁ֔י מָלַ֖ךְ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vdvyd bn yshy mlkh 'l khl yshr'l
verses.translation: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלַךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/חֶבְר֤וֹן מָלַךְ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם מָלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/שָׁלֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr mlkh 'l yshr'l 'rb'ym shnh bchbrvn mlkh shb' shnym vbyrvshlm mlkh shlshym vshlvsh
verses.translation: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָת֙ בְּ/שֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֔ה שְׂבַ֥ע יָמִ֖ים עֹ֣שֶׁר וְ/כָב֑וֹד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vymt bshybh tvbh shb' ymym 'shr vkhbvd vymlkh shlmh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/דִבְרֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אֲחרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל דִּבְרֵי֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הָ/רֹאֶ֔ה וְ/עַל דִּבְרֵי֙ נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֔יא וְ/עַל דִּבְרֵ֖י גָּ֥ד הַ/חֹזֶֽה
verses.translit: vdbry dvyd hmlkh hr'shnym vh'chrnym hnm khtvbym 'l dbry shmv'l hr'h v'l dbry ntn hnby' v'l dbry gd hchzh
verses.translation: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

verses.original: עִ֥ם כָּל מַלְכוּת֖/וֹ וּ/גְבוּרָת֑/וֹ וְ/הָ/עִתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ עָלָי/ו֙ וְ/עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'm khl mlkhvtv vgbvrtv vh'tym 'shr 'brv 'lyv v'l yshr'l v'l khl mmlkhvt h'rtsvt
verses.translation: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֛ק שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בֶן דָּוִ֖יד עַל מַלְכוּת֑/וֹ וַ/יהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יְגַדְּלֵ֖/הוּ לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vytchzq shlmh bn dvyd 'l mlkhvtv vyhvh 'lhyv 'mv vygdlhv lm'lh
verses.translation: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לְ/שָׂרֵי֩ הָ/אֲלָפִ֨ים וְ/הַ/מֵּא֜וֹת וְ/לַ/שֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים וּ/לְ/כֹ֛ל נָשִׂ֥יא לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ/אָבֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh lkhl yshr'l lshry h'lpym vhm'vt vlshptym vlkhl nshy' lkhl yshr'l r'shy h'bvt
verses.translation: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֗וּ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ וְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָ֣ל עִמּ֔/וֹ לַ/בָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/גִבְע֑וֹן כִּי שָׁ֣ם הָיָ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vylkhv shlmh vkhl hqhl 'mv lbmh 'shr bgb'vn khy shm hyh 'hl mv'd h'lhym 'shr 'shh mshh 'bd yhvh bmdbr
verses.translation: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

verses.original: אֲבָ֗ל אֲר֤וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ הֶעֱלָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ מִ/קִּרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים בַּֽ/הֵכִ֥ין ל֖/וֹ דָּוִ֑יד כִּ֧י נָֽטָה ל֛/וֹ אֹ֖הֶל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'bl 'rvn h'lhym h'lh dvyd mqryt y'rym bhkhyn lv dvyd khy nth lv 'hl byrvshlm
verses.translation: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/נְּחֹ֗שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ בְּצַלְאֵל֙ בֶּן אוּרִ֣י בֶן ח֔וּר שָׂ֕ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּדְרְשֵׁ֥/הוּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְ/הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vmzbch hnchsht 'shr 'shh btsl'l bn 'vry bn chvr shm lpny mshkhn yhvh vydrshhv shlmh vhqhl
verses.translation: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַל֩ שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה שָׁ֜ם עַל מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛י/ו עֹל֖וֹת אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vy'l shlmh shm 'l mzbch hnchsht lpny yhvh 'shr l'hl mv'd vy'l 'lyv 'lvt 'lf
verses.translation: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

verses.original: בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֔וּא נִרְאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: blylh hhv' nr'h 'lhym lshlmh vy'mr lv sh'l mh 'tn lkh
verses.translation: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים אַתָּ֗ה עָשִׂ֛יתָ עִם דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖/י חֶ֣סֶד גָּד֑וֹל וְ/הִמְלַכְתַּ֖/נִי תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh l'lhym 'th 'shyt 'm dvyd 'by chsd gdvl vhmlkhtny tchtyv
verses.translation: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְ/ךָ֔ עִ֖ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑/י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַכְתַּ֔/נִי עַל עַ֕ם רַ֖ב כַּ/עֲפַ֥ר הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'th yhvh 'lhym y'mn dbrkh 'm dvyd 'by khy 'th hmlkhtny 'l 'm rb kh'pr h'rts
verses.translation: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּ/מַדָּע֙ תֶּן לִ֔/י וְ/אֵֽצְאָ֛ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/אָב֑וֹאָה כִּֽי מִ֣י יִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת עַמְּ/ךָ֥ הַ/זֶּ֖ה הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: 'th chkhmh vmd' tn ly v'ts'h lpny h'm hzh v'bv'h khy my yshpt 't 'mkh hzh hgdvl
verses.translation: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֣ים לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֡ה יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה זֹ֜את עִם לְבָבֶ֗/ךָ וְ/לֹֽא שָׁ֠אַלְתָּ עֹ֣שֶׁר נְכָסִ֤ים וְ/כָבוֹד֙ וְ/אֵת֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/גַם יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לְתָּ וַ/תִּֽשְׁאַל לְ/ךָ֙ חָכְמָ֣ה וּ/מַדָּ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁפּוֹט֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלַכְתִּ֖י/ךָ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym lshlmh y'n 'shr hyth z't 'm lbbkh vl' sh'lt 'shr nkhsym vkhbvd v't npsh shn'ykh vgm ymym rbym l' sh'lt vtsh'l lkh chkhmh vmd' 'shr tshpvt 't 'my 'shr hmlkhtykh 'lyv
verses.translation: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

verses.original: הַֽ/חָכְמָ֥ה וְ/הַ/מַּדָּ֖ע נָת֣וּן לָ֑/ךְ וְ/עֹ֨שֶׁר וּ/נְכָסִ֤ים וְ/כָבוֹד֙ אֶתֶּן לָ֔/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא הָ֣יָה כֵ֗ן לַ/מְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה כֵּֽן
verses.translit: hchkhmh vhmd' ntvn lkh v'shr vnkhsym vkhbvd 'tn lkh 'shr l' hyh khn lmlkhym 'shr lpnykh v'chrykh l' yhyh khn
verses.translation: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לַ/בָּמָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר בְּ/גִבְעוֹן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb' shlmh lbmh 'shr bgb'vn yrvshlm mlpny 'hl mv'd vymlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּ/פָרָשִׁים֒ וַֽ/יְהִי ל֗/וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּ/שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יַּנִּיחֵ/ם֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וְ/עִם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'sf shlmh rkhb vprshym vyhy lv 'lf v'rb' m'vt rkhb vshnym 'shr 'lf prshym vynychm b'ry hrkhb v'm hmlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֧סֶף וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֛ב בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּ/אֲבָנִ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ת הָ/אֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּ/שִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vytn hmlkh 't hkhsf v't hzhb byrvshlm kh'bnym v't h'rzym ntn khshqmym 'shr bshplh lrb
verses.translation: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצָ֧א הַ/סּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וּ/מִ/קְוֵ֕א סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מִ/קְוֵ֥א יִקְח֖וּ בִּ/מְחִֽיר
verses.translit: vmvts' hsvsym 'shr lshlmh mmtsrym vmqv' schry hmlkh mqv' yqchv bmchyr
verses.translation: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/יַּעֲלוּ וַ/יּוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִ/מִּצְרַ֤יִם מֶרְכָּבָה֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/ס֖וּס בַּ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מֵאָ֑ה וְ֠/כֵן לְ/כָל מַלְכֵ֧י הַֽ/חִתִּ֛ים וּ/מַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם בְּ/יָדָ֥/ם יוֹצִֽיאוּ
verses.translit: vy'lv vyvtsy'v mmtsrym mrkhbh bshsh m'vt khsf vsvs bchmshym vm'h vkhn lkhl mlkhy hchtym vmlkhy 'rm bydm yvtsy'v
verses.translation: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְפֹּ֨ר שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ אִ֣ישׁ סַבָּ֔ל וּ/שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ חֹצֵ֣ב בָּ/הָ֑ר וּ/מְנַצְּחִ֣ים עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyspr shlmh shb'ym 'lf 'ysh sbl vshmvnym 'lf 'ysh chtsb bhr vmntschym 'lyhm shlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD , and an house for his kingdom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶל חוּרָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ צֹ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ עִם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔/י וַ/תִּֽשְׁלַֽח ל֣/וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים לִ/בְנֽוֹת ל֥/וֹ בַ֖יִת לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch shlmh 'l chvrm mlkh tsr l'mr kh'shr 'shyt 'm dvyd 'by vtshlch lv 'rzym lbnvt lv byt lshbt bv
verses.translation: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י בֽוֹנֶה בַּ֜יִת לְ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֗/י לְ/הַקְדִּ֣ישׁ ל֡/וֹ לְ/הַקְטִ֣יר לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו קְטֹֽרֶת סַמִּים֩ וּ/מַעֲרֶ֨כֶת תָּמִ֤יד וְ/עֹלוֹת֙ לַ/בֹּ֣קֶר וְ/לָ/עֶ֔רֶב לַ/שַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְ/לֶ֣/חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּֽ/לְ/מוֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם זֹ֥את עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh 'ny bvnh byt lshm yhvh 'lhy lhqdysh lv lhqtyr lpnyv qtrt smym vm'rkht tmyd v'lvt lbqr vl'rb lshbtvt vlchdshym vlmv'dy yhvh 'lhynv l'vlm z't 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֑וֹל כִּֽי גָד֥וֹל אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ מִ/כָּל הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vhbyt 'shr 'ny bvnh gdvl khy gdvl 'lhynv mkhl h'lhym
verses.translation: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֤י יַעֲצָר כֹּ֨חַ֙ לִ/בְנֽוֹת ל֣/וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֧י הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם וּ/שְׁמֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּלֻ֑/הוּ וּ/מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶבְנֶה לּ֣/וֹ בַ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם לְ/הַקְטִ֥יר לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmy y'tsr khch lbnvt lv byt khy hshmym vshmy hshmym l' ykhlkhlhv vmy 'ny 'shr 'bnh lv byt khy 'm lhqtyr lpnyv
verses.translation: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה שְֽׁלַֽח לִ֣/י אִישׁ חָכָ֡ם לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֩ בַּ/זָּהָ֨ב וּ/בַ/כֶּ֜סֶף וּ/בַ/נְּחֹ֣שֶׁת וּ/בַ/בַּרְזֶ֗ל וּ/בָֽ/אַרְגְּוָן֙ וְ/כַרְמִ֣יל וּ/תְכֵ֔לֶת וְ/יֹדֵ֖עַ לְ/פַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתּוּחִ֑ים עִם הַֽ/חֲכָמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עִמִּ/י֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֣ה וּ/בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th shlch ly 'ysh chkhm l'shvt bzhb vbkhsf vbnchsht vbbrzl vb'rgvn vkhrmyl vtkhlt vyd' lptch ptvchym 'm hchkhmym 'shr 'my byhvdh vbyrvshlm 'shr hkhyn dvyd 'by
verses.translation: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

verses.original: וּֽ/שְׁלַֽח לִ/י֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים בְּרוֹשִׁ֣ים וְ/אַלְגּוּמִּים֮ מֵֽ/הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יֽוֹדְעִ֔ים לִ/כְר֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדַ֖/י עִם עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vshlch ly 'tsy 'rzym brvshym v'lgvmym mhlbnvn khy 'ny yd'ty 'shr 'bdykh yvd'ym lkhrvt 'tsy lbnvn vhnh 'bdy 'm 'bdykh
verses.translation: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הָכִ֥ין לִ֛/י עֵצִ֖ים לָ/רֹ֑ב כִּ֥י הַ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֥וֹל וְ/הַפְלֵֽא
verses.translit: vlhkhyn ly 'tsym lrb khy hbyt 'shr 'ny bvnh gdvl vhpl'
verses.translation: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה לַֽ/חֹטְבִ֣ים לְֽ/כֹרְתֵ֣י הָ/עֵצִ֡ים נָתַתִּי֩ חִטִּ֨ים מַכּ֜וֹת לַ/עֲבָדֶ֗י/ךָ כֹּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּ/שְׂעֹרִ֕ים כֹּרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְ/יַ֗יִן בַּתִּים֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְ/שֶׁ֕מֶן בַּתִּ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vhnh lchtbym lkhrty h'tsym ntty chtym mkhvt l'bdykh khrym 'shrym 'lf vsh'rym khrym 'shrym 'lf vyyn btym 'shrym 'lf vshmn btym 'shrym 'lf
verses.translation: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר חוּרָ֤ם מֶֽלֶךְ צֹר֙ בִּ/כְתָ֔ב וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּ/אַהֲבַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ נְתָנְ/ךָ֥ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr chvrm mlkh tsr bkhtb vyshlch 'l shlmh b'hbt yhvh 't 'mv ntnkh 'lyhm mlkh
verses.translation: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ חוּרָם֒ בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַן֩ לְ/דָוִ֨יד הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֗ם יוֹדֵ֨עַ֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּ/בִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְנֶה בַּ֨יִת֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/בַ֖יִת לְ/מַלְכוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr chvrm brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr 'shh 't hshmym v't h'rts 'shr ntn ldvyd hmlkh bn chkhm yvd' shkhl vbynh 'shr ybnh byt lyhvh vbyt lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שָׁלַ֧חְתִּי אִישׁ חָכָ֛ם יוֹדֵ֥עַ בִּינָ֖ה לְ/חוּרָ֥ם אָבִֽי
verses.translit: v'th shlchty 'ysh chkhm yvd' bynh lchvrm 'by
verses.translation: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD , and an house for his kingdom.

verses.original: בֶּן אִשָּׁ֞ה מִן בְּנ֣וֹת דָּ֗ן וְ/אָבִ֣י/ו אִישׁ צֹרִ֡י יוֹדֵ֡עַ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת בַּ/זָּֽהָב וּ֠/בַ/כֶּסֶף בַּ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת בַּ/בַּרְזֶ֜ל בָּ/אֲבָנִ֣ים וּ/בָ/עֵצִ֗ים בָּ/אַרְגָּמָ֤ן בַּ/תְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּ/בַ/בּ֣וּץ וּ/בַ/כַּרְמִ֔יל וּ/לְ/פַתֵּ֨חַ֙ כָּל פִּתּ֔וּחַ וְ/לַ/חְשֹׁ֖ב כָּל מַחֲשָׁ֑בֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנָּֽתֶן ל/וֹ֙ עִם חֲכָמֶ֔י/ךָ וְֽ/חַכְמֵ֔י אֲדֹנִ֖/י דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: bn 'shh mn bnvt dn v'byv 'ysh tsry yvd' l'shvt bzhb vbkhsf bnchsht bbrzl b'bnym vb'tsym b'rgmn btkhlt vbbvts vbkhrmyl vlptch khl ptvch vlchshb khl mchshbt 'shr yntn lv 'm chkhmykh vchkhmy 'dny dvyd 'bykh
verses.translation: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה הַ/חִטִּ֨ים וְ/הַ/שְּׂעֹרִ֜ים הַ/שֶּׁ֤מֶן וְ/הַ/יַּ֨יִן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנִ֔/י יִשְׁלַ֖ח לַ/עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'th hchtym vhsh'rym hshmn vhyyn 'shr 'mr 'dny yshlch l'bdyv
verses.translation: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

verses.original: וַ֠/אֲנַחְנוּ נִכְרֹ֨ת עֵצִ֤ים מִן הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ כְּ/כָל צָרְכֶּ֔/ךָ וּ/נְבִיאֵ֥/ם לְ/ךָ֛ רַפְסֹד֖וֹת עַל יָ֣ם יָפ֑וֹ וְ/אַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖/ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v'nchnv nkhrt 'tsym mn hlbnvn khkhl tsrkhkh vnby'm lkh rpsdvt 'l ym ypv v'th t'lh 'tm yrvshlm
verses.translation: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְפֹּ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה כָּל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הַ/גֵּירִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/סְּפָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְפָרָ֖/ם דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמָּצְא֗וּ מֵאָ֤ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyspr shlmh khl h'nshym hgyrym 'shr b'rts yshr'l 'chry hspr 'shr sprm dvyd 'byv vymts'v m'h vchmshym 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ מֵ/הֶ֜ם שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ סַבָּ֔ל וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֹצֵ֣ב בָּ/הָ֑ר וּ/שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת מְנַצְּחִ֖ים לְ/הַעֲבִ֥יד אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'sh mhm shb'ym 'lf sbl vshmnym 'lf chtsb bhr vshlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt mntschym lh'byd 't h'm
verses.translation: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣חֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִ/בְנ֤וֹת אֶת בֵּית יְהוָה֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ/הַר֙ הַ/מּ֣וֹרִיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִרְאָ֖ה לְ/דָוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י/הוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵכִין֙ בִּ/מְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֔יד בְּ/גֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vychl shlmh lbnvt 't byt yhvh byrvshlm bhr hmvryh 'shr nr'h ldvyd 'byhv 'shr hkhyn bmqvm dvyd bgrn 'rnn hybvsy
verses.translation: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּחֶל לִ/בְנ֞וֹת בַּ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ בַּ/שֵּׁנִ֔י בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֖ע לְ/מַלְכוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychl lbnvt bchdsh hshny bshny bshnt 'rb' lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הוּסַ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִ/בְנ֖וֹת אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים הָ/אֹ֡רֶךְ אַמּ֞וֹת בַּ/מִּדָּ֤ה הָ/רִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ אַמּ֣וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֔ים וְ/רֹ֖חַב אַמּ֥וֹת עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: v'lh hvsd shlmh lbnvt 't byt h'lhym h'rkh 'mvt bmdh hr'shvnh 'mvt shshym vrchb 'mvt 'shrym
verses.translation: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אוּלָ֡ם אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל פְּנֵ֨י הָ/אֹ֜רֶךְ עַל פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְ/הַ/גֹּ֖בַהּ מֵאָ֣ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַ/יְצַפֵּ֥/הוּ מִ/פְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vh'vlm 'shr 'l pny h'rkh 'l pny rchb hbyt 'mvt 'shrym vhgbh m'h v'shrym vytsphv mpnymh zhb thvr
verses.translation: And the porch that was in the front of the house , the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/גָּד֗וֹל חִפָּה֙ עֵ֣ץ בְּרוֹשִׁ֔ים וַ/יְחַפֵּ֖/הוּ זָהָ֣ב ט֑וֹב וַ/יַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛י/ו תִּמֹרִ֖ים וְ/שַׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't hbyt hgdvl chph 'ts brvshym vychphv zhb tvb vy'l 'lyv tmrym vshrshrvt
verses.translation: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֧ף אֶת הַ/בַּ֛יִת אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה לְ/תִפְאָ֑רֶת וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֖ב זְהַ֥ב פַּרְוָֽיִם
verses.translit: vytsf 't hbyt 'bn yqrh ltp'rt vhzhb zhb prvym
verses.translation: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַ֨ף אֶת הַ/בַּ֜יִת הַ/קֹּר֧וֹת הַ/סִּפִּ֛ים וְ/קִֽירוֹתָ֥י/ו וְ/דַלְתוֹתָ֖י/ו זָהָ֑ב וּ/פִתַּ֥ח כְּרוּבִ֖ים עַל הַ/קִּירֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychf 't hbyt hqrvt hspym vqyrvtyv vdltvtyv zhb vptch khrvbym 'l hqyrvt
verses.translation: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת בֵּֽית קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֔ים אָרְכּ֞/וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְ/רָחְבּ֖/וֹ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַ/יְחַפֵּ֨/הוּ֙ זָהָ֣ב ט֔וֹב לְ/כִכָּרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'sh 't byt qdsh hqdshym 'rkhv 'l pny rchb hbyt 'mvt 'shrym vrchbv 'mvt 'shrym vychphv zhb tvb lkhkhrym shsh m'vt
verses.translation: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁקָ֛ל לְ/מִסְמְר֥וֹת לִ/שְׁקָלִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים זָהָ֑ב וְ/הָ/עֲלִיּ֖וֹת חִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vmshql lmsmrvt lshqlym chmshym zhb vh'lyvt chph zhb
verses.translation: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ בְּ/בֵֽית קֹ֤דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁים֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה צַעֲצֻעִ֑ים וַ/יְצַפּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vy'sh bbyt qdsh hqdshym khrvbym shnym m'shh ts'ts'ym vytspv 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.original: וְ/כַנְפֵי֙ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֔ים אָרְכָּ֖/ם אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים כְּנַ֨ף הָ/אֶחָ֜ד לְ/אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֗שׁ מַגַּ֨עַת֙ לְ/קִ֣יר הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/הַ/כָּנָ֤ף הָ/אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֕יעַ לִ/כְנַ֖ף הַ/כְּר֥וּב הָ/אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vkhnpy hkhrvbym 'rkhm 'mvt 'shrym khnf h'chd l'mvt chmsh mg't lqyr hbyt vhkhnf h'chrt 'mvt chmsh mgy' lkhnf hkhrvb h'chr
verses.translation: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.original: וּ/כְנַ֨ף הַ/כְּר֤וּב הָ/אֶחָד֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֖יעַ לְ/קִ֣יר הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/הַ/כָּנָ֤ף הָ/אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ דְּבֵקָ֕ה לִ/כְנַ֖ף הַ/כְּר֥וּב הָ/אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vkhnf hkhrvb h'chd 'mvt chmsh mgy' lqyr hbyt vhkhnf h'chrt 'mvt chmsh dbqh lkhnf hkhrvb h'chr
verses.translation: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also , joining to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.original: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וְ/הֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֥ם לַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: khnpy hkhrvbym h'lh prshym 'mvt 'shrym vhm 'mdym 'l rglyhm vpnyhm lbyt
verses.translation: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ אֶת הַ/פָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְ/כַרְמִ֣יל וּ/ב֑וּץ וַ/יַּ֥עַל עָלָ֖י/ו כְּרוּבִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hprkht tkhlt v'rgmn vkhrmyl vbvts vy'l 'lyv khrvbym
verses.translation: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם אַמּ֕וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/חָמֵ֖שׁ אֹ֑רֶךְ וְ/הַ/צֶּ֥פֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ אַמּ֥וֹת חָמֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'sh lpny hbyt 'mvdym shnym 'mvt shlshym vchmsh 'rkh vhtspt 'shr 'l r'shv 'mvt chmsh
verses.translation: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת֙ בַּ/דְּבִ֔יר וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/עַמֻּדִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ רִמּוֹנִים֙ מֵאָ֔ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן בַּֽ/שַּׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'sh shrshrvt bdbyr vytn 'l r'sh h'mdym vy'sh rmvnym m'h vytn bshrshrvt
verses.translation: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קֶם אֶת הָֽ/עַמּוּדִים֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/הֵיכָ֔ל אֶחָ֥ד מִ/יָּמִ֖ין וְ/אֶחָ֣ד מֵֽ/הַ/שְּׂמֹ֑אול וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם ה/ימיני הַ/יְמָנִי֙ יָכִ֔ין וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֖י בֹּֽעַז
verses.translit: vyqm 't h'mvdym 'l pny hhykhl 'chd mymyn v'chd mhshm'vl vyqr' shm hymyny hymny ykhyn vshm hshm'ly b'z
verses.translation: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh mzbch nchsht 'shrym 'mh 'rkhv v'shrym 'mh rchbv v'shr 'mvt qvmtv
verses.translation: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּֽ֠/אַמָּה מִ/שְּׂפָת֨/וֹ אֶל שְׂפָת֜/וֹ עָג֣וֹל סָבִ֗יב וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽ/אַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔/וֹ וְ/קָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hym mvtsq 'shr b'mh mshptv 'l shptv 'gvl sbyb vchmsh b'mh qvmtv vqv shlshym b'mh ysb 'tv sbyb
verses.translation: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

verses.original: וּ/דְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜/וֹ סָבִ֤יב סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔/וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַ/בָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּ/מֻֽצַקְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vdmvt bqrym tcht lv sbyb sbyb svbbym 'tv 'shr b'mh mqypym 't hym sbyb shnym tvrym hbqr ytsvqym bmtsqtv
verses.translation: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

verses.original: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים צָפ֡וֹנָ/ה וּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים יָ֜מָּ/ה וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּ/ה וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה וְ/הַ/יָּ֥ם עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/כָל אֲחֹרֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: 'vmd 'l shnym 'shr bqr shlshh pnym tspvnh vshlvshh pnym ymh vshlshh pnym ngbh vshlshh pnym mzrchh vhym 'lyhm mlm'lh vkhl 'chryhm byth
verses.translation: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

verses.original: וְ/עָבְי֣/וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּ/שְׂפָת/וֹ֙ כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל
verses.translit: v'byv tpch vshptv khm'shh shpt khvs prch shvshnh mchzyq btym shlsht 'lpym ykhyl
verses.translation: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠/יִּתֵּן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִ/יָּמִ֜ין וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִ/שְּׂמֹאול֙ לְ/רָחְצָ֣ה בָ/הֶ֔ם אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָ/עוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑/ם וְ/הַ/יָּ֕ם לְ/רָחְצָ֥ה לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh khyvrym 'shrh vytn chmshh mymyn vchmshh mshm'vl lrchtsh bhm 't m'shh h'vlh ydychv bm vhym lrchtsh lkhhnym bv
verses.translation: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּעַשׂ אֶת מְנֹר֧וֹת הַ/זָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֑/ם וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽ/הֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִ/יָּמִ֖ין וְ/חָמֵ֥שׁ מִ/שְּׂמֹֽאול
verses.translit: vy'sh 't mnrvt hzhb 'shr khmshptm vytn bhykhl chmsh mymyn vchmsh mshm'vl
verses.translation: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ/יַּנַּח֙ בַּֽ/הֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִ/יָּמִ֖ין וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִ/שְּׂמֹ֑אול וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh shlchnvt 'shrh vynch bhykhl chmshh mymyn vchmshh mshm'vl vy'sh mzrqy zhb m'h
verses.translation: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְ/הָ/עֲזָרָ֖ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּ/דְלָת֧וֹת לָ/עֲזָרָ֛ה וְ/דַלְתוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vy'sh chtsr hkhhnym vh'zrh hgdvlh vdltvt l'zrh vdltvtyhm tsph nchsht
verses.translation: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִ/כֶּ֧תֶף הַ/יְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָ/ה מִ/מּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: v't hym ntn mkhtf hymnyt qdmh mmvl ngbh
verses.translation: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶת הַ֨/סִּיר֔וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַ/יְכַ֣ל חירם חוּרָ֗ם לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּ/בֵ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh chvrm 't hsyrvt v't hy'ym v't hmzrqvt vykhl chyrm chvrm l'shvt 't hml'khh 'shr 'shh lmlkh shlmh bbyt h'lhym
verses.translation: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

verses.original: עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְ/הַ/גֻּלּ֧וֹת וְ/הַ/כֹּתָר֛וֹת עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/עַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְ/הַ/שְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ/כַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַ/כֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: 'mvdym shnym vhglvt vhkhtrvt 'l r'sh h'mvdym shtym vhshbkhvt shtym lkhsvt 't shty glvt hkhtrvt 'shr 'l r'sh h'mvdym
verses.translation: To wit , the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָֽ/רִמּוֹנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/שְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנַ֨יִם טוּרִ֤ים רִמּוֹנִים֙ לַ/שְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָ/אֶחָ֔ת לְ/כַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַ/כֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: v't hrmvnym 'rb' m'vt lshty hshbkhvt shnym tvrym rmvnym lshbkhh h'cht lkhsvt 't shty glvt hkhtrvt 'shr 'l pny h'mvdym
verses.translation: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה וְ/אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּר֥וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה עַל הַ/מְּכֹנֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't hmkhnvt 'shh v't hkhyrvt 'shh 'l hmkhnvt
verses.translation: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

verses.original: אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם אֶחָ֑ד וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: 't hym 'chd v't hbqr shnym 'shr tchtyv
verses.translation: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֠/סִּירוֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֤ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל כְּלֵי/הֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק
verses.translit: v't hsyrvt v't hy'ym v't hmzlgvt v't khl khlyhm 'shh chvrm 'byv lmlkh shlmh lbyt yhvh nchsht mrvq
verses.translation: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.

verses.original: בְּ/כִכַּ֤ר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣/ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּ/עֲבִ֖י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּ/בֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: bkhkhr hyrdn ytsqm hmlkh b'by h'dmh byn skhvt vbyn tsrdth
verses.translation: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לָ/רֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַ/נְּחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh khl hkhlym h'lh lrb m'd khy l' nchqr mshql hnchsht
verses.translation: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/אֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/זָּהָ֔ב וְ/אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַ/פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh 't khl hkhlym 'shr byt h'lhym v't mzbch hzhb v't hshlchnvt v'lyhm lchm hpnym
verses.translation: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנֹר֞וֹת וְ/נֵרֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם לְ/בַעֲרָ֧/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/דְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר
verses.translit: v't hmnrvt vnrtyhm lb'rm khmshpt lpny hdbyr zhb sgvr
verses.translation: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/פֶּ֧רַח וְ/הַ/נֵּר֛וֹת וְ/הַ/מֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vhprch vhnrvt vhmlqchym zhb hv' mkhlvt zhb
verses.translation: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/מְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְ/הַ/מִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְ/הַ/כַּפּ֥וֹת וְ/הַ/מַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וּ/פֶ֣תַח הַ֠/בַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨י/ו הַ/פְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְ/קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְ/דַלְתֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֛יִת לַ/הֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vhmzmrvt vhmzrqvt vhkhpvt vhmchtvt zhb sgvr vptch hbyt dltvtyv hpnymyvt lqdsh hqdshym vdlty hbyt lhykhl zhb
verses.translation: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place , and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁלַם֙ כָּל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֣י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֗י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָב֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּ/אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vtshlm khl hml'khh 'shr 'shh shlmh lbyt yhvh vyb' shlmh 't qdshy dvyd 'byv v't hkhsf v't hzhb v't khl hkhlym ntn b'tsrvt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

verses.original: אָז֩ יַקְהֵ֨יל שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/אֶת כָּל רָאשֵׁ֨י הַ/מַּטּ֜וֹת נְשִׂיאֵ֧י הָ/אָב֛וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְֽ/הַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֛ה מֵ/עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'z yqhyl shlmh 't zqny yshr'l v't khl r'shy hmtvt nshy'y h'bvt lbny yshr'l 'l yrvshlm lh'lvt 't 'rvn bryt yhvh m'yr dvyd hy' tsyvn
verses.translation: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּהֲל֧וּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ כָּל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּ/חָ֑ג ה֖וּא הַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִעִֽי
verses.translit: vyqhlv 'l hmlkh khl 'ysh yshr'l bchg hv' hchdsh hshb'y
verses.translation: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם אֶת הָ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyb'v khl zqny yshr'l vysh'v hlvym 't h'rvn
verses.translation: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֤וּ אֶת הָ/אָרוֹן֙ וְ/אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/אֶת כָּל כְּלֵ֥י הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/אֹ֑הֶל הֶעֱל֣וּ אֹתָ֔/ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'lv 't h'rvn v't 'hl mv'd v't khl khly hqdsh 'shr b'hl h'lv 'tm hkhhnym hlvym
verses.translation: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְ/כָל עֲדַ֧ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַ/נּוֹעָדִ֥ים עָלָ֖י/ו לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/אָר֑וֹן מְזַבְּחִים֙ צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יִסָּפְר֛וּ וְ/לֹ֥א יִמָּנ֖וּ מֵ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh vkhl 'dt yshr'l hnv'dym 'lyv lpny h'rvn mzbchym ts'n vbqr 'shr l' ysprv vl' ymnv mrb
verses.translation: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֣יאוּ הַ֠/כֹּהֲנִים אֶת אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֧ה אֶל מְקוֹמ֛/וֹ אֶל דְּבִ֥יר הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֶל קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קְּדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵ֥י הַ/כְּרוּבִֽים
verses.translit: vyby'v hkhhnym 't 'rvn bryt yhvh 'l mqvmv 'l dbyr hbyt 'l qdsh hqdshym 'l tcht khnpy hkhrvbym
verses.translation: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ הַ/כְּרוּבִים֙ פֹּרְשִׂ֣ים כְּנָפַ֔יִם עַל מְק֖וֹם הָ/אָר֑וֹן וַ/יְכַסּ֧וּ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֛ים עַל הָ/אָר֥וֹן וְ/עַל בַּדָּ֖י/ו מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhyv hkhrvbym prshym khnpym 'l mqvm h'rvn vykhsv hkhrvbym 'l h'rvn v'l bdyv mlm'lh
verses.translation: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּאֲרִיכוּ֮ הַ/בַּדִּים֒ וַ/יֵּרָאוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַ/בַּדִּ֤ים מִן הָ/אָרוֹן֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/דְּבִ֔יר וְ/לֹ֥א יֵרָא֖וּ הַ/ח֑וּצָ/ה וַֽ/יְהִי שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'rykhv hbdym vyr'v r'shy hbdym mn h'rvn 'l pny hdbyr vl' yr'v hchvtsh vyhy shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And they drew out the staves of the ark , that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

verses.original: אֵ֚ין בָּֽ/אָר֔וֹן רַ֚ק שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/לֻּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/חֹרֵ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'yn b'rvn rq shny hlchvt 'shr ntn mshh bchrb 'shr khrt yhvh 'm bny yshr'l bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt. : or, where, etc

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י בְּ/צֵ֥את הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מִן הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֠י כָּל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽ/נִּמְצְאִים֙ הִתְקַדָּ֔שׁוּ אֵ֖ין לִ/שְׁמ֥וֹר לְ/מַחְלְקֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy bts't hkhhnym mn hqdsh khy khl hkhhnym hnmts'ym htqdshv 'yn lshmvr lmchlqvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם הַ/מְשֹׁרֲרִ֣ים לְ/כֻלָּ֡/ם לְ/אָסָ֡ף לְ/הֵימָ֣ן לִֽ֠/ידֻתוּן וְ/לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֨ם וְ/לַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֜ם מְלֻבָּשִׁ֣ים בּ֗וּץ בִּ/מְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ וּ/בִ/נְבָלִ֣ים וְ/כִנֹּר֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים מִזְרָ֣ח לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֤ם כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְ/מֵאָ֣ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֔ים מחצררים מַחְצְרִ֖ים בַּ/חֲצֹֽצְרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhlvym hmshrrym lkhlm l'sf lhymn lydtvn vlbnyhm vl'chyhm mlbshym bvts bmtsltym vbnblym vkhnrvt 'mdym mzrch lmzbch v'mhm khhnym lm'h v'shrym mchtsrrym mchtsrym bchtstsrvt
verses.translation: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְ֠/אֶחָד ל/מחצצרים לַ/מְחַצְּרִ֨ים וְ/לַ/מְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֜ים לְ/הַשְׁמִ֣יעַ קוֹל אֶחָ֗ד לְ/הַלֵּ֣ל וּ/לְ/הֹדוֹת֮ לַ/יהוָה֒ וּ/כְ/הָרִ֣ים ק֠וֹל בַּ/חֲצֹצְר֨וֹת וּ/בִ/מְצִלְתַּ֜יִם וּ/בִ/כְלֵ֣י הַ/שִּׁ֗יר וּ/בְ/הַלֵּ֤ל לַ/יהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/הַ/בַּ֛יִת מָלֵ֥א עָנָ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy kh'chd lmchtstsrym lmchtsrym vlmshrrym lhshmy' qvl 'chd lhll vlhdvt lyhvh vkhhrym qvl bchtstsrvt vbmtsltym vbkhly hshyr vbhll lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv vhbyt ml' 'nn byt yhvh
verses.translation: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD ; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD , saying , For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD ;

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָֽכְל֧וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים לַ/עֲמ֥וֹד לְ/שָׁרֵ֖ת מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הֶ/עָנָ֑ן כִּֽי מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv hkhhnym l'mvd lshrt mpny h'nn khy ml' khbvd yhvh 't byt h'lhym
verses.translation: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.

verses.original: אָ֖ז אָמַ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה יְהוָ֣ה אָמַ֔ר לִ/שְׁכּ֖וֹן בָּ/עֲרָפֶֽל
verses.translit: 'z 'mr shlmh yhvh 'mr lshkhvn b'rpl
verses.translation: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.original: וַֽ/אֲנִ֛י בָּנִ֥יתִי בֵית זְבֻ֖ל לָ֑/ךְ וּ/מָכ֥וֹן לְ/שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֖ עוֹלָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'ny bnyty byt zbl lkh vmkhvn lshbtkh 'vlmym
verses.translation: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסֵּ֤ב הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת פָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כָל קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עוֹמֵֽד
verses.translit: vysb hmlkh 't pnyv vybrkh 't khl qhl yshr'l vkhl qhl yshr'l 'vmd
verses.translation: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּ/פִ֔י/ו אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑/י וּ/בְ/יָדָ֥י/ו מִלֵּ֖א לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr dbr bpyv 't dvyd 'by vbydyv ml' l'mr
verses.translation: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

verses.original: מִן הַ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֣אתִי אֶת עַמִּ/י֮ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ לֹא בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְ/עִ֗יר מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לִ/הְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖/י שָׁ֑ם וְ/לֹא בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְ/אִ֔ישׁ לִ/הְי֥וֹת נָגִ֖יד עַל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: mn hyvm 'shr hvts'ty 't 'my m'rts mtsrym l' bchrty b'yr mkhl shbty yshr'l lbnvt byt lhyvt shmy shm vl' bchrty b'ysh lhyvt ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

verses.original: וָ/אֶבְחַר֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/הְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖/י שָׁ֑ם וָ/אֶבְחַ֣ר בְּ/דָוִ֔יד לִ/הְי֖וֹת עַל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'bchr byrvshlm lhyvt shmy shm v'bchr bdvyd lhyvt 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י עִם לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑/י לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy 'm lbb dvyd 'by lbnvt byt lshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔/י יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיָה֙ עִם לְבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ לִ/בְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לִ/שְׁמִ֑/י הֱֽטִיב֔וֹתָ כִּ֥י הָיָ֖ה עִם לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l dvyd 'by y'n 'shr hyh 'm lbbkh lbnvt byt lshmy htybvt khy hyh 'm lbbkh
verses.translation: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

verses.original: רַ֣ק אַתָּ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבְנֶ֖ה הַ/בָּ֑יִת כִּ֤י בִנְ/ךָ֙ הַ/יּוֹצֵ֣א מֵֽ/חֲלָצֶ֔י/ךָ הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה הַ/בַּ֖יִת לִ/שְׁמִֽ/י
verses.translit: rq 'th l' tbnh hbyt khy bnkh hyvts' mchltsykh hv' ybnh hbyt lshmy
verses.translation: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת דְּבָר֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וָ/אָק֡וּם תַּחַת֩ דָּוִ֨יד אָבִ֜/י וָ/אֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וָ/אֶבְנֶ֣ה הַ/בַּ֔יִת לְ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm yhvh 't dbrv 'shr dbr v'qvm tcht dvyd 'by v'shb 'l khs' yshr'l kh'shr dbr yhvh v'bnh hbyt lshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וָ/אָשִׂ֥ים שָׁם֙ אֶת הָ֣/אָר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'shym shm 't h'rvn 'shr shm bryt yhvh 'shr khrt 'm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD , that he made with the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֗ד לִ/פְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּפְרֹ֖שׂ כַּפָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'md lpny mzbch yhvh ngd khl qhl yshr'l vyprsh khpyv
verses.translation: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

verses.original: כִּֽי עָשָׂ֨ה שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה כִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ/הוּ֮ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עֲזָרָה֒ חָמֵ֨שׁ אַמּ֜וֹת אָרְכּ֗/וֹ וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ רָחְבּ֔/וֹ וְ/אַמּ֥וֹת שָׁל֖וֹשׁ קוֹמָת֑/וֹ וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד עָלָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּבְרַ֤ךְ עַל בִּרְכָּי/ו֙ נֶ֚גֶד כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖י/ו הַ/שָּׁמָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: khy 'shh shlmh khyvr nchsht vytnhv btvkh h'zrh chmsh 'mvt 'rkhv vchmsh 'mvt rchbv v'mvt shlvsh qvmtv vy'md 'lyv vybrkh 'l brkhyv ngd khl qhl yshr'l vyprsh khpyv hshmymh
verses.translation: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵין כָּמ֣וֹ/ךָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/בָ/אָ֑רֶץ שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַ/בְּרִית֙ וְֽ/הַ/חֶ֔סֶד לַ/עֲבָדֶ֕י/ךָ הַ/הֹלְכִ֥ים לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לִבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'yn khmvkh 'lhym bshmym vb'rts shmr hbryt vhchsd l'bdykh hhlkhym lpnykh bkhl lbm
verses.translation: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

verses.translit: 'shr shmrt l'bdkh dvyd 'by 't 'shr dbrt lv vtdbr bpykh vbydkh ml't khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹר לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֨ דָוִ֤יד אָבִ/י֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּ/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹא יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְ/ךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִ/לְּ/פָנַ֔/י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֜י/ךָ אֶת דַּרְכָּ֗/ם לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹרָתִ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhy yshr'l shmr l'bdkh dvyd 'by 't 'shr dbrt lv l'mr l' ykhrt lkh 'ysh mlpny yvshb 'l khs' yshr'l rq 'm yshmrv bnykh 't drkhm llkht btvrty kh'shr hlkht lpny
verses.translation: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ לְ/דָוִֽיד
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhy yshr'l y'mn dbrkh 'shr dbrt l'bdkh ldvyd
verses.translation: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַֽ/אֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָ/אָדָ֖ם עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּה שָׁמַ֜יִם וּ/שְׁמֵ֤י הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּ/ךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי
verses.translit: khy h'mnm yshb 'lhym 't h'dm 'l h'rts hnh shmym vshmy hshmym l' ykhlkhlvkh 'f khy hbyt hzh 'shr bnyty
verses.translation: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

verses.original: וּ/פָנִ֜יתָ אֶל תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ וְ/אֶל תְּחִנָּת֖/וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י לִ/שְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל הָ/רִנָּה֙ וְ/אֶל הַ/תְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vpnyt 'l tplt 'bdkh v'l tchntv yhvh 'lhy lshm' 'l hrnh v'l htplh 'shr 'bdkh mtpll lpnykh
verses.translation: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

verses.original: לִ/הְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ פְתֻח֜וֹת אֶל הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַ֔יְלָה אֶל הַ֨/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ לָ/שׂ֥וּם שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם לִ/שְׁמ֨וֹעַ֙ אֶל הַ/תְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: lhyvt 'ynykh ptchvt 'l hbyt hzh yvmm vlylh 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mrt lshvm shmkh shm lshmv' 'l htplh 'shr ytpll 'bdkh 'l hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל תַּחֲנוּנֵ֤י עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ֠/אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע מִ/מְּק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְ/סָלָֽחְתָּ
verses.translit: vshm't 'l tchnvny 'bdkh v'mkh yshr'l 'shr ytpllv 'l hmqvm hzh v'th tshm' mmqvm shbtkh mn hshmym vshm't vslcht
verses.translation: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

verses.original: אִם יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְ/רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/נָֽשָׁא ב֥/וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְ/הַֽאֲלֹת֑/וֹ וּ/בָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲ/ךָ֖ בַּ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'm ycht' 'ysh lr'hv vnsh' bv 'lh lh'ltv vb' 'lh lpny mzbchkh bbyt hzh
verses.translation: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תִּשְׁמַ֣ע מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ וְ/שָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב לְ/רָשָׁ֔ע לָ/תֵ֥ת דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ בְּ/רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וּ/לְ/הַצְדִּ֣יק צַדִּ֔יק לָ֥/תֶת ל֖/וֹ כְּ/צִדְקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th tshm' mn hshmym v'shyt vshptt 't 'bdykh lhshyb lrsh' ltt drkhv br'shv vlhtsdyq tsdyq ltt lv khtsdqtv
verses.translation: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

verses.original: וְֽ/אִם יִנָּגֵ֞ף עַמְּ/ךָ֧ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י אוֹיֵ֖ב כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/שָׁ֨בוּ֙ וְ/הוֹד֣וּ אֶת שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הִתְפַּֽלְל֧וּ וְ/הִֽתְחַנְּנ֛וּ לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'm yngf 'mkh yshr'l lpny 'vyb khy ycht'v lkh vshbv vhvdv 't shmkh vhtpllv vhtchnnv lpnykh bbyt hzh
verses.translation: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/סָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ לְ/חַטַּ֖את עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/הֲשֵׁיבוֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th tshm' mn hshmym vslcht lcht't 'mkh yshr'l vhshybvtm 'l h'dmh 'shr ntth lhm vl'btyhm
verses.translation: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

verses.original: בְּ/הֵעָצֵ֧ר הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה מָטָ֖ר כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הִֽתְפַּלְל֞וּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/הוֹד֣וּ אֶת שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ מֵ/חַטָּאתָ֥/ם יְשׁוּב֖וּ/ן כִּ֥י תַעֲנֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: bh'tsr hshmym vl' yhyh mtr khy ycht'v lkh vhtpllv 'l hmqvm hzh vhvdv 't shmkh mcht'tm yshvbvn khy t'nm
verses.translation: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/סָ֨לַחְתָּ֜ לְ/חַטַּ֤את עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תוֹרֵ֛/ם אֶל הַ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽלְכוּ בָ֑/הּ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה מָטָר֙ עַֽל אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/נַחֲלָֽה
