verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym vslcht lcht't 'bdykh v'mkh yshr'l khy tvrm 'l hdrkh htvbh 'shr ylkhv bh vntth mtr 'l 'rtskh 'shr ntth l'mkh lnchlh
verses.translation: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

verses.original: רָעָ֞ב כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֣ה בָ/אָ֗רֶץ דֶּ֣בֶר כִּֽי יִֽ֠הְיֶה שִׁדָּפ֨וֹן וְ/יֵרָק֜וֹן אַרְבֶּ֤ה וְ/חָסִיל֙ כִּ֣י יִהְיֶ֔ה כִּ֧י יָֽצַר ל֛/וֹ אוֹיְבָ֖י/ו בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ שְׁעָרָ֑י/ו כָּל נֶ֖גַע וְ/כָֽל מַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: r'b khy yhyh b'rts dbr khy yhyh shdpvn vyrqvn 'rbh vchsyl khy yhyh khy ytsr lv 'vybyv b'rts sh'ryv khl ng' vkhl mchlh
verses.translation: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

verses.original: כָּל תְּפִלָּ֣ה כָל תְּחִנָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ לְ/כָל הָ֣/אָדָ֔ם וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵדְע֗וּ אִ֤ישׁ נִגְע/וֹ֙ וּ/מַכְאֹב֔/וֹ וּ/פָרַ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khl tplh khl tchnh 'shr yhyh lkhl h'dm vlkhl 'mkh yshr'l 'shr yd'v 'ysh ng'v vmkh'bv vprsh khpyv 'l hbyt hzh
verses.translation: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

verses.original: וְ֠/אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֨ע מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם מְכ֤וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֨/ךָ֙ וְ/סָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה לָ/אִישׁ֙ כְּ/כָל דְּרָכָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּדַ֖ע אֶת לְבָב֑/וֹ כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ לְ/בַדְּ/ךָ֣ יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֶת לְבַ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: v'th tshm' mn hshmym mkhvn shbtkh vslcht vntth l'ysh khkhl drkhyv 'shr td' 't lbbv khy 'th lbdkh yd't 't lbb bny h'dm
verses.translation: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יִֽירָא֗וּ/ךָ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ בִּ/דְרָכֶ֔י/ךָ כָּל הַ֨/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לַ/אֲבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: lm'n yyr'vkh llkht bdrkhykh khl hymym 'shr hm chyym 'l pny h'dmh 'shr ntth l'btynv
verses.translation: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֶל הַ/נָּכְרִ֗י אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֥א מֵ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ הוּא֒ וּ/בָ֣א מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֗ה לְמַ֨עַן שִׁמְ/ךָ֤ הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ וְ/יָדְ/ךָ֣ הַ/חֲזָקָ֔ה וּֽ/זְרֽוֹעֲ/ךָ֖ הַ/נְּטוּיָ֑ה וּ/בָ֥אוּ וְ/הִֽתְפַּלְל֖וּ אֶל הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'l hnkhry 'shr l' m'mkh yshr'l hv' vb' m'rts rchvqh lm'n shmkh hgdvl vydkh hchzqh vzrv'kh hntvyh vb'v vhtpllv 'l hbyt hzh
verses.translation: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name’s sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה תִּשְׁמַ֤ע מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מְּכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֕יתָ כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥א אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/נָּכְרִ֑י לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְעוּ֩ כָל עַמֵּ֨י הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֶת שְׁמֶ֗/ךָ וּ/לְ/יִרְאָ֤ה אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ כְּ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לָ/דַ֕עַת כִּֽי שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי
verses.translit: v'th tshm' mn hshmym mmkhvn shbtkh v'shyt khkhl 'shr yqr' 'lykh hnkhry lm'n yd'v khl 'my h'rts 't shmkh vlyr'h 'tkh kh'mkh yshr'l vld't khy shmkh nqr' 'l hbyt hzh 'shr bnyty
verses.translation: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

verses.original: כִּֽי יֵצֵ֨א עַמְּ/ךָ֤ לַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל א֣וֹיְבָ֔י/ו בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֑/ם וְ/הִתְפַּֽלְל֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתָּ בָּ֔/הּ וְ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנִ֥יתִי לִ/שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy yts' 'mkh lmlchmh 'l 'vybyv bdrkh 'shr tshlchm vhtpllv 'lykh drkh h'yr hz't 'shr bchrt bh vhbyt 'shr bnyty lshmkh
verses.translation: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם אֶת תְּפִלָּתָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת תְּחִנָּתָ֑/ם וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshm't mn hshmym 't tpltm v't tchntm v'shyt mshptm
verses.translation: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ לָ֗/ךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יֶחֱטָ֔א וְ/אָנַפְתָּ֣ בָ֔/ם וּ/נְתַתָּ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וְ/שָׁב֧וּ/ם שׁוֹבֵי/הֶ֛ם אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֖ה א֥וֹ קְרוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: khy ycht'v lkh khy 'yn 'dm 'shr l' ycht' v'npt bm vnttm lpny 'vyb vshbvm shvbyhm 'l 'rts rchvqh 'v qrvbh
verses.translation: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

verses.original: וְ/הֵשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ אֶל לְבָבָ֔/ם בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ שָׁ֑ם וְ/שָׁ֣בוּ וְ/הִֽתְחַנְּנ֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ שִׁבְיָ/ם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר חָטָ֥אנוּ הֶעֱוִ֖ינוּ וְ/רָשָֽׁעְנוּ
verses.translit: vhshybv 'l lbbm b'rts 'shr nshbv shm vshbv vhtchnnv 'lykh b'rts shbym l'mr cht'nv h'vynv vrsh'nv
verses.translation: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣בוּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לִבָּ/ם֙ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשָׁ֔/ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁר שָׁב֣וּ אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/הִֽתְפַּֽלְל֗וּ דֶּ֤רֶךְ אַרְצָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתָּ וְ/לַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנִ֥יתִי לִ/שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vshbv 'lykh bkhl lbm vbkhl npshm b'rts shbym 'shr shbv 'tm vhtpllv drkh 'rtsm 'shr ntth l'bvtm vh'yr 'shr bchrt vlbyt 'shr bnyty lshmkh
verses.translation: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֨ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם מִ/מְּכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֗ אֶת תְּפִלָּתָ/ם֙ וְ/אֶת תְּחִנֹּ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָ֑/ם וְ/סָלַחְתָּ֥ לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָֽטְאוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vshm't mn hshmym mmkhvn shbtkh 't tpltm v't tchntyhm v'shyt mshptm vslcht l'mkh 'shr cht'v lkh
verses.translation: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗/י יִֽהְיוּ נָ֤א עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ פְּתֻח֔וֹת וְ/אָזְנֶ֖י/ךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לִ/תְפִלַּ֖ת הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'th 'lhy yhyv n' 'ynykh ptchvt v'znykh qshbvt ltplt hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה קוּמָ֞/ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְֽ/נוּחֶ֔/ךָ אַתָּ֖ה וַ/אֲר֣וֹן עֻזֶּ֑/ךָ כֹּהֲנֶ֜י/ךָ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ תְשׁוּעָ֔ה וַ/חֲסִידֶ֖י/ךָ יִשְׂמְח֥וּ בַ/טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: v'th qvmh yhvh 'lhym lnvchkh 'th v'rvn 'zkh khhnykh yhvh 'lhym ylbshv tshv'h vchsydykh yshmchv btvb
verses.translation: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל תָּשֵׁ֖ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶ֑י/ךָ זָכְרָ֕/ה לְ/חַֽסְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhym 'l tshb pny mshychykh zkhrh lchsdy dvyd 'bdkh
verses.translation: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/כַלּ֤וֹת שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וְ/הָ/אֵ֗שׁ יָֽרְדָה֙ מֵֽ/הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/תֹּ֥אכַל הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/הַ/זְּבָחִ֑ים וּ/כְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה מָלֵ֥א אֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vkhkhlvt shlmh lhtpll vh'sh yrdh mhshmym vt'khl h'lh vhzbchym vkhbvd yhvh ml' 't hbyt
verses.translation: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לָ/ב֖וֹא אֶל בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv hkhhnym lbv' 'l byt yhvh khy ml' khbvd yhvh 't byt yhvh
verses.translation: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD , because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD’s house.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹאִים֙ בְּ/רֶ֣דֶת הָ/אֵ֔שׁ וּ/כְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עַל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יִּכְרְעוּ֩ אַפַּ֨יִם אַ֤רְצָ/ה עַל הָ/רִֽצְפָה֙ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּֽחֲו֔וּ וְ/הוֹד֤וֹת לַ/יהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl bny yshr'l r'ym brdt h'sh vkhbvd yhvh 'l hbyt vykhr'v 'pym 'rtsh 'l hrtsph vyshtchvv vhvdvt lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD , saying , For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם זֹבְחִ֥ים זֶ֖בַח לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhmlkh vkhl h'm zbchym zbch lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבַּ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֮ אֶת זֶ֣בַח הַ/בָּקָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/צֹ֕אן מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וַֽ/יַּחְנְכוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/כָל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyzbch hmlkh shlmh 't zbch hbqr 'shrym vshnym 'lf vts'n m'h v'shrym 'lf vychnkhv 't byt h'lhym hmlkh vkhl h'm
verses.translation: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֞ים עַל מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֣/ם עֹמְדִ֗ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֞ם בִּ/כְלֵי שִׁ֤יר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה דָּוִ֣יד הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ לְ/הֹד֤וֹת לַ/יהוָה֙ כִּֽי לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔/וֹ בְּ/הַלֵּ֥ל דָּוִ֖יד בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ מחצצרים מַחְצְרִ֣ים נֶגְדָּ֔/ם וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמְדִֽים
verses.translit: vhkhhnym 'l mshmrvtm 'mdym vhlvym bkhly shyr yhvh 'shr 'shh dvyd hmlkh lhdvt lyhvh khy l'vlm chsdv bhll dvyd bydm vhkhhnym mchtstsrym mchtsrym ngdm vkhl yshr'l 'mdym
verses.translation: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD , which David the king had made to praise the LORD , because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

verses.original: וַ/יְקַדֵּ֣שׁ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת תּ֤וֹךְ הֶֽ/חָצֵר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י בֵית יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי עָ֤שָׂה שָׁם֙ הָֽ/עֹל֔וֹת וְ/אֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים כִּֽי מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לֹ֣א יָכ֗וֹל לְ/הָכִ֛יל אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֥ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֖ה וְ/אֶת הַ/חֲלָבִֽים
verses.translit: vyqdsh shlmh 't tvkh hchtsr 'shr lpny byt yhvh khy 'shh shm h'lvt v't chlby hshlmym khy mzbch hnchsht 'shr 'shh shlmh l' ykhvl lhkhyl 't h'lh v't hmnchh v't hchlbym
verses.translation: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD : for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אֶת הֶ֠/חָג בָּ/עֵ֨ת הַ/הִ֜יא שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔/וֹ קָהָ֖ל גָּד֣וֹל מְאֹ֑ד מִ/לְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד נַ֥חַל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh 't hchg b't hhy' shb't ymym vkhl yshr'l 'mv qhl gdvl m'd mlbv' chmt 'd nchl mtsrym
verses.translation: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֛וּ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֖י עֲצָ֑רֶת כִּ֣י חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ עָשׂוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וְ/הֶ/חָ֖ג שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'shv byvm hshmyny 'tsrt khy chnkht hmzbch 'shv shb't ymym vhchg shb't ymym
verses.translation: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/י֨וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם לְ/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׂמֵחִים֙ וְ/ט֣וֹבֵי לֵ֔ב עַל הַ/טּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/דָוִ֣יד וְ/לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּ/לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbyvm 'shrym vshlshh lchdsh hshby'y shlch 't h'm l'hlyhm shmchym vtvby lb 'l htvbh 'shr 'shh yhvh ldvyd vlshlmh vlyshr'l 'mv
verses.translation: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֧ל שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל הַ/בָּ֜א עַל לֵ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֧וֹת בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֛ה וּ/בְ/בֵית֖/וֹ הִצְלִֽיחַ
verses.translit: vykhl shlmh 't byt yhvh v't byt hmlkh v't khl hb' 'l lb shlmh l'shvt bbyt yhvh vbbytv htslych
verses.translation: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD , and the king’s house: and all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the house of the LORD , and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בַּ/לָּ֑יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת תְּפִלָּתֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בָחַ֜רְתִּי בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה לִ֖/י לְ/בֵ֥ית זָֽבַח
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh 'l shlmh blylh vy'mr lv shm'ty 't tpltkh vbchrty bmqvm hzh ly lbyt zbch
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אֶֽעֱצֹ֤ר הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְ/הֵן אֲצַוֶּ֥ה עַל חָגָ֖ב לֶ/אֱכ֣וֹל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אִם אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח דֶּ֖בֶר בְּ/עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: hn ''tsr hshmym vl' yhyh mtr vhn 'tsvh 'l chgb l'khvl h'rts v'm 'shlch dbr b'my
verses.translation: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

verses.original: וְ/יִכָּנְע֨וּ עַמִּ֜/י אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא שְׁמִ֣/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/יִֽתְפַּֽלְלוּ֙ וִֽ/יבַקְשׁ֣וּ פָנַ֔/י וְ/יָשֻׁ֖בוּ מִ/דַּרְכֵי/הֶ֣ם הָ/רָעִ֑ים וַ/אֲנִי֙ אֶשְׁמַ֣ע מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/אֶסְלַח֙ לְ/חַטָּאתָ֔/ם וְ/אֶרְפָּ֖א אֶת אַרְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykhn'v 'my 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyhm vytpllv vybqshv pny vyshbv mdrkhyhm hr'ym v'ny 'shm' mn hshmym v'slch lcht'tm v'rp' 't 'rtsm
verses.translation: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה עֵינַ/י֙ יִהְי֣וּ פְתֻח֔וֹת וְ/אָזְנַ֖/י קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לִ/תְפִלַּ֖ת הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'th 'yny yhyv ptchvt v'zny qshbvt ltplt hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה בָּחַ֤רְתִּי וְ/הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי֙ אֶת הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/זֶּ֔ה לִ/הְיוֹת שְׁמִ֥/י שָׁ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/הָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧/י וְ/לִבִּ֛/י שָׁ֖ם כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: v'th bchrty vhqdshty 't hbyt hzh lhyvt shmy shm 'd 'vlm vhyv 'yny vlby shm khl hymym
verses.translation: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה אִם תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְ/פָנַ֗/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י/ךָ וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑י/ךָ וְ/חֻקַּ֥/י וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י תִּשְׁמֽוֹר
verses.translit: v'th 'm tlkh lpny kh'shr hlkh dvyd 'bykh vl'shvt khkhl 'shr tsvytykh vchqy vmshpty tshmvr
verses.translation: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִ֣ימוֹתִ֔י אֵ֖ת כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּתֶ֑/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֗תִּי לְ/דָוִ֤יד אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְ/ךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhqymvty 't khs' mlkhvtkh kh'shr khrty ldvyd 'bykh l'mr l' ykhrt lkh 'ysh mvshl byshr'l
verses.translation: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אִם תְּשׁוּב֣וּ/ן אַתֶּ֔ם וַ/עֲזַבְתֶּם֙ חֻקּוֹתַ֣/י וּ/מִצְוֺתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm tshvbvn 'tm v'zbtm chqvty vmtsvty 'shr ntty lpnykhm vhlkhtm v'bdtm 'lhym 'chrym vhshtchvytm lhm
verses.translation: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

verses.original: וּ/נְתַשְׁתִּ֗י/ם מֵ/עַ֤ל אַדְמָתִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִ/שְׁמִ֔/י אַשְׁלִ֖יךְ מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑/י וְ/אֶתְּנֶ֛/נּוּ לְ/מָשָׁ֥ל וְ/לִ/שְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּ/כָל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: vntshtym m'l 'dmty 'shr ntty lhm v't hbyt hzh 'shr hqdshty lshmy 'shlykh m'l pny v'tnnv lmshl vlshnynh bkhl h'mym
verses.translation: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן לְ/כָל עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖י/ו יִשֹּׁ֑ם וְ/אָמַ֗ר בַּ/מֶּ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/לַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhbyt hzh 'shr hyh 'lyvn lkhl 'br 'lyv yshm v'mr bmh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'rts hz't vlbyt hzh
verses.translation: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

verses.original: וְ/אָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽזְב֜וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצִיאָ/ם֮ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽ/יַּחֲזִ֨יקוּ֙ בֵּ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/יַּֽעַבְד֑וּ/ם עַל כֵּן֙ הֵבִ֣יא עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 't yhvh 'lhy 'btyhm 'shr hvtsy'm m'rts mtsrym vychzyqv b'lhym 'chrym vyshtchvv lhm vy'bdvm 'l khn hby' 'lyhm 't khl hr'h hz't
verses.translation: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י מִ/קֵּ֣ץ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'shrym shnh 'shr bnh shlmh 't byt yhvh v't bytv
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD , and his own house,

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/עָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן חוּרָם֙ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יּ֥וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֖ם אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vh'rym 'shr ntn chvrm lshlmh bnh shlmh 'tm vyvshb shm 't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ חֲמָ֣ת צוֹבָ֔ה וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֖ק עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vylkh shlmh chmt tsvbh vychzq 'lyh
verses.translation: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥בֶן אֶת תַּדְמֹ֖ר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל עָרֵ֣י הַֽ/מִּסְכְּנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּ/חֲמָֽת
verses.translit: vybn 't tdmr bmdbr v't khl 'ry hmskhnvt 'shr bnh bchmt
verses.translation: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֜בֶן אֶת בֵּ֤ית חוֹרוֹן֙ הָֽ/עֶלְי֔וֹן וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן הַ/תַּחְתּ֑וֹן עָרֵ֣י מָצ֔וֹר חוֹמ֖וֹת דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּ/בְרִֽיחַ
verses.translit: vybn 't byt chvrvn h'lyvn v't byt chvrvn htchtvn 'ry mtsvr chvmvt dltym vbrych
verses.translation: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽת בַּעֲלָ֗ת וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל עָרֵ֤י הַֽ/מִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל עָרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וְ/אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַ/פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִ/בְנ֤וֹת בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּ/בַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't b'lt v't khl 'ry hmskhnvt 'shr hyv lshlmh v't khl 'ry hrkhb v't 'ry hprshym v't khl chshq shlmh 'shr chshq lbnvt byrvshlm vblbnvn vbkhl 'rts mmshltv
verses.translation: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

verses.original: כָּל הָ֠/עָם הַ/נּוֹתָ֨ר מִן הַ/חִתִּ֜י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִ֤י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּי֙ וְ/הַ/חִוִּ֣י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: khl h'm hnvtr mn hchty vh'mry vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy 'shr l' myshr'l hmh
verses.translation: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,

verses.original: מִן בְּנֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נוֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא כִלּ֖וּ/ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּעֲלֵ֤/ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְ/מַ֔ס עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: mn bnyhm 'shr nvtrv 'chryhm b'rts 'shr l' khlvm bny yshr'l vy'lm shlmh lms 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא נָתַ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים לִ/מְלַאכְתּ֑/וֹ כִּי הֵ֜מָּה אַנְשֵׁ֤י מִלְחָמָה֙ וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י שָׁלִישָׁ֔י/ו וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וּ/פָרָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vmn bny yshr'l 'shr l' ntn shlmh l'bdym lml'khtv khy hmh 'nshy mlchmh vshry shlyshyv vshry rkhbv vprshyv
verses.translation: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה שָׂרֵ֤י ה/נציבים הַ/נִּצָּבִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מָאתָ֑יִם הָ/רֹדִ֖ים בָּ/עָֽם
verses.translit: v'lh shry hntsybym hntsbym 'shr lmlkh shlmh chmshym vm'tym hrdym b'm
verses.translation: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בַּת פַּרְעֹ֗ה הֶעֱלָ֤ה שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֵ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד לַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה לָ֑/הּ כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר לֹא תֵשֵׁ֨ב אִשָּׁ֥ה לִ/י֙ בְּ/בֵית֙ דָּוִ֣יד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּי קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁר בָּֽאָ֥ה אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v't bt pr'h h'lh shlmh m'yr dvyd lbyt 'shr bnh lh khy 'mr l' tshb 'shh ly bbyt dvyd mlkh yshr'l khy qdsh hmh 'shr b'h 'lyhm 'rvn yhvh
verses.translation: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.

verses.original: אָ֣ז הֶעֱלָ֧ה שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה עֹל֖וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה עַ֚ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אוּלָֽם
verses.translit: 'z h'lh shlmh 'lvt lyhvh 'l mzbch yhvh 'shr bnh lpny h'vlm
verses.translation: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD , which he had built before the porch,

verses.original: וּ/בִ/דְבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/י֗וֹם לְ/הַעֲלוֹת֙ כְּ/מִצְוַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַ/שַּׁבָּתוֹת֙ וְ/לֶ֣/חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וְ/לַ/מּ֣וֹעֲד֔וֹת שָׁל֥וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה בְּ/חַ֧ג הַ/מַּצּ֛וֹת וּ/בְ/חַ֥ג הַ/שָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּ/בְ/חַ֥ג הַ/סֻּכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbdbr yvm byvm lh'lvt khmtsvt mshh lshbtvt vlchdshym vlmv'dvt shlvsh p'mym bshnh bchg hmtsvt vbchg hshb'vt vbchg hskhvt
verses.translation: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֣ד כְּ/מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּֽוִיד אָ֠בִי/ו אֶת מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים עַל עֲבֹדָתָ֗/ם וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם עַל מִ֠שְׁמְרוֹתָ/ם לְ/הַלֵּ֨ל וּ/לְ/שָׁרֵ֜ת נֶ֤גֶד הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לִ/דְבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים בְּ/מַחְלְקוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/שַׁ֣עַר וָ/שָׁ֑עַר כִּ֣י כֵ֔ן מִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֥יד אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'md khmshpt dvyd 'byv 't mchlqvt hkhhnym 'l 'bdtm vhlvym 'l mshmrvtm lhll vlshrt ngd hkhhnym ldbr yvm byvmv vhshv'rym bmchlqvtm lsh'r vsh'r khy khn mtsvt dvyd 'ysh h'lhym
verses.translation: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א סָרוּ֩ מִצְוַ֨ת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם לְ/כָל דָּבָ֖ר וְ/לָ/אֹצָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vl' srv mtsvt hmlkh 'l hkhhnym vhlvym lkhl dbr vl'tsrvt
verses.translation: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכֹּן֙ כָּל מְלֶ֣אכֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַד הַ/יּ֛וֹם מוּסַ֥ד בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/עַד כְּלֹת֑/וֹ שָׁלֵ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtkhn khl ml'kht shlmh 'd hyvm mvsd byt yhvh v'd khltv shlm byt yhvh
verses.translation: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD , and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.

verses.original: אָז֩ הָלַ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה לְ/עֶצְיֽוֹן גֶּ֧בֶר וְ/אֶל אֵיל֛וֹת עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יָּ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'z hlkh shlmh l'tsyvn gbr v'l 'ylvt 'l shpt hym b'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽשְׁלַֽח ל/וֹ֩ חוּרָ֨ם בְּ/יַד עֲבָדָ֜י/ו אוניות אֳנִיּ֗וֹת וַ/עֲבָדִים֮ י֣וֹדְעֵי יָם֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ עִם עַבְדֵ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אוֹפִ֔ירָ/ה וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֑ב וַ/יָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch lv chvrm byd 'bdyv 'vnyvt 'nyvt v'bdym yvd'y ym vyb'v 'm 'bdy shlmh 'vpyrh vyqchv mshm 'rb' m'vt vchmshym khkhr zhb vyby'v 'l hmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

verses.original: וּ/מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֗א שָֽׁמְעָה֮ אֶת שֵׁ֣מַע שְׁלֹמֹה֒ וַ/תָּב֣וֹא לְ/נַסּוֹת֩ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְ/חִיד֜וֹת בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם בְּ/חַ֣יִל כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֡ד וּ֠/גְמַלִּים נֹשְׂאִ֨ים בְּשָׂמִ֧ים וְ/זָהָ֛ב לָ/רֹ֖ב וְ/אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה וַ/תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֣ר עִמּ֔/וֹ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם לְבָבָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vmlkht shb' shm'h 't shm' shlmh vtbv' lnsvt 't shlmh bchydvt byrvshlm bchyl khbd m'd vgmlym nsh'ym bshmym vzhb lrb v'bn yqrh vtbv' 'l shlmh vtdbr 'mv 't khl 'shr hyh 'm lbbh
verses.translation: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֶּד לָ֥/הּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת כָּל דְּבָרֶ֑י/הָ וְ/לֹֽא נֶעְלַ֤ם דָּבָר֙ מִ/שְּׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹ֦א הִגִּ֖יד לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vygd lh shlmh 't khl dbryh vl' n'lm dbr mshlmh 'shr l' hgyd lh
verses.translation: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא֙ מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֔א אֵ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָֽה
verses.translit: vtr' mlkht shb' 't chkhmt shlmh vhbyt 'shr bnh
verses.translation: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

verses.original: וּ/מַאֲכַ֣ל שֻׁלְחָנ֡/וֹ וּ/מוֹשַׁ֣ב עֲבָדָי/ו֩ וּ/מַעֲמַ֨ד מְשָׁרְתָ֜י/ו וּ/מַלְבּֽוּשֵׁי/הֶ֗ם וּ/מַשְׁקָי/ו֙ וּ/מַלְבּ֣וּשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם וַ/עֲלִיָּת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה ע֛וֹד בָּ֖/הּ רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vm'khl shlchnv vmvshb 'bdyv vm'md mshrtyv vmlbvshyhm vmshqyv vmlbvshyhm v'lytv 'shr y'lh byt yhvh vl' hyh 'vd bh rvch
verses.translation: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD ; there was no more spirit in her.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֱמֶת֙ הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בְּ/אַרְצִ֑/י עַל דְּבָרֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/עַל חָכְמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l hmlkh 'mt hdbr 'shr shm'ty b'rtsy 'l dbrykh v'l chkhmtkh
verses.translation: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא הֶאֱמַ֣נְתִּי לְ/דִבְרֵי/הֶ֗ם עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר בָּ֨אתִי֙ וַ/תִּרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינַ֔/י וְ/הִנֵּה֙ לֹ֣א הֻגַּד לִ֔/י חֲצִ֖י מַרְבִּ֣ית חָכְמָתֶ֑/ךָ יָסַ֕פְתָּ עַל הַ/שְּׁמוּעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vl' h'mnty ldbryhm 'd 'shr b'ty vtr'ynh 'yny vhnh l' hgd ly chtsy mrbyt chkhmtkh yspt 'l hshmv'h 'shr shm'ty
verses.translation: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֲנָשֶׁ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַשְׁרֵ֖י עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ אֵ֑לֶּה הָ/עֹמְדִ֤ים לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תָּמִ֔יד וְ/שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֶת חָכְמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shry 'nshykh v'shry 'bdykh 'lh h'mdym lpnykh tmyd vshm'ym 't chkhmtkh
verses.translation: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

verses.original: יְהִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בָּר֔וּךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפֵ֣ץ בְּ/ךָ֗ לְ/תִתְּ/ךָ֤ עַל כִּסְא/וֹ֙ לְ/מֶ֔לֶךְ לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/אַהֲבַ֨ת אֱלֹהֶ֤י/ךָ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/הַעֲמִיד֣/וֹ לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם וַ/יִּתֶּנְ/ךָ֤ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/מֶ֔לֶךְ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: yhy yhvh 'lhykh brvkh 'shr chpts bkh lttkh 'l khs'v lmlkh lyhvh 'lhykh b'hbt 'lhykh 't yshr'l lh'mydv l'vlm vytnkh 'lyhm lmlkh l'shvt mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֵּ֨ן לַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֗ב וּ/בְשָׂמִ֛ים לָ/רֹ֥ב מְאֹ֖ד וְ/אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א הָיָה֙ כַּ/בֹּ֣שֶׂם הַ/ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר נָתְנָ֥ה מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֖א לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vttn lmlkh m'h v'shrym khkhr zhb vbshmym lrb m'd v'bn yqrh vl' hyh khbshm hhv' 'shr ntnh mlkht shb' lmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

verses.original: וְ/גַם עַבְדֵ֤י חירם חוּרָם֙ וְ/עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֥יאוּ זָהָ֖ב מֵ/אוֹפִ֑יר הֵבִ֛יאוּ עֲצֵ֥י אַלְגּוּמִּ֖ים וְ/אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'bdy chyrm chvrm v'bdy shlmh 'shr hby'v zhb m'vpyr hby'v 'tsy 'lgvmym v'bn yqrh
verses.translation: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ אֶת עֲצֵ֨י הָֽ/אַלְגּוּמִּ֜ים מְסִלּ֤וֹת לְ/בֵית יְהוָה֙ וּ/לְ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כִנֹּר֥וֹת וּ/נְבָלִ֖ים לַ/שָּׁרִ֑ים וְ/לֹא נִרְא֥וּ כָ/הֵ֛ם לְ/פָנִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh 't 'tsy h'lgvmym mslvt lbyt yhvh vlbyt hmlkh vkhnrvt vnblym lshrym vl' nr'v khhm lpnym b'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD , and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה נָתַ֣ן לְ/מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֗א אֶת כָּל חֶפְצָ/הּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔לָה מִ/לְּ/בַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֣יאָה אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽ/תַּהֲפֹ֛ךְ וַ/תֵּ֥לֶךְ לְ/אַרְצָ֖/הּ הִ֥יא וַ/עֲבָדֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh ntn lmlkht shb' 't khl chptsh 'shr sh'lh mlbd 'shr hby'h 'l hmlkh vthpkh vtlkh l'rtsh hy' v'bdyh
verses.translation: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ מִשְׁקַ֣ל הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּ/שָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָ/שֵׁ֖שׁ כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vyhy mshql hzhb 'shr b' lshlmh bshnh 'cht shsh m'vt vshshym vshsh khkhry zhb
verses.translation: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

verses.original: לְ/בַ֞ד מֵ/אַנְשֵׁ֧י הַ/תָּרִ֛ים וְ/הַ/סֹּחֲרִ֖ים מְבִיאִ֑ים וְ/כָל מַלְכֵ֤י עֲרַב֙ וּ/פַח֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מְבִיאִ֛ים זָהָ֥ב וָ/כֶ֖סֶף לִ/שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: lbd m'nshy htrym vhschrym mby'ym vkhl mlkhy 'rb vpchvt h'rts mby'ym zhb vkhsf lshlmh
verses.translation: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה מָאתַ֥יִם צִנָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב שָׁח֑וּט שֵׁ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב שָׁח֔וּט יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל הַ/צִּנָּ֥ה הָ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh shlmh m'tym tsnh zhb shchvt shsh m'vt zhb shchvt y'lh 'l htsnh h'cht
verses.translation: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֤וֹת מָֽגִנִּים֙ זָהָ֣ב שָׁח֔וּט שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ זָהָ֔ב יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל הַ/מָּגֵ֣ן הָ/אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֣/ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּ/בֵ֖ית יַ֥עַר הַ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: vshlsh m'vt mgnym zhb shchvt shlsh m'vt zhb y'lh 'l hmgn h'cht vytnm hmlkh bbyt y'r hlbnvn
verses.translation: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ כִּסֵּא שֵׁ֖ן גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יְצַפֵּ֖/הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh khs' shn gdvl vytsphv zhb thvr
verses.translation: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מַעֲל֣וֹת לַ֠/כִּסֵּא וְ/כֶ֨בֶשׁ בַּ/זָּהָ֤ב לַ/כִּסֵּא֙ מָאֳחָזִ֔ים וְ/יָד֛וֹת מִ/זֶּ֥ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֖ה עַל מְק֣וֹם הַ/שָּׁ֑בֶת וּ/שְׁנַ֣יִם אֲרָי֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים אֵ֥צֶל הַ/יָּדֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshsh m'lvt lkhs' vkhbsh bzhb lkhs' m'chzym vydvt mzh vmzh 'l mqvm hshbt vshnym 'ryvt 'mdym 'tsl hydvt
verses.translation: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲרָי֗וֹת עֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֛ם עַל שֵׁ֥שׁ הַֽ/מַּעֲל֖וֹת מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֑ה לֹא נַעֲשָׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן לְ/כָל מַמְלָכָֽה
verses.translit: vshnym 'shr 'ryvt 'mdym shm 'l shsh hm'lvt mzh vmzh l' n'shh khn lkhl mmlkhh
verses.translation: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

verses.original: וְ֠/כֹל כְּלֵ֞י מַשְׁקֵ֨ה הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ זָהָ֔ב וְ/כֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י בֵּֽית יַ֥עַר הַ/לְּבָנ֖וֹן זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר אֵ֣ין כֶּ֗סֶף נֶחְשָׁ֛ב בִּ/ימֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לִ/מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: vkhl khly mshqh hmlkh shlmh zhb vkhl khly byt y'r hlbnvn zhb sgvr 'yn khsf nchshb bymy shlmh lm'vmh
verses.translation: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֳנִיּ֤וֹת לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הֹלְכ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ עִ֖ם עַבְדֵ֣י חוּרָ֑ם אַחַת֩ לְ/שָׁל֨וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֜ים תָּב֣וֹאנָה אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֗ישׁ נֹֽשְׂאוֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב וָ/כֶ֔סֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּ֥ים וְ/קוֹפִ֖ים וְ/תוּכִּיִּֽים
verses.translit: khy 'nyvt lmlkh hlkhvt trshysh 'm 'bdy chvrm 'cht lshlvsh shnym tbv'nh 'nyvt trshysh nsh'vt zhb vkhsf shnhbym vqvpym vtvkhyym
verses.translation: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְדַּל֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מִ/כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לְ/עֹ֖שֶׁר וְ/חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: vygdl hmlkh shlmh mkhl mlkhy h'rts l'shr vchkhmh
verses.translation: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מְבַקְשִׁ֖ים אֶת פְּנֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה לִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת חָכְמָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl mlkhy h'rts mbqshym 't pny shlmh lshm' 't chkhmtv 'shr ntn h'lhym blbv
verses.translation: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֣ם מְבִיאִ֣ים אִ֣ישׁ מִנְחָת֡/וֹ כְּלֵ֣י כֶסֶף֩ וּ/כְלֵ֨י זָהָ֤ב וּ/שְׂלָמוֹת֙ נֵ֣שֶׁק וּ/בְשָׂמִ֔ים סוּסִ֖ים וּ/פְרָדִ֑ים דְּבַר שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vhm mby'ym 'ysh mnchtv khly khsf vkhly zhb vshlmvt nshq vbshmym svsym vprdym dbr shnh bshnh
verses.translation: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אַרְבַּעַת֩ אֲלָפִ֨ים אֻֽרְי֤וֹת סוּסִים֙ וּ/מַרְכָּב֔וֹת וּ/שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יַּנִּיחֵ/ם֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וְ/עִם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy lshlmh 'rb't 'lpym 'ryvt svsym vmrkhbvt vshnym 'shr 'lf prshym vynychm b'ry hrkhb v'm hmlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּ/כָל הַ/מְּלָכִ֑ים מִן הַ/נָּהָר֙ וְ/עַד אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy mvshl bkhl hmlkhym mn hnhr v'd 'rts plshtym v'd gbvl mtsrym
verses.translation: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֛סֶף בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּ/אֲבָנִ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ת הָ/אֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּ/שִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vytn hmlkh 't hkhsf byrvshlm kh'bnym v't h'rzym ntn khshqmym 'shr bshplh lrb
verses.translation: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצִיאִ֨ים סוּסִ֧ים מִ/מִּצְרַ֛יִם לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וּ/מִ/כָּל הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmvtsy'ym svsym mmtsrym lshlmh vmkhl h'rtsvt
verses.translation: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אֲחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל דִּבְרֵי֙ נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֔יא וְ/עַל נְבוּאַ֞ת אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַ/שִּֽׁילוֹנִ֗י וּ/בַ/חֲזוֹת֙ יעדי יֶעְדּ֣וֹ הַ/חֹזֶ֔ה עַל יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּן נְבָֽט
verses.translit: vsh'r dbry shlmh hr'shnym vh'chrvnym hl' hm khtvbym 'l dbry ntn hnby' v'l nbv't 'chyh hshylvny vbchzvt y'dy y'dv hchzh 'l yrb'm bn nbt
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלֹ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֧ה בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vymlkh shlmh byrvshlm 'l khl yshr'l 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁלֹמֹה֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֔/הוּ בְּ/עִ֖יר דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ רְחַבְעָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb shlmh 'm 'btyv vyqbrhv b'yr dvyd 'byv vymlkh rchb'm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֖ם שְׁכֶ֑מָ/ה כִּ֥י שְׁכֶ֛ם בָּ֥אוּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/הַמְלִ֥יךְ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh rchb'm shkhmh khy shkhm b'v khl yshr'l lhmlykh 'tv
verses.translation: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן נְבָט֙ וְ/ה֣וּא בְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרַ֔ח מִ/פְּנֵ֖י שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב יָרָבְעָ֖ם מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' yrb'm bn nbt vhv' bmtsrym 'shr brch mpny shlmh hmlkh vyshb yrb'm mmtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ וַ/יִּקְרְאוּ ל֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֥א יָרָבְעָ֖ם וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל רְחַבְעָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshlchv vyqr'v lv vyb' yrb'm vkhl yshr'l vydbrv 'l rchb'm l'mr
verses.translation: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

verses.original: אָבִ֖י/ךָ הִקְשָׁ֣ה אֶת עֻלֵּ֑/נוּ וְ/עַתָּ֡ה הָקֵל֩ מֵ/עֲבֹדַ֨ת אָבִ֜י/ךָ הַ/קָּשָׁ֗ה וּ/מֵ/עֻלּ֧/וֹ הַ/כָּבֵ֛ד אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן עָלֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/נַֽעַבְדֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'bykh hqshh 't 'lnv v'th hql m'bdt 'bykh hqshh vm'lv hkhbd 'shr ntn 'lynv vn'bdkh
verses.translation: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם ע֛וֹד שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים וְ/שׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm 'vd shlsht ymym vshvbv 'ly vylkh h'm
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֞ץ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת הַ/זְּקֵנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ עֹֽמְדִ֗ים לִ/פְנֵי֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אָבִ֔י/ו בִּֽ/הְיֹת֥/וֹ חַ֖י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֵ֚יךְ אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב לָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyv'ts hmlkh rchb'm 't hzqnym 'shr hyv 'mdym lpny shlmh 'byv bhytv chy l'mr 'ykh 'tm nv'tsym lhshyb l'm hzh dbr
verses.translation: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבְּר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אִם תִּֽהְיֶ֨ה לְ/ט֜וֹב לְ/הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ וּ/רְצִיתָ֔/ם וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/ךָ֛ עֲבָדִ֖ים כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vydbrv 'lyv l'mr 'm thyh ltvb lh'm hzh vrtsytm vdbrt 'lhm dbrym tvbym vhyv lkh 'bdym khl hymym
verses.translation: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת עֲצַ֥ת הַ/זְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצֻ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֶת הַ/יְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּ֔/וֹ הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'zb 't 'tst hzqnym 'shr y'tshv vyv'ts 't hyldym 'shr gdlv 'tv h'mdym lpnyv
verses.translation: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם מָ֚ה אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים וְ/נָשִׁ֥יב דָּבָ֖ר אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּר֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הָקֵל֙ מִן הָ/עֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן אָבִ֖י/ךָ עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm mh 'tm nv'tsym vnshyb dbr 't h'm hzh 'shr dbrv 'ly l'mr hql mn h'l 'shr ntn 'bykh 'lynv
verses.translation: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבְּר֣וּ אִתּ֗/וֹ הַ/יְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּ/וֹ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֡ר לָ/עָם֩ אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּר֨וּ אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶת עֻלֵּ֔/נוּ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה הָקֵ֣ל מֵ/עָלֵ֑י/נוּ כֹּ֚ה תֹּאמַ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם קָֽטָנִּ֥/י עָבָ֖ה מִ/מָּתְנֵ֥י אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vydbrv 'tv hyldym 'shr gdlv 'tv l'mr khh t'mr l'm 'shr dbrv 'lykh l'mr 'bykh hkhbyd 't 'lnv v'th hql m'lynv khh t'mr 'lhm qtny 'bh mmtny 'by
verses.translation: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אָבִ/י֙ הֶעְמִ֤יס עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ עֹ֣ל כָּבֵ֔ד וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֹסִ֣יף עַֽל עֻלְּ/כֶ֑ם אָבִ֗/י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַ/אֲנִ֖י בָּֽ/עֲקְרַבִּֽים
verses.translit: v'th 'by h'mys 'lykhm 'l khbd v'ny 'syf 'l 'lkhm 'by ysr 'tkhm bshvtym v'ny b'qrbym
verses.translation: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יָרָבְעָ֧ם וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֛ם אֶל רְחַבְעָ֖ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֑י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שׁ֥וּבוּ אֵלַ֖/י בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁי
verses.translit: vyb' yrb'm vkhl h'm 'l rchb'm byvm hshlshy kh'shr dbr hmlkh l'mr shvbv 'ly byvm hshlshy
verses.translation: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנֵ֥/ם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ קָשָׁ֑ה וַֽ/יַּעֲזֹב֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֔ם אֵ֖ת עֲצַ֥ת הַ/זְּקֵנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'nm hmlkh qshh vy'zb hmlkh rchb'm 't 'tst hzqnym
verses.translation: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם כַּ/עֲצַ֤ת הַ/יְלָדִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַכְבִּיד֙ אֶֽת עֻלְּ/כֶ֔ם וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֹסִ֣יף עָלָ֑י/ו אָבִ֗/י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַ/אֲנִ֖י בָּ/עֲקְרַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhm kh'tst hyldym l'mr 'khbyd 't 'lkhm v'ny 'syf 'lyv 'by ysr 'tkhm bshvtym v'ny b'qrbym
verses.translation: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמַ֥ע הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם כִּֽי הָיְתָ֤ה נְסִבָּה֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְמַעַן֩ הָקִ֨ים יְהוָ֜ה אֶת דְּבָר֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ בְּ/יַד֙ אֲחִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/שִּֽׁלוֹנִ֔י אֶל יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּן נְבָֽט
verses.translit: vl' shm' hmlkh 'l h'm khy hyth nsbh m'm h'lhym lm'n hqym yhvh 't dbrv 'shr dbr byd 'chyhv hshlvny 'l yrb'm bn nbt
verses.translation: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ לָ/הֶם֒ וַ/יָּשִׁ֣יבוּ הָ/עָ֣ם אֶת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֡ר מַה לָּ/נוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק בְּ/דָוִ֜יד וְ/לֹֽא נַחֲלָ֣ה בְּ/בֶן יִשַׁ֗י אִ֤ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַתָּ֕ה רְאֵ֥ה בֵיתְ/ךָ֖ דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l khy l' shm' hmlkh lhm vyshybv h'm 't hmlkh l'mr mh lnv chlq bdvyd vl' nchlh bbn yshy 'ysh l'hlykh yshr'l 'th r'h bytkh dvyd vylkh khl yshr'l l'hlyv
verses.translation: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם רְחַבְעָֽם
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l hyshbym b'ry yhvdh vymlkh 'lyhm rchb'm
verses.translation: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת הֲדֹרָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/מַּ֔ס וַ/יִּרְגְּמוּ ב֧/וֹ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶ֖בֶן וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם הִתְאַמֵּץ֙ לַֽ/עֲל֣וֹת בַּ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֔ה לָ/נ֖וּס יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh rchb'm 't hdrm 'shr 'l hms vyrgmv bv bny yshr'l 'bn vymt vhmlkh rchb'm ht'mts l'lvt bmrkhbh lnvs yrvshlm
verses.translation: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְשְׁע֤וּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vypsh'v yshr'l bbyt dvyd 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א רְחַבְעָם֮ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַ/יַּקְהֵל֩ אֶת בֵּ֨ית יְהוּדָ֜ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֗ן מֵאָ֨ה וּ/שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בָּח֖וּר עֹשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָ֑ה לְ/הִלָּחֵם֙ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה לִ/רְחַבְעָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' rchb'm yrvshlm vyqhl 't byt yhvdh vbnymn m'h vshmvnym 'lf bchvr 'shh mlchmh lhlchm 'm yshr'l lhshyb 't hmmlkhh lrchb'm
verses.translation: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men , which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥הוּ אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l shm'yhv 'ysh h'lhym l'mr
verses.translation: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

verses.original: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אֶל֙ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּ/יהוּדָ֥ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'mr 'l rchb'm bn shlmh mlkh yhvdh v'l khl yshr'l byhvdh vbnymn l'mr
verses.translation: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה לֹא תַעֲלוּ֩ וְ/לֹא תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ עִם אֲחֵי/כֶ֗ם שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/בֵית֔/וֹ כִּ֧י מֵֽ/אִתִּ֛/י נִהְיָ֖ה הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִ/לֶּ֥כֶת אֶל יָרָבְעָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh l' t'lv vl' tlchmv 'm 'chykhm shvbv 'ysh lbytv khy m'ty nhyh hdbr hzh vyshm'v 't dbry yhvh vyshbv mlkht 'l yrb'm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD , and returned from going against Jeroboam.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב רְחַבְעָ֖ם בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יִּ֧בֶן עָרִ֛ים לְ/מָצ֖וֹר בִּ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyshb rchb'm byrvshlm vybn 'rym lmtsvr byhvdh
verses.translation: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֧בֶן אֶת בֵּֽית לֶ֛חֶם וְ/אֶת עֵיטָ֖ם וְ/אֶת תְּקֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: vybn 't byt lchm v't 'ytm v't tqv'
verses.translation: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בֵּֽית צ֥וּר וְ/אֶת שׂוֹכ֖וֹ וְ/אֶת עֲדֻלָּֽם
verses.translit: v't byt tsvr v't shvkhv v't 'dlm
verses.translation: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת גַּ֥ת וְ/אֶת מָרֵשָׁ֖ה וְ/אֶת זִֽיף
verses.translit: v't gt v't mrshh v't zyf
verses.translation: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אֲדוֹרַ֥יִם וְ/אֶת לָכִ֖ישׁ וְ/אֶת עֲזֵקָֽה
verses.translit: v't 'dvrym v't lkhysh v't 'zqh
verses.translation: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת צָרְעָה֙ וְ/אֶת אַיָּל֔וֹן וְ/אֶת חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/יהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בְ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן עָרֵ֖י מְצֻרֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't tsr'h v't 'ylvn v't chbrvn 'shr byhvdh vbbnymn 'ry mtsrvt
verses.translation: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת הַ/מְּצֻר֑וֹת וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן בָּ/הֶם֙ נְגִידִ֔ים וְ/אֹצְר֥וֹת מַאֲכָ֖ל וְ/שֶׁ֥מֶן וָ/יָֽיִן
verses.translit: vychzq 't hmtsrvt vytn bhm ngydym v'tsrvt m'khl vshmn vyyn
verses.translation: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל עִ֤יר וָ/עִיר֙ צִנּ֣וֹת וּ/רְמָחִ֔ים וַֽ/יְחַזְּקֵ֖/ם לְ/הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יְהִי ל֖/וֹ יְהוּדָ֥ה וּ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vbkhl 'yr v'yr tsnvt vrmchym vychzqm lhrbh m'd vyhy lv yhvdh vbnymn
verses.translation: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו מִ/כָּל גְּבוּלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhkhhnym vhlvym 'shr bkhl yshr'l htytsbv 'lyv mkhl gbvlm
verses.translation: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָזְב֣וּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם אֶת מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶם֙ וַ/אֲחֻזָּתָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ לִ/יהוּדָ֖ה וְ/לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי הִזְנִיחָ֤/ם יָֽרָבְעָם֙ וּ/בָנָ֔י/ו מִ/כַּהֵ֖ן לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'zbv hlvym 't mgrshyhm v'chztm vylkhv lyhvdh vlyrvshlm khy hznychm yrb'm vbnyv mkhhn lyhvh
verses.translation: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto the LORD :

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲמֶד ל/וֹ֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים לַ/בָּמ֖וֹת וְ/לַ/שְּׂעִירִ֑ים וְ/לָ/עֲגָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'md lv khhnym lbmvt vlsh'yrym vl'glym 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/נֹּֽתְנִים֙ אֶת לְבָבָ֔/ם לְ/בַקֵּ֕שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בָּ֚אוּ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/זְבּ֕וֹחַ לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'chryhm mkhl shbty yshr'l hntnym 't lbbm lbqsh 't yhvh 'lhy yshr'l b'v yrvshlm lzbvch lyhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽ/יְאַמְּצ֛וּ אֶת רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/שָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ כִּ֣י הָֽלְכ֗וּ בְּ/דֶ֧רֶךְ דָּוִ֛יד וּ/שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/שָׁנִ֥ים שָׁלֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vychzqv 't mlkhvt yhvdh vy'mtsv 't rchb'm bn shlmh lshnym shlvsh khy hlkhv bdrkh dvyd vshlmh lshnym shlvsh
verses.translation: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל֤/וֹ רְחַבְעָם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת מָ֣חֲלַ֔ת בן בַּת יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן דָּוִ֑יד אֲבִיהַ֕יִל בַּת אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן יִשָֽׁי
verses.translit: vyqch lv rchb'm 'shh 't mchlt bn bt yrymvt bn dvyd 'byhyl bt 'ly'b bn yshy
verses.translation: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖/וֹ בָּנִ֑ים אֶת יְע֥וּשׁ וְ/אֶת שְׁמַרְיָ֖ה וְ/אֶת זָֽהַם
verses.translit: vtld lv bnym 't y'vsh v't shmryh v't zhm
verses.translation: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֶ֣י/הָ לָקַ֔ח אֶֽת מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד ל֗/וֹ אֶת אֲבִיָּה֙ וְ/אֶת עַתַּ֔י וְ/אֶת זִיזָ֖א וְ/אֶת שְׁלֹמִֽית
verses.translit: v'chryh lqch 't m'khh bt 'bshlvm vtld lv 't 'byh v't 'ty v't zyz' v't shlmyt
verses.translation: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם אֶת מַעֲכָ֣ה בַת אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם מִ/כָּל נָשָׁי/ו֙ וּ/פִ֣ילַגְשָׁ֔י/ו כִּ֠י נָשִׁ֤ים שְׁמוֹנֶֽה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ נָשָׂ֔א וּ/פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֑ים וַ/יּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּ/שְׁמוֹנָ֛ה בָּנִ֖ים וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים בָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'hb rchb'm 't m'khh bt 'bshlvm mkhl nshyv vpylgshyv khy nshym shmvnh 'shrh nsh' vpylgshym shshym vyvld 'shrym vshmvnh bnym vshshym bnvt
verses.translation: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲמֵ֨ד לָ/רֹ֧אשׁ רְחַבְעָ֛ם אֶת אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן מַעֲכָ֖ה לְ/נָגִ֣יד בְּ/אֶחָ֑י/ו כִּ֖י לְ/הַמְלִיכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'md lr'sh rchb'm 't 'byh bn m'khh lngyd b'chyv khy lhmlykhv
verses.translation: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֶן֩ וַ/יִּפְרֹ֨ץ מִ/כָּל בָּנָ֜י/ו לְֽ/כָל אַרְצ֧וֹת יְהוּדָ֣ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֗ן לְ/כֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַ/מְּצֻר֔וֹת וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן לָ/הֶ֛ם הַ/מָּז֖וֹן לָ/רֹ֑ב וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֖ל הֲמ֥וֹן נָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vybn vyprts mkhl bnyv lkhl 'rtsvt yhvdh vbnymn lkhl 'ry hmtsrvt vytn lhm hmzvn lrb vysh'l hmvn nshym
verses.translation: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/הָכִ֞ין מַלְכ֤וּת רְחַבְעָם֙ וּ/כְ/חֶזְקָת֔/וֹ עָזַ֖ב אֶת תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khhkhyn mlkhvt rchb'm vkhchzqtv 'zb 't tvrt yhvh vkhl yshr'l 'mv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD , and all Israel with him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֤ה הַֽ/חֲמִישִׁית֙ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֔ם עָלָ֛ה שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֥י מָעֲל֖וּ בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hchmyshyt lmlkh rchb'm 'lh shyshq mlkh mtsrym 'l yrvshlm khy m'lv byhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD ,

verses.original: בְּ/אֶ֤לֶף וּ/מָאתַ֨יִם֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּ/בְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֗ר לָ/עָ֞ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤אוּ עִמּ/וֹ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם לוּבִ֥ים סֻכִּיִּ֖ים וְ/כוּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: b'lf vm'tym rkhb vbshshym 'lf prshym v'yn mspr l'm 'shr b'v 'mv mmtsrym lvbym skhyym vkhvshym
verses.translation: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֛ד אֶת עָרֵ֥י הַ/מְּצֻר֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א עַד יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vylkhd 't 'ry hmtsrvt 'shr lyhvdh vyb' 'd yrvshlm
verses.translation: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּֽ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַ/נָּבִיא֙ בָּ֣א אֶל רְחַבְעָ֔ם וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מִ/פְּנֵ֣י שִׁישָׁ֑ק וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לָ/הֶ֜ם כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַתֶּם֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֔/י וְ/אַף אֲנִ֛י עָזַ֥בְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יַד שִׁישָֽׁק
verses.translit: vshm'yh hnby' b' 'l rchb'm vshry yhvdh 'shr n'spv 'l yrvshlm mpny shyshq vy'mr lhm khh 'mr yhvh 'tm 'zbtm 'ty v'f 'ny 'zbty 'tkhm byd shyshq
verses.translation: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD , Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכָּנְע֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ צַדִּ֥יק יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vykhn'v shry yshr'l vhmlkh vy'mrv tsdyq yhvh
verses.translation: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/רְא֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י נִכְנָ֔עוּ הָיָה֩ דְבַר יְהוָ֨ה אֶל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה לֵ/אמֹ֛ר נִכְנְע֖וּ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִיתֵ֑/ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י לָ/הֶ֤ם כִּ/מְעַט֙ לִ/פְלֵיטָ֔ה וְ/לֹא תִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛/י בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/יַד שִׁישָֽׁק
verses.translit: vbr'vt yhvh khy nkhn'v hyh dbr yhvh 'l shm'yh l'mr nkhn'v l' 'shchytm vntty lhm khm't lplyth vl' ttkh chmty byrvshlm byd shyshq
verses.translation: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

verses.original: כִּ֥י יִהְיוּ ל֖/וֹ לַ/עֲבָדִ֑ים וְ/יֵדְעוּ֙ עֲב֣וֹדָתִ֔/י וַ/עֲבוֹדַ֖ת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy yhyv lv l'bdym vyd'v 'bvdty v'bvdt mmlkhvt h'rtsvt
verses.translation: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם֮ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת אֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֗ה וְ/אֶת אֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת הַ/כֹּ֖ל לָקָ֑ח וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת מָגִנֵּ֣י הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'l shyshq mlkh mtsrym 'l yrvshlm vyqch 't 'tsrvt byt yhvh v't 'tsrvt byt hmlkh 't hkhl lqch vyqch 't mgny hzhb 'shr 'shh shlmh
verses.translation: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ רְחַבְעָם֙ תַּחְתֵּי/הֶ֔ם מָגִנֵּ֖י נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/הִפְקִ֗יד עַל יַד֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/רָצִ֔ים הַ/שֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh rchb'm tchtyhm mgny nchsht vhpqyd 'l yd shry hrtsym hshmrym ptch byt hmlkh
verses.translation: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י מִ/דֵּי ב֥וֹא הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בָּ֤אוּ הָ/רָצִים֙ וּ/נְשָׂא֔וּ/ם וֶ/הֱשִׁב֖וּ/ם אֶל תָּ֥א הָ/רָצִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy mdy bv' hmlkh byt yhvh b'v hrtsym vnsh'vm vhshbvm 'l t' hrtsym
verses.translation: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD , the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הִכָּֽנְע֗/וֹ שָׁ֤ב מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ אַף יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/הַשְׁחִ֖ית לְ/כָלָ֑ה וְ/גַם֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה הָיָ֖ה דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִֽים
verses.translit: vbhkhn'v shb mmnv 'f yhvh vl' lhshchyt lkhlh vgm byhvdh hyh dbrym tvbym
verses.translation: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֞ק הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֛ם בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַ/יִּמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֣י בֶן אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְ/אַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּ/מָלְכ֜/וֹ וּֽ/שֲׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָ֠/עִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָ/שׂ֨וּם אֶת שְׁמ֥/וֹ שָׁם֙ מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָֽ/עַמֹּנִֽית
verses.translit: vytchzq hmlkh rchb'm byrvshlm vymlkh khy bn 'rb'ym v'cht shnh rchb'm bmlkhv vshb' 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm h'yr 'shr bchr yhvh lshvm 't shmv shm mkhl shbty yshr'l vshm 'mv n'mh h'mnyt
verses.translation: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ הָ/רָ֑ע כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הֵכִין֙ לִבּ֔/וֹ לִ/דְר֖וֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' khy l' hkhyn lbv ldrvsh 't yhvh
verses.translation: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/דִבְרֵ֣י רְחַבְעָ֗ם הָ/רִאשֹׁנִים֙ וְ/הָ/אֲ֣חַרוֹנִ֔ים הֲ/לֹא הֵ֨ם כְּתוּבִ֜ים בְּ/דִבְרֵ֨י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַ/נָּבִ֛יא וְ/עִדּ֥וֹ הַ/חֹזֶ֖ה לְ/הִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וּ/מִלְחֲמ֧וֹת רְחַבְעָ֛ם וְ/יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vdbry rchb'm hr'shnym vh'chrvnym hl' hm khtvbym bdbry shm'yh hnby' v'dv hchzh lhtychsh vmlchmvt rchb'm vyrb'm khl hymym
verses.translation: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב רְחַבְעָם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb rchb'm 'm 'btyv vyqbr b'yr dvyd vymlkh 'byh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֑ם וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ה עַל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shmvnh 'shrh lmlkh yrb'm vymlkh 'byh 'l yhvdh
verses.translation: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֗ים מָלַךְ֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ מִיכָיָ֥הוּ בַת אוּרִיאֵ֖ל מִן גִּבְעָ֑ה וּ/מִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ה וּ/בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם
verses.translit: shlvsh shnym mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv mykhyhv bt 'vry'l mn gb'h vmlchmh hyth byn 'byh vbyn yrb'm
verses.translation: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאְסֹ֨ר אֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶת הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה בְּ/חַ֨יִל֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֑וּר וְ/יָרָבְעָ֗ם עָרַ֤ךְ עִמּ/וֹ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בִּ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vy'sr 'byh 't hmlchmh bchyl gbvry mlchmh 'rb' m'vt 'lf 'ysh bchvr vyrb'm 'rkh 'mv mlchmh bshmvnh m'vt 'lf 'ysh bchvr gbvr chyl
verses.translation: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם אֲבִיָּ֗ה מֵ/עַל֙ לְ/הַ֣ר צְמָרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּ/נִי יָרָבְעָ֥ם וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm 'byh m'l lhr tsmrym 'shr bhr 'prym vy'mr shm'vny yrb'm vkhl yshr'l
verses.translation: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֤א לָ/כֶם֙ לָ/דַ֔עַת כִּ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָתַ֨ן מַמְלָכָ֧ה לְ/דָוִ֛יד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם ל֥/וֹ וּ/לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו בְּרִ֥ית מֶֽלַח
verses.translit: hl' lkhm ld't khy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l ntn mmlkhh ldvyd 'l yshr'l l'vlm lv vlbnyv bryt mlch
verses.translation: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט עֶ֖בֶד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּמְרֹ֖ד עַל אֲדֹנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm yrb'm bn nbt 'bd shlmh bn dvyd vymrd 'l 'dnyv
verses.translation: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עָלָ֗י/ו אֲנָשִׁ֤ים רֵקִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיַּ֔עַל וַ/יִּֽתְאַמְּצ֖וּ עַל רְחַבְעָ֣ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וּ/רְחַבְעָ֗ם הָ֤יָה נַ֨עַר֙ וְ/רַךְ לֵבָ֔ב וְ/לֹ֥א הִתְחַזַּ֖ק לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqbtsv 'lyv 'nshym rqym bny bly'l vyt'mtsv 'l rchb'm bn shlmh vrchb'm hyh n'r vrkh lbb vl' htchzq lpnyhm
verses.translation: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֗ים לְ/הִתְחַזֵּק֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/יַ֖ד בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד וְ/אַתֶּם֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְ/עִמָּ/כֶם֙ עֶגְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם יָרָבְעָ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'th 'tm 'mrym lhtchzq lpny mmlkht yhvh byd bny dvyd v'tm hmvn rb v'mkhm 'gly zhb 'shr 'shh lkhm yrb'm l'lhym
verses.translation: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֤א הִדַּחְתֶּם֙ אֶת כֹּהֲנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וַ/תַּעֲשׂ֨וּ לָ/כֶ֤ם כֹּהֲנִים֙ כְּ/עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת כָּל הַ/בָּ֗א לְ/מַלֵּ֨א יָד֜/וֹ בְּ/פַ֤ר בֶּן בָּקָר֙ וְ/אֵילִ֣ם שִׁבְעָ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה כֹהֵ֖ן לְ/לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: hl' hdchtm 't khhny yhvh 't bny 'hrn vhlvym vt'shv lkhm khhnym kh'my h'rtsvt khl hb' lml' ydv bpr bn bqr v'ylm shb'h vhyh khhn ll' 'lhym
verses.translation: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנַ֛חְנוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/לֹ֣א עֲזַבְנֻ֑/הוּ וְ/כֹ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתִ֤ים לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בַּ/מְלָֽאכֶת
verses.translit: v'nchnv yhvh 'lhynv vl' 'zbnhv vkhhnym mshrtym lyhvh bny 'hrn vhlvym bml'kht
verses.translation: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD , are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

verses.original: וּ/מַקְטִרִ֣ים לַ/יהוָ֡ה עֹל֣וֹת בַּ/בֹּֽקֶר בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר וּ/בָ/עֶֽרֶב בָּ/עֶ֣רֶב וּ/קְטֹֽרֶת סַמִּים֩ וּ/מַעֲרֶ֨כֶת לֶ֜חֶם עַל הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֣ן הַ/טָּה֗וֹר וּ/מְנוֹרַ֨ת הַ/זָּהָ֤ב וְ/נֵרֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ לְ/בָעֵר֙ בָּ/עֶ֣רֶב בָּ/עֶ֔רֶב כִּֽי שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmqtrym lyhvh 'lvt bbqr bbqr vb'rb b'rb vqtrt smym vm'rkht lchm 'l hshlchn hthvr vmnvrt hzhb vnrtyh lb'r b'rb b'rb khy shmrym 'nchnv 't mshmrt yhvh 'lhynv v'tm 'zbtm 'tv
verses.translation: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֩ עִמָּ֨/נוּ בָ/רֹ֜אשׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֧ים וְ/כֹהֲנָ֛י/ו וַ/חֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַ/תְּרוּעָ֖ה לְ/הָרִ֣יעַ עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַל תִּלָּֽחֲמ֛וּ עִם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם כִּי לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ
verses.translit: vhnh 'mnv br'sh h'lhym vkhhnyv vchtstsrvt htrv'h lhry' 'lykhm bny yshr'l 'l tlchmv 'm yhvh 'lhy 'btykhm khy l' ttslychv
verses.translation: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

verses.original: וְ/יָֽרָבְעָ֗ם הֵסֵב֙ אֶת הַ/מַּאְרָ֔ב לָ/ב֖וֹא מֵֽ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/הַ/מַּאְרָ֖ב מֵ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyrb'm hsb 't hm'rb lbv' m'chryhm vyhyv lpny yhvdh vhm'rb m'chryhm
verses.translation: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֣וּ יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה לָ/הֶ֤ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ פָּנִ֣ים וְ/אָח֔וֹר וַֽ/יִּצְעֲק֖וּ לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מחצצרים מַחְצְרִ֖ים בַּ/חֲצֹצְרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vypnv yhvdh vhnh lhm hmlchmh pnym v'chvr vyts'qv lyhvh vhkhhnym mchtstsrym mchtsrym bchtstsrvt
verses.translation: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD , and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

verses.original: וַ/יָּרִ֖יעוּ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/הָרִ֨יעַ֙ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים נָגַ֤ף אֶת יָֽרָבְעָם֙ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֲבִיָּ֖ה וִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyry'v 'ysh yhvdh vyhy bhry' 'ysh yhvdh vh'lhym ngf 't yrb'm vkhl yshr'l lpny 'byh vyhvdh
verses.translation: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּנ֥וּסוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vynvsv bny yshr'l mpny yhvdh vytnm 'lhym bydm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ בָ/הֶ֛ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה וְ/עַמּ֖/וֹ מַכָּ֣ה רַבָּ֑ה וַ/יִּפְּל֤וּ חֲלָלִים֙ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֲמֵשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר
verses.translit: vykhv bhm 'byh v'mv mkhh rbh vyplv chllym myshr'l chmsh m'vt 'lf 'ysh bchvr
verses.translation: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכָּנְע֥וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וַ/יֶּֽאֶמְצוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֣י נִשְׁעֲנ֔וּ עַל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vykhn'v bny yshr'l b't hhy' vy'mtsv bny yhvdh khy nsh'nv 'l yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֣ף אֲבִיָּה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י יָרָבְעָם֒ וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֤ד מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ עָרִ֔ים אֶת בֵּֽית אֵל֙ וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת יְשָׁנָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת עפרון עֶפְרַ֖יִן וּ/בְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyrdf 'byh 'chry yrb'm vylkhd mmnv 'rym 't byt 'l v't bnvtyh v't yshnh v't bnvtyh v't 'prvn 'pryn vbntyh
verses.translation: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא עָצַ֧ר כֹּֽחַ יָרָבְעָ֛ם ע֖וֹד בִּ/ימֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יִּגְּפֵ֥/הוּ יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vl' 'tsr khch yrb'm 'vd bymy 'byhv vygphv yhvh vymt
verses.translation: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֣ק אֲבִיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יִּ֨שָּׂא ל֔/וֹ נָשִׁ֖ים אַרְבַּ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֑ה וַ/יּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ בָּנִ֔ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה בָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytchzq 'byhv vysh' lv nshym 'rb' 'shrh vyvld 'shrym vshnym bnym vshsh 'shrh bnvt
verses.translation: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֔ה וּ/דְרָכָ֖י/ו וּ/דְבָרָ֑י/ו כְּתוּבִ֕ים בְּ/מִדְרַ֖שׁ הַ/נָּבִ֥יא עִדּֽוֹ
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'byh vdrkhyv vdbryv khtvbym bmdrsh hnby' 'dv
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ אָסָא֙ הַ/טּ֣וֹב וְ/הַ/יָּשָׁ֔ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh 's' htvb vhyshr b'yny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛סַר אֶת מִזְבְּח֥וֹת הַ/נֵּכָ֖ר וְ/הַ/בָּמ֑וֹת וַ/יְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת הַ/מַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַ/יְגַדַּ֖ע אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרִֽים
verses.translit: vysr 't mzbchvt hnkhr vhbmvt vyshbr 't hmtsbvt vygd' 't h'shrym
verses.translation: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה לִ/דְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה וְ/הַ/מִּצְוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr lyhvdh ldrvsh 't yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm vl'shvt htvrh vhmtsvh
verses.translation: For he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨סַר֙ מִ/כָּל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת וְ/אֶת הַֽ/חַמָּנִ֑ים וַ/תִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vysr mkhl 'ry yhvdh 't hbmvt v't hchmnym vtshqt hmmlkhh lpnyv
verses.translation: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֛בֶן עָרֵ֥י מְצוּרָ֖ה בִּ/יהוּדָ֑ה כִּֽי שָׁקְטָ֣ה הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וְ/אֵין עִמּ֤/וֹ מִלְחָמָה֙ בַּ/שָּׁנִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כִּֽי הֵנִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vybn 'ry mtsvrh byhvdh khy shqth h'rts v'yn 'mv mlchmh bshnym h'lh khy hnych yhvh lv
verses.translation: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לִֽ/יהוּדָ֜ה נִבְנֶ֣ה אֶת הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וְ/נָסֵ֨ב חוֹמָ֣ה וּ/מִגְדָּלִים֮ דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּ/בְרִיחִים֒ עוֹדֶ֨/נּוּ הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לְ/פָנֵ֗י/נוּ כִּ֤י דָרַ֨שְׁנוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ דָּרַ֕שְׁנוּ וַ/יָּ֥נַֽח לָ֖/נוּ מִ/סָּבִ֑יב וַ/יִּבְנ֖וּ וַ/יַּצְלִֽיחוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lyhvdh nbnh 't h'rym h'lh vnsb chvmh vmgdlym dltym vbrychym 'vdnv h'rts lpnynv khy drshnv 't yhvh 'lhynv drshnv vynch lnv msbyb vybnv vytslychv
verses.translation: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לְ/אָסָ֗א חַיִל֮ נֹשֵׂ֣א צִנָּ֣ה וָ/רֹמַח֒ מִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶף וּ/מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֗ן נֹשְׂאֵ֤י מָגֵן֙ וְ/דֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת מָאתַ֥יִם וּ/שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyhy l's' chyl nsh' tsnh vrmch myhvdh shlsh m'vt 'lf vmbnymn nsh'y mgn vdrkhy qsht m'tym vshmvnym 'lf khl 'lh gbvry chyl
verses.translation: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him , and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
