verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם זֶ֣רַח הַ/כּוּשִׁ֗י בְּ/חַ֨יִל֙ אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/מַרְכָּב֖וֹת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וַ/יָּבֹ֖א עַד מָרֵשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vyts' 'lyhm zrch hkhvshy bchyl 'lf 'lpym vmrkhbvt shlsh m'vt vyb' 'd mrshh
verses.translation: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א אָסָ֖א לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּֽעַרְכוּ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּ/גֵ֥יא צְפַ֖תָה לְ/מָרֵשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vyts' 's' lpnyv vy'rkhv mlchmh bgy' tspth lmrshh
verses.translation: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אָסָ֜א אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָי/ו֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֵֽין עִמְּ/ךָ֤ לַ/עְזוֹר֙ בֵּ֥ין רַב֙ לְ/אֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ עָזְרֵ֜/נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ כִּֽי עָלֶ֣י/ךָ נִשְׁעַ֔נּוּ וּ/בְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ בָ֔אנוּ עַל הֶ/הָמ֖וֹן הַ/זֶּ֑ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אַ֔תָּה אַל יַעְצֹ֥ר עִמְּ/ךָ֖ אֱנֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vyqr' 's' 'l yhvh 'lhyv vy'mr yhvh 'yn 'mkh l'zvr byn rb l'yn khch 'zrnv yhvh 'lhynv khy 'lykh nsh'nv vbshmkh b'nv 'l hhmvn hzh yhvh 'lhynv 'th 'l y'tsr 'mkh 'nvsh
verses.translation: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ/כּוּשִׁ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י אָסָ֖א וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ הַ/כּוּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vygf yhvh 't hkhvshym lpny 's' vlpny yhvdh vynsv hkhvshym
verses.translation: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD , it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD , thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפֵ֨/ם אָסָ֜א וְ/הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּ/וֹ֮ עַד לִ/גְרָר֒ וַ/יִּפֹּ֤ל מִ/כּוּשִׁים֙ לְ/אֵ֣ין לָ/הֶ֣ם מִֽחְיָ֔ה כִּֽי נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ לִ/פְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י מַחֲנֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyrdpm 's' vh'm 'shr 'mv 'd lgrr vypl mkhvshym l'yn lhm mchyh khy nshbrv lpny yhvh vlpny mchnhv vysh'v shll hrbh m'd
verses.translation: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כָּל הֶֽ/עָרִים֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת גְּרָ֔ר כִּי הָיָ֥ה פַֽחַד יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּבֹ֨זּוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים כִּֽי בִזָּ֥ה רַבָּ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vykhv 't khl h'rym sbybvt grr khy hyh pchd yhvh 'lyhm vybzv 't khl h'rym khy bzh rbh hyth bhm
verses.translation: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD , and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אָהֳלֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הִכּ֑וּ וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֨וּ צֹ֤אן לָ/רֹב֙ וּ/גְמַלִּ֔ים וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vgm 'hly mqnh hkhv vyshbv ts'n lrb vgmlym vyshbv yrvshlm
verses.translation: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן עוֹדֵ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה עָלָ֖י/ו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'zryhv bn 'vdd hyth 'lyv rvch 'lhym
verses.translation: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אָסָא֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ שְׁמָע֕וּ/נִי אָסָ֖א וְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֣ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן יְהוָ֤ה עִמָּ/כֶם֙ בִּֽ/הְיֽוֹתְ/כֶ֣ם עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/אִֽם תִּדְרְשֻׁ֨/הוּ֙ יִמָּצֵ֣א לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אִם תַּעַזְבֻ֖/הוּ יַעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyts' lpny 's' vy'mr lv shm'vny 's' vkhl yhvdh vbnymn yhvh 'mkhm bhyvtkhm 'mv v'm tdrshhv ymts' lkhm v'm t'zbhv y'zb 'tkhm
verses.translation: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

verses.original: וְ/יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/לֹ֣א אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֱמֶ֗ת וּ/לְ/לֹ֛א כֹּהֵ֥ן מוֹרֶ֖ה וּ/לְ/לֹ֥א תוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vymym rbym lyshr'l ll' 'lhy 'mt vll' khhn mvrh vll' tvrh
verses.translation: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ בַּ/צַּר ל֔/וֹ עַל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יְבַקְשֻׁ֖/הוּ וַ/יִּמָּצֵ֥א לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshb btsr lv 'l yhvh 'lhy yshr'l vybqshhv vymts' lhm
verses.translation: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

verses.original: וּ/בָ/עִתִּ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לַ/יּוֹצֵ֣א וְ/לַ/בָּ֑א כִּ֚י מְהוּמֹ֣ת רַבּ֔וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אֲרָצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vb'tym hhm 'yn shlvm lyvts' vlb' khy mhvmt rbvt 'l khl yvshby h'rtsvt
verses.translation: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

verses.original: וְ/כֻתְּת֥וּ גוֹי בְּ/ג֖וֹי וְ/עִ֣יר בְּ/עִ֑יר כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲמָמָ֖/ם בְּ/כָל צָרָֽה
verses.translit: vkhttv gvy bgvy v'yr b'yr khy 'lhym hmmm bkhl tsrh
verses.translation: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם חִזְק֔וּ וְ/אַל יִרְפּ֖וּ יְדֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ שָׂכָ֖ר לִ/פְעֻלַּתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm chzqv v'l yrpv ydykhm khy ysh shkhr lp'ltkhm
verses.translation: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

verses.original: וְ/כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ אָסָ֜א הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וְ/הַ/נְּבוּאָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד הַ/נָּבִיא֒ הִתְחַזַּ֗ק וַ/יַּעֲבֵ֤ר הַ/שִּׁקּוּצִים֙ מִ/כָּל אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן וּ/מִן הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד מֵ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יְחַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר לִ/פְנֵ֖י אוּלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhshm' 's' hdbrym h'lh vhnbv'h 'dd hnby' htchzq vy'br hshqvtsym mkhl 'rts yhvdh vbnymn vmn h'rym 'shr lkhd mhr 'prym vychdsh 't mzbch yhvh 'shr lpny 'vlm yhvh
verses.translation: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD , that was before the porch of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֗ץ אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן וְ/הַ/גָּרִים֙ עִמָּ/הֶ֔ם מֵ/אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּ/מִ/שִּׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי נָפְל֨וּ עָלָ֤י/ו מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָ/רֹ֔ב בִּ/רְאֹתָ֕/ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqbts 't khl yhvdh vbnymn vhgrym 'mhm m'prym vmnshh vmshm'vn khy nplv 'lyv myshr'l lrb br'tm khy yhvh 'lhyv 'mv
verses.translation: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֥וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לִ/שְׁנַ֥ת חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לְ/מַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא
verses.translit: vyqbtsv yrvshlm bchdsh hshlyshy lshnt chmsh 'shrh lmlkhvt 's'
verses.translation: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבְּח֤וּ לַ/יהוָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא מִן הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל הֵבִ֑יאוּ בָּקָר֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וְ/צֹ֖אן שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: vyzbchv lyhvh byvm hhv' mn hshll hby'v bqr shb' m'vt vts'n shb't 'lpym
verses.translation: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ בַ/בְּרִ֔ית לִ/דְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם בְּ/כָל לְבָבָ֖/ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vyb'v bbryt ldrvsh 't yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm bkhl lbbm vbkhl npshm
verses.translation: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יִדְרֹ֛שׁ לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יוּמָ֑ת לְ/מִן קָטֹן֙ וְ/עַד גָּד֔וֹל לְ/מֵ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/עַד אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr l' ydrsh lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l yvmt lmn qtn v'd gdvl lm'ysh v'd 'shh
verses.translation: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וּ/בִ/תְרוּעָ֑ה וּ/בַ/חֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּ/בְ/שׁוֹפָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyshb'v lyhvh bqvl gdvl vbtrv'h vbchtstsrvt vbshvprvt
verses.translation: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל הַ/שְּׁבוּעָ֗ה כִּ֤י בְ/כָל לְבָבָ/ם֙ נִשְׁבָּ֔עוּ וּ/בְ/כָל רְצוֹנָ֣/ם בִּקְשֻׁ֔/הוּ וַ/יִּמָּצֵ֖א לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּ֧נַח יְהוָ֛ה לָ/הֶ֖ם מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyshmchv khl yhvdh 'l hshbv'h khy bkhl lbbm nshb'v vbkhl rtsvnm bqshhv vymts' lhm vynch yhvh lhm msbyb
verses.translation: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.

verses.original: וְ/גַֽם מַעֲכָ֞ה אֵ֣ם אָסָ֣א הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ הֱסִירָ/הּ֙ מִ/גְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה לַ/אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה מִפְלָ֑צֶת וַ/יִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת מִפְלַצְתָּ֔/הּ וַ/יָּ֕דֶק וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּ/נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vgm m'khh 'm 's' hmlkh hsyrh mgbyrh 'shr 'shth l'shrh mpltst vykhrt 's' 't mpltsth vydq vyshrf bnchl qdrvn
verses.translation: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/בָּמ֔וֹת לֹא סָ֖רוּ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֧ק לְבַב אָסָ֛א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֖ם כָּל יָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhbmvt l' srv myshr'l rq lbb 's' hyh shlm khl ymyv
verses.translation: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֞א אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֥י אָבִ֛י/ו וְ/קָֽדָשָׁ֖י/ו בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כֶּ֥סֶף וְ/זָהָ֖ב וְ/כֵלִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' 't qdshy 'byv vqdshyv byt h'lhym khsf vzhb vkhlym
verses.translation: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.original: וּ/מִלְחָמָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָיָ֑תָה עַ֛ד שְׁנַת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/חָמֵ֖שׁ לְ/מַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא
verses.translit: vmlchmh l' hyth 'd shnt shlshym vchmsh lmlkhvt 's'
verses.translation: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָ/שֵׁשׁ֙ לְ/מַלְכ֣וּת אָסָ֔א עָלָ֞ה בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּ֖בֶן אֶת הָ/רָמָ֑ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יוֹצֵ֣א וָ/בָ֔א לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shlshym vshsh lmlkhvt 's' 'lh b'sh' mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvdh vybn 't hrmh lblty tt yvts' vb' l's' mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּצֵ֨א אָסָ֜א כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֗ב מֵ/אֹֽצְר֛וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל בֶּן הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/דַרְמֶ֖שֶׂק לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyts' 's' khsf vzhb m'tsrvt byt yhvh vbyt hmlkh vyshlch 'l bn hdd mlkh 'rm hyvshb bdrmshq l'mr
verses.translation: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

verses.original: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בֵ֥ין אָבִ֖/י וּ/בֵ֣ין אָבִ֑י/ךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּֽי לְ/ךָ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב לֵ֞ךְ הָפֵ֣ר בְּרִֽיתְ/ךָ֗ אֶת בַּעְשָׁא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/יַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵ/עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: bryt byny vbynkh vbyn 'by vbyn 'bykh hnh shlchty lkh khsf vzhb lkh hpr brytkh 't b'sh' mlkh yshr'l vy'lh m'ly
verses.translation: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן הֲדַ֜ד אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/חֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֙ אֶל עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּכּוּ֙ אֶת עִיּ֣וֹן וְ/אֶת דָּ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל מָ֑יִם וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּֽל מִסְכְּנ֖וֹת עָרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי
verses.translit: vyshm' bn hdd 'l hmlkh 's' vyshlch 't shry hchylym 'shr lv 'l 'ry yshr'l vykhv 't 'yvn v't dn v't 'bl mym v't khl mskhnvt 'ry nptly
verses.translation: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א וַ/יֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִ/בְּנ֖וֹת אֶת הָ/רָמָ֑ה וַ/יַּשְׁבֵּ֖ת אֶת מְלַאכְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' b'sh' vychdl mbnvt 't hrmh vyshbt 't ml'khtv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

verses.original: וְ/אָסָ֣א הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ לָקַח֙ אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽ/רָמָה֙ וְ/אֶת עֵצֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א וַ/יִּ֣בֶן בָּ/הֶ֔ם אֶת גֶּ֖בַע וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: v's' hmlkh lqch 't khl yhvdh vysh'v 't 'bny hrmh v't 'tsyh 'shr bnh b'sh' vybn bhm 't gb' v't hmtsph
verses.translation: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

verses.original: וּ/בָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא בָּ֚א חֲנָ֣נִי הָ/רֹאֶ֔ה אֶל אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו בְּ/הִשָּׁ֨עֶנְ/ךָ֜ עַל מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲרָם֙ וְ/לֹ֤א נִשְׁעַ֨נְתָּ֙ עַל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ עַל כֵּ֗ן נִמְלַ֛ט חֵ֥יל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם מִ/יָּדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vb't hhy' b' chnny hr'h 'l 's' mlkh yhvdh vy'mr 'lyv bhsh'nkh 'l mlkh 'rm vl' nsh'nt 'l yhvh 'lhykh 'l khn nmlt chyl mlkh 'rm mydkh
verses.translation: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֧א הַ/כּוּשִׁ֣ים וְ/הַ/לּוּבִ֗ים הָי֨וּ לְ/חַ֧יִל לָ/רֹ֛ב לְ/רֶ֥כֶב וּ/לְ/פָרָשִׁ֖ים לְ/הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּ/בְ/הִשָּֽׁעֶנְ/ךָ֥ עַל יְהוָ֖ה נְתָנָ֥/ם בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hl' hkhvshym vhlvbym hyv lchyl lrb lrkhb vlprshym lhrbh m'd vbhsh'nkh 'l yhvh ntnm bydkh
verses.translation: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD , he delivered them into thine hand.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה עֵינָ֞י/ו מְשֹׁטְט֤וֹת בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לְ֠/הִתְחַזֵּק עִם לְבָבָ֥/ם שָׁלֵ֛ם אֵלָ֖י/ו נִסְכַּ֣לְתָּ עַל זֹ֑את כִּ֣י מֵ/עַ֔תָּה יֵ֥שׁ עִמְּ/ךָ֖ מִלְחָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'ynyv mshttvt bkhl h'rts lhtchzq 'm lbbm shlm 'lyv nskhlt 'l z't khy m'th ysh 'mkh mlchmvt
verses.translation: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְעַ֨ס אָסָ֜א אֶל הָ/רֹאֶ֗ה וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֨/הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/מַּהְפֶּ֔כֶת כִּֽי בְ/זַ֥עַף עִמּ֖/וֹ עַל זֹ֑את וַ/יְרַצֵּ֥ץ אָסָ֛א מִן הָ/עָ֖ם בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: vykh's 's' 'l hr'h vytnhv byt hmhpkht khy bz'f 'mv 'l z't vyrtsts 's' mn h'm b't hhy'
verses.translation: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing . And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָסָ֔א הָ/רִאשׁוֹנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֤/ם כְּתוּבִים֙ עַל סֵ֣פֶר הַ/מְּלָכִ֔ים לִ/יהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhnh dbry 's' hr'shvnym vh'chrvnym hnm khtvbym 'l spr hmlkhym lyhvdh vyshr'l
verses.translation: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱלֶ֣א אָסָ֡א בִּ/שְׁנַת֩ שְׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים וָ/תֵ֤שַׁע לְ/מַלְכוּת/וֹ֙ בְּ/רַגְלָ֔י/ו עַד לְ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה חָלְי֑/וֹ וְ/גַם בְּ/חָלְי/וֹ֙ לֹא דָרַ֣שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֖י בָּ/רֹפְאִֽים
verses.translit: vychl' 's' bshnt shlvshym vtsh' lmlkhvtv brglyv 'd lm'lh chlyv vgm bchlyv l' drsh 't yhvh khy brp'ym
verses.translation: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD , but to the physicians.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אָסָ֖א עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֕מָת בִּ/שְׁנַ֛ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ/אַחַ֖ת לְ/מָלְכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshkhb 's' 'm 'btyv vymt bshnt 'rb'ym v'cht lmlkhv
verses.translation: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֣/הוּ בְ/קִבְרֹתָ֗י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּֽרָה ל/וֹ֮ בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִיד֒ וַ/יַּשְׁכִּיבֻ֗/הוּ בַּ/מִּשְׁכָּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּא֙ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים וּ/זְנִ֔ים מְרֻקָּחִ֖ים בְּ/מִרְקַ֣חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׂרְפוּ ל֥/וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה עַד לִ/מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyqbrhv bqbrtyv 'shr khrh lv b'yr dvyd vyshkhybhv bmshkhb 'shr ml' bshmym vznym mrqchym bmrqcht m'shh vyshrpv lv shrph gdvlh 'd lm'd
verses.translation: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries’ art: and they made a very great burning for him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vymlkh yhvshpt bnv tchtyv vytchzq 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨תֶּן חַ֔יִל בְּ/כָל עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה הַ/בְּצֻר֑וֹת וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן נְצִיבִים֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד אָסָ֥א אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytn chyl bkhl 'ry yhvdh hbtsrvt vytn ntsybym b'rts yhvdh vb'ry 'prym 'shr lkhd 's' 'byv
verses.translation: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י הָלַ֗ךְ בְּ/דַרְכֵ֞י דָּוִ֤יד אָבִי/ו֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א דָרַ֖שׁ לַ/בְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 'm yhvshpt khy hlkh bdrkhy dvyd 'byv hr'shnym vl' drsh lb'lym
verses.translation: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֤י אָבִי/ו֙ דָּרָ֔שׁ וּ/בְ/מִצְוֺתָ֖י/ו הָלָ֑ךְ וְ/לֹ֖א כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy l'lhy 'byv drsh vbmtsvtyv hlkh vl' khm'shh yshr'l
verses.translation: But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨כֶן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יִּתְּנ֧וּ כָל יְהוּדָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַֽ/יְהִי ל֥/וֹ עֹֽשֶׁר וְ/כָב֖וֹד לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vykhn yhvh 't hmmlkhh bydv vytnv khl yhvdh mnchh lyhvshpt vyhy lv 'shr vkhbvd lrb
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְבַּ֥הּ לִבּ֖/וֹ בְּ/דַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/ע֗וֹד הֵסִ֛יר אֶת הַ/בָּמ֥וֹת וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים מִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vygbh lbv bdrkhy yhvh v'vd hsyr 't hbmvt v't h'shrym myhvdh
verses.translation: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD : moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֨ת שָׁל֜וֹשׁ לְ/מָלְכ֗/וֹ שָׁלַ֤ח לְ/שָׂרָי/ו֙ לְ/בֶן חַ֨יִל֙ וּ/לְ/עֹבַדְיָ֣ה וְ/לִ/זְכַרְיָ֔ה וְ/לִ/נְתַנְאֵ֖ל וּ/לְ/מִיכָיָ֑הוּ לְ/לַמֵּ֖ד בְּ/עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnt shlvsh lmlkhv shlch lshryv lbn chyl vl'bdyh vlzkhryh vlntn'l vlmykhyhv llmd b'ry yhvdh
verses.translation: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֣ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָ֡הוּ וּ/נְתַנְיָ֡הוּ וּ/זְבַדְיָ֡הוּ וַ/עֲשָׂהאֵ֡ל ו/שמרימות וּ/שְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽ/יהוֹנָתָן֩ וַ/אֲדֹ֨נִיָּ֧הוּ וְ/טֽוֹבִיָּ֛הוּ וְ/ט֥וֹב אֲדוֹנִיָּ֖ה הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֛ם אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וִֽ/יהוֹרָ֖ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: v'mhm hlvym shm'yhv vntnyhv vzbdyhv v'shh'l vshmrymvt vshmyrmvt vyhvntn v'dnyhv vtvbyhv vtvb 'dvnyh hlvym v'mhm 'lyshm' vyhvrm hkhhnym
verses.translation: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְלַמְּדוּ֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עִ֨מָּ/הֶ֔ם סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ בְּ/כָל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽ/יְלַמְּד֖וּ בָּ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vylmdv byhvdh v'mhm spr tvrt yhvh vysbv bkhl 'ry yhvdh vylmdv b'm
verses.translation: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֗ה עַ֚ל כָּל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָֽ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיב֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט
verses.translit: vyhy pchd yhvh 'l khl mmlkhvt h'rtsvt 'shr sbybvt yhvdh vl' nlchmv 'm yhvshpt
verses.translation: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

verses.original: וּ/מִן פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים מְבִיאִ֧ים לִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט מִנְחָ֖ה וְ/כֶ֣סֶף מַשָּׂ֑א גַּ֣ם הָֽ/עַרְבִיאִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֥ים ל/וֹ֙ צֹ֕אן אֵילִ֔ים שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וּ/שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּ/תְיָשִׁ֕ים שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmn plshtym mby'ym lyhvshpt mnchh vkhsf msh' gm h'rby'ym mby'ym lv ts'n 'ylym shb't 'lpym vshb' m'vt vtyshym shb't 'lpym vshb' m'vt
verses.translation: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְ/גָדֵ֖ל עַד לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וַ/יִּ֧בֶן בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֛ה בִּירָנִיּ֖וֹת וְ/עָרֵ֥י מִסְכְּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy yhvshpt hlkh vgdl 'd lm'lh vybn byhvdh byrnyvt v'ry mskhnvt
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.

verses.original: וּ/מְלָאכָ֥ה רַבָּ֛ה הָ֥יָה ל֖/וֹ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vml'khh rbh hyh lv b'ry yhvdh v'nshy mlchmh gbvry chyl byrvshlm
verses.translation: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם לִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י אֲלָפִ֔ים עַדְנָ֣ה הַ/שָּׂ֔ר וְ/עִמּ/וֹ֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: v'lh pqdtm lbyt 'bvtyhm lyhvdh shry 'lpym 'dnh hshr v'mv gbvry chyl shlsh m'vt 'lf
verses.translation: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָד֖/וֹ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַ/שָּׂ֑ר וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם וּ/שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: v'l ydv yhvchnn hshr v'mv m'tym vshmvnym 'lf
verses.translation: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָד/וֹ֙ עֲמַסְיָ֣ה בֶן זִכְרִ֔י הַ/מִּתְנַדֵּ֖ב לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/עִמּ֛/וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל
verses.translit: v'l ydv 'msyh bn zkhry hmtndb lyhvh v'mv m'tym 'lf gbvr chyl
verses.translation: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֨ן בִּנְיָמִ֔ן גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל אֶלְיָדָ֑ע וְ/עִמּ֛/וֹ נֹֽשְׁקֵי קֶ֥שֶׁת וּ/מָגֵ֖ן מָאתַ֥יִם אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vmn bnymn gbvr chyl 'lyd' v'mv nshqy qsht vmgn m'tym 'lf
verses.translation: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָד֖/וֹ יְהוֹזָבָ֑ד וְ/עִמּ֛/וֹ מֵאָֽה וּ/שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא
verses.translit: v'l ydv yhvzbd v'mv m'h vshmvnym 'lf chlvtsy tsb'
verses.translation: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה הַ/מְשָׁרְתִ֣ים אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ מִ/לְּ/בַ֞ד אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/מִּבְצָ֖ר בְּ/כָל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh hmshrtym 't hmlkh mlbd 'shr ntn hmlkh b'ry hmbtsr bkhl yhvdh
verses.translation: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י לִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט עֹ֥שֶׁר וְ/כָב֖וֹד לָ/רֹ֑ב וַ/יִּתְחַתֵּ֖ן לְ/אַחְאָֽב
verses.translit: vyhy lyhvshpt 'shr vkhbvd lrb vytchtn l'ch'b
verses.translation: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרֶד֩ לְ/קֵ֨ץ שָׁנִ֤ים אֶל אַחְאָב֙ לְ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַ/יִּֽזְבַּֽח ל֨/וֹ אַחְאָ֜ב צֹ֤אן וּ/בָקָר֙ לָ/רֹ֔ב וְ/לָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְסִיתֵ֕/הוּ לַ/עֲל֖וֹת אֶל רָמ֥וֹת גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyrd lqts shnym 'l 'ch'b lshmrvn vyzbch lv 'ch'b ts'n vbqr lrb vl'm 'shr 'mv vysythv l'lvt 'l rmvt gl'd
verses.translation: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲ/תֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמִּ֖/י רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ כָּמ֤וֹ/נִי כָמ֨וֹ/ךָ֙ וּ/כְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ עַמִּ֔/י וְ/עִמְּ/ךָ֖ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh htlkh 'my rmt gl'd vy'mr lv khmvny khmvkh vkh'mkh 'my v'mkh bmlchmh
verses.translation: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art , and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דְּרָשׁ נָ֥א כַ/יּ֖וֹם אֶת דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt 'l mlkh yshr'l drsh n' khyvm 't dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֨ץ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֶֽת הַ/נְּבִאִים֮ אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת אִישׁ֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם הֲ/נֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ עֲלֵ֔ה וְ/יִתֵּ֥ן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyqbts mlkh yshr'l 't hnb'ym 'rb' m'vt 'ysh vy'mr 'lhm hnlkh 'l rmt gl'd lmlchmh 'm 'chdl vy'mrv 'lh vytn h'lhym byd hmlkh
verses.translation: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king’s hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הַ/אֵ֨ין פֹּ֥ה נָבִ֛יא לַ/יהוָ֖ה ע֑וֹד וְ/נִדְרְשָׁ֖ה מֵ/אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt h'yn ph nby' lyhvh 'vd vndrshh m'tv
verses.translation: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֶֽל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט ע֣וֹד אִישׁ אֶחָ֡ד לִ/דְרוֹשׁ֩ אֶת יְהוָ֨ה מֵֽ/אֹת֜/וֹ וַ/אֲנִ֣י שְׂנֵאתִ֗י/הוּ כִּֽי אֵ֠ינֶ/נּוּ מִתְנַבֵּ֨א עָלַ֤/י לְ/טוֹבָה֙ כִּ֣י כָל יָמָ֣י/ו לְ/רָעָ֔ה ה֖וּא מִיכָ֣יְהוּ בֶן יִמְלָ֑א וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט אַל יֹאמַ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt 'vd 'ysh 'chd ldrvsh 't yhvh m'tv v'ny shn'tyhv khy 'ynnv mtnb' 'ly ltvbh khy khl ymyv lr'h hv' mykhyhv bn yml' vy'mr yhvshpt 'l y'mr hmlkh khn
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD : but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל סָרִ֖יס אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מַהֵ֖ר מיכהו מִיכָ֥יְהוּ בֶן יִמְלָֽא
verses.translit: vyqr' mlkh yshr'l 'l srys 'chd vy'mr mhr mykhhv mykhyhv bn yml'
verses.translation: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֡ה יוֹשְׁבִים֩ אִ֨ישׁ עַל כִּסְא֜/וֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֤ים בְּגָדִים֙ וְ/יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּ/גֹ֔רֶן פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְ/כָל הַ֨/נְּבִיאִ֔ים מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh yvshbym 'ysh 'l khs'v mlbshym bgdym vyshbym bgrn ptch sh'r shmrvn vkhl hnby'ym mtnb'ym lpnyhm
verses.translation: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛/וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָ֖ה קַרְנֵ֣י בַרְזֶ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/אֵ֛לֶּה תְּנַגַּ֥ח אֶת אֲרָ֖ם עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'sh lv tsdqyhv bn khn'nh qrny brzl vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh b'lh tngch 't 'rm 'd khlvtm
verses.translation: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD , With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ֨/נְּבִאִ֔ים נִבְּאִ֥ים כֵּ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/הַצְלַ֔ח וְ/נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vkhl hnb'ym nb'ym khn l'mr 'lh rmt gl'd vhtslch vntn yhvh byd hmlkh
verses.translation: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּלְאָ֞ךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֣ךְ לִ/קְרֹ֣א לְ/מִיכָ֗יְהוּ דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֞ה דִּבְרֵ֧י הַ/נְּבִאִ֛ים פֶּֽה אֶחָ֥ד ט֖וֹב אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וִֽ/יהִי נָ֧א דְבָרְ/ךָ֛ כְּ/אַחַ֥ד מֵ/הֶ֖ם וְ/דִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: vhml'kh 'shr hlkh lqr' lmykhyhv dbr 'lyv l'mr hnh dbry hnb'ym ph 'chd tvb 'l hmlkh vyhy n' dbrkh kh'chd mhm vdbrt tvb
verses.translation: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מִיכָ֑יְהוּ חַי יְהוָ֕ה כִּ֛י אֶת אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהַ֖/י אֹת֥/וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv chy yhvh khy 't 'shr y'mr 'lhy 'tv 'dbr
verses.translation: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֮ אֶל הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֵלָ֗י/ו מִיכָה֙ הֲ/נֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ עֲל֣וּ וְ/הַצְלִ֔יחוּ וְ/יִנָּתְנ֖וּ בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb' 'l hmlkh vy'mr hmlkh 'lyv mykhh hnlkh 'l rmt gl'd lmlchmh 'm 'chdl vy'mr 'lv vhtslychv vyntnv bydkhm
verses.translation: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַד כַּ/מֶּ֥ה פְעָמִ֖ים אֲנִ֣י מַשְׁבִּיעֶ֑/ךָ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא תְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛/י רַק אֱמֶ֖ת בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv hmlkh 'd khmh p'mym 'ny mshby'kh 'shr l' tdbr 'ly rq 'mt bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְפוֹצִ֣ים עַל הֶֽ/הָרִ֔ים כַּ/צֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֖ן רֹעֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לֹֽא אֲדֹנִ֣ים לָ/אֵ֔לֶּה יָשׁ֥וּבוּ אִישׁ לְ/בֵית֖/וֹ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr r'yty 't khl yshr'l npvtsym 'l hhrym khts'n 'shr 'yn lhn r'h vy'mr yhvh l' 'dnym l'lh yshvbv 'ysh lbytv bshlvm
verses.translation: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט הֲ/לֹא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ לֹא יִתְנַבֵּ֥א עָלַ֛/י ט֖וֹב כִּ֥י אִם לְ/רָֽע
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt hl' 'mrty 'lykh l' ytnb' 'ly tvb khy 'm lr'
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לָ/כֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֑ה רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת יְהוָה֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְא֔/וֹ וְ/כָל צְבָ֤א הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ עֹֽמְדִ֔ים עַל יְמִינ֖/וֹ וּ/שְׂמֹאלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhn shm'v dbr yhvh r'yty 't yhvh yvshb 'l khs'v vkhl tsb' hshmym 'mdym 'l ymynv vshm'lv
verses.translation: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD ; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה מִ֤י יְפַתֶּה֙ אֶת אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/יַ֕עַל וְ/יִפֹּ֖ל בְּ/רָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר זֶ֚ה אֹמֵ֣ר כָּ֔כָה וְ/זֶ֖ה אֹמֵ֥ר כָּֽכָה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh my ypth 't 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l vy'l vypl brmvt gl'd vy'mr zh 'mr khkhh vzh 'mr khkhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א הָ/ר֗וּחַ וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲנִ֣י אֲפַתֶּ֑/נּוּ וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖י/ו בַּ/מָּֽה
verses.translit: vyts' hrvch vy'md lpny yhvh vy'mr 'ny 'ptnv vy'mr yhvh 'lyv bmh
verses.translation: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD , and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֵצֵא֙ וְ/הָיִ֨יתִי֙ לְ/ר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּ/פִ֖י כָּל נְבִיאָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר תְּפַתֶּה֙ וְ/גַם תּוּכָ֔ל צֵ֖א וַ/עֲשֵׂה כֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ts' vhyyty lrvch shqr bpy khl nby'yv vy'mr tpth vgm tvkhl ts' v'shh khn
verses.translation: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the Lord said, Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּ/פִ֖י נְבִיאֶ֣י/ךָ אֵ֑לֶּה וַֽ/יהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֖י/ךָ רָעָֽה
verses.translit: v'th hnh ntn yhvh rvch shqr bpy nby'ykh 'lh vyhvh dbr 'lykh r'h
verses.translation: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּשׁ֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת מִיכָ֖יְהוּ עַל הַ/לֶּ֑חִי וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֣י זֶ֤ה הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ עָבַ֧ר רֽוּחַ יְהוָ֛ה מֵ/אִתִּ֖/י לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vygsh tsdqyhv bn khn'nh vykh 't mykhyhv 'l hlchy vy'mr 'y zh hdrkh 'br rvch yhvh m'ty ldbr 'tkh
verses.translation: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔יְהוּ הִנְּ/ךָ֥ רֹאֶ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּב֛וֹא חֶ֥דֶר בְּ/חֶ֖דֶר לְ/הֵחָבֵֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv hnkh r'h byvm hhv' 'shr tbv' chdr bchdr lhchb'
verses.translation: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל קְחוּ֙ אֶת מִיכָ֔יְהוּ וַ/הֲשִׁיבֻ֖/הוּ אֶל אָמ֣וֹן שַׂר הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/אֶל יוֹאָ֖שׁ בֶּן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l qchv 't mykhyhv vhshybhv 'l 'mvn shr h'yr v'l yv'sh bn hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שִׂ֥ימוּ זֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית הַ/כֶּ֑לֶא וְ/הַאֲכִלֻ֜/הוּ לֶ֤חֶם לַ֨חַץ֙ וּ/מַ֣יִם לַ֔חַץ עַ֖ד שׁוּבִ֥/י בְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'mrtm khh 'mr hmlkh shymv zh byt hkhl' vh'khlhv lchm lchts vmym lchts 'd shvby bshlvm
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔יְהוּ אִם שׁ֤וֹב תָּשׁוּב֙ בְּ/שָׁל֔וֹם לֹא דִבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בִּ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְע֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv 'm shvb tshvb bshlvm l' dbr yhvh by vy'mr shm'v 'mym khlm
verses.translation: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַל מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vy'l mlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh 'l rmt gl'd
verses.translation: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ֙ וָ/ב֣וֹא בַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לְבַ֣שׁ בְּגָדֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יִּתְחַפֵּשׂ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt htchpsh vbv' bmlchmh v'th lbsh bgdykh vytchpsh mlkh yshr'l vyb'v bmlchmh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֡ם צִוָּה֩ אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י הָ/רֶ֤כֶב אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֚א תִּלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ אֶת הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן אֶת הַ/גָּד֑וֹל כִּ֛י אִֽם אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmlkh 'rm tsvh 't shry hrkhb 'shr lv l'mr l' tlchmv 't hqtn 't hgdvl khy 'm 't mlkh yshr'l lbdv
verses.translation: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כִּ/רְאוֹת֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָ/רֶ֜כֶב אֶת יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וְ/הֵ֤מָּה אָֽמְרוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֔וּא וַ/יָּסֹ֥בּוּ עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/הִלָּחֵ֑ם וַ/יִּזְעַ֤ק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ וַֽ/יהוָ֣ה עֲזָר֔/וֹ וַ/יְסִיתֵ֥/ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt shry hrkhb 't yhvshpt vhmh 'mrv mlkh yshr'l hv' vysbv 'lyv lhlchm vyz'q yhvshpt vyhvh 'zrv vysytm 'lhym mmnv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/רְאוֹת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב כִּ֥י לֹא הָיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מֵ/אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt shry hrkhb khy l' hyh mlkh yshr'l vyshbv m'chryv
verses.translation: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ מָשַׁ֤ךְ בַּ/קֶּ֨שֶׁת֙ לְ/תֻמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בֵּ֥ין הַ/דְּבָקִ֖ים וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/שִּׁרְיָ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָֽ/רַכָּ֗ב הֲפֹ֧ךְ ידי/ך יָדְ/ךָ֛ וְ/הוֹצֵאתַ֥/נִי מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה כִּ֥י הָחֳלֵֽיתִי
verses.translit: v'ysh mshkh bqsht ltmv vykh 't mlkh yshr'l byn hdbqym vbyn hshryn vy'mr lrkhb hpkh ydykh ydkh vhvts'tny mn hmchnh khy hchlyty
verses.translation: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֤עַל הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָיָ֨ה מַעֲמִ֧יד בַּ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה נֹ֥כַח אֲרָ֖ם עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וַ/יָּ֕מָת לְ/עֵ֖ת בּ֥וֹא הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vt'l hmlchmh byvm hhv' vmlkh yshr'l hyh m'myd bmrkhbh nkhch 'rm 'd h'rb vymt l't bv' hshmsh
verses.translation: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּשָׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֧ה אֶל בֵּית֛/וֹ בְּ/שָׁל֖וֹם לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshb yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh 'l bytv bshlvm lyrvshlm
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א אֶל פָּנָ֗י/ו יֵה֣וּא בֶן חֲנָ֘נִי֮ הַ/חֹזֶה֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הֲ/לָ/רָשָׁ֣ע לַ/עְזֹ֔ר וּ/לְ/שֹׂנְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תֶּאֱהָ֑ב וּ/בָ/זֹאת֙ עָלֶ֣י/ךָ קֶּ֔צֶף מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' 'l pnyv yhv' bn chnny hchzh vy'mr 'l hmlkh yhvshpt hlrsh' l'zr vlshn'y yhvh t'hb vbz't 'lykh qtsf mlpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD .

verses.original: אֲבָ֕ל דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִ֖ים נִמְצְא֣וּ עִמָּ֑/ךְ כִּֽי בִעַ֤רְתָּ הָ/אֲשֵׁרוֹת֙ מִן הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/הֲכִינ֥וֹתָ לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ לִ/דְרֹ֥שׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'bl dbrym tvbym nmts'v 'mkh khy b'rt h'shrvt mn h'rts vhkhynvt lbbkh ldrsh h'lhym
verses.translation: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֜שָׁב וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א בָ/עָ֗ם מִ/בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֨בַע֙ עַד הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַ/יְשִׁיבֵ֕/ם אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshb yhvshpt byrvshlm vyshb vyts' b'm mb'r shb' 'd hr 'prym vyshybm 'l yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֨ד שֹֽׁפְטִ֜ים בָּ/אָ֗רֶץ בְּ/כָל עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ/בְּצֻר֖וֹת לְ/עִ֥יר וָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'md shptym b'rts bkhl 'ry yhvdh hbtsrvt l'yr v'yr
verses.translation: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל הַ/שֹּֽׁפְטִ֗ים רְאוּ֙ מָֽה אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כִּ֣י לֹ֧א לְ/אָדָ֛ם תִּשְׁפְּט֖וּ כִּ֣י לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם בִּ/דְבַ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l hshptym r'v mh 'tm 'shym khy l' l'dm tshptv khy lyhvh v'mkhm bdbr mshpt
verses.translation: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD , who is with you in the judgment.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה יְהִ֥י פַֽחַד יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם שִׁמְר֣וּ וַ/עֲשׂ֔וּ כִּֽי אֵ֞ין עִם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ עַוְלָ֛ה וּ/מַשֹּׂ֥א פָנִ֖ים וּ/מִקַּח שֹֽׁחַד
verses.translit: v'th yhy pchd yhvh 'lykhm shmrv v'shv khy 'yn 'm yhvh 'lhynv 'vlh vmsh' pnym vmqch shchd
verses.translation: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם בִּ֠/ירוּשָׁלִַם הֶעֱמִ֨יד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּ/מֵ/רָאשֵׁ֤י הָ/אָבוֹת֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לָ/רִ֑יב וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vgm byrvshlm h'myd yhvshpt mn hlvym vhkhhnym vmr'shy h'bvt lyshr'l lmshpt yhvh vlryb vyshbv yrvshlm
verses.translation: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD , and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ו עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּ/ן֙ בְּ/יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֖ה וּ/בְ/לֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם
verses.translit: vytsv 'lyhm l'mr khh t'shvn byr't yhvh b'mvnh vblbb shlm
verses.translation: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD , faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

verses.original: וְ/כָל רִיב֩ אֲשֶׁר יָב֨וֹא עֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם מֵ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֣ם הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֣ים בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֗ם בֵּֽין דָּ֣ם לְ/דָם֮ בֵּין תּוֹרָ֣ה לְ/מִצְוָה֮ לְ/חֻקִּ֣ים וּ/לְ/מִשְׁפָּטִים֒ וְ/הִזְהַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֤א יֶאְשְׁמוּ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הָֽיָה קֶ֥צֶף עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/עַל אֲחֵי/כֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשׂ֖וּ/ן וְ/לֹ֥א תֶאְשָֽׁמוּ
verses.translit: vkhl ryb 'shr ybv' 'lykhm m'chykhm hyshbym b'ryhm byn dm ldm byn tvrh lmtsvh lchqym vlmshptym vhzhrtm 'tm vl' y'shmv lyhvh vhyh qtsf 'lykhm v'l 'chykhm khh t'shvn vl' t'shmv
verses.translation: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD , and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֡ה אֲמַרְיָ֣הוּ כֹהֵן֩ הָ/רֹ֨אשׁ עֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם לְ/כֹ֣ל דְּבַר יְהוָ֗ה וּ/זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל הַ/נָּגִ֤יד לְ/בֵית יְהוּדָה֙ לְ/כֹ֣ל דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/שֹׁטְרִ֥ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם חִזְק֣וּ וַ/עֲשׂ֔וּ וִ/יהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם הַ/טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: vhnh 'mryhv khhn hr'sh 'lykhm lkhl dbr yhvh vzbdyhv bn yshm''l hngyd lbyt yhvdh lkhl dbr hmlkh vshtrym hlvym lpnykhm chzqv v'shv vyhy yhvh 'm htvb
verses.translation: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king’s matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֡ן בָּ֣אוּ בְנֵי מוֹאָב֩ וּ/בְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֧ם מֵֽ/הָ/עַמּוֹנִ֛ים עַל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn b'v bny mv'b vbny 'mvn v'mhm mh'mvnym 'l yhvshpt lmlchmh
verses.translation: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ וַ/יַּגִּ֤ידוּ לִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָט֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּ֣א עָלֶ֜י/ךָ הָמ֥וֹן רָ֛ב מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לַ/יָּ֖ם מֵ/אֲרָ֑ם וְ/הִנָּ/ם֙ בְּ/חַֽצְצ֣וֹן תָּמָ֔ר הִ֖יא עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי
verses.translit: vyb'v vygydv lyhvshpt l'mr b' 'lykh hmvn rb m'br lym m'rm vhnm bchtstsvn tmr hy' 'yn gdy
verses.translation: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרָ֕א וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט אֶת פָּנָ֖י/ו לִ/דְר֣וֹשׁ לַ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרָא צ֖וֹם עַל כָּל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyr' vytn yhvshpt 't pnyv ldrvsh lyhvh vyqr' tsvm 'l khl yhvdh
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD , and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֣וּ יְהוּדָ֔ה לְ/בַקֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽ/יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם מִ/כָּל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqbtsv yhvdh lbqsh myhvh gm mkhl 'ry yhvdh b'v lbqsh 't yhvh
verses.translation: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט בִּ/קְהַ֧ל יְהוּדָ֛ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/חֲדָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'md yhvshpt bqhl yhvdh vyrvshlm bbyt yhvh lpny hchtsr hchdshh
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD , before the new court,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ הֲ/לֹ֨א אַתָּֽה ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/אַתָּ֣ה מוֹשֵׁ֔ל בְּ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ/בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֙ כֹּ֣חַ וּ/גְבוּרָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥ין עִמְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/הִתְיַצֵּֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhy 'btynv hl' 'th hv' 'lhym bshmym v'th mvshl bkhl mmlkhvt hgvym vbydkh khch vgbvrh v'yn 'mkh lhtytsb
verses.translation: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ הוֹרַ֨שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/תִּתְּנָ֗/הּ לְ/זֶ֛רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹֽהַבְ/ךָ֖ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hl' 'th 'lhynv hvrsht 't yshby h'rts hz't mlpny 'mkh yshr'l vttnh lzr' 'brhm 'hbkh l'vlm
verses.translation: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?

verses.translit: vyshbv bh vybnv lkh bh mqdsh lshmkh l'mr
verses.translation: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

verses.original: אִם תָּב֨וֹא עָלֵ֜י/נוּ רָעָ֗ה חֶרֶב֮ שְׁפוֹט֮ וְ/דֶ֣בֶר וְ/רָעָב֒ נַֽעַמְדָ֞ה לִ/פְנֵ֨י הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ וּ/לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֥י שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ בַּ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/נִזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ מִ/צָּרָתֵ֖/נוּ וְ/תִשְׁמַ֥ע וְ/תוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: 'm tbv' 'lynv r'h chrb shpvt vdbr vr'b n'mdh lpny hbyt hzh vlpnykh khy shmkh bbyt hzh vnz'q 'lykh mtsrtnv vtshm' vtvshy'
verses.translation: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה הִנֵּה֩ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֨וֹן וּ/מוֹאָ֜ב וְ/הַר שֵׂעִ֗יר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא נָתַ֤תָּה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָ/ב֣וֹא בָ/הֶ֔ם בְּ/בֹאָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֛י סָ֥רוּ מֵ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א הִשְׁמִידֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: v'th hnh bny 'mvn vmv'b vhr sh'yr 'shr l' ntth lyshr'l lbv' bhm bb'm m'rts mtsrym khy srv m'lyhm vl' hshmydvm
verses.translation: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

verses.original: וְ/הִ֨נֵּה הֵ֔ם גֹּמְלִ֖ים עָלֵ֑י/נוּ לָ/בוֹא֙ לְ/גָ֣רְשֵׁ֔/נוּ מִ/יְּרֻשָּׁתְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֽוֹרַשְׁתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vhnh hm gmlym 'lynv lbv' lgrshnv myrshtkh 'shr hvrshtnv
verses.translation: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ הֲ/לֹ֣א תִשְׁפָּט בָּ֔/ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בָּ֨/נוּ֙ כֹּ֔חַ לִ֠/פְנֵי הֶ/הָמ֥וֹן הָ/רָ֛ב הַ/זֶּ֖ה הַ/בָּ֣א עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֤א נֵדַע֙ מַֽה נַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֥י עָלֶ֖י/ךָ עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'lhynv hl' tshpt bm khy 'yn bnv khch lpny hhmvn hrb hzh hb' 'lynv v'nchnv l' nd' mh n'shh khy 'lykh 'ynynv
verses.translation: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

verses.original: וְ/כָ֨ל יְהוּדָ֔ה עֹמְדִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה גַּם טַפָּ֖/ם נְשֵׁי/הֶ֥ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl yhvdh 'mdym lpny yhvh gm tpm nshyhm vbnyhm
verses.translation: And all Judah stood before the LORD , with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

verses.original: וְ/יַחֲזִיאֵ֡ל בֶּן זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֶּן בְּ֠נָיָה בֶּן יְעִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן מַתַּנְיָ֛ה הַ/לֵּוִ֖י מִן בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֑ף הָיְתָ֤ה עָלָי/ו֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vychzy'l bn zkhryhv bn bnyh bn y'y'l bn mtnyh hlvy mn bny 'sf hyth 'lyv rvch yhvh btvkh hqhl
verses.translation: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הַקְשִׁ֤יבוּ כָל יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָ/כֶ֗ם אַ֠תֶּם אַל תִּֽירְא֤וּ וְ/אַל תֵּחַ֨תּוּ֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֨י הֶ/הָמ֤וֹן הָ/רָב֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָ/כֶ֛ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה כִּ֥י לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr hqshybv khl yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm vhmlkh yhvshpt khh 'mr yhvh lkhm 'tm 'l tyr'v v'l tchtv mpny hhmvn hrb hzh khy l' lkhm hmlchmh khy l'lhym
verses.translation: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

verses.original: מָחָר֙ רְד֣וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם הִנָּ֥/ם עֹלִ֖ים בְּ/מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַ/צִּ֑יץ וּ/מְצָאתֶ֤ם אֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/ס֣וֹף הַ/נַּ֔חַל פְּנֵ֖י מִדְבַּ֥ר יְרוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: mchr rdv 'lyhm hnm 'lym bm'lh htsyts vmts'tm 'tm bsvf hnchl pny mdbr yrv'l
verses.translation: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

verses.original: לֹ֥א לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם בָּ/זֹ֑את הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ עִמְד֡וּ וּ/רְא֣וּ אֶת יְשׁוּעַת֩ יְהוָ֨ה עִמָּ/כֶ֜ם יְהוּדָ֣ה וִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אַל תִּֽירְאוּ֙ וְ/אַל תֵּחַ֔תּוּ מָחָר֙ צְא֣וּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יהוָ֖ה עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' lkhm lhlchm bz't htytsbv 'mdv vr'v 't yshv't yhvh 'mkhm yhvdh vyrvshlm 'l tyr'v v'l tchtv mchr ts'v lpnyhm vyhvh 'mkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still , and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקֹּ֧ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט אַפַּ֖יִם אָ֑רְצָ/ה וְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֞ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם נָֽפְלוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqd yhvshpt 'pym 'rtsh vkhl yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm nplv lpny yhvh lhshtchvt lyhvh
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD , worshipping the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֧מוּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם מִן בְּנֵ֥י הַ/קְּהָתִ֖ים וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֣י הַ/קָּרְחִ֑ים לְ/הַלֵּ֗ל לַ/יהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqmv hlvym mn bny hqhtym vmn bny hqrchym lhll lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l bqvl gdvl lm'lh
verses.translation: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ לְ/מִדְבַּ֣ר תְּק֑וֹעַ וּ/בְ/צֵאתָ֞/ם עָמַ֣ד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ שְׁמָע֗וּ/נִי יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הַאֲמִ֜ינוּ בַּ/יהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/תֵ֣אָמֵ֔נוּ הַאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִ/נְבִיאָ֖י/ו וְ/הַצְלִֽיחוּ
verses.translit: vyshkhymv bbqr vyts'v lmdbr tqv' vbts'tm 'md yhvshpt vy'mr shm'vny yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm h'mynv byhvh 'lhykhm vt'mnv h'mynv bnby'yv vhtslychv
verses.translation: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַץ֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֤ד מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וּֽ/מְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְ/הַדְרַת קֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּ/צֵאת֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הֶֽ/חָל֔וּץ וְ/אֹֽמְרִים֙ הוֹד֣וּ לַ/יהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyv'ts 'l h'm vy'md mshrrym lyhvh vmhllym lhdrt qdsh bts't lpny hchlvts v'mrym hvdv lyhvh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD , and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD ; for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/עֵת֩ הֵחֵ֨לּוּ בְ/רִנָּ֜ה וּ/תְהִלָּ֗ה נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֣ה מְ֠אָֽרְבִים עַל בְּנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן מוֹאָ֧ב וְ/הַר שֵׂעִ֛יר הַ/בָּאִ֥ים לִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה וַ/יִּנָּגֵֽפוּ
verses.translit: vb't hchlv brnh vthlh ntn yhvh m'rbym 'l bny 'mvn mv'b vhr sh'yr hb'ym lyhvdh vyngpv
verses.translation: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּֽעַמְדוּ בְּנֵ֨י עַמּ֧וֹן וּ/מוֹאָ֛ב עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַר שֵׂעִ֖יר לְ/הַחֲרִ֣ים וּ/לְ/הַשְׁמִ֑יד וּ/כְ/כַלּוֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר עָזְר֥וּ אִישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵ֖/הוּ לְ/מַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: vy'mdv bny 'mvn vmv'b 'l yshby hr sh'yr lhchrym vlhshmyd vkhkhlvtm byvshby sh'yr 'zrv 'ysh br'hv lmshchyt
verses.translation: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

verses.original: וִֽ/יהוּדָ֛ה בָּ֥א עַל הַ/מִּצְפֶּ֖ה לַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ/יִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל הֶ֣/הָמ֔וֹן וְ/הִנָּ֧/ם פְּגָרִ֛ים נֹפְלִ֥ים אַ֖רְצָ/ה וְ/אֵ֥ין פְּלֵיטָֽה
verses.translit: vyhvdh b' 'l hmtsph lmdbr vypnv 'l hhmvn vhnm pgrym nplym 'rtsh v'yn plyth
verses.translation: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט וְ/עַמּ/וֹ֮ לָ/בֹ֣ז אֶת שְׁלָלָ/ם֒ וַ/יִּמְצְאוּ֩ בָ/הֶ֨ם לָ/רֹ֜ב וּ/רְכ֤וּשׁ וּ/פְגָרִים֙ וּ/כְלֵ֣י חֲמֻד֔וֹת וַ/יְנַצְּל֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/אֵ֣ין מַשָּׂ֑א וַ/יִּֽהְי֞וּ יָמִ֧ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֛ה בֹּזְזִ֥ים אֶת הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל כִּ֥י רַב הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyb' yhvshpt v'mv lbz 't shllm vymts'v bhm lrb vrkhvsh vpgrym vkhly chmdvt vyntslv lhm l'yn msh' vyhyv ymym shlvshh bzzym 't hshll khy rb hv'
verses.translation: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/רְבִעִ֗י נִקְהֲלוּ֙ לְ/עֵ֣מֶק בְּרָכָ֔ה כִּי שָׁ֖ם בֵּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֡ן קָֽרְא֞וּ אֶת שֵׁ֨ם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֛וּא עֵ֥מֶק בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vbyvm hrb'y nqhlv l'mq brkhh khy shm brkhv 't yhvh 'l khn qr'v 't shm hmqvm hhv' 'mq brkhh 'd hyvm
verses.translation: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD : therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּשֻׁבוּ כָּל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֔/ם לָ/שׁ֥וּב אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה כִּֽי שִׂמְּחָ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה מֵֽ/אוֹיְבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshbv khl 'ysh yhvdh vyrvshlm vyhvshpt br'shm lshvb 'l yrvshlm bshmchh khy shmchm yhvh m'vybyhm
verses.translation: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּ/נְבָלִ֥ים וּ/בְ/כִנֹּר֖וֹת וּ/בַ/חֲצֹצְר֑וֹת אֶל בֵּ֖ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v yrvshlm bnblym vbkhnrvt vbchtstsrvt 'l byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ פַּ֣חַד אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל כָּל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת בְּ/שָׁמְעָ֕/ם כִּ֚י נִלְחַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עִ֖ם אוֹיְבֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy pchd 'lhym 'l khl mmlkhvt h'rtsvt bshm'm khy nlchm yhvh 'm 'vyby yshr'l
verses.translation: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁקֹ֖ט מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וַ/יָּ֧נַֽח ל֦/וֹ אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: vtshqt mlkhvt yhvshpt vynch lv 'lhyv msbyb
verses.translation: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט עַל יְהוּדָ֑ה בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים֩ וְ/חָמֵ֨שׁ שָׁנָ֜ה בְּ/מָלְכ֗/וֹ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ עֲזוּבָ֖ה בַּת שִׁלְחִֽי
verses.translit: vymlkh yhvshpt 'l yhvdh bn shlshym vchmsh shnh bmlkhv v'shrym vchmsh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv 'zvbh bt shlchy
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֛רֶךְ אָבִ֥י/ו אָסָ֖א וְ/לֹא סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֑/נָּה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkh 'byv 's' vl' sr mmnh l'shvt hyshr b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ וְ/ע֤וֹד הָ/עָם֙ לֹא הֵכִ֣ינוּ לְבָבָ֔/ם לֵ/אלֹהֵ֖י אֲבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'kh hbmvt l' srv v'vd h'm l' hkhynv lbbm l'lhy 'btyhm
verses.translation: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֔ט הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בְּ/דִבְרֵי֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן חֲנָ֔נִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֹֽעֲלָ֔ה עַל סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhvshpt hr'shnym vh'chrnym hnm khtvbym bdbry yhv' bn chnny 'shr h'lh 'l spr mlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אֶתְחַבַּר֙ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲחַזְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא הִרְשִׁ֥יעַ לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: v'chry khn 'tchbr yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh 'm 'chzyh mlkh yshr'l hv' hrshy' l'shvt
verses.translation: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

verses.original: וַ/יְחַבְּרֵ֣/הוּ עִמּ֔/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֳנִיּ֖וֹת לָ/לֶ֣כֶת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֳנִיּ֖וֹת בְּ/עֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: vychbrhv 'mv l'shvt 'nyvt llkht trshysh vy'shv 'nyvt b'tsyvn gbr
verses.translation: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְנַבֵּ֞א אֱלִיעֶ֤זֶר בֶּן דֹּדָוָ֨הוּ֙ מִ/מָּ֣רֵשָׁ֔ה עַל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כְּ/הִֽתְחַבֶּרְ/ךָ֣ עִם אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ פָּרַ֤ץ יְהוָה֙ אֶֽת מַעֲשֶׂ֔י/ךָ וַ/יִּשָּׁבְר֣וּ אֳנִיּ֔וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א עָצְר֖וּ לָ/לֶ֥כֶת אֶל תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ
verses.translit: vytnb' 'ly'zr bn ddvhv mmrshh 'l yhvshpt l'mr khhtchbrkh 'm 'chzyhv prts yhvh 't m'shykh vyshbrv 'nyvt vl' 'tsrv llkht 'l trshysh
verses.translation: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhvshpt 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvyd vymlkh yhvrm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/לֽ/וֹ אַחִ֞ים בְּנֵ֣י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט עֲזַרְיָ֤ה וִֽ/יחִיאֵל֙ וּ/זְכַרְיָ֣הוּ וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֔הוּ וּ/מִיכָאֵ֖ל וּ/שְׁפַטְיָ֑הוּ כָּל אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlv 'chym bny yhvshpt 'zryh vychy'l vzkhryhv v'zryhv vmykh'l vshptyhv khl 'lh bny yhvshpt mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֣ם אֲ֠בִי/הֶם מַתָּנ֨וֹת רַבּ֜וֹת לְ/כֶ֤סֶף וּ/לְ/זָהָב֙ וּ/לְ/מִגְדָּנ֔וֹת עִם עָרֵ֥י מְצֻר֖וֹת בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן לִֽ/יהוֹרָ֖ם כִּי ה֥וּא הַ/בְּכֽוֹר
verses.translit: vytn lhm 'byhm mtnvt rbvt lkhsf vlzhb vlmgdnvt 'm 'ry mtsrvt byhvdh v't hmmlkhh ntn lyhvrm khy hv' hbkhvr
verses.translation: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם יְהוֹרָ֜ם עַל מַמְלֶ֤כַת אָבִי/ו֙ וַ/יִּתְחַזַּ֔ק וַ/יַּהֲרֹ֥ג אֶת כָּל אֶחָ֖י/ו בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב וְ/גַ֖ם מִ/שָּׂרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm yhvrm 'l mmlkht 'byv vytchzq vyhrg 't khl 'chyv bchrb vgm mshry yshr'l
verses.translation: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה יְהוֹרָ֣ם בְּ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shlshym vshtym shnh yhvrm bmlkhv vshmvnh shnym mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֜לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כִּ֚י בַּת אַחְאָ֔ב הָ֥יְתָה לּ֖/וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkh mlkhy yshr'l kh'shr 'shv byt 'ch'b khy bt 'ch'b hyth lv 'shh vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹא אָבָ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לְ/הַשְׁחִית֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד לְמַ֣עַן הַ/בְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת לְ/דָוִ֑יד וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗ר לָ/תֵ֨ת ל֥/וֹ נִ֛יר וּ/לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vl' 'bh yhvh lhshchyt 't byt dvyd lm'n hbryt 'shr khrt ldvyd vkh'shr 'mr ltt lv nyr vlbnyv khl hymym
verses.translation: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

verses.original: בְּ/יָמָי/ו֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע אֱד֔וֹם מִ/תַּ֖חַת יַד יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יַּמְלִ֥יכוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: bymyv psh' 'dvm mtcht yd yhvdh vymlykhv 'lyhm mlkh
verses.translation: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲבֹ֤ר יְהוֹרָם֙ עִם שָׂרָ֔י/ו וְ/כָל הָ/רֶ֖כֶב עִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְהִי֙ קָ֣ם לַ֔יְלָה וַ/יַּ֗ךְ אֶת אֱדוֹם֙ הַ/סּוֹבֵ֣ב אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָ/רָֽכֶב
verses.translit: vy'br yhvrm 'm shryv vkhl hrkhb 'mv vyhy qm lylh vykh 't 'dvm hsvbb 'lyv v't shry hrkhb
verses.translation: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְשַׁ֨ע אֱד֜וֹם מִ/תַּ֣חַת יַד יְהוּדָ֗ה עַ֚ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אָ֣ז תִּפְשַׁ֥ע לִבְנָ֛ה בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖יא מִ/תַּ֣חַת יָד֑/וֹ כִּ֣י עָזַ֔ב אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vypsh' 'dvm mtcht yd yhvdh 'd hyvm hzh 'z tpsh' lbnh b't hhy' mtcht ydv khy 'zb 't yhvh 'lhy 'btyv
verses.translation: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

verses.original: גַּם ה֥וּא עָשָֽׂה בָמ֖וֹת בְּ/הָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יֶּ֨זֶן֙ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יַּדַּ֖ח אֶת יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: gm hv' 'shh bmvt bhry yhvdh vyzn 't yshby yrvshlm vydch 't yhvdh
verses.translation: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ מִכְתָּ֔ב מֵֽ/אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י/ךָ תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא הָלַ֨כְתָּ֙ בְּ/דַרְכֵי֙ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט אָבִ֔י/ךָ וּ/בְ/דַרְכֵ֖י אָסָ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyv mkhtb m'lyhv hnby' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy dvyd 'bykh tcht 'shr l' hlkht bdrkhy yhvshpt 'bykh vbdrkhy 's' mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/תַּזְנֶ֤ה אֶת יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּ/הַזְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וְ/גַ֨ם אֶת אַחֶ֧י/ךָ בֵית אָבִ֛י/ךָ הַ/טּוֹבִ֥ים מִמְּ/ךָ֖ הָרָֽגְתָּ
verses.translit: vtlkh bdrkh mlkhy yshr'l vtznh 't yhvdh v't yshby yrvshlm khhznvt byt 'ch'b vgm 't 'chykh byt 'bykh htvbym mmkh hrgt
verses.translation: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father’s house, which were better than thyself:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה נֹגֵ֛ף מַגֵּפָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בְּ/עַמֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/בְ/בָנֶ֥י/ךָ וּ/בְ/נָשֶׁ֖י/ךָ וּ/בְ/כָל רְכוּשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: hnh yhvh ngf mgph gdvlh b'mkh vbbnykh vbnshykh vbkhl rkhvshkh
verses.translation: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֛ה בָּ/חֳלָיִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים בְּ/מַחֲלֵ֣ה מֵעֶ֑י/ךָ עַד יֵצְא֤וּ מֵעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִן הַ/חֹ֔לִי יָמִ֖ים עַל יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'th bchlyym rbym bmchlh m'ykh 'd yts'v m'ykh mn hchly ymym 'l ymym
verses.translation: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨עַר יְהוָ֜ה עַל יְהוֹרָ֗ם אֵ֣ת ר֤וּחַ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ וְ/הָ֣/עַרְבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל יַ֥ד כּוּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vy'r yhvh 'l yhvrm 't rvch hplshtym vh'rbym 'shr 'l yd khvshym
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֤וּ בִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ וַ/יִּבְקָע֔וּ/הָ וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כָּל הָ/רְכוּשׁ֙ הַ/נִּמְצָ֣א לְ/בֵית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/גַם בָּנָ֖י/ו וְ/נָשָׁ֑י/ו וְ/לֹ֤א נִשְׁאַר ל/וֹ֙ בֵּ֔ן כִּ֥י אִם יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז קְטֹ֥ן בָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'lv byhvdh vybq'vh vyshbv 't khl hrkhvsh hnmts' lbyt hmlkh vgm bnyv vnshyv vl' nsh'r lv bn khy 'm yhv'chz qtn bnyv
verses.translation: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king’s house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל זֹ֑את נְגָפ֨/וֹ יְהוָ֧ה בְּ/מֵעָ֛י/ו לָ/חֳלִ֖י לְ/אֵ֥ין מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: v'chry khl z't ngpv yhvh bm'yv lchly l'yn mrp'
verses.translation: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לְ/יָמִ֣ים מִ/יָּמִ֡ים וּ/כְ/עֵת֩ צֵ֨את הַ/קֵּ֜ץ לְ/יָמִ֣ים שְׁנַ֗יִם יָצְא֤וּ מֵעָי/ו֙ עִם חָלְי֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֖מָת בְּ/תַחֲלֻאִ֣ים רָעִ֑ים וְ/לֹא עָ֨שׂוּ ל֥/וֹ עַמּ֛/וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה כִּ/שְׂרֵפַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy lymym mymym vkh't ts't hqts lymym shnym yts'v m'yv 'm chlyv vymt btchl'ym r'ym vl' 'shv lv 'mv shrph khshrpt 'btyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּ/לֹ֣א חֶמְדָּ֔ה וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד וְ/לֹ֖א בְּ/קִבְר֥וֹת הַ/מְּלָכִֽים
verses.translit: bn shlshym vshtym hyh bmlkhv vshmvnh shnym mlkh byrvshlm vylkh bl' chmdh vyqbrhv b'yr dvyd vl' bqbrvt hmlkhym
verses.translation: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְלִיכוּ֩ יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֤/וֹ הַ/קָּטֹן֙ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו כִּ֤י כָל הָ/רִאשֹׁנִים֙ הָרַ֣ג הַ/גְּד֔וּד הַ/בָּ֥א בָֽ/עַרְבִ֖ים לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vymlykhv yvshby yrvshlm 't 'chzyhv bnv hqtn tchtyv khy khl hr'shnym hrg hgdvd hb' b'rbym lmchnh vymlkh 'chzyhv bn yhvrm mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

verses.original: בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁנָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ בַּת עָמְרִֽי
verses.translit: bn 'rb'ym vshtym shnh 'chzyhv bmlkhv vshnh 'cht mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv 'tlyhv bt 'mry
verses.translation: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

verses.original: גַּם ה֣וּא הָלַ֔ךְ בְּ/דַרְכֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּ֥י אִמּ֛/וֹ הָיְתָ֥ה יֽוֹעַצְתּ֖/וֹ לְ/הַרְשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: gm hv' hlkh bdrkhy byt 'ch'b khy 'mv hyth yv'tstv lhrshy'
verses.translation: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/בֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּי הֵ֜מָּה הָֽיוּ ל֣/וֹ יֽוֹעֲצִ֗ים אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת אָבִ֖י/ו לְ/מַשְׁחִ֥ית לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khbyt 'ch'b khy hmh hyv lv yv'tsym 'chry mvt 'byv lmshchyt lv
verses.translation: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בַּ/עֲצָתָ/ם֮ הָלַךְ֒ וַ/יֵּלֶךְ֩ אֶת יְהוֹרָ֨ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֜ב מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה עַל חֲזָאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם בְּ/רָמ֣וֹת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ הָֽ/רַמִּ֖ים אֶת יוֹרָֽם
verses.translit: gm b'tstm hlkh vylkh 't yhvrm bn 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l lmlchmh 'l chz'l mlkh 'rm brmvt gl'd vykhv hrmym 't yvrm
verses.translation: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜שָׁב לְ/הִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְ/יִזְרְעֶ֗אל כִּ֤י הַ/מַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכֻּ֣/הוּ בָֽ/רָמָ֔ה בְּ/הִלָּ֣חֲמ֔/וֹ אֶת חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִ/רְא֞וֹת אֶת יְהוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֛ב בְּ/יִזְרְעֶ֖אל כִּי חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyshb lhtrp' byzr''l khy hmkhym 'shr hkhhv brmh bhlchmv 't chzh'l mlkh 'rm v'zryhv bn yhvrm mlkh yhvdh yrd lr'vt 't yhvrm bn 'ch'b byzr''l khy chlh hv'
verses.translation: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

verses.original: וּ/מֵֽ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים הָיְתָה֙ תְּבוּסַ֣ת אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לָ/ב֖וֹא אֶל יוֹרָ֑ם וּ/בְ/בֹא֗/וֹ יָצָ֤א עִם יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶל יֵה֣וּא בֶן נִמְשִׁ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְשָׁח֣/וֹ יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הַכְרִ֖ית אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָֽב
verses.translit: vm'lhym hyth tbvst 'chzyhv lbv' 'l yvrm vbb'v yts' 'm yhvrm 'l yhv' bn nmshy 'shr mshchv yhvh lhkhryt 't byt 'ch'b
verses.translation: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כְּ/הִשָּׁפֵ֥ט יֵה֖וּא עִם בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַ/יִּמְצָא֩ אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה וּ/בְנֵ֨י אֲחֵ֧י אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים לַ/אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ וַ/יַּהַרְגֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy khhshpt yhv' 'm byt 'ch'b vymts' 't shry yhvdh vbny 'chy 'chzyhv mshrtym l'chzyhv vyhrgm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

verses.original: וַ/יְבַקֵּשׁ֩ אֶת אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדֻ֜/הוּ וְ/ה֧וּא מִתְחַבֵּ֣א בְ/שֹֽׁמְר֗וֹן וַ/יְבִאֻ֣/הוּ אֶל יֵהוּא֮ וַ/יְמִתֻ/הוּ֒ וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֔/הוּ כִּ֤י אָֽמְרוּ֙ בֶּן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר דָּרַ֥שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/כָל לְבָב֑/וֹ וְ/אֵין֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ לַ/עְצֹ֥ר כֹּ֖חַ לְ/מַמְלָכָֽה
verses.translit: vybqsh 't 'chzyhv vylkhdhv vhv' mtchb' bshmrvn vyb'hv 'l yhv' vymthv vyqbrhv khy 'mrv bn yhvshpt hv' 'shr drsh 't yhvh bkhl lbbv v'yn lbyt 'chzyhv l'tsr khch lmmlkhh
verses.translation: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

verses.original: וַ/עֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ רָאֲתָ֖ה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑/הּ וַ/תָּ֗קָם וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת כָּל זֶ֥רַע הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְ/בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'tlyhv 'm 'chzyhv r'th khy mt bnh vtqm vtdbr 't khl zr' hmmlkhh lbyt yhvdh
verses.translation: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּח֩ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֨ת בַּת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ וַ/תִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹת/וֹ֙ מִ/תּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/מּ֣וּמָתִ֔ים וַ/תִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת מֵֽינִקְתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/חֲדַ֣ר הַ/מִּטּ֑וֹת וַ/תַּסְתִּירֵ֡/הוּ יְהוֹשַׁבְעַ֣ת בַּת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֡ם אֵשֶׁת֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן כִּ֣י הִיא֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֲח֧וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֛הוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְ/לֹ֥א הֱמִיתָֽתְ/הוּ
verses.translit: vtqch yhvshb't bt hmlkh 't yv'sh bn 'chzyhv vtgnb 'tv mtvkh bny hmlkh hmvmtym vttn 'tv v't mynqtv bchdr hmtvt vtstyrhv yhvshb't bt hmlkh yhvrm 'sht yhvyd' hkhhn khy hy' hyth 'chvt 'chzyhv mpny 'tlyhv vl' hmytthv
verses.translation: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י אִתָּ/ם֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִתְחַבֵּ֖א שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וַ/עֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy 'tm bbyt h'lhym mtchb' shsh shnym v'tlyh mlkht 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
