verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֨ה הַ/שְּׁבִעִ֜ית הִתְחַזַּ֣ק יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֵּא֡וֹת לַ/עֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ בֶן יְרֹחָ֡ם וּ/לְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן יְ֠הוֹחָנָן וְ/לַֽ/עֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן עוֹבֵ֜ד וְ/אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֧הוּ בֶן עֲדָיָ֛הוּ וְ/אֶת אֱלִישָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן זִכְרִ֖י עִמּ֥/וֹ בַ/בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vbshnh hshb'yt htchzq yhvyd' vyqch 't shry hm'vt l'zryhv bn yrchm vlyshm''l bn yhvchnn vl'zryhv bn 'vbd v't m'shyhv bn 'dyhv v't 'lyshpt bn zkhry 'mv bbryt
verses.translation: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְבְּצ֤וּ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ מִ/כָּל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ/אָב֖וֹת לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vysbv byhvdh vyqbtsv 't hlvym mkhl 'ry yhvdh vr'shy h'bvt lyshr'l vyb'v 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֨ת כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֥ל בְּרִ֛ית בְּ/בֵ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִם הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֶן הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֔ךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל בְּנֵ֥י דָוִֽיד
verses.translit: vykhrt khl hqhl bryt bbyt h'lhym 'm hmlkh vy'mr lhm hnh bn hmlkh ymlkh kh'shr dbr yhvh 'l bny dvyd
verses.translation: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.

verses.original: זֶ֥ה הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֨ית מִ/כֶּ֜ם בָּאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֗ת לַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/שֹֽׁעֲרֵ֖י הַ/סִּפִּֽים
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr t'shv hshlshyt mkhm b'y hshbt lkhhnym vllvym lsh'ry hspym
verses.translation: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/יְס֑וֹד וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֔ם בְּ/חַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhshlshyt bbyt hmlkh vhshlshyt bsh'r hysvd vkhl h'm bchtsrvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And a third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אַל יָב֣וֹא בֵית יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י אִם הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/מְשָׁרְתִ֣ים לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם הֵ֥מָּה יָבֹ֖אוּ כִּי קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑מָּה וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֔ם יִשְׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'l ybv' byt yhvh khy 'm hkhhnym vhmshrtym llvym hmh yb'v khy qdsh hmh vkhl h'm yshmrv mshmrt yhvh
verses.translation: But let none come into the house of the LORD , save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִקִּיפוּ֩ הַ/לְוִיִּ֨ם אֶת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְ/כֵלָ֣י/ו בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/בָּ֥א אֶל הַ/בַּ֖יִת יוּמָ֑ת וִֽ/הְי֥וּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/בֹא֥/וֹ וּ/בְ/צֵאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhqypv hlvym 't hmlkh sbyb 'ysh vkhlyv bydv vhb' 'l hbyt yvmt vhyv 't hmlkh bb'v vbts'tv
verses.translation: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֨וּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם וְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַ/כֹּהֵן֒ וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו בָּאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יוֹצְאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת כִּ֣י לֹ֥א פָטַ֛ר יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַֽ/מַּחְלְקֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'shv hlvym vkhl yhvdh khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvyd' hkhhn vyqchv 'ysh 't 'nshyv b'y hshbt 'm yvts'y hshbt khy l' ptr yhvyd' hkhhn 't hmchlqvt
verses.translation: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן לְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֵּא֗וֹת אֶת הַֽ/חֲנִיתִים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מָּגִנּוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vytn yhvyd' hkhhn lshry hm'vt 't hchnytym v't hmgnvt v't hshltym 'shr lmlkh dvyd 'shr byt h'lhym
verses.translation: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David’s, which were in the house of God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֨ד אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֜ם וְ/אִ֣ישׁ שִׁלְח֣/וֹ בְ/יָד֗/וֹ מִ/כֶּ֨תֶף הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/יְמָנִית֙ עַד כֶּ֤תֶף הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְ/לַ/בָּ֑יִת עַל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vy'md 't khl h'm v'ysh shlchv bydv mkhtf hbyt hymnyt 'd khtf hbyt hshm'lyt lmzbch vlbyt 'l hmlkh sbyb
verses.translation: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָי/ו֙ אֶת הַ/נֵּ֨זֶר֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/עֵד֔וּת וַ/יַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּמְשָׁחֻ֨/הוּ֙ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע וּ/בָנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyvtsy'v 't bn hmlkh vytnv 'lyv 't hnzr v't h'dvt vymlykhv 'tv vymshchhv yhvyd' vbnyv vy'mrv ychy hmlkh
verses.translation: Then they brought out the king’s son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֗הוּ אֶת ק֤וֹל הָ/עָם֙ הָֽ/רָצִ֔ים וְ/הַֽ/מְהַֽלְלִ֖ים אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/תָּב֥וֹא אֶל הָ/עָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtshm' 'tlyhv 't qvl h'm hrtsym vhmhllym 't hmlkh vtbv' 'l h'm byt yhvh
verses.translation: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD :

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֡רֶא וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֩ עוֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל עַמּוּד֜/וֹ בַּ/מָּב֗וֹא וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֣ים וְ/הַ/חֲצֹצְרוֹת֮ עַל הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ וְ/כָל עַ֨ם הָ/אָ֜רֶץ שָׂמֵ֗חַ וְ/תוֹקֵ֨עַ֙ בַּ/חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת וְ/הַ/מְשֽׁוֹרֲרִים֙ בִּ/כְלֵ֣י הַ/שִּׁ֔יר וּ/מוֹדִיעִ֖ים לְ/הַלֵּ֑ל וַ/תִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶת בְּגָדֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: vtr' vhnh hmlkh 'vmd 'l 'mvdv bmbv' vhshrym vhchtstsrvt 'l hmlkh vkhl 'm h'rts shmch vtvq' bchtstsrvt vhmshvrrym bkhly hshyr vmvdy'ym lhll vtqr' 'tlyhv 't bgdyh vt'mr qshr qshr
verses.translation: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵא֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/מֵּא֣וֹת פְּקוּדֵ֣י הַ/חַ֗יִל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ הֽוֹצִיא֨וּ/הָ֙ אֶל מִ/בֵּ֣ית הַ/שְּׂדֵר֔וֹת וְ/הַ/בָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖י/הָ יוּמַ֣ת בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֥א תְמִית֖וּ/הָ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyvts' yhvyd' hkhhn 't shry hm'vt pqvdy hchyl vy'mr 'lhm hvtsy'vh 'l mbyt hshdrvt vhb' 'chryh yvmt bchrb khy 'mr hkhhn l' tmytvh byt yhvh
verses.translation: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֤ימוּ לָ/הּ֙ יָדַ֔יִם וַ/תָּב֛וֹא אֶל מְב֥וֹא שַֽׁעַר הַ/סּוּסִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יְמִית֖וּ/הָ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshymv lh ydym vtbv' 'l mbv' sh'r hsvsym byt hmlkh vymytvh shm
verses.translation: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king’s house, they slew her there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֤ת יְהוֹיָדָע֙ בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינ֕/וֹ וּ/בֵ֥ין כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ לִ/הְי֥וֹת לְ/עָ֖ם לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvyd' bryt bynv vbyn khl h'm vbyn hmlkh lhyvt l'm lyhvh
verses.translation: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD’s people.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ כָל הָ/עָ֤ם בֵּית הַ/בַּ֨עַל֙ וַֽ/יִּתְּצֻ֔/הוּ וְ/אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת צְלָמָ֖י/ו שִׁבֵּ֑רוּ וְ/אֵ֗ת מַתָּן֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/בַּ֔עַל הָרְג֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַֽ/מִּזְבְּחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyb'v khl h'm byt hb'l vyttshv v't mzbchtyv v't tslmyv shbrv v't mtn khhn hb'l hrgv lpny hmzbchvt
verses.translation: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֶׂם֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע פְּקֻדֹּ֜ת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/יַ֨ד הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ/לְוִיִּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָלַ֣ק דָּוִיד֮ עַל בֵּ֣ית יְהוָה֒ לְֽ/הַעֲל֞וֹת עֹל֣וֹת יְהוָ֗ה כַּ/כָּת֛וּב בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֣ה וּ/בְ/שִׁ֑יר עַ֖ל יְדֵ֥י דָוִֽיד
verses.translit: vyshm yhvyd' pqdt byt yhvh byd hkhhnym hlvym 'shr chlq dvyd 'l byt yhvh lh'lvt 'lvt yhvh khkhtvb btvrt mshh bshmchh vbshyr 'l ydy dvyd
verses.translation: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD , to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD , as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֵד֙ הַ/שּׁ֣וֹעֲרִ֔ים עַֽל שַׁעֲרֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא יָבֹ֥א טָמֵ֖א לְ/כָל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'md hshv'rym 'l sh'ry byt yhvh vl' yb' tm' lkhl dbr
verses.translation: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֵּא֡וֹת וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אַדִּירִים֩ וְ/אֶת הַ/מּֽוֹשְׁלִ֨ים בָּ/עָ֜ם וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וַ/יּ֤וֹרֶד אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֛אוּ בְּ/תֽוֹךְ שַׁ֥עַר הָֽ/עֶלְי֖וֹן בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יּוֹשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א הַ/מַּמְלָכָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch 't shry hm'vt v't h'dyrym v't hmvshlym b'm v't khl 'm h'rts vyvrd 't hmlkh mbyt yhvh vyb'v btvkh sh'r h'lyvn byt hmlkh vyvshybv 't hmlkh 'l khs' hmmlkhh
verses.translation: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD : and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כָל עַם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/הָ/עִ֣יר שָׁקָ֑טָה וְ/אֶת עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ הֵמִ֥יתוּ בֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyshmchv khl 'm h'rts vh'yr shqth v't 'tlyhv hmytv bchrb
verses.translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

verses.original: בֶּן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ יֹאָ֣שׁ בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ צִבְיָ֖ה מִ/בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: bn shb' shnym y'sh bmlkhv v'rb'ym shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv tsbyh mb'r shb'
verses.translation: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ יוֹאָ֛שׁ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כָּל יְמֵ֖י יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'sh yv'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khl ymy yhvyd' hkhhn
verses.translation: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂא ל֥/וֹ יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע נָשִׁ֣ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד בָּנִ֥ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vysh' lv yhvyd' nshym shtym vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י אַחֲרֵי כֵ֑ן הָיָה֙ עִם לֵ֣ב יוֹאָ֔שׁ לְ/חַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn hyh 'm lb yv'sh lchdsh 't byt yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּץ֮ אֶת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּם֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֡ם צְא֣וּ לְ/עָרֵ֪י יְהוּדָ֟ה וְ/קִבְצוּ֩ מִ/כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל כֶּ֜סֶף לְ/חַזֵּ֣ק אֶת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֗ם מִ/דֵּ֤י שָׁנָה֙ בְּ/שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם תְּמַהֲר֣וּ לַ/דָּבָ֑ר וְ/לֹ֥א מִֽהֲר֖וּ הַֽ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vyqbts 't hkhhnym vhlvym vy'mr lhm ts'v l'ry yhvdh vqbtsv mkhl yshr'l khsf lchzq 't byt 'lhykhm mdy shnh bshnh v'tm tmhrv ldbr vl' mhrv hlvym
verses.translation: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ לִֽ/יהוֹיָדָ֣ע הָ/רֹאשׁ֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ לֹֽא דָרַ֣שְׁתָּ עַל הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/הָבִ֞יא מִֽ/יהוּדָ֣ה וּ/מִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֶת מַשְׂאַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הַ/קָּהָ֖ל לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/אֹ֖הֶל הָ/עֵדֽוּת
verses.translit: vyqr' hmlkh lyhvyd' hr'sh vy'mr lv mdv' l' drsht 'l hlvym lhby' myhvdh vmyrvshlm 't msh't mshh 'bd yhvh vhqhl lyshr'l l'hl h'dvt
verses.translation: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD , and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַ/מִּרְשַׁ֔עַת בָּנֶ֥י/הָ פָרְצ֖וּ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/גַם֙ כָּל קָדְשֵׁ֣י בֵית יְהוָ֔ה עָשׂ֖וּ לַ/בְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'tlyhv hmrsh't bnyh prtsv 't byt h'lhym vgm khl qdshy byt yhvh 'shv lb'lym
verses.translation: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֲר֣וֹן אֶחָ֑ד וַֽ/יִּתְּנֻ֛/הוּ בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh vy'shv 'rvn 'chd vytnhv bsh'r byt yhvh chvtsh
verses.translation: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנוּ ק֞וֹל בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֣ה וּ/בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְ/הָבִ֤יא לַֽ/יהוָה֙ מַשְׂאַ֞ת מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vytnv qvl byhvdh vbyrvshlm lhby' lyhvh msh't mshh 'bd h'lhym 'l yshr'l bmdbr
verses.translation: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כָל הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יָּבִ֛יאוּ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֥יכוּ לָ/אָר֖וֹן עַד לְ/כַלֵּֽה
verses.translit: vyshmchv khl hshrym vkhl h'm vyby'v vyshlykhv l'rvn 'd lkhlh
verses.translation: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י בְּ/עֵת֩ יָבִ֨יא אֶת הָֽ/אָר֜וֹן אֶל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/לְוִיִּם֒ וְ/כִ/רְאוֹתָ֞/ם כִּי רַ֣ב הַ/כֶּ֗סֶף וּ/בָ֨א סוֹפֵ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וּ/פְקִיד֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וִ/יעָ֨רוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣/אָר֔וֹן וְ/יִשָּׂאֻ֖/הוּ וִֽ/ישִׁיבֻ֣/הוּ אֶל מְקֹמ֑/וֹ כֹּ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ לְ/י֣וֹם בְּ/י֔וֹם וַ/יַּֽאַסְפוּ כֶ֖סֶף לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vyhy b't yby' 't h'rvn 'l pqdt hmlkh byd hlvym vkhr'vtm khy rb hkhsf vb' svpr hmlkh vpqyd khhn hr'sh vy'rv 't h'rvn vysh'hv vyshybhv 'l mqmv khh 'shv lyvm byvm vy'spv khsf lrb
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֨/הוּ הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וִֽ/יהוֹיָדָ֗ע אֶל עוֹשֵׂה֙ מְלֶ֨אכֶת֙ עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּֽהְי֤וּ שֹׂכְרִים֙ חֹצְבִ֣ים וְ/חָרָשִׁ֔ים לְ/חַדֵּ֖שׁ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠/גַם לְ/חָרָשֵׁ֤י בַרְזֶל֙ וּ/נְחֹ֔שֶׁת לְ/חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytnhv hmlkh vyhvyd' 'l 'vshh ml'kht 'bvdt byt yhvh vyhyv shkhrym chtsbym vchrshym lchdsh byt yhvh vgm lchrshy brzl vnchsht lchzq 't byt yhvh
verses.translation: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD , and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD , and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה וַ/תַּ֧עַל אֲרוּכָ֛ה לַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם וַֽ/יַּעֲמִ֜ידוּ אֶת בֵּ֧ית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים עַל מַתְכֻּנְתּ֖/וֹ וַֽ/יְאַמְּצֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'shv 'shy hml'khh vt'l 'rvkhh lml'khh bydm vy'mydv 't byt h'lhym 'l mtkhntv vy'mtshv
verses.translation: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.

verses.original: וּֽ/כְ/כַלּוֹתָ֡/ם הֵבִ֣יאוּ לִ/פְנֵי֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ וִֽ/יהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶת שְׁאָ֣ר הַ/כֶּ֗סֶף וַ/יַּעֲשֵׂ֨/הוּ כֵלִ֤ים לְ/בֵית יְהוָה֙ כְּלֵ֣י שָׁרֵ֔ת וְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת וְ/כַפּ֔וֹת וּ/כְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וָ/כָ֑סֶף וַ֠/יִּֽהְיוּ מַעֲלִ֨ים עֹל֤וֹת בְּ/בֵית יְהוָה֙ תָּמִ֔יד כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י יְהוֹיָדָֽע
verses.translit: vkhkhlvtm hby'v lpny hmlkh vyhvyd' 't sh'r hkhsf vy'shhv khlym lbyt yhvh khly shrt vh'lvt vkhpvt vkhly zhb vkhsf vyhyv m'lym 'lvt bbyt yhvh tmyd khl ymy yhvyd'
verses.translation: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD , even vessels to minister, and to offer withal , and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְקַ֧ן יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע וַ/יִּשְׂבַּ֥ע יָמִ֖ים וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת בֶּן מֵאָ֧ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyzqn yhvyd' vyshb' ymym vymt bn m'h vshlshym shnh bmvtv
verses.translation: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֥/הוּ בְ/עִיר דָּוִ֖יד עִם הַ/מְּלָכִ֑ים כִּֽי עָשָׂ֤ה טוֹבָה֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/עִ֥ם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqbrhv b'yr dvyd 'm hmlkhym khy 'shh tvbh byshr'l v'm h'lhym vbytv
verses.translation: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

verses.original: וְ/אַֽחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע בָּ֚אוּ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ אָ֛ז שָׁמַ֥ע הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'chry mvt yhvyd' b'v shry yhvdh vyshtchvv lmlkh 'z shm' hmlkh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַזְב֗וּ אֶת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּֽעַבְד֥וּ אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הָֽ/עֲצַבִּ֑ים וַֽ/יְהִי קֶ֗צֶף עַל יְהוּדָה֙ וִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ/אַשְׁמָתָ֖/ם זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vy'zbv 't byt yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm vy'bdv 't h'shrym v't h'tsbym vyhy qtsf 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm b'shmtm z't
verses.translation: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח בָּ/הֶם֙ נְבִאִ֔ים לַ/הֲשִׁיבָ֖/ם אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּעִ֥ידוּ בָ֖/ם וְ/לֹ֥א הֶאֱזִֽינוּ
verses.translit: vyshlch bhm nb'ym lhshybm 'l yhvh vy'ydv bm vl' h'zynv
verses.translation: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD ; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

verses.original: וְ/ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָֽבְשָׁה֙ אֶת זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד מֵ/עַ֣ל לָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לָ/הֶ֜ם כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ/מָה֩ אַתֶּ֨ם עֹבְרִ֜ים אֶת מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תַצְלִ֔יחוּ כִּֽי עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יַּֽעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vrvch 'lhym lbshh 't zkhryh bn yhvyd' hkhhn vy'md m'l l'm vy'mr lhm khh 'mr h'lhym lmh 'tm 'brym 't mtsvt yhvh vl' ttslychv khy 'zbtm 't yhvh vy'zb 'tkhm
verses.translation: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD , that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD , he hath also forsaken you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשְׁר֣וּ עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּרְגְּמֻ֥/הוּ אֶ֖בֶן בְּ/מִצְוַ֣ת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ בַּ/חֲצַ֖ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqshrv 'lyv vyrgmhv 'bn bmtsvt hmlkh bchtsr byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹא זָכַ֞ר יוֹאָ֣שׁ הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ הַ/חֶ֨סֶד֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע אָבִי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹ֖ג אֶת בְּנ֑/וֹ וּ/כְ/מוֹת֣/וֹ אָמַ֔ר יֵ֥רֶא יְהוָ֖ה וְ/יִדְרֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: vl' zkhr yv'sh hmlkh hchsd 'shr 'shh yhvyd' 'byv 'mv vyhrg 't bnv vkhmvtv 'mr yr' yhvh vydrsh
verses.translation: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon it , and require it .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לִ/תְקוּפַ֣ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֗ה עָלָ֣ה עָלָי/ו֮ חֵ֣יל אֲרָם֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ אֶל יְהוּדָה֙ וִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יַּשְׁחִ֛יתוּ אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵ֥י הָ/עָ֖ם מֵ/עָ֑ם וְ/כָל שְׁלָלָ֥/ם שִׁלְּח֖וּ לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ דַּרְמָֽשֶׂק
verses.translit: vyhy ltqvpt hshnh 'lh 'lyv chyl 'rm vyb'v 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm vyshchytv 't khl shry h'm m'm vkhl shllm shlchv lmlkh drmshq
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.

verses.original: כִּי֩ בְ/מִצְעַ֨ר אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בָּ֣אוּ חֵ֣יל אֲרָ֗ם וַֽ/יהוָה֙ נָתַ֨ן בְּ/יָדָ֥/ם חַ֨יִל֙ לָ/רֹ֣ב מְאֹ֔ד כִּ֣י עָֽזְב֔וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֶת יוֹאָ֖שׁ עָשׂ֥וּ שְׁפָטִֽים
verses.translit: khy bmts'r 'nshym b'v chyl 'rm vyhvh ntn bydm chyl lrb m'd khy 'zbv 't yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm v't yv'sh 'shv shptym
verses.translation: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/לֶכְתָּ֣/ם מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ כִּֽי עָזְב֣וּ אֹת/וֹ֮ ב/מחליים בְּ/מַחֲלוּיִ֣ם רַבִּים֒ הִתְקַשְּׁר֨וּ עָלָ֜י/ו עֲבָדָ֗י/ו בִּ/דְמֵי֙ בְּנֵי֙ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וַ/יַּֽהַרְגֻ֥/הוּ עַל מִטָּת֖/וֹ וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד וְ/לֹ֥א קְבָרֻ֖/הוּ בְּ/קִבְר֥וֹת הַ/מְּלָכִֽים
verses.translit: vblkhtm mmnv khy 'zbv 'tv bmchlyym bmchlvym rbym htqshrv 'lyv 'bdyv bdmy bny yhvyd' hkhhn vyhrghv 'l mttv vymt vyqbrhv b'yr dvyd vl' qbrhv bqbrvt hmlkhym
verses.translation: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה הַ/מִּתְקַשְּׁרִ֣ים עָלָ֑י/ו זָבָ֗ד בֶּן שִׁמְעָת֙ הָֽ/עַמּוֹנִ֔ית וִ/יה֣וֹזָבָ֔ד בֶּן שִׁמְרִ֖ית הַ/מּוֹאָבִֽית
verses.translit: v'lh hmtqshrym 'lyv zbd bn shm't h'mvnyt vyhvzbd bn shmryt hmv'byt
verses.translation: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

verses.original: וּ/בָנָ֞י/ו ו/רב יִ֧רֶ֞ב הַ/מַּשָּׂ֣א עָלָ֗י/ו וִ/יסוֹד֙ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל מִדְרַ֖שׁ סֵ֣פֶר הַ/מְּלָכִ֑ים וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbnyv vrb yrb hmsh' 'lyv vysvd byt h'lhym hnm khtvbym 'l mdrsh spr hmlkhym vymlkh 'mtsyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָ/תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יְהוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִ/ירוּשָׁלָֽיִם
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh mlkh 'mtsyhv v'shrym vtsh' shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv yhv'dn myrvshlym
verses.translation: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א בְּ/לֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh rq l' blbb shlm
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , but not with a perfect heart.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה עָלָ֑י/ו וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י/ו הַ/מַּכִּ֖ים אֶת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr chzqh hmmlkhh 'lyv vyhrg 't 'bdyv hmkhym 't hmlkh 'byv
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כִּ֣י כַ/כָּת֣וּב בַּ/תּוֹרָ֡ה בְּ/סֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לֹא יָמ֨וּתוּ אָב֤וֹת עַל בָּנִים֙ וּ/בָנִים֙ לֹא יָמ֣וּתוּ עַל אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/חֶטְא֖/וֹ יָמֽוּתוּ
verses.translit: v't bnyhm l' hmyt khy khkhtvb btvrh bspr mshh 'shr tsvh yhvh l'mr l' ymvtv 'bvt 'l bnym vbnym l' ymvtv 'l 'bvt khy 'ysh bcht'v ymvtv
verses.translation: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֤ץ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יַּֽעֲמִידֵ֣/ם לְ/בֵית אָב֗וֹת לְ/שָׂרֵ֤י הָ/אֲלָפִים֙ וּ/לְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֵּא֔וֹת לְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽ/יִּפְקְדֵ֗/ם לְ/מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וַ/יִּמְצָאֵ֗/ם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף בָּחוּר֙ יוֹצֵ֣א צָבָ֔א אֹחֵ֖ז רֹ֥מַח וְ/צִנָּֽה
verses.translit: vyqbts 'mtsyhv 't yhvdh vy'mydm lbyt 'bvt lshry h'lpym vlshry hm'vt lkhl yhvdh vbnymn vypqdm lmbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh vymts'm shlsh m'vt 'lf bchvr yvts' tsb' 'chz rmch vtsnh
verses.translation: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂכֹּ֣ר מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֥אָה אֶ֛לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל בְּ/מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vyshkhr myshr'l m'h 'lf gbvr chyl bm'h khkhr khsf
verses.translation: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/מֶּ֕לֶךְ אַל יָבֹ֥א עִמְּ/ךָ֖ צְבָ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'ysh h'lhym b' 'lyv l'mr hmlkh 'l yb' 'mkh tsb' yshr'l khy 'yn yhvh 'm yshr'l khl bny 'prym
verses.translation: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם בֹּ֣א אַתָּ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה חֲזַ֣ק לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה יַכְשִֽׁילְ/ךָ֤ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ כֹּ֛חַ בֵּ/אלֹהִ֖ים לַ/עְז֥וֹר וּ/לְ/הַכְשִֽׁיל
verses.translit: khy 'm b' 'th 'shh chzq lmlchmh ykhshylkh h'lhym lpny 'vyb khy ysh khch b'lhym l'zvr vlhkhshyl
verses.translation: But if thou wilt go, do it , be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/מַֽה לַּ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ לִ/מְאַ֣ת הַ/כִּכָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/גְד֣וּד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵ֚שׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לָ֥/תֶת לְ/ךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mtsyhv l'ysh h'lhym vmh l'shvt lm't hkhkhr 'shr ntty lgdvd yshr'l vy'mr 'ysh h'lhym ysh lyhvh ltt lkh hrbh mzh
verses.translation: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.

verses.original: וַ/יַּבְדִּילֵ֣/ם אֲמַצְיָ֗הוּ לְ/הַ/גְּדוּד֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ מֵֽ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם לָ/לֶ֖כֶת לִ/מְקוֹמָ֑/ם וַ/יִּ֨חַר אַפָּ֤/ם מְאֹד֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יָּשׁ֥וּבוּ לִ/מְקוֹמָ֖/ם בָּ/חֳרִי אָֽף
verses.translit: vybdylm 'mtsyhv lhgdvd 'shr b' 'lyv m'prym llkht lmqvmm vychr 'pm m'd byhvdh vyshvbv lmqvmm bchry 'f
verses.translation: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק וַ/יִּנְהַג֙ אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ גֵּ֣יא הַמֶּ֑לַח וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת בְּנֵי שֵׂעִ֖יר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: v'mtsyhv htchzq vynhg 't 'mv vylkh gy' hmlch vykh 't bny sh'yr 'shrt 'lpym
verses.translation: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים חַיִּ֗ים שָׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יְבִיא֖וּ/ם לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/סָּ֑לַע וַ/יַּשְׁלִיכ֛וּ/ם מֵֽ/רֹאשׁ הַ/סֶּ֖לַע וְ/כֻלָּ֥/ם נִבְקָֽעוּ
verses.translit: v'shrt 'lpym chyym shbv bny yhvdh vyby'vm lr'sh hsl' vyshlykhvm mr'sh hsl' vkhlm nbq'v
verses.translation: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י הַ/גְּד֗וּד אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֤יב אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ מִ/לֶּ֤כֶת עִמּ/וֹ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּפְשְׁטוּ֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ/שֹּׁמְר֖וֹן וְ/עַד בֵּ֣ית חוֹר֑וֹן וַ/יַּכּ֤וּ מֵ/הֶם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַ/יָּבֹ֖זּוּ בִּזָּ֥ה רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: vbny hgdvd 'shr hshyb 'mtsyhv mlkht 'mv lmlchmh vypshtv b'ry yhvdh mshmrvn v'd byt chvrvn vykhv mhm shlsht 'lpym vybzv bzh rbh
verses.translation: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֨י ב֤וֹא אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵֽ/הַכּ֣וֹת אֶת אֲדוֹמִ֔ים וַ/יָּבֵ֗א אֶת אֱלֹהֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר וַ/יַּֽעֲמִידֵ֥/ם ל֖/וֹ לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים וְ/לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֥ם יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְ/לָ/הֶ֥ם יְקַטֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry bv' 'mtsyhv mhkhvt 't 'dvmym vyb' 't 'lhy bny sh'yr vy'mydm lv l'lhym vlpnyhm yshtchvh vlhm yqtr
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/אֲמַצְיָ֑הוּ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵלָי/ו֙ נָבִ֔יא וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ לָ֤/מָּה דָרַ֨שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת עַמָּ֖/ם מִ/יָּדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh b'mtsyhv vyshlch 'lyv nby' vy'mr lv lmh drsht 't 'lhy h'm 'shr l' htsylv 't 'mm mydkh
verses.translation: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/דַבְּר֣/וֹ אֵלָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הַ/לְ/יוֹעֵ֤ץ לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ נְתַנּ֔וּ/ךָ חֲדַל לְ/ךָ֖ לָ֣/מָּה יַכּ֑וּ/ךָ וַ/יֶּחְדַּ֣ל הַ/נָּבִ֗יא וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי יָעַ֤ץ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/הַשְׁחִיתֶ֔/ךָ כִּֽי עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּ֔את וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ לַ/עֲצָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy bdbrv 'lyv vy'mr lv hlyv'ts lmlkh ntnvkh chdl lkh lmh ykhvkh vychdl hnby' vy'mr yd'ty khy y'ts 'lhym lhshchytkh khy 'shyt z't vl' shm't l'tsty
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח אֶל יוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לך לְכָ֖/ה נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים
verses.translit: vyv'ts 'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh vyshlch 'l yv'sh bn yhv'chz bn yhv' mlkh yshr'l l'mr lkh lkhh ntr'h pnym
verses.translation: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ הַ/ח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/לְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל הָ/אֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר תְּנָֽ/ה אֶת בִּתְּ/ךָ֥ לִ/בְנִ֖/י לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַֽ/תַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וַ/תִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת הַ/חֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: vyshlch yv'sh mlkh yshr'l 'l 'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr hchvch 'shr blbnvn shlch 'l h'rz 'shr blbnvn l'mr tnh 't btkh lbny l'shh vt'br chyt hshdh 'shr blbnvn vtrms 't hchvch
verses.translation: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

verses.original: אָמַ֗רְתָּ הִנֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֱד֔וֹם וּ/נְשָׂאֲ/ךָ֥ לִבְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/הַכְבִּ֑יד עַתָּה֙ שְׁבָ֣/ה בְּ/בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ לָ֤/מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּ/רָעָ֔ה וְ/נָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ אַתָּ֖ה וִ/יהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'mrt hnh hkhyt 't 'dvm vnsh'kh lbkh lhkhbyd 'th shbh bbytkh lmh ttgrh br'h vnplt 'th vyhvdh 'mkh
verses.translation: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

verses.original: וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ כִּ֤י מֵ/הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ הִ֔יא לְמַ֖עַן תִּתָּ֣/ם בְּ/יָ֑ד כִּ֣י דָֽרְשׁ֔וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vl' shm' 'mtsyhv khy mh'lhym hy' lm'n ttm byd khy drshv 't 'lhy 'dvm
verses.translation: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל יוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַ/אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּ/בֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'l yv'sh mlkh yshr'l vytr'v pnym hv' v'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh bbyt shmsh 'shr lyhvdh
verses.translation: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyngf yhvdh lpny yshr'l vynsv 'ysh l'hlyv
verses.translation: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֗ז תָּפַ֛שׂ יוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/בֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וַ/יְבִיאֵ֨/הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יִּפְרֹ֞ץ בְּ/חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם מִ/שַּׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד שַׁ֣עַר הַ/פּוֹנֶ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: v't 'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh bn yv'sh bn yhv'chz tpsh yv'sh mlkh yshr'l bbyt shmsh vyby'hv yrvshlm vyprts bchvmt yrvshlm msh'r 'prym 'd sh'r hpvnh 'rb' m'vt 'mh
verses.translation: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.original: וְ/כָֽל הַ/זָּהָ֣ב וְ/הַ/כֶּ֡סֶף וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ֠/כֵּלִים הַ/נִּמְצְאִ֨ים בְּ/בֵית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם עֹבֵ֣ד אֱד֗וֹם וְ/אֶת אֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י הַ/תַּֽעֲרֻב֑וֹת וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vkhl hzhb vhkhsf v't khl hkhlym hnmts'ym bbyt h'lhym 'm 'bd 'dvm v't 'tsrvt byt hmlkh v't bny ht'rbvt vyshb shmrvn
verses.translation: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֨י אֲמַצְיָ֤הוּ בֶן יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת יוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vychy 'mtsyhv bn yv'sh mlkh yhvdh 'chry mvt yv'sh bn yhv'chz mlkh yshr'l chmsh 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הֲ/לֹא֙ הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'mtsyhv hr'shnym vh'chrvnym hl' hnm khtvbym 'l spr mlkhy yhvdh vyshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁר סָ֤ר אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְשְׁר֨וּ עָלָ֥י/ו קֶ֛שֶׁר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַ/יָּ֣נָס לָכִ֑ישָׁ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֤וּ אַחֲרָי/ו֙ לָכִ֔ישָׁ/ה וַ/יְמִיתֻ֖/הוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vm't 'shr sr 'mtsyhv m'chry yhvh vyqshrv 'lyv qshr byrvshlm vyns lkhyshh vyshlchv 'chryv lkhyshh vymythv shm
verses.translation: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂאֻ֖/הוּ עַל הַ/סּוּסִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֥יר יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vysh'hv 'l hsvsym vyqbrv 'tv 'm 'btyv b'yr yhvdh
verses.translation: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ כָּל עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וְ/ה֕וּא בֶּן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יַּמְלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֔/וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥י/ו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyqchv khl 'm yhvdh 't 'zyhv vhv' bn shsh 'shrh shnh vymlykhv 'tv tcht 'byv 'mtsyhv
verses.translation: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

verses.original: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת אֵיל֔וֹת וַ/יְשִׁיבֶ֖/הָ לִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hv' bnh 't 'ylvt vyshybh lyhvdh 'chry shkhb hmlkh 'm 'btyv
verses.translation: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

verses.original: בֶּן שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יכיליה יְכָלְיָ֖ה מִן יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shsh 'shrh shnh 'zyhv bmlkhv vchmshym vshtym shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv ykhylyh ykhlyh mn yrvshlm
verses.translation: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh 'mtsyhv 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Amaziah did.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ לִ/דְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בִּ/ימֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֔הוּ הַ/מֵּבִ֖ין בִּ/רְאֹ֣ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ/בִ/ימֵי֙ דָּרְשׁ֣/וֹ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה הִצְלִיח֖/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy ldrsh 'lhym bymy zkhryhv hmbyn br't h'lhym vbymy drshv 't yhvh htslychv h'lhym
verses.translation: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ וַ/יִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יִּפְרֹ֞ץ אֶת ח֣וֹמַת גַּ֗ת וְ/אֵת֙ חוֹמַ֣ת יַבְנֵ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת אַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וַ/יִּבְנֶ֣ה עָרִ֔ים בְּ/אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וּ/בַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyts' vylchm bplshtym vyprts 't chvmt gt v't chvmt ybnh v't chvmt 'shdvd vybnh 'rym b'shdvd vbplshtym
verses.translation: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעְזְרֵ֨/הוּ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים וְ/עַל ה/ערביים הָֽ/עַרְבִ֛ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בְּ/גוּר בָּ֖עַל וְ/הַ/מְּעוּנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'zrhv h'lhym 'l plshtym v'l h'rbyym h'rbym hyshbym bgvr b'l vhm'vnym
verses.translation: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֧וּ הָֽ/עַמּוֹנִ֛ים מִנְחָ֖ה לְ/עֻזִּיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ שְׁמ/וֹ֙ עַד לְ/ב֣וֹא מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֥י הֶחֱזִ֖יק עַד לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vytnv h'mvnym mnchh l'zyhv vylkh shmv 'd lbv' mtsrym khy hchzyq 'd lm'lh
verses.translation: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֤הוּ מִגְדָּלִים֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַל שַׁ֧עַר הַ/פִּנָּ֛ה וְ/עַל שַׁ֥עַר הַ/גַּ֖יְא וְ/עַל הַ/מִּקְצ֑וֹעַ וַֽ/יְחַזְּקֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vybn 'zyhv mgdlym byrvshlm 'l sh'r hpnh v'l sh'r hgy' v'l hmqtsv' vychzqm
verses.translation: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall , and fortified them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨בֶן מִגְדָּלִ֜ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר וַ/יַּחְצֹב֙ בֹּר֣וֹת רַבִּ֔ים כִּ֤י מִקְנֶה רַּב֙ הָ֣יָה ל֔/וֹ וּ/בַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וּ/בַ/מִּישׁ֑וֹר אִכָּרִ֣ים וְ/כֹֽרְמִ֗ים בֶּ/הָרִים֙ וּ/בַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל כִּֽי אֹהֵ֥ב אֲדָמָ֖ה הָיָֽה
verses.translit: vybn mgdlym bmdbr vychtsb brvt rbym khy mqnh rb hyh lv vbshplh vbmyshvr 'khrym vkhrmym bhrym vbkhrml khy 'hb 'dmh hyh
verses.translation: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לְ/עֻזִּיָּ֡הוּ חַיִל֩ עֹשֵׂ֨ה מִלְחָמָ֜ה יוֹצְאֵ֧י צָבָ֣א לִ/גְד֗וּד בְּ/מִסְפַּר֙ פְּקֻדָּתָ֔/ם בְּ/יַד֙ יעואל יְעִיאֵ֣ל הַ/סּוֹפֵ֔ר וּ/מַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ הַ/שּׁוֹטֵ֑ר עַ֚ל יַד חֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ מִ/שָּׂרֵ֖י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy l'zyhv chyl 'shh mlchmh yvts'y tsb' lgdvd bmspr pqdtm byd y'v'l y'y'l hsvpr vm'shyhv hshvtr 'l yd chnnyhv mshry hmlkh
verses.translation: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

verses.original: כֹּ֠ל מִסְפַּ֞ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָ/אָבוֹת֙ לְ/גִבּ֣וֹרֵי חָ֔יִל אַלְפַּ֖יִם וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: khl mspr r'shy h'bvt lgbvry chyl 'lpym vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָדָ/ם֩ חֵ֨יל צָבָ֜א שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֗לֶף וְ/שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וַ/חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת עוֹשֵׂ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ/כֹ֣חַ חָ֑יִל לַ/עְזֹ֥ר לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל הָ/אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: v'l ydm chyl tsb' shlsh m'vt 'lf vshb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt 'vshy mlchmh bkhch chyl l'zr lmlkh 'l h'vyb
verses.translation: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

verses.original: וַ/יָּכֶן֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ לְ/כָל הַ/צָּבָ֗א מָגִנִּ֤ים וּ/רְמָחִים֙ וְ/כ֣וֹבָעִ֔ים וְ/שִׁרְיֹנ֖וֹת וּ/קְשָׁת֑וֹת וּ/לְ/אַבְנֵ֖י קְלָעִֽים
verses.translit: vykhn lhm 'zyhv lkhl htsb' mgnym vrmchym vkhvb'ym vshrynvt vqshtvt vl'bny ql'ym
verses.translation: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם חִשְּׁבֹנ֜וֹת מַחֲשֶׁ֣בֶת חוֹשֵׁ֗ב לִ/הְי֤וֹת עַל הַ/מִּגְדָּלִים֙ וְ/עַל הַ/פִּנּ֔וֹת לִ/ירוֹא֙ בַּֽ/חִצִּ֔ים וּ/בָ/אֲבָנִ֖ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א שְׁמ/וֹ֙ עַד לְ/מֵ֣/רָח֔וֹק כִּֽי הִפְלִ֥יא לְ/הֵעָזֵ֖ר עַ֥ד כִּֽי חָזָֽק
verses.translit: vy'sh byrvshlm chshbnvt mchshbt chvshb lhyvt 'l hmgdlym v'l hpnvt lyrv' bchtsym vb'bnym gdlvt vyts' shmv 'd lmrchvq khy hply' lh'zr 'd khy chzq
verses.translation: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/חֶזְקָת֗/וֹ גָּבַ֤הּ לִבּ/וֹ֙ עַד לְ/הַשְׁחִ֔ית וַ/יִּמְעַ֖ל בַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הַקְטִ֖יר עַל מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/קְּטֹֽרֶת
verses.translit: vkhchzqtv gbh lbv 'd lhshchyt vym'l byhvh 'lhyv vyb' 'l hykhl yhvh lhqtyr 'l mzbch hqtrt
verses.translation: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אַחֲרָ֖י/ו עֲזַרְיָ֣הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/עִמּ֞/וֹ כֹּהֲנִ֧ים לַ/יהוָ֛ה שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים בְּנֵי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyb' 'chryv 'zryhv hkhhn v'mv khhnym lyhvh shmvnym bny chyl
verses.translation: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD , that were valiant men:

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַמְד֞וּ עַל עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֹא לְ/ךָ֣ עֻזִּיָּ֗הוּ לְ/הַקְטִיר֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כִּ֣י לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹ֛ן הַ/מְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לְ/הַקְטִ֑יר צֵ֤א מִן הַ/מִּקְדָּשׁ֙ כִּ֣י מָעַ֔לְתָּ וְ/לֹֽא לְ/ךָ֥ לְ/כָב֖וֹד מֵ/יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mdv 'l 'zyhv hmlkh vy'mrv lv l' lkh 'zyhv lhqtyr lyhvh khy lkhhnym bny 'hrn hmqdshym lhqtyr ts' mn hmqdsh khy m'lt vl' lkh lkhbvd myhvh 'lhym
verses.translation: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD , but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְעַף֙ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וּ/בְ/יָד֥/וֹ מִקְטֶ֖רֶת לְ/הַקְטִ֑יר וּ/בְ/זַעְפּ֣/וֹ עִם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְ֠/הַ/צָּרַעַת זָרְחָ֨ה בְ/מִצְח֜/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֖ל לְ/מִזְבַּ֥ח הַ/קְּטֹֽרֶת
verses.translit: vyz'f 'zyhv vbydv mqtrt lhqtyr vbz'pv 'm hkhhnym vhtsr't zrchh bmtschv lpny hkhhnym bbyt yhvh m'l lmzbch hqtrt
verses.translation: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD , from beside the incense altar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣פֶן אֵלָ֡י/ו עֲזַרְיָהוּ֩ כֹהֵ֨ן הָ/רֹ֜אשׁ וְ/כָל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְ/הִנֵּה ה֤וּא מְצֹרָע֙ בְּ/מִצְח֔/וֹ וַ/יַּבְהִל֖וּ/הוּ מִ/שָּׁ֑ם וְ/גַם הוּא֙ נִדְחַ֣ף לָ/צֵ֔את כִּ֥י נִגְּע֖/וֹ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vypn 'lyv 'zryhv khhn hr'sh vkhl hkhhnym vhnh hv' mtsr' bmtschv vybhlvhv mshm vgm hv' ndchf lts't khy ng'v yhvh
verses.translation: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ עֻזִּיָּ֨הוּ הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ מְצֹרָ֣ע עַד י֣וֹם מוֹת֗/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֜שֶׁב בֵּ֤ית ה/חפשות הַֽ/חָפְשִׁית֙ מְצֹרָ֔ע כִּ֥י נִגְזַ֖ר מִ/בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ/יוֹתָ֤ם בְּנ/וֹ֙ עַל בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֖ט אֶת עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy 'zyhv hmlkh mtsr' 'd yvm mvtv vyshb byt hchpshvt hchpshyt mtsr' khy ngzr mbyt yhvh vyvtm bnv 'l byt hmlkh shvpt 't 'm h'rts
verses.translation: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD : and Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אֲחֲרֹנִ֑ים כָּתַ֛ב יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ בֶן אָמ֖וֹץ הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'zyhv hr'shnym vh'chrnym khtb ysh'yhv bn 'mvts hnby'
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֨ב עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ עִם אֲבֹתָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֤/וֹ עִם אֲבֹתָי/ו֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֤ה הַ/קְּבוּרָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/מְּלָכִ֔ים כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ מְצוֹרָ֣ע ה֑וּא וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'zyhv 'm 'btyv vyqbrv 'tv 'm 'btyv bshdh hqbvrh 'shr lmlkhym khy 'mrv mtsvr' hv' vymlkh yvtm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יוֹתָ֣ם בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖ה בַּת צָדֽוֹק
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh yvtm bmlkhv vshsh 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv yrvshh bt tsdvq
verses.translation: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֜ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה כְּ/כֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֙ עֻזִּיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔י/ו רַ֕ק לֹא בָ֖א אֶל הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/ע֥וֹד הָ/עָ֖ם מַשְׁחִיתִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh 'zyhv 'byv rq l' b' 'l hykhl yhvh v'vd h'm mshchytym
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD . And the people did yet corruptly.

verses.original: ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה הָ/עֶלְי֑וֹן וּ/בְ/חוֹמַ֥ת הָ/עֹ֛פֶל בָּנָ֖ה לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: hv' bnh 't sh'r byt yhvh h'lyvn vbchvmt h'pl bnh lrb
verses.translation: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD , and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

verses.original: וְ/עָרִ֥ים בָּנָ֖ה בְּ/הַר יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/בֶ/חֳרָשִׁ֣ים בָּנָ֔ה בִּֽירָנִיּ֖וֹת וּ/מִגְדָּלִֽים
verses.translit: v'rym bnh bhr yhvdh vbchrshym bnh byrnyvt vmgdlym
verses.translation: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

verses.original: וְ֠/הוּא נִלְחַ֞ם עִם מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן֮ וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֣ק עֲלֵי/הֶם֒ וַ/יִּתְּנוּ ל֨/וֹ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֜וֹן בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/הִ֗יא מֵאָה֙ כִּכַּר כֶּ֔סֶף וַ/עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים כֹּרִים֙ חִטִּ֔ים וּ/שְׂעוֹרִ֖ים עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים זֹ֗את הֵשִׁ֤יבוּ ל/וֹ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁית
verses.translit: vhv' nlchm 'm mlkh bny 'mvn vychzq 'lyhm vytnv lv bny 'mvn bshnh hhy' m'h khkhr khsf v'shrt 'lpym khrym chtym vsh'vrym 'shrt 'lpym z't hshybv lv bny 'mvn vbshnh hshnyt vhshlshyt
verses.translation: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֖ק יוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֚י הֵכִ֣ין דְּרָכָ֔י/ו לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytchzq yvtm khy hkhyn drkhyv lpny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

verses.original: וְ/יֶתֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יוֹתָ֔ם וְ/כָל מִלְחֲמֹתָ֖י/ו וּ/דְרָכָ֑י/ו הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry yvtm vkhl mlchmtyv vdrkhyv hnm khtvbym 'l spr mlkhy yshr'l vyhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְ/חָמֵ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וְ/שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh hyh bmlkhv vshsh 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yvtm 'm 'btyv vyqbrv 'tv b'yr dvyd vymlkh 'chz bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/לֹא עָשָׂ֧ה הַ/יָּשָׁ֛ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/דָוִ֥יד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: bn 'shrym shnh 'chz bmlkhv vshsh 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vl' 'shh hyshr b'yny yhvh khdvyd 'byv
verses.translation: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD , like David his father:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ/דַרְכֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/גַ֧ם מַסֵּכ֛וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה לַ/בְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkhy mlkhy yshr'l vgm mskhvt 'shh lb'lym
verses.translation: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

verses.original: וְ/ה֥וּא הִקְטִ֖יר בְּ/גֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֑ם וַ/יַּבְעֵ֤ר אֶת בָּנָי/ו֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ כְּ/תֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhv' hqtyr bgy' bn hnm vyb'r 't bnyv b'sh kht'bvt hgvym 'shr hrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַ/יְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּ/בָּמ֖וֹת וְ/עַל הַ/גְּבָע֑וֹת וְ/תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן
verses.translit: vyzbch vyqtr bbmvt v'l hgb'vt vtcht khl 'ts r'nn
verses.translation: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֜/הוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָי/ו֮ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָם֒ וַ/יַּ֨כּוּ ב֔/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֤וּ מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ שִׁבְיָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַ/יָּבִ֖יאוּ דַּרְמָ֑שֶׂק וְ֠/גַם בְּ/יַד מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נִתָּ֔ן וַ/יַּךְ בּ֖/וֹ מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vytnhv yhvh 'lhyv byd mlkh 'rm vykhv bv vyshbv mmnv shbyh gdvlh vyby'v drmshq vgm byd mlkh yshr'l ntn vykh bv mkhh gdvlh
verses.translation: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

verses.original: וַ/יַּהֲרֹג֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה מֵאָ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד הַ/כֹּ֣ל בְּנֵי חָ֑יִל בְּ/עָזְבָ֕/ם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhrg pqch bn rmlyhv byhvdh m'h v'shrym 'lf byvm 'chd hkhl bny chyl b'zbm 't yhvh 'lhy 'bvtm
verses.translation: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹ֞ג זִכְרִ֣י גִּבּ֣וֹר אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אֶת עַזְרִיקָ֖ם נְגִ֣יד הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/אֶת אֶלְקָנָ֖ה מִשְׁנֵ֥ה הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhrg zkhry gbvr 'prym 't m'shyhv bn hmlkh v't 'zryqm ngyd hbyt v't 'lqnh mshnh hmlkh
verses.translation: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁבּוּ֩ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל מֵֽ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֜ם מָאתַ֣יִם אֶ֗לֶף נָשִׁים֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנ֔וֹת וְ/גַם שָׁלָ֥ל רָ֖ב בָּזְז֣וּ מֵ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל לְ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshbv bny yshr'l m'chyhm m'tym 'lf nshym bnym vbnvt vgm shll rb bzzv mhm vyby'v 't hshll lshmrvn
verses.translation: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

verses.original: וְ֠/שָׁם הָיָ֨ה נָבִ֥יא לַֽ/יהוָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד שְׁמ/וֹ֒ וַ/יֵּצֵ֗א לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/צָּבָא֙ הַ/בָּ֣א לְ/שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם הִ֠נֵּה בַּ/חֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה נְתָנָ֣/ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/תַּֽהַרְגוּ בָ֣/ם בְ/זַ֔עַף עַ֥ד לַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם הִגִּֽיעַ
verses.translit: vshm hyh nby' lyhvh 'dd shmv vyts' lpny htsb' hb' lshmrvn vy'mr lhm hnh bchmt yhvh 'lhy 'bvtykhm 'l yhvdh ntnm bydkhm vthrgv bm bz'f 'd lshmym hgy'
verses.translation: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֤ה וִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לִ/כְבֹּ֛שׁ לַ/עֲבָדִ֥ים וְ/לִ/שְׁפָח֖וֹת לָ/כֶ֑ם הֲ/לֹ֤א רַק אַתֶּם֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֣ם אֲשָׁמ֔וֹת לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th bny yhvdh vyrvshlm 'tm 'mrym lkhbsh l'bdym vlshpchvt lkhm hl' rq 'tm 'mkhm 'shmvt lyhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה שְׁמָע֔וּ/נִי וְ/הָשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ הַ/שִּׁבְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁבִיתֶ֖ם מֵ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֛י חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th shm'vny vhshybv hshbyh 'shr shbytm m'chykhm khy chrvn 'f yhvh 'lykhm
verses.translation: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD is upon you.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֨מוּ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵ/רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֗יִם עֲזַרְיָ֤הוּ בֶן יְהֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּרֶכְיָ֣הוּ בֶן מְשִׁלֵּמ֔וֹת וִֽ/יחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן שַׁלֻּ֔ם וַ/עֲמָשָׂ֖א בֶּן חַדְלָ֑י עַל הַ/בָּאִ֖ים מִן הַ/צָּבָֽא
verses.translit: vyqmv 'nshym mr'shy bny 'prym 'zryhv bn yhvchnn brkhyhv bn mshlmvt vychzqyhv bn shlm v'msh' bn chdly 'l hb'ym mn htsb'
verses.translation: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ/הֶ֗ם לֹא תָבִ֤יאוּ אֶת הַ/שִּׁבְיָה֙ הֵ֔נָּה כִּי֩ לְ/אַשְׁמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים לְ/הֹסִ֥יף עַל חַטֹּאתֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/עַל אַשְׁמָתֵ֑י/נוּ כִּֽי רַבָּ֤ה אַשְׁמָה֙ לָ֔/נוּ וַ/חֲר֥וֹן אָ֖ף עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv lhm l' tby'v 't hshbyh hnh khy l'shmt yhvh 'lynv 'tm 'mrym lhsyf 'l cht'tynv v'l 'shmtynv khy rbh 'shmh lnv vchrvn 'f 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֣ב הֶֽ/חָל֗וּץ אֶת הַ/שִּׁבְיָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/בִּזָּ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים וְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vy'zb hchlvts 't hshbyh v't hbzh lpny hshrym vkhl hqhl
verses.translation: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֣מוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֩ אֲשֶׁר נִקְּב֨וּ בְ/שֵׁמ֜וֹת וַ/יַּחֲזִ֣יקוּ בַ/שִּׁבְיָ֗ה וְ/כָֽל מַעֲרֻמֵּי/הֶם֮ הִלְבִּ֣ישׁוּ מִן הַ/שָּׁלָל֒ וַ/יַּלְבִּשׁ֣וּ/ם וַ֠/יַּנְעִלוּ/ם וַ/יַּאֲכִל֨וּ/ם וַ/יַּשְׁק֜וּ/ם וַ/יְסֻכ֗וּ/ם וַ/יְנַהֲל֤וּ/ם בַּ/חֲמֹרִים֙ לְ/כָל כּוֹשֵׁ֔ל וַ/יְבִיא֛וּ/ם יְרֵח֥וֹ עִיר הַ/תְּמָרִ֖ים אֵ֣צֶל אֲחֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּשׁ֖וּבוּ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqmv h'nshym 'shr nqbv bshmvt vychzyqv bshbyh vkhl m'rmyhm hlbyshv mn hshll vylbshvm vyn'lvm vy'khlvm vyshqvm vyskhvm vynhlvm bchmrym lkhl khvshl vyby'vm yrchv 'yr htmrym 'tsl 'chyhm vyshvbv shmrvn
verses.translation: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא שָׁלַ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ אָחָ֛ז עַל מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר לַ/עְזֹ֥ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b't hhy' shlch hmlkh 'chz 'l mlkhy 'shvr l'zr lv
verses.translation: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

verses.original: וְ/ע֥וֹד אֲדוֹמִ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ בִ/יהוּדָ֖ה וַ/יִּשְׁבּוּ שֶֽׁבִי
verses.translit: v'vd 'dvmym b'v vykhv byhvdh vyshbv shby
verses.translation: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים פָּשְׁט֗וּ בְּ/עָרֵ֨י הַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֣ה וְ/הַ/נֶּגֶב֮ לִֽ/יהוּדָה֒ וַֽ֠/יִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת בֵּֽית שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ וְ/אֶת אַיָּל֜וֹן וְ/אֶת הַ/גְּדֵר֗וֹת וְ/אֶת שׂוֹכ֤וֹ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אֶת תִּמְנָ֣ה וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת גִּמְז֖וֹ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vplshtym pshtv b'ry hshplh vhngb lyhvdh vylkhdv 't byt shmsh v't 'ylvn v't hgdrvt v't shvkhv vbnvtyh v't tmnh vbnvtyh v't gmzv v't bntyh vyshbv shm
verses.translation: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִכְנִ֤יעַ יְהוָה֙ אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה בַּ/עֲב֖וּר אָחָ֣ז מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י הִפְרִ֨יעַ֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וּ/מָע֥וֹל מַ֖עַל בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy hkhny' yhvh 't yhvdh b'bvr 'chz mlkh yshr'l khy hpry' byhvdh vm'vl m'l byhvh
verses.translation: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א עָלָ֔י/ו תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יָּ֥צַר ל֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א חֲזָקֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyv tlgt pln'sr mlkh 'shvr vytsr lv vl' chzqv
verses.translation: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

verses.original: כִּֽי חָלַ֤ק אָחָז֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֑ים וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/עֶזְרָ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy chlq 'chz 't byt yhvh v't byt hmlkh vhshrym vytn lmlkh 'shvr vl' l'zrh lv
verses.translation: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD , and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/עֵת֙ הָצֵ֣ר ל֔/וֹ וַ/יּ֖וֹסֶף לִ/מְע֣וֹל בַּ/יהוָ֑ה ה֖וּא הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז
verses.translit: vb't htsr lv vyvsf lm'vl byhvh hv' hmlkh 'chz
verses.translation: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD : this is that king Ahaz.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבַּ֗ח לֵֽ/אלֹהֵ֣י דַרְמֶשֶׂק֮ הַ/מַּכִּ֣ים בּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּ֠י אֱלֹהֵ֤י מַלְכֵֽי אֲרָם֙ הֵ֚ם מַעְזְרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔/ם לָ/הֶ֥ם אֲזַבֵּ֖חַ וְ/יַעְזְר֑וּ/נִי וְ/הֵ֛ם הָֽיוּ ל֥/וֹ לְ/הַכְשִׁיל֖/וֹ וּ/לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyzbch l'lhy drmshq hmkhym bv vy'mr khy 'lhy mlkhy 'rm hm m'zrym 'vtm lhm 'zbch vy'zrvny vhm hyv lv lhkhshylv vlkhl yshr'l
verses.translation: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֨ף אָחָ֜ז אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים וַ/יְקַצֵּץ֙ אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יִּסְגֹּ֖ר אֶת דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ ל֧/וֹ מִזְבְּח֛וֹת בְּ/כָל פִּנָּ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'sf 'chz 't khly byt h'lhym vyqtsts 't khly byt h'lhym vysgr 't dltvt byt yhvh vy'sh lv mzbchvt bkhl pnh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל עִ֨יר וָ/עִ֤יר לִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בָמ֔וֹת לְ/קַטֵּ֖ר לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַ/יַּכְעֵ֕ס אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbkhl 'yr v'yr lyhvdh 'shh bmvt lqtr l'lhym 'chrym vykh's 't yhvh 'lhy 'btyv
verses.translation: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֤תֶר דְּבָרָי/ו֙ וְ/כָל דְּרָכָ֔י/ו הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbryv vkhl drkhyv hr'shnym vh'chrvnym hnm khtvbym 'l spr mlkhy yhvdh vyshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אָחָ֜ז עִם אֲבֹתָ֗י/ו וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֤/הוּ בָ/עִיר֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ֚י לֹ֣א הֱבִיאֻ֔/הוּ לְ/קִבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'chz 'm 'btyv vyqbrhv b'yr byrvshlm khy l' hby'hv lqbry mlkhy yshr'l vymlkh ychzqyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מָלַ֗ךְ בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְ/חָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ/תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ אֲבִיָּ֖ה בַּת זְכַרְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: ychzqyhv mlkh bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh v'shrym vtsh' shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv 'byh bt zkhryhv
verses.translation: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh dvyd 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that David his father had done.

verses.original: ה֣וּא בַ/שָּׁנָה֩ הָ/רִאשׁוֹנָ֨ה לְ/מָלְכ֜/וֹ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן פָּתַ֛ח אֶת דַּלְת֥וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וַֽ/יְחַזְּקֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: hv' bshnh hr'shvnh lmlkhv bchdsh hr'shvn ptch 't dltvt byt yhvh vychzqm
verses.translation: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD , and repaired them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֶת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וַ/יַּֽאַסְפֵ֖/ם לִ/רְח֥וֹב הַ/מִּזְרָֽח
verses.translit: vyb' 't hkhhnym v't hlvym vy'spm lrchvb hmzrch
verses.translation: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לָ/הֶ֖ם שְׁמָע֣וּ/נִי הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם עַתָּ֣ה הִֽתְקַדְּשׁ֗וּ וְ/קַדְּשׁוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הוֹצִ֥יאוּ אֶת הַ/נִּדָּ֖ה מִן הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm shm'vny hlvym 'th htqdshv vqdshv 't byt yhvh 'lhy 'btykhm vhvtsy'v 't hndh mn hqdsh
verses.translation: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place .

verses.original: כִּֽי מָעֲל֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗י/נוּ וְ/עָשׂ֥וּ הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ וַ/יַּֽעַזְבֻ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּסֵּ֧בּוּ פְנֵי/הֶ֛ם מִ/מִּשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יִּתְּנוּ עֹֽרֶף
verses.translit: khy m'lv 'btynv v'shv hr' b'yny yhvh 'lhynv vy'zbhv vysbv pnyhm mmshkhn yhvh vytnv 'rf
verses.translation: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD , and turned their backs.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם סָֽגְר֞וּ דַּלְת֣וֹת הָ/אוּלָ֗ם וַ/יְכַבּוּ֙ אֶת הַ/נֵּר֔וֹת וּ/קְטֹ֖רֶת לֹ֣א הִקְטִ֑ירוּ וְ/עֹלָה֙ לֹא הֶעֱל֣וּ בַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ לֵ/אלֹהֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: gm sgrv dltvt h'vlm vykhbv 't hnrvt vqtrt l' hqtyrv v'lh l' h'lv bqdsh l'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף יְהוָ֔ה עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֤/ם ל/זועה לְ/זַֽעֲוָה֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה וְ/לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy qtsf yhvh 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm vytnm lzv'h lz'vh lshmh vlshrqh kh'shr 'tm r'ym b'ynykhm
verses.translation: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה נָפְל֥וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֖י/נוּ בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב וּ/בָנֵ֨י/נוּ וּ/בְנוֹתֵ֧י/נוּ וְ/נָשֵׁ֛י/נוּ בַּ/שְּׁבִ֖י עַל זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vhnh nplv 'bvtynv bchrb vbnynv vbnvtynv vnshynv bshby 'l z't
verses.translation: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ עִם לְבָבִ֔/י לִ/כְר֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/יָשֹׁ֥ב מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'th 'm lbby lkhrvt bryt lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l vyshb mmnv chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

verses.original: בָּנַ֕/י עַתָּ֖ה אַל תִּשָּׁל֑וּ כִּֽי בָ/כֶ֞ם בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַ/עֲמֹ֤ד לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לְ/שָׁ֣רְת֔/וֹ וְ/לִ/הְי֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ מְשָׁרְתִ֥ים וּ/מַקְטִרִֽים
verses.translit: bny 'th 'l tshlv khy bkhm bchr yhvh l'md lpnyv lshrtv vlhyvt lv mshrtym vmqtrym
verses.translation: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֣מוּ הַ֠/לְוִיִּם מַ֣חַת בֶּן עֲמָשַׂ֞י וְ/יוֹאֵ֣ל בֶּן עֲזַרְיָהוּ֮ מִן בְּנֵ֣י הַ/קְּהָתִי֒ וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י קִ֚ישׁ בֶּן עַבְדִּ֔י וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י יוֹאָח֙ בֶּן זִמָּ֔ה וְ/עֵ֖דֶן בֶּן יוֹאָֽח
verses.translit: vyqmv hlvym mcht bn 'mshy vyv'l bn 'zryhv mn bny hqhty vmn bny mrry qysh bn 'bdy v'zryhv bn yhll'l vmn hgrshny yv'ch bn zmh v'dn bn yv'ch
verses.translation: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵי֙ אֱלִ֣יצָפָ֔ן שִׁמְרִ֖י ו/יעואל וִ/יעִיאֵ֑ל וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ וּ/מַתַּנְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vmn bny 'lytspn shmry vy'v'l vy'y'l vmn bny 'sf zkhryhv vmtnyhv
verses.translation: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֥י הֵימָ֖ן יחואל יְחִיאֵ֣ל וְ/שִׁמְעִ֑י וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֔וּן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְ/עֻזִּיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vmn bny hymn ychv'l ychy'l vshm'y vmn bny ydvtvn shm'yh v'zy'l
verses.translation: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽאַסְפ֤וּ אֶת אֲחֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ כְ/מִצְוַת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/דִבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְ/טַהֵ֖ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'spv 't 'chyhm vytqdshv vyb'v khmtsvt hmlkh bdbry yhvh lthr byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD , to cleanse the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ הַ֠/כֹּהֲנִים לִ/פְנִ֣ימָה בֵית יְהוָה֮ לְ/טַהֵר֒ וַ/יּוֹצִ֗יאוּ אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/טֻּמְאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָֽצְאוּ֙ בְּ/הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לַ/חֲצַ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַֽ/יְקַבְּלוּ֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא לְ/נַֽחַל קִדְר֖וֹן חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb'v hkhhnym lpnymh byt yhvh lthr vyvtsy'v 't khl htm'h 'shr mts'v bhykhl yhvh lchtsr byt yhvh vyqblv hlvym lhvtsy' lnchl qdrvn chvtsh
verses.translation: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD , to cleanse it , and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD . And the Levites took it , to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּחֵלּוּ בְּ/אֶחָ֞ד לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁוֹן֮ לְ/קַדֵּשׁ֒ וּ/בְ/י֧וֹם שְׁמוֹנָ֣ה לַ/חֹ֗דֶשׁ בָּ֚אוּ לְ/אוּלָ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה לְ/יָמִ֣ים שְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וּ/בְ/י֨וֹם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן כִּלּֽוּ
verses.translit: vychlv b'chd lchdsh hr'shvn lqdsh vbyvm shmvnh lchdsh b'v l'vlm yhvh vyqdshv 't byt yhvh lymym shmvnh vbyvm shshh 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn khlv
verses.translation: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD : so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֤וֹאוּ פְנִ֨ימָה֙ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טִהַ֖רְנוּ אֶת כָּל בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֶת מִזְבַּ֤ח הָ/עוֹלָה֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת שֻׁלְחַ֥ן הַֽ/מַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vybv'v pnymh 'l chzqyhv hmlkh vy'mrv thrnv 't khl byt yhvh 't mzbch h'vlh v't khl khlyv v't shlchn hm'rkht v't khl khlyv
verses.translation: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD , and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִזְנִיחַ֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֧ז בְּ/מַלְכוּת֛/וֹ בְּ/מַעֲל֖/וֹ הֵכַ֣נּוּ וְ/הִקְדָּ֑שְׁנוּ וְ/הִנָּ֕/ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v't khl hkhlym 'shr hznych hmlkh 'chz bmlkhvtv bm'lv hkhnv vhqdshnv vhnm lpny mzbch yhvh
verses.translation: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּם֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יַּ֖עַל בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshkhm ychzqyhv hmlkh vy'sf 't shry h'yr vy'l byt yhvh
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֣יאוּ פָרִים שִׁבְעָה֩ וְ/אֵילִ֨ים שִׁבְעָ֜ה וּ/כְבָשִׂ֣ים שִׁבְעָ֗ה וּ/צְפִירֵ֨י עִזִּ֤ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לְ/חַטָּ֔את עַל הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֥ה וְ/עַל הַ/מִּקְדָּ֖שׁ וְ/עַל יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לִ/בְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לְ/הַעֲל֖וֹת עַל מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyby'v prym shb'h v'ylym shb'h vkhbshym shb'h vtspyry 'zym shb'h lcht't 'l hmmlkhh v'l hmqdsh v'l yhvdh vy'mr lbny 'hrn hkhhnym lh'lvt 'l mzbch yhvh
verses.translation: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲטוּ֙ הַ/בָּקָ֔ר וַ/יְקַבְּל֤וּ הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם וַֽ/יִּזְרְק֖וּ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הָ/אֵלִ֗ים וַ/יִּזְרְק֤וּ הַ/דָּם֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲטוּ֙ הַ/כְּבָשִׂ֔ים וַ/יִּזְרְק֥וּ הַ/דָּ֖ם הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshchtv hbqr vyqblv hkhhnym 't hdm vyzrqv hmzbchh vyshchtv h'lym vyzrqv hdm hmzbchh vyshchtv hkhbshym vyzrqv hdm hmzbchh
verses.translation: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ אֶת שְׂעִירֵ֣י הַֽ/חַטָּ֔את לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/הַ/קָּהָ֑ל וַ/יִּסְמְכ֥וּ יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vygyshv 't sh'yry hcht't lpny hmlkh vhqhl vysmkhv ydyhm 'lyhm
verses.translation: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחָטוּ/ם֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַֽ/יְחַטְּא֤וּ אֶת דָּמָ/ם֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הָ/עוֹלָ֖ה וְ/הַ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: vyshchtvm hkhhnym vycht'v 't dmm hmzbchh lkhpr 'l khl yshr'l khy lkhl yshr'l 'mr hmlkh h'vlh vhcht't
verses.translation: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲמֵ֨ד אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בִּ/מְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ בִּ/נְבָלִ֣ים וּ/בְ/כִנֹּר֔וֹת בְּ/מִצְוַ֥ת דָּוִ֛יד וְ/גָ֥ד חֹזֵֽה הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֑יא כִּ֧י בְ/יַד יְהוָ֛ה הַ/מִּצְוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד נְבִיאָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'md 't hlvym byt yhvh bmtsltym bnblym vbkhnrvt bmtsvt dvyd vgd chzh hmlkh vntn hnby' khy byd yhvh hmtsvh byd nby'yv
verses.translation: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets. : Heb. commandment by the hand of the LORD

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֤וּ הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ בִּ/כְלֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּ/חֲצֹצְרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mdv hlvym bkhly dvyd vhkhhnym bchtstsrvt
verses.translation: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ לְ/הַעֲל֥וֹת הָ/עֹלָ֖ה לְ/הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּ/בְ/עֵ֞ת הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽ/עוֹלָ֗ה הֵחֵ֤ל שִׁיר יְהוָה֙ וְ/הַ/חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת וְ/עַ֨ל יְדֵ֔י כְּלֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv lh'lvt h'lh lhmzbch vb't hchl h'vlh hchl shyr yhvh vhchtstsrvt v'l ydy khly dvyd mlkh yshr'l
