verses.translation: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָל֙ מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔ים וְ/הַ/שִּׁ֣יר מְשׁוֹרֵ֔ר וְ/הַ/חֲצֹצְר֖וֹת מחצצרים מַחְצְרִ֑ים הַ/כֹּ֕ל עַ֖ד לִ/כְל֥וֹת הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl hqhl mshtchvym vhshyr mshvrr vhchtstsrvt mchtstsrym mchtsrym hkhl 'd lkhlvt h'lh
verses.translation: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/כַלּ֖וֹת לְ/הַעֲל֑וֹת כָּרְע֗וּ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/כָֽל הַ/נִּמְצְאִ֥ים אִתּ֖/וֹ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ
verses.translit: vkhkhlvt lh'lvt khr'v hmlkh vkhl hnmts'ym 'tv vyshtchvv
verses.translation: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/הַלֵּל֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/דִבְרֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד וְ/אָסָ֣ף הַ/חֹזֶ֑ה וַֽ/יְהַלְלוּ֙ עַד לְ/שִׂמְחָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּקְּד֖וּ וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr ychzqyhv hmlkh vhshrym llvym lhll lyhvh bdbry dvyd v'sf hchzh vyhllv 'd lshmchh vyqdv vyshtchvv
verses.translation: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר עַתָּ֨ה מִלֵּאתֶ֤ם יֶדְ/כֶם֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה גֹּ֧שׁוּ וְ/הָבִ֛יאוּ זְבָחִ֥ים וְ/תוֹד֖וֹת לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּבִ֤יאוּ הַ/קָּהָל֙ זְבָחִ֣ים וְ/תוֹד֔וֹת וְ/כָל נְדִ֥יב לֵ֖ב עֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'n ychzqyhv vy'mr 'th ml'tm ydkhm lyhvh gshv vhby'v zbchym vtvdvt lbyt yhvh vyby'v hqhl zbchym vtvdvt vkhl ndyb lb 'lvt
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD , come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD . And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י מִסְפַּ֣ר הָ/עֹלָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵבִ֣יאוּ הַ/קָּהָל֒ בָּקָ֣ר שִׁבְעִ֔ים אֵילִ֥ים מֵאָ֖ה כְּבָשִׂ֣ים מָאתָ֑יִם לְ/עֹלָ֥ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה כָּל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy mspr h'lh 'shr hby'v hqhl bqr shb'ym 'ylym m'h khbshym m'tym l'lh lyhvh khl 'lh
verses.translation: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD .

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים בָּקָר֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְ/צֹ֖אן שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: vhqdshym bqr shsh m'vt vts'n shlsht 'lpym
verses.translation: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

verses.original: רַ֤ק הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הָי֣וּ לִ/מְעָ֔ט וְ/לֹ֣א יָֽכְל֔וּ לְ/הַפְשִׁ֖יט אֶת כָּל הָ/עֹל֑וֹת וַֽ/יְּחַזְּק֞וּ/ם אֲחֵי/הֶ֣ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם עַד כְּל֤וֹת הַ/מְּלָאכָה֙ וְ/עַ֣ד יִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ יִשְׁרֵ֣י לֵבָ֔ב לְ/הִתְקַדֵּ֖שׁ מֵֽ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: rq hkhhnym hyv lm't vl' ykhlv lhpshyt 't khl h'lvt vychzqvm 'chyhm hlvym 'd khlvt hml'khh v'd ytqdshv hkhhnym khy hlvym yshry lbb lhtqdsh mhkhhnym
verses.translation: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

verses.original: וְ/גַם עֹלָ֨ה לָ/רֹ֜ב בְּ/חֶלְבֵ֧י הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֛ים וּ/בַ/נְּסָכִ֖ים לָ/עֹלָ֑ה וַ/תִּכּ֖וֹן עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'lh lrb bchlby hshlmym vbnskhym l'lh vtkhvn 'bvdt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמַ֤ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֔ם עַ֛ל הַ/הֵכִ֥ין הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים לָ/עָ֑ם כִּ֥י בְּ/פִתְאֹ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyshmch ychzqyhv vkhl h'm 'l hhkhyn h'lhym l'm khy bpt'm hyh hdbr
verses.translation: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה וְ/גַֽם אִגְּרוֹת֙ כָּתַב֙ עַל אֶפְרַ֣יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָ/ב֥וֹא לְ/בֵית יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת פֶּ֔סַח לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshlch ychzqyhv 'l khl yshr'l vyhvdh vgm 'grvt khtb 'l 'prym vmnshh lbv' lbyt yhvh byrvshlm l'shvt psch lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֨ץ הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ וְ/שָׂרָ֛י/ו וְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָ֖ל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vyv'ts hmlkh vshryv vkhl hqhl byrvshlm l'shvt hpsch bchdsh hshny
verses.translation: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יָכְל֛וּ לַ/עֲשֹׂת֖/וֹ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא כִּ֤י הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ לֹֽא הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְ/מַ דַּ֔י וְ/הָ/עָ֖ם לֹא נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy l' ykhlv l'shtv b't hhy' khy hkhhnym l' htqdshv lm dy vh'm l' n'spv lyrvshlm
verses.translation: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּישַׁ֥ר הַ/דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vyyshr hdbr b'yny hmlkh vb'yny khl hqhl
verses.translation: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲמִ֣ידוּ דָבָ֗ר לְ/הַעֲבִ֨יר ק֤וֹל בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/בְּאֵֽר שֶׁ֣בַע וְ/עַד דָּ֔ן לָ/ב֞וֹא לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּ֛סַח לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָ/רֹ֛ב עָשׂ֖וּ כַּ/כָּתֽוּב
verses.translit: vy'mydv dbr lh'byr qvl bkhl yshr'l mb'r shb' v'd dn lbv' l'shvt psch lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l byrvshlm khy l' lrb 'shv khkhtvb
verses.translation: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֩ הָ/רָצִ֨ים בָּֽ/אִגְּר֜וֹת מִ/יַּ֧ד הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ וְ/שָׂרָ֗י/ו בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וּ/כְ/מִצְוַ֥ת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אֶל יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/יָשֹׁב֙ אֶל הַ/פְּלֵיטָ֔ה הַ/נִּשְׁאֶ֣רֶת לָ/כֶ֔ם מִ/כַּ֖ף מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vylkhv hrtsym b'grvt myd hmlkh vshryv bkhl yshr'l vyhvdh vkhmtsvt hmlkh l'mr bny yshr'l shvbv 'l yhvh 'lhy 'brhm ytschq vyshr'l vyshb 'l hplyth hnsh'rt lkhm mkhf mlkhy 'shvr
verses.translation: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

verses.original: וְ/אַל תִּֽהְי֗וּ כַּ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/כַ֣/אֲחֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲל֔וּ בַּ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֣/ם לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִֽים
verses.translit: v'l thyv kh'bvtykhm vkh'chykhm 'shr m'lv byhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm vytnm lshmh kh'shr 'tm r'ym
verses.translation: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

verses.original: עַתָּ֕ה אַל תַּקְשׁ֥וּ עָרְפְּ/כֶ֖ם כַּ/אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם תְּנוּ יָ֣ד לַ/יהוָ֗ה וּ/בֹ֤אוּ לְ/מִקְדָּשׁ/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֣ישׁ לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם וְ/עִבְדוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/יָשֹׁ֥ב מִ/כֶּ֖ם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'th 'l tqshv 'rpkhm kh'bvtykhm tnv yd lyhvh vb'v lmqdshv 'shr hqdysh l'vlm v'bdv 't yhvh 'lhykhm vyshb mkhm chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD , and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ/שׁוּבְ/כֶ֞ם עַל יְהוָ֗ה אֲחֵי/כֶ֨ם וּ/בְנֵי/כֶ֤ם לְ/רַחֲמִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י שֽׁוֹבֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לָ/שׁ֖וּב לָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את כִּֽי חַנּ֤וּן וְ/רַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹא יָסִ֤יר פָּנִים֙ מִ/כֶּ֔ם אִם תָּשׁ֖וּבוּ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy bshvbkhm 'l yhvh 'chykhm vbnykhm lrchmym lpny shvbyhm vlshvb l'rts hz't khy chnvn vrchvm yhvh 'lhykhm vl' ysyr pnym mkhm 'm tshvbv 'lyv
verses.translation: For if ye turn again unto the LORD , your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֨וּ הָ/רָצִ֜ים עֹבְרִ֨ים מֵ/עִ֧יר לָ/עִ֛יר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְ/עַד זְבֻל֑וּן וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ מַשְׂחִיקִ֣ים עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/מַלְעִגִ֖ים בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhyv hrtsym 'brym m'yr l'yr b'rts 'prym vmnshh v'd zblvn vyhyv mshchyqym 'lyhm vml'gym bm
verses.translation: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

verses.original: אַךְ אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מֵ/אָשֵׁ֥ר וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּ/מִ/זְּבֻל֑וּן נִֽכְנְע֔וּ וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'kh 'nshym m'shr vmnshh vmzblvn nkhn'v vyb'v lyrvshlm
verses.translation: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בִּ/יהוּדָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ יַ֣ד הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֑ד לַ/עֲשׂ֞וֹת מִצְוַ֥ת הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים בִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: gm byhvdh hyth yd h'lhym ltt lhm lb 'chd l'shvt mtsvt hmlkh vhshrym bdbr yhvh
verses.translation: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽאָסְפ֤וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַם רָ֔ב לַ/עֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת חַ֥ג הַ/מַּצּ֖וֹת בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י קָהָ֖ל לָ/רֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'spv yrvshlm 'm rb l'shvt 't chg hmtsvt bchdsh hshny qhl lrb m'd
verses.translation: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֕מוּ וַ/יָּסִ֨ירוּ֙ אֶת הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל הַֽ/מְקַטְּרוֹת֙ הֵסִ֔ירוּ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֖יכוּ לְ/נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqmv vysyrv 't hmzbchvt 'shr byrvshlm v't khl hmqtrvt hsyrv vyshlykhv lnchl qdrvn
verses.translation: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַ/פֶּ֔סַח בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֤ם נִכְלְמוּ֙ וַ/יִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַ/יָּבִ֥יאוּ עֹל֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshchtv hpsch b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh hshny vhkhhnym vhlvym nkhlmv vytqdshv vyby'v 'lvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֤וּ עַל עָמְדָ/ם֙ כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֔/ם כְּ/תוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ זֹרְקִ֣ים אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם מִ/יַּ֖ד הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mdv 'l 'mdm khmshptm khtvrt mshh 'ysh h'lhym hkhhnym zrqym 't hdm myd hlvym
verses.translation: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.

verses.original: כִּי רַבַּ֥ת בַּ/קָּהָ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֞ם עַל שְׁחִיטַ֣ת הַ/פְּסָחִ֗ים לְ/כֹל֙ לֹ֣א טָה֔וֹר לְ/הַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy rbt bqhl 'shr l' htqdshv vhlvym 'l shchytt hpschym lkhl l' thvr lhqdysh lyhvh
verses.translation: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַרְבִּ֣ית הָ/עָ֡ם רַ֠בַּת מֵֽ/אֶפְרַ֨יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה יִשָּׂשכָ֤ר וּ/זְבֻלוּן֙ לֹ֣א הִטֶּהָ֔רוּ כִּֽי אָכְל֥וּ אֶת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בְּ/לֹ֣א כַ/כָּת֑וּב כִּי֩ הִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֥ה הַ/טּ֖וֹב יְכַפֵּ֥ר בְּעַֽד
verses.translit: khy mrbyt h'm rbt m'prym vmnshh yshshkhr vzblvn l' hthrv khy 'khlv 't hpsch bl' khkhtvb khy htpll ychzqyhv 'lyhm l'mr yhvh htvb ykhpr b'd
verses.translation: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one

verses.original: כָּל לְבָב֣/וֹ הֵכִ֔ין לִ/דְר֛וֹשׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֥ים יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹ֖א כְּ/טָהֳרַ֥ת הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: khl lbbv hkhyn ldrvsh h'lhym yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyv vl' khthrt hqdsh
verses.translation: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יִּרְפָּ֖א אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh 'l ychzqyhv vyrp' 't h'm
verses.translation: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל הַ/נִּמְצְאִ֨ים בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת חַ֧ג הַ/מַּצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וּֽ/מְהַלְלִ֣ים לַ֠/יהוָה י֣וֹם בְּ/י֞וֹם הַ/לְוִיִּ֧ם וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים בִּ/כְלֵי עֹ֖ז לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l hnmts'ym byrvshlm 't chg hmtsvt shb't ymym bshmchh gdvlh vmhllym lyhvh yvm byvm hlvym vhkhhnym bkhly 'z lyhvh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל לֵב֙ כָּל הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם הַ/מַּשְׂכִּילִ֥ים שֵֽׂכֶל ט֖וֹב לַ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּאכְל֤וּ אֶת הַ/מּוֹעֵד֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַ/יָּמִ֔ים מְזַבְּחִים֙ זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֔ים וּ/מִ֨תְוַדִּ֔ים לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vydbr ychzqyhv 'l lb khl hlvym hmshkhylym shkhl tvb lyhvh vy'khlv 't hmv'd shb't hymym mzbchym zbchy shlmym vmtvdym lyhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD : and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּֽעֲצוּ֙ כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֔ל לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִ֖ים שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: vyv'tsv khl hqhl l'shvt shb't ymym 'chrym vy'shv shb't ymym shmchh
verses.translation: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְ֠הוּדָה הֵרִ֨ים לַ/קָּהָ֜ל אֶ֣לֶף פָּרִים֮ וְ/שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֣ים צֹאן֒ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֞ים הֵרִ֤ימוּ לַ/קָּהָל֙ פָּרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְ/צֹ֖אן עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַ/יִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: khy chzqyhv mlkh yhvdh hrym lqhl 'lf prym vshb't 'lpym ts'n vhshrym hrymv lqhl prym 'lf vts'n 'shrt 'lpym vytqdshv khhnym lrb
verses.translation: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׂמְח֣וּ כָּל קְהַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/כָל הַ/קָּהָ֖ל הַ/בָּאִ֣ים מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הַ/גֵּרִ֗ים הַ/בָּאִים֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הַ/יּוֹשְׁבִ֖ים בִּ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyshmchv khl qhl yhvdh vhkhhnym vhlvym vkhl hqhl hb'ym myshr'l vhgrym hb'ym m'rts yshr'l vhyvshbym byhvdh
verses.translation: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָֽה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֠י מִ/ימֵ֞י שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א כָ/זֹ֖את בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vthy shmchh gdvlh byrvshlm khy mymy shlmh bn dvyd mlkh yshr'l l' khz't byrvshlm
verses.translation: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֜מוּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ וַ/יְבָרֲכ֣וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יִּשָּׁמַ֖ע בְּ/קוֹלָ֑/ם וַ/תָּב֧וֹא תְפִלָּתָ֛/ם לִ/מְע֥וֹן קָדְשׁ֖/וֹ לַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqmv hkhhnym hlvym vybrkhv 't h'm vyshm' bqvlm vtbv' tpltm lm'vn qdshv lshmym
verses.translation: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/כַלּ֣וֹת כָּל זֹ֗את יָצְא֨וּ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הַֽ/נִּמְצְאִים֮ לְ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ וַ/יְשַׁבְּר֣וּ הַ/מַּצֵּב֣וֹת וַ/יְגַדְּע֣וּ הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֡ים וַ/יְנַתְּצ֣וּ אֶת הַ֠/בָּמוֹת וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מִּזְבְּחֹ֞ת מִ/כָּל יְהוּדָ֧ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֛ן וּ/בְ/אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עַד לְ/כַלֵּ֑ה וַ/יָּשׁ֜וּבוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לַ/אֲחֻזָּת֖/וֹ לְ/עָרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhkhlvt khl z't yts'v khl yshr'l hnmts'ym l'ry yhvdh vyshbrv hmtsbvt vygd'v h'shrym vynttsv 't hbmvt v't hmzbcht mkhl yhvdh vbnymn vb'prym vmnshh 'd lkhlh vyshvbv khl bny yshr'l 'ysh l'chztv l'ryhm
verses.translation: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֣ד יְחִזְקִיָּ֡הוּ אֶת מַחְלְק֣וֹת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠/הַ/לְוִיִּם עַֽל מַחְלְקוֹתָ֞/ם אִ֣ישׁ כְּ/פִ֣י עֲבֹדָת֗/וֹ לַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/לִ/שְׁלָמִ֑ים לְ/שָׁרֵת֙ וּ/לְ/הֹד֣וֹת וּ/לְ/הַלֵּ֔ל בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֖י מַחֲנ֥וֹת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'md ychzqyhv 't mchlqvt hkhhnym vhlvym 'l mchlqvtm 'ysh khpy 'bdtv lkhhnym vllvym l'lh vlshlmym lshrt vlhdvt vlhll bsh'ry mchnvt yhvh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/מְנָת֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ מִן רְכוּשׁ֜/וֹ לָ/עֹל֗וֹת לְ/עֹלוֹת֙ הַ/בֹּ֣קֶר וְ/הָ/עֶ֔רֶב וְ/הָ֣/עֹל֔וֹת לַ/שַּׁבָּת֖וֹת וְ/לֶ/חֳדָשִׁ֣ים וְ/לַ/מֹּעֲדִ֑ים כַּ/כָּת֖וּב בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vmnt hmlkh mn rkhvshv l'lvt l'lvt hbqr vh'rb vh'lvt lshbtvt vlchdshym vlm'dym khkhtvb btvrt yhvh
verses.translation: He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit , for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/עָם֙ לְ/יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָ/תֵ֕ת מְנָ֥ת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם לְמַ֥עַן יֶחֶזְק֖וּ בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr l'm lyvshby yrvshlm ltt mnt hkhhnym vhlvym lm'n ychzqv btvrt yhvh
verses.translation: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִ/פְרֹ֣ץ הַ/דָּבָ֗ר הִרְבּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּגָ֗ן תִּיר֤וֹשׁ וְ/יִצְהָר֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ וְ/כֹ֖ל תְּבוּאַ֣ת שָׂדֶ֑ה וּ/מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַ/כֹּ֛ל לָ/רֹ֖ב הֵבִֽיאוּ
verses.translit: vkhprts hdbr hrbv bny yshr'l r'shyt dgn tyrvsh vytshr vdbsh vkhl tbv't shdh vm'shr hkhl lrb hby'v
verses.translation: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה הַ/יּֽוֹשְׁבִים֮ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָה֒ גַּם הֵ֗ם מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָ/צֹ֔אן וּ/מַעְשַׂ֣ר קָֽדָשִׁ֔ים הַ/מְקֻדָּשִׁ֖ים לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם הֵבִ֕יאוּ וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֖וּ עֲרֵמ֥וֹת עֲרֵמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l vyhvdh hyvshbym b'ry yhvdh gm hm m'shr bqr vts'n vm'shr qdshym hmqdshym lyhvh 'lhyhm hby'v vytnv 'rmvt 'rmvt
verses.translation: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֔י הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הָ/עֲרֵמ֖וֹת לְ/יִסּ֑וֹד וּ/בַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י כִּלּֽוּ
verses.translit: bchdsh hshlshy hchlv h'rmvt lysvd vbchdsh hshby'y khlv
verses.translation: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֔ים וַ/יִּרְא֖וּ אֶת הָ/עֲרֵמ֑וֹת וַֽ/יְבָרֲכוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת עַמּ֥/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb'v ychzqyhv vhshrym vyr'v 't h'rmvt vybrkhv 't yhvh v't 'mv yshr'l
verses.translation: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD , and his people Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדְרֹ֣שׁ יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִ֛ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם עַל הָ/עֲרֵמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vydrsh ychzqyhv 'l hkhhnym vhlvym 'l h'rmvt
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו עֲזַרְיָ֧הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן הָ/רֹ֖אשׁ לְ/בֵ֣ית צָד֑וֹק וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר מֵ/הָחֵ֨ל הַ/תְּרוּמָ֜ה לָ/בִ֣יא בֵית יְהוָ֗ה אָכ֨וֹל וְ/שָׂב֤וֹעַ וְ/הוֹתֵר֙ עַד לָ/ר֔וֹב כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֣ךְ אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֖ר אֶת הֶ/הָמ֥וֹן הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'zryhv hkhhn hr'sh lbyt tsdvq vy'mr mhchl htrvmh lby' byt yhvh 'khvl vshbv' vhvtr 'd lrvb khy yhvh brkh 't 'mv vhnvtr 't hhmvn hzh
verses.translation: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD , we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ לְ/הָכִ֧ין לְשָׁכ֛וֹת בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יָּכִֽינוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr ychzqyhv lhkhyn lshkhvt bbyt yhvh vykhynv
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD ; and they prepared them ,

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת הַ/תְּרוּמָ֧ה וְ/הַֽ/מַּעֲשֵׂ֛ר וְ/הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֖ים בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֑ה וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֤ם נָגִיד֙ כונניהו כָּֽנַנְיָ֣הוּ הַ/לֵּוִ֔י וְ/שִׁמְעִ֥י אָחִ֖י/הוּ מִשְׁנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyby'v 't htrvmh vhm'shr vhqdshym b'mvnh v'lyhm ngyd khvnnyhv khnnyhv hlvy vshm'y 'chyhv mshnh
verses.translation: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.

verses.original: וִֽ/יחִיאֵ֡ל וַ֠/עֲזַזְיָהוּ וְ/נַ֨חַת וַ/עֲשָׂהאֵ֜ל וִֽ/ירִימ֤וֹת וְ/יוֹזָבָד֙ וֶ/אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְ/יִסְמַכְיָ֔הוּ וּ/מַ֖חַת וּ/בְנָיָ֑הוּ פְּקִידִ֗ים מִ/יַּ֤ד כונניהו כָּֽנַנְיָ֨הוּ֙ וְ/שִׁמְעִ֣י אָחִ֔י/ו בְּ/מִפְקַד֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ נְגִ֥יד בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vychy'l v'zzyhv vncht v'shh'l vyrymvt vyvzbd v'ly'l vysmkhyhv vmcht vbnyhv pqydym myd khvnnyhv khnnyhv vshm'y 'chyv bmpqd ychzqyhv hmlkh v'zryhv ngyd byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

verses.original: וְ/קוֹרֵ֨א בֶן יִמְנָ֤ה הַ/לֵּוִי֙ הַ/שּׁוֹעֵ֣ר לַ/מִּזְרָ֔חָ/ה עַ֖ל נִדְב֣וֹת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים לָ/תֵת֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vqvr' bn ymnh hlvy hshv'r lmzrchh 'l ndbvt h'lhym ltt trvmt yhvh vqdshy hqdshym
verses.translation: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD , and the most holy things.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָד֡/וֹ עֵ֣דֶן וּ֠/מִנְיָמִן וְ/יֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּֽ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֜הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֧הוּ וּ/שְׁכַנְיָ֛הוּ בְּ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֑ה לָ/תֵ֤ת לַ/אֲחֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/מַחְלְק֔וֹת כַּ/גָּד֖וֹל כַּ/קָּטָֽן
verses.translit: v'l ydv 'dn vmnymn vyshv' vshm'yhv 'mryhv vshkhnyhv b'ry hkhhnym b'mvnh ltt l'chyhm bmchlqvt khgdvl khqtn
verses.translation: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

verses.original: מִ/לְּ/בַ֞ד הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣/ם לִ/זְכָרִ֗ים מִ/בֶּ֨ן שָׁל֤וֹשׁ שָׁנִים֙ וּ/לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה לְ/כָל הַ/בָּ֥א לְ/בֵית יְהוָ֖ה לִ/דְבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֑/וֹ לַ/עֲב֣וֹדָתָ֔/ם בְּ/מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֖/ם כְּ/מַחְלְקוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: mlbd htychshm lzkhrym mbn shlvsh shnym vlm'lh lkhl hb' lbyt yhvh ldbr yvm byvmv l'bvdtm bmshmrvtm khmchlqvtyhm
verses.translation: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת הִתְיַחֵ֤שׂ הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הַ֨/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה בְּ/מִשְׁמְרוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/מַחְלְקוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v't htychsh hkhhnym lbyt 'bvtyhm vhlvym mbn 'shrym shnh vlm'lh bmshmrvtyhm bmchlqvtyhm
verses.translation: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הִתְיַחֵ֗שׂ בְּ/כָל טַפָּ֧/ם נְשֵׁי/הֶ֛ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֥ם וּ/בְנוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/כָל קָהָ֑ל כִּ֥י בֶ/אֱמוּנָתָ֖/ם יִתְקַדְּשׁוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vlhtychsh bkhl tpm nshyhm vbnyhm vbnvtyhm lkhl qhl khy b'mvntm ytqdshv qdsh
verses.translation: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים בִּ/שְׂדֵ֨י מִגְרַ֤שׁ עָרֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/כָל עִ֣יר וָ/עִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּ/שֵׁמ֑וֹת לָ/תֵ֣ת מָנ֗וֹת לְ/כָל זָכָר֙ בַּ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּ/לְ/כָל הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ בַּ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn hkhhnym bshdy mgrsh 'ryhm bkhl 'yr v'yr 'nshym 'shr nqbv bshmvt ltt mnvt lkhl zkhr bkhhnym vlkhl htychsh blvym
verses.translation: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ כָּ/זֹ֛את יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ/כָל יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/טּ֤וֹב וְ/הַ/יָּשָׁר֙ וְ/הָ֣/אֱמֶ֔ת לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh khz't ychzqyhv bkhl yhvdh vy'sh htvb vhyshr vh'mt lpny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָֽל מַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֲשֶׁר הֵחֵ֣ל בַּ/עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּ/בַ/תּוֹרָה֙ וּ/בַ/מִּצְוָ֔ה לִ/דְרֹ֖שׁ לֵֽ/אלֹהָ֑י/ו בְּ/כָל לְבָב֥/וֹ עָשָׂ֖ה וְ/הִצְלִֽיחַ
verses.translit: vbkhl m'shh 'shr hchl b'bvdt byt h'lhym vbtvrh vbmtsvh ldrsh l'lhyv bkhl lbbv 'shh vhtslych
verses.translation: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י הַ/דְּבָרִ֤ים וְ/הָ/אֱמֶת֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה בָּ֖א סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יָּבֹ֣א בִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יִּ֨חַן֙ עַל הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הַ/בְּצֻר֔וֹת וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לְ/בִקְעָ֥/ם אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'chry hdbrym vh'mt h'lh b' snchryb mlkh 'shvr vyb' byhvdh vychn 'l h'rym hbtsrvt vy'mr lbq'm 'lyv
verses.translation: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּי בָ֖א סַנְחֵרִ֑יב וּ/פָנָ֕י/ו לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyr' ychzqyhv khy b' snchryb vpnyv lmlchmh 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֗ץ עִם שָׂרָי/ו֙ וְ/גִבֹּרָ֔י/ו לִ/סְתּוֹם֙ אֶת מֵימֵ֣י הָ/עֲיָנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/ח֣וּץ לָ/עִ֑יר וַֽ/יַּעְזְרֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyv'ts 'm shryv vgbryv lstvm 't mymy h'ynvt 'shr mchvts l'yr vy'zrvhv
verses.translation: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עַם רָ֔ב וַֽ/יִּסְתְּמוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/מַּעְיָנ֔וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/נַּ֛חַל הַ/שּׁוֹטֵ֥ף בְּ/תוֹךְ הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לָ֤/מָּה יָב֨וֹאוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר וּ/מָצְא֖וּ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqbtsv 'm rb vystmv 't khl hm'ynvt v't hnchl hshvtf btvkh h'rts l'mr lmh ybv'v mlkhy 'shvr vmts'v mym rbym
verses.translation: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַזַּ֡ק וַ/יִּבֶן֩ אֶת כָּל הַ/חוֹמָ֨ה הַ/פְּרוּצָ֜ה וַ/יַּ֣עַל עַל הַ/מִּגְדָּל֗וֹת וְ/לַ/ח֨וּצָ/ה֙ הַ/חוֹמָ֣ה אַחֶ֔רֶת וַ/יְחַזֵּ֥ק אֶת הַ/מִּלּ֖וֹא עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ שֶׁ֛לַח לָ/רֹ֖ב וּ/מָגִנִּֽים
verses.translit: vytchzq vybn 't khl hchvmh hprvtsh vy'l 'l hmgdlvt vlchvtsh hchvmh 'chrt vychzq 't hmlv' 'yr dvyd vy'sh shlch lrb vmgnym
verses.translation: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֛ן שָׂרֵ֥י מִלְחָמ֖וֹת עַל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּקְבְּצֵ֣/ם אֵלָ֗י/ו אֶל רְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר עַל לְבָבָ֖/ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytn shry mlchmvt 'l h'm vyqbtsm 'lyv 'l rchvb sh'r h'yr vydbr 'l lbbm l'mr
verses.translation: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,

verses.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְ/אִמְצ֔וּ אַל תִּֽירְא֣וּ וְ/אַל תֵּחַ֗תּוּ מִ/פְּנֵי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וּ/מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י כָּל הֶ/הָמ֣וֹן אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי עִמָּ֥/נוּ רַ֖ב מֵ/עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chzqv v'mtsv 'l tyr'v v'l tchtv mpny mlkh 'shvr vmlpny khl hhmvn 'shr 'mv khy 'mnv rb m'mv
verses.translation: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:

verses.original: עִמּ/וֹ֙ זְר֣וֹעַ בָּשָׂ֔ר וְ/עִמָּ֜/נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לְ/עָזְרֵ֔/נוּ וּ/לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם מִלְחֲמֹתֵ֑/נוּ וַ/יִּסָּמְכ֣וּ הָ/עָ֔ם עַל דִּבְרֵ֖י יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: 'mv zrv' bshr v'mnv yhvh 'lhynv l'zrnv vlhlchm mlchmtnv vysmkhv h'm 'l dbry ychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

verses.original: אַ֣חַר זֶ֗ה שָׁ֠לַח סַנְחֵרִ֨יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר עֲבָדָי/ו֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔יְמָ/ה וְ/הוּא֙ עַל לָכִ֔ישׁ וְ/כָל מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֖/וֹ עִמּ֑/וֹ עַל יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עַל כָּל יְהוּדָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'chr zh shlch snchryb mlkh 'shvr 'bdyv yrvshlymh vhv' 'l lkhysh vkhl mmshltv 'mv 'l ychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh v'l khl yhvdh 'shr byrvshlm l'mr
verses.translation: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֔ר סַנְחֵרִ֖יב מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר עַל מָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם בֹּטְחִ֔ים וְ/יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בְּ/מָצ֖וֹר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr snchryb mlkh 'shvr 'l mh 'tm btchym vyshbym bmtsvr byrvshlm
verses.translation: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֤א יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ מַסִּ֣ית אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם לָ/תֵ֣ת אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם לָ/מ֛וּת בְּ/רָעָ֥ב וּ/בְ/צָמָ֖א לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ יַצִּילֵ֕/נוּ מִ/כַּ֖ף מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: hl' ychzqyhv msyt 'tkhm ltt 'tkhm lmvt br'b vbtsm' l'mr yhvh 'lhynv ytsylnv mkhf mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא הוּא֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ הֵסִ֥יר אֶת בָּמֹתָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לִֽ/יהוּדָ֤ה וְ/לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לִ/פְנֵ֨י מִזְבֵּ֧חַ אֶחָ֛ד תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ וְ/עָלָ֥י/ו תַּקְטִֽירוּ
verses.translit: hl' hv' ychzqyhv hsyr 't bmtyv v't mzbchtyv vy'mr lyhvdh vlyrvshlm l'mr lpny mzbch 'chd tshtchvv v'lyv tqtyrv
verses.translation: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א תֵדְע֗וּ מֶ֤ה עָשִׂ֨יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י וַ/אֲבוֹתַ֔/י לְ/כֹ֖ל עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת הֲ/יָכ֣וֹל יָֽכְל֗וּ אֱלֹהֵי֙ גּוֹיֵ֣ הָ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶת אַרְצָ֖/ם מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: hl' td'v mh 'shyty 'ny v'bvty lkhl 'my h'rtsvt hykhvl ykhlv 'lhy gvy h'rtsvt lhtsyl 't 'rtsm mydy
verses.translation: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

verses.original: מִ֠י בְּֽ/כָל אֱלֹהֵ֞י הַ/גּוֹיִ֤ם הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱרִ֣ימוּ אֲבוֹתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָכ֔וֹל לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶת עַמּ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדִ֑/י כִּ֤י יוּכַל֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: my bkhl 'lhy hgvym h'lh 'shr hchrymv 'bvty 'shr ykhvl lhtsyl 't 'mv mydy khy yvkhl 'lhykhm lhtsyl 'tkhm mydy
verses.translation: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה אַל יַשִּׁיא֩ אֶתְ/כֶ֨ם חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וְ/אַל יַסִּ֨ית אֶתְ/כֶ֣ם כָּ/זֹאת֮ וְ/אַל תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ ל/וֹ֒ כִּי לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל כָּל אֱל֨וֹהַ֙ כָּל גּ֣וֹי וּ/מַמְלָכָ֔ה לְ/הַצִּ֥יל עַמּ֛/וֹ מִ/יָּדִ֖/י וּ/מִ/יַּ֣ד אֲבוֹתָ֑/י אַ֚ף כִּ֣י אֱֽלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם לֹא יַצִּ֥ילוּ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th 'l yshy' 'tkhm chzqyhv v'l ysyt 'tkhm khz't v'l t'mynv lv khy l' yvkhl khl 'lvh khl gvy vmmlkhh lhtsyl 'mv mydy vmyd 'bvty 'f khy 'lhykhm l' ytsylv 'tkhm mydy
verses.translation: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

verses.original: וְ/עוֹד֙ דִּבְּר֣וּ עֲבָדָ֔י/ו עַל יְהוָ֖ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/עַ֖ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ עַבְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'vd dbrv 'bdyv 'l yhvh h'lhym v'l ychzqyhv 'bdv
verses.translation: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

verses.original: וּ/סְפָרִ֣ים כָּתַ֔ב לְ/חָרֵ֕ף לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֵֽ/אמֹ֨ר עָלָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֵּֽ/אלֹהֵ֞י גּוֹיֵ֤ הָ/אֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא הִצִּ֤ילוּ עַמָּ/ם֙ מִ/יָּדִ֔/י כֵּ֣ן לֹֽא יַצִּ֞יל אֱלֹהֵ֧י יְחִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ עַמּ֖/וֹ מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vsprym khtb lchrf lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l vl'mr 'lyv l'mr kh'lhy gvy h'rtsvt 'shr l' htsylv 'mm mydy khn l' ytsyl 'lhy ychzqyhv 'mv mydy
verses.translation: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְא֨וּ בְ/קוֹל גָּד֜וֹל יְהוּדִ֗ית עַל עַ֤ם יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַֽ/חוֹמָ֔ה לְ/יָֽרְאָ֖/ם וּֽ/לְ/בַהֲלָ֑/ם לְמַ֖עַן יִלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyqr'v bqvl gdvl yhvdyt 'l 'm yrvshlm 'shr 'l hchvmh lyr'm vlbhlm lm'n ylkhdv 't h'yr
verses.translation: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל אֱלֹהֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כְּ/עַ֗ל אֱלֹהֵי֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vydbrv 'l 'lhy yrvshlm kh'l 'lhy 'my h'rts m'shh ydy h'dm
verses.translation: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֞ל יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וִֽ/ישַֽׁעְיָ֧הוּ בֶן אָמ֛וֹץ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא עַל זֹ֑את וַֽ/יִּזְעֲק֖וּ הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vytpll ychzqyhv hmlkh vysh'yhv bn 'mvts hnby' 'l z't vyz'qv hshmym
verses.translation: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַ/יַּכְחֵ֞ד כָּל גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֨יִל֙ וְ/נָגִ֣יד וְ/שָׂ֔ר בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ בְּ/בֹ֨שֶׁת פָּנִ֜ים לְ/אַרְצ֗/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו ו/מ/יציא/ו וּ/מִֽ/יצִיאֵ֣י מֵעָ֔י/ו שָׁ֖ם הִפִּילֻ֥/הוּ בֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh ml'kh vykhchd khl gbvr chyl vngyd vshr bmchnh mlkh 'shvr vyshb bbsht pnym l'rtsv vyb' byt 'lhyv vmytsy'v vmytsy'y m'yv shm hpylhv bchrb
verses.translation: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹשַׁע֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶת יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ וְ/אֵ֣ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם מִ/יַּ֛ד סַנְחֵרִ֥יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר וּ/מִ/יַּד כֹּ֑ל וַֽ/יְנַהֲלֵ֖/ם מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyvsh' yhvh 't ychzqyhv v't yshby yrvshlm myd snchryb mlkh 'shvr vmyd khl vynhlm msbyb
verses.translation: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side.

verses.original: וְ֠/רַבִּים מְבִיאִ֨ים מִנְחָ֤ה לַ/יהוָה֙ לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּ/מִ֨גְדָּנ֔וֹת לִֽ/יחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּנַּשֵּׂ֛א לְ/עֵינֵ֥י כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם מֵ/אַֽחֲרֵי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vrbym mby'ym mnchh lyhvh lyrvshlm vmgdnvt lychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh vynsh' l'yny khl hgvym m'chry khn
verses.translation: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ עַד לָ/מ֑וּת וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ וּ/מוֹפֵ֖ת נָ֥תַן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bymym hhm chlh ychzqyhv 'd lmvt vytpll 'l yhvh vy'mr lv vmvpt ntn lv
verses.translation: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD : and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא כִ/גְמֻ֤ל עָלָי/ו֙ הֵשִׁ֣יב יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּ֥י גָבַ֖הּ לִבּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְהִ֤י עָלָי/ו֙ קֶ֔צֶף וְ/עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vl' khgml 'lyv hshyb ychzqyhv khy gbh lbv vyhy 'lyv qtsf v'l yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכָּנַ֤ע יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בְּ/גֹ֣בַהּ לִבּ֔/וֹ ה֖וּא וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/לֹא בָ֤א עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ קֶ֣צֶף יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/ימֵ֖י יְחִזְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vykhn' ychzqyhv bgbh lbv hv' vyshby yrvshlm vl' b' 'lyhm qtsf yhvh bymy ychzqyhv
verses.translation: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י לִֽ/יחִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ עֹ֥שֶׁר וְ/כָב֖וֹד הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְ/אֹֽצָר֣וֹת עָֽשָׂה ל֠/וֹ לְ/כֶ֨סֶף וּ/לְ/זָהָ֜ב וּ/לְ/אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֗ה וְ/לִ/בְשָׂמִים֙ וּ/לְ/מָ֣גִנִּ֔ים וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל כְּלֵ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy lychzqyhv 'shr vkhbvd hrbh m'd v'tsrvt 'shh lv lkhsf vlzhb vl'bn yqrh vlbshmym vlmgnym vlkhl khly chmdh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

verses.original: וּ/מִ֨סְכְּנ֔וֹת לִ/תְבוּאַ֥ת דָּגָ֖ן וְ/תִיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/יִצְהָ֑ר וְ/אֻֽרָוֺת֙ לְ/כָל בְּהֵמָ֣ה וּ/בְהֵמָ֔ה וַ/עֲדָרִ֖ים לָ/אֲוֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmskhnvt ltbv't dgn vtyrvsh vytshr v'rvt lkhl bhmh vbhmh v'drym l'vrvt
verses.translation: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

verses.original: וְ/עָרִים֙ עָ֣שָׂה ל֔/וֹ וּ/מִקְנֵה צֹ֥אן וּ/בָקָ֖ר לָ/רֹ֑ב כִּ֤י נָֽתַן ל/וֹ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים רְכ֖וּשׁ רַ֥ב מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v'rym 'shh lv vmqnh ts'n vbqr lrb khy ntn lv 'lhym rkhvsh rb m'd
verses.translation: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

verses.original: וְ/ה֣וּא יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ סָתַם֙ אֶת מוֹצָ֞א מֵימֵ֤י גִיחוֹן֙ הָֽ/עֶלְי֔וֹן וַֽ/יַּישְּׁרֵ֥/ם לְ/מַֽטָּה מַּעְרָ֖בָ/ה לְ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יַּצְלַ֥ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ/כָֽל מַעֲשֵֽׂ/הוּ
verses.translit: vhv' ychzqyhv stm 't mvts' mymy gychvn h'lyvn vyyshrm lmth m'rbh l'yr dvyd vytslch ychzqyhv bkhl m'shhv
verses.translation: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

verses.original: וְ/כֵ֞ן בִּ/מְלִיצֵ֣י שָׂרֵ֣י בָּבֶ֗ל הַֽ/מְשַׁלְּחִ֤ים עָלָי/ו֙ לִ/דְרֹ֗שׁ הַ/מּוֹפֵת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה בָ/אָ֔רֶץ עֲזָב֖/וֹ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְ/נַ֨סּוֹת֔/וֹ לָ/דַ֖עַת כָּל בִּ/לְבָבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhn bmlytsy shry bbl hmshlchym 'lyv ldrsh hmvpt 'shr hyh b'rts 'zbv h'lhym lnsvtv ld't khl blbbv
verses.translation: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ וַ/חֲסָדָ֑י/ו הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בַּ/חֲז֞וֹן יְשַֽׁעְיָ֤הוּ בֶן אָמוֹץ֙ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry ychzqyhv vchsdyv hnm khtvbym bchzvn ysh'yhv bn 'mvts hnby' 'l spr mlkhy yhvdh vyshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֨ב יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עִם אֲבֹתָ֗י/ו וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ/הוּ֮ בְּֽ/מַעֲלֵה֮ קִבְרֵ֣י בְנֵי דָוִיד֒ וְ/כָבוֹד֙ עָֽשׂוּ ל֣/וֹ בְ/מוֹת֔/וֹ כָּל יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb ychzqyhv 'm 'btyv vyqbrhv bm'lh qbry bny dvyd vkhbvd 'shv lv bmvtv khl yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm vymlkh mnshh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה שָׁנָ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְ/חָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shtym 'shrh shnh mnshh bmlkhv vchmshym vchmsh shnh mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/תֽוֹעֲבוֹת֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khtv'bvt hgvym 'shr hvrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֗שָׁב וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת הַ/בָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּ֖ץ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּח֤וֹת לַ/בְּעָלִים֙ וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ אֲשֵׁר֔וֹת וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ לְ/כָל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshb vybn 't hbmvt 'shr ntts ychzqyhv 'byv vyqm mzbchvt lb'lym vy'sh 'shrvt vyshtchv lkhl tsb' hshmym vy'bd 'tm
verses.translation: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.original: וּ/בָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּח֖וֹת בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם יִֽהְיֶה שְּׁמִ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vbnh mzbchvt bbyt yhvh 'shr 'mr yhvh byrvshlm yhyh shmy l'vlm
verses.translation: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD , whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְ/כָל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vybn mzbchvt lkhl tsb' hshmym bshty chtsrvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הוּא֩ הֶעֱבִ֨יר אֶת בָּנָ֤י/ו בָּ/אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/גֵ֣י בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם וְ/עוֹנֵ֤ן וְ/נִחֵשׁ֙ וְֽ/כִשֵּׁ֔ף וְ/עָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְ/יִדְּעוֹנִ֑י הִרְבָּ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַכְעִיסֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhv' h'byr 't bnyv b'sh bgy bn hnm v'vnn vnchsh vkhshf v'shh 'vb vyd'vny hrbh l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת פֶּ֥סֶל הַ/סֶּ֖מֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל דָּוִיד֙ וְ/אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔/וֹ בַּ/בַּ֨יִת הַ/זֶּ֜ה וּ/בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֨רְתִּי֙ מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י לְ/עֵילֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshm 't psl hsml 'shr 'shh bbyt h'lhym 'shr 'mr 'lhym 'l dvyd v'l shlmh bnv bbyt hzh vbyrvshlm 'shr bchrty mkhl shbty yshr'l 'shym 't shmy l'ylvm
verses.translation: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א אוֹסִ֗יף לְ/הָסִיר֙ אֶת רֶ֣גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/עַל֙ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתִּי לַ/אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם רַ֣ק אִם יִשְׁמְר֣וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔י/ם לְ/כָל הַ/תּוֹרָ֛ה וְ/הַֽ/חֻקִּ֥ים וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vl' 'vsyf lhsyr 't rgl yshr'l m'l h'dmh 'shr h'mdty l'btykhm rq 'm yshmrv l'shvt 't khl 'shr tsvytym lkhl htvrh vhchqym vhmshptym byd mshh
verses.translation: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּ֣תַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת רָ֔ע מִן הַ֨/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyt' mnshh 't yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm l'shvt r' mn hgvym 'shr hshmyd yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה וְ/אֶל עַמּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א הִקְשִֽׁיבוּ
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mnshh v'l 'mv vl' hqshybv
verses.translation: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֨א יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם אֶת שָׂרֵ֤י הַ/צָּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַ/יִּלְכְּד֥וּ אֶת מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה בַּ/חֹחִ֑ים וַ/יַּֽאַסְרֻ֨/הוּ֙ בַּֽ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַ/יּוֹלִיכֻ֖/הוּ בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb' yhvh 'lyhm 't shry htsb' 'shr lmlkh 'shvr vylkhdv 't mnshh bchchym vy'srhv bnchshtym vyvlykhhv bblh
verses.translation: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/הָצֵ֣ר ל֔/וֹ חִלָּ֕ה אֶת פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּכָּנַ֣ע מְאֹ֔ד מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhhtsr lv chlh 't pny yhvh 'lhyv vykhn' m'd mlpny 'lhy 'btyv
verses.translation: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֗י/ו וַ/יֵּעָ֤תֶר ל/וֹ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע תְּחִנָּת֔/וֹ וַ/יְשִׁיבֵ֥/הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְ/מַלְכוּת֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֣דַע מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֥וּא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vytpll 'lyv vy'tr lv vyshm' tchntv vyshybhv yrvshlm lmlkhvtv vyd' mnshh khy yhvh hv' h'lhym
verses.translation: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֡ן בָּנָ֣ה חוֹמָ֣ה חִֽיצוֹנָ֣ה לְ/עִיר דָּוִ֡יד מַעְרָבָ/ה֩ לְ/גִיח֨וֹן בַּ/נַּ֜חַל וְ/לָ/ב֨וֹא בְ/שַׁ֤עַר הַ/דָּגִים֙ וְ/סָבַ֣ב לָ/עֹ֔פֶל וַ/יַּגְבִּיהֶ֖/הָ מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם שָֽׂרֵי חַ֛יִל בְּ/כָל הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הַ/בְּצֻר֖וֹת בִּ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'chry khn bnh chvmh chytsvnh l'yr dvyd m'rbh lgychvn bnchl vlbv' bsh'r hdgym vsbb l'pl vygbyhh m'd vyshm shry chyl bkhl h'rym hbtsrvt byhvdh
verses.translation: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּסַר אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֨י הַ/נֵּכָ֤ר וְ/אֶת הַ/סֶּ֨מֶל֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/כָל הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֛ה בְּ/הַ֥ר בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ ח֥וּצָ/ה לָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vysr 't 'lhy hnkhr v't hsml mbyt yhvh vkhl hmzbchvt 'shr bnh bhr byt yhvh vbyrvshlm vyshlkh chvtsh l'yr
verses.translation: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD , and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD , and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

verses.original: ו/יכן וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּזְבַּ֣ח עָלָ֔י/ו זִבְחֵ֥י שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְ/תוֹדָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה לַ/עֲב֕וֹד אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhn vybn 't mzbch yhvh vyzbch 'lyv zbchy shlmym vtvdh vy'mr lyhvdh l'bvd 't yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And he repaired the altar of the LORD , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: אֲבָל֙ ע֣וֹד הָ/עָ֔ם זֹבְחִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמ֑וֹת רַ֖ק לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'bl 'vd h'm zbchym bbmvt rq lyhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁה֮ וּ/תְפִלָּת֣/וֹ אֶל אֱלֹהָי/ו֒ וְ/דִבְרֵי֙ הַֽ/חֹזִ֔ים הַֽ/מְדַבְּרִ֣ים אֵלָ֔י/ו בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּ֕/ם עַל דִּבְרֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry mnshh vtpltv 'l 'lhyv vdbry hchzym hmdbrym 'lyv bshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnm 'l dbry mlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: וּ/תְפִלָּת֣/וֹ וְ/הֵֽעָתֶר ל/וֹ֮ וְ/כָל חַטָּאת֣/וֹ וּ/מַעְל/וֹ֒ וְ/הַ/מְּקֹמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּנָ֨ה בָ/הֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ וְ/הֶעֱמִיד֙ הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֣ים וְ/הַ/פְּסִלִ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י הִכָּנְע֑/וֹ הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַ֖ל דִּבְרֵ֥י חוֹזָֽי
verses.translit: vtpltv vh'tr lv vkhl cht'tv vm'lv vhmqmvt 'shr bnh bhm bmvt vh'myd h'shrym vhpslym lpny hkhn'v hnm khtvbym 'l dbry chvzy
verses.translation: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֖/הוּ בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb mnshh 'm 'btyv vyqbrhv bytv vymlkh 'mvn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה אָמ֣וֹן בְּ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vshtym shnh 'mvn bmlkhv vshtym shnym mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑י/ו וּֽ/לְ/כָל הַ/פְּסִילִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֔י/ו זִבַּ֥ח אָמ֖וֹן וַ/יַּֽעַבְדֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh kh'shr 'shh mnshh 'byv vlkhl hpsylym 'shr 'shh mnshh 'byv zbch 'mvn vy'bdm
verses.translation: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א נִכְנַע֙ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כְּ/הִכָּנַ֖ע מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אָבִ֑י/ו כִּ֛י ה֥וּא אָמ֖וֹן הִרְבָּ֥ה אַשְׁמָֽה
verses.translit: vl' nkhn' mlpny yhvh khhkhn' mnshh 'byv khy hv' 'mvn hrbh 'shmh
verses.translation: And humbled not himself before the LORD , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשְׁר֤וּ עָלָי/ו֙ עֲבָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יְמִיתֻ֖/הוּ בְּ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqshrv 'lyv 'bdyv vymythv bbytv
verses.translation: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּוּ֙ עַם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/קֹּֽשְׁרִ֖ים עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָמ֑וֹן וַ/יַּמְלִ֧יכוּ עַם הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֶת יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vykhv 'm h'rts 't khl hqshrym 'l hmlkh 'mvn vymlykhv 'm h'rts 't y'shyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִ֖ים יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ/אַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shmvnh shnym y'shyhv bmlkhv vshlshym v'cht shnh mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/דַרְכֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י/ו וְ/לֹא סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאול
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh vylkh bdrkhy dvyd 'byv vl' sr ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה שָׁנִ֜ים לְ/מָלְכ֗/וֹ וְ/הוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ נַ֔עַר הֵחֵ֕ל לִ/דְר֕וֹשׁ לֵ/אלֹהֵ֖י דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י/ו וּ/בִ/שְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה הֵחֵל֙ לְ/טַהֵ֔ר אֶת יְהוּדָה֙ וִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִן הַ/בָּמוֹת֙ וְ/הָ֣/אֲשֵׁרִ֔ים וְ/הַ/פְּסִלִ֖ים וְ/הַ/מַּסֵּכֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbshmvnh shnym lmlkhv vhv' 'vdnv n'r hchl ldrvsh l'lhy dvyd 'byv vbshtym 'shrh shnh hchl lthr 't yhvdh vyrvshlm mn hbmvt vh'shrym vhpslym vhmskhvt
verses.translation: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַתְּצ֣וּ לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו אֵ֚ת מִזְבְּח֣וֹת הַ/בְּעָלִ֔ים וְ/הַֽ/חַמָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר לְ/מַ֥עְלָ/ה מֵ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם גִּדֵּ֑עַ וְ֠/הָ/אֲשֵׁרִים וְ/הַ/פְּסִלִ֤ים וְ/הַ/מַּסֵּכוֹת֙ שִׁבַּ֣ר וְ/הֵדַ֔ק וַ/יִּזְרֹק֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/קְּבָרִ֔ים הַ/זֹּבְחִ֖ים לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vynttsv lpnyv 't mzbchvt hb'lym vhchmnym 'shr lm'lh m'lyhm gd' vh'shrym vhpslym vhmskhvt shbr vhdq vyzrq 'l pny hqbrym hzbchym lhm
verses.translation: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

verses.original: וְ/עַצְמוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שָׂרַ֖ף עַל מזבחותים מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יְטַהֵ֥ר אֶת יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v'tsmvt khhnym shrf 'l mzbchvtym mzbchvtm vythr 't yhvdh v't yrvshlm
verses.translation: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה וְ/אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְ/שִׁמְע֖וֹן וְ/עַד נַפְתָּלִ֑י ב/הר בתי/הם בְּ/חַרְבֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vb'ry mnshh v'prym vshm'vn v'd nptly bhr btyhm bchrbtyhm sbyb
verses.translation: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַתֵּ֣ץ אֶת הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֗וֹת וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֤ים וְ/הַ/פְּסִלִים֙ כִּתַּ֣ת לְ/הֵדַ֔ק וְ/כָל הַֽ/חַמָּנִ֥ים גִּדַּ֖ע בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב לִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyntts 't hmzbchvt v't h'shrym vhpslym khtt lhdq vkhl hchmnym gd' bkhl 'rts yshr'l vyshb lyrvshlm
verses.translation: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ לְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ לְ/טַהֵ֥ר הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/הַ/בָּ֑יִת שָׁ֠לַח אֶת שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן אֲצַלְיָ֜הוּ וְ/אֶת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣הוּ שַׂר הָ/עִ֗יר וְ֠/אֵת יוֹאָ֤ח בֶּן יֽוֹאָחָז֙ הַ/מַּזְכִּ֔יר לְ/חַזֵּ֕ק אֶת בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbshnt shmvnh 'shrh lmlkhv lthr h'rts vhbyt shlch 't shpn bn 'tslyhv v't m'shyhv shr h'yr v't yv'ch bn yv'chz hmzkhyr lchzq 't byt yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֗וֹל וַֽ/יִּתְּנוּ֮ אֶת הַ/כֶּסֶף֮ הַ/מּוּבָ֣א בֵית אֱלֹהִים֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָסְפֽוּ הַ/לְוִיִּם֩ שֹׁמְרֵ֨י הַ/סַּ֜ף מִ/יַּ֧ד מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְ/אֶפְרַ֗יִם וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מִ/כָּל יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן ו/ישבי וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l chlqyhv hkhhn hgdvl vytnv 't hkhsf hmvb' byt 'lhym 'shr 'spv hlvym shmry hsf myd mnshh v'prym vmkhl sh'ryt yshr'l vmkhl yhvdh vbnymn vyshby vyshbv yrvshlm
verses.translation: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֗וּ עַל יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה הַ/מֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ אֹת֜/וֹ עוֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לִ/בְדּ֥וֹק וּ/לְ/חַזֵּ֖ק הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vytnv 'l yd 'shh hml'khh hmpqdym bbyt yhvh vytnv 'tv 'vshy hml'khh 'shr 'shym bbyt yhvh lbdvq vlchzq hbyt
verses.translation: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD , to repair and amend the house:

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֗וּ לֶ/חָֽרָשִׁים֙ וְ/לַ/בֹּנִ֔ים לִ/קְנוֹת֙ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב וְ/עֵצִ֖ים לַֽ/מְחַבְּר֑וֹת וּ/לְ/קָרוֹת֙ אֶת הַ/בָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁחִ֖יתוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytnv lchrshym vlbnym lqnvt 'bny mchtsb v'tsym lmchbrvt vlqrvt 't hbtym 'shr hshchytv mlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it , to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֜ה בַּ/מְּלָאכָ֗ה וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם מֻ֠פְקָדִים יַ֣חַת וְ/עֹבַדְיָ֤הוּ הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ מִן בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י וּ/זְכַרְיָ֧ה וּ/מְשֻׁלָּ֛ם מִן בְּנֵ֥י הַ/קְּהָתִ֖ים לְ/נַצֵּ֑חַ וְ/הַ֨/לְוִיִּ֔ם כָּל מֵבִ֖ין בִּ/כְלֵי שִֽׁיר
verses.translit: vh'nshym 'shym b'mvnh bml'khh v'lyhm mpqdym ycht v'bdyhv hlvym mn bny mrry vzkhryh vmshlm mn bny hqhtym lntsch vhlvym khl mbyn bkhly shyr
verses.translation: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל הַ/סַּבָּלִ֗ים וּֽ/מְנַצְּחִים֙ לְ/כֹל֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה מְלָאכָ֔ה לַ/עֲבוֹדָ֖ה וַ/עֲבוֹדָ֑ה וּ/מֵֽ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם סוֹפְרִ֥ים וְ/שֹׁטְרִ֖ים וְ/שׁוֹעֲרִֽים
verses.translit: v'l hsblym vmntschym lkhl 'shh ml'khh l'bvdh v'bvdh vmhlvym svprym vshtrym vshv'rym
verses.translation: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הוֹצִיאָ֣/ם אֶת הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף הַ/מּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מָצָא֙ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת סֵ֥פֶר תּֽוֹרַת יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vbhvtsy'm 't hkhsf hmvb' byt yhvh mts' chlqyhv hkhhn 't spr tvrt yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD , Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן חִלְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל שָׁפָ֣ן הַ/סּוֹפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן חִלְקִיָּ֛הוּ אֶת הַ/סֵּ֖פֶר אֶל שָׁפָֽן
verses.translit: vy'n chlqyhv vy'mr 'l shpn hsvpr spr htvrh mts'ty bbyt yhvh vytn chlqyhv 't hspr 'l shpn
verses.translation: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֨א שָׁפָ֤ן אֶת הַ/סֵּ֨פֶר֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֨שֶׁב ע֧וֹד אֶת הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ דָּבָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר נִתַּ֥ן בְּ/יַד עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: vyb' shpn 't hspr 'l hmlkh vyshb 'vd 't hmlkh dbr l'mr khl 'shr ntn byd 'bdykh hm 'shym
verses.translation: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it .

verses.original: וַ/יַּתִּ֕יכוּ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף הַ/נִּמְצָ֣א בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֑ה וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֗וּ/הוּ עַל יַד֙ הַ/מֻּפְקָדִ֔ים וְ/עַל יַ֖ד עוֹשֵׂ֥י הַ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vytykhv 't hkhsf hnmts' bbyt yhvh vytnvhv 'l yd hmpqdym v'l yd 'vshy hml'khh
verses.translation: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַ/סּוֹפֵר֙ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔/י חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָא ב֥/וֹ שָׁפָ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vygd shpn hsvpr lmlkh l'mr spr ntn ly chlqyhv hkhhn vyqr' bv shpn lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/תּוֹרָ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh 't dbry htvrh vyqr' 't bgdyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת חִלְקִיָּ֡הוּ וְ/אֶת אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁ֠פָן וְ/אֶת עַבְדּ֨וֹן בֶּן מִיכָ֜ה וְ/אֵ֣ת שָׁפָ֣ן הַ/סּוֹפֵ֗ר וְ/אֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 't chlqyhv v't 'chyqm bn shpn v't 'bdvn bn mykhh v't shpn hsvpr v't 'shyh 'bd hmlkh l'mr
verses.translation: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

verses.original: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֗/י וּ/בְעַד֙ הַ/נִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּ/בִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה עַל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/סֵּ֖פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א כִּֽי גְדוֹלָ֤ה חֲמַת יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּכָ֣ה בָ֔/נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא שָׁמְר֤וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּ/כָל הַ/כָּת֖וּב עַל הַ/סֵּ֥פֶר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: lkhv drshv 't yhvh b'dy vb'd hnsh'r byshr'l vbyhvdh 'l dbry hspr 'shr nmts' khy gdvlh chmt yhvh 'shr ntkhh bnv 'l 'shr l' shmrv 'bvtynv 't dbr yhvh l'shvt khkhl hkhtvb 'l hspr hzh
verses.translation: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD , to do after all that is written in this book.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַ/נְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן תוקהת תָּקְהַ֗ת בֶּן חַסְרָה֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַ/בְּגָדִ֔ים וְ/הִ֛יא יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ/מִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַ/יְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י/הָ כָּ/זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vylkh chlqyhv v'shr hmlkh 'l chldh hnby'h 'sht shlm bn tvqht tqht bn chsrh shvmr hbgdym vhy' yvshbt byrvshlm bmshnh vydbrv 'lyh khz't
verses.translation: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect .

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם כֹּה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'mrv l'ysh 'shr shlch 'tkhm 'ly
verses.translation: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה עַל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/עַל יוֹשְׁבָ֑י/ו אֵ֤ת כָּל הָ/אָלוֹת֙ הַ/כְּתוּב֣וֹת עַל הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָֽרְא֔וּ לִ/פְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny mby' r'h 'l hmqvm hzh v'l yvshbyv 't khl h'lvt hkhtvbvt 'l hspr 'shr qr'v lpny mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּ/נִי ו/יקטירו וַֽ/יְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֨עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔/נִי בְּ/כֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְדֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/תִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛/י בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: tcht 'shr 'zbvny vyqtyrv vyqtrv l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'ysny bkhl m'shy ydyhm vttkh chmty bmqvm hzh vl' tkhbh
verses.translation: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַ/שֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לִ/דְר֣וֹשׁ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: v'l mlkh yhvdh hshlch 'tkhm ldrvsh byhvh khh t'mrv 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hdbrym 'shr shm't
verses.translation: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD , so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;

verses.original: יַ֠עַן רַךְ לְבָ֨בְ/ךָ֜ וַ/תִּכָּנַ֣ע מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֗ים בְּ/שָׁמְעֲ/ךָ֤ אֶת דְּבָרָי/ו֙ עַל הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/עַל יֹ֣שְׁבָ֔י/ו וַ/תִּכָּנַ֣ע לְ/פָנַ֔/י וַ/תִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת בְּגָדֶ֖י/ךָ וַ/תֵּ֣בְךְּ לְ/פָנָ֑/י וְ/גַם אֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: y'n rkh lbbkh vtkhn' mlpny 'lhym bshm'kh 't dbryv 'l hmqvm hzh v'l yshbyv vtkhn' lpny vtqr' 't bgdykh vtbkh lpny vgm 'ny shm'ty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י אֹֽסִפְ/ךָ֜ אֶל אֲבֹתֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/נֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל קִבְרֹתֶי/ךָ֮ בְּ/שָׁלוֹם֒ וְ/לֹא תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא עַל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/עַל יֹשְׁבָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: hnny 'spkh 'l 'btykh vn'spt 'l qbrtykh bshlvm vl' tr'ynh 'ynykh bkhl hr'h 'shr 'ny mby' 'l hmqvm hzh v'l yshbyv vyshybv 't hmlkh dbr
verses.translation: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֕ף אֶת כָּל זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh vy'sf 't khl zqny yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית יְ֠הוָה וְ/כָל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְ/הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם מִ/גָּד֣וֹל וְ/עַד קָטָ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א בְ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֗ם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַ/בְּרִ֔ית הַ/נִּמְצָ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'l hmlkh byt yhvh vkhl 'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm vhkhhnym vhlvym vkhl h'm mgdvl v'd qtn vyqr' b'znyhm 't khl dbry spr hbryt hnmts' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And the king went up into the house of the LORD , and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֨ד הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ עַל עָמְד֗/וֹ וַ/יִּכְרֹ֣ת אֶֽת הַ/בְּרִית֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ לָ/לֶ֜כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְ/לִ/שְׁמ֤וֹר אֶת מִצְוֺתָי/ו֙ וְ/עֵֽדְוֺתָ֣י/ו וְ/חֻקָּ֔י/ו בְּ/כָל לְבָב֖/וֹ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/בְּרִ֔ית הַ/כְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל הַ/סֵּ֥פֶר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'md hmlkh 'l 'mdv vykhrt 't hbryt lpny yhvh llkht 'chry yhvh vlshmvr 't mtsvtyv v'dvtyv vchqyv bkhl lbbv vbkhl npshv l'shvt 't dbry hbryt hkhtvbym 'l hspr hzh
verses.translation: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֕ד אֵ֛ת כָּל הַ/נִּמְצָ֥א בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ/בְרִ֥ית אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'md 't khl hnmts' byrvshlm vbnymn vy'shv yshby yrvshlm khbryt 'lhym 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it . And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨סַר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ אֶת כָּל הַ/תּוֹעֵב֗וֹת מִֽ/כָּל הָ/אֲרָצוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֵ֗ד אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/נִּמְצָא֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַ/עֲב֖וֹד אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם כָּל יָמָ֕י/ו לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ מֵֽ/אַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vysr y'shyhv 't khl htv'bvt mkhl h'rtsvt 'shr lbny yshr'l vy'bd 't khl hnmts' byshr'l l'bvd 't yhvh 'lhyhm khl ymyv l' srv m'chry yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm
verses.translation: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. And all his days they departed not from following the LORD , the God of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ יֹאשִׁיָּ֧הוּ בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם פֶּ֖סַח לַ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַ/פֶּ֔סַח בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vy'sh y'shyhv byrvshlm psch lyhvh vyshchtv hpsch b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn
verses.translation: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֥ד הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים עַל מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֑/ם וַֽ/יְחַזְּקֵ֔/ם לַ/עֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'md hkhhnym 'l mshmrvtm vychzqm l'bvdt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD ,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לַ֠/לְוִיִּם ה/מבונים הַ/מְּבִינִ֨ים לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַ/קְּדוֹשִׁ֣ים לַ/יהוָ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ אֶת אֲרוֹן הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ בַּ֠/בַּיִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵין לָ/כֶ֥ם מַשָּׂ֖א בַּ/כָּתֵ֑ף עַתָּ֗ה עִבְדוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת עַמּ֥/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr llvym hmbvnym hmbynym lkhl yshr'l hqdvshym lyhvh tnv 't 'rvn hqdsh bbyt 'shr bnh shlmh bn dvyd mlkh yshr'l 'yn lkhm msh' bkhtf 'th 'bdv 't yhvh 'lhykhm v't 'mv yshr'l
verses.translation: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD , Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

verses.original: וְ/הָכִ֥ונוּ לְ/בֵית אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם כְּ/מַחְלְקוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם בִּ/כְתָ֗ב דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/בְ/מִכְתַּ֖ב שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhkhvnv lbyt 'bvtykhm khmchlqvtykhm bkhtb dvyd mlkh yshr'l vbmkhtb shlmh bnv
verses.translation: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

verses.original: וְ/עִמְד֣וּ בַ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ לִ/פְלֻגּוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽ/אָב֔וֹת לַ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/חֲלֻקַּ֥ת בֵּֽית אָ֖ב לַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: v'mdv bqdsh lplgvt byt h'bvt l'chykhm bny h'm vchlqt byt 'b llvym
verses.translation: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁחֲט֖וּ הַ/פָּ֑סַח וְ/הִתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ וְ/הָכִ֣ינוּ לַ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֔ם לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת כִּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vshchtv hpsch vhtqdshv vhkhynv l'chykhm l'shvt khdbr yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣רֶם יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ לִ/בְנֵ֪י הָ/עָ֟ם צֹ֞אן כְּבָשִׂ֣ים וּ/בְנֵֽי עִזִּים֮ הַ/כֹּ֣ל לַ/פְּסָחִים֒ לְ/כָל הַ/נִּמְצָ֗א לְ/מִסְפַּר֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּ/בָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה מֵ/רְכ֥וּשׁ הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyrm y'shyhv lbny h'm ts'n khbshym vbny 'zym hkhl lpschym lkhl hnmts' lmspr shlshym 'lf vbqr shlsht 'lpym 'lh mrkhvsh hmlkh
verses.translation: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king’s substance.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂרָ֞י/ו לִ/נְדָבָ֥ה לָ/עָ֛ם לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם הֵרִ֑ימוּ חִלְקִיָּ֨ה וּ/זְכַרְיָ֜הוּ וִֽ/יחִיאֵ֗ל נְגִידֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֞ים נָתְנ֣וּ לַ/פְּסָחִ֗ים אַלְפַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וּ/בָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshryv lndbh l'm lkhhnym vllvym hrymv chlqyh vzkhryhv vychy'l ngydy byt h'lhym lkhhnym ntnv lpschym 'lpym vshsh m'vt vbqr shlsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen.

verses.original: ו/כונניהו וְ֠/כָֽנַנְיָהוּ וּ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֨הוּ וּ/נְתַנְאֵ֜ל אֶחָ֗י/ו וַ/חֲשַׁבְיָ֧הוּ וִ/יעִיאֵ֛ל וְ/יוֹזָבָ֖ד שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם הֵרִ֨ימוּ לַ/לְוִיִּ֤ם לַ/פְּסָחִים֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/בָקָ֖ר חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vkhvnnyhv vkhnnyhv vshm'yhv vntn'l 'chyv vchshbyhv vy'y'l vyvzbd shry hlvym hrymv llvym lpschym chmsht 'lpym vbqr chmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle , and five hundred oxen.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכּ֖וֹן הָ/עֲבוֹדָ֑ה וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֨וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים עַל עָמְדָ֛/ם וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֥ם עַל מַחְלְקוֹתָ֖/ם כְּ/מִצְוַ֥ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vtkhvn h'bvdh vy'mdv hkhhnym 'l 'mdm vhlvym 'l mchlqvtm khmtsvt hmlkh
verses.translation: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
