verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ הַ/פָּ֑סַח וַ/יִּזְרְק֤וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ מִ/יָּדָ֔/ם וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם מַפְשִׁיטִֽים
verses.translit: vyshchtv hpsch vyzrqv hkhhnym mydm vhlvym mpshytym
verses.translation: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them .

verses.original: וַ/יָּסִ֨ירוּ הָ/עֹלָ֜ה לְ֠/תִתָּ/ם לְ/מִפְלַגּ֤וֹת לְ/בֵית אָבוֹת֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם לְ/הַקְרִיב֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה כַּ/כָּת֖וּב בְּ/סֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְ/כֵ֖ן לַ/בָּקָֽר
verses.translit: vysyrv h'lh lttm lmplgvt lbyt 'bvt lbny h'm lhqryb lyhvh khkhtvb bspr mshh vkhn lbqr
verses.translation: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD , as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְבַשְּׁל֥וּ הַ/פֶּ֛סַח בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ/הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֣ים בִּשְּׁל֗וּ בַּ/סִּיר֤וֹת וּ/בַ/דְּוָדִים֙ וּ/בַ/צֵּ֣לָח֔וֹת וַ/יָּרִ֖יצוּ לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vybshlv hpsch b'sh khmshpt vhqdshym bshlv bsyrvt vbdvdym vbtslchvt vyrytsv lkhl bny h'm
verses.translation: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֗ר הֵכִ֤ינוּ לָ/הֶם֙ וְ/לַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּ/הַֽעֲל֛וֹת הָ/עוֹלָ֥ה וְ/הַ/חֲלָבִ֖ים עַד לָ֑יְלָה וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: v'chr hkhynv lhm vlkhhnym khy hkhhnym bny 'hrn bh'lvt h'vlh vhchlbym 'd lylh vhlvym hkhynv lhm vlkhhnym bny 'hrn
verses.translation: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֨ים בְּנֵי אָסָ֜ף עַל מַעֲמָדָ֗/ם כְּ/מִצְוַ֤ת דָּוִיד֙ וְ/אָסָ֞ף וְ/הֵימָ֤ן וִֽ/ידֻתוּן֙ חוֹזֵ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים לְ/שַׁ֣עַר וָ/שָׁ֑עַר אֵ֣ין לָ/הֶ֗ם לָ/סוּר֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל עֲבֹֽדָתָ֔/ם כִּֽי אֲחֵי/הֶ֥ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhmshrrym bny 'sf 'l m'mdm khmtsvt dvyd v'sf vhymn vydtvn chvzh hmlkh vhsh'rym lsh'r vsh'r 'yn lhm lsvr m'l 'bdtm khy 'chyhm hlvym hkhynv lhm
verses.translation: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

verses.original: וַ֠/תִּכּוֹן כָּל עֲבוֹדַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הַ/פֶּ֔סַח וְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת עֹל֔וֹת עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/מִצְוַ֖ת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vtkhvn khl 'bvdt yhvh byvm hhv' l'shvt hpsch vh'lvt 'lvt 'l mzbch yhvh khmtsvt hmlkh y'shyhv
verses.translation: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD , according to the commandment of king Josiah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל הַֽ/נִּמְצְאִ֛ים אֶת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/אֶת חַ֥ג הַ/מַּצּ֖וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l hnmts'ym 't hpsch b't hhy' v't chg hmtsvt shb't ymym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא נַעֲשָׂ֨ה פֶ֤סַח כָּמֹ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/ימֵ֖י שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הַ/נָּבִ֑יא וְ/כָל מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל לֹֽא עָשׂ֡וּ כַּ/פֶּ֣סַח אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה יֹֽ֠אשִׁיָּהוּ וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֤ם וְ/כָל יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הַ/נִּמְצָ֔א וְ/יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vl' n'shh psch khmhv byshr'l mymy shmv'l hnby' vkhl mlkhy yshr'l l' 'shv khpsch 'shr 'shh y'shyhv vhkhhnym vhlvym vkhl yhvdh vyshr'l hnmts' vyvshby yrvshlm
verses.translation: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/מַלְכ֖וּת יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֖ה הַ/פֶּ֥סַח הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bshmvnh 'shrh shnh lmlkhvt y'shyhv n'shh hpsch hzh
verses.translation: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י כָל זֹ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵכִ֤ין יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת עָלָ֞ה נְכ֧וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֛יִם לְ/הִלָּחֵ֥ם בְּ/כַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ עַל פְּרָ֑ת וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א לִ/קְרָאת֖/וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: 'chry khl z't 'shr hkhyn y'shyhv 't hbyt 'lh nkhv mlkh mtsrym lhlchm bkhrkhmysh 'l prt vyts' lqr'tv y'shyhv
verses.translation: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֵלָ֣י/ו מַלְאָכִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹר֩ מַה לִּ֨/י וָ/לָ֜/ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה לֹא עָלֶ֨י/ךָ אַתָּ֤ה הַ/יּוֹם֙ כִּ֚י אֶל בֵּ֣ית מִלְחַמְתִּ֔/י וֵ/אלֹהִ֖ים אָמַ֣ר לְ/בַֽהֲלֵ֑/נִי חֲדַל לְ/ךָ֛ מֵ/אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר עִמִּ֖/י וְ/אַל יַשְׁחִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv ml'khym l'mr mh ly vlkh mlkh yhvdh l' 'lykh 'th hyvm khy 'l byt mlchmty v'lhym 'mr lbhlny chdl lkh m'lhym 'shr 'my v'l yshchytkh
verses.translation: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא הֵסֵב֩ יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ פָנָ֜י/ו מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ כִּ֤י לְ/הִלָּחֵֽם בּ/וֹ֙ הִתְחַפֵּ֔שׂ וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע אֶל דִּבְרֵ֥י נְכ֖וֹ מִ/פִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יָּבֹ֕א לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם בְּ/בִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹ
verses.translit: vl' hsb y'shyhv pnyv mmnv khy lhlchm bv htchpsh vl' shm' 'l dbry nkhv mpy 'lhym vyb' lhlchm bbq't mgdv
verses.translation: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּרוּ֙ הַ/יֹּרִ֔ים לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ לַ/עֲבָדָי/ו֙ הַעֲבִיר֔וּ/נִי כִּ֥י הָחֳלֵ֖יתִי מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyrv hyrym lmlkh y'shyhv vy'mr hmlkh l'bdyv h'byrvny khy hchlyty m'd
verses.translation: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲבִירֻ֨/הוּ עֲבָדָ֜י/ו מִן הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה וַֽ/יַּרְכִּיבֻ/הוּ֮ עַ֣ל רֶ֣כֶב הַ/מִּשְׁנֶה֮ אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֒ וַ/יּוֹלִיכֻ֨/הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יָּ֕מָת וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/קִבְר֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/כָל יְהוּדָה֙ וִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עַל יֹאשִׁיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vy'byrhv 'bdyv mn hmrkhbh vyrkhybhv 'l rkhb hmshnh 'shr lv vyvlykhhv yrvshlm vymt vyqbr bqbrvt 'btyv vkhl yhvdh vyrvshlm mt'blym 'l y'shyhv
verses.translation: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

verses.original: וַ/יְקוֹנֵ֣ן יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ עַל יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ כָֽל הַ/שָּׁרִ֣ים וְ֠/הַ/שָּׁרוֹת בְּ/קִינ֨וֹתֵי/הֶ֤ם עַל יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ עַד הַ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/יִּתְּנ֥וּ/ם לְ/חֹ֖ק עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הִנָּ֥/ם כְּתוּבִ֖ים עַל הַ/קִּינֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqvnn yrmyhv 'l y'shyhv vy'mrv khl hshrym vhshrvt bqynvtyhm 'l y'shyhv 'd hyvm vytnvm lchq 'l yshr'l vhnm khtvbym 'l hqynvt
verses.translation: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וַ/חֲסָדָ֑י/ו כַּ/כָּת֖וּב בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry y'shyhv vchsdyv khkhtvb btvrt yhvh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the LORD ,

verses.original: וּ/דְבָרָ֕י/ו הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vdbryv hr'shnym vh'chrnym hnm khtvbym 'l spr mlkhy yshr'l vyhvdh
verses.translation: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ עַם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֶת יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יַּמְלִיכֻ֥/הוּ תַֽחַת אָבִ֖י/ו בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqchv 'm h'rts 't yhv'chz bn y'shyhv vymlykhhv tcht 'byv byrvshlm
verses.translation: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.

verses.original: בֶּן שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה יוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shlvsh v'shrym shnh yv'chz bmlkhv vshlshh chdshym mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְסִירֵ֥/הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַֽ/יַּעֲנֹשׁ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר כֶּ֖סֶף וְ/כִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vysyrhv mlkh mtsrym byrvshlm vy'nsh 't h'rts m'h khkhr khsf vkhkhr zhb
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְלֵ֨ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֜יִם אֶת אֶלְיָקִ֣ים אָחִ֗י/ו עַל יְהוּדָה֙ וִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְ/אֶת יוֹאָחָ֤ז אָחִי/ו֙ לָקַ֣ח נְכ֔וֹ וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/הוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vymlkh mlkh mtsrym 't 'lyqym 'chyv 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm vysb 't shmv yhvyqym v't yv'chz 'chyv lqch nkhv vyby'hv mtsrymh
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ הָ/רַ֔ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh yhvyqym bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

verses.original: עָלָ֣י/ו עָלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַ/יַּֽאַסְרֵ֨/הוּ֙ בַּֽ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ/הֹלִיכ֖/וֹ בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: 'lyv 'lh nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl vy'srhv bnchshtym lhlykhv bblh
verses.translation: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/כְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֵבִ֥יא נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר לְ/בָבֶ֑ל וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/ם בְּ/הֵיכָל֖/וֹ בְּ/בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: vmkhly byt yhvh hby' nbvkhdn'tsr lbbl vytnm bhykhlv bbbl
verses.translation: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/יֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהֽוֹיָקִ֜ים וְ/תֹֽעֲבֹתָ֤י/ו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֙ וְ/הַ/נִּמְצָ֣א עָלָ֔י/ו הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhvyqym vt'btyv 'shr 'shh vhnmts' 'lyv hnm khtvbym 'l spr mlkhy yshr'l vyhvdh vymlkh yhvykhyn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁמוֹנֶ֤ה שָׁנִים֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ וַ/עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת יָמִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bn shmvnh shnym yhvykhyn bmlkhv vshlshh chdshym v'shrt ymym mlkh byrvshlm vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לִ/תְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֗ה שָׁלַח֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֔ר וַ/יְבִאֵ֣/הוּ בָבֶ֔לָ/ה עִם כְּלֵ֖י חֶמְדַּ֣ת בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּמְלֵךְ֙ אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָחִ֔י/ו עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vltshvbt hshnh shlch hmlkh nbvkhdn'tsr vyb'hv bblh 'm khly chmdt byt yhvh vymlkh 't tsdqyhv 'chyv 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְ/אַחַ֛ת שָׁנָ֖ה צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn 'shrym v'cht shnh tsdqyhv bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ הָ/רַ֔ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו לֹ֣א נִכְנַ֗ע מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֛י יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא מִ/פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh 'lhyv l' nkhn' mlpny yrmyhv hnby' mpy yhvh
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ֠/גַם בַּ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּר֙ מָרָ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבִּיע֖/וֹ בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יֶּ֤קֶשׁ אֶת עָרְפּ/וֹ֙ וַ/יְאַמֵּ֣ץ אֶת לְבָב֔/וֹ מִ/שּׁ֕וּב אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vgm bmlkh nbvkhdn'tsr mrd 'shr hshby'v b'lhym vyqsh 't 'rpv vy'mts 't lbbv mshvb 'l yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: גַּ֠ם כָּל שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְ/הָ/עָם֙ הִרְבּ֣וּ לִ/מְעָול מַ֔עַל כְּ/כֹ֖ל תֹּעֲב֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ/יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְדִּ֖ישׁ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: gm khl shry hkhhnym vh'm hrbv lm'vl m'l khkhl t'bvt hgvym vytm'v 't byt yhvh 'shr hqdysh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֡ח יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֧ם עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם בְּ/יַ֥ד מַלְאָכָ֖י/ו הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְ/שָׁל֑וֹחַ כִּֽי חָמַ֥ל עַל עַמּ֖/וֹ וְ/עַל מְעוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh 'lhy 'bvtyhm 'lyhm byd ml'khyv hshkhm vshlvch khy chml 'l 'mv v'l m'vnv
verses.translation: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֤וּ מַלְעִבִים֙ בְּ/מַלְאֲכֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/בוֹזִ֣ים דְּבָרָ֔י/ו וּ/מִֽתַּעְתְּעִ֖ים בִּ/נְבִאָ֑י/ו עַ֠ד עֲל֧וֹת חֲמַת יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/עַמּ֖/וֹ עַד לְ/אֵ֥ין מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: vyhyv ml'bym bml'khy h'lhym vbvzym dbryv vmt't'ym bnb'yv 'd 'lvt chmt yhvh b'mv 'd l'yn mrp'
verses.translation: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ כשדיים כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים וַ/יַּהֲרֹ֨ג בַּחוּרֵי/הֶ֤ם בַּ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית מִקְדָּשָׁ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א חָמַ֛ל עַל בָּח֥וּר וּ/בְתוּלָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְ/יָשֵׁ֑שׁ הַ/כֹּ֖ל נָתַ֥ן בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'l 'lyhm 't mlkh khshdyym khshdym vyhrg bchvryhm bchrb bbyt mqdshm vl' chml 'l bchvr vbtvlh zqn vyshsh hkhl ntn bydv
verses.translation: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.

verses.original: וְ֠/כֹל כְּלֵ֞י בֵּ֤ית הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ הַ/גְּדֹלִ֣ים וְ/הַ/קְּטַנִּ֔ים וְ/אֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֹצְר֥וֹת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/שָׂרָ֑י/ו הַ/כֹּ֖ל הֵבִ֥יא בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: vkhl khly byt h'lhym hgdlym vhqtnym v'tsrvt byt yhvh v'tsrvt hmlkh vshryv hkhl hby' bbl
verses.translation: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׂרְפוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַֽ/יְנַתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/כָל אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/כָל כְּלֵ֥י מַחֲמַדֶּ֖י/הָ לְ/הַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: vyshrpv 't byt h'lhym vynttsv 't chvmt yrvshlm vkhl 'rmnvtyh shrpv b'sh vkhl khly mchmdyh lhshchyt
verses.translation: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּ֛גֶל הַ/שְּׁאֵרִ֥ית מִן הַ/חֶ֖רֶב אֶל בָּבֶ֑ל וַֽ/יִּהְיוּ ל֤/וֹ וּ/לְ/בָנָי/ו֙ לַ/עֲבָדִ֔ים עַד מְלֹ֖ךְ מַלְכ֥וּת פָּרָֽס
verses.translit: vygl hsh'ryt mn hchrb 'l bbl vyhyv lv vlbnyv l'bdym 'd mlkh mlkhvt prs
verses.translation: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

verses.original: לְ/מַלֹּ֤אות דְּבַר יְהוָה֙ בְּ/פִ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ עַד רָצְתָ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתֶ֑י/הָ כָּל יְמֵ֤י הָשַּׁמָּ/ה֙ שָׁבָ֔תָה לְ/מַלֹּ֖אות שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: lml'vt dbr yhvh bpy yrmyhv 'd rtsth h'rts 't shbtvtyh khl ymy hshmh shbth lml'vt shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְ/כ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִ/כְל֥וֹת דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/פִ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת ר֨וּחַ֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס וַ/יַּֽעֲבֶר קוֹל֙ בְּ/כָל מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ וְ/גַם בְּ/מִכְתָּ֖ב לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vbshnt 'cht lkhvrsh mlkh prs lkhlvt dbr yhvh bpy yrmyhv h'yr yhvh 't rvch khvrsh mlkh prs vy'br qvl bkhl mlkhvtv vgm bmkhtb l'mr
verses.translation: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֞ר כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֗ס כָּל מַמְלְכ֤וֹת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ נָ֣תַן לִ֗/י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/הֽוּא פָקַ֤ד עָלַ/י֙ לִ/בְנֽוֹת ל֣/וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה מִֽי בָ/כֶ֣ם מִ/כָּל עַמּ֗/וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהָ֛י/ו עִמּ֖/וֹ וְ/יָֽעַל
verses.translit: khh 'mr khvrsh mlkh prs khl mmlkhvt h'rts ntn ly yhvh 'lhy hshmym vhv' pqd 'ly lbnvt lv byt byrvshlm 'shr byhvdh my bkhm mkhl 'mv yhvh 'lhyv 'mv vy'l
verses.translation: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְ/כ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִ/כְל֥וֹת דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה מִ/פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑ה הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת ר֨וּחַ֙ כֹּ֣רֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס וַ/יַּֽעֲבֶר קוֹל֙ בְּ/כָל מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ וְ/גַם בְּ/מִכְתָּ֖ב לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vbshnt 'cht lkhvrsh mlkh prs lkhlvt dbr yhvh mpy yrmyh h'yr yhvh 't rvch khrsh mlkh prs vy'br qvl bkhl mlkhvtv vgm bmkhtb l'mr
verses.translation: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֗ר כֹּ֚רֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס כֹּ֚ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ נָ֣תַן לִ֔/י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/הֽוּא פָקַ֤ד עָלַ/י֙ לִ/בְנֽוֹת ל֣/וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr khrsh mlkh prs khl mmlkhvt h'rts ntn ly yhvh 'lhy hshmym vhv' pqd 'ly lbnvt lv byt byrvshlm 'shr byhvdh
verses.translation: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

verses.original: מִֽי בָ/כֶ֣ם מִ/כָּל עַמּ֗/וֹ יְהִ֤י אֱלֹהָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/יַ֕עַל לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/יהוּדָ֑ה וְ/יִ֗בֶן אֶת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ה֥וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: my bkhm mkhl 'mv yhy 'lhyv 'mv vy'l lyrvshlm 'shr byhvdh vybn 't byt yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hv' h'lhym 'shr byrvshlm
verses.translation: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נִּשְׁאָ֗ר מִֽ/כָּל הַ/מְּקֹמוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ה֣וּא גָֽר שָׁם֒ יְנַשְּׂא֨וּ/הוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מְקֹמ֔/וֹ בְּ/כֶ֥סֶף וּ/בְ/זָהָ֖ב וּ/בִ/רְכ֣וּשׁ וּ/בִ/בְהֵמָ֑ה עִם הַ֨/נְּדָבָ֔ה לְ/בֵ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vkhl hnsh'r mkhl hmqmvt 'shr hv' gr shm ynsh'vhv 'nshy mqmv bkhsf vbzhb vbrkhvsh vbbhmh 'm hndbh lbyt h'lhym 'shr byrvshlm
verses.translation: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֜וּמוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/אָב֗וֹת לִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם לְ/כֹ֨ל הֵעִ֤יר הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת רוּח֔/וֹ לַ/עֲל֣וֹת לִ/בְנ֔וֹת אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqvmv r'shy h'bvt lyhvdh vbnymn vhkhhnym vhlvym lkhl h'yr h'lhym 't rvchv l'lvt lbnvt 't byt yhvh 'shr byrvshlm
verses.translation: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/כָל סְבִיבֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ חִזְּק֣וּ בִֽ/ידֵי/הֶ֔ם בִּ/כְלֵי כֶ֧סֶף בַּ/זָּהָ֛ב בָּ/רְכ֥וּשׁ וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה וּ/בַ/מִּגְדָּנ֑וֹת לְ/בַ֖ד עַל כָּל הִתְנַדֵּֽב
verses.translit: vkhl sbybtyhm chzqv bydyhm bkhly khsf bzhb brkhvsh vbbhmh vbmgdnvt lbd 'l khl htndb
verses.translation: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ כּ֔וֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִ֖יא אֶת כְּלֵ֣י בֵית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֤יא נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhmlkh khvrsh hvtsy' 't khly byt yhvh 'shr hvtsy' nbvkhdntsr myrvshlm vytnm bbyt 'lhyv
verses.translation: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD , which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

verses.original: וַ/יּֽוֹצִיאֵ֗/ם כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס עַל יַ֖ד מִתְרְדָ֣ת הַ/גִּזְבָּ֑ר וַֽ/יִּסְפְּרֵ/ם֙ לְ/שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֔ר הַ/נָּשִׂ֖יא לִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyvtsy'm khvrsh mlkh prs 'l yd mtrdt hgzbr vysprm lshshbtsr hnshy' lyhvdh
verses.translation: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִסְפָּרָ֑/ם אֲגַרְטְלֵ֨י זָהָ֜ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֗ים אֲגַרְטְלֵי כֶ֨סֶף֙ אָ֔לֶף מַחֲלָפִ֖ים תִּשְׁעָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: v'lh msprm 'grtly zhb shlshym 'grtly khsf 'lf mchlpym tsh'h v'shrym
verses.translation: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

verses.original: כְּפוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֔ים כְּפ֤וֹרֵי כֶ֨סֶף֙ מִשְׁנִ֔ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֑ה כֵּלִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: khpvry zhb shlshym khpvry khsf mshnym 'rb' m'vt v'shrh khlym 'chrym 'lf
verses.translation: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

verses.original: כָּל כֵּלִים֙ לַ/זָּהָ֣ב וְ/לַ/כֶּ֔סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת הַ/כֹּ֞ל הֶעֱלָ֣ה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֗ר עִ֚ם הֵעָל֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה מִ/בָּבֶ֖ל לִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khl khlym lzhb vlkhsf chmsht 'lpym v'rb' m'vt hkhl h'lh shshbtsr 'm h'lvt hgvlh mbbl lyrvshlm
verses.translation: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינָ֗ה הָֽ/עֹלִים֙ מִ/שְּׁבִ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶגְלָ֛ה נבוכדנצור נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל לְ/בָבֶ֑ל וַ/יָּשׁ֛וּבוּ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם וִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְ/עִירֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'lh bny hmdynh h'lym mshby hgvlh 'shr hglh nbvkhdntsvr nbvkhdntsr mlkh bbl lbbl vyshvbv lyrvshlm vyhvdh 'ysh l'yrv
verses.translation: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ עִם זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְ֠חֶמְיָה שְׂרָיָ֨ה רְֽעֵלָיָ֜ה מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפָּ֥ר בִּגְוַ֖י רְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'shr b'v 'm zrbbl yshv' nchmyh shryh r'lyh mrdkhy blshn mspr bgvy rchvm b'nh mspr 'nshy 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny pr'sh 'lpym m'h shb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny shptyh shlsh m'vt shb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְ/שִׁבְעִֽים
verses.translit: bny 'rch shb' m'vt chmshh vshb'ym
verses.translation: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִ/בְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ יוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: bny pcht mv'b lbny yshv' yv'b 'lpym shmnh m'vt vshnym 'shr
verses.translation: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny ztv' tsh' m'vt v'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: bny zkhy shb' m'vt vshshym
verses.translation: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny bny shsh m'vt 'rb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny bby shsh m'vt 'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny 'zgd 'lf m'tym 'shrym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny 'dnyqm shsh m'vt shshym vshshh
verses.translation: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny bgvy 'lpym chmshym vshshh
verses.translation: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'dyn 'rb' m'vt chmshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי אָטֵ֥ר לִֽ/יחִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'tr lychzqyh tsh'ym vshmnh
verses.translation: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny btsy shlsh m'vt 'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יוֹרָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה וּ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: bny yvrh m'h vshnym 'shr
verses.translation: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny chshm m'tym 'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גִבָּ֖ר תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny gbr tsh'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵֽית לָ֔חֶם מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny byt lchm m'h 'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: The children of Beth-lehem, an hundred twenty and three.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְטֹפָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'nshy ntph chmshym vshshh
verses.translation: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: 'nshy 'ntvt m'h 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny 'zmvt 'rb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת עָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּ/בְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny qryt 'rym khpyrh vb'rvt shb' m'vt v'rb'ym vshlshh
verses.translation: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י הָ/רָמָה֙ וָ/גָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: bny hrmh vgb' shsh m'vt 'shrym v'chd
verses.translation: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'nshy mkhms m'h 'shrym vshnym
verses.translation: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית אֵל֙ וְ/הָ/עָ֔י מָאתַ֖יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: 'nshy byt 'l vh'y m'tym 'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְב֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny nbv chmshym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מַגְבִּ֔ישׁ מֵאָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny mgbysh m'h chmshym vshshh
verses.translation: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'chr 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: bny chrm shlsh m'vt v'shrym
verses.translation: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

verses.original: בְּנֵי לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְ/אוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny ld chdyd v'vnv shb' m'vt 'shrym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֔וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny yrchv shlsh m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: bny sn'h shlsht 'lpym vshsh m'vt vshlshym
verses.translation: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.

verses.original: הַֽ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: hkhhnym bny yd'yh lbyt yshv' tsh' m'vt shb'ym vshlshh
verses.translation: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny 'mr 'lf chmshym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: bny pshchvr 'lf m'tym 'rb'ym vshb'h
verses.translation: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: bny chrm 'lf vshb'h 'shr
verses.translation: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

verses.original: הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵי יֵשׁ֧וּעַ וְ/קַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: hlvym bny yshv' vqdmy'l lbny hvdvyh shb'ym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.

verses.original: הַֽ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: hmshrrym bny 'sf m'h 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י הַ/שֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵי שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵי טַלְמ֣וֹן בְּנֵי עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י הַ/כֹּ֕ל מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/תִשְׁעָֽה
verses.translit: bny hsh'rym bny shlvm bny 'tr bny tlmvn bny 'qvb bny chtyt' bny shby hkhl m'h shlshym vtsh'h
verses.translation: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.

verses.original: הַ/נְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי צִיחָ֥א בְנֵי חֲשׂוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת
verses.translit: hntynym bny tsych' bny chshvp' bny tb'vt
verses.translation: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

verses.original: בְּנֵי קֵרֹ֥ס בְּֽנֵי סִֽיעֲהָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן
verses.translit: bny qrs bny sy'h' bny pdvn
verses.translation: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

verses.original: בְּנֵי לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י עַקּֽוּב
verses.translit: bny lbnh bny chgbh bny 'qvb
verses.translation: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

verses.original: בְּנֵי חָגָ֥ב בְּנֵי שמלי שַׁלְמַ֖י בְּנֵ֥י חָנָֽן
verses.translit: bny chgb bny shmly shlmy bny chnn
verses.translation: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,

verses.original: בְּנֵי גִדֵּ֥ל בְּנֵי גַ֖חַר בְּנֵ֥י רְאָיָֽה
verses.translit: bny gdl bny gchr bny r'yh
verses.translation: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

verses.original: בְּנֵי רְצִ֥ין בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י גַזָּֽם
verses.translit: bny rtsyn bny nqvd' bny gzm
verses.translation: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

verses.original: בְּנֵי עֻזָּ֥א בְנֵי פָסֵ֖חַ בְּנֵ֥י בֵסָֽי
verses.translit: bny 'z' bny psch bny bsy
verses.translation: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

verses.original: בְּנֵי אַסְנָ֥ה בְנֵי מעינים מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י נפיסים נְפוּסִֽים
verses.translit: bny 'snh bny m'ynym m'vnym bny npysym npvsym
verses.translation: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵי חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר
verses.translit: bny bqbvq bny chqvp' bny chrchvr
verses.translation: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בַצְל֥וּת בְּנֵי מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא
verses.translit: bny btslvt bny mchyd' bny chrsh'
verses.translation: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי תָֽמַח
verses.translit: bny brqvs bny sysr' bny tmch
verses.translation: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא
verses.translit: bny ntsych bny chtyp'
verses.translation: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי סֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי הַ/סֹּפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרוּדָֽא
verses.translit: bny 'bdy shlmh bny sty bny hsprt bny prvd'
verses.translation: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

verses.original: בְּנֵי יַעְלָ֥ה בְנֵי דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל
verses.translit: bny y'lh bny drqvn bny gdl
verses.translation: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמִֽי
verses.translit: bny shptyh bny chtyl bny pkhrt htsbyym bny 'my
verses.translation: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

verses.original: כָּ֨ל הַ/נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: khl hntynym vbny 'bdy shlmh shlsh m'vt tsh'ym vshnym
verses.translation: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה הָֽ/עֹלִים֙ מִ/תֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדָּ֖ן אִמֵּ֑ר וְ/לֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לְ/הַגִּ֤יד בֵּית אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/זַרְעָ֔/ם אִ֥ם מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם
verses.translit: v'lh h'lym mtl mlch tl chrsh' khrvb 'dn 'mr vl' ykhlv lhgyd byt 'bvtm vzr'm 'm myshr'l hm
verses.translation: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

verses.original: בְּנֵי דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵי טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny dlyh bny tvbyh bny nqvd' shsh m'vt chmshym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵי֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִ/בְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/יִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל שְׁמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vmbny hkhhnym bny chbyh bny hqvts bny brzly 'shr lqch mbnvt brzly hgl'dy 'shh vyqr' 'l shmm
verses.translation: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛/ם הַ/מִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְ/לֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑אוּ וַֽ/יְגֹאֲל֖וּ מִן הַ/כְּהֻנָּֽה
verses.translit: 'lh bqshv khtbm hmtychshym vl' nmts'v vyg'lv mn hkhhnh
verses.translation: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יֹאכְל֖וּ מִ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד כֹּהֵ֖ן לְ/אוּרִ֥ים וּ/לְ/תֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr htrsht' lhm 'shr l' y'khlv mqdsh hqdshym 'd 'md khhn l'vrym vltmym
verses.translation: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֖ל כְּ/אֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: khl hqhl kh'chd 'rb' rbv' 'lpym shlsh m'vt shshym
verses.translation: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

verses.original: מִ֠/לְּ/בַד עַבְדֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/אַמְהֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְ/לָ/הֶ֛ם מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וּֽ/מְשֹׁרְר֖וֹת מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: mlbd 'bdyhm v'mhtyhm 'lh shb't 'lpym shlsh m'vt shlshym vshb'h vlhm mshrrym vmshrrvt m'tym
verses.translation: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

verses.original: סוּסֵי/הֶ֕ם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֑ה פִּרְדֵי/הֶ֕ם מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: svsyhm shb' m'vt shlshym vshshh prdyhm m'tym 'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

verses.original: גְּמַ֨לֵּי/הֶ֔ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: gmlyhm 'rb' m'vt shlshym vchmshh chmrym shsht 'lpym shb' m'vt v'shrym
verses.translation: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/רָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽ/אָב֔וֹת בְּ/בוֹאָ֕/ם לְ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הִֽתְנַדְּבוּ֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְ/הַעֲמִיד֖/וֹ עַל מְכוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmr'shy h'bvt bbv'm lbyt yhvh 'shr byrvshlm htndbv lbyt h'lhym lh'mydv 'l mkhvnv
verses.translation: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:

verses.original: כְּ/כֹחָ֗/ם נָתְנוּ֮ לְ/אוֹצַ֣ר הַ/מְּלָאכָה֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שֵׁשׁ רִבֹּ֣אות וָ/אֶ֔לֶף וְ/כֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְ/כָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מֵאָֽה
verses.translit: khkhchm ntnv l'vtsr hml'khh zhb drkhmvnym shsh rb'vt v'lf vkhsf mnym chmsht 'lpym vkhtnt khhnym m'h
verses.translation: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠/הַ/לְוִיִּם וּֽ/מִן הָ/עָ֞ם וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְ/הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִ֛ים וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֖ים בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshbv hkhhnym vhlvym vmn h'm vhmshrrym vhshv'rym vhntynym b'ryhm vkhl yshr'l b'ryhm
verses.translation: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּע֙ הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּ/עָרִ֑ים וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyg' hchdsh hshby'y vbny yshr'l b'rym vy'spv h'm kh'ysh 'chd 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקָם֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וְ/אֶחָ֣י/ו הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּ/זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְ/אֶחָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּבְנ֕וּ אֶת מִזְבַּ֖ח אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/הַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָי/ו֙ עֹל֔וֹת כַּ/כָּת֕וּב בְּ/תוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֥ה אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyqm yshv' bn yvtsdq v'chyv hkhhnym vzrbbl bn sh'lty'l v'chyv vybnv 't mzbch 'lhy yshr'l lh'lvt 'lyv 'lvt khkhtvb btvrt mshh 'ysh h'lhym
verses.translation: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּכִ֤ינוּ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל מְכ֣וֹנֹתָ֔י/ו כִּ֚י בְּ/אֵימָ֣ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם מֵ/עַמֵּ֖י הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת ו/יעל וַ/יַּעֲל֨וּ עָלָ֤י/ו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה עֹל֖וֹת לַ/בֹּ֥קֶר וְ/לָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vykhynv hmzbch 'l mkhvntyv khy b'ymh 'lyhm m'my h'rtsvt vy'l vy'lv 'lyv 'lvt lyhvh 'lvt lbqr vl'rb
verses.translation: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD , even burnt offerings morning and evening.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת חַ֥ג הַ/סֻּכּ֖וֹת כַּ/כָּת֑וּב וְ/עֹלַ֨ת י֤וֹם בְּ/יוֹם֙ בְּ/מִסְפָּ֔ר כְּ/מִשְׁפַּ֖ט דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'shv 't chg hskhvt khkhtvb v'lt yvm byvm bmspr khmshpt dbr yvm byvmv
verses.translation: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֞ן עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ וְ/לֶ֣/חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּ/לְ/כָל מוֹעֲדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הַ/מְקֻדָּשִׁ֑ים וּ/לְ/כֹ֛ל מִתְנַדֵּ֥ב נְדָבָ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'chry khn 'lt tmyd vlchdshym vlkhl mv'dy yhvh hmqdshym vlkhl mtndb ndbh lyhvh
verses.translation: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: מִ/יּ֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י הֵחֵ֕לּוּ לְ/הַעֲל֥וֹת עֹל֖וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יֻסָּֽד
verses.translit: myvm 'chd lchdsh hshby'y hchlv lh'lvt 'lvt lyhvh vhykhl yhvh l' ysd
verses.translation: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD . But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid. was not yet founded

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨תְּנוּ כֶ֔סֶף לַ/חֹצְבִ֖ים וְ/לֶ/חָרָשִׁ֑ים וּ/מַאֲכָ֨ל וּ/מִשְׁתֶּ֜ה וָ/שֶׁ֗מֶן לַ/צִּֽדֹנִים֙ וְ/לַ/צֹּרִ֔ים לְ/הָבִיא֩ עֲצֵ֨י אֲרָזִ֤ים מִן הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ אֶל יָ֣ם יָפ֔וֹא כְּ/רִשְׁי֛וֹן כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרַ֖ס עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vytnv khsf lchtsbym vlchrshym vm'khl vmshth vshmn ltsdnym vltsrym lhby' 'tsy 'rzym mn hlbnvn 'l ym ypv' khrshyvn khvrsh mlkh prs 'lyhm
verses.translation: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗ית לְ/בוֹאָ֞/ם אֶל בֵּ֤ית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י הֵחֵ֡לּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל בֶּן שְׁ֠אַלְתִּיאֵל וְ/יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וּ/שְׁאָ֥ר אֲחֵי/הֶ֣ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם וְ/כָל הַ/בָּאִים֙ מֵ/הַ/שְּׁבִ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה לְ/נַצֵּ֖חַ עַל מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnh hshnyt lbv'm 'l byt h'lhym lyrvshlm bchdsh hshny hchlv zrbbl bn sh'lty'l vyshv' bn yvtsdq vsh'r 'chyhm hkhhnym vhlvym vkhl hb'ym mhshby yrvshlm vy'mydv 't hlvym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lntsch 'l ml'kht byt yhvh
verses.translation: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד יֵשׁ֡וּעַ בָּנָ֣י/ו וְ֠/אֶחָי/ו קַדְמִיאֵ֨ל וּ/בָנָ֤י/ו בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָה֙ כְּ/אֶחָ֔ד לְ/נַצֵּ֛חַ עַל עֹשֵׂ֥ה הַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּנֵי֙ חֵֽנָדָ֔ד בְּנֵי/הֶ֥ם וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'md yshv' bnyv v'chyv qdmy'l vbnyv bny yhvdh kh'chd lntsch 'l 'shh hml'khh bbyt h'lhym bny chndd bnyhm v'chyhm hlvym
verses.translation: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

verses.original: וְ/יִסְּד֥וּ הַ/בֹּנִ֖ים אֶת הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּעֲמִידוּ֩ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים מְלֻבָּשִׁ֜ים בַּ/חֲצֹֽצְר֗וֹת וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֤ם בְּנֵֽי אָסָף֙ בַּֽ/מְצִלְתַּ֔יִם לְ/הַלֵּל֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה עַל יְדֵ֖י דָּוִ֥יד מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vysdv hbnym 't hykhl yhvh vy'mydv hkhhnym mlbshym bchtstsrvt vhlvym bny 'sf bmtsltym lhll 't yhvh 'l ydy dvyd mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD , after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/יַּעֲנוּ בְּ/הַלֵּ֨ל וּ/בְ/הוֹדֹ֤ת לַֽ/יהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּֽי לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם חַסְדּ֖/וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֡ם הֵרִיעוּ֩ תְרוּעָ֨ה גְדוֹלָ֤ה בְ/הַלֵּל֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה עַ֖ל הוּסַ֥ד בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'nv bhll vbhvdt lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv 'l yshr'l vkhl h'm hry'v trv'h gdvlh bhll lyhvh 'l hvsd byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD ; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD , because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

verses.original: וְ/רַבִּ֡ים מֵ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּם֩ וְ/רָאשֵׁ֨י הָ/אָב֜וֹת הַ/זְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָא֜וּ אֶת הַ/בַּ֤יִת הָֽ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּ/יָסְד֔/וֹ זֶ֤ה הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם בֹּכִ֖ים בְּ/ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וְ/רַבִּ֛ים בִּ/תְרוּעָ֥ה בְ/שִׂמְחָ֖ה לְ/הָרִ֥ים קֽוֹל
verses.translit: vrbym mhkhhnym vhlvym vr'shy h'bvt hzqnym 'shr r'v 't hbyt hr'shvn bysdv zh hbyt b'ynyhm bkhym bqvl gdvl vrbym btrv'h bshmchh lhrym qvl
verses.translation: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ין הָ/עָ֗ם מַכִּירִים֙ ק֚וֹל תְּרוּעַ֣ת הַ/שִּׂמְחָ֔ה לְ/ק֖וֹל בְּכִ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם כִּ֣י הָ/עָ֗ם מְרִיעִים֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְ/הַ/קּ֥וֹל נִשְׁמַ֖ע עַד לְ/מֵ/רָחֽוֹק
verses.translit: v'yn h'm mkhyrym qvl trv't hshmchh lqvl bkhy h'm khy h'm mry'ym trv'h gdvlh vhqvl nshm' 'd lmrchvq
verses.translation: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֔וּ צָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּֽי בְנֵ֤י הַ/גּוֹלָה֙ בּוֹנִ֣ים הֵיכָ֔ל לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshm'v tsry yhvdh vbnymn khy bny hgvlh bvnym hykhl lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֨וּ אֶל זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְ/אֶל רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֗וֹת וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ נִבְנֶ֣ה עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם כִּ֣י כָ/כֶ֔ם נִדְר֖וֹשׁ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם ו/לא וְ/ל֣/וֹ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ זֹבְחִ֗ים מִ/ימֵי֙ אֵסַ֤ר חַדֹּן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר הַ/מַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖/נוּ פֹּֽה
verses.translit: vygshv 'l zrbbl v'l r'shy h'bvt vy'mrv lhm nbnh 'mkhm khy khkhm ndrvsh l'lhykhm vl' vlv 'nchnv zbchym mymy 'sr chdn mlkh 'shvr hm'lh 'tnv ph
verses.translation: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וְ/יֵשׁ֗וּעַ וּ/שְׁאָ֨ר רָאשֵׁ֤י הָֽ/אָבוֹת֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא לָ֣/כֶם וָ/לָ֔/נוּ לִ/בְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לֵ/אלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ כִּי֩ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ יַ֜חַד נִבְנֶ֗ה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔/נוּ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרָֽס
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm zrbbl vyshv' vsh'r r'shy h'bvt lyshr'l l' lkhm vlnv lbnvt byt l'lhynv khy 'nchnv ychd nbnh lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l kh'shr tsvnv hmlkh khvrsh mlkh prs
verses.translation: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ עַם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מְרַפִּ֖ים יְדֵ֣י עַם יְהוּדָ֑ה ו/מבלהים וּֽ/מְבַהֲלִ֥ים אוֹתָ֖/ם לִ/בְנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy 'm h'rts mrpym ydy 'm yhvdh vmblhym vmbhlym 'vtm lbnvt
verses.translation: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

verses.original: וְ/סֹכְרִ֧ים עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם יוֹעֲצִ֖ים לְ/הָפֵ֣ר עֲצָתָ֑/ם כָּל יְמֵ֗י כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס וְ/עַד מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרָֽס
verses.translit: vskhrym 'lyhm yv'tsym lhpr 'tstm khl ymy khvrsh mlkh prs v'd mlkhvt dryvsh mlkh prs
verses.translation: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/מַלְכוּת֙ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ בִּ/תְחִלַּ֖ת מַלְכוּת֑/וֹ כָּתְב֣וּ שִׂטְנָ֔ה עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vbmlkhvt 'chshvrvsh btchlt mlkhvtv khtbv shtnh 'l yshby yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/ימֵ֣י אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֗שְׂתָּא כָּתַ֨ב בִּשְׁלָ֜ם מִתְרְדָ֤ת טָֽבְאֵל֙ וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר כנות/ו כְּנָוֺתָ֔י/ו עַל ארתחששתא אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרָ֑ס וּ/כְתָב֙ הַֽ/נִּשְׁתְּוָ֔ן כָּת֥וּב אֲרָמִ֖ית וּ/מְתֻרְגָּ֥ם אֲרָמִֽית
verses.translit: vbymy 'rtchshsht' khtb bshlm mtrdt tb'l vsh'r khnvtv khnvtyv 'l 'rtchshsht' 'rtchshsht mlkh prs vkhtb hnshtvn khtvb 'rmyt vmtrgm 'rmyt
verses.translation: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

verses.original: רְח֣וּם בְּעֵל טְעֵ֗ם וְ/שִׁמְשַׁי֙ סָֽפְרָ֔/א כְּתַ֛בוּ אִגְּרָ֥ה חֲדָ֖ה עַל יְרוּשְׁלֶ֑ם לְ/אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֖/א כְּנֵֽמָא
verses.translit: rchvm b'l t'm vshmshy spr' khtbv 'grh chdh 'l yrvshlm l'rtchshsht' mlkh' khnm'
verses.translation: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

verses.original: אֱדַ֜יִן רְח֣וּם בְּעֵל טְעֵ֗ם וְ/שִׁמְשַׁי֙ סָֽפְרָ֔/א וּ/שְׁאָ֖ר כְּנָוָתְ/ה֑וֹן דִּ֠ינָיֵ/א וַ/אֲפַרְסַתְכָיֵ֞/א טַרְפְּלָיֵ֣/א אֲפָֽרְסָיֵ֗/א ארכוי אַרְכְּוָיֵ֤/א בָבְלָיֵ/א֙ שֽׁוּשַׁנְכָיֵ֔/א ד/הוא דֶּהָיֵ֖/א עֵלְמָיֵֽ/א
verses.translit: 'dyn rchvm b'l t'm vshmshy spr' vsh'r khnvthvn dyny' v'prstkhy' trply' 'prsy' 'rkhvy 'rkhvy' bbly' shvshnkhy' dhv' dhy' 'lmy'
verses.translation: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר אֻמַּיָּ֗/א דִּ֤י הַגְלִי֙ אָסְנַפַּר֙ רַבָּ֣/א וְ/יַקִּירָ֔/א וְ/הוֹתֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּ/קִרְיָ֖ה דִּ֣י שָׁמְרָ֑יִן וּ/שְׁאָ֥ר עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֖/ה וּ/כְעֶֽנֶת
verses.translit: vsh'r 'my' dy hgly 'snpr rb' vyqyr' vhvtb hmv bqryh dy shmryn vsh'r 'br nhrh vkh'nt
verses.translation: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

verses.original: דְּנָה֙ פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִגַּרְתָּ֔/א דִּ֚י שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֔וֹ/הִי עַל אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מַלְכָּ֑/א עַבְדָ֛י/ךְ אֱנָ֥שׁ עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֖/ה וּ/כְעֶֽנֶת
verses.translit: dnh prshgn 'grt' dy shlchv 'lvhy 'l 'rtchshsht' mlkh' 'bdykh 'nsh 'br nhrh vkh'nt
verses.translation: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

verses.original: יְדִ֨יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א דִּ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֗/א דִּ֤י סְלִ֨קוּ֙ מִן לְוָתָ֔/ךְ עֲלֶ֥י/נָא אֲת֖וֹ לִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם קִרְיְתָ֨/א מָֽרָדְתָּ֤/א ו/באישת/א וּ/בִֽישְׁתָּ/א֙ בָּנַ֔יִן ו/שורי וְ/שׁוּרַיָּ֣/א אשכללו שַׁכְלִ֔ילוּ וְ/אֻשַּׁיָּ֖/א יַחִֽיטוּ
verses.translit: ydy' lhv' lmlkh' dy yhvdy' dy slqv mn lvtkh 'lyn' 'tv lyrvshlm qryt' mrdt' vb'ysht' vbysht' bnyn vshvry vshvry' 'shkhllv shkhlylv v'shy' ychytv
verses.translation: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations.

verses.original: כְּעַ֗ן יְדִ֨יעַ֙ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְ/שׁוּרַיָּ֖/ה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן מִנְדָּֽה בְל֤וֹ וַ/הֲלָךְ֙ לָ֣א יִנְתְּנ֔וּן וְ/אַפְּתֹ֥ם מַלְכִ֖ים תְּהַנְזִֽק
verses.translit: kh'n ydy' lhv' lmlkh' dy hn qryt' dkh ttbn' vshvryh yshtkhllvn mndh blv vhlkh l' yntnvn v'ptm mlkhym thnzq
verses.translation: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.

verses.original: כְּעַ֗ן כָּ/ל קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי מְלַ֤ח הֵֽיכְלָ/א֙ מְלַ֔חְנָא וְ/עַרְוַ֣ת מַלְכָּ֔/א לָ֥א אֲֽרִֽיךְ לַ֖/נָא לְ/מֶֽחֱזֵ֑א עַ֨ל דְּנָ֔ה שְׁלַ֖חְנָא וְ/הוֹדַ֥עְנָא לְ/מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: kh'n khl qbl dy mlch hykhl' mlchn' v'rvt mlkh' l' 'rykh ln' lmchz' 'l dnh shlchn' vhvd'n' lmlkh'
verses.translation: Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

verses.original: דִּ֡י יְבַקַּר֩ בִּֽ/סְפַר דָּכְרָ֨נַיָּ֜/א דִּ֣י אֲבָהָתָ֗/ךְ וּ֠/תְהַשְׁכַּח בִּ/סְפַ֣ר דָּכְרָנַיָּ/א֮ וְ/תִנְדַּע֒ דִּי֩ קִרְיְתָ֨/א דָ֜ךְ קִרְיָ֣א מָֽרָדָ֗א וּֽ/מְהַנְזְקַ֤ת מַלְכִין֙ וּ/מְדִנָ֔ן וְ/אֶשְׁתַּדּוּר֙ עָבְדִ֣ין בְּ/גַוַּ֔/הּ מִן יוֹמָ֖ת עָלְמָ֑/א עַ֨ל דְּנָ֔ה קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָ֖ךְ הָֽחָרְבַֽת
verses.translit: dy ybqr bspr dkhrny' dy 'bhtkh vthshkhch bspr dkhrny' vtnd' dy qryt' dkh qry' mrd' vmhnzqt mlkhyn vmdnn v'shtdvr 'bdyn bgvh mn yvmt 'lm' 'l dnh qryt' dkh hchrbt
verses.translation: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.

verses.original: מְהוֹדְעִ֤ין אֲנַ֨חְנָה֙ לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/א דִּ֠י הֵ֣ן קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָךְ֙ תִּתְבְּנֵ֔א וְ/שׁוּרַיָּ֖/ה יִֽשְׁתַּכְלְל֑וּן לָ/קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָ֔ה חֲלָק֙ בַּ/עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔/א לָ֥א אִיתַ֖י לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: mhvd'yn 'nchnh lmlkh' dy hn qryt' dkh ttbn' vshvryh yshtkhllvn lqbl dnh chlq b'br nhr' l' 'yty lkh
verses.translation: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.

verses.original: פִּתְגָמָ֞/א שְׁלַ֣ח מַלְכָּ֗/א עַל רְח֤וּם בְּעֵל טְעֵם֙ וְ/שִׁמְשַׁ֣י סָֽפְרָ֔/א וּ/שְׁאָר֙ כְּנָוָ֣תְ/ה֔וֹן דִּ֥י יָתְבִ֖ין בְּ/שָֽׁמְרָ֑יִן וּ/שְׁאָ֧ר עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֛/ה שְׁלָ֖ם וּ/כְעֶֽת
verses.translit: ptgm' shlch mlkh' 'l rchvm b'l t'm vshmshy spr' vsh'r khnvthvn dy ytbyn bshmryn vsh'r 'br nhrh shlm vkh't
verses.translation: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.

verses.original: נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֕/א דִּ֥י שְׁלַחְתּ֖וּן עֲלֶ֑י/נָא מְפָרַ֥שׁ קֱרִ֖י קָדָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: nshtvn' dy shlchtvn 'lyn' mprsh qry qdmy
verses.translation: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.

verses.original: וּ/מִנִּ/י֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ וּ/בַקַּ֣רוּ וְ/הַשְׁכַּ֔חוּ דִּ֚י קִרְיְתָ֣/א דָ֔ךְ מִן יוֹמָת֙ עָֽלְמָ֔/א עַל מַלְכִ֖ין מִֽתְנַשְּׂאָ֑ה וּ/מְרַ֥ד וְ/אֶשְׁתַּדּ֖וּר מִתְעֲבֶד בַּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm vbqrv vhshkhchv dy qryt' dkh mn yvmt 'lm' 'l mlkhyn mtnsh'h vmrd v'shtdvr mt'bd bh
verses.translation: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְכִ֣ין תַּקִּיפִ֗ין הֲווֹ֙ עַל יְר֣וּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְ/שַׁ֨לִּיטִ֔ין בְּ/כֹ֖ל עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑/ה וּ/מִדָּ֥ה בְל֛וֹ וַ/הֲלָ֖ךְ מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְ/הֽוֹן
verses.translit: vmlkhyn tqypyn hvv 'l yrvshlm vshlytyn bkhl 'br nhrh vmdh blv vhlkh mtyhb lhvn
verses.translation: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.

verses.original: כְּעַן֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ טְּעֵ֔ם לְ/בַטָּלָ֖א גֻּבְרַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֑ךְ וְ/קִרְיְתָ֥/א דָךְ֙ לָ֣א תִתְבְּנֵ֔א עַד מִנִּ֖/י טַעְמָ֥/א יִתְּשָֽׂם
verses.translit: kh'n shymv t'm lbtl' gbry' 'lkh vqryt' dkh l' ttbn' 'd mny t'm' ytshm
verses.translation: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.

verses.original: וּ/זְהִירִ֥ין הֱו֛וֹ שָׁל֖וּ לְ/מֶעְבַּ֣ד עַל דְּנָ֑ה לְ/מָה֙ יִשְׂגֵּ֣א חֲבָלָ֔/א לְ/הַנְזָקַ֖ת מַלְכִֽין
verses.translit: vzhyryn hvv shlv lm'bd 'l dnh lmh yshg' chbl' lhnzqt mlkhyn
verses.translation: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן מִן דִּ֞י פַּרְשֶׁ֤גֶן נִשְׁתְּוָנָ/א֙ דִּ֚י ארתחששתא אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣שְׂתְּ מַלְכָּ֔/א קֱרִ֧י קֳדָם רְח֛וּם וְ/שִׁמְשַׁ֥י סָפְרָ֖/א וּ/כְנָוָתְ/ה֑וֹן אֲזַ֨לוּ בִ/בְהִיל֤וּ לִ/ירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ עַל יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔/א וּ/בַטִּ֥לוּ הִמּ֖וֹ בְּ/אֶדְרָ֥ע וְ/חָֽיִל
verses.translit: 'dyn mn dy prshgn nshtvn' dy 'rtchshsht' 'rtchshsht mlkh' qry qdm rchvm vshmshy spr' vkhnvthvn 'zlv bbhylv lyrvshlm 'l yhvdy' vbtlv hmv b'dr' vchyl
verses.translation: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֗יִן בְּטֵלַת֙ עֲבִידַ֣ת בֵּית אֱלָהָ֔/א דִּ֖י בִּ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וַ/הֲוָת֙ בָּֽטְלָ֔א עַ֚ד שְׁנַ֣ת תַּרְתֵּ֔ין לְ/מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרָֽס
verses.translit: b'dyn btlt 'bydt byt 'lh' dy byrvshlm vhvt btl' 'd shnt trtyn lmlkhvt dryvsh mlkh prs
verses.translation: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְנַבִּ֞י חַגַּ֣י נביא/ה נְבִיָּ֗/א וּ/זְכַרְיָ֤ה בַר עִדּוֹא֙ נביאי/א נְבִיַּיָּ֔/א עַל יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔/א דִּ֥י בִ/יה֖וּד וּ/בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּ/שֻׁ֛ם אֱלָ֥הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲלֵי/הֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhtnby chgy nby'h nby' vzkhryh br 'dv' nby'y' nbyy' 'l yhvdy' dy byhvd vbyrvshlm bshm 'lh yshr'l 'lyhvn
verses.translation: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֡יִן קָ֠מוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בַּר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְ/יֵשׁ֣וּעַ בַּר יֽוֹצָדָ֔ק וְ/שָׁרִ֣יו לְ/מִבְנֵ֔א בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְ/עִמְּ/ה֛וֹן נביאי/א נְבִיַּיָּ֥/א דִֽי אֱלָהָ֖/א מְסָעֲדִ֥ין לְ/הֽוֹן
verses.translit: b'dyn qmv zrbbl br sh'lty'l vyshv' br yvtsdq vshryv lmbn' byt 'lh' dy byrvshlm v'mhvn nby'y' nbyy' dy 'lh' ms'dyn lhvn
verses.translation: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.

verses.original: בֵּ/הּ זִמְנָ/א֩ אֲתָ֨א עֲלֵי/ה֜וֹן תַּ֠תְּנַי פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֛/ה וּ/שְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּ/כְנָוָתְ/ה֑וֹן וְ/כֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לְ/הֹ֔ם מַן שָׂ֨ם לְ/כֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤/א דְנָה֙ לִ/בְּנֵ֔א וְ/אֻשַּׁרְנָ֥/א דְנָ֖ה לְ/שַׁכְלָלָֽה
verses.translit: bh zmn' 't' 'lyhvn ttny pcht 'br nhrh vshtr bvzny vkhnvthvn vkhn 'mryn lhm mn shm lkhm t'm byt' dnh lbn' v'shrn' dnh lshkhllh
verses.translation: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

verses.original: אֱדַ֥יִן כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּ/הֹ֑ם מַן אִנּוּן֙ שְׁמָהָ֣ת גֻּבְרַיָּ֔/א דִּֽי דְנָ֥ה בִנְיָנָ֖/א בָּנַֽיִן
verses.translit: 'dyn khnm' 'mrn' lhm mn 'nvn shmht gbry' dy dnh bnyn' bnyn
verses.translation: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?

verses.original: וְ/עֵ֣ין אֱלָהֲ/הֹ֗ם הֲוָת֙ עַל שָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔/א וְ/לָא בַטִּ֣לוּ הִמּ֔וֹ עַד טַעְמָ֖/א לְ/דָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ יְהָ֑ךְ וֶ/אֱדַ֛יִן יְתִיב֥וּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֖/א עַל דְּנָֽה
verses.translit: v'yn 'lhhm hvt 'l shby yhvdy' vl' btlv hmv 'd t'm' ldryvsh yhkh v'dyn ytybvn nshtvn' 'l dnh
verses.translation: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .

verses.original: פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִ֠גַּרְתָּ/א דִּֽי שְׁלַ֞ח תַּתְּנַ֣י פַּחַ֣ת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֗/ה וּ/שְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּ/כְנָ֣וָתֵ֔/הּ אֲפַ֨רְסְכָיֵ֔/א דִּ֖י בַּ/עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑/ה עַל דָּרְיָ֖וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: prshgn 'grt' dy shlch ttny pcht 'br nhrh vshtr bvzny vkhnvth 'prskhy' dy b'br nhrh 'l dryvsh mlkh'
verses.translation: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:

verses.original: פִּתְגָמָ֖/א שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֑וֹ/הִי וְ/כִ/דְנָה֙ כְּתִ֣יב בְּ/גַוֵּ֔/הּ לְ/דָרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖/א שְׁלָמָ֥/א כֹֽלָּ/א
verses.translit: ptgm' shlchv 'lvhy vkhdnh khtyb bgvh ldryvsh mlkh' shlm' khl'
verses.translation: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.

verses.original: יְדִ֣יעַ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְ/מַלְכָּ֗/א דִּֽי אֲזַ֜לְנָא לִ/יה֤וּד מְדִֽינְתָּ/א֙ לְ/בֵית֙ אֱלָהָ֣/א רַבָּ֔/א וְ/ה֤וּא מִתְבְּנֵא֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּלָ֔ל וְ/אָ֖ע מִתְּשָׂ֣ם בְּ/כֻתְלַיָּ֑/א וַ/עֲבִ֥ידְתָּ/א דָ֛ךְ אָסְפַּ֥רְנָא מִתְעַבְדָ֖א וּ/מַצְלַ֥ח בְּ/יֶדְ/הֹֽם
verses.translit: ydy' lhv' lmlkh' dy 'zln' lyhvd mdynt' lbyt 'lh' rb' vhv' mtbn' 'bn gll v'' mtshm bkhtly' v'bydt' dkh 'sprn' mt'bd' vmtslch bydhm
verses.translation: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן שְׁאֵ֨לְנָא֙ לְ/שָׂבַיָּ֣/א אִלֵּ֔ךְ כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּ/הֹ֑ם מַן שָׂ֨ם לְ/כֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤/א דְנָה֙ לְ/מִבְנְיָ֔ה וְ/אֻשַּׁרְנָ֥/א דְנָ֖ה לְ/שַׁכְלָלָֽה
verses.translit: 'dyn sh'ln' lshby' 'lkh khnm' 'mrn' lhm mn shm lkhm t'm byt' dnh lmbnyh v'shrn' dnh lshkhllh
verses.translation: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

verses.original: וְ/אַ֧ף שְׁמָהָתְ/הֹ֛ם שְׁאֵ֥לְנָא לְּ/הֹ֖ם לְ/הוֹדָעוּתָ֑/ךְ דִּ֛י נִכְתֻּ֥ב שֻׁם גֻּבְרַיָּ֖/א דִּ֥י בְ/רָאשֵׁי/הֹֽם
verses.translit: v'f shmhthm sh'ln' lhm lhvd'vtkh dy nkhtb shm gbry' dy br'shyhm
verses.translation: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.

verses.original: וּ/כְנֵ֥מָא פִתְגָמָ֖/א הֲתִיב֣וּ/נָא לְ/מֵמַ֑ר אֲנַ֣חְנָא הִמּ֡וֹ עַבְדוֹ/הִי֩ דִֽי אֱלָ֨הּ שְׁמַיָּ֜/א וְ/אַרְעָ֗/א וּ/בָנַ֤יִן בַּיְתָ/א֙ דִּֽי הֲוָ֨א בְנֵ֜ה מִ/קַּדְמַ֤ת דְּנָה֙ שְׁנִ֣ין שַׂגִּיאָ֔ן וּ/מֶ֤לֶךְ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רַ֔ב בְּנָ֖/הִי וְ/שַׁכְלְלֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vkhnm' ptgm' htybvn' lmmr 'nchn' hmv 'bdvhy dy 'lh shmy' v'r'' vbnyn byt' dy hv' bnh mqdmt dnh shnyn shgy'n vmlkh lyshr'l rb bnhy vshkhllh
verses.translation: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.

verses.original: לָהֵ֗ן מִן דִּ֨י הַרְגִּ֤זוּ אֲבָהֳתַ֨/נָא֙ לֶ/אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔/א יְהַ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּ/יַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל כסדי/א כַּסְדָּאָ֑/ה וּ/בַיְתָ֤/ה דְנָה֙ סַתְרֵ֔/הּ וְ/עַמָּ֖/ה הַגְלִ֥י לְ/בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: lhn mn dy hrgzv 'bhtn' l'lh shmy' yhb hmv byd nbvkhdntsr mlkh bbl khsdy' khsd'h vbyth dnh strh v'mh hgly lbbl
verses.translation: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.

verses.original: בְּרַם֙ בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֔ה לְ/כ֥וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖/א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ/א֙ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֔ם בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥/א דְנָ֖ה לִ/בְּנֵֽא
verses.translit: brm bshnt chdh lkhvrsh mlkh' dy bbl khvrsh mlkh' shm t'm byt 'lh' dnh lbn'
verses.translation: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.

verses.original: וְ֠/אַף מָאנַיָּ֣/א דִֽי בֵית אֱלָהָ/א֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣/ה וְ/כַסְפָּ/א֒ דִּ֣י נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּק֙ מִן הֵֽיכְלָ/א֙ דִּ֣י בִֽ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְ/הֵיבֵ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹ לְ/הֵיכְלָ֖/א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל הַנְפֵּ֨ק הִמּ֜וֹ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗/א מִן הֵֽיכְלָ/א֙ דִּ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וִ/יהִ֨יבוּ֙ לְ/שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר שְׁמֵ֔/הּ דִּ֥י פֶחָ֖ה שָׂמֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'f m'ny' dy byt 'lh' dy dhbh vkhsp' dy nbvkhdntsr hnpq mn hykhl' dy byrvshlm vhybl hmv lhykhl' dy bbl hnpq hmv khvrsh mlkh' mn hykhl' dy bbl vyhybv lshshbtsr shmh dy pchh shmh
verses.translation: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַר לֵ֓/הּ אלה אֵ֚ל מָֽאנַיָּ֔/א שֵׂ֚א אֵֽזֶל אֲחֵ֣ת הִמּ֔וֹ בְּ/הֵיכְלָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּ/בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖/א יִתְבְּנֵ֥א עַל אַתְרֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mr lh 'lh 'l m'ny' sh' 'zl 'cht hmv bhykhl' dy byrvshlm vbyt 'lh' ytbn' 'l 'trh
verses.translation: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן֙ שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר דֵּ֔ךְ אֲתָ֗א יְהַ֧ב אֻשַּׁיָּ֛/א דִּי בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּ/מִן אֱדַ֧יִן וְ/עַד כְּעַ֛ן מִתְבְּנֵ֖א וְ/לָ֥א שְׁלִֽם
verses.translit: 'dyn shshbtsr dkh 't' yhb 'shy' dy byt 'lh' dy byrvshlm vmn 'dyn v'd kh'n mtbn' vl' shlm
verses.translation: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.

verses.original: וּ/כְעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן עַל מַלְכָּ֣/א טָ֗ב יִ֠תְבַּקַּר בְּ/בֵ֨ית גִּנְזַיָּ֜/א דִּי מַלְכָּ֣/א תַמָּה֮ דִּ֣י בְּ/בָבֶל֒ הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י דִּֽי מִן כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ/א֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְ/מִבְנֵ֛א בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥/א דֵ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּ/רְע֥וּת מַלְכָּ֛/א עַל דְּנָ֖ה יִשְׁלַ֥ח עֲלֶֽי/נָא
verses.translit: vkh'n hn 'l mlkh' tb ytbqr bbyt gnzy' dy mlkh' tmh dy bbbl hn 'yty dy mn khvrsh mlkh' shym t'm lmbn' byt 'lh' dkh byrvshlm vr'vt mlkh' 'l dnh yshlch 'lyn'
verses.translation: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

verses.original: בֵּ/אדַ֛יִן דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖/א שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֑ם וּ/בַקַּ֣רוּ בְּ/בֵ֣ית סִפְרַיָּ֗/א דִּ֧י גִנְזַיָּ֛/א מְהַחֲתִ֥ין תַּמָּ֖ה בְּ/בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: b'dyn dryvsh mlkh' shm t'm vbqrv bbyt spry' dy gnzy' mhchtyn tmh bbbl
verses.translation: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בְּ/אַחְמְתָ֗א בְּ/בִֽירְתָ֛/א דִּ֛י בְּ/מָדַ֥י מְדִינְתָּ֖/ה מְגִלָּ֣ה חֲדָ֑ה וְ/כֵן כְּתִ֥יב בְּ/גַוַּ֖/הּ דִּכְרוֹנָֽ/ה
verses.translit: vhshtkhch b'chmt' bbyrt' dy bmdy mdynth mglh chdh vkhn khtyb bgvh dkhrvnh
verses.translation: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת חֲדָ֜ה לְ/כ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗/א כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ/א֮ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵם֒ בֵּית אֱלָהָ֤/א בִֽ/ירוּשְׁלֶם֙ בַּיְתָ֣/א יִתְבְּנֵ֔א אֲתַר֙ דִּֽי דָבְחִ֣ין דִּבְחִ֔ין וְ/אֻשּׁ֖וֹ/הִי מְסֽוֹבְלִ֑ין רוּמֵ/הּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖/הּ אַמִּ֥ין שִׁתִּֽין
verses.translit: bshnt chdh lkhvrsh mlkh' khvrsh mlkh' shm t'm byt 'lh' byrvshlm byt' ytbn' 'tr dy dbchyn dbchyn v'shvhy msvblyn rvmh 'myn shtyn ptyh 'myn shtyn
verses.translation: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;

verses.original: נִדְבָּכִ֞ין דִּי אֶ֤בֶן גְּלָל֙ תְּלָתָ֔א וְ/נִדְבָּ֖ךְ דִּי אָ֣ע חֲדַ֑ת וְ/נִ֨פְקְתָ֔/א מִן בֵּ֥ית מַלְכָּ֖/א תִּתְיְהִֽב
verses.translit: ndbkhyn dy 'bn gll tlt' vndbkh dy '' chdt vnpqt' mn byt mlkh' ttyhb
verses.translation: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house:

verses.original: וְ֠/אַף מָאנֵ֣י בֵית אֱלָהָ/א֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣/ה וְ/כַסְפָּ/א֒ דִּ֣י נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּ֛ק מִן הֵיכְלָ֥/א דִי בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם וְ/הֵיבֵ֣ל לְ/בָבֶ֑ל יַהֲתִיב֗וּן וִ֠/יהָךְ לְ/הֵיכְלָ֤/א דִי בִ/ירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לְ/אַתְרֵ֔/הּ וְ/תַחֵ֖ת בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָֽ/א
verses.translit: v'f m'ny byt 'lh' dy dhbh vkhsp' dy nbvkhdntsr hnpq mn hykhl' dy byrvshlm vhybl lbbl yhtybvn vyhkh lhykhl' dy byrvshlm l'trh vtcht bbyt 'lh'
verses.translation: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.

verses.original: כְּעַ֡ן תַּ֠תְּנַי פַּחַ֨ת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֜/ה שְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּ/כְנָוָ֣תְ/ה֔וֹן אֲפַרְסְכָיֵ֔/א דִּ֖י בַּ/עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑/ה רַחִיקִ֥ין הֲו֖וֹ מִן תַּמָּֽה
verses.translit: kh'n ttny pcht 'br nhrh shtr bvzny vkhnvthvn 'prskhy' dy b'br nhrh rchyqyn hvv mn tmh
verses.translation: Now therefore , Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

verses.original: שְׁבֻ֕קוּ לַ/עֲבִידַ֖ת בֵּית אֱלָהָ֣/א דֵ֑ךְ פַּחַ֤ת יְהוּדָיֵ/א֙ וּ/לְ/שָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔/א בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥/א דֵ֖ךְ יִבְנ֥וֹן עַל אַתְרֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shbqv l'bydt byt 'lh' dkh pcht yhvdy' vlshby yhvdy' byt 'lh' dkh ybnvn 'l 'trh
verses.translation: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.

verses.original: וּ/מִנִּ/י֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ לְ/מָ֣א דִֽי תַֽעַבְד֗וּן עִם שָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵ/א֙ אִלֵּ֔ךְ לְ/מִבְנֵ֖א בֵּית אֱלָהָ֣/א דֵ֑ךְ וּ/מִ/נִּכְסֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֗/א דִּ֚י מִדַּת֙ עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔/ה אָסְפַּ֗רְנָא נִפְקְתָ֛/א תֶּהֱוֵ֧א מִֽתְיַהֲבָ֛א לְ/גֻבְרַיָּ֥/א אִלֵּ֖ךְ דִּי לָ֥א לְ/בַטָּלָֽא
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm lm' dy t'bdvn 'm shby yhvdy' 'lkh lmbn' byt 'lh' dkh vmnkhsy mlkh' dy mdt 'br nhrh 'sprn' npqt' thv' mtyhb' lgbry' 'lkh dy l' lbtl'
verses.translation: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.

verses.original: וּ/מָ֣ה חַשְׁחָ֡ן וּ/בְנֵ֣י תוֹרִ֣ין וְ/דִכְרִ֣ין וְ/אִמְּרִ֣ין לַ/עֲלָוָ֣ן לֶ/אֱלָ֪הּ שְׁמַיָּ֟/א חִנְטִ֞ין מְלַ֣ח חֲמַ֣ר וּ/מְשַׁ֗ח כְּ/מֵאמַ֨ר כָּהֲנַיָּ֤/א דִי בִ/ירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לֶהֱוֵ֨א מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְ/הֹ֛ם י֥וֹם בְּ/י֖וֹם דִּי לָ֥א שָׁלֽוּ
verses.translit: vmh chshchn vbny tvryn vdkhryn v'mryn l'lvn l'lh shmy' chntyn mlch chmr vmshch khm'mr khhny' dy byrvshlm lhv' mtyhb lhm yvm byvm dy l' shlv
verses.translation: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

verses.original: דִּֽי לֶהֱוֺ֧ן מְהַקְרְבִ֛ין נִיחוֹחִ֖ין לֶ/אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑/א וּ/מְצַלַּ֕יִן לְ/חַיֵּ֥י מַלְכָּ֖/א וּ/בְנֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: dy lhvn mhqrbyn nychvchyn l'lh shmy' vmtslyn lchyy mlkh' vbnvhy
verses.translation: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

verses.original: וּ/מִנִּ/י֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל אֱנָ֗שׁ דִּ֤י יְהַשְׁנֵא֙ פִּתְגָמָ֣/א דְנָ֔ה יִתְנְסַ֥ח אָע֙ מִן בַּיְתֵ֔/הּ וּ/זְקִ֖יף יִתְמְחֵ֣א עֲלֹ֑/הִי וּ/בַיְתֵ֛/הּ נְוָל֥וּ יִתְעֲבֵ֖ד עַל דְּנָֽה
verses.translit: vmny shym t'm dy khl 'nsh dy yhshn' ptgm' dnh ytnsch '' mn byth vzqyf ytmch' 'lhy vbyth nvlv yt'bd 'l dnh
verses.translation: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

verses.original: וֵֽ/אלָהָ֞/א דִּ֣י שַׁכִּ֧ן שְׁמֵ֣/הּ תַּמָּ֗ה יְמַגַּ֞ר כָּל מֶ֤לֶךְ וְ/עַם֙ דִּ֣י יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְדֵ֗/הּ לְ/הַשְׁנָיָ֛ה לְ/חַבָּלָ֛ה בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥/א דֵ֖ךְ דִּ֣י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם אֲנָ֤ה דָרְיָ֨וֶשׁ֙ שָׂ֣מֶת טְעֵ֔ם אָסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד
verses.translit: v'lh' dy shkhn shmh tmh ymgr khl mlkh v'm dy yshlch ydh lhshnyh lchblh byt 'lh' dkh dy byrvshlm 'nh dryvsh shmt t'm 'sprn' yt'bd
verses.translation: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן תַּתְּנַ֞י פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֛/ה שְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּ/כְנָוָתְ/ה֑וֹן לָ/קֳבֵ֗ל דִּֽי שְׁלַ֞ח דָּרְיָ֧וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֛/א כְּנֵ֖מָא אָסְפַּ֥רְנָא עֲבַֽדוּ
verses.translit: 'dyn ttny pcht 'br nhrh shtr bvzny vkhnvthvn lqbl dy shlch dryvsh mlkh' khnm' 'sprn' 'bdv
verses.translation: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵ/א֙ בָּנַ֣יִן וּ/מַצְלְחִ֔ין בִּ/נְבוּאַת֙ חַגַּ֣י נביא/ה נְבִיָּ֔/א וּ/זְכַרְיָ֖ה בַּר עִדּ֑וֹא וּ/בְנ֣וֹ וְ/שַׁכְלִ֗לוּ מִן טַ֨עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מִ/טְּעֵם֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ וְ/דָרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וְ/אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מֶ֥לֶךְ פָּרָֽס
verses.translit: vshby yhvdy' bnyn vmtslchyn bnbv't chgy nby'h nby' vzkhryh br 'dv' vbnv vshkhllv mn t'm 'lh yshr'l vmt'm khvrsh vdryvsh v'rtchshsht' mlkh prs
verses.translation: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo.
