And they builded, and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁיצִיא֙ בַּיְתָ֣/ה דְנָ֔ה עַ֛ד י֥וֹם תְּלָתָ֖ה לִ/ירַ֣ח אֲדָ֑ר דִּי הִ֣יא שְׁנַת שֵׁ֔ת לְ/מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vshytsy' byth dnh 'd yvm tlth lyrch 'dr dy hy' shnt sht lmlkhvt dryvsh mlkh'
verses.translation: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

verses.original: וַ/עֲבַ֣דוּ בְנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּ֨/א וְ/לֵוָיֵ֜/א וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר בְּנֵי גָלוּתָ֗/א חֲנֻכַּ֛ת בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥/א דְנָ֖ה בְּ/חֶדְוָֽה
verses.translit: v'bdv bny yshr'l khhny' vlvy' vsh'r bny glvt' chnkht byt 'lh' dnh bchdvh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

verses.original: וְ/הַקְרִ֗בוּ לַ/חֲנֻכַּת֮ בֵּית אֱלָהָ֣/א דְנָה֒ תּוֹרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה דִּכְרִ֣ין מָאתַ֔יִן אִמְּרִ֖ין אַרְבַּ֣ע מְאָ֑ה וּ/צְפִירֵ֨י עִזִּ֜ין ל/חטיא לְ/חַטָּאָ֤ה עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ תְּרֵֽי עֲשַׂ֔ר לְ/מִנְיָ֖ן שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhqrbv lchnkht byt 'lh' dnh tvryn m'h dkhryn m'tyn 'mryn 'rb' m'h vtspyry 'zyn lchty' lcht'h 'l khl yshr'l try 'shr lmnyn shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִ֨ימוּ כָהֲנַיָּ֜/א בִּ/פְלֻגָּתְ/ה֗וֹן וְ/לֵוָיֵ/א֙ בְּ/מַחְלְקָ֣תְ/ה֔וֹן עַל עֲבִידַ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖/א דִּ֣י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם כִּ/כְתָ֖ב סְפַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vhqymv khhny' bplgthvn vlvy' bmchlqthvn 'l 'bydt 'lh' dy byrvshlm khkhtb spr mshh
verses.translation: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵי הַ/גּוֹלָ֖ה אֶת הַ/פָּ֑סַח בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vy'shv bny hgvlh 't hpsch b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn
verses.translation: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִֽטַּהֲר֞וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם כְּ/אֶחָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֣/ם טְהוֹרִ֑ים וַ/יִּשְׁחֲט֤וּ הַ/פֶּ֨סַח֙ לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה וְ/לַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֥ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy hthrv hkhhnym vhlvym kh'chd khlm thvrym vyshchtv hpsch lkhl bny hgvlh vl'chyhm hkhhnym vlhm
verses.translation: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאכְל֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַ/שָּׁבִים֙ מֵֽ/הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה וְ/כֹ֗ל הַ/נִּבְדָּ֛ל מִ/טֻּמְאַ֥ת גּוֹיֵֽ הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם לִ/דְרֹ֕שׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'khlv bny yshr'l hshbym mhgvlh vkhl hnbdl mtm't gvy h'rts 'lhm ldrsh lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֧וּ חַג מַצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה כִּ֣י שִׂמְּחָ֣/ם יְהוָ֗ה וְֽ/הֵסֵ֞ב לֵ֤ב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם לְ/חַזֵּ֣ק יְדֵי/הֶ֔ם בִּ/מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'shv chg mtsvt shb't ymym bshmchh khy shmchm yhvh vhsb lb mlkh 'shvr 'lyhm lchzq ydyhm bml'kht byt h'lhym 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה בְּ/מַלְכ֖וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרָ֑ס עֶזְרָא֙ בֶּן שְׂרָיָ֔ה בֶּן עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן חִלְקִיָּֽה
verses.translit: v'chr hdbrym h'lh bmlkhvt 'rtchshst' mlkh prs 'zr' bn shryh bn 'zryh bn chlqyh
verses.translation: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.original: בֶּן שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן צָד֖וֹק בֶּן אֲחִיטֽוּב
verses.translit: bn shlvm bn tsdvq bn 'chytvb
verses.translation: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

verses.original: בֶּן אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בֶן עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן מְרָיֽוֹת
verses.translit: bn 'mryh bn 'zryh bn mryvt
verses.translation: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

verses.original: בֶּן זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בֶן עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן בֻּקִּֽי
verses.translit: bn zrchyh bn 'zy bn bqy
verses.translation: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

verses.original: בֶּן אֲבִישׁ֗וּעַ בֶּן פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הָ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: bn 'byshv' bn pynchs bn 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn hr'sh
verses.translation: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

verses.original: ה֤וּא עֶזְרָא֙ עָלָ֣ה מִ/בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/הֽוּא סֹפֵ֤ר מָהִיר֙ בְּ/תוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֣/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ כְּ/יַד יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָי/ו֙ עָלָ֔י/ו כֹּ֖ל בַּקָּשָׁתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hv' 'zr' 'lh mbbl vhv' spr mhyr btvrt mshh 'shr ntn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l vytn lv hmlkh khyd yhvh 'lhyv 'lyv khl bqshtv
verses.translation: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲל֣וּ מִ/בְּנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וּ/מִן הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֛ים וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֖ים אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בִּ/שְׁנַת שֶׁ֖בַע לְ/אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'lv mbny yshr'l vmn hkhhnym vhlvym vhmshrrym vhsh'rym vhntynym 'l yrvshlm bshnt shb' l'rtchshst' hmlkh
verses.translation: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֑י הִ֛יא שְׁנַ֥ת הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖ית לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyb' yrvshlm bchdsh hchmyshy hy' shnt hshby'yt lmlkh
verses.translation: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּ/אֶחָד֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן ה֣וּא יְסֻ֔ד הַֽ/מַּעֲלָ֖ה מִ/בָּבֶ֑ל וּ/בְ/אֶחָ֞ד לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֗י בָּ֚א אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּ/יַד אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו הַ/טּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy b'chd lchdsh hr'shvn hv' ysd hm'lh mbbl vb'chd lchdsh hchmyshy b' 'l yrvshlm khyd 'lhyv htvbh 'lyv
verses.translation: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֶזְרָא֙ הֵכִ֣ין לְבָב֔/וֹ לִ/דְר֛וֹשׁ אֶת תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לַ/עֲשֹׂ֑ת וּ/לְ/לַמֵּ֥ד בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֹ֥ק וּ/מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: khy 'zr' hkhyn lbbv ldrvsh 't tvrt yhvh vl'sht vllmd byshr'l chq vmshpt
verses.translation: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֣ה פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַֽ/נִּשְׁתְּוָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא לְ/עֶזְרָ֥א הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֑ר סֹפֵ֞ר דִּבְרֵ֧י מִצְוֺת יְהוָ֛ה וְ/חֻקָּ֖י/ו עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vzh prshgn hnshtvn 'shr ntn hmlkh 'rtchshst' l'zr' hkhhn hspr spr dbry mtsvt yhvh vchqyv 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD , and of his statutes to Israel.

verses.original: אַ֨רְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא מֶ֖לֶךְ מַלְכַיָּ֑/א לְ/עֶזְרָ֣א כָ֠הֲנָ/א סָפַ֨ר דָּתָ֜/א דִּֽי אֱלָ֧הּ שְׁמַיָּ֛/א גְּמִ֖יר וּ/כְעֶֽנֶת
verses.translit: 'rtchshst' mlkh mlkhy' l'zr' khhn' spr dt' dy 'lh shmy' gmyr vkh'nt
verses.translation: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace , and at such a time.

verses.original: מִנִּ/י֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל מִתְנַדַּ֣ב בְּ/מַלְכוּתִ/י֩ מִן עַמָּ֨/ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וְ/כָהֲנ֣וֹ/הִי וְ/לֵוָיֵ֗/א לִ/מְהָ֧ךְ לִֽ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֛ם עִמָּ֖/ךְ יְהָֽךְ
verses.translit: mny shym t'm dy khl mtndb bmlkhvty mn 'mh yshr'l vkhhnvhy vlvy' lmhkh lyrvshlm 'mkh yhkh
verses.translation: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּי֩ מִן קֳדָ֨ם מַלְכָּ֜/א וְ/שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָעֲטֹ֨/הִי֙ שְׁלִ֔יחַ לְ/בַקָּרָ֥א עַל יְה֖וּד וְ/לִֽ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּ/דָ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖/ךְ דִּ֥י בִ/ידָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khl qbl dy mn qdm mlkh' vshb't y'thy shlych lbqr' 'l yhvd vlyrvshlm bdt 'lhkh dy bydkh
verses.translation: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הֵיבָלָ֖ה כְּסַ֣ף וּ/דְהַ֑ב דִּֽי מַלְכָּ֣/א וְ/יָעֲט֗וֹ/הִי הִתְנַדַּ֨בוּ֙ לֶ/אֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דִּ֥י בִֽ/ירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם מִשְׁכְּנֵֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vlhyblh khsf vdhb dy mlkh' vy'tvhy htndbv l'lh yshr'l dy byrvshlm mshkhnh
verses.translation: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ כְּסַ֣ף וּ/דְהַ֔ב דִּ֣י תְהַשְׁכַּ֔ח בְּ/כֹ֖ל מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֑ל עִם֩ הִתְנַדָּב֨וּת עַמָּ֤/א וְ/כָֽהֲנַיָּ/א֙ מִֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ין לְ/בֵ֥ית אֱלָהֲ/הֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl khsf vdhb dy thshkhch bkhl mdynt bbl 'm htndbvt 'm' vkhhny' mtndbyn lbyt 'lhhm dy byrvshlm
verses.translation: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:

verses.original: כָּ/ל קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָה֩ אָסְפַּ֨רְנָא תִקְנֵ֜א בְּ/כַסְפָּ֣/א דְנָ֗ה תּוֹרִ֤ין דִּכְרִין֙ אִמְּרִ֔ין וּ/מִנְחָתְ/ה֖וֹן וְ/נִסְכֵּי/ה֑וֹן וּ/תְקָרֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ עַֽל מַדְבְּחָ֔/ה דִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהֲ/כֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִ/ירוּשְׁלֶֽם
verses.translit: khl qbl dnh 'sprn' tqn' bkhsp' dnh tvryn dkhryn 'mryn vmnchthvn vnskhyhvn vtqrb hmv 'l mdbchh dy byt 'lhkhm dy byrvshlm
verses.translation: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/מָ֣ה דִי֩ עלי/ך עֲלָ֨/ךְ וְ/עַל אחי/ך אֶחָ֜/ךְ יֵיטַ֗ב בִּ/שְׁאָ֛ר כַּסְפָּ֥/א וְ/דַהֲבָ֖/ה לְ/מֶעְבַּ֑ד כִּ/רְע֥וּת אֱלָהֲ/כֹ֖ם תַּעַבְדֽוּן
verses.translit: vmh dy 'lykh 'lkh v'l 'chykh 'chkh yytb bsh'r khsp' vdhbh lm'bd khr'vt 'lhkhm t'bdvn
verses.translation: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

verses.original: וּ/מָֽאנַיָּ/א֙ דִּֽי מִתְיַהֲבִ֣ין לָ֔/ךְ לְ/פָלְחָ֖ן בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֑/ךְ הַשְׁלֵ֕ם קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָ֥הּ יְרוּשְׁלֶֽם
verses.translit: vm'ny' dy mtyhbyn lkh lplchn byt 'lhkh hshlm qdm 'lh yrvshlm
verses.translation: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֗ר חַשְׁחוּת֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֔/ךְ דִּ֥י יִפֶּל לָ֖/ךְ לְ/מִנְתַּ֑ן תִּנְתֵּ֕ן מִן בֵּ֖ית גִּנְזֵ֥י מַלְכָּֽ/א
verses.translit: vsh'r chshchvt byt 'lhkh dy ypl lkh lmntn tntn mn byt gnzy mlkh'
verses.translation: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.

verses.original: וּ֠/מִנִּ/י אֲנָ֞ה אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מַלְכָּ/א֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְ/כֹל֙ גִּזַּֽבְרַיָּ֔/א דִּ֖י בַּ/עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑/ה דִּ֣י כָל דִּ֣י יִ֠שְׁאֲלֶנְ/כוֹן עֶזְרָ֨א כָהֲנָ֜/ה סָפַ֤ר דָּתָ/א֙ דִּֽי אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔/א אָסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד
verses.translit: vmny 'nh 'rtchshst' mlkh' shym t'm lkhl gzbry' dy b'br nhrh dy khl dy ysh'lnkhvn 'zr' khhnh spr dt' dy 'lh shmy' 'sprn' yt'bd
verses.translation: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

verses.original: עַד כְּסַף֮ כַּכְּרִ֣ין מְאָה֒ וְ/עַד חִנְטִין֙ כֹּרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְ/עַד חֲמַר֙ בַּתִּ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְ/עַד בַּתִּ֥ין מְשַׁ֖ח מְאָ֑ה וּ/מְלַ֖ח דִּי לָ֥א כְתָֽב
verses.translit: 'd khsf khkhryn m'h v'd chntyn khryn m'h v'd chmr btyn m'h v'd btyn mshch m'h vmlch dy l' khtb
verses.translation: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much .

verses.original: כָּל דִּ֗י מִן טַ֨עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔/א יִתְעֲבֵד֙ אַדְרַזְדָּ֔א לְ/בֵ֖ית אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑/א דִּֽי לְ/מָ֤ה לֶֽהֱוֵא֙ קְצַ֔ף עַל מַלְכ֥וּת מַלְכָּ֖/א וּ/בְנֽוֹ/הִי
verses.translit: khl dy mn t'm 'lh shmy' yt'bd 'drzd' lbyt 'lh shmy' dy lmh lhv' qtsf 'l mlkhvt mlkh' vbnvhy
verses.translation: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

verses.original: וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ם מְהוֹדְעִ֗ין דִּ֣י כָל כָּהֲנַיָּ֣/א וְ֠/לֵוָיֵ/א זַמָּ֨רַיָּ֤/א תָרָֽעַיָּ/א֙ נְתִ֣ינַיָּ֔/א וּ/פָ֣לְחֵ֔י בֵּ֖ית אֱלָהָ֣/א דְנָ֑ה מִנְדָּ֤ה בְלוֹ֙ וַ/הֲלָ֔ךְ לָ֥א שַׁלִּ֖יט לְ/מִרְמֵ֥א עֲלֵי/הֹֽם
verses.translit: vlkhm mhvd'yn dy khl khhny' vlvy' zmry' tr'y' ntyny' vplchy byt 'lh' dnh mndh blv vhlkh l' shlyt lmrm' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אַ֣נְתְּ עֶזְרָ֗א כְּ/חָכְמַ֨ת אֱלָהָ֤/ךְ דִּֽי בִ/ידָ/ךְ֙ מֶ֣נִּי שָׁפְטִ֞ין וְ/דַיָּנִ֗ין דִּי לֶהֱוֺ֤ן דאנין דָּאיְנִין֙ לְ/כָל עַמָּ/ה֙ דִּ֚י בַּ/עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔/ה לְ/כָל יָדְעֵ֖י דָּתֵ֣י אֱלָהָ֑/ךְ וְ/דִ֧י לָ֦א יָדַ֖ע תְּהוֹדְעֽוּן
verses.translit: v'nt 'zr' khchkhmt 'lhkh dy bydkh mny shptyn vdynyn dy lhvn d'nyn d'ynyn lkhl 'mh dy b'br nhrh lkhl yd'y dty 'lhkh vdy l' yd' thvd'vn
verses.translation: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.

verses.original: וְ/כָל דִּי לָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨א עָבֵ֜ד דָּתָ֣/א דִֽי אֱלָהָ֗/ךְ וְ/דָתָ/א֙ דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֔/א אָסְפַּ֕רְנָא דִּינָ֕/ה לֶהֱוֵ֥א מִתְעֲבֵ֖ד מִנֵּ֑/הּ הֵ֤ן לְ/מוֹת֙ הֵ֣ן ל/שרשו לִ/שְׁרֹשִׁ֔י הֵן לַ/עֲנָ֥שׁ נִכְסִ֖ין וְ/לֶ/אֱסוּרִֽין
verses.translit: vkhl dy l' lhv' 'bd dt' dy 'lhkh vdt' dy mlkh' 'sprn' dynh lhv' mt'bd mnh hn lmvt hn lshrshv lshrshy hn l'nsh nkhsyn vl'svryn
verses.translation: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵ֑י/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן כָּ/זֹאת֙ בְּ/לֵ֣ב הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/פָאֵ֕ר אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'lhy 'bvtynv 'shr ntn khz't blb hmlkh lp'r 't byt yhvh 'shr byrvshlm
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:

verses.original: וְ/עָלַ֣/י הִטָּה חֶ֗סֶד לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/יֽוֹעֲצָ֔י/ו וּ/לְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֑ים וַ/אֲנִ֣י הִתְחַזַּ֗קְתִּי כְּ/יַד יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַ/י֙ עָלַ֔/י וָ/אֶקְבְּצָ֧/ה מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֛ל רָאשִׁ֖ים לַ/עֲל֥וֹת עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ly hth chsd lpny hmlkh vyv'tsyv vlkhl shry hmlkh hgbrym v'ny htchzqty khyd yhvh 'lhy 'ly v'qbtsh myshr'l r'shym l'lvt 'my
verses.translation: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אֲבֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/הִתְיַחְשָׂ֑/ם הָ/עֹלִ֣ים עִמִּ֗/י בְּ/מַלְכ֛וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מִ/בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy 'btyhm vhtychshm h'lym 'my bmlkhvt 'rtchshst' hmlkh mbbl
verses.translation: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֤י פִֽינְחָס֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם מִ/בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר דָּנִיֵּ֑אל מִ/בְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד חַטּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: mbny pynchs grshm mbny 'ytmr dny'l mbny dvyd chtvsh
verses.translation: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֣י שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה מִ/בְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖שׁ זְכַרְיָ֑ה וְ/עִמּ֛/וֹ הִתְיַחֵ֥שׂ לִ/זְכָרִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: mbny shkhnyh mbny pr'sh zkhryh v'mv htychsh lzkhrym m'h vchmshym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵי֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְיְהֽוֹעֵינַ֖י בֶּן זְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: mbny pcht mv'b 'lyhv'yny bn zrchyh v'mv m'tym hzkhrym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן יַחֲזִיאֵ֑ל וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: mbny shkhnyh bn ychzy'l v'mv shlsh m'vt hzkhrym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין עֶ֖בֶד בֶּן יוֹנָתָ֑ן וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny 'dyn 'bd bn yvntn v'mv chmshym hzkhrym
verses.translation: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה בֶּן עֲתַלְיָ֑ה וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny 'ylm ysh'yh bn 'tlyh v'mv shb'ym hzkhrym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה זְבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן מִֽיכָאֵ֑ל וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ שְׁמֹנִ֥ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny shptyh zbdyh bn mykh'l v'mv shmnym hzkhrym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן יְחִיאֵ֑ל וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ מָאתַ֛יִם וּ/שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: mbny yv'b 'bdyh bn ychy'l v'mv m'tym vshmnh 'shr hzkhrym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֥י שְׁלוֹמִ֖ית בֶּן יוֹסִפְיָ֑ה וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֖ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny shlvmyt bn yvspyh v'mv m'h vshshym hzkhrym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י בֵבַ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן בֵּבָ֑י וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָ֖ה הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny bby zkhryh bn bby v'mv 'shrym vshmnh hzkhrym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד יוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן הַ/קָּטָ֑ן וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֖ה הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny 'zgd yvchnn bn hqtn v'mv m'h v'shrh hzkhrym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִיקָם֮ אַחֲרֹנִים֒ וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔/ם אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט יְעִיאֵ֣ל וּֽ/שְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny 'dnyqm 'chrnym v'lh shmvtm 'lyplt y'y'l vshm'yh v'mhm shshym hzkhrym
verses.translation: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֥י בִגְוַ֖י עוּתַ֣י ו/זבוד וְ/זַכּ֑וּר וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַ/זְּכָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmbny bgvy 'vty vzbvd vzkhvr v'mv shb'ym hzkhrym
verses.translation: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶקְבְּצֵ֗/ם אֶל הַ/נָּהָר֙ הַ/בָּ֣א אֶֽל אַהֲוָ֔א וַ/נַּחֲנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֣ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וָ/אָבִ֤ינָ/ה בָ/עָם֙ וּ/בַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י לֹא מָצָ֥אתִי שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'qbtsm 'l hnhr hb' 'l 'hv' vnchnh shm ymym shlshh v'bynh b'm vbkhhnym vmbny lvy l' mts'ty shm
verses.translation: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלְחָ֡/ה לֶ/אֱלִיעֶ֡זֶר לַ/אֲרִיאֵ֡ל לִֽ֠/שְׁמַעְיָה וּ/לְ/אֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּ/לְ/יָרִ֜יב וּ/לְ/אֶלְנָתָ֧ן וּ/לְ/נָתָ֛ן וְ/לִ/זְכַרְיָ֥ה וְ/לִ/מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים וּ/לְ/יוֹיָרִ֥יב וּ/לְ/אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מְבִינִֽים
verses.translit: v'shlchh l'ly'zr l'ry'l lshm'yh vl'lntn vlyryb vl'lntn vlntn vlzkhryh vlmshlm r'shym vlyvyryb vl'lntn mbynym
verses.translation: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

verses.original: ו/אוצא/ה וָ/אֲצַוֶּ֤ה אוֹתָ/ם֙ עַל אִדּ֣וֹ הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ בְּ/כָסִפְיָ֖א הַ/מָּק֑וֹם וָ/אָשִׂימָ/ה֩ בְּ/פִי/הֶ֨ם דְּבָרִ֜ים לְ֠/דַבֵּר אֶל אִדּ֨וֹ אָחִ֤י/ו ה/נתונים הַ/נְּתִינִים֙ בְּ/כָסִפְיָ֣א הַ/מָּק֔וֹם לְ/הָֽבִיא לָ֥/נוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים לְ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'vts'h v'tsvh 'vtm 'l 'dv hr'sh bkhspy' hmqvm v'shymh bpyhm dbrym ldbr 'l 'dv 'chyv hntvnym hntynym bkhspy' hmqvm lhby' lnv mshrtym lbyt 'lhynv
verses.translation: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֨יאּוּ לָ֜/נוּ כְּ/יַד אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ הַ/טּוֹבָ֤ה עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ שֶׂ֔כֶל מִ/בְּנֵ֣י מַחְלִ֔י בֶּן לֵוִ֖י בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֛ה וּ/בָנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vyby'v lnv khyd 'lhynv htvbh 'lynv 'ysh shkhl mbny mchly bn lvy bn yshr'l vshrbyh vbnyv v'chyv shmnh 'shr
verses.translation: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְ/אִתּ֥/וֹ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה מִ/בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֶחָ֥י/ו וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: v't chshbyh v'tv ysh'yh mbny mrry 'chyv vbnyhm 'shrym
verses.translation: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/נְּתִינִ֗ים שֶׁ/נָּתַ֨ן דָּוִ֤יד וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ לַ/עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם נְתִינִ֖ים מָאתַ֣יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֖/ם נִקְּב֥וּ בְ/שֵׁמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmn hntynym shntn dvyd vhshrym l'bdt hlvym ntynym m'tym v'shrym khlm nqbv bshmvt
verses.translation: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקְרָ֨א שָׁ֥ם צוֹם֙ עַל הַ/נָּהָ֣ר אַהֲוָ֔א לְ/הִתְעַנּ֖וֹת לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לְ/בַקֵּ֤שׁ מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֔ה לָ֥/נוּ וּ/לְ/טַפֵּ֖/נוּ וּ/לְ/כָל רְכוּשֵֽׁ/נוּ
verses.translit: v'qr' shm tsvm 'l hnhr 'hv' lht'nvt lpny 'lhynv lbqsh mmnv drkh yshrh lnv vltpnv vlkhl rkhvshnv
verses.translation: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֹ֗שְׁתִּי לִ/שְׁא֤וֹל מִן הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חַ֣יִל וּ/פָרָשִׁ֔ים לְ/עָזְרֵ֥/נוּ מֵ/אוֹיֵ֖ב בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ כִּֽי אָמַ֨רְנוּ לַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר יַד אֱלֹהֵ֤י/נוּ עַל כָּל מְבַקְשָׁי/ו֙ לְ/טוֹבָ֔ה וְ/עֻזּ֣/וֹ וְ/אַפּ֔/וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל עֹזְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy bshty lsh'vl mn hmlkh chyl vprshym l'zrnv m'vyb bdrkh khy 'mrnv lmlkh l'mr yd 'lhynv 'l khl mbqshyv ltvbh v'zv v'pv 'l khl 'zbyv
verses.translation: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

verses.original: וַ/נָּצ֛וּמָ/ה וַ/נְּבַקְשָׁ֥/ה מֵ/אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ עַל זֹ֑את וַ/יֵּעָתֵ֖ר לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vntsvmh vnbqshh m'lhynv 'l z't vy'tr lnv
verses.translation: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

verses.original: וָ/אַבְדִּ֛ילָ/ה מִ/שָּׂרֵ֥י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר לְ/שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֥ם מֵ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה
verses.translit: v'bdylh mshry hkhhnym shnym 'shr lshrbyh chshbyh v'mhm m'chyhm 'shrh
verses.translation: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

verses.original: ו/אשקול/ה וָ/אֶשְׁקֳלָ֣/ה לָ/הֶ֔ם אֶת הַ/כֶּ֥סֶף וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/אֶת הַ/כֵּלִ֑ים תְּרוּמַ֣ת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ הַ/הֵרִ֨ימוּ֙ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/יֹעֲצָ֣י/ו וְ/שָׂרָ֔י/ו וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ/נִּמְצָאִֽים
verses.translit: v'shqvlh v'shqlh lhm 't hkhsf v't hzhb v't hkhlym trvmt byt 'lhynv hhrymv hmlkh vy'tsyv vshryv vkhl yshr'l hnmts'ym
verses.translation: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁקֲלָ֨/ה עַל יָדָ֜/ם כֶּ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים וּ/כְלֵי כֶ֥סֶף מֵאָ֖ה לְ/כִכָּרִ֑ים זָהָ֖ב מֵאָ֥ה כִכָּֽר
verses.translit: v'shqlh 'l ydm khsf khkhrym shsh m'vt vchmshym vkhly khsf m'h lkhkhrym zhb m'h khkhr
verses.translation: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;

verses.original: וּ/כְפֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לַ/אֲדַרְכֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּ/כְלֵ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת מֻצְהָ֤ב טוֹבָה֙ שְׁנַ֔יִם חֲמוּדֹ֖ת כַּ/זָּהָֽב
verses.translit: vkhpry zhb 'shrym l'drkhnym 'lf vkhly nchsht mtshb tvbh shnym chmvdt khzhb
verses.translation: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמְרָ֣/ה אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הַ/כֵּלִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/הַ/זָּהָב֙ נְדָבָ֔ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrh 'lhm 'tm qdsh lyhvh vhkhlym qdsh vhkhsf vhzhb ndbh lyhvh 'lhy 'btykhm
verses.translation: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD ; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.

verses.original: שִׁקְד֣וּ וְ/שִׁמְר֗וּ עַֽד תִּשְׁקְל֡וּ לִ/פְנֵי֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם וְ/שָׂרֵֽי הָ/אָב֥וֹת לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הַ/לִּשְׁכ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shqdv vshmrv 'd tshqlv lpny shry hkhhnym vhlvym vshry h'bvt lyshr'l byrvshlm hlshkhvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: Watch ye, and keep them , until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/קִבְּלוּ֙ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִשְׁקַ֛ל הַ/כֶּ֥סֶף וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/הַ/כֵּלִ֑ים לְ/הָבִ֥יא לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vqblv hkhhnym vhlvym mshql hkhsf vhzhb vhkhlym lhby' lyrvshlm lbyt 'lhynv
verses.translation: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.

verses.original: וַֽ/נִּסְעָ֞/ה מִ/נְּהַ֣ר אַֽהֲוָ֗א בִּ/שְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן לָ/לֶ֖כֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/יַד אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ הָיְתָ֣ה עָלֵ֔י/נוּ וַ/יַּ֨צִּילֵ֔/נוּ מִ/כַּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֛ב וְ/אוֹרֵ֖ב עַל הַ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vns'h mnhr 'hv' bshnym 'shr lchdsh hr'shvn llkht yrvshlm vyd 'lhynv hyth 'lynv vytsylnv mkhf 'vyb v'vrb 'l hdrkh
verses.translation: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

verses.original: וַ/נָּב֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/נֵּ֥שֶׁב שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vnbv' yrvshlm vnshb shm ymym shlshh
verses.translation: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/רְבִיעִ֡י נִשְׁקַ֣ל הַ/כֶּסֶף֩ וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֨ב וְ/הַ/כֵּלִ֜ים בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ עַ֠ל יַד מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/עִמּ֖/וֹ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן פִּֽינְחָ֑ס וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֞ם יוֹזָבָ֧ד בֶּן יֵשׁ֛וּעַ וְ/נֽוֹעַדְיָ֥ה בֶן בִּנּ֖וּי הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hrby'y nshql hkhsf vhzhb vhkhlym bbyt 'lhynv 'l yd mrmvt bn 'vryh hkhhn v'mv 'l'zr bn pynchs v'mhm yvzbd bn yshv' vnv'dyh bn bnvy hlvym
verses.translation: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

verses.translit: bmspr bmshql lkhl vykhtb khl hmshql b't hhy'
verses.translation: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.

verses.original: הַ֠/בָּאִים מֵֽ/הַ/שְּׁבִ֨י בְנֵֽי הַ/גּוֹלָ֜ה הִקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹל֣וֹת לֵ/אלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּרִ֨ים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֤ר עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵילִ֣ים תִּשְׁעִ֣ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֗ה כְּבָשִׂים֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֔ה צְפִירֵ֥י חַטָּ֖את שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הַ/כֹּ֖ל עוֹלָ֥ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: hb'ym mhshby bny hgvlh hqrybv 'lvt l'lhy yshr'l prym shnym 'shr 'l khl yshr'l 'ylym tsh'ym vshshh khbshym shb'ym vshb'h tspyry cht't shnym 'shr hkhl 'vlh lyhvh
verses.translation: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶת דָּתֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ לַ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/פַחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֑ר וְ/נִשְּׂא֥וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם וְ/אֶת בֵּֽית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vytnv 't dty hmlkh l'chshdrpny hmlkh vpchvvt 'br hnhr vnsh'v 't h'm v't byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/כַלּ֣וֹת אֵ֗לֶּה נִגְּשׁ֨וּ אֵלַ֤/י הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא נִבְדְּל֞וּ הָ/עָ֤ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מֵ/עַמֵּ֖י הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּ֠/תוֹעֲבֹֽתֵי/הֶם לַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֨י הַ/חִתִּ֜י הַ/פְּרִזִּ֣י הַ/יְבוּסִ֗י הָֽ/עַמֹּנִי֙ הַ/מֹּ֣אָבִ֔י הַ/מִּצְרִ֖י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: vkhkhlvt 'lh ngshv 'ly hshrym l'mr l' nbdlv h'm yshr'l vhkhhnym vhlvym m'my h'rtsvt khtv'btyhm lkhn'ny hchty hprzy hybvsy h'mny hm'by hmtsry vh'mry
verses.translation: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

verses.original: כִּֽי נָשְׂא֣וּ מִ/בְּנֹֽתֵי/הֶ֗ם לָ/הֶם֙ וְ/לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הִתְעָֽרְבוּ֙ זֶ֣רַע הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ בְּ/עַמֵּ֖י הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וְ/יַ֧ד הַ/שָּׂרִ֣ים וְ/הַ/סְּגָנִ֗ים הָֽיְתָ֛ה בַּ/מַּ֥עַל הַ/זֶּ֖ה רִאשׁוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: khy nsh'v mbntyhm lhm vlbnyhm vht'rbv zr' hqdsh b'my h'rtsvt vyd hshrym vhsgnym hyth bm'l hzh r'shvnh
verses.translation: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/שָׁמְעִ/י֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה קָרַ֥עְתִּי אֶת בִּגְדִ֖/י וּ/מְעִילִ֑/י וָ/אֶמְרְטָ֞/ה מִ/שְּׂעַ֤ר רֹאשִׁ/י֙ וּ/זְקָנִ֔/י וָ/אֵשְׁבָ֖/ה מְשׁוֹמֵֽם
verses.translit: vkhshm'y 't hdbr hzh qr'ty 't bgdy vm'yly v'mrth msh'r r'shy vzqny v'shbh mshvmm
verses.translation: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.

verses.original: וְ/אֵלַ֣/י יֵאָסְפ֗וּ כֹּ֤ל חָרֵד֙ בְּ/דִבְרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ל מַ֣עַל הַ/גּוֹלָ֑ה וַ/אֲנִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב מְשׁוֹמֵ֔ם עַ֖ד לְ/מִנְחַ֥ת הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'ly y'spv khl chrd bdbry 'lhy yshr'l 'l m'l hgvlh v'ny yshb mshvmm 'd lmncht h'rb
verses.translation: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/מִנְחַ֣ת הָ/עֶ֗רֶב קַ֚מְתִּי מִ/תַּֽעֲנִיתִ֔/י וּ/בְ/קָרְעִ֥/י בִגְדִ֖/י וּ/מְעִילִ֑/י וָֽ/אֶכְרְעָ/ה֙ עַל בִּרְכַּ֔/י וָ/אֶפְרְשָׂ֥/ה כַפַּ֖/י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: vbmncht h'rb qmty mt'nyty vbqr'y bgdy vm'yly v'khr'h 'l brkhy v'prshh khpy 'l yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God,

verses.original: וָ/אֹמְרָ֗/ה אֱלֹהַ/י֙ בֹּ֣שְׁתִּי וְ/נִכְלַ֔מְתִּי לְ/הָרִ֧ים אֱלֹהַ֛/י פָּנַ֖/י אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֣י עֲוֺנֹתֵ֤י/נוּ רָבוּ֙ לְ/מַ֣עְלָ/ה רֹּ֔אשׁ וְ/אַשְׁמָתֵ֥/נוּ גָדְלָ֖ה עַ֥ד לַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'mrh 'lhy bshty vnkhlmty lhrym 'lhy pny 'lykh khy 'vntynv rbv lm'lh r'sh v'shmtnv gdlh 'd lshmym
verses.translation: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

verses.original: מִ/ימֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵ֗י/נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ בְּ/אַשְׁמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וּ/בַ/עֲוֺנֹתֵ֡י/נוּ נִתַּ֡נּוּ אֲנַחְנוּ֩ מְלָכֵ֨י/נוּ כֹהֲנֵ֜י/נוּ בְּ/יַ֣ד מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אֲרָצ֗וֹת בַּ/חֶ֜רֶב בַּ/שְּׁבִ֧י וּ/בַ/בִּזָּ֛ה וּ/בְ/בֹ֥שֶׁת פָּנִ֖ים כְּ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: mymy 'btynv 'nchnv b'shmh gdlh 'd hyvm hzh vb'vntynv ntnv 'nchnv mlkhynv khhnynv byd mlkhy h'rtsvt bchrb bshby vbbzh vbbsht pnym khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה כִּ/מְעַט רֶגַע֩ הָיְתָ֨ה תְחִנָּ֜ה מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ לְ/הַשְׁאִ֥יר לָ֨/נוּ֙ פְּלֵיטָ֔ה וְ/לָ/תֶת לָ֥/נוּ יָתֵ֖ד בִּ/מְק֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ לְ/הָאִ֤יר עֵינֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/לְ/תִתֵּ֛/נוּ מִֽחְיָ֥ה מְעַ֖ט בְּ/עַבְדֻתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: v'th khm't rg' hyth tchnh m't yhvh 'lhynv lhsh'yr lnv plyth vltt lnv ytd bmqvm qdshv lh'yr 'ynynv 'lhynv vlttnv mchyh m't b'bdtnv
verses.translation: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

verses.original: כִּֽי עֲבָדִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וּ/בְ/עַבְדֻ֔תֵ/נוּ לֹ֥א עֲזָבָ֖/נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַֽ/יַּט עָלֵ֣י/נוּ חֶ֡סֶד לִ/פְנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י פָרַ֜ס לָֽ/תֶת לָ֣/נוּ מִֽחְיָ֗ה לְ/רוֹמֵ֞ם אֶת בֵּ֤ית אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ/לְ/הַעֲמִ֣יד אֶת חָרְבֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/לָֽ/תֶת לָ֣/נוּ גָדֵ֔ר בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy 'bdym 'nchnv vb'bdtnv l' 'zbnv 'lhynv vyt 'lynv chsd lpny mlkhy prs ltt lnv mchyh lrvmm 't byt 'lhynv vlh'myd 't chrbtyv vltt lnv gdr byhvdh vbyrvshlm
verses.translation: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה מַה נֹּאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ אַֽחֲרֵי זֹ֑את כִּ֥י עָזַ֖בְנוּ מִצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th mh n'mr 'lhynv 'chry z't khy 'zbnv mtsvtykh
verses.translation: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֗יתָ בְּ/יַ֨ד עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ הַ/נְּבִיאִים֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם בָּאִים֙ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֔/הּ אֶ֤רֶץ נִדָּה֙ הִ֔יא בְּ/נִדַּ֖ת עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת בְּ/תוֹעֲבֹֽתֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלְא֛וּ/הָ מִ/פֶּ֥ה אֶל פֶּ֖ה בְּ/טֻמְאָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr tsvyt byd 'bdykh hnby'ym l'mr h'rts 'shr 'tm b'ym lrshth 'rts ndh hy' bndt 'my h'rtsvt btv'btyhm 'shr ml'vh mph 'l ph btm'tm
verses.translation: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה בְּֽנוֹתֵי/כֶ֞ם אַל תִּתְּנ֣וּ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וּ/בְנֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אַל תִּשְׂא֣וּ לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא תִדְרְשׁ֧וּ שְׁלֹמָ֛/ם וְ/טוֹבָתָ֖/ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּם֙ אֶת ט֣וּב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'th bnvtykhm 'l ttnv lbnyhm vbntyhm 'l tsh'v lbnykhm vl' tdrshv shlmm vtvbtm 'd 'vlm lm'n tchzqv v'khltm 't tvb h'rts vhvrshtm lbnykhm 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

verses.original: וְ/אַֽחֲרֵי֙ כָּל הַ/בָּ֣א עָלֵ֔י/נוּ בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֨י/נוּ֙ הָ/רָעִ֔ים וּ/בְ/אַשְׁמָתֵ֖/נוּ הַ/גְּדֹלָ֑ה כִּ֣י אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ חָשַׂ֤כְתָּֽ לְ/מַ֨טָּה֙ מֵֽ/עֲוֺנֵ֔/נוּ וְ/נָתַ֥תָּה לָּ֛/נוּ פְּלֵיטָ֖ה כָּ/זֹֽאת
verses.translit: v'chry khl hb' 'lynv bm'shynv hr'ym vb'shmtnv hgdlh khy 'th 'lhynv chshkht lmth m'vnnv vntth lnv plyth khz't
verses.translation: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve , and hast given us such deliverance as this;

verses.original: הֲ/נָשׁוּב֙ לְ/הָפֵ֣ר מִצְוֺתֶ֔י/ךָ וּ֨/לְ/הִתְחַתֵּ֔ן בְּ/עַמֵּ֥י הַ/תֹּעֵב֖וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה הֲ/ל֤וֹא תֶֽאֱנַף בָּ֨/נוּ֙ עַד כַּלֵּ֔ה לְ/אֵ֥ין שְׁאֵרִ֖ית וּ/פְלֵיטָֽה
verses.translit: hnshvb lhpr mtsvtykh vlhtchtn b'my ht'bvt h'lh hlv' t'nf bnv 'd khlh l'yn sh'ryt vplyth
verses.translation: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us , so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ צַדִּ֣יק אַ֔תָּה כִּֽי נִשְׁאַ֥רְנוּ פְלֵיטָ֖ה כְּ/הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה הִנְ/נ֤וּ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/אַשְׁמָתֵ֔י/נוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לַ/עֲמ֛וֹד לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ עַל זֹֽאת
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy yshr'l tsdyq 'th khy nsh'rnv plyth khhyvm hzh hnnv lpnykh b'shmtynv khy 'yn l'mvd lpnykh 'l z't
verses.translation: O LORD God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּ/כְ֨/הִתְוַדֹּת֔/וֹ בֹּכֶה֙ וּ/מִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִ/פְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨י/ו מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְ/נָשִׁים֙ וִֽ/ילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי בָכ֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה בֶֽכֶה
verses.translit: vkhhtpll 'zr' vkhhtvdtv bkhh vmtnpl lpny byt h'lhym nqbtsv 'lyv myshr'l qhl rb m'd 'nshym vnshym vyldym khy bkhv h'm hrbh bkhh
verses.translation: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִ/בְּנֵ֤י עולם עֵילָם֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/עֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵ/אלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ וַ/נֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵ/עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/עַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ מִקְוֶ֥ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vy'n shkhnyh bn ychy'l mbny 'vlm 'ylm vy'mr l'zr' 'nchnv m'lnv b'lhynv vnshb nshym nkhryvt m'my h'rts v'th ysh mqvh lyshr'l 'l z't
verses.translation: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרָת בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠/אלֹהֵי/נוּ לְ/הוֹצִ֨יא כָל נָשִׁ֜ים וְ/הַ/נּוֹלָ֤ד מֵ/הֶם֙ בַּ/עֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔/י וְ/הַ/חֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּ/מִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/כַ/תּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: v'th nkhrt bryt l'lhynv lhvtsy' khl nshym vhnvld mhm b'tst 'dny vhchrdym bmtsvt 'lhynv vkhtvrh y'shh
verses.translation: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

verses.original: ק֛וּם כִּֽי עָלֶ֥י/ךָ הַ/דָּבָ֖ר וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עִמָּ֑/ךְ חֲזַ֖ק וַ/עֲשֵֽׂה
verses.translit: qvm khy 'lykh hdbr v'nchnv 'mkh chzq v'shh
verses.translation: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֡א וַ/יַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת שָׂרֵי֩ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַ/עֲשׂ֛וֹת כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה וַ/יִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: vyqm 'zr' vyshb' 't shry hkhhnym hlvym vkhl yshr'l l'shvt khdbr hzh vyshb'v
verses.translation: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֗א מִ/לִּ/פְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא אָכַל֙ וּ/מַ֣יִם לֹֽא שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל מַ֥עַל הַ/גּוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vyqm 'zr' mlpny byt h'lhym vylkh 'l lshkht yhvchnn bn 'lyshyb vylkh shm lchm l' 'khl vmym l' shth khy mt'bl 'l m'l hgvlh
verses.translation: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֜וֹל בִּ/יהוּדָ֣ה וִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְ/כֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה לְ/הִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'byrv qvl byhvdh vyrvshlm lkhl bny hgvlh lhqbts yrvshlm
verses.translation: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יָב֜וֹא לִ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַ/יָּמִ֗ים כַּ/עֲצַ֤ת הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ וְ/הַ/זְּקֵנִ֔ים יָחֳרַ֖ם כָּל רְכוּשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/ה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִ/קְּהַ֥ל הַ/גּוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr l' ybv' lshlsht hymym kh'tst hshrym vhzqnym ychrm khl rkhvshv vhv' ybdl mqhl hgvlh
verses.translation: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֣וּ כָל אַנְשֵֽׁי יְהוּדָה֩ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֨ן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַ/יָּמִ֗ים ה֛וּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֖י בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ כָל הָ/עָ֗ם בִּ/רְחוֹב֙ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַרְעִידִ֥ים עַל הַ/דָּבָ֖ר וּ/מֵ/הַ/גְּשָׁמִֽים
verses.translit: vyqbtsv khl 'nshy yhvdh vbnymn yrvshlm lshlsht hymym hv' chdsh htshy'y b'shrym bchdsh vyshbv khl h'm brchvb byt h'lhym mr'ydym 'l hdbr vmhgshmym
verses.translation: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם עֶזְרָ֤א הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם מְעַלְתֶּ֔ם וַ/תֹּשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת לְ/הוֹסִ֖יף עַל אַשְׁמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm 'zr' hkhhn vy'mr 'lhm 'tm m'ltm vtshybv nshym nkhryvt lhvsyf 'l 'shmt yshr'l
verses.translation: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֥וּ תוֹדָ֛ה לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם וַ/עֲשׂ֣וּ רְצוֹנ֑/וֹ וְ/הִבָּֽדְלוּ֙ מֵ/עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מִן הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים הַ/נָּכְרִיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'th tnv tvdh lyhvh 'lhy 'btykhm v'shv rtsvnv vhbdlv m'my h'rts vmn hnshym hnkhryvt
verses.translation: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעְנ֧וּ כָֽל הַ/קָּהָ֛ל וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל כֵּ֛ן כ/דברי/ך כִּ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֥ עָלֵ֖י/נוּ לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vy'nv khl hqhl vy'mrv qvl gdvl khn khdbrykh khdbrkh 'lynv l'shvt
verses.translation: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.

verses.original: אֲבָ֞ל הָ/עָ֥ם רָב֙ וְ/הָ/עֵ֣ת גְּשָׁמִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַ/עֲמ֣וֹד בַּ/ח֑וּץ וְ/הַ/מְּלָאכָ֗ה לֹֽא לְ/י֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ וְ/לֹ֣א לִ/שְׁנַ֔יִם כִּֽי הִרְבִּ֥ינוּ לִ/פְשֹׁ֖עַ בַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'bl h'm rb vh't gshmym v'yn khch l'mvd bchvts vhml'khh l' lyvm 'chd vl' lshnym khy hrbynv lpsh' bdbr hzh
verses.translation: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

verses.original: יַֽעֲמְדוּ נָ֣א שָׂ֠רֵי/נוּ לְֽ/כָל הַ/קָּהָ֞ל וְ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּ/עָרֵ֗י/נוּ הַ/הֹשִׁ֞יב נָשִׁ֤ים נָכְרִיּוֹת֙ יָבֹא֙ לְ/עִתִּ֣ים מְזֻמָּנִ֔ים וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֛ם זִקְנֵי עִ֥יר וָ/עִ֖יר וְ/שֹׁפְטֶ֑י/הָ עַ֠ד לְ/הָשִׁ֞יב חֲר֤וֹן אַף אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ עַ֖ד לַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: y'mdv n' shrynv lkhl hqhl vkhl 'shr b'rynv hhshyb nshym nkhryvt yb' l'tym mzmnym v'mhm zqny 'yr v'yr vshptyh 'd lhshyb chrvn 'f 'lhynv mmnv 'd ldbr hzh
verses.translation: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וְ/יַחְזְיָ֥ה בֶן תִּקְוָ֖ה עָמְד֣וּ עַל זֹ֑את וּ/מְשֻׁלָּ֛ם וְ/שַׁבְּתַ֥י הַ/לֵּוִ֖י עֲזָרֻֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'kh yvntn bn 'shh'l vychzyh bn tqvh 'mdv 'l z't vmshlm vshbty hlvy 'zrm
verses.translation: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָה֒ וַ/יִּבָּדְלוּ֩ עֶזְרָ֨א הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֲנָשִׁ֨ים רָאשֵׁ֧י הָ/אָב֛וֹת לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖/ם וְ/כֻלָּ֣/ם בְּ/שֵׁמ֑וֹת וַ/יֵּשְׁב֗וּ בְּ/י֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֔י לְ/דַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'shv khn bny hgvlh vybdlv 'zr' hkhhn 'nshym r'shy h'bvt lbyt 'btm vkhlm bshmvt vyshbv byvm 'chd lchdsh h'shyry ldryvsh hdbr
verses.translation: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַלּ֣וּ בַ/כֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַ/הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת עַ֛ד י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vykhlv bkhl 'nshym hhshybv nshym nkhryvt 'd yvm 'chd lchdsh hr'shvn
verses.translation: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּצֵא֙ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת מִ/בְּנֵ֨י יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן יֽוֹצָדָק֙ וְ/אֶחָ֔י/ו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽ/אֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְ/יָרִ֖יב וּ/גְדַלְיָֽה
verses.translit: vymts' mbny hkhhnym 'shr hshybv nshym nkhryvt mbny yshv' bn yvtsdq v'chyv m'shyh v'ly'zr vyryb vgdlyh
verses.translation: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely , of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖/ם לְ/הוֹצִ֣יא נְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ם וַ/אֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל צֹ֖אן עַל אַשְׁמָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vytnv ydm lhvtsy' nshyhm v'shmym 'yl ts'n 'l 'shmtm
verses.translation: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר חֲנָ֖נִי וּ/זְבַדְיָֽה
verses.translit: vmbny 'mr chnny vzbdyh
verses.translation: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂיָ֤ה וְ/אֵֽלִיָּה֙ וּֽ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וִ/יחִיאֵ֖ל וְ/עֻזִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vmbny chrm m'shyh v'lyh vshm'yh vychy'l v'zyh
verses.translation: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י פַּשְׁח֑וּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל נְתַנְאֵ֔ל יוֹזָבָ֖ד וְ/אֶלְעָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vmbny pshchvr 'lyv'yny m'shyh yshm''l ntn'l yvzbd v'l'shh
verses.translation: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽן הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם יוֹזָבָ֣ד וְ/שִׁמְעִ֗י וְ/קֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶ/אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר
verses.translit: vmn hlvym yvzbd vshm'y vqlyh hv' qlyt' ptchyh yhvdh v'ly'zr
verses.translation: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וּ/מִן הַ/שֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים שַׁלֻּ֥ם וָ/טֶ֖לֶם וְ/אוּרִֽי
verses.translit: vmn hmshrrym 'lyshyb vmn hsh'rym shlm vtlm v'vry
verses.translation: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ/בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֡שׁ רַ֠מְיָה וְ/יִזִּיָּ֤ה וּ/מַלְכִּיָּה֙ וּ/מִיָּמִ֣ן וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וּ/מַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וּ/בְנָיָֽה
verses.translit: vmyshr'l mbny pr'sh rmyh vyzyh vmlkhyh vmymn v'l'zr vmlkhyh vbnyh
verses.translation: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י עֵילָ֑ם מַתַּנְיָ֤ה זְכַרְיָה֙ וִ/יחִיאֵ֣ל וְ/עַבְדִּ֔י וִ/ירֵמ֖וֹת וְ/אֵלִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vmbny 'ylm mtnyh zkhryh vychy'l v'bdy vyrmvt v'lyh
verses.translation: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י זַתּ֑וּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַ֤י אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה וִֽ/ירֵמ֔וֹת וְ/זָבָ֖ד וַ/עֲזִיזָֽא
verses.translit: vmbny ztv' 'lyv'ny 'lyshyb mtnyh vyrmvt vzbd v'zyz'
verses.translation: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י בֵּבָ֑י יְהוֹחָנָ֥ן חֲנַנְיָ֖ה זַבַּ֥י עַתְלָֽי
verses.translit: vmbny bby yhvchnn chnnyh zby 'tly
verses.translation: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֖י בָּנִ֑י מְשֻׁלָּ֤ם מַלּוּךְ֙ וַ/עֲדָיָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב וּ/שְׁאָ֥ל ירמות וְ/רָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmbny bny mshlm mlvkh v'dyh yshvb vsh'l yrmvt vrmvt
verses.translation: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֛י פַּחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב עַדְנָ֣א וּ/כְלָ֑ל בְּנָיָ֤ה מַעֲשֵׂיָה֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה בְצַלְאֵ֔ל וּ/בִנּ֖וּי וּ/מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vmbny pcht mv'b 'dn' vkhll bnyh m'shyh mtnyh btsl'l vbnvy vmnshh
verses.translation: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם אֱלִיעֶ֧זֶר יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה מַלְכִּיָּ֖ה שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה שִׁמְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vbny chrm 'ly'zr yshyh mlkhyh shm'yh shm'vn
verses.translation: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

verses.original: בְּנְיָמִ֥ן מַלּ֖וּךְ שְׁמַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: bnymn mlvkh shmryh
verses.translation: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֖י חָשֻׁ֑ם מַתְּנַ֤י מַתַּתָּה֙ זָבָ֣ד אֱלִיפֶ֔לֶט יְרֵמַ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: mbny chshm mtny mtth zbd 'lyplt yrmy mnshh shm'y
verses.translation: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔י מַעֲדַ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם וְ/אוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: mbny bny m'dy 'mrm v'v'l
verses.translation: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֥ה בֵדְיָ֖ה כלהי כְּלֽוּהוּ
verses.translit: bnyh bdyh khlhy khlvhv
verses.translation: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

verses.original: וַנְיָ֥ה מְרֵמ֖וֹת אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: vnyh mrmvt 'lyshyb
verses.translation: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.original: מַתַּנְיָ֥ה מַתְּנַ֖י ו/יעשו וְ/יַעֲשָֽׂי
verses.translit: mtnyh mtny vy'shv vy'shy
verses.translation: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

verses.original: וּ/בָנִ֥י וּ/בִנּ֖וּי שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: vbny vbnvy shm'y
verses.translation: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

verses.original: וְ/שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥ה וְ/נָתָ֖ן וַ/עֲדָיָֽה
verses.translit: vshlmyh vntn v'dyh
verses.translation: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

verses.original: מַכְנַדְבַ֥י שָׁשַׁ֖י שָׁרָֽי
verses.translit: mkhndby shshy shry
verses.translation: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.original: עֲזַרְאֵ֥ל וְ/שֶׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ שְׁמַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: 'zr'l vshlmyhv shmryh
verses.translation: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.original: שַׁלּ֥וּם אֲמַרְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: shlvm 'mryh yvsf
verses.translation: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

verses.original: מִ/בְּנֵ֖י נְב֑וֹ יְעִיאֵ֤ל מַתִּתְיָה֙ זָבָ֣ד זְבִינָ֔א ידו יַדַּ֥י וְ/יוֹאֵ֖ל בְּנָיָֽה
verses.translit: mbny nbv y'y'l mttyh zbd zbyn' ydv ydy vyv'l bnyh
verses.translation: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֕לֶּה נשא/י נָשְׂא֖וּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת וְ/יֵ֣שׁ מֵ/הֶ֣ם נָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בָּנִֽים
verses.translit: khl 'lh nsh'y nsh'v nshym nkhryvt vysh mhm nshym vyshymv bnym
verses.translation: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י נְחֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן חֲכַלְיָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֤י בְ/חֹֽדֶשׁ כסלו כִּסְלֵיו֙ שְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וַ/אֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַ/בִּירָֽה
verses.translit: dbry nchmyh bn chkhlyh vyhy bchdsh khslv khslyv shnt 'shrym v'ny hyyty bshvshn hbyrh
verses.translation: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א חֲנָ֜נִי אֶחָ֧ד מֵ/אַחַ֛/י ה֥וּא וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וָ/אֶשְׁאָלֵ֞/ם עַל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֧ים הַ/פְּלֵיטָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר נִשְׁאֲר֥וּ מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֖בִי וְ/עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' chnny 'chd m'chy hv' v'nshym myhvdh v'sh'lm 'l hyhvdym hplyth 'shr nsh'rv mn hshby v'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֮ לִ/י֒ הַֽ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֞ים אֲשֶֽׁר נִשְׁאֲר֤וּ מִן הַ/שְּׁבִי֙ שָׁ֣ם בַּ/מְּדִינָ֔ה בְּ/רָעָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה וּ/בְ/חֶרְפָּ֑ה וְ/חוֹמַ֤ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ מְפֹרָ֔צֶת וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֖י/הָ נִצְּת֥וּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mrv ly hnsh'rym 'shr nsh'rv mn hshby shm bmdynh br'h gdlh vbchrph vchvmt yrvshlm mprtst vsh'ryh ntstv b'sh
verses.translation: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כְּ/שָׁמְעִ֣/י אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ וָֽ/אֶבְכֶּ֔ה וָ/אֶתְאַבְּלָ֖/ה יָמִ֑ים וָֽ/אֱהִ֥י צָם֙ וּ/מִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'y 't hdbrym h'lh yshbty v'bkhh v't'blh ymym v'hy tsm vmtpll lpny 'lhy hshmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אָֽנָּ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם הָ/אֵ֥ל הַ/גָּד֖וֹל וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָ֑א שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַ/בְּרִית֙ וָ/חֶ֔סֶד לְ/אֹהֲבָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'mr 'n' yhvh 'lhy hshmym h'l hgdvl vhnvr' shmr hbryt vchsd l'hbyv vlshmry mtsvtyv
verses.translation: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:

verses.original: תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אָזְנְ/ךָֽ קַשֶּׁ֣בֶת וְֽ/עֵינֶ֪י/ךָ פְתֻוּח֟וֹת לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֶל תְּפִלַּ֣ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֡ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִי֩ מִתְפַּלֵּ֨ל לְ/פָנֶ֤י/ךָ הַ/יּוֹם֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַ֔יְלָה עַל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/מִתְוַדֶּ֗ה עַל חַטֹּ֤אות בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֣אנוּ לָ֔/ךְ וַ/אֲנִ֥י וּ/בֵית אָבִ֖/י חָטָֽאנוּ
verses.translit: thy n' 'znkh qshbt v'ynykh ptvchvt lshm' 'l tplt 'bdkh 'shr 'nkhy mtpll lpnykh hyvm yvmm vlylh 'l bny yshr'l 'bdykh vmtvdh 'l cht'vt bny yshr'l 'shr cht'nv lkh v'ny vbyt 'by cht'nv
verses.translation: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father’s house have sinned.

verses.original: חֲבֹ֖ל חָבַ֣לְנוּ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֣רְנוּ אֶת הַ/מִּצְוֺ֗ת וְ/אֶת הַֽ/חֻקִּים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתָ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chbl chblnv lkh vl' shmrnv 't hmtsvt v't hchqym v't hmshptym 'shr tsvyt 't mshh 'bdkh
verses.translation: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.

verses.original: זְכָר נָא֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתָ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֣ם תִּמְעָ֔לוּ אֲנִ֕י אָפִ֥יץ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בָּ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: zkhr n' 't hdbr 'shr tsvyt 't mshh 'bdkh l'mr 'tm tm'lv 'ny 'pyts 'tkhm b'mym
verses.translation: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔/י וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔/י וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם אִם יִהְיֶ֨ה נִֽדַּחֲ/כֶ֜ם בִּ/קְצֵ֤ה הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/שָּׁ֣ם אֲקַבְּצֵ֔/ם ו/הבואתי/ם וַ/הֲבִֽיאוֹתִי/ם֙ אֶל הַ/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתִּי לְ/שַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vshbtm 'ly vshmrtm mtsvty v'shytm 'tm 'm yhyh ndchkhm bqtsh hshmym mshm 'qbtsm vhbv'tym vhby'vtym 'l hmqvm 'shr bchrty lshkhn 't shmy shm
verses.translation: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֥ם עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/עַמֶּ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּדִ֨יתָ֙ בְּ/כֹחֲ/ךָ֣ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וּ/בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ הַ/חֲזָקָֽה
verses.translit: vhm 'bdykh v'mkh 'shr pdyt bkhchkh hgdvl vbydkh hchzqh
verses.translation: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.

verses.original: אָנָּ֣א אֲדֹנָ֗/י תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אָזְנְ/ךָֽ קַ֠שֶּׁבֶת אֶל תְּפִלַּ֨ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֜ וְ/אֶל תְּפִלַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֗י/ךָ הַֽ/חֲפֵצִים֙ לְ/יִרְאָ֣ה אֶת שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הַצְלִֽיחָ/ה נָּ֤א לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וּ/תְנֵ֣/הוּ לְ/רַחֲמִ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/אֲנִ֛י הָיִ֥יתִי מַשְׁקֶ֖ה לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: 'n' 'dny thy n' 'znkh qshbt 'l tplt 'bdkh v'l tplt 'bdykh hchptsym lyr'h 't shmkh vhtslychh n' l'bdkh hyvm vtnhv lrchmym lpny h'ysh hzh v'ny hyyty mshqh lmlkh
verses.translation: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ נִיסָ֗ן שְׁנַ֥ת עֶשְׂרִ֛ים לְ/אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יַ֣יִן לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וָ/אֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת הַ/יַּ֨יִן֙ וָ/אֶתְּנָ֣/ה לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/לֹא הָיִ֥יתִי רַ֖ע לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy bchdsh nysn shnt 'shrym l'rtchshst' hmlkh yyn lpnyv v'sh' 't hyyn v'tnh lmlkh vl' hyyty r' lpnyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ לִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ מַדּ֣וּעַ פָּנֶ֣י/ךָ רָעִ֗ים וְ/אַתָּה֙ אֵֽינְ/ךָ֣ חוֹלֶ֔ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֔ה כִּי אִ֖ם רֹ֣עַֽ לֵ֑ב וָ/אִירָ֖א הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hmlkh mdv' pnykh r'ym v'th 'ynkh chvlh 'yn zh khy 'm r' lb v'yr' hrbh m'd
verses.translation: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם יִחְיֶ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ לֹא יֵרְע֣וּ פָנַ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָ/עִ֜יר בֵּית קִבְר֤וֹת אֲבֹתַ/י֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֖י/הָ אֻכְּל֥וּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'mr lmlkh hmlkh l'vlm ychyh mdv' l' yr'v pny 'shr h'yr byt qbrvt 'bty chrbh vsh'ryh 'khlv b'sh
verses.translation: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לִ/י֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל מַה זֶּ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ וָֽ/אֶתְפַּלֵּ֔ל אֶל אֱלֹהֵ֖י הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hmlkh 'l mh zh 'th mbqsh v'tpll 'l 'lhy hshmym
verses.translation: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב וְ/אִם יִיטַ֥ב עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֣/נִי אֶל יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל עִ֛יר קִבְר֥וֹת אֲבֹתַ֖/י וְ/אֶבְנֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'mr lmlkh 'm 'l hmlkh tvb v'm yytb 'bdkh lpnykh 'shr tshlchny 'l yhvdh 'l 'yr qbrvt 'bty v'bnnh
verses.translation: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers’ sepulchres, that I may build it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ לִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שֵּׁגַ֣ל יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶצְל֗/וֹ עַד מָתַ֛י יִהְיֶ֥ה מַֽהֲלָכֲ/ךָ֖ וּ/מָתַ֣י תָּשׁ֑וּב וַ/יִּיטַ֤ב לִ/פְנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֵ֔/נִי וָֽ/אֶתְּנָ֥/ה ל֖/וֹ זְמָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hmlkh vhshgl yvshbt 'tslv 'd mty yhyh mhlkhkh vmty tshvb vyytb lpny hmlkh vyshlchny v'tnh lv zmn
verses.translation: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

verses.original: וָ/אוֹמַר֮ לַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב אִגְּרוֹת֙ יִתְּנוּ לִ֔/י עַֽל פַּחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲבִיר֔וּ/נִי עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר אָב֖וֹא אֶל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'vmr lmlkh 'm 'l hmlkh tvb 'grvt ytnv ly 'l pchvvt 'br hnhr 'shr y'byrvny 'd 'shr 'bv' 'l yhvdh
verses.translation: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;

verses.original: וְ/אִגֶּ֡רֶת אֶל אָסָף֩ שֹׁמֵ֨ר הַ/פַּרְדֵּ֜ס אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתֶּן לִ֣/י עֵצִ֡ים לְ֠/קָרוֹת אֶת שַׁעֲרֵ֨י הַ/בִּירָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר לַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ וּ/לְ/חוֹמַ֣ת הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/לַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר אָב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתֶּן לִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כְּ/יַד אֱלֹהַ֖/י הַ/טּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'grt 'l 'sf shmr hprds 'shr lmlkh 'shr ytn ly 'tsym lqrvt 't sh'ry hbyrh 'shr lbyt vlchvmt h'yr vlbyt 'shr 'bv' 'lyv vytn ly hmlkh khyd 'lhy htvbh 'ly
verses.translation: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.

verses.original: וָֽ/אָב֗וֹא אֶֽל פַּֽחֲווֹת֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֔ר וָ/אֶתְּנָ֣/ה לָ/הֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אִגְּר֣וֹת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח עִמִּ/י֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂ֥רֵי חַ֖יִל וּ/פָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v'bv' 'l pchvvt 'br hnhr v'tnh lhm 't 'grvt hmlkh vyshlch 'my hmlkh shry chyl vprshym
verses.translation: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֞ע סַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַ/חֹרֹנִ֗י וְ/טֽוֹבִיָּה֙ הָ/עֶ֣בֶד הָֽ/עַמֹּנִ֔י וַ/יֵּ֥רַע לָ/הֶ֖ם רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א אָדָ֔ם לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ טוֹבָ֖ה לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshm' snblt hchrny vtvbyh h'bd h'mny vyr' lhm r'h gdlh 'shr b' 'dm lbqsh tvbh lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וָ/אָב֖וֹא אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וָ/אֱהִי שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: v'bv' 'l yrvshlm v'hy shm ymym shlshh
verses.translation: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

verses.original: וָ/אָק֣וּם לַ֗יְלָה אֲנִי֮ וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים מְעַט֮ עִמִּ/י֒ וְ/לֹא הִגַּ֣דְתִּי לְ/אָדָ֔ם מָ֗ה אֱלֹהַ/י֙ נֹתֵ֣ן אֶל לִבִּ֔/י לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת לִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּ/בְהֵמָה֙ אֵ֣ין עִמִּ֔/י כִּ֚י אִם הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י רֹכֵ֥ב בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'qvm lylh 'ny v'nshym m't 'my vl' hgdty l'dm mh 'lhy ntn 'l lby l'shvt lyrvshlm vbhmh 'yn 'my khy 'm hbhmh 'shr 'ny rkhb bh
verses.translation: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.

verses.original: וָ/אֵצְאָ֨/ה בְ/שַֽׁעַר הַ/גַּ֜יא לַ֗יְלָה וְ/אֶל פְּנֵי֙ עֵ֣ין הַתַּנִּ֔ין וְ/אֶל שַׁ֖עַר הָ/אַשְׁפֹּ֑ת וָ/אֱהִ֨י שֹׂבֵ֜ר בְּ/חוֹמֹ֤ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֲשֶׁר ה/מפרוצים הֵ֣ם פְּרוּצִ֔ים וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֖י/הָ אֻכְּל֥וּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'ts'h bsh'r hgy' lylh v'l pny 'yn htnyn v'l sh'r h'shpt v'hy shbr bchvmt yrvshlm 'shr hmprvtsym hm prvtsym vsh'ryh 'khlv b'sh
verses.translation: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

verses.original: וָ/אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶל שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עַ֔יִן וְ/אֶל בְּרֵכַ֖ת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/אֵין מָק֥וֹם לַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה לַ/עֲבֹ֥ר תַּחְתָּֽ/י
verses.translit: v''br 'l sh'r h'yn v'l brkht hmlkh v'yn mqvm lbhmh l'br tchty
verses.translation: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.

verses.original: וָ/אֱהִ֨י עֹלֶ֤ה בַ/נַּ֨חַל֙ לַ֔יְלָה וָ/אֱהִ֥י שֹׂבֵ֖ר בַּ/חוֹמָ֑ה וָ/אָשׁ֗וּב וָ/אָב֛וֹא בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר הַ/גַּ֖יְא וָ/אָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: v'hy 'lh bnchl lylh v'hy shbr bchvmh v'shvb v'bv' bsh'r hgy' v'shvb
verses.translation: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/סְּגָנִ֗ים לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ אָ֣נָה הָלַ֔כְתִּי וּ/מָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֑ה וְ/לַ/יְּהוּדִ֨ים וְ/לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְ/לַ/חֹרִ֣ים וְ/לַ/סְּגָנִ֗ים וּ/לְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה עַד כֵּ֖ן לֹ֥א הִגַּֽדְתִּי
verses.translit: vhsgnym l' yd'v 'nh hlkhty vmh 'ny 'shh vlyhvdym vlkhhnym vlchrym vlsgnym vlytr 'shh hml'khh 'd khn l' hgdty
verses.translation: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

verses.original: וָ/אוֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם רֹאִים֙ הָ/רָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בָ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֖י/הָ נִצְּת֣וּ בָ/אֵ֑שׁ לְכ֗וּ וְ/נִבְנֶה֙ אֶת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/לֹא נִהְיֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: v'vmr 'lhm 'tm r'ym hr'h 'shr 'nchnv bh 'shr yrvshlm chrbh vsh'ryh ntstv b'sh lkhv vnbnh 't chvmt yrvshlm vl' nhyh 'vd chrph
verses.translation: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.

verses.original: וָ/אַגִּ֨יד לָ/הֶ֜ם אֶת יַ֣ד אֱלֹהַ֗/י אֲשֶׁר הִיא֙ טוֹבָ֣ה עָלַ֔/י וְ/אַף דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר לִ֑/י וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ נָק֣וּם וּ/בָנִ֔ינוּ וַ/יְחַזְּק֥וּ יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם לַ/טּוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: v'gyd lhm 't yd 'lhy 'shr hy' tvbh 'ly v'f dbry hmlkh 'shr 'mr ly vy'mrv nqvm vbnynv vychzqv ydyhm ltvbh
verses.translation: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַע֩ סַנְבַלַּ֨ט הַ/חֹרֹנִ֜י וְ/טֹבִיָּ֣ה הָ/עֶ֣בֶד הָֽ/עַמּוֹנִ֗י וְ/גֶ֨שֶׁם֙ הָֽ/עַרְבִ֔י וַ/יַּלְעִ֣גוּ לָ֔/נוּ וַ/יִּבְז֖וּ עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ מָֽה הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים הַ/עַ֥ל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אַתֶּ֥ם מֹרְדִֽים
verses.translit: vyshm' snblt hchrny vtbyh h'bd h'mvny vgshm h'rby vyl'gv lnv vybzv 'lynv vy'mrv mh hdbr hzh 'shr 'tm 'shym h'l hmlkh 'tm mrdym
verses.translation: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it , they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?

verses.original: וָ/אָשִׁ֨יב אוֹתָ֜/ם דָּבָ֗ר וָ/אוֹמַ֤ר לָ/הֶם֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם ה֚וּא יַצְלִ֣יחַֽ לָ֔/נוּ וַ/אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדָ֖י/ו נָק֣וּם וּ/בָנִ֑ינוּ וְ/לָ/כֶ֗ם אֵֽין חֵ֧לֶק וּ/צְדָקָ֛ה וְ/זִכָּר֖וֹן בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v'shyb 'vtm dbr v'vmr lhm 'lhy hshmym hv' ytslych lnv v'nchnv 'bdyv nqvm vbnynv vlkhm 'yn chlq vtsdqh vzkhrvn byrvshlm
verses.translation: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֡קָם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן הַ/גָּד֜וֹל וְ/אֶחָ֣י/ו הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַ/יִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת שַׁ֣עַר הַ/צֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּ/הוּ וַֽ/יַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/עַד מִגְדַּ֤ל הַ/מֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּ/הוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm 'lyshyb hkhhn hgdvl v'chyv hkhhnym vybnv 't sh'r hts'n hmh qdshvhv vy'mydv dlttyv v'd mgdl hm'h qdshvhv 'd mgdl chnn'l
verses.translation: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָד֥/וֹ בָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וְ/עַל יָד֣/וֹ בָנָ֔ה זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן אִמְרִֽי
verses.translit: v'l ydv bnv 'nshy yrchv v'l ydv bnh zkhvr bn 'mry
verses.translation: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַ/דָּגִ֔ים בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/סְּנָאָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּ/הוּ וַֽ/יַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔י/ו מַנְעוּלָ֖י/ו וּ/בְרִיחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't sh'r hdgym bnv bny hsn'h hmh qrvhv vy'mydv dlttyv mn'vlyv vbrychyv
verses.translation: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָדָ֣/ם הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן אוּרִיָּה֙ בֶּן הַקּ֔וֹץ וְ/עַל יָדָ֣/ם הֶחֱזִ֔יק מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן בֶּרֶכְיָ֖ה בֶּן מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֑ל וְ/עַל יָדָ֣/ם הֶֽחֱזִ֔יק צָד֖וֹק בֶּֽן בַּעֲנָֽא
verses.translit: v'l ydm hchzyq mrmvt bn 'vryh bn hqvts v'l ydm hchzyq mshlm bn brkhyh bn mshyzb'l v'l ydm hchzyq tsdvq bn b'n'
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָדָ֖/ם הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ הַ/תְּקוֹעִ֑ים וְ/אַדִּֽירֵי/הֶם֙ לֹא הֵבִ֣יאוּ צַוָּרָ֔/ם בַּ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֲדֹנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'l ydm hchzyqv htqv'ym v'dyryhm l' hby'v tsvrm b'bdt 'dnyhm
verses.translation: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ יֽוֹיָדָע֙ בֶּן פָּסֵ֔חַ וּ/מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּן בְּסֽוֹדְיָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּ/הוּ וַֽ/יַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔י/ו וּ/מַנְעֻלָ֖י/ו וּ/בְרִיחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't sh'r hyshnh hchzyqv yvyd' bn psch vmshlm bn bsvdyh hmh qrvhv vy'mydv dlttyv vmn'lyv vbrychyv
verses.translation: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָדָ֨/ם הֶחֱזִ֜יק מְלַטְיָ֣ה הַ/גִּבְעֹנִ֗י וְ/יָדוֹן֙ הַ/מֵּרֹ֣נֹתִ֔י אַנְשֵׁ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן וְ/הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑ה לְ/כִסֵּ֕א פַּחַ֖ת עֵ֥בֶר הַ/נָּהָֽר
verses.translit: v'l ydm hchzyq mltyh hgb'ny vydvn hmrnty 'nshy gb'vn vhmtsph lkhs' pcht 'br hnhr
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.

verses.original: עַל יָד֣/וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֻזִּיאֵ֤ל בֶּֽן חַרְהֲיָה֙ צֽוֹרְפִ֔ים וְ/עַל יָד֣/וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן הָ/רַקָּחִ֑ים וַ/יַּֽעַזְבוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/חוֹמָ֥ה הָ/רְחָבָֽה
verses.translit: 'l ydv hchzyq 'zy'l bn chrhyh tsvrpym v'l ydv hchzyq chnnyh bn hrqchym vy'zbv yrvshlm 'd hchvmh hrchbh
verses.translation: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָדָ֤/ם הֶחֱזִיק֙ רְפָיָ֣ה בֶן ח֔וּר שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v'l ydm hchzyq rpyh bn chvr shr chtsy plkh yrvshlm
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָדָ֧/ם הֶחֱזִ֛יק יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן חֲרוּמַ֖ף וְ/נֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑/וֹ וְ/עַל יָד֣/וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חַטּ֖וּשׁ בֶּן חֲשַׁבְנְיָֽה
verses.translit: v'l ydm hchzyq ydyh bn chrvmf vngd bytv v'l ydv hchzyq chtvsh bn chshbnyh
verses.translation: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

verses.original: מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֗ית הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן חָרִ֔ם וְ/חַשּׁ֖וּב בֶּן פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב וְ/אֵ֖ת מִגְדַּ֥ל הַ/תַּנּוּרִֽים
verses.translit: mdh shnyt hchzyq mlkhyh bn chrm vchshvb bn pcht mv'b v't mgdl htnvrym
verses.translation: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

verses.original: וְ/עַל יָד֣/וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק שַׁלּוּם֙ בֶּן הַלּוֹחֵ֔שׁ שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם ה֖וּא וּ/בְנוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'l ydv hchzyq shlvm bn hlvchsh shr chtsy plkh yrvshlm hv' vbnvtyv
verses.translation: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

verses.original: אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַ/גַּ֜יְא הֶחֱזִ֣יק חָנוּן֮ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י זָנוֹחַ֒ הֵ֣מָּה בָנ֔וּ/הוּ וַֽ/יַּעֲמִ֨ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔י/ו מַנְעֻלָ֖י/ו וּ/בְרִיחָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶ֤לֶף אַמָּה֙ בַּ/חוֹמָ֔ה עַ֖ד שַׁ֥עַר הָ/שֲׁפֽוֹת
verses.translit: 't sh'r hgy' hchzyq chnvn vyshby znvch hmh bnvhv vy'mydv dlttyv mn'lyv vbrychyv v'lf 'mh bchvmh 'd sh'r hshpvt
verses.translation: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת שַׁ֣עַר הָ/אַשְׁפּ֗וֹת הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן רֵכָ֔ב שַׂ֖ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית הַכָּ֑רֶם ה֣וּא יִבְנֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/יַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔י/ו מַנְעֻלָ֖י/ו וּ/בְרִיחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v't sh'r h'shpvt hchzyq mlkhyh bn rkhb shr plkh byt hkhrm hv' ybnnv vy'myd dlttyv mn'lyv vbrychyv
verses.translation: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָ/עַ֜יִן הֶ֠חֱזִיק שַׁלּ֣וּן בֶּן כָּל חֹזֶה֮ שַׂ֣ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ הַ/מִּצְפָּה֒ ה֤וּא יִבְנֶ֨/נּוּ֙ וִ/יטַֽלְלֶ֔/נּוּ ו/יעמידו וְ/יַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔י/ו מַנְעֻלָ֖י/ו וּ/בְרִיחָ֑י/ו וְ֠/אֵת חוֹמַ֞ת בְּרֵכַ֤ת הַ/שֶּׁ֨לַח֙ לְ/גַן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/עַד הַֽ/מַּעֲל֔וֹת הַ/יּוֹרְד֖וֹת מֵ/עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: v't sh'r h'yn hchzyq shlvn bn khl chzh shr plkh hmtsph hv' ybnnv vytllnv vy'mydv vy'myd dlttyv mn'lyv vbrychyv v't chvmt brkht hshlch lgn hmlkh v'd hm'lvt hyvrdvt m'yr dvyd
verses.translation: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤י/ו הֶחֱזִיק֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה בֶן עַזְבּ֔וּק שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּֽית צ֑וּר עַד נֶ֨גֶד֙ קִבְרֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְ/עַד הַ/בְּרֵכָה֙ הָ/עֲשׂוּיָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הַ/גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq nchmyh bn 'zbvq shr chtsy plkh byt tsvr 'd ngd qbry dvyd v'd hbrkhh h'shvyh v'd byt hgbrym
verses.translation: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֛י/ו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם רְח֣וּם בֶּן בָּנִ֑י עַל יָד֣/וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק חֲשַׁבְיָ֛ה שַׂר חֲצִי פֶ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָ֖ה לְ/פִלְכּֽ/וֹ
