verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyqv hlvym rchvm bn bny 'l ydv hchzyq chshbyh shr chtsy plkh q'ylh lplkhv
verses.translation: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

verses.original: אַחֲרָי/ו֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם בַּוַּ֖י בֶּן חֵנָדָ֑ד שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָֽה
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyqv 'chyhm bvy bn chndd shr chtsy plkh q'ylh
verses.translation: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֨ק עַל יָד֜/וֹ עֵ֧זֶר בֶּן יֵשׁ֛וּעַ שַׂ֥ר הַ/מִּצְפָּ֖ה מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִ/נֶּ֕גֶד עֲלֹ֥ת הַ/נֶּ֖שֶׁק הַ/מִּקְצֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vychzq 'l ydv 'zr bn yshv' shr hmtsph mdh shnyt mngd 'lt hnshq hmqts'
verses.translation: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֨י/ו הֶחֱרָ֧ה הֶחֱזִ֛יק בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן זבי זַכַּ֖י מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִן הַ֨/מִּקְצ֔וֹעַ עַד פֶּ֨תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: 'chryv hchrh hchzyq brvkh bn zby zkhy mdh shnyt mn hmqtsv' 'd ptch byt 'lyshyb hkhhn hgdvl
verses.translation: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֣י/ו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֧וֹת בֶּן אוּרִיָּ֛ה בֶּן הַקּ֖וֹץ מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִ/פֶּ֨תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְ/עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית בֵּ֥ית אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq mrmvt bn 'vryh bn hqvts mdh shnyt mptch byt 'lyshyb v'd tkhlyt byt 'lyshyb
verses.translation: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרָ֛י/ו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/כִּכָּֽר
verses.translit: v'chryv hchzyqv hkhhnym 'nshy hkhkhr
verses.translation: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֨י/ו הֶחֱזִ֧יק בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וְ/חַשּׁ֖וּב נֶ֣גֶד בֵּיתָ֑/ם אַחֲרָ֣י/ו הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֲזַרְיָ֧ה בֶן מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן עֲנָֽנְיָ֖ה אֵ֥צֶל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq bnymn vchshvb ngd bytm 'chryv hchzyq 'zryh bn m'shyh bn 'nnyh 'tsl bytv
verses.translation: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֣י/ו הֶחֱזִ֗יק בִּנּ֛וּי בֶּן חֵנָדָ֖ד מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִ/בֵּ֣ית עֲזַרְיָ֔ה עַד הַ/מִּקְצ֖וֹעַ וְ/עַד הַ/פִּנָּֽה
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq bnvy bn chndd mdh shnyt mbyt 'zryh 'd hmqtsv' v'd hpnh
verses.translation: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner.

verses.original: פָּלָ֣ל בֶּן אוּזַי֮ מִ/נֶּ֣גֶד הַ/מִּקְצוֹעַ֒ וְ/הַ/מִּגְדָּ֗ל הַ/יּוֹצֵא֙ מִ/בֵּ֤ית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הָֽ/עֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַ/חֲצַ֣ר הַ/מַּטָּרָ֑ה אַחֲרָ֖י/ו פְּדָיָ֥ה בֶן פַּרְעֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: pll bn 'vzy mngd hmqtsv' vhmgdl hyvts' mbyt hmlkh h'lyvn 'shr lchtsr hmtrh 'chryv pdyh bn pr'sh
verses.translation: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall , and the tower which lieth out from the king’s high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/נְּתִינִ֔ים הָי֥וּ יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בָּ/עֹ֑פֶל עַ֠ד נֶ֜גֶד שַׁ֤עַר הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ לַ/מִּזְרָ֔ח וְ/הַ/מִּגְדָּ֖ל הַ/יּוֹצֵֽא
verses.translit: vhntynym hyv yshbym b'pl 'd ngd sh'r hmym lmzrch vhmgdl hyvts'
verses.translation: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֛י/ו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַ/תְּקֹעִ֖ים מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִ/נֶּ֜גֶד הַ/מִּגְדָּ֤ל הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔א וְ/עַ֖ד חוֹמַ֥ת הָ/עֹֽפֶל
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyqv htq'ym mdh shnyt mngd hmgdl hgdvl hyvts' v'd chvmt h'pl
verses.translation: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.

verses.original: מֵ/עַ֣ל שַׁ֣עַר הַ/סּוּסִ֗ים הֶחֱזִ֨יקוּ֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ לְ/נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: m'l sh'r hsvsym hchzyqv hkhhnym 'ysh lngd bytv
verses.translation: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֧י/ו הֶחֱזִ֛יק צָד֥וֹק בֶּן אִמֵּ֖ר נֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑/וֹ וְ/אַחֲרָ֤י/ו הֶחֱזִיק֙ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֣ה בֶן שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖ר שַׁ֥עַר הַ/מִּזְרָֽח
verses.translit: 'chryv hchzyq tsdvq bn 'mr ngd bytv v'chryv hchzyq shm'yh bn shkhnyh shmr sh'r hmzrch
verses.translation: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

verses.original: אחר/י אַחֲרָ֨י/ו הֶחֱזִ֜יק חֲנַנְיָ֣ה בֶן שֶׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְ/חָנ֧וּן בֶּן צָלָ֛ף הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֖י מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑י אַחֲרָ֣י/ו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד נִשְׁכָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'chry 'chryv hchzyq chnnyh bn shlmyh vchnvn bn tslf hshshy mdh shny 'chryv hchzyq mshlm bn brkhyh ngd nshkhtv
verses.translation: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.

verses.original: אחרי אַחֲרָ֣י/ו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מַלְכִּיָּה֙ בֶּן הַ/צֹּ֣רְפִ֔י עַד בֵּ֥ית הַ/נְּתִינִ֖ים וְ/הָ/רֹכְלִ֑ים נֶ֚גֶד שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מִּפְקָ֔ד וְ/עַ֖ד עֲלִיַּ֥ת הַ/פִּנָּֽה
verses.translit: 'chry 'chryv hchzyq mlkhyh bn htsrpy 'd byt hntynym vhrkhlym ngd sh'r hmpqd v'd 'lyt hpnh
verses.translation: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith’s son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֨ין עֲלִיַּ֤ת הַ/פִּנָּה֙ לְ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/צֹּ֔אן הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַ/צֹּרְפִ֖ים וְ/הָ/רֹכְלִֽים
verses.translit: vbyn 'lyt hpnh lsh'r hts'n hchzyqv htsrpym vhrkhlym
verses.translation: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע סַנְבַלַּ֡ט וְ֠/טוֹבִיָּה וְ/הָ/עַרְבִ֨ים וְ/הָ/עַמֹּנִ֜ים וְ/הָ/אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֗ים כִּֽי עָלְתָ֤ה אֲרוּכָה֙ לְ/חֹמ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּי הֵחֵ֥לּוּ הַ/פְּרֻצִ֖ים לְ/הִסָּתֵ֑ם וַ/יִּ֥חַר לָ/הֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm' snblt vtvbyh vh'rbym vh'mnym vh'shdvdym khy 'lth 'rvkhh lchmvt yrvshlm khy hchlv hprtsym lhstm vychr lhm m'd
verses.translation: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשְׁר֤וּ כֻלָּ/ם֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָ/ב֖וֹא לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ תּוֹעָֽה
verses.translit: vyqshrv khlm ychdv lbv' lhlchm byrvshlm vl'shvt lv tv'h
verses.translation: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

verses.original: וַ/נִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/נַּעֲמִ֨יד מִשְׁמָ֧ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם יוֹמָ֥ם וָ/לַ֖יְלָה מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntpll 'l 'lhynv vn'myd mshmr 'lyhm yvmm vlylh mpnyhm
verses.translation: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֗ה כָּשַׁל֙ כֹּ֣חַ הַ/סַּבָּ֔ל וְ/הֶ/עָפָ֖ר הַרְבֵּ֑ה וַ/אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ לֹ֣א נוּכַ֔ל לִ/בְנ֖וֹת בַּ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh khshl khch hsbl vh'pr hrbh v'nchnv l' nvkhl lbnvt bchvmh
verses.translation: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ צָרֵ֗י/נוּ לֹ֤א יֵדְעוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר נָב֥וֹא אֶל תּוֹכָ֖/ם וַ/הֲרַגְנ֑וּ/ם וְ/הִשְׁבַּ֖תְנוּ אֶת הַ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv tsrynv l' yd'v vl' yr'v 'd 'shr nbv' 'l tvkhm vhrgnvm vhshbtnv 't hml'khh
verses.translation: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑/ם וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ לָ֨/נוּ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים מִ/כָּל הַ/מְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר תָּשׁ֥וּבוּ עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr b'v hyhvdym hyshbym 'tslm vy'mrv lnv 'shr p'mym mkhl hmqmvt 'shr tshvbv 'lynv
verses.translation: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

verses.original: וָֽ/אַעֲמִ֞יד מִֽ/תַּחְתִּיּ֧וֹת לַ/מָּק֛וֹם מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֥י לַ/חוֹמָ֖ה ב/צחחיים בַּ/צְּחִיחִ֑ים וָֽ/אַעֲמִ֤יד אֶת הָ/עָם֙ לְ/מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת עִם חַרְבֹתֵי/הֶ֛ם רָמְחֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/קַשְּׁתֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v''myd mtchtyvt lmqvm m'chry lchvmh btschchyym btschychym v''myd 't h'm lmshpchvt 'm chrbtyhm rmchyhm vqshttyhm
verses.translation: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֣רֶא וָ/אָק֗וּם וָ/אֹמַ֞ר אֶל הַ/חֹרִ֤ים וְ/אֶל הַ/סְּגָנִים֙ וְ/אֶל יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם אַל תִּֽירְא֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶת אֲדֹנָ֞/י הַ/גָּד֤וֹל וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָא֙ זְכֹ֔רוּ וְ/הִֽלָּחֲמ֗וּ עַל אֲחֵי/כֶם֙ בְּנֵי/כֶ֣ם וּ/בְנֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם נְשֵׁי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בָתֵּי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'r' v'qvm v'mr 'l hchrym v'l hsgnym v'l ytr h'm 'l tyr'v mpnyhm 't 'dny hgdvl vhnvr' zkhrv vhlchmv 'l 'chykhm bnykhm vbntykhm nshykhm vbtykhm
verses.translation: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְע֤וּ אוֹיְבֵ֨י/נוּ֙ כִּי נ֣וֹדַֽע לָ֔/נוּ וַ/יָּ֥פֶר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת עֲצָתָ֑/ם ו/נשוב וַ/נָּ֤שָׁב כֻּלָּ֨/נוּ֙ אֶל הַ֣/חוֹמָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ אֶל מְלַאכְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm'v 'vybynv khy nvd' lnv vypr h'lhym 't 'tstm vnshvb vnshb khlnv 'l hchvmh 'ysh 'l ml'khtv
verses.translation: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י מִן הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא חֲצִ֣י נְעָרַ/י֮ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּ/מְּלָאכָה֒ וְ/חֶצְיָ֗/ם מַחֲזִיקִים֙ וְ/הָ/רְמָחִ֣ים הַ/מָּגִנִּ֔ים וְ/הַ/קְּשָׁת֖וֹת וְ/הַ/שִּׁרְיֹנִ֑ים וְ/הַ֨/שָּׂרִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy mn hyvm hhv' chtsy n'ry 'shym bml'khh vchtsym mchzyqym vhrmchym hmgnym vhqshtvt vhshrynym vhshrym 'chry khl byt yhvdh
verses.translation: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

verses.original: הַ/בּוֹנִ֧ים בַּ/חוֹמָ֛ה וְ/הַ/נֹּשְׂאִ֥ים בַּ/סֶּ֖בֶל עֹמְשִׂ֑ים בְּ/אַחַ֤ת יָד/וֹ֙ עֹשֶׂ֣ה בַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה וְ/אַחַ֖ת מַחֲזֶ֥קֶת הַ/שָּֽׁלַח
verses.translit: hbvnym bchvmh vhnsh'ym bsbl 'mshym b'cht ydv 'shh bml'khh v'cht mchzqt hshlch
verses.translation: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/בּוֹנִ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ חַרְבּ֛/וֹ אֲסוּרִ֥ים עַל מָתְנָ֖י/ו וּ/בוֹנִ֑ים וְ/הַ/תּוֹקֵ֥עַ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֖ר אֶצְלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhbvnym 'ysh chrbv 'svrym 'l mtnyv vbvnym vhtvq' bshvpr 'tsly
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you .

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֞ר אֶל הַ/חֹרִ֤ים וְ/אֶל הַ/סְּגָנִים֙ וְ/אֶל יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם הַ/מְּלָאכָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה וּ/רְחָבָ֑ה וַ/אֲנַ֗חְנוּ נִפְרָדִים֙ עַל הַ֣/חוֹמָ֔ה רְחוֹקִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵ/אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'mr 'l hchrym v'l hsgnym v'l ytr h'm hml'khh hrbh vrchbh v'nchnv nprdym 'l hchvmh rchvqym 'ysh m'chyv
verses.translation: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

verses.original: בִּ/מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר שָׁ֖מָּ/ה תִּקָּבְצ֣וּ אֵלֵ֑י/נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ יִלָּ֥חֶם לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: bmqvm 'shr tshm'v 't qvl hshvpr shmh tqbtsv 'lynv 'lhynv ylchm lnv
verses.translation: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנַ֖חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּ/מְּלָאכָ֑ה וְ/חֶצְיָ֗/ם מַחֲזִיקִים֙ בָּֽ/רְמָחִ֔ים מֵ/עֲל֣וֹת הַ/שַּׁ֔חַר עַ֖ד צֵ֥את הַ/כּוֹכָבִֽים
verses.translit: v'nchnv 'shym bml'khh vchtsym mchzyqym brmchym m'lvt hshchr 'd ts't hkhvkhbym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָ/עָ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ וְ/נַעֲר֔/וֹ יָלִ֖ינוּ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/הָֽיוּ לָ֧/נוּ הַ/לַּ֛יְלָה מִשְׁמָ֖ר וְ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: gm b't hhy' 'mrty l'm 'ysh vn'rv ylynv btvkh yrvshlm vhyv lnv hlylh mshmr vhyvm ml'khh
verses.translation: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ין אֲנִ֜י וְ/אַחַ֣/י וּ/נְעָרַ֗/י וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מִּשְׁמָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַחֲרַ֔/י אֵין אֲנַ֥חְנוּ פֹשְׁטִ֖ים בְּגָדֵ֑י/נוּ אִ֖ישׁ שִׁלְח֥/וֹ הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: v'yn 'ny v'chy vn'ry v'nshy hmshmr 'shr 'chry 'yn 'nchnv pshtym bgdynv 'ysh shlchv hmym
verses.translation: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֨י צַעֲקַ֥ת הָ/עָ֛ם וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם גְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֶל אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/יְּהוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vthy ts'qt h'm vnshyhm gdvlh 'l 'chyhm hyhvdym
verses.translation: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

verses.original: וְ/יֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים בָּנֵ֥י/נוּ וּ/בְנֹתֵ֖י/נוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ רַבִּ֑ים וְ/נִקְחָ֥ה דָגָ֖ן וְ/נֹאכְלָ֥ה וְ/נִחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vysh 'shr 'mrym bnynv vbntynv 'nchnv rbym vnqchh dgn vn'khlh vnchyh
verses.translation: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them , that we may eat, and live.

verses.original: וְ/יֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים שְׂדֹתֵ֛י/נוּ וּ/כְרָמֵ֥י/נוּ וּ/בָתֵּ֖י/נוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹרְבִ֑ים וְ/נִקְחָ֥ה דָגָ֖ן בָּ/רָעָֽב
verses.translit: vysh 'shr 'mrym shdtynv vkhrmynv vbtynv 'nchnv 'rbym vnqchh dgn br'b
verses.translation: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

verses.original: וְ/יֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים לָוִ֥ינוּ כֶ֖סֶף לְ/מִדַּ֣ת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׂדֹתֵ֖י/נוּ וּ/כְרָמֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vysh 'shr 'mrym lvynv khsf lmdt hmlkh shdtynv vkhrmynv
verses.translation: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כִּ/בְשַׂ֤ר אַחֵ֨י/נוּ֙ בְּשָׂרֵ֔/נוּ כִּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּנֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אֲנַ֣חְנוּ כֹ֠בְשִׁים אֶת בָּנֵ֨י/נוּ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֵ֜י/נוּ לַ/עֲבָדִ֗ים וְ/יֵ֨שׁ מִ/בְּנֹתֵ֤י/נוּ נִכְבָּשׁוֹת֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין לְ/אֵ֣ל יָדֵ֔/נוּ וּ/שְׂדֹתֵ֥י/נוּ וּ/כְרָמֵ֖י/נוּ לַ/אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: v'th khbshr 'chynv bshrnv khbnyhm bnynv vhnh 'nchnv khbshym 't bnynv v't bntynv l'bdym vysh mbntynv nkhbshvt v'yn l'l ydnv vshdtynv vkhrmynv l'chrym
verses.translation: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥חַר לִ֖/י מְאֹ֑ד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת זַֽעֲקָתָ֔/ם וְ/אֵ֖ת הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vychr ly m'd kh'shr shm'ty 't z'qtm v't hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֨ךְ לִבִּ֜/י עָלַ֗/י וָ/אָרִ֨יבָ/ה֙ אֶת הַ/חֹרִ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/סְּגָנִ֔ים וָ/אֹמְרָ֣/ה לָ/הֶ֔ם מַשָּׁ֥א אִישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֖י/ו אַתֶּ֣ם נשאים נֹשִׁ֑ים וָ/אֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם קְהִלָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vymlkh lby 'ly v'rybh 't hchrym v't hsgnym v'mrh lhm msh' 'ysh b'chyv 'tm nsh'ym nshym v'tn 'lyhm qhlh gdvlh
verses.translation: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמְרָ֣/ה לָ/הֶ֗ם אֲנַ֣חְנוּ קָ֠נִינוּ אֶת אַחֵ֨י/נוּ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֜ים הַ/נִּמְכָּרִ֤ים לַ/גּוֹיִם֙ כְּ/דֵ֣י בָ֔/נוּ וְ/גַם אַתֶּ֛ם תִּמְכְּר֥וּ אֶת אֲחֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/נִמְכְּרוּ לָ֑/נוּ וַֽ/יַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ וְ/לֹ֥א מָצְא֖וּ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: v'mrh lhm 'nchnv qnynv 't 'chynv hyhvdym hnmkhrym lgvym khdy bnv vgm 'tm tmkhrv 't 'chykhm vnmkhrv lnv vychryshv vl' mts'v dbr
verses.translation: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer .

verses.original: ו/יאמר וָ/אוֹמַ֕ר לֹא ט֥וֹב הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֑ים הֲ/ל֞וֹא בְּ/יִרְאַ֤ת אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ מֵ/חֶרְפַּ֖ת הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם אוֹיְבֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr v'vmr l' tvb hdbr 'shr 'tm 'shym hlv' byr't 'lhynv tlkhv mchrpt hgvym 'vybynv
verses.translation: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִי֙ אַחַ֣/י וּ/נְעָרַ֔/י נֹשִׁ֥ים בָּ/הֶ֖ם כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/דָגָ֑ן נַֽעַזְבָה נָּ֖א אֶת הַ/מַּשָּׁ֥א הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'ny 'chy vn'ry nshym bhm khsf vdgn n'zbh n' 't hmsh' hzh
verses.translation: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

verses.original: הָשִׁיבוּ֩ נָ֨א לָ/הֶ֜ם כְּ/הַ/יּ֗וֹם שְׂדֹתֵי/הֶ֛ם כַּרְמֵי/הֶ֥ם זֵיתֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/בָתֵּי/הֶ֑ם וּ/מְאַ֨ת הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/הַ/דָּגָן֙ הַ/תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/הַ/יִּצְהָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם נֹשִׁ֥ים בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hshybv n' lhm khhyvm shdtyhm khrmyhm zytyhm vbtyhm vm't hkhsf vhdgn htyrvsh vhytshr 'shr 'tm nshym bhm
verses.translation: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ נָשִׁ֗יב וּ/מֵ/הֶם֙ לֹ֣א נְבַקֵּ֔שׁ כֵּ֣ן נַעֲשֶׂ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה אוֹמֵ֑ר וָ/אֶקְרָא֙ אֶת הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וָֽ/אַשְׁבִּיעֵ֔/ם לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv nshyb vmhm l' nbqsh khn n'shh kh'shr 'th 'vmr v'qr' 't hkhhnym v'shby'm l'shvt khdbr hzh
verses.translation: Then said they, We will restore them , and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

verses.original: גַּם חָצְנִ֣/י נָעַ֗רְתִּי וָֽ/אֹמְרָ֡/ה כָּ֣כָה יְנַעֵ֪ר הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֟ים אֶת כָּל הָ/אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יָקִ֜ים אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה מִ/בֵּית/וֹ֙ וּ/מִ֣/יגִיע֔/וֹ וְ/כָ֛כָה יִהְיֶ֥ה נָע֖וּר וָ/רֵ֑ק וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ כָֽל הַ/קָּהָ֜ל אָמֵ֗ן וַֽ/יְהַלְלוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/עָ֖ם כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: gm chtsny n'rty v'mrh khkhh yn'r h'lhym 't khl h'ysh 'shr l' yqym 't hdbr hzh mbytv vmygy'v vkhkhh yhyh n'vr vrq vy'mrv khl hqhl 'mn vyhllv 't yhvh vy'sh h'm khdbr hzh
verses.translation: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD . And the people did according to this promise.

verses.original: גַּ֞ם מִ/יּ֣וֹם אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה אֹתִ֗/י לִ/הְי֣וֹת פֶּחָ/ם֮ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָה֒ מִ/שְּׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְ֠/עַד שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ לְ/אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣סְתְּא הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׁנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֑ה אֲנִ֣י וְ/אַחַ֔/י לֶ֥חֶם הַ/פֶּ֖חָה לֹ֥א אָכַֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: gm myvm 'shr tsvh 'ty lhyvt pchm b'rts yhvdh mshnt 'shrym v'd shnt shlshym vshtym l'rtchshst' hmlkh shnym shtym 'shrh 'ny v'chy lchm hpchh l' 'khlty
verses.translation: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is , twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/פַּחוֹת֩ הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר לְ/פָנַ֜/י הִכְבִּ֣ידוּ עַל הָ/עָ֗ם וַ/יִּקְח֨וּ מֵ/הֶ֜ם בְּ/לֶ֤חֶם וָ/יַ֨יִן֙ אַחַר֙ כֶּֽסֶף שְׁקָלִ֣ים אַרְבָּעִ֔ים גַּ֥ם נַעֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם שָׁלְט֣וּ עַל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/אֲנִי֙ לֹא עָשִׂ֣יתִי כֵ֔ן מִ/פְּנֵ֖י יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vhpchvt hr'shnym 'shr lpny hkhbydv 'l h'm vyqchv mhm blchm vyyn 'chr khsf shqlym 'rb'ym gm n'ryhm shltv 'l h'm v'ny l' 'shyty khn mpny yr't 'lhym
verses.translation: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

verses.original: וְ֠/גַם בִּ/מְלֶ֜אכֶת הַ/חוֹמָ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ הֶחֱזַ֔קְתִּי וְ/שָׂדֶ֖ה לֹ֣א קָנִ֑ינוּ וְ/כָל נְעָרַ֔/י קְבוּצִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם עַל הַ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vgm bml'kht hchvmh hz't hchzqty vshdh l' qnynv vkhl n'ry qbvtsym shm 'l hml'khh
verses.translation: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יְּהוּדִ֨ים וְ/הַ/סְּגָנִ֜ים מֵאָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וְ/הַ/בָּאִ֥ים אֵלֵ֛י/נוּ מִן הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵ֖י/נוּ עַל שֻׁלְחָנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyhvdym vhsgnym m'h vchmshym 'ysh vhb'ym 'lynv mn hgvym 'shr sbybtynv 'l shlchny
verses.translation: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה לְ/י֣וֹם אֶחָ֗ד שׁ֣וֹר אֶחָ֞ד צֹ֠אן שֵׁשׁ בְּרֻר֤וֹת וְ/צִפֳּרִים֙ נַֽעֲשׂוּ לִ֔/י וּ/בֵ֨ין עֲשֶׂ֧רֶת יָמִ֛ים בְּ/כָל יַ֖יִן לְ/הַרְבֵּ֑ה וְ/עִם זֶ֗ה לֶ֤חֶם הַ/פֶּחָה֙ לֹ֣א בִקַּ֔שְׁתִּי כִּֽי כָֽבְדָ֥ה הָ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה עַל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'shr hyh n'shh lyvm 'chd shvr 'chd ts'n shsh brrvt vtsprym n'shv ly vbyn 'shrt ymym bkhl yyn lhrbh v'm zh lchm hpchh l' bqshty khy khbdh h'bdh 'l h'm hzh
verses.translation: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

verses.original: זָכְרָ/ה לִּ֥/י אֱלֹהַ֖/י לְ/טוֹבָ֑ה כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֖יתִי עַל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: zkhrh ly 'lhy ltvbh khl 'shr 'shyty 'l h'm hzh
verses.translation: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁמַ֣ע לְ/סַנְבַלַּ֣ט וְ֠/טוֹבִיָּה וּ/לְ/גֶ֨שֶׁם הָֽ/עַרְבִ֜י וּ/לְ/יֶ֣תֶר אֹֽיְבֵ֗י/נוּ כִּ֤י בָנִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת הַ֣/חוֹמָ֔ה וְ/לֹא נ֥וֹתַר בָּ֖/הּ פָּ֑רֶץ גַּ֚ם עַד הָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא דְּלָת֖וֹת לֹא הֶעֱמַ֥דְתִּי בַ/שְּׁעָרִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr nshm' lsnblt vtvbyh vlgshm h'rby vlytr 'ybynv khy bnyty 't hchvmh vl' nvtr bh prts gm 'd h't hhy' dltvt l' h'mdty bsh'rym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח סַנְבַלַּ֤ט וְ/גֶ֨שֶׁם֙ אֵלַ֣/י לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְכָ֞/ה וְ/נִֽוָּעֲדָ֥ה יַחְדָּ֛ו בַּ/כְּפִירִ֖ים בְּ/בִקְעַ֣ת אוֹנ֑וֹ וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ חֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לִ֖/י רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch snblt vgshm 'ly l'mr lkhh vnv'dh ychdv bkhpyrym bbq't 'vnv vhmh chshbym l'shvt ly r'h
verses.translation: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלְחָ֨/ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֤ם מַלְאָכִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מְלָאכָ֤ה גְדוֹלָה֙ אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לָ/רֶ֑דֶת לָ֣/מָּה תִשְׁבַּ֤ת הַ/מְּלָאכָה֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַרְפֶּ֔/הָ וְ/יָרַדְתִּ֖י אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'shlchh 'lyhm ml'khym l'mr ml'khh gdvlh 'ny 'shh vl' 'vkhl lrdt lmh tshbt hml'khh kh'shr 'rph vyrdty 'lykhm
verses.translation: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלַ֛/י כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה אַרְבַּ֣ע פְּעָמִ֑ים וָ/אָשִׁ֥יב אוֹתָ֖/ם כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshlchv 'ly khdbr hzh 'rb' p'mym v'shyb 'vtm khdbr hzh
verses.translation: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ אֵלַ֨/י סַנְבַלַּ֜ט כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֛ה פַּ֥עַם חֲמִישִׁ֖ית אֶֽת נַעֲר֑/וֹ וְ/אִגֶּ֥רֶת פְּתוּחָ֖ה בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'ly snblt khdbr hzh p'm chmyshyt 't n'rv v'grt ptvchh bydv
verses.translation: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

verses.original: כָּת֣וּב בָּ֗/הּ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֤ם נִשְׁמָע֙ וְ/גַשְׁמ֣וּ אֹמֵ֔ר אַתָּ֤ה וְ/הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ חֹשְׁבִ֣ים לִ/מְר֔וֹד עַל כֵּ֛ן אַתָּ֥ה בוֹנֶ֖ה הַ/חוֹמָ֑ה וְ/אַתָּ֗ה הֹוֶ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/מֶ֔לֶךְ כַּ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: khtvb bh bgvym nshm' vgshmv 'mr 'th vhyhvdym chshbym lmrvd 'l khn 'th bvnh hchvmh v'th hvh lhm lmlkh khdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

verses.original: וְ/גַם נְבִיאִ֡ים הֶעֱמַ֣דְתָּ לִ/קְרֹא֩ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מֶ֚לֶךְ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עַתָּה֙ יִשָּׁמַ֣ע לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כַּ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/עַתָּ֣ה לְכָ֔/ה וְ/נִֽוָּעֲצָ֖ה יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: vgm nby'ym h'mdt lqr' 'lykh byrvshlm l'mr mlkh byhvdh v'th yshm' lmlkh khdbrym h'lh v'th lkhh vnv'tsh ychdv
verses.translation: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלְחָ֤/ה אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ כַּ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתָּ֣ה אוֹמֵ֑ר כִּ֥י מִֽ/לִּבְּ/ךָ֖ אַתָּ֥ה בוֹדָֽא/ם
verses.translit: v'shlchh 'lyv l'mr l' nhyh khdbrym h'lh 'shr 'th 'vmr khy mlbkh 'th bvd'm
verses.translation: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֻלָּ֗/ם מְיָֽרְאִ֤ים אוֹתָ֨/נוּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יִרְפּ֧וּ יְדֵי/הֶ֛ם מִן הַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֖ה חַזֵּ֥ק אֶת יָדָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy khlm myr'ym 'vtnv l'mr yrpv ydyhm mn hml'khh vl' t'shh v'th chzq 't ydy
verses.translation: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God , strengthen my hands.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִי בָ֗אתִי בֵּ֣ית שְֽׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן דְּלָיָ֛ה בֶּן מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵ֖ל וְ/ה֣וּא עָצ֑וּר וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר נִוָּעֵד֩ אֶל בֵּ֨ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַֽ/הֵיכָ֗ל וְ/נִסְגְּרָה֙ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַ/הֵיכָ֔ל כִּ֚י בָּאִ֣ים לְ/הָרְגֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לַ֖יְלָה בָּאִ֥ים לְ/הָרְגֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'ny b'ty byt shm'yh bn dlyh bn mhytb'l vhv' 'tsvr vy'mr nv'd 'l byt h'lhym 'l tvkh hhykhl vnsgrh dltvt hhykhl khy b'ym lhrgkh vlylh b'ym lhrgkh
verses.translation: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמְרָ֗/ה הַ/אִ֤ישׁ כָּמ֨וֹ/נִי֙ יִבְרָ֔ח וּ/מִ֥י כָמ֛וֹ/נִי אֲשֶׁר יָב֥וֹא אֶל הַ/הֵיכָ֖ל וָ/חָ֑י לֹ֖א אָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: v'mrh h'ysh khmvny ybrch vmy khmvny 'shr ybv' 'l hhykhl vchy l' 'bv'
verses.translation: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there , that, being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

verses.original: וָ/אַכִּ֕ירָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה לֹֽא אֱלֹהִ֖ים שְׁלָח֑/וֹ כִּ֤י הַ/נְּבוּאָה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלַ֔/י וְ/טוֹבִיָּ֥ה וְ/סַנְבַלַּ֖ט שְׂכָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'khyrh vhnh l' 'lhym shlchv khy hnbv'h dbr 'ly vtvbyh vsnblt shkhrv
verses.translation: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן שָׂכוּר֙ ה֔וּא לְמַֽעַן אִירָ֥א וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה כֵּ֖ן וְ/חָטָ֑אתִי וְ/הָיָ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/שֵׁ֣ם רָ֔ע לְמַ֖עַן יְחָֽרְפֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: lm'n shkhvr hv' lm'n 'yr' v''shh khn vcht'ty vhyh lhm lshm r' lm'n ychrpvny
verses.translation: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

verses.original: זָכְרָ֧/ה אֱלֹהַ֛/י לְ/טוֹבִיָּ֥ה וּ/לְ/סַנְבַלַּ֖ט כְּ/מַעֲשָׂ֣י/ו אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/גַ֨ם לְ/נוֹעַדְיָ֤ה הַ/נְּבִיאָה֙ וּ/לְ/יֶ֣תֶר הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ מְיָֽרְאִ֥ים אוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: zkhrh 'lhy ltvbyh vlsnblt khm'shyv 'lh vgm lnv'dyh hnby'h vlytr hnby'ym 'shr hyv myr'ym 'vty
verses.translation: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁלַם֙ הַֽ/חוֹמָ֔ה בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לֶ/אֱל֑וּל לַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנַ֖יִם יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vtshlm hchvmh b'shrym vchmshh l'lvl lchmshym vshnym yvm
verses.translation: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ כָּל א֣וֹיְבֵ֔י/נוּ וַ/יִּֽרְא֗וּ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִֽיבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֚י מֵ/אֵ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה הַ/מְּלָאכָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm'v khl 'vybynv vyr'v khl hgvym 'shr sbybtynv vyplv m'd b'ynyhm vyd'v khy m't 'lhynv n'shth hml'khh hz't
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֗ם מַרְבִּ֞ים חֹרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ אִגְּרֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם הוֹלְכ֖וֹת עַל טוֹבִיָּ֑ה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בָּא֥וֹת אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: gm bymym hhm mrbym chry yhvdh 'grtyhm hvlkhvt 'l tvbyh v'shr ltvbyh b'vt 'lyhm
verses.translation: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.

verses.original: כִּי רַבִּ֣ים בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁבוּעָה֙ ל֔/וֹ כִּי חָתָ֥ן ה֖וּא לִ/שְׁכַנְיָ֣ה בֶן אָרַ֑ח וִֽ/יהוֹחָנָ֣ן בְּנ֔/וֹ לָקַ֕ח אֶת בַּת מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּ֥ן בֶּֽרֶכְיָֽה
verses.translit: khy rbym byhvdh b'ly shbv'h lv khy chtn hv' lshkhnyh bn 'rch vyhvchnn bnv lqch 't bt mshlm bn brkhyh
verses.translation: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם טוֹבֹתָ֗י/ו הָי֤וּ אֹמְרִים֙ לְ/פָנַ֔/י וּ/דְבָרַ֕/י הָי֥וּ מוֹצִיאִ֖ים ל֑/וֹ אִגְּר֛וֹת שָׁלַ֥ח טוֹבִיָּ֖ה לְ/יָֽרְאֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: gm tvbtyv hyv 'mrym lpny vdbry hyv mvtsy'ym lv 'grvt shlch tvbyh lyr'ny
verses.translation: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִבְנְתָה֙ הַ/חוֹמָ֔ה וָ/אַעֲמִ֖יד הַ/דְּלָת֑וֹת וַ/יִּפָּֽקְד֛וּ הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr nbnth hchvmh v''myd hdltvt vypqdv hshv'rym vhmshrrym vhlvym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

verses.original: וָ/אֲצַוֶּ֞ה אֶת חֲנָ֣נִי אָחִ֗/י וְ/אֶת חֲנַנְיָ֛ה שַׂ֥ר הַ/בִּירָ֖ה עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּי הוּא֙ כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ אֱמֶ֔ת וְ/יָרֵ֥א אֶת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵ/רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: v'tsvh 't chnny 'chy v't chnnyh shr hbyrh 'l yrvshlm khy hv' kh'ysh 'mt vyr' 't h'lhym mrbym
verses.translation: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

verses.original: ו/יאמר וָ/אֹמַ֣ר לָ/הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַד חֹ֣ם הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְ/עַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַ/דְּלָת֖וֹת וֶ/אֱחֹ֑זוּ וְ/הַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרוֹת֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אִ֚ישׁ בְּ/מִשְׁמָר֔/וֹ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr v'mr lhm l' yptchv sh'ry yrvshlm 'd chm hshmsh v'd hm 'mdym ygypv hdltvt v'chzv vh'myd mshmrvt yshby yrvshlm 'ysh bmshmrv v'ysh ngd bytv
verses.translation: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עִ֞יר רַחֲבַ֤ת יָדַ֨יִם֙ וּ/גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם מְעַ֖ט בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/הּ וְ/אֵ֥ין בָּתִּ֖ים בְּנוּיִֽם
verses.translit: vh'yr rchbt ydym vgdvlh vh'm m't btvkhh v'yn btym bnvym
verses.translation: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהַ/י֙ אֶל לִבִּ֔/י וָ/אֶקְבְּצָ֞/ה אֶת הַ/חֹרִ֧ים וְ/אֶת הַ/סְּגָנִ֛ים וְ/אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם לְ/הִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וָֽ/אֶמְצָ֗א סֵ֤פֶר הַ/יַּ֨חַשׂ֙ הָ/עוֹלִ֣ים בָּ/רִאשׁוֹנָ֔ה וָ/אֶמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytn 'lhy 'l lby v'qbtsh 't hchrym v't hsgnym v't h'm lhtychsh v'mts' spr hychsh h'vlym br'shvnh v'mts' khtvb bv
verses.translation: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינָ֗ה הָ/עֹלִים֙ מִ/שְּׁבִ֣י הַ/גּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַ/יָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/לִ/יהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְ/עִירֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'lh bny hmdynh h'lym mshby hgvlh 'shr hglh nbvkhdntsr mlkh bbl vyshvbv lyrvshlm vlyhvdh 'ysh l'yrv
verses.translation: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;

verses.original: הַ/בָּאִ֣ים עִם זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hb'ym 'm zrbbl yshv' nchmyh 'zryh r'myh nchmny mrdkhy blshn msprt bgvy nchvm b'nh mspr 'nshy 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say , of the men of the people of Israel was this;

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny pr'sh 'lpym m'h vshb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny shptyh shlsh m'vt shb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny 'rch shsh m'vt chmshym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִ/בְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ וְ/יוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: bny pcht mv'b lbny yshv' vyv'b 'lpym vshmnh m'vt shmnh 'shr
verses.translation: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny ztv' shmnh m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: bny zkhy shb' m'vt vshshym
verses.translation: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִנּ֔וּי שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: bny bnvy shsh m'vt 'rb'ym vshmnh
verses.translation: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: bny bby shsh m'vt 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny 'zgd 'lpym shlsh m'vt 'shrym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'dnyqm shsh m'vt shshym vshb'h
verses.translation: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: bny bgvy 'lpym shshym vshb'h
verses.translation: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny 'dyn shsh m'vt chmshym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי אָטֵ֥ר לְ/חִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'tr lchzqyh tsh'ym vshmnh
verses.translation: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: bny chshm shlsh m'vt 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny btsy shlsh m'vt 'shrym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔יף מֵאָ֖ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: bny chryf m'h shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny gb'vn tsh'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית לֶ֨חֶם֙ וּ/נְטֹפָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: 'nshy byt lchm vntph m'h shmnym vshmnh
verses.translation: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: 'nshy 'ntvt m'h 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵית עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'nshy byt 'zmvt 'rb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת יְעָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּ/בְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: 'nshy qryt y'rym khpyrh vb'rvt shb' m'vt 'rb'ym vshlshh
verses.translation: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָֽ/רָמָה֙ וָ/גָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'nshy hrmh vgb' shsh m'vt 'shrym v'chd
verses.translation: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'nshy mkhms m'h v'shrym vshnym
verses.translation: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית אֵל֙ וְ/הָ/עָ֔י מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: 'nshy byt 'l vh'y m'h 'shrym vshlshh
verses.translation: The men of Beth-el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְב֛וֹ אַחֵ֖ר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'nshy nbv 'chr chmshym vshnym
verses.translation: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny 'ylm 'chr 'lf m'tym chmshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: bny chrm shlsh m'vt v'shrym
verses.translation: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֔וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bny yrchv shlsh m'vt 'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

verses.original: בְּנֵי לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְ/אוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: bny ld chdyd v'vnv shb' m'vt v'shrym v'chd
verses.translation: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: bny sn'h shlsht 'lpym tsh' m'vt vshlshym
verses.translation: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

verses.original: הַֽ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: hkhhnym bny yd'yh lbyt yshv' tsh' m'vt shb'ym vshlshh
verses.translation: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny 'mr 'lf chmshym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: bny pshchvr 'lf m'tym 'rb'ym vshb'h
verses.translation: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: bny chrm 'lf shb'h 'shr
verses.translation: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

verses.original: הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵֽי יֵשׁ֧וּעַ לְ/קַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י לְ/הוֹדְוָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: hlvym bny yshv' lqdmy'l lbny lhvdvh shb'ym v'rb'h
verses.translation: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

verses.original: הַֽ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: hmshrrym bny 'sf m'h 'rb'ym vshmnh
verses.translation: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

verses.original: הַ/שֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵֽי שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵֽי טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵֽי עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: hsh'rym bny shlvm bny 'tr bny tlmn bny 'qvb bny chtyt' bny shby m'h shlshym vshmnh
verses.translation: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.

verses.original: הַ/נְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי צִחָ֥א בְנֵי חֲשֻׂפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת
verses.translit: hntynym bny tsch' bny chshp' bny tb'vt
verses.translation: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

verses.original: בְּנֵי קֵירֹ֥ס בְּנֵי סִיעָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן
verses.translit: bny qyrs bny sy'' bny pdvn
verses.translation: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

verses.original: בְּנֵי לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שַׁלְמָֽי
verses.translit: bny lbnh bny chgbh bny shlmy
verses.translation: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,

verses.original: בְּנֵי חָנָ֥ן בְּנֵי גִדֵּ֖ל בְּנֵי גָֽחַר
verses.translit: bny chnn bny gdl bny gchr
verses.translation: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

verses.original: בְּנֵי רְאָיָ֥ה בְנֵי רְצִ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י נְקוֹדָֽא
verses.translit: bny r'yh bny rtsyn bny nqvd'
verses.translation: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

verses.original: בְּנֵי גַזָּ֥ם בְּנֵי עֻזָּ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָסֵֽחַ
verses.translit: bny gzm bny 'z' bny psch
verses.translation: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בֵסַ֥י בְּנֵי מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י נפושסים נְפִֽישְׁסִֽים
verses.translit: bny bsy bny m'vnym bny npvshsym npyshsym
verses.translation: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵֽי חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר
verses.translit: bny bqbvq bny chqvp' bny chrchvr
verses.translation: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בַצְלִ֥ית בְּנֵֽי מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא
verses.translit: bny btslyt bny mchyd' bny chrsh'
verses.translation: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

verses.original: בְּנֵי בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי תָֽמַח
verses.translit: bny brqvs bny sysr' bny tmch
verses.translation: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא
verses.translit: bny ntsych bny chtyp'
verses.translation: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי סוֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי סוֹפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא
verses.translit: bny 'bdy shlmh bny svty bny svprt bny pryd'
verses.translation: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

verses.original: בְּנֵי יַעְלָ֥א בְנֵי דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל
verses.translit: bny y'l' bny drqvn bny gdl
verses.translation: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֽוֹן
verses.translit: bny shptyh bny chtyl bny pkhrt htsbyym bny 'mvn
verses.translation: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

verses.original: כָּל הַ֨/נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: khl hntynym vbny 'bdy shlmh shlsh m'vt tsh'ym vshnym
verses.translation: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה הָֽ/עוֹלִים֙ מִ/תֵּ֥ל מֶ֨לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדּ֖וֹן וְ/אִמֵּ֑ר וְ/לֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְ/הַגִּ֤יד בֵּית אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/זַרְעָ֔/ם אִ֥ם מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם
verses.translit: v'lh h'vlym mtl mlch tl chrsh' khrvb 'dvn v'mr vl' ykhlv lhgyd byt 'bvtm vzr'm 'm myshr'l hm
verses.translation: And these were they which went up also from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵי דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny dlyh bny tvbyh bny nqvd' shsh m'vt v'rb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִ/בְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/יִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל שְׁמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vmn hkhhnym bny chbyh bny hqvts bny brzly 'shr lqch mbnvt brzly hgl'dy 'shh vyqr' 'l shmm
verses.translation: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛/ם הַ/מִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְ/לֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַ/יְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן הַ/כְּהֻנָּֽה
verses.translit: 'lh bqshv khtbm hmtychshym vl' nmts' vyg'lv mn hkhhnh
verses.translation: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֨תָא֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יֹאכְל֖וּ מִ/קֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לְ/אוּרִ֥ים וְ/תוּמִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr htrsht' lhm 'shr l' y'khlv mqdsh hqdshym 'd 'md hkhhn l'vrym vtvmym
verses.translation: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֖ל כְּ/אֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: khl hqhl kh'chd 'rb' rbv' 'lpym shlsh m'vt vshshym
verses.translation: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

verses.original: מִ֠/לְּ/בַד עַבְדֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/אַמְהֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְ/לָ/הֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּ/מְשֹׁ֣רֲר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: mlbd 'bdyhm v'mhtyhm 'lh shb't 'lpym shlsh m'vt shlshym vshb'h vlhm mshrrym vmshrrvt m'tym v'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

verses.original: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: gmlym 'rb' m'vt shlshym vchmshh chmrym shsht 'lpym shb' m'vt v'shrym
verses.translation: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/קְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַ/מְּלָאכָ֑ה הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָ/אוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ מִזְרָק֣וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כָּתְנוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmqtst r'shy h'bvt ntnv lml'khh htrsht' ntn l'vtsr zhb drkhmnym 'lf mzrqvt chmshym khtnvt khhnym shlshym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

verses.original: וּ/מֵֽ/רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְ/אוֹצַ֣ר הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְ/כֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vmr'shy h'bvt ntnv l'vtsr hml'khh zhb drkhmvnym shty rbvt vkhsf mnym 'lpym vm'tym
verses.translation: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests’ garments.

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָ/עָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְ/כֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְ/כָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: v'shr ntnv sh'ryt h'm zhb drkhmvnym shty rbv' vkhsf mnym 'lpym vkhtnt khhnym shshym vshb'h
verses.translation: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֡ם וְ/הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּ/מִן הָ/עָ֧ם וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֛ים וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּגַּע֙ הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshbv hkhhnym vhlvym vhshv'rym vhmshrrym vmn h'm vhntynym vkhl yshr'l b'ryhm vyg' hchdsh hshby'y vbny yshr'l b'ryhm
verses.translation: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests’ garments.

So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֤וּ כָל הָ/עָם֙ כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֔ד אֶל הָ֣/רְח֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ לְ/עֶזְרָ֣א הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר לְ/הָבִ֗יא אֶת סֵ֨פֶר֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'spv khl h'm kh'ysh 'chd 'l hrchvb 'shr lpny sh'r hmym vy'mrv l'zr' hspr lhby' 't spr tvrt mshh 'shr tsvh yhvh 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֣יא עֶזְרָ֣א הַ֠/כֹּהֵן אֶֽת הַ/תּוֹרָ֞ה לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/קָּהָל֙ מֵ/אִ֣ישׁ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/כֹ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין לִ/שְׁמֹ֑עַ בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vyby' 'zr' hkhhn 't htvrh lpny hqhl m'ysh v'd 'shh vkhl mbyn lshm' byvm 'chd lchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא ב/וֹ֩ לִ/פְנֵ֨י הָ/רְח֜וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר הַ/מַּ֗יִם מִן הָ/אוֹר֙ עַד מַחֲצִ֣ית הַ/יּ֔וֹם נֶ֛גֶד הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים וְ/הַ/מְּבִינִ֑ים וְ/אָזְנֵ֥י כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל סֵ֥פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' bv lpny hrchvb 'shr lpny sh'r hmym mn h'vr 'd mchtsyt hyvm ngd h'nshym vhnshym vhmbynym v'zny khl h'm 'l spr htvrh
verses.translation: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֞ד עֶזְרָ֣א הַ/סֹּפֵ֗ר עַֽל מִגְדַּל עֵץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ לַ/דָּבָר֒ וַ/יַּֽעֲמֹ֣ד אֶצְל֡/וֹ מַתִּתְיָ֡ה וְ/שֶׁ֡מַע וַ֠/עֲנָיָה וְ/אוּרִיָּ֧ה וְ/חִלְקִיָּ֛ה וּ/מַעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה עַל יְמִינ֑/וֹ וּ/מִ/שְּׂמֹאל֗/וֹ פְּ֠דָיָה וּ/מִֽישָׁאֵ֧ל וּ/מַלְכִּיָּ֛ה וְ/חָשֻׁ֥ם וְ/חַשְׁבַּדָּ֖נָה זְכַרְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּֽם
verses.translit: vy'md 'zr' hspr 'l mgdl 'ts 'shr 'shv ldbr vy'md 'tslv mttyh vshm' v'nyh v'vryh vchlqyh vm'shyh 'l ymynv vmshm'lv pdyh vmysh'l vmlkhyh vchshm vchshbdnh zkhryh mshlm
verses.translation: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְתַּ֨ח עֶזְרָ֤א הַ/סֵּ֨פֶר֙ לְ/עֵינֵ֣י כָל הָ/עָ֔ם כִּֽי מֵ/עַ֥ל כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם הָיָ֑ה וּ/כְ/פִתְח֖/וֹ עָֽמְד֥וּ כָל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyptch 'zr' hspr l'yny khl h'm khy m'l khl h'm hyh vkhptchv 'mdv khl h'm
verses.translation: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

verses.original: וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ עֶזְרָ֔א אֶת יְהוָ֥ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים הַ/גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יַּֽעֲנ֨וּ כָל הָ/עָ֜ם אָמֵ֤ן אָמֵן֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עַל יְדֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּקְּד֧וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּחֲוֻּ֛ לַ/יהוָ֖ה אַפַּ֥יִם אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vybrkh 'zr' 't yhvh h'lhym hgdvl vy'nv khl h'm 'mn 'mn bm'l ydyhm vyqdv vyshtchv lyhvh 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Ezra blessed the LORD , the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

verses.original: וְ/יֵשׁ֡וּעַ וּ/בָנִ֡י וְ/שֵׁרֵ֥בְיָ֣ה יָמִ֡ין עַקּ֡וּב שַׁבְּתַ֣י הֽוֹדִיָּ֡ה מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה קְלִיטָ֣א עֲזַרְיָה֩ יוֹזָבָ֨ד חָנָ֤ן פְּלָאיָה֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מְבִינִ֥ים אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם לַ/תּוֹרָ֑ה וְ/הָ/עָ֖ם עַל עָמְדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshv' vbny vshrbyh ymyn 'qvb shbty hvdyh m'shyh qlyt' 'zryh yvzbd chnn pl'yh vhlvym mbynym 't h'm ltvrh vh'm 'l 'mdm
verses.translation: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְא֥וּ בַ/סֵּ֛פֶר בְּ/תוֹרַ֥ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים מְפֹרָ֑שׁ וְ/שׂ֣וֹם שֶׂ֔כֶל וַ/יָּבִ֖ינוּ בַּ/מִּקְרָֽא
verses.translit: vyqr'v bspr btvrt h'lhym mprsh vshvm shkhl vybynv bmqr'
verses.translation: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר נְחֶמְיָ֣ה ה֣וּא הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֡תָא וְ/עֶזְרָ֣א הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֡ר וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּם֩ הַ/מְּבִינִ֨ים אֶת הָ/עָ֜ם לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/יּ֤וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ הוּא֙ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם אַל תִּֽתְאַבְּל֖וּ וְ/אַל תִּבְכּ֑וּ כִּ֤י בוֹכִים֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם כְּ/שָׁמְעָ֖/ם אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr nchmyh hv' htrsht' v'zr' hkhhn hspr vhlvym hmbynym 't h'm lkhl h'm hyvm qdsh hv' lyhvh 'lhykhm 'l tt'blv v'l tbkhv khy bvkhym khl h'm khshm'm 't dbry htvrh
verses.translation: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֡ם לְכוּ֩ אִכְל֨וּ מַשְׁמַנִּ֜ים וּ/שְׁת֣וּ מַֽמְתַקִּ֗ים וְ/שִׁלְח֤וּ מָנוֹת֙ לְ/אֵ֣ין נָכ֣וֹן ל֔/וֹ כִּֽי קָד֥וֹשׁ הַ/יּ֖וֹם לַ/אֲדֹנֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/אַל תֵּ֣עָצֵ֔בוּ כִּֽי חֶדְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא מָֽעֻזְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm lkhv 'khlv mshmnym vshtv mmtqym vshlchv mnvt l'yn nkhvn lv khy qdvsh hyvm l'dnynv v'l t'tsbv khy chdvt yhvh hy' m'zkhm
verses.translation: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֞ם מַחְשִׁ֤ים לְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֣ר הַ֔סּוּ כִּ֥י הַ/יּ֖וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ וְ/אַל תֵּעָצֵֽבוּ
verses.translit: vhlvym mchshym lkhl h'm l'mr hsv khy hyvm qdsh v'l t'tsbv
verses.translation: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֨וּ כָל הָ/עָ֜ם לֶ/אֱכֹ֤ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּוֹת֙ וּ/לְ/שַׁלַּ֣ח מָנ֔וֹת וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֵבִ֨ינוּ֙ בַּ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹדִ֖יעוּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vylkhv khl h'm l'khl vlshtvt vlshlch mnvt vl'shvt shmchh gdvlh khy hbynv bdbrym 'shr hvdy'v lhm
verses.translation: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֡י נֶאֶסְפוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָ/אָב֜וֹת לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל עֶזְרָ֖א הַ/סֹּפֵ֑ר וּ/לְ/הַשְׂכִּ֖יל אֶל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vbyvm hshny n'spv r'shy h'bvt lkhl h'm hkhhnym vhlvym 'l 'zr' hspr vlhshkhyl 'l dbry htvrh
verses.translation: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֖וּ כָּת֣וּב בַּ/תּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ יֵשְׁב֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל בַּ/סֻּכּ֛וֹת בֶּ/חָ֖ג בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vymts'v khtvb btvrh 'shr tsvh yhvh byd mshh 'shr yshbv bny yshr'l bskhvt bchg bchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ וְ/יַעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בְּ/כָל עָרֵי/הֶם֮ וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לֵ/אמֹר֒ צְא֣וּ הָ/הָ֗ר וְ/הָבִ֨יאוּ֙ עֲלֵי זַ֨יִת֙ וַ/עֲלֵי עֵ֣ץ שֶׁ֔מֶן וַ/עֲלֵ֤י הֲדַס֙ וַ/עֲלֵ֣י תְמָרִ֔ים וַ/עֲלֵ֖י עֵ֣ץ עָבֹ֑ת לַ/עֲשֹׂ֥ת סֻכֹּ֖ת כַּ/כָּתֽוּב
verses.translit: v'shr yshmy'v vy'byrv qvl bkhl 'ryhm vbyrvshlm l'mr ts'v hhr vhby'v 'ly zyt v'ly 'ts shmn v'ly hds v'ly tmrym v'ly 'ts 'bt l'sht skht khkhtvb
verses.translation: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֣וּ הָ/עָם֮ וַ/יָּבִיאוּ֒ וַ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם סֻכּ֜וֹת אִ֤ישׁ עַל גַּגּ/וֹ֙ וּ/בְ/חַצְרֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/חַצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ/בִ/רְחוֹב֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מַּ֔יִם וּ/בִ/רְח֖וֹב שַׁ֥עַר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyts'v h'm vyby'v vy'shv lhm skhvt 'ysh 'l ggv vbchtsrtyhm vbchtsrvt byt h'lhym vbrchvb sh'r hmym vbrchvb sh'r 'prym
verses.translation: So the people went forth, and brought them , and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֣וּ כָֽל הַ֠/קָּהָל הַ/שָּׁבִ֨ים מִן הַ/שְּׁבִ֥י סֻכּוֹת֮ וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ בַ/סֻּכּוֹת֒ כִּ֣י לֹֽא עָשׂ֡וּ מִ/ימֵי֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בִּן נ֥וּן כֵּן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/תְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'shv khl hqhl hshbym mn hshby skhvt vyshbv bskhvt khy l' 'shv mymy yshv' bn nvn khn bny yshr'l 'd hyvm hhv' vthy shmchh gdvlh m'd
verses.translation: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּקְרָא בְּ/סֵ֨פֶר תּוֹרַ֤ת הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ י֣וֹם בְּ/י֔וֹם מִן הַ/יּוֹם֙ הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/אַחֲר֑וֹן וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ חָג֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֛י עֲצֶ֖רֶת כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vyqr' bspr tvrt h'lhym yvm byvm mn hyvm hr'shvn 'd hyvm h'chrvn vy'shv chg shb't ymym vbyvm hshmyny 'tsrt khmshpt
verses.translation: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/יוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֗ה נֶאֶסְפ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/צ֣וֹם וּ/בְ/שַׂקִּ֔ים וַ/אֲדָמָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm 'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh hzh n'spv bny yshr'l btsvm vbshqym v'dmh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבָּֽדְלוּ֙ זֶ֣רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָ֑ר וַ/יַּעַמְד֗וּ וַ/יִּתְוַדּוּ֙ עַל חַטֹּ֣אתֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/עֲוֺנ֖וֹת אֲבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vybdlv zr' yshr'l mkhl bny nkhr vy'mdv vytvdv 'l cht'tyhm v'vnvt 'btyhm
verses.translation: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֨וּמוּ֙ עַל עָמְדָ֔/ם וַֽ/יִּקְרְא֗וּ בְּ/סֵ֨פֶר תּוֹרַ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם רְבִעִ֣ית הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/רְבִעִית֙ מִתְוַדִּ֣ים וּ/מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔ים לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqvmv 'l 'mdm vyqr'v bspr tvrt yhvh 'lhyhm rb'yt hyvm vrb'yt mtvdym vmshtchvym lyhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜קָם עַֽל מַֽעֲלֵ֣ה הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּ/בָנִ֜י קַדְמִיאֵ֧ל שְׁבַנְיָ֛ה בֻּנִּ֥י שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה בָּנִ֣י כְנָ֑נִי וַֽ/יִּזְעֲקוּ֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqm 'l m'lh hlvym yshv' vbny qdmy'l shbnyh bny shrbyh bny khnny vyz'qv bqvl gdvl 'l yhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֡ם יֵשׁ֣וּעַ וְ֠/קַדְמִיאֵל בָּנִ֨י חֲשַׁבְנְיָ֜ה שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֤ה הֽוֹדִיָּה֙ שְׁבַנְיָ֣ה פְתַֽחְיָ֔ה ק֗וּמוּ בָּרֲכוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם מִן הָ/עוֹלָ֖ם עַד הָ/עוֹלָ֑ם וִ/יבָֽרְכוּ֙ שֵׁ֣ם כְּבוֹדֶ֔/ךָ וּ/מְרוֹמַ֥ם עַל כָּל בְּרָכָ֖ה וּ/תְהִלָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv hlvym yshv' vqdmy'l bny chshbnyh shrbyh hvdyh shbnyh ptchyh qvmv brkhv 't yhvh 'lhykhm mn h'vlm 'd h'vlm vybrkhv shm khbvdkh vmrvmm 'l khl brkhh vthlh
verses.translation: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

verses.original: אַתָּה ה֣וּא יְהוָה֮ לְ/בַדֶּ/ךָ֒ את אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֡יתָ אֶֽת הַ/שָּׁמַיִם֩ שְׁמֵ֨י הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם וְ/כָל צְבָאָ֗/ם הָ/אָ֜רֶץ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ הַ/יַּמִּים֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אַתָּ֖ה מְחַיֶּ֣ה אֶת כֻּלָּ֑/ם וּ/צְבָ֥א הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם לְ/ךָ֥ מִשְׁתַּחֲוִֽים
verses.translit: 'th hv' yhvh lbdkh 't 'th 'shyt 't hshmym shmy hshmym vkhl tsb'm h'rts vkhl 'shr 'lyh hymym vkhl 'shr bhm v'th mchyh 't khlm vtsb' hshmym lkh mshtchvym
verses.translation: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

verses.original: אַתָּה הוּא֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֨רְתָּ֙ בְּ/אַבְרָ֔ם וְ/הוֹצֵאת֖/וֹ מֵ/א֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים וְ/שַׂ֥מְתָּ שְּׁמ֖/וֹ אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: 'th hv' yhvh h'lhym 'shr bchrt b'brm vhvts'tv m'vr khshdym vshmt shmv 'brhm
verses.translation: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

verses.original: וּ/מָצָ֣אתָ אֶת לְבָב/וֹ֮ נֶאֱמָ֣ן לְ/פָנֶי/ךָ֒ וְ/כָר֨וֹת עִמּ֜/וֹ הַ/בְּרִ֗ית לָ/תֵ֡ת אֶת אֶרֶץ֩ הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֨י הַ/חִתִּ֜י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֧י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֛י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֥י וְ/הַ/גִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י לָ/תֵ֣ת לְ/זַרְע֑/וֹ וַ/תָּ֨קֶם֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֥י צַדִּ֖יק אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vmts't 't lbbv n'mn lpnykh vkhrvt 'mv hbryt ltt 't 'rts hkhn'ny hchty h'mry vhprzy vhybvsy vhgrgshy ltt lzr'v vtqm 't dbrykh khy tsdyq 'th
verses.translation: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say , to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֛רֶא אֶת עֳנִ֥י אֲבֹתֵ֖י/נוּ בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת זַעֲקָתָ֥/ם שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַל יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: vtr' 't 'ny 'btynv bmtsrym v't z'qtm shm't 'l ym svf
verses.translation: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

verses.original: וַ֠/תִּתֵּן אֹתֹ֨ת וּ/מֹֽפְתִ֜ים בְּ/פַרְעֹ֤ה וּ/בְ/כָל עֲבָדָי/ו֙ וּ/בְ/כָל עַ֣ם אַרְצ֔/וֹ כִּ֣י יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֥י הֵזִ֖ידוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/תַּֽעַשׂ לְ/ךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם כְּ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vttn 'tt vmptym bpr'h vbkhl 'bdyv vbkhl 'm 'rtsv khy yd't khy hzydv 'lyhm vt'sh lkh shm khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּם֙ בָּקַ֣עְתָּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְ/תוֹךְ הַ/יָּ֖ם בַּ/יַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וְֽ/אֶת רֹ֨דְפֵי/הֶ֜ם הִשְׁלַ֧כְתָּ בִ/מְצוֹלֹ֛ת כְּמוֹ אֶ֖בֶן בְּ/מַ֥יִם עַזִּֽים
verses.translit: vhym bq't lpnyhm vy'brv btvkh hym bybshh v't rdpyhm hshlkht bmtsvlt khmv 'bn bmym 'zym
verses.translation: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/עַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן הִנְחִיתָ֖/ם יוֹמָ֑ם וּ/בְ/עַמּ֥וּד אֵשׁ֙ לַ֔יְלָה לְ/הָאִ֣יר לָ/הֶ֔ם אֶת הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vb'mvd 'nn hnchytm yvmm vb'mvd 'sh lylh lh'yr lhm 't hdrkh 'shr ylkhv bh
verses.translation: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֤ל הַר סִינַי֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ וְ/דַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּ/הֶ֖ם מִ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/תִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֜ם מִשְׁפָּטִ֤ים יְשָׁרִים֙ וְ/תוֹר֣וֹת אֱמֶ֔ת חֻקִּ֥ים וּ/מִצְוֺ֖ת טוֹבִֽים
verses.translit: v'l hr syny yrdt vdbr 'mhm mshmym vttn lhm mshptym yshrym vtvrvt 'mt chqym vmtsvt tvbym
verses.translation: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת שַׁבַּ֥ת קָדְשְׁ/ךָ֖ הוֹדַ֣עַתָ לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִצְו֤וֹת וְ/חֻקִּים֙ וְ/תוֹרָ֔ה צִוִּ֣יתָ לָ/הֶ֔ם בְּ/יַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v't shbt qdshkh hvd't lhm vmtsvvt vchqym vtvrh tsvyt lhm byd mshh 'bdkh
verses.translation: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

verses.original: וְ֠/לֶחֶם מִ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם נָתַ֤תָּה לָ/הֶם֙ לִ/רְעָבָ֔/ם וּ/מַ֗יִם מִ/סֶּ֛לַע הוֹצֵ֥אתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם לִ/צְמָאָ֑/ם וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם לָ/בוֹא֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂ֥אתָ אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֖ לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vlchm mshmym ntth lhm lr'bm vmym msl' hvts't lhm ltsm'm vt'mr lhm lbv' lrsht 't h'rts 'shr nsh't 't ydkh ltt lhm
verses.translation: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֥ם וַ/אֲבֹתֵ֖י/נוּ הֵזִ֑ידוּ וַ/יַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת עָרְפָּ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ אֶל מִצְוֺתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhm v'btynv hzydv vyqshv 't 'rpm vl' shm'v 'l mtsvtykh
verses.translation: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֲנ֣וּ לִ/שְׁמֹ֗עַ וְ/לֹא זָכְר֤וּ נִפְלְאֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת עָרְפָּ֔/ם וַ/יִּתְּנוּ רֹ֛אשׁ לָ/שׁ֥וּב לְ/עַבְדֻתָ֖/ם בְּ/מִרְיָ֑/ם וְ/אַתָּה֩ אֱל֨וֹהַּ סְלִיח֜וֹת חַנּ֧וּן וְ/רַח֛וּם אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּ֥יִם וְ/רַב ו/חסד חֶ֖סֶד וְ/לֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vym'nv lshm' vl' zkhrv npl'tykh 'shr 'shyt 'mhm vyqshv 't 'rpm vytnv r'sh lshvb l'bdtm bmrym v'th 'lvh slychvt chnvn vrchvm 'rkh 'pym vrb vchsd chsd vl' 'zbtm
verses.translation: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

verses.original: אַ֗ף כִּֽי עָשׂ֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ זֶ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֶלְ/ךָ֖ מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'f khy 'shv lhm 'gl mskhh vy'mrv zh 'lhykh 'shr h'lkh mmtsrym vy'shv n'tsvt gdlvt
verses.translation: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ בְּ/רַחֲמֶ֣י/ךָ הָֽ/רַבִּ֔ים לֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּ֖/ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר אֶת עַמּ֣וּד הֶ֠/עָנָן לֹא סָ֨ר מֵ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֤ם בְּ/יוֹמָם֙ לְ/הַנְחֹתָ֣/ם בְּ/הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/אֶת עַמּ֨וּד הָ/אֵ֤שׁ בְּ/לַ֨יְלָה֙ לְ/הָאִ֣יר לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'th brchmykh hrbym l' 'zbtm bmdbr 't 'mvd h'nn l' sr m'lyhm byvmm lhnchtm bhdrkh v't 'mvd h'sh blylh lh'yr lhm v't hdrkh 'shr ylkhv bh
verses.translation: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

verses.original: וְ/רוּחֲ/ךָ֨ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה נָתַ֖תָּ לְ/הַשְׂכִּילָ֑/ם וּ/מַנְ/ךָ֙ לֹא מָנַ֣עְתָּ מִ/פִּי/הֶ֔ם וּ/מַ֛יִם נָתַ֥תָּה לָ/הֶ֖ם לִ/צְמָאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vrvchkh htvbh ntt lhshkhylm vmnkh l' mn't mpyhm vmym ntth lhm ltsm'm
verses.translation: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה כִּלְכַּלְתָּ֥/ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑רוּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ לֹ֣א בָל֔וּ וְ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֥א בָצֵֽקוּ
verses.translit: v'rb'ym shnh khlkhltm bmdbr l' chsrv shlmtyhm l' blv vrglyhm l' btsqv
verses.translation: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֤ם מַמְלָכוֹת֙ וַ/עֲמָמִ֔ים וַֽ/תַּחְלְקֵ֖/ם לְ/פֵאָ֑ה וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֞וּ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ סִיח֗וֹן וְ/אֶת אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן וְ/אֶת אֶ֖רֶץ ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vttn lhm mmlkhvt v'mmym vtchlqm lp'h vyyrshv 't 'rts sychvn v't 'rts mlkh chshbvn v't 'rts 'vg mlkh hbshn
verses.translation: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֣ם הִרְבִּ֔יתָ כְּ/כֹכְבֵ֖י הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/תְּבִיאֵ/ם֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אָמַ֥רְתָּ לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם לָ/ב֥וֹא לָ/רָֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vbnyhm hrbyt khkhkhby hshmym vtby'm 'l h'rts 'shr 'mrt l'btyhm lbv' lrsht
verses.translation: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it .

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ הַ/בָּנִים֙ וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/תַּכְנַ֨ע לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ הַ/כְּנַ֣עֲנִ֔ים וַֽ/תִּתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם וְ/אֶת מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/אֶת עַֽמְמֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת בָּ/הֶ֖ם כִּ/רְצוֹנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyb'v hbnym vyyrshv 't h'rts vtkhn' lpnyhm 't yshby h'rts hkhn'nym vttnm bydm v't mlkhyhm v't 'mmy h'rts l'shvt bhm khrtsvnm
verses.translation: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֞וּ עָרִ֣ים בְּצֻרוֹת֮ וַ/אֲדָמָ֣ה שְׁמֵנָה֒ וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֡וּ בָּתִּ֣ים מְלֵֽאִים כָּל ט֠וּב בֹּר֨וֹת חֲצוּבִ֜ים כְּרָמִ֧ים וְ/זֵיתִ֛ים וְ/עֵ֥ץ מַאֲכָ֖ל לָ/רֹ֑ב וַ/יֹּאכְל֤וּ וַֽ/יִּשְׂבְּעוּ֙ וַ/יַּשְׁמִ֔ינוּ וַ/יִּֽתְעַדְּנ֖וּ בְּ/טוּבְ/ךָ֥ הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vylkhdv 'rym btsrvt v'dmh shmnh vyyrshv btym ml'ym khl tvb brvt chtsvbym khrmym vzytym v'ts m'khl lrb vy'khlv vyshb'v vyshmynv vyt'dnv btvbkh hgdvl
verses.translation: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְר֨וּ וַֽ/יִּמְרְד֜וּ בָּ֗/ךְ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֤כוּ אֶת תּוֹרָֽתְ/ךָ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוָּ֔/ם וְ/אֶת נְבִיאֶ֣י/ךָ הָרָ֔גוּ אֲשֶׁר הֵעִ֥ידוּ בָ֖/ם לַ/הֲשִׁיבָ֣/ם אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדוֹלֹֽת
verses.translit: vymrv vymrdv bkh vyshlkhv 't tvrtkh 'chry gvm v't nby'ykh hrgv 'shr h'ydv bm lhshybm 'lykh vy'shv n'tsvt gdvlt
verses.translation: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

verses.original: וַֽ/תִּתְּנֵ/ם֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד צָֽרֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּצֵ֖רוּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/בְ/עֵ֤ת צָֽרָתָ/ם֙ יִצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַתָּה֙ מִ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם תִּשְׁמָ֔ע וּֽ/כְ/רַחֲמֶ֣י/ךָ הָֽ/רַבִּ֗ים תִּתֵּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעִ֔ים וְ/יוֹשִׁיע֖וּ/ם מִ/יַּ֥ד צָרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vttnm byd tsryhm vytsrv lhm vb't tsrtm yts'qv 'lykh v'th mshmym tshm' vkhrchmykh hrbym ttn lhm mvshy'ym vyvshy'vm myd tsryhm
verses.translation: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/נ֣וֹחַ לָ/הֶ֔ם יָשׁ֕וּבוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת רַ֖ע לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/תַּֽעַזְבֵ֞/ם בְּ/יַ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יִּרְדּ֣וּ בָ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּשׁ֨וּבוּ֙ וַ/יִּזְעָק֔וּ/ךָ וְ/אַתָּ֞ה מִ/שָּׁמַ֧יִם תִּשְׁמַ֛ע וְ/תַצִּילֵ֥/ם כְּֽ/רַחֲמֶ֖י/ךָ רַבּ֥וֹת עִתִּֽים
verses.translit: vkhnvch lhm yshvbv l'shvt r' lpnykh vt'zbm byd 'ybyhm vyrdv bhm vyshvbv vyz'qvkh v'th mshmym tshm' vttsylm khrchmykh rbvt 'tym
verses.translation: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֨עַד בָּ/הֶ֜ם לַ/הֲשִׁיבָ֣/ם אֶל תּוֹרָתֶ֗/ךָ וְ/הֵ֨מָּה הֵזִ֜ידוּ וְ/לֹא שָׁמְע֤וּ לְ/מִצְוֺתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּ/בְ/מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣י/ךָ חָֽטְאוּ בָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וְ/חָיָ֣ה בָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ כָתֵף֙ סוֹרֶ֔רֶת וְ/עָרְפָּ֥/ם הִקְשׁ֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: vt'd bhm lhshybm 'l tvrtkh vhmh hzydv vl' shm'v lmtsvtykh vbmshptykh cht'v bm 'shr y'shh 'dm vchyh bhm vytnv khtf svrrt v'rpm hqshv vl' shm'v
