verses.translation: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

verses.original: וַ/תִּמְשֹׁ֤ךְ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ שָׁנִ֣ים רַבּ֔וֹת וַ/תָּ֨עַד בָּ֧/ם בְּ/רוּחֲ/ךָ֛ בְּ/יַד נְבִיאֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ וַֽ/תִּתְּנֵ֔/ם בְּ/יַ֖ד עַמֵּ֥י הָ/אֲרָצֹֽת
verses.translit: vtmshkh 'lyhm shnym rbvt vt'd bm brvchkh byd nby'ykh vl' h'zynv vttnm byd 'my h'rtst
verses.translation: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/רַחֲמֶ֧י/ךָ הָ/רַבִּ֛ים לֹֽא עֲשִׂיתָ֥/ם כָּלָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א עֲזַבְתָּ֑/ם כִּ֛י אֵֽל חַנּ֥וּן וְ/רַח֖וּם אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vbrchmykh hrbym l' 'shytm khlh vl' 'zbtm khy 'l chnvn vrchvm 'th
verses.translation: Nevertheless for thy great mercies’ sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֵי/נוּ הָ/אֵ֨ל הַ/גָּד֜וֹל הַ/גִּבּ֣וֹר וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָא֮ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַ/בְּרִ֣ית וְ/הַ/חֶסֶד֒ אַל יִמְעַ֣ט לְ/פָנֶ֡י/ךָ אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/תְּלָאָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר מְ֠צָאַתְ/נוּ לִ/מְלָכֵ֨י/נוּ לְ/שָׂרֵ֧י/נוּ וּ/לְ/כֹהֲנֵ֛י/נוּ וְ/לִ/נְבִיאֵ֥/נוּ וְ/לַ/אֲבֹתֵ֖י/נוּ וּ/לְ/כָל עַמֶּ֑/ךָ מִ/ימֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'th 'lhynv h'l hgdvl hgbvr vhnvr' shvmr hbryt vhchsd 'l ym't lpnykh 't khl htl'h 'shr mts'tnv lmlkhynv lshrynv vlkhhnynv vlnby'nv vl'btynv vlkhl 'mkh mymy mlkhy 'shvr 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה צַדִּ֔יק עַ֖ל כָּל הַ/בָּ֣א עָלֵ֑י/נוּ כִּֽי אֱמֶ֥ת עָשִׂ֖יתָ וַ/אֲנַ֥חְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ
verses.translit: v'th tsdyq 'l khl hb' 'lynv khy 'mt 'shyt v'nchnv hrsh'nv
verses.translation: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מְלָכֵ֤י/נוּ שָׂרֵ֨י/נוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י/נוּ וַ/אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ לֹ֥א עָשׂ֖וּ תּוֹרָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/לֹ֤א הִקְשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ אֶל מִצְוֺתֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/לְ/עֵ֣דְוֺתֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַעִידֹ֖תָ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v't mlkhynv shrynv khhnynv v'btynv l' 'shv tvrtkh vl' hqshybv 'l mtsvtykh vl'dvtykh 'shr h'ydt bhm
verses.translation: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֣ם בְּ/מַלְכוּתָ/ם֩ וּ/בְ/טוּבְ/ךָ֨ הָ/רָ֜ב אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֣תָּ לָ/הֶ֗ם וּ/בְ/אֶ֨רֶץ הָ/רְחָבָ֧ה וְ/הַ/שְּׁמֵנָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א עֲבָד֑וּ/ךָ וְֽ/לֹא שָׁ֔בוּ מִ/מַּֽעַלְלֵי/הֶ֖ם הָ/רָעִֽים
verses.translit: vhm bmlkhvtm vbtvbkh hrb 'shr ntt lhm vb'rts hrchbh vhshmnh 'shr ntt lpnyhm l' 'bdvkh vl' shbv mm'llyhm hr'ym
verses.translation: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ הַ/יּ֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֑ים וְ/הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֣תָּה לַ/אֲבֹתֵ֗י/נוּ לֶ/אֱכֹ֤ל אֶת פִּרְיָ/הּ֙ וְ/אֶת טוּבָ֔/הּ הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדִ֖ים עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: hnh 'nchnv hyvm 'bdym vh'rts 'shr ntth l'btynv l'khl 't pryh v't tvbh hnh 'nchnv 'bdym 'lyh
verses.translation: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:

verses.original: וּ/תְבוּאָתָ֣/הּ מַרְבָּ֗ה לַ/מְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה עָלֵ֖י/נוּ בְּ/חַטֹּאותֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/עַ֣ל גְּ֠וִיֹּתֵי/נוּ מֹשְׁלִ֤ים וּ/בִ/בְהֶמְתֵּ֨/נוּ֙ כִּ/רְצוֹנָ֔/ם וּ/בְ/צָרָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vtbv'th mrbh lmlkhym 'shr ntth 'lynv bcht'vtynv v'l gvytynv mshlym vbbhmtnv khrtsvnm vbtsrh gdvlh 'nchnv
verses.translation: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
And because of all this we make a sure covenant , and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it .

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל זֹ֕את אֲנַ֛חְנוּ כֹּרְתִ֥ים אֲמָנָ֖ה וְ/כֹתְבִ֑ים וְ/עַל֙ הֶֽ/חָת֔וּם שָׂרֵ֥י/נוּ לְוִיֵּ֖/נוּ כֹּהֲנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vbkhl z't 'nchnv khrtym 'mnh vkhtbym v'l hchtvm shrynv lvynv khhnynv
verses.translation: Now those that sealed were , Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

verses.original: וְ/עַ֖ל הַ/חֲתוּמִ֑ים נְחֶמְיָ֧ה הַ/תִּרְשָׁ֛תָא בֶּן חֲכַלְיָ֖ה וְ/צִדְקִיָּֽה
verses.translit: v'l hchtvmym nchmyh htrsht' bn chkhlyh vtsdqyh
verses.translation: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

verses.original: שְׂרָיָ֥ה עֲזַרְיָ֖ה יִרְמְיָֽה
verses.translit: shryh 'zryh yrmyh
verses.translation: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

verses.original: פַּשְׁח֥וּר אֲמַרְיָ֖ה מַלְכִּיָּֽה
verses.translit: pshchvr 'mryh mlkhyh
verses.translation: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

verses.original: חַטּ֥וּשׁ שְׁבַנְיָ֖ה מַלּֽוּךְ
verses.translit: chtvsh shbnyh mlvkh
verses.translation: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

verses.original: חָרִ֥ם מְרֵמ֖וֹת עֹֽבַדְיָֽה
verses.translit: chrm mrmvt 'bdyh
verses.translation: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

verses.original: דָּנִיֵּ֥אל גִּנְּת֖וֹן בָּרֽוּךְ
verses.translit: dny'l gntvn brvkh
verses.translation: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

verses.original: מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם אֲבִיָּ֖ה מִיָּמִֽן
verses.translit: mshlm 'byh mymn
verses.translation: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.

verses.original: מַֽעַזְיָ֥ה בִלְגַּ֖י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֖לֶּה הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: m'zyh blgy shm'yh 'lh hkhhnym
verses.translation: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/יֵשׁ֨וּעַ֙ בֶּן אֲזַנְיָ֔ה בִּנּ֕וּי מִ/בְּנֵ֥י חֵנָדָ֖ד קַדְמִיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhlvym vyshv' bn 'znyh bnvy mbny chndd qdmy'l
verses.translation: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁבַנְיָ֧ה הֽוֹדִיָּ֛ה קְלִיטָ֖א פְּלָאיָ֥ה חָנָֽן
verses.translit: v'chyhm shbnyh hvdyh qlyt' pl'yh chnn
verses.translation: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

verses.original: מִיכָ֥א רְח֖וֹב חֲשַׁבְיָֽה
verses.translit: mykh' rchvb chshbyh
verses.translation: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

verses.original: זַכּ֥וּר שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֖ה שְׁבַנְיָֽה
verses.translit: zkhvr shrbyh shbnyh
verses.translation: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

verses.original: הוֹדִיָּ֥ה בָנִ֖י בְּנִֽינוּ
verses.translit: hvdyh bny bnynv
verses.translation: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

verses.original: רָאשֵׁ֖י הָ/עָ֑ם פַּרְעֹשׁ֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עֵילָ֥ם זַתּ֖וּא בָּנִֽי
verses.translit: r'shy h'm pr'sh pcht mv'b 'ylm ztv' bny
verses.translation: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.original: בֻּנִּ֥י עַזְגָּ֖ד בֵּבָֽי
verses.translit: bny 'zgd bby
verses.translation: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

verses.original: אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בִגְוַ֖י עָדִֽין
verses.translit: 'dnyh bgvy 'dyn
verses.translation: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

verses.original: אָטֵ֥ר חִזְקִיָּ֖ה עַזּֽוּר
verses.translit: 'tr chzqyh 'zvr
verses.translation: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

verses.original: הוֹדִיָּ֥ה חָשֻׁ֖ם בֵּצָֽי
verses.translit: hvdyh chshm btsy
verses.translation: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

verses.original: חָרִ֥יף עֲנָת֖וֹת נובי נֵיבָֽי
verses.translit: chryf 'ntvt nvby nyby
verses.translation: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

verses.original: מַגְפִּיעָ֥שׁ מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם חֵזִֽיר
verses.translit: mgpy'sh mshlm chzyr
verses.translation: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

verses.original: מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֥ל צָד֖וֹק יַדּֽוּעַ
verses.translit: mshyzb'l tsdvq ydv'
verses.translation: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

verses.original: פְּלַטְיָ֥ה חָנָ֖ן עֲנָיָֽה
verses.translit: pltyh chnn 'nyh
verses.translation: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

verses.original: הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ חֲנַנְיָ֖ה חַשּֽׁוּב
verses.translit: hvsh' chnnyh chshvb
verses.translation: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

verses.original: הַלּוֹחֵ֥שׁ פִּלְחָ֖א שׁוֹבֵֽק
verses.translit: hlvchsh plch' shvbq
verses.translation: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

verses.original: רְח֥וּם חֲשַׁבְנָ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂיָֽה
verses.translit: rchvm chshbnh m'shyh
verses.translation: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

verses.original: וַ/אֲחִיָּ֥ה חָנָ֖ן עָנָֽן
verses.translit: v'chyh chnn 'nn
verses.translation: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

verses.original: מַלּ֥וּךְ חָרִ֖ם בַּעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: mlvkh chrm b'nh
verses.translation: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר הָ/עָ֡ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ֠/לְוִיִּם הַ/שּׁוֹעֲרִ֨ים הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֜ים הַ/נְּתִינִ֗ים וְֽ/כָל הַ/נִּבְדָּ֞ל מֵ/עַמֵּ֤י הָ/אֲרָצוֹת֙ אֶל תּוֹרַ֣ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם בְּנֵי/הֶ֣ם וּ/בְנֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל יוֹדֵ֥עַ מֵבִֽין
verses.translit: vsh'r h'm hkhhnym hlvym hshv'rym hmshrrym hntynym vkhl hnbdl m'my h'rtsvt 'l tvrt h'lhym nshyhm bnyhm vbntyhm khl yvd' mbyn
verses.translation: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

verses.original: מַחֲזִיקִ֣ים עַל אֲחֵי/הֶם֮ אַדִּירֵי/הֶם֒ וּ/בָאִ֞ים בְּ/אָלָ֣ה וּ/בִ/שְׁבוּעָ֗ה לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּ/תוֹרַ֣ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּנָ֔ה בְּ/יַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/לִ/שְׁמ֣וֹר וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֲדֹנֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֖י/ו וְ/חֻקָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: mchzyqym 'l 'chyhm 'dyryhm vb'ym b'lh vbshbv'h llkht btvrt h'lhym 'shr ntnh byd mshh 'bd h'lhym vlshmvr vl'shvt 't khl mtsvt yhvh 'dnynv vmshptyv vchqyv
verses.translation: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא נִתֵּ֥ן בְּנֹתֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִקַּ֖ח לְ/בָנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'shr l' ntn bntynv l'my h'rts v't bntyhm l' nqch lbnynv
verses.translation: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

verses.original: וְ/עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֡רֶץ הַֽ/מְבִיאִים֩ אֶת הַ/מַּקָּח֨וֹת וְ/כָל שֶׁ֜בֶר בְּ/י֤וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּת֙ לִ/מְכּ֔וֹר לֹא נִקַּ֥ח מֵ/הֶ֛ם בַּ/שַּׁבָּ֖ת וּ/בְ/י֣וֹם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/נִטֹּ֛שׁ אֶת הַ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖ית וּ/מַשָּׁ֥א כָל יָֽד
verses.translit: v'my h'rts hmby'ym 't hmqchvt vkhl shbr byvm hshbt lmkhvr l' nqch mhm bshbt vbyvm qdsh vntsh 't hshnh hshby'yt vmsh' khl yd
verses.translation: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱמַ֤דְנוּ עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ מִצְוֺ֔ת לָ/תֵ֥ת עָלֵ֛י/נוּ שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶל בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה לַ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vh'mdnv 'lynv mtsvt ltt 'lynv shlshyt hshql bshnh l'bdt byt 'lhynv
verses.translation: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things , and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

verses.original: לְ/לֶ֣חֶם הַֽ/מַּעֲרֶ֡כֶת וּ/מִנְחַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֣יד וּ/לְ/עוֹלַ֣ת הַ֠/תָּמִיד הַ/שַּׁבָּת֨וֹת הֶ/חֳדָשִׁ֜ים לַ/מּוֹעֲדִ֗ים וְ/לַ/קֳּדָשִׁים֙ וְ/לַ֣/חַטָּא֔וֹת לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כֹ֖ל מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: llchm hm'rkht vmncht htmyd vl'vlt htmyd hshbtvt hchdshym lmv'dym vlqdshym vlcht'vt lkhpr 'l yshr'l vkhl ml'kht byt 'lhynv
verses.translation: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/גּוֹרָל֨וֹת הִפַּ֜לְנוּ עַל קֻרְבַּ֣ן הָ/עֵצִ֗ים הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ/לְוִיִּם֮ וְ/הָ/עָם֒ לְ֠/הָבִיא לְ/בֵ֨ית אֱלֹהֵ֧י/נוּ לְ/בֵית אֲבֹתֵ֛י/נוּ לְ/עִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֣ה בְ/שָׁנָ֑ה לְ/בַעֵ֗ר עַל מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ כַּ/כָּת֖וּב בַּ/תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vhgvrlvt hplnv 'l qrbn h'tsym hkhhnym hlvym vh'm lhby' lbyt 'lhynv lbyt 'btynv l'tym mzmnym shnh bshnh lb'r 'l mzbch yhvh 'lhynv khkhtvb btvrh
verses.translation: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD :

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הָבִ֞יא אֶת בִּכּוּרֵ֣י אַדְמָתֵ֗/נוּ וּ/בִכּוּרֵ֛י כָּל פְּרִ֥י כָל עֵ֖ץ שָׁנָ֣ה בְ/שָׁנָ֑ה לְ/בֵ֖ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlhby' 't bkhvry 'dmtnv vbkhvry khl pry khl 'ts shnh bshnh lbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּכֹר֤וֹת בָּנֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ/בְהֶמְתֵּ֔י/נוּ כַּ/כָּת֖וּב בַּ/תּוֹרָ֑ה וְ/אֶת בְּכוֹרֵ֨י בְקָרֵ֜י/נוּ וְ/צֹאנֵ֗י/נוּ לְ/הָבִיא֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ לַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַ/מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v't bkhrvt bnynv vbhmtynv khkhtvb btvrh v't bkhvry bqrynv vts'nynv lhby' lbyt 'lhynv lkhhnym hmshrtym bbyt 'lhynv
verses.translation: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת רֵאשִׁ֣ית עֲרִיסֹתֵ֣י/נוּ וּ֠/תְרוּמֹתֵי/נוּ וּ/פְרִ֨י כָל עֵ֜ץ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/יִצְהָ֗ר נָבִ֤יא לַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ אֶל לִשְׁכ֣וֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/מַעְשַׂ֥ר אַדְמָתֵ֖/נוּ לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הֵם֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם הַֽ/מְעַשְּׂרִ֔ים בְּ/כֹ֖ל עָרֵ֥י עֲבֹדָתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: v't r'shyt 'rystynv vtrvmtynv vpry khl 'ts tyrvsh vytshr nby' lkhhnym 'l lshkhvt byt 'lhynv vm'shr 'dmtnv llvym vhm hlvym hm'shrym bkhl 'ry 'bdtnv
verses.translation: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֧ן בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עִם הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בַּ/עְשֵׂ֣ר הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֞ם יַעֲל֨וּ אֶת מַעֲשַׂ֤ר הַֽ/מַּעֲשֵׂר֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ אֶל הַ/לְּשָׁכ֖וֹת לְ/בֵ֥ית הָ/אוֹצָֽר
verses.translit: vhyh hkhhn bn 'hrn 'm hlvym b'shr hlvym vhlvym y'lv 't m'shr hm'shr lbyt 'lhynv 'l hlshkhvt lbyt h'vtsr
verses.translation: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי הָ/עָ֖ם בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר הָ֠/עָם הִפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת לְ/הָבִ֣יא אֶחָ֣ד מִן הָ/עֲשָׂרָ֗ה לָ/שֶׁ֨בֶת֙ בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עִ֣יר הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְ/תֵ֥שַׁע הַ/יָּד֖וֹת בֶּ/עָרִֽים
verses.translit: vyshbv shry h'm byrvshlm vsh'r h'm hpylv gvrlvt lhby' 'chd mn h'shrh lshbt byrvshlm 'yr hqdsh vtsh' hydvt b'rym
verses.translation: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְבָרֲכ֖וּ הָ/עָ֑ם לְ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַ/מִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ים לָ/שֶׁ֖בֶת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vybrkhv h'm lkhl h'nshym hmtndbym lshbt byrvshlm
verses.translation: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ/מְּדִינָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּ/בְ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ בַּ/אֲחֻזָּת/וֹ֙ בְּ/עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy hmdynh 'shr yshbv byrvshlm vb'ry yhvdh yshbv 'ysh b'chztv b'ryhm yshr'l hkhhnym vhlvym vhntynym vbny 'bdy shlmh
verses.translation: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit , Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

verses.original: וּ/בִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָֽשְׁב֔וּ מִ/בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יְ֠הוּדָה עֲתָיָ֨ה בֶן עֻזִּיָּ֜ה בֶּן זְכַרְיָ֧ה בֶן אֲמַרְיָ֛ה בֶּן שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל מִ/בְּנֵי פָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vbyrvshlm yshbv mbny yhvdh vmbny bnymn mbny yhvdh 'tyh bn 'zyh bn zkhryh bn 'mryh bn shptyh bn mhll'l mbny prts
verses.translation: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

verses.original: וּ/מַעֲשֵׂיָ֣ה בֶן בָּר֣וּךְ בֶּן כָּל חֹ֠זֶה בֶּן חֲזָיָ֨ה בֶן עֲדָיָ֧ה בֶן יוֹיָרִ֛יב בֶּן זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן הַ/שִּׁלֹנִֽי
verses.translit: vm'shyh bn brvkh bn khl chzh bn chzyh bn 'dyh bn yvyryb bn zkhryh bn hshlny
verses.translation: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

verses.original: כָּל בְּנֵי פֶ֕רֶץ הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֛וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: khl bny prts hyshbym byrvshlm 'rb' m'vt shshym vshmnh 'nshy chyl
verses.translation: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן סַלֻּ֡א בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם בֶּן יוֹעֵ֡ד בֶּן פְּדָיָה֩ בֶן ק֨וֹלָיָ֧ה בֶן מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן אִֽיתִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן יְשַֽׁעְיָֽה
verses.translit: v'lh bny bnymn sl' bn mshlm bn yv'd bn pdyh bn qvlyh bn m'shyh bn 'yty'l bn ysh'yh
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרָ֖י/ו גַּבַּ֣י סַלָּ֑י תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: v'chryv gby sly tsh' m'vt 'shrym vshmnh
verses.translation: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאֵ֥ל בֶּן זִכְרִ֖י פָּקִ֣יד עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וִ/יהוּדָ֧ה בֶן הַ/סְּנוּאָ֛ה עַל הָ/עִ֖יר מִשְׁנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyv'l bn zkhry pqyd 'lyhm vyhvdh bn hsnv'h 'l h'yr mshnh
verses.translation: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

verses.original: מִן הַֽ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה בֶן יוֹיָרִ֖יב יָכִֽין
verses.translit: mn hkhhnym yd'yh bn yvyryb ykhyn
verses.translation: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

verses.original: שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן צָד֗וֹק בֶּן מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: shryh bn chlqyh bn mshlm bn tsdvq bn mryvt bn 'chytvb ngd byt h'lhym
verses.translation: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֗ם עֹשֵׂ֤י הַ/מְּלָאכָה֙ לַ/בַּ֔יִת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּ/שְׁנָ֑יִם וַ֠/עֲדָיָה בֶּן יְרֹחָ֤ם בֶּן פְּלַלְיָה֙ בֶּן אַמְצִ֣י בֶן זְכַרְיָ֔ה בֶּן פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּֽה
verses.translit: v'chyhm 'shy hml'khh lbyt shmnh m'vt 'shrym vshnym v'dyh bn yrchm bn pllyh bn 'mtsy bn zkhryh bn pshchvr bn mlkhyh
verses.translation: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶחָי/ו֙ רָאשִׁ֣ים לְ/אָב֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וּ/שְׁנָ֑יִם וַ/עֲמַשְׁסַ֧י בֶּן עֲזַרְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אַחְזַ֥י בֶּן מְשִׁלֵּמ֖וֹת בֶּן אִמֵּֽר
verses.translit: v'chyv r'shym l'bvt m'tym 'rb'ym vshnym v'mshsy bn 'zr'l bn 'chzy bn mshlmvt bn 'mr
verses.translation: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶם֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וּ/שְׁמֹנָ֑ה וּ/פָקִ֣יד עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם זַבְדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן הַ/גְּדוֹלִֽים
verses.translit: v'chyhm gbvry chyl m'h 'shrym vshmnh vpqyd 'lyhm zbdy'l bn hgdvlym
verses.translation: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽן הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן בּוּנִּֽי
verses.translit: vmn hlvym shm'yh bn chshvb bn 'zryqm bn chshbyh bn bvny
verses.translation: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְּתַ֨י וְ/יוֹזָבָ֜ד עַל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֤ה הַ/חִֽיצֹנָה֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵ/רָאשֵׁ֖י הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vshbty vyvzbd 'l hml'khh hchytsnh lbyt h'lhym mr'shy hlvym
verses.translation: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

verses.original: וּ/מַתַּנְיָ֣ה בֶן מִ֠יכָה בֶּן זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן אָסָ֜ף רֹ֗אשׁ הַ/תְּחִלָּה֙ יְהוֹדֶ֣ה לַ/תְּפִלָּ֔ה וּ/בַקְבֻּקְיָ֖ה מִשְׁנֶ֣ה מֵ/אֶחָ֑י/ו וְ/עַבְדָּא֙ בֶּן שַׁמּ֔וּעַ בֶּן גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן ידיתון יְדוּתֽוּן
verses.translit: vmtnyh bn mykhh bn zbdy bn 'sf r'sh htchlh yhvdh ltplh vbqbqyh mshnh m'chyv v'bd' bn shmv' bn gll bn ydytvn ydvtvn
verses.translation: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ בְּ/עִ֣יר הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: khl hlvym b'yr hqdsh m'tym shmnym v'rb'h
verses.translation: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שּֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ עַקּ֣וּב טַלְמ֔וֹן וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/שֹּׁמְרִ֣ים בַּ/שְּׁעָרִ֑ים מֵאָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhshv'rym 'qvb tlmvn v'chyhm hshmrym bsh'rym m'h shb'ym vshnym
verses.translation: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ בְּ/כָל עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vsh'r yshr'l hkhhnym hlvym bkhl 'ry yhvdh 'ysh bnchltv
verses.translation: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִ֖ים יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ/עֹ֑פֶל וְ/צִיחָ֥א וְ/גִשְׁפָּ֖א עַל הַ/נְּתִינִֽים
verses.translit: vhntynym yshbym b'pl vtsych' vgshp' 'l hntynym
verses.translation: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.

verses.original: וּ/פְקִ֤יד הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עֻזִּ֤י בֶן בָּנִי֙ בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן מַתַּנְיָ֖ה בֶּן מִיכָ֑א מִ/בְּנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים לְ/נֶ֖גֶד מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vpqyd hlvym byrvshlm 'zy bn bny bn chshbyh bn mtnyh bn mykh' mbny 'sf hmshrrym lngd ml'kht byt h'lhym
verses.translation: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.

verses.original: כִּֽי מִצְוַ֥ת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/אֲמָנָ֥ה עַל הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy mtsvt hmlkh 'lyhm v'mnh 'l hmshrrym dbr yvm byvmv
verses.translation: For it was the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

verses.original: וּ/פְתַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶּן מְשֵֽׁיזַבְאֵ֜ל מִ/בְּנֵי זֶ֤רַח בֶּן יְהוּדָה֙ לְ/יַ֣ד הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/כָל דָּבָ֖ר לָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vptchyh bn mshyzb'l mbny zrch bn yhvdh lyd hmlkh lkhl dbr l'm
verses.translation: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הַ/חֲצֵרִ֖ים בִּ/שְׂדֹתָ֑/ם מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה יָֽשְׁב֞וּ בְּ/קִרְיַ֤ת הָֽאַרְבַּע֙ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/הָ וּ/בְ/דִיבֹן֙ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/הָ וּ/בִֽ/יקַּבְצְאֵ֖ל וַ/חֲצֵרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'l hchtsrym bshdtm mbny yhvdh yshbv bqryt h'rb' vbntyh vbdybn vbntyh vbyqbts'l vchtsryh
verses.translation: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,

verses.original: וּ/בְ/יֵשׁ֥וּעַ וּ/בְ/מוֹלָדָ֖ה וּ/בְ/בֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט
verses.translit: vbyshv' vbmvldh vbbyt plt
verses.translation: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּ/בִ/בְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּ/בְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbchtsr shv'l vbb'r shb' vbntyh
verses.translation: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages thereof,

verses.original: וּ/בְ/צִֽקְלַ֥ג וּ/בִ/מְכֹנָ֖ה וּ/בִ/בְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbtsqlg vbmkhnh vbbntyh
verses.translation: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

verses.original: וּ/בְ/עֵ֥ין רִמּ֛וֹן וּ/בְ/צָרְעָ֖ה וּ/בְ/יַרְמֽוּת
verses.translit: vb'yn rmvn vbtsr'h vbyrmvt
verses.translation: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

verses.original: זָנֹ֤חַ עֲדֻלָּם֙ וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶ֔ם לָכִישׁ֙ וּ/שְׂדֹתֶ֔י/הָ עֲזֵקָ֖ה וּ/בְנֹתֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יַּחֲנ֥וּ מִ/בְּאֵֽר שֶׁ֖בַע עַד גֵּֽיא הִנֹּֽם
verses.translit: znch 'dlm vchtsryhm lkhysh vshdtyh 'zqh vbntyh vychnv mb'r shb' 'd gy' hnm
verses.translation: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִ/גָּ֑בַע מִכְמָ֣שׂ וְ/עַיָּ֔ה וּ/בֵֽית אֵ֖ל וּ/בְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbny bnymn mgb' mkhmsh v'yh vbyt 'l vbntyh
verses.translation: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-el, and in their villages,

verses.original: עֲנָת֥וֹת נֹ֖ב עֲנָֽנְיָֽה
verses.translit: 'ntvt nb 'nnyh
verses.translation: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.original: חָצ֥וֹר רָמָ֖ה גִּתָּֽיִם
verses.translit: chtsvr rmh gtym
verses.translation: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.original: חָדִ֥יד צְבֹעִ֖ים נְבַלָּֽט
verses.translit: chdyd tsb'ym nblt
verses.translation: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.original: לֹ֥ד וְ/אוֹנ֖וֹ גֵּ֥י הַחֲרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: ld v'vnv gy hchrshym
verses.translation: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מַחְלְק֥וֹת יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/בִנְיָמִֽין
verses.translit: vmn hlvym mchlqvt yhvdh lbnymyn
verses.translation: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָל֛וּ עִם זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל בֶּן שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל וְ/יֵשׁ֑וּעַ שְׂרָיָ֥ה יִרְמְיָ֖ה עֶזְרָֽא
verses.translit: v'lh hkhhnym vhlvym 'shr 'lv 'm zrbbl bn sh'lty'l vyshv' shryh yrmyh 'zr'
verses.translation: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

verses.original: אֲמַרְיָ֥ה מַלּ֖וּךְ חַטּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: 'mryh mlvkh chtvsh
verses.translation: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.original: שְׁכַנְיָ֥ה רְחֻ֖ם מְרֵמֹֽת
verses.translit: shkhnyh rchm mrmt
verses.translation: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.original: עִדּ֥וֹא גִנְּת֖וֹי אֲבִיָּֽה
verses.translit: 'dv' gntvy 'byh
verses.translation: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

verses.original: מִיָּמִ֥ין מַֽעַדְיָ֖ה בִּלְגָּֽה
verses.translit: mymyn m'dyh blgh
verses.translation: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

verses.original: שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה וְ/יוֹיָרִ֖יב יְדַֽעְיָֽה
verses.translit: shm'yh vyvyryb yd'yh
verses.translation: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.original: סַלּ֣וּ עָמ֔וֹק חִלְקִיָּ֖ה יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֧י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם בִּ/ימֵ֥י יֵשֽׁוּעַ
verses.translit: slv 'mvq chlqyh yd'yh 'lh r'shy hkhhnym v'chyhm bymy yshv'
verses.translation: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֧וּעַ בִּנּ֛וּי קַדְמִיאֵ֥ל שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה מַתַּנְיָ֑ה עַֽל הֻיְּד֖וֹת ה֥וּא וְ/אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhlvym yshv' bnvy qdmy'l shrbyh yhvdh mtnyh 'l hydvt hv' v'chyv
verses.translation: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

verses.original: וּ/בַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֨ה ו/ענו וְ/עֻנִּ֧י אֲחֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/נֶגְדָּ֖/ם לְ/מִשְׁמָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbqbqyh v'nv v'ny 'chyhm lngdm lmshmrvt
verses.translation: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.

verses.original: וְ/יֵשׁ֖וּעַ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יֽוֹיָקִ֑ים וְ/יֽוֹיָקִים֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְ/אֶלְיָשִׁ֖יב אֶת יוֹיָדָֽע
verses.translit: vyshv' hvlyd 't yvyqym vyvyqym hvlyd 't 'lyshyb v'lyshyb 't yvyd'
verses.translation: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

verses.original: וְ/יוֹיָדָע֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יוֹנָתָ֔ן וְ/יוֹנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת יַדּֽוּעַ
verses.translit: vyvyd' hvlyd 't yvntn vyvntn hvlyd 't ydv'
verses.translation: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/ימֵי֙ יֽוֹיָקִ֔ים הָי֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/אָב֑וֹת לִ/שְׂרָיָ֣ה מְרָיָ֔ה לְ/יִרְמְיָ֖ה חֲנַנְיָֽה
verses.translit: vbymy yvyqym hyv khhnym r'shy h'bvt lshryh mryh lyrmyh chnnyh
verses.translation: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.original: לְ/עֶזְרָ֣א מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם לַ/אֲמַרְיָ֖ה יְהוֹחָנָֽן
verses.translit: l'zr' mshlm l'mryh yhvchnn
verses.translation: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.original: ל/מלוכי לִ/מְלִ֨יכוּ֙ יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן לִ/שְׁבַנְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: lmlvkhy lmlykhv yvntn lshbnyh yvsf
verses.translation: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

verses.original: לְ/חָרִ֣ם עַדְנָ֔א לִ/מְרָי֖וֹת חֶלְקָֽי
verses.translit: lchrm 'dn' lmryvt chlqy
verses.translation: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.original: ל/עדיא לְ/עִדּ֥וֹא זְכַרְיָ֖ה לְ/גִנְּת֥וֹן מְשֻׁלָּֽם
verses.translit: l'dy' l'dv' zkhryh lgntvn mshlm
verses.translation: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

verses.original: לַ/אֲבִיָּ֖ה זִכְרִ֑י לְ/מִ֨נְיָמִ֔ין לְ/מוֹעַדְיָ֖ה פִּלְטָֽי
verses.translit: l'byh zkhry lmnymyn lmv'dyh plty
verses.translation: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

verses.original: לְ/בִלְגָּ֣ה שַׁמּ֔וּעַ לִֽ/שְׁמַעְיָ֖ה יְהוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: lblgh shmv' lshm'yh yhvntn
verses.translation: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/יוֹיָרִ֣יב מַתְּנַ֔י לִֽ/ידַֽעְיָ֖ה עֻזִּֽי
verses.translit: vlyvyryb mtny lyd'yh 'zy
verses.translation: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.original: לְ/סַלַּ֥י קַלָּ֖י לְ/עָמ֥וֹק עֵֽבֶר
verses.translit: lsly qly l'mvq 'br
verses.translation: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

verses.original: לְ/חִלְקִיָּ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה לִֽ/ידַֽעְיָ֖ה נְתַנְאֵֽל
verses.translit: lchlqyh chshbyh lyd'yh ntn'l
verses.translation: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

verses.original: הַ/לְוִיִּם֩ בִּ/ימֵ֨י אֶלְיָשִׁ֜יב יוֹיָדָ֤ע וְ/יוֹחָנָן֙ וְ/יַדּ֔וּעַ כְּתוּבִ֖ים רָאשֵׁ֣י אָב֑וֹת וְ/הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים עַל מַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַ/פָּֽרְסִֽי
verses.translit: hlvym bymy 'lyshyb yvyd' vyvchnn vydv' khtvbym r'shy 'bvt vhkhhnym 'l mlkhvt dryvsh hprsy
verses.translation: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י לֵוִי֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֔וֹת כְּתוּבִ֕ים עַל סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וְ/עַד יְמֵ֖י יֽוֹחָנָ֥ן בֶּן אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: bny lvy r'shy h'bvt khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym v'd ymy yvchnn bn 'lyshyb
verses.translation: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

verses.original: וְ/רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ֠/לְוִיִּם חֲשַׁבְיָ֨ה שֵֽׁרֵבְיָ֜ה וְ/יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן קַדְמִיאֵל֙ וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֣ם לְ/נֶגְדָּ֔/ם לְ/הַלֵּ֣ל לְ/הוֹד֔וֹת בְּ/מִצְוַ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְ/עֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר
verses.translit: vr'shy hlvym chshbyh shrbyh vyshv' bn qdmy'l v'chyhm lngdm lhll lhvdvt bmtsvt dvyd 'ysh h'lhym mshmr l'mt mshmr
verses.translation: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

verses.original: מַתַּנְיָ֧ה וּ/בַקְבֻּֽקְיָ֛ה עֹבַדְיָ֥ה מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם טַלְמ֣וֹן עַקּ֑וּב שֹׁמְרִ֤ים שֽׁוֹעֲרִים֙ מִשְׁמָ֔ר בַּ/אֲסֻפֵּ֖י הַ/שְּׁעָרִֽים
verses.translit: mtnyh vbqbqyh 'bdyh mshlm tlmvn 'qvb shmrym shv'rym mshmr b'spy hsh'rym
verses.translation: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה בִּ/ימֵ֛י יוֹיָקִ֥ים בֶּן יֵשׁ֖וּעַ בֶּן יוֹצָדָ֑ק וּ/בִ/ימֵי֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה הַ/פֶּחָ֔ה וְ/עֶזְרָ֥א הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/סּוֹפֵֽר
verses.translit: 'lh bymy yvyqym bn yshv' bn yvtsdq vbymy nchmyh hpchh v'zr' hkhhn hsvpr
verses.translation: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲנֻכַּ֞ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם בִּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ מִ/כָּל מְק֣וֹמֹתָ֔/ם לַ/הֲבִיאָ֖/ם לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַ/עֲשֹׂ֨ת חֲנֻכָּ֤ה וְ/שִׂמְחָה֙ וּ/בְ/תוֹד֣וֹת וּ/בְ/שִׁ֔יר מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם נְבָלִ֥ים וּ/בְ/כִנֹּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbchnkht chvmt yrvshlm bqshv 't hlvym mkhl mqvmtm lhby'm lyrvshlm l'sht chnkhh vshmchh vbtvdvt vbshyr mtsltym nblym vbkhnrvt
verses.translation: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ בְּנֵ֖י הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וּ/מִן הַ/כִּכָּר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּ/מִן חַצְרֵ֖י נְטֹפָתִֽי
verses.translit: vy'spv bny hmshrrym vmn hkhkhr sbybvt yrvshlm vmn chtsry ntpty
verses.translation: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בֵּית֙ הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל וּ/מִ/שְּׂד֥וֹת גֶּ֖בַע וְ/עַזְמָ֑וֶת כִּ֣י חֲצֵרִ֗ים בָּנ֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רֲרִ֔ים סְבִיב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vmbyt hglgl vmshdvt gb' v'zmvt khy chtsrym bnv lhm hmshrrym sbybvt yrvshlm
verses.translation: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽטַּהֲר֔וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וַֽ/יְטַהֲרוּ֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֖ים וְ/אֶֽת הַ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vythrv hkhhnym vhlvym vythrv 't h'm v't hsh'rym v't hchvmh
verses.translation: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

verses.original: וָ/אַעֲלֶה֙ אֶת שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֖ל לַ/חוֹמָ֑ה וָ/אַעֲמִ֡ידָ/ה שְׁתֵּ֣י תוֹדֹת֩ גְּדוֹלֹ֨ת וְ/תַהֲלֻכֹ֤ת לַ/יָּמִין֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל לַ/חוֹמָ֔ה לְ/שַׁ֖עַר הָ/אַשְׁפֹּֽת
verses.translit: v''lh 't shry yhvdh m'l lchvmh v''mydh shty tvdt gdvlt vthlkht lymyn m'l lchvmh lsh'r h'shpt
verses.translation: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ אַחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ הוֹשַׁ֣עְיָ֔ה וַ/חֲצִ֖י שָׂרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh 'chryhm hvsh'yh vchtsy shry yhvdh
verses.translation: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

verses.original: וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֥ה עֶזְרָ֖א וּ/מְשֻׁלָּֽם
verses.translit: v'zryh 'zr' vmshlm
verses.translation: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

verses.original: יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן וּֽ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֖ה וְ/יִרְמְיָֽה
verses.translit: yhvdh vbnymn vshm'yh vyrmyh
verses.translation: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֥י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּ/חֲצֹצְר֑וֹת זְכַרְיָ֨ה בֶן יֽוֹנָתָ֜ן בֶּן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה בֶּן מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן מִ֣יכָיָ֔ה בֶּן זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן אָסָֽף
verses.translit: vmbny hkhhnym bchtstsrvt zkhryh bn yvntn bn shm'yh bn mtnyh bn mykhyh bn zkhvr bn 'sf
verses.translation: And certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets; namely , Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶחָ֡י/ו שְֽׁמַעְיָ֡ה וַ/עֲזַרְאֵ֡ל מִֽלֲלַ֡י גִּֽלֲלַ֡י מָעַ֞י נְתַנְאֵ֤ל וִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ חֲנָ֔נִי בִּ/כְלֵי שִׁ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/עֶזְרָ֥א הַ/סּוֹפֵ֖ר לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'chyv shm'yh v'zr'l mlly glly m'y ntn'l vyhvdh chnny bkhly shyr dvyd 'ysh h'lhym v'zr' hsvpr lpnyhm
verses.translation: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

verses.original: וְ/עַל֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָ/עַ֜יִן וְ/נֶגְדָּ֗/ם עָלוּ֙ עַֽל מַעֲלוֹת֙ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד בַּֽ/מַּעֲלֶ֖ה לַ/חוֹמָ֑ה מֵ/עַל֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔יד וְ/עַ֛ד שַׁ֥עַר הַ/מַּ֖יִם מִזְרָֽח
verses.translit: v'l sh'r h'yn vngdm 'lv 'l m'lvt 'yr dvyd bm'lh lchvmh m'l lbyt dvyd v'd sh'r hmym mzrch
verses.translation: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/תּוֹדָ֧ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֛ית הַ/הוֹלֶ֥כֶת לְ/מ֖וֹאל וַ/אֲנִ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑י/הָ וַ/חֲצִ֨י הָ/עָ֜ם מֵ/עַ֣ל לְ/הַ/חוֹמָ֗ה מֵ/עַל֙ לְ/מִגְדַּ֣ל הַ/תַּנּוּרִ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ד הַ/חוֹמָ֥ה הָ/רְחָבָֽה
verses.translit: vhtvdh hshnyt hhvlkht lmv'l v'ny 'chryh vchtsy h'm m'l lhchvmh m'l lmgdl htnvrym v'd hchvmh hrchbh
verses.translation: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them , and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עַ֣ל לְ/שַֽׁעַר אֶ֠פְרַיִם וְ/עַל שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה וְ/עַל שַׁ֣עַר הַ/דָּגִ֗ים וּ/מִגְדַּ֤ל חֲנַנְאֵל֙ וּ/מִגְדַּ֣ל הַ/מֵּאָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ד שַׁ֣עַר הַ/צֹּ֑אן וְ/עָ֣מְד֔וּ בְּ/שַׁ֖עַר הַ/מַּטָּרָֽה
verses.translit: vm'l lsh'r 'prym v'l sh'r hyshnh v'l sh'r hdgym vmgdl chnn'l vmgdl hm'h v'd sh'r hts'n v'mdv bsh'r hmtrh
verses.translation: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י הַ/תּוֹדֹ֖ת בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/אֲנִ֕י וַ/חֲצִ֥י הַ/סְּגָנִ֖ים עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mdnh shty htvdt bbyt h'lhym v'ny vchtsy hsgnym 'my
verses.translation: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֡ים אֶלְיָקִ֡ים מַעֲשֵׂיָ֡ה מִ֠נְיָמִין מִיכָיָ֧ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֛י זְכַרְיָ֥ה חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בַּ/חֲצֹצְרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhkhhnym 'lyqym m'shyh mnymyn mykhyh 'lyv'yny zkhryh chnnyh bchtstsrvt
verses.translation: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

verses.original: וּ/מַעֲשֵׂיָ֨ה וּֽ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֜ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֧ר וְ/עֻזִּ֛י וִֽ/יהוֹחָנָ֥ן וּ/מַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וְ/עֵילָ֣ם וָ/עָ֑זֶר וַ/יַּשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְ/יִֽזְרַחְיָ֖ה הַ/פָּקִֽיד
verses.translit: vm'shyh vshm'yh v'l'zr v'zy vyhvchnn vmlkhyh v'ylm v'zr vyshmy'v hmshrrym vyzrchyh hpqyd
verses.translation: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבְּח֣וּ בַ/יּוֹם הַ֠/הוּא זְבָחִ֨ים גְּדוֹלִ֜ים וַ/יִּשְׂמָ֗חוּ כִּ֤י הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ שִׂמְּחָ/ם֙ שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וְ/גַ֧ם הַ/נָּשִׁ֛ים וְ/הַ/יְלָדִ֖ים שָׂמֵ֑חוּ וַ/תִּשָּׁמַ֛ע שִׂמְחַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מֵ/רָחֽוֹק
verses.translit: vyzbchv byvm hhv' zbchym gdvlym vyshmchv khy h'lhym shmchm shmchh gdvlh vgm hnshym vhyldym shmchv vtshm' shmcht yrvshlm mrchvq
verses.translation: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפָּקְד֣וּ בַ/יּוֹם֩ הַ/ה֨וּא אֲנָשִׁ֜ים עַל הַ/נְּשָׁכ֗וֹת לָ/א֨וֹצָר֥וֹת לַ/תְּרוּמוֹת֮ לָ/רֵאשִׁ֣ית וְ/לַ/מַּֽעַשְׂרוֹת֒ לִ/כְנ֨וֹס בָּ/הֶ֜ם לִ/שְׂדֵ֤י הֶ/עָרִים֙ מְנָא֣וֹת הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׂמְחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ/עַל הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם הָ/עֹמְדִֽים
verses.translit: vypqdv byvm hhv' 'nshym 'l hnshkhvt l'vtsrvt ltrvmvt lr'shyt vlm'shrvt lkhnvs bhm lshdy h'rym mn'vt htvrh lkhhnym vllvym khy shmcht yhvdh 'l hkhhnym v'l hlvym h'mdym
verses.translation: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְר֞וּ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶם֙ וּ/מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַֽ/טָּהֳרָ֔ה וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים כְּ/מִצְוַ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshmrv mshmrt 'lhyhm vmshmrt hthrh vhmshrrym vhsh'rym khmtsvt dvyd shlmh bnv
verses.translation: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

verses.original: כִּֽי בִ/ימֵ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְ/אָסָ֖ף מִ/קֶּ֑דֶם ראש רָאשֵׁי֙ הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וְ/שִׁיר תְּהִלָּ֥ה וְ/הֹד֖וֹת לֵֽ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy bymy dvyd v'sf mqdm r'sh r'shy hmshrrym vshyr thlh vhdvt l'lhym
verses.translation: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ בִּ/ימֵ֨י זְרֻבָּבֶ֜ל וּ/בִ/ימֵ֣י נְחֶמְיָ֗ה נֹֽתְנִ֛ים מְנָי֛וֹת הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֖ים דְּבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֑/וֹ וּ/מַקְדִּשִׁים֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֖ים לִ/בְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l bymy zrbbl vbymy nchmyh ntnym mnyvt hmshrrym vhsh'rym dbr yvm byvmv vmqdshym llvym vhlvym mqdshym lbny 'hrn
verses.translation: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נִקְרָ֛א בְּ/סֵ֥פֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/נִמְצָא֙ כָּת֣וּב בּ֔/וֹ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא יָב֨וֹא עַמֹּנִ֧י וּ/מֹאָבִ֛י בִּ/קְהַ֥ל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: byvm hhv' nqr' bspr mshh b'zny h'm vnmts' khtvb bv 'shr l' ybv' 'mny vm'by bqhl h'lhym 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א קִדְּמ֛וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/לֶּ֣חֶם וּ/בַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר עָלָ֤י/ו אֶת בִּלְעָם֙ לְ/קַֽלְל֔/וֹ וַ/יַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ הַ/קְּלָלָ֖ה לִ/בְרָכָֽה
verses.translit: khy l' qdmv 't bny yshr'l blchm vbmym vyshkhr 'lyv 't bl'm lqllv vyhpkh 'lhynv hqllh lbrkhh
verses.translation: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י כְּ/שָׁמְעָ֣/ם אֶת הַ/תּוֹרָ֑ה וַ/יַּבְדִּ֥ילוּ כָל עֵ֖רֶב מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'm 't htvrh vybdylv khl 'rb myshr'l
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י מִ/זֶּ֔ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן נָת֖וּן בְּ/לִשְׁכַּ֣ת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ קָר֖וֹב לְ/טוֹבִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vlpny mzh 'lyshyb hkhhn ntvn blshkht byt 'lhynv qrvb ltvbyh
verses.translation: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ ל֜/וֹ לִשְׁכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֗ה וְ/שָׁ֣ם הָי֪וּ לְ/פָנִ֟ים נֹ֠תְנִים אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֨ה הַ/לְּבוֹנָ֜ה וְ/הַ/כֵּלִ֗ים וּ/מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַ/דָּגָן֙ הַ/תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/הַ/יִּצְהָ֔ר מִצְוַת֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים וּ/תְרוּמַ֖ת הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh lv lshkhh gdvlh vshm hyv lpnym ntnym 't hmnchh hlbvnh vhkhlym vm'shr hdgn htyrvsh vhytshr mtsvt hlvym vhmshrrym vhsh'rym vtrvmt hkhhnym
verses.translation: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל זֶ֕ה לֹ֥א הָיִ֖יתִי בִּֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֡י בִּ/שְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֜יִם לְ/אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ בָּ֣אתִי אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/לְ/קֵ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים נִשְׁאַ֥לְתִּי מִן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vbkhl zh l' hyyty byrvshlm khy bshnt shlshym vshtym l'rtchshst' mlkh bbl b'ty 'l hmlkh vlqts ymym nsh'lty mn hmlkh
verses.translation: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

verses.original: וָ/אָב֖וֹא לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וָ/אָבִ֣ינָ/ה בָ/רָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ לְ/ט֣וֹבִיָּ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת ל/וֹ֙ נִשְׁכָּ֔ה בְּ/חַצְרֵ֖י בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'bv' lyrvshlm v'bynh br'h 'shr 'shh 'lyshyb ltvbyh l'shvt lv nshkhh bchtsry byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥רַֽע לִ֖/י מְאֹ֑ד וָֽ/אַשְׁלִ֜יכָ/ה אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֧י בֵית טוֹבִיָּ֛ה הַ/ח֖וּץ מִן הַ/לִּשְׁכָּֽה
verses.translit: vyr' ly m'd v'shlykhh 't khl khly byt tvbyh hchvts mn hlshkhh
verses.translation: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.

verses.original: וָ/אֹ֣מְרָ֔/ה וַֽ/יְטַהֲר֖וּ הַ/לְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וָ/אָשִׁ֣יבָ/ה שָּׁ֗ם כְּלֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֖ה וְ/הַ/לְּבוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: v'mrh vythrv hlshkhvt v'shybh shm khly byt h'lhym 't hmnchh vhlbvnh
verses.translation: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֣דְעָ֔/ה כִּֽי מְנָי֥וֹת הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לֹ֣א נִתָּ֑נָה וַ/יִּבְרְח֧וּ אִישׁ לְ/שָׂדֵ֛/הוּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֥ם וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֥י הַ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: v'd'h khy mnyvt hlvym l' ntnh vybrchv 'ysh lshdhv hlvym vhmshrrym 'shy hml'khh
verses.translation: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

verses.original: וָ/אָרִ֨יבָ/ה֙ אֶת הַ/סְּגָנִ֔ים וָ/אֹ֣מְרָ֔/ה מַדּ֖וּעַ נֶעֱזַ֣ב בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וָֽ/אֶ֨קְבְּצֵ֔/ם וָֽ/אַעֲמִדֵ֖/ם עַל עָמְדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'rybh 't hsgnym v'mrh mdv' n'zb byt h'lhym v'qbtsm v''mdm 'l 'mdm
verses.translation: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֗ה הֵבִ֜יאוּ מַעְשַׂ֧ר הַ/דָּגָ֛ן וְ/הַ/תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְ/הַ/יִּצְהָ֖ר לָ/אוֹצָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vkhl yhvdh hby'v m'shr hdgn vhtyrvsh vhytshr l'vtsrvt
verses.translation: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

verses.original: וָ/אוֹצְרָ֣/ה עַל א֠וֹצָרוֹת שֶׁלֶמְיָ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וְ/צָד֣וֹק הַ/סּוֹפֵ֗ר וּ/פְדָיָה֙ מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/עַל יָדָ֔/ם חָנָ֥ן בֶּן זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן מַתַּנְיָ֑ה כִּ֤י נֶאֱמָנִים֙ נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לַ/חֲלֹ֥ק לַ/אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'vtsrh 'l 'vtsrvt shlmyh hkhhn vtsdvq hsvpr vpdyh mn hlvym v'l ydm chnn bn zkhvr bn mtnyh khy n'mnym nchshbv v'lyhm lchlq l'chyhm
verses.translation: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.

verses.original: זָכְרָ/ה לִּ֥/י אֱלֹהַ֖/י עַל זֹ֑את וְ/אַל תֶּ֣מַח חֲסָדַ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי בְּ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהַ֖/י וּ/בְ/מִשְׁמָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: zkhrh ly 'lhy 'l z't v'l tmch chsdy 'shr 'shyty bbyt 'lhy vbmshmryv
verses.translation: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֡מָּה רָאִ֣יתִי בִֽ/יהוּדָ֣ה דֹּֽרְכִֽים גִּתּ֣וֹת בַּ/שַּׁבָּ֡ת וּ/מְבִיאִ֣ים הָ/עֲרֵמ֣וֹת וְֽ/עֹמְסִ֪ים עַל הַ/חֲמֹרִ֟ים וְ/אַף יַ֜יִן עֲנָבִ֤ים וּ/תְאֵנִים֙ וְ/כָל מַשָּׂ֔א וּ/מְבִיאִ֥ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וָ/אָעִ֕יד בְּ/י֖וֹם מִכְרָ֥/ם צָֽיִד
verses.translit: bymym hhmh r'yty byhvdh drkhym gtvt bshbt vmby'ym h'rmvt v'msym 'l hchmrym v'f yyn 'nbym vt'nym vkhl msh' vmby'ym yrvshlm byvm hshbt v''yd byvm mkhrm tsyd
verses.translation: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/צֹּרִים֙ יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔/הּ מְבִיאִ֥ים דָּ֖אג וְ/כָל מֶ֑כֶר וּ/מֹכְרִ֧ים בַּ/שַּׁבָּ֛ת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhtsrym yshbv bh mby'ym d'g vkhl mkhr vmkhrym bshbt lbny yhvdh vbyrvshlm
verses.translation: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וָ/אָרִ֕יבָ/ה אֵ֖ת חֹרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וָ/אֹמְרָ֣/ה לָ/הֶ֗ם מָֽה הַ/דָּבָ֨ר הָ/רָ֤ע הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים וּֽ/מְחַלְּלִ֖ים אֶת י֥וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: v'rybh 't chry yhvdh v'mrh lhm mh hdbr hr' hzh 'shr 'tm 'shym vmchllym 't yvm hshbt
verses.translation: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֨וֹא כֹ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ אֲבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וַ/יָּבֵ֨א אֱלֹהֵ֜י/נוּ עָלֵ֗י/נוּ אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/עַ֖ל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/אַתֶּ֞ם מוֹסִיפִ֤ים חָרוֹן֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת הַ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: hlv' khh 'shv 'btykhm vyb' 'lhynv 'lynv 't khl hr'h hz't v'l h'yr hz't v'tm mvsypym chrvn 'l yshr'l lchll 't hshbt
verses.translation: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽלֲלוּ֩ שַׁעֲרֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֗ת וָ/אֹֽמְרָ/ה֙ וַ/יִּסָּגְר֣וּ הַ/דְּלָת֔וֹת וָ/אֹ֣מְרָ֔/ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִפְתָּח֔וּ/ם עַ֖ד אַחַ֣ר הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וּ/מִ/נְּעָרַ֗/י הֶֽעֱמַ֨דְתִּי֙ עַל הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֔ים לֹא יָב֥וֹא מַשָּׂ֖א בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr tsllv sh'ry yrvshlm lpny hshbt v'mrh vysgrv hdltvt v'mrh 'shr l' yptchvm 'd 'chr hshbt vmn'ry h'mdty 'l hsh'rym l' ybv' msh' byvm hshbt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּלִ֨ינוּ הָ/רֹכְלִ֜ים וּ/מֹכְרֵ֧י כָל מִמְכָּ֛ר מִ/ח֥וּץ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֖ם פַּ֥עַם וּ/שְׁתָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vylynv hrkhlym vmkhry khl mmkhr mchvts lyrvshlm p'm vshtym
verses.translation: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

verses.original: וָ/אָעִ֣ידָ/ה בָ/הֶ֗ם וָ/אֹמְרָ֤/ה אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ מַדּ֜וּעַ אַתֶּ֤ם לֵנִים֙ נֶ֣גֶד הַ/חוֹמָ֔ה אִם תִּשְׁנ֕וּ יָ֖ד אֶשְׁלַ֣ח בָּ/כֶ֑ם מִן הָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא לֹא בָ֖אוּ בַּ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: v''ydh bhm v'mrh 'lyhm mdv' 'tm lnym ngd hchvmh 'm tshnv yd 'shlch bkhm mn h't hhy' l' b'v bshbt
verses.translation: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמְרָ֣/ה לַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְי֤וּ מִֽטַּהֲרִים֙ וּ/בָאִים֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְ/קַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת גַּם זֹאת֙ זָכְרָ/ה לִּ֣/י אֱלֹהַ֔/י וְ/ח֥וּסָ/ה עָלַ֖/י כְּ/רֹ֥ב חַסְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'mrh llvym 'shr yhyv mthrym vb'ym shmrym hsh'rym lqdsh 't yvm hshbt gm z't zkhrh ly 'lhy vchvsh 'ly khrb chsdkh
verses.translation: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֗ם רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ הֹשִׁ֗יבוּ נָשִׁים֙ אשדודיות אַשְׁדֳּדִיּ֔וֹת עמוניות עַמֳּנִיּ֖וֹת מוֹאֲבִיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: gm bymym hhm r'yty 't hyhvdym hshybv nshym 'shdvdyvt 'shddyvt 'mvnyvt 'mnyvt mv'byvt
verses.translation: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֗ם חֲצִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֔ית וְ/אֵינָ֥/ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית וְ/כִ/לְשׁ֖וֹן עַ֥ם וָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vbnyhm chtsy mdbr 'shdvdyt v'ynm mkhyrym ldbr yhvdyt vkhlshvn 'm v'm
verses.translation: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

verses.original: וָ/אָרִ֤יב עִמָּ/ם֙ וָ/אֲקַֽלְלֵ֔/ם וָ/אַכֶּ֥ה מֵ/הֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וָֽ/אֶמְרְטֵ֑/ם וָ/אַשְׁבִּיעֵ֣/ם בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֗ים אִם תִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אִם תִּשְׂאוּ֙ מִ/בְּנֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'ryb 'mm v'qllm v'khh mhm 'nshym v'mrtm v'shby'm b'lhym 'm ttnv bntykhm lbnyhm v'm tsh'v mbntyhm lbnykhm vlkhm
verses.translation: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying , Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא עַל אֵ֣לֶּה חָטָֽא שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּ/בַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/רַבִּים֩ לֹֽא הָיָ֨ה מֶ֜לֶךְ כָּמֹ֗/הוּ וְ/אָה֤וּב לֵֽ/אלֹהָי/ו֙ הָיָ֔ה וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֣/הוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גַּם אוֹת֣/וֹ הֶחֱטִ֔יאוּ הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים הַ/נָּכְרִיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: hlv' 'l 'lh cht' shlmh mlkh yshr'l vbgvym hrbym l' hyh mlkh khmhv v'hvb l'lhyv hyh vytnhv 'lhym mlkh 'l khl yshr'l gm 'vtv hchty'v hnshym hnkhryvt
verses.translation: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

verses.original: וְ/לָ/כֶ֣ם הֲ/נִשְׁמַ֗ע לַ/עֲשֹׂת֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֤ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את לִ/מְעֹ֖ל בֵּֽ/אלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לְ/הֹשִׁ֖יב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vlkhm hnshm' l'sht 't khl hr'h hgdvlh hz't lm'l b'lhynv lhshyb nshym nkhryvt
verses.translation: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֨י יוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֔וֹל חָתָ֖ן לְ/סַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַ/חֹרֹנִ֑י וָ/אַבְרִיחֵ֖/הוּ מֵ/עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vmbny yvyd' bn 'lyshyb hkhhn hgdvl chtn lsnblt hchrny v'brychhv m'ly
verses.translation: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

verses.original: זָכְרָ֥/ה לָ/הֶ֖ם אֱלֹהָ֑/י עַ֚ל גָּאֳלֵ֣י הַ/כְּהֻנָּ֔ה וּ/בְרִ֥ית הַ/כְּהֻנָּ֖ה וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: zkhrh lhm 'lhy 'l g'ly hkhhnh vbryt hkhhnh vhlvym
verses.translation: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

verses.original: וְ/טִֽהַרְתִּ֖י/ם מִ/כָּל נֵכָ֑ר וָ/אַעֲמִ֧ידָ/ה מִשְׁמָר֛וֹת לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בִּ/מְלַאכְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vthrtym mkhl nkhr v''mydh mshmrvt lkhhnym vllvym 'ysh bml'khtv
verses.translation: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/קֻרְבַּ֧ן הָ/עֵצִ֛ים בְּ/עִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנ֖וֹת וְ/לַ/בִּכּוּרִ֑ים זָכְרָ/ה לִּ֥/י אֱלֹהַ֖/י לְ/טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vlqrbn h'tsym b'tym mzmnvt vlbkhvrym zkhrh ly 'lhy ltvbh
verses.translation: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י בִּ/ימֵ֣י אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ ה֣וּא אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ הַ/מֹּלֵךְ֙ מֵ/הֹ֣דּוּ וְ/עַד כּ֔וּשׁ שֶׁ֛בַע וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/מֵאָ֖ה מְדִינָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bymy 'chshvrvsh hv' 'chshvrvsh hmlkh mhdv v'd khvsh shb' v'shrym vm'h mdynh
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֖ים הָ/הֵ֑ם כְּ/שֶׁ֣בֶת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ עַ֚ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַ/בִּירָֽה
verses.translit: bymym hhm khshbt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'l khs' mlkhvtv 'shr bshvshn hbyrh
verses.translation: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֤ת שָׁלוֹשׁ֙ לְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ עָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה לְ/כָל שָׂרָ֖י/ו וַ/עֲבָדָ֑י/ו חֵ֣יל פָּרַ֣ס וּ/מָדַ֗י הַֽ/פַּרְתְּמִ֛ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/מְּדִינ֖וֹת לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bshnt shlvsh lmlkhv 'shh mshth lkhl shryv v'bdyv chyl prs vmdy hprtmym vshry hmdynvt lpnyv
verses.translation: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:

verses.original: בְּ/הַרְאֹת֗/וֹ אֶת עֹ֨שֶׁר֙ כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ וְ/אֶ֨ת יְקָ֔ר תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּדוּלָּת֑/וֹ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם
verses.translit: bhr'tv 't 'shr khbvd mlkhvtv v't yqr tp'rt gdvltv ymym rbym shmvnym vm't yvm
verses.translation: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/מְל֣וֹאת הַ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה עָשָׂ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/נִּמְצְאִים֩ בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֨ן הַ/בִּירָ֜ה לְ/מִ/גָּ֧דוֹל וְ/עַד קָטָ֛ן מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּ/חֲצַ֕ר גִּנַּ֥ת בִּיתַ֖ן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vbmlv't hymym h'lh 'shh hmlkh lkhl h'm hnmts'ym bshvshn hbyrh lmgdvl v'd qtn mshth shb't ymym bchtsr gnt bytn hmlkh
verses.translation: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace;

verses.original: ח֣וּר כַּרְפַּ֣ס וּ/תְכֵ֗לֶת אָחוּז֙ בְּ/חַבְלֵי ב֣וּץ וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֔ן עַל גְּלִ֥ילֵי כֶ֖סֶף וְ/עַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֑שׁ מִטּ֣וֹת זָהָ֣ב וָ/כֶ֗סֶף עַ֛ל רִֽצְפַ֥ת בַּהַט וָ/שֵׁ֖שׁ וְ/דַ֥ר וְ/סֹחָֽרֶת
verses.translit: chvr khrps vtkhlt 'chvz bchbly bvts v'rgmn 'l glyly khsf v'mvdy shsh mtvt zhb vkhsf 'l rtspt bht vshsh vdr vschrt
verses.translation: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

verses.original: וְ/הַשְׁקוֹת֙ בִּ/כְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְ/כֵלִ֖ים מִ/כֵּלִ֣ים שׁוֹנִ֑ים וְ/יֵ֥ין מַלְכ֛וּת רָ֖ב כְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vhshqvt bkhly zhb vkhlym mkhlym shvnym vyyn mlkhvt rb khyd hmlkh
verses.translation: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שְּׁתִיָּ֥ה כַ/דָּ֖ת אֵ֣ין אֹנֵ֑ס כִּי כֵ֣ן יִסַּ֣ד הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ עַ֚ל כָּל רַ֣ב בֵּית֔/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת כִּ/רְצ֥וֹן אִישׁ וָ/אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vhshtyh khdt 'yn 'ns khy khn ysd hmlkh 'l khl rb bytv l'shvt khrtsvn 'ysh v'ysh
verses.translation: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

verses.original: גַּ֚ם וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַ/מַּלְכָּ֔ה עָשְׂתָ֖ה מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה נָשִׁ֑ים בֵּ֚ית הַ/מַּלְכ֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: gm vshty hmlkhh 'shth mshth nshym byt hmlkhvt 'shr lmlkh 'chshvrvsh
verses.translation: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.

verses.original: בַּ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י כְּ/ט֥וֹב לֵב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בַּ/יָּ֑יִן אָמַ֡ר לִ֠/מְהוּמָן בִּזְּתָ֨א חַרְבוֹנָ֜א בִּגְתָ֤א וַ/אֲבַגְתָא֙ זֵתַ֣ר וְ/כַרְכַּ֔ס שִׁבְעַת֙ הַ/סָּ֣רִיסִ֔ים הַ/מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים אֶת פְּנֵ֖י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: byvm hshby'y khtvb lb hmlkh byyn 'mr lmhvmn bzt' chrbvn' bgt' v'bgt' ztr vkhrkhs shb't hsrysym hmshrtym 't pny hmlkh 'chshvrvsh
verses.translation: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

verses.original: לְ֠/הָבִיא אֶת וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַ/מַּלְכָּ֛ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/כֶ֣תֶר מַלְכ֑וּת לְ/הַרְא֨וֹת הָֽ/עַמִּ֤ים וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ אֶת יָפְיָ֔/הּ כִּֽי טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽיא
verses.translit: lhby' 't vshty hmlkhh lpny hmlkh bkhtr mlkhvt lhr'vt h'mym vhshrym 't ypyh khy tvbt mr'h hy'
verses.translation: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.

verses.original: וַ/תְּמָאֵ֞ן הַ/מַּלְכָּ֣ה וַשְׁתִּ֗י לָ/בוֹא֙ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/סָּרִיסִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְצֹ֤ף הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַ/חֲמָת֖/וֹ בָּעֲרָ֥ה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtm'n hmlkhh vshty lbv' bdbr hmlkh 'shr byd hsrysym vyqtsf hmlkh m'd vchmtv b'rh bv
verses.translation: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לַ/חֲכָמִ֖ים יֹדְעֵ֣י הָֽ/עִתִּ֑ים כִּי כֵן֙ דְּבַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לִ/פְנֵ֕י כָּל יֹדְעֵ֖י דָּ֥ת וָ/דִֽין
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lchkhmym yd'y h'tym khy khn dbr hmlkh lpny khl yd'y dt vdyn
verses.translation: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king’s manner toward all that knew law and judgment:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/קָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֗י/ו כַּרְשְׁנָ֤א שֵׁתָר֙ אַדְמָ֣תָא תַרְשִׁ֔ישׁ מֶ֥רֶס מַרְסְנָ֖א מְמוּכָ֑ן שִׁבְעַ֞ת שָׂרֵ֣י פָּרַ֣ס וּ/מָדַ֗י רֹאֵי֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה בַּ/מַּלְכֽוּת
verses.translit: vhqrb 'lyv khrshn' shtr 'dmt' trshysh mrs mrsn' mmvkhn shb't shry prs vmdy r'y pny hmlkh hyshbym r'shnh bmlkhvt
verses.translation: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king’s face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)

verses.original: כְּ/דָת֙ מַֽה לַּ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת בַּ/מַּלְכָּ֖ה וַשְׁתִּ֑י עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא עָשְׂתָ֗ה אֶֽת מַאֲמַר֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ בְּ/יַ֖ד הַ/סָּרִיסִֽים
verses.translit: khdt mh l'shvt bmlkhh vshty 'l 'shr l' 'shth 't m'mr hmlkh 'chshvrvsh byd hsrysym
verses.translation: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מומכן מְמוּכָ֗ן לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֔ים לֹ֤א עַל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ עָוְתָ֖ה וַשְׁתִּ֣י הַ/מַּלְכָּ֑ה כִּ֤י עַל כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ וְ/עַל כָּל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּ/כָל מְדִינ֖וֹת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr mvmkhn mmvkhn lpny hmlkh vhshrym l' 'l hmlkh lbdv 'vth vshty hmlkhh khy 'l khl hshrym v'l khl h'mym 'shr bkhl mdynvt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh
verses.translation: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

verses.original: כִּֽי יֵצֵ֤א דְבַר הַ/מַּלְכָּה֙ עַל כָּל הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים לְ/הַבְז֥וֹת בַּעְלֵי/הֶ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֑ן בְּ/אָמְרָ֗/ם הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֡וֹשׁ אָמַ֞ר לְ/הָבִ֨יא אֶת וַשְׁתִּ֧י הַ/מַּלְכָּ֛ה לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו וְ/לֹא בָֽאָה
verses.translit: khy yts' dbr hmlkhh 'l khl hnshym lhbzvt b'lyhn b'ynyhn b'mrm hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'mr lhby' 't vshty hmlkhh lpnyv vl' b'h
verses.translation: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֜ה תֹּאמַ֣רְנָה שָׂר֣וֹת פָּֽרַס וּ/מָדַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וּ/כְ/דַ֖י בִּזָּי֥וֹן וָ/קָֽצֶף
verses.translit: vhyvm hzh t'mrnh shrvt prs vmdy 'shr shm'v 't dbr hmlkhh lkhl shry hmlkh vkhdy bzyvn vqtsf
verses.translation: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king’s princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.

verses.original: אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֗וֹב יֵצֵ֤א דְבַר מַלְכוּת֙ מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֔י/ו וְ/יִכָּתֵ֛ב בְּ/דָתֵ֥י פָֽרַס וּ/מָדַ֖י וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲב֑וֹר אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא תָב֜וֹא וַשְׁתִּ֗י לִ/פְנֵי֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וּ/מַלְכוּתָ/הּ֙ יִתֵּ֣ן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לִ/רְעוּתָ֖/הּ הַ/טּוֹבָ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: 'm 'l hmlkh tvb yts' dbr mlkhvt mlpnyv vykhtb bdty prs vmdy vl' y'bvr 'shr l' tbv' vshty lpny hmlkh 'chshvrvsh vmlkhvth ytn hmlkh lr'vth htvbh mmnh
verses.translation: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁמַע֩ פִּתְגָ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲשֶֽׁר יַעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּ/כָל מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה הִ֑יא וְ/כָל הַ/נָּשִׁ֗ים יִתְּנ֤וּ יְקָר֙ לְ/בַעְלֵי/הֶ֔ן לְ/מִ/גָּד֖וֹל וְ/עַד קָטָֽן
verses.translit: vnshm' ptgm hmlkh 'shr y'shh bkhl mlkhvtv khy rbh hy' vkhl hnshym ytnv yqr lb'lyhn lmgdvl v'd qtn
verses.translation: And when the king’s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיטַב֙ הַ/דָּבָ֔ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר מְמוּכָֽן
verses.translit: vyytb hdbr b'yny hmlkh vhshrym vy'sh hmlkh khdbr mmvkhn
verses.translation: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח סְפָרִים֙ אֶל כָּל מְדִינ֣וֹת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל מְדִינָ֤ה וּ/מְדִינָה֙ כִּ/כְתָבָ֔/הּ וְ/אֶל עַ֥ם וָ/עָ֖ם כִּ/לְשׁוֹנ֑/וֹ לִ/הְי֤וֹת כָּל אִישׁ֙ שֹׂרֵ֣ר בְּ/בֵית֔/וֹ וּ/מְדַבֵּ֖ר כִּ/לְשׁ֥וֹן עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch sprym 'l khl mdynvt hmlkh 'l mdynh vmdynh khkhtbh v'l 'm v'm khlshvnv lhyvt khl 'ysh shrr bbytv vmdbr khlshvn 'mv
verses.translation: For he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.

verses.original: אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כְּ/שֹׁ֕ךְ חֲמַ֖ת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ זָכַ֤ר אֶת וַשְׁתִּי֙ וְ/אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֔תָה וְ/אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר נִגְזַ֖ר עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'chr hdbrym h'lh khshkh chmt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh zkhr 't vshty v't 'shr 'shth v't 'shr ngzr 'lyh
verses.translation: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ נַעֲרֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מְשָׁרְתָ֑י/ו יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ לַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ נְעָר֥וֹת בְּתוּל֖וֹת טוֹב֥וֹת מַרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv n'ry hmlkh mshrtyv ybqshv lmlkh n'rvt btvlvt tvbvt mr'h
verses.translation: Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:

verses.original: וְ/יַפְקֵ֨ד הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ פְּקִידִים֮ בְּ/כָל מְדִינ֣וֹת מַלְכוּת/וֹ֒ וְ/יִקְבְּצ֣וּ אֶת כָּל נַעֲרָֽה בְ֠תוּלָה טוֹבַ֨ת מַרְאֶ֜ה אֶל שׁוּשַׁ֤ן הַ/בִּירָה֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים אֶל יַ֥ד הֵגֶ֛א סְרִ֥יס הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַ/נָּשִׁ֑ים וְ/נָת֖וֹן תַּמְרוּקֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vypqd hmlkh pqydym bkhl mdynvt mlkhvtv vyqbtsv 't khl n'rh btvlh tvbt mr'h 'l shvshn hbyrh 'l byt hnshym 'l yd hg' srys hmlkh shmr hnshym vntvn tmrvqyhn
verses.translation: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hege the king’s chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּיטַב֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ תִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּ֣חַת וַשְׁתִּ֑י וַ/יִּיטַ֧ב הַ/דָּבָ֛ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vhn'rh 'shr tytb b'yny hmlkh tmlkh tcht vshty vyytb hdbr b'yny hmlkh vy'sh khn
verses.translation: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדִ֔י הָיָ֖ה בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַ/בִּירָ֑ה וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ מָרְדֳּכַ֗י בֶּ֣ן יָאִ֧יר בֶּן שִׁמְעִ֛י בֶּן קִ֖ישׁ אִ֥ישׁ יְמִינִֽי
verses.translit: 'ysh yhvdy hyh bshvshn hbyrh vshmv mrdkhy bn y'yr bn shm'y bn qysh 'ysh ymyny
verses.translation: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָגְלָה֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלַ֔יִם עִם הַ/גֹּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָגְלְתָ֔ה עִ֖ם יְכָנְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: 'shr hglh myrvshlym 'm hglh 'shr hglth 'm ykhnyh mlkh yhvdh 'shr hglh nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl
verses.translation: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י אֹמֵ֜ן אֶת הֲדַסָּ֗ה הִ֤יא אֶסְתֵּר֙ בַּת דֹּד֔/וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין לָ֖/הּ אָ֣ב וָ/אֵ֑ם וְ/הַ/נַּעֲרָ֤ה יְפַת תֹּ֨אַר֙ וְ/טוֹבַ֣ת מַרְאֶ֔ה וּ/בְ/מ֤וֹת אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אִמָּ֔/הּ לְקָחָ֧/הּ מָרְדֳּכַ֛י ל֖/וֹ לְ/בַֽת
verses.translit: vyhy 'mn 't hdsh hy' 'str bt ddv khy 'yn lh 'b v'm vhn'rh ypt t'r vtvbt mr'h vbmvt 'byh v'mh lqchh mrdkhy lv lbt
verses.translation: And he brought up Hadassah, that is , Esther, his uncle’s daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/הִשָּׁמַ֤ע דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/דָת֔/וֹ וּֽ/בְ/הִקָּבֵ֞ץ נְעָר֥וֹת רַבּ֛וֹת אֶל שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַ/בִּירָ֖ה אֶל יַ֣ד הֵגָ֑י וַ/תִּלָּקַ֤ח אֶסְתֵּר֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל יַ֥ד הֵגַ֖י שֹׁמֵ֥ר הַ/נָּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhy bhshm' dbr hmlkh vdtv vbhqbts n'rvt rbvt 'l shvshn hbyrh 'l yd hgy vtlqch 'str 'l byt hmlkh 'l yd hgy shmr hnshym
verses.translation: So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

verses.original: וַ/תִּיטַ֨ב הַ/נַּעֲרָ֣ה בְ/עֵינָי/ו֮ וַ/תִּשָּׂ֣א חֶ֣סֶד לְ/פָנָי/ו֒ וַ֠/יְבַהֵל אֶת תַּמְרוּקֶ֤י/הָ וְ/אֶת מָנוֹתֶ֨/הָ֙ לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ֔/הּ וְ/אֵת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע הַ/נְּעָר֔וֹת הָ/רְאֻי֥וֹת לָֽ/תֶת לָ֖/הּ מִ/בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יְשַׁנֶּ֧/הָ וְ/אֶת נַעֲרוֹתֶ֛י/הָ לְ/ט֖וֹב בֵּ֥ית הַ/נָּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vtytb hn'rh b'ynyv vtsh' chsd lpnyv vybhl 't tmrvqyh v't mnvth ltt lh v't shb' hn'rvt hr'yvt ltt lh mbyt hmlkh vyshnh v't n'rvtyh ltvb byt hnshym
verses.translation: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king’s house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.

verses.original: לֹא הִגִּ֣ידָה אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֶת עַמָּ֖/הּ וְ/אֶת מֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑/הּ כִּ֧י מָרְדֳּכַ֛י צִוָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תַגִּֽיד
verses.translit: l' hgydh 'str 't 'mh v't mvldth khy mrdkhy tsvh 'lyh 'shr l' tgyd
verses.translation: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it .

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל י֣וֹם וָ/י֔וֹם מָרְדֳּכַי֙ מִתְהַלֵּ֔ךְ לִ/פְנֵ֖י חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית הַ/נָּשִׁ֑ים לָ/דַ֨עַת֙ אֶת שְׁל֣וֹם אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וּ/מַה יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vbkhl yvm vyvm mrdkhy mthlkh lpny chtsr byt hnshym ld't 't shlvm 'str vmh y'shh bh
verses.translation: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women’s house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַגִּ֡יעַ תֹּר֩ נַעֲרָ֨ה וְ/נַעֲרָ֜ה לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֗וֹשׁ מִ/קֵּץ֩ הֱי֨וֹת לָ֜/הּ כְּ/דָ֤ת הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר חֹ֔דֶשׁ כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יִמְלְא֖וּ יְמֵ֣י מְרוּקֵי/הֶ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ בְּ/שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מֹּ֔ר וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ בַּ/בְּשָׂמִ֔ים וּ/בְ/תַמְרוּקֵ֖י הַ/נָּשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vbhgy' tr n'rh vn'rh lbv' 'l hmlkh 'chshvrvsh mqts hyvt lh khdt hnshym shnym 'shr chdsh khy khn yml'v ymy mrvqyhn shshh chdshym bshmn hmr vshshh chdshym bbshmym vbtmrvqy hnshym
verses.translation: Now when every maid’s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit , six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)

verses.original: וּ/בָ/זֶ֕ה הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֖ה בָּאָ֣ה אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאמַ֜ר יִנָּ֤תֵֽן לָ/הּ֙ לָ/ב֣וֹא עִמָּ֔/הּ מִ/בֵּ֥ית הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים עַד בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vbzh hn'rh b'h 'l hmlkh 't khl 'shr t'mr yntn lh lbv' 'mh mbyt hnshym 'd byt hmlkh
verses.translation: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king’s house.

verses.original: בָּ/עֶ֣רֶב הִ֣יא בָאָ֗ה וּ֠/בַ/בֹּקֶר הִ֣יא שָׁבָ֞ה אֶל בֵּ֤ית הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ שֵׁנִ֔י אֶל יַ֧ד שַֽׁעֲשְׁגַ֛ז סְרִ֥יס הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַ/פִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים לֹא תָב֥וֹא עוֹד֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֣י אִם חָפֵ֥ץ בָּ֛/הּ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/נִקְרְאָ֥ה בְ/שֵֽׁם
verses.translit: b'rb hy' b'h vbbqr hy' shbh 'l byt hnshym shny 'l yd sh'shgz srys hmlkh shmr hpylgshym l' tbv' 'vd 'l hmlkh khy 'm chpts bh hmlkh vnqr'h bshm
verses.translation: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַגִּ֣יעַ תֹּר אֶסְתֵּ֣ר בַּת אֲבִיחַ֣יִל דֹּ֣ד מָרְדֳּכַ֡י אֲשֶׁר֩ לָקַֽח ל֨/וֹ לְ/בַ֜ת לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ לֹ֤א בִקְשָׁה֙ דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֠י אִ֣ם אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֛ר הֵגַ֥י סְרִיס הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַ/נָּשִׁ֑ים וַ/תְּהִ֤י אֶסְתֵּר֙ נֹשֵׂ֣את חֵ֔ן בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל רֹאֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbhgy' tr 'str bt 'bychyl dd mrdkhy 'shr lqch lv lbt lbv' 'l hmlkh l' bqshh dbr khy 'm 't 'shr y'mr hgy srys hmlkh shmr hnshym vthy 'str nsh't chn b'yny khl r'yh
verses.translation: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.

verses.original: וַ/תִּלָּקַ֨ח אֶסְתֵּ֜ר אֶל הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֖י הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ טֵבֵ֑ת בִּ/שְׁנַת שֶׁ֖בַע לְ/מַלְכוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtlqch 'str 'l hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 'l byt mlkhvtv bchdsh h'shyry hv' chdsh tbt bshnt shb' lmlkhvtv
verses.translation: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֨ב הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֶת אֶסְתֵּר֙ מִ/כָּל הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים וַ/תִּשָּׂא חֵ֥ן וָ/חֶ֛סֶד לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו מִ/כָּל הַ/בְּתוּלֹ֑ת וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם כֶּֽתֶר מַלְכוּת֙ בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֔/הּ וַ/יַּמְלִיכֶ֖/הָ תַּ֥חַת וַשְׁתִּֽי
verses.translit: vy'hb hmlkh 't 'str mkhl hnshym vtsh' chn vchsd lpnyv mkhl hbtvlt vyshm khtr mlkhvt br'shh vymlykhh tcht vshty
verses.translation: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה גָד֗וֹל לְ/כָל שָׂרָי/ו֙ וַ/עֲבָדָ֔י/ו אֵ֖ת מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה אֶסְתֵּ֑ר וַ/הֲנָחָ֤ה לַ/מְּדִינוֹת֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן מַשְׂאֵ֖ת כְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh mshth gdvl lkhl shryv v'bdyv 't mshth 'str vhnchh lmdynvt 'shh vytn msh't khyd hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הִקָּבֵ֥ץ בְּתוּל֖וֹת שֵׁנִ֑ית וּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/שַֽׁעַר הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
