verses.translit: vbhqbts btvlvt shnyt vmrdkhy yshb bsh'r hmlkh
verses.translation: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king’s gate.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין אֶסְתֵּ֗ר מַגֶּ֤דֶת מֽוֹלַדְתָּ/הּ֙ וְ/אֶת עַמָּ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/הָ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וְ/אֶת מַאֲמַ֤ר מָרְדֳּכַי֙ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר עֹשָׂ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר הָיְתָ֥ה בְ/אָמְנָ֖ה אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'yn 'str mgdt mvldth v't 'mh kh'shr tsvh 'lyh mrdkhy v't m'mr mrdkhy 'str 'shh kh'shr hyth b'mnh 'tv
verses.translation: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם וּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֖י יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/שַֽׁעַר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ קָצַף֩ בִּגְתָ֨ן וָ/תֶ֜רֶשׁ שְׁנֵֽי סָרִיסֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מִ/שֹּׁמְרֵ֣י הַ/סַּ֔ף וַ/יְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לִ/שְׁלֹ֣חַ יָ֔ד בַּ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵֽרֹשׁ
verses.translit: bymym hhm vmrdkhy yshb bsh'r hmlkh qtsf bgtn vtrsh shny srysy hmlkh mshmry hsf vybqshv lshlch yd bmlkh 'chshvrsh
verses.translation: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king’s gate, two of the king’s chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּדַ֤ע הַ/דָּבָר֙ לְ/מָרְדֳּכַ֔י וַ/יַּגֵּ֖ד לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֑ה וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֛ר לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם מָרְדֳּכָֽי
verses.translit: vyvd' hdbr lmrdkhy vygd l'str hmlkhh vt'mr 'str lmlkh bshm mrdkhy
verses.translation: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai’s name.

verses.original: וַ/יְבֻקַּ֤שׁ הַ/דָּבָר֙ וַ/יִּמָּצֵ֔א וַ/יִּתָּל֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל עֵ֑ץ וַ/יִּכָּתֵ֗ב בְּ/סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vybqsh hdbr vymts' vytlv shnyhm 'l 'ts vykhtb bspr dbry hymym lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.

verses.original: אַחַ֣ר הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה גִּדַּל֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֜וֹשׁ אֶת הָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֛תָא הָ/אֲגָגִ֖י וַֽ/יְנַשְּׂאֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶת כִּסְא֔/וֹ מֵ/עַ֕ל כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'chr hdbrym h'lh gdl hmlkh 'chshvrvsh 't hmn bn hmdt' h'ggy vynsh'hv vyshm 't khs'v m'l khl hshrym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

verses.original: וְ/כָל עַבְדֵ֨י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ כֹּרְעִ֤ים וּ/מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ לְ/הָמָ֔ן כִּי כֵ֖ן צִוָּה ל֣/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וּ/מָ֨רְדֳּכַ֔י לֹ֥א יִכְרַ֖ע וְ/לֹ֥א יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhl 'bdy hmlkh 'shr bsh'r hmlkh khr'ym vmshtchvym lhmn khy khn tsvh lv hmlkh vmrdkhy l' ykhr' vl' yshtchvh
verses.translation: And all the king’s servants, that were in the king’s gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ עַבְדֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לְ/מָרְדֳּכָ֑י מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ אַתָּ֣ה עוֹבֵ֔ר אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֥ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdy hmlkh 'shr bsh'r hmlkh lmrdkhy mdv' 'th 'vbr 't mtsvt hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king’s servants, which were in the king’s gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king’s commandment?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י ב/אמר/ם כְּ/אָמְרָ֤/ם אֵלָי/ו֙ י֣וֹם וָ/י֔וֹם וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ לְ/הָמָ֗ן לִ/רְאוֹת֙ הֲ/יַֽעַמְדוּ֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י מָרְדֳּכַ֔י כִּֽי הִגִּ֥יד לָ/הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא יְהוּדִֽי
verses.translit: vyhy b'mrm kh'mrm 'lyv yvm vyvm vl' shm' 'lyhm vygydv lhmn lr'vt hy'mdv dbry mrdkhy khy hgyd lhm 'shr hv' yhvdy
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא הָמָ֔ן כִּי אֵ֣ין מָרְדֳּכַ֔י כֹּרֵ֥עַ וּ/מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה ל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֥א הָמָ֖ן חֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vyr' hmn khy 'yn mrdkhy khr' vmshtchvh lv vyml' hmn chmh
verses.translation: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣בֶז בְּ/עֵינָ֗י/ו לִ/שְׁלֹ֤ח יָד֙ בְּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֣י לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ כִּֽי הִגִּ֥ידוּ ל֖/וֹ אֶת עַ֣ם מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַ/יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ הָמָ֗ן לְ/הַשְׁמִ֧יד אֶת כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּ/כָל מַלְכ֥וּת אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ עַ֥ם מָרְדֳּכָֽי
verses.translit: vybz b'ynyv lshlch yd bmrdkhy lbdv khy hgydv lv 't 'm mrdkhy vybqsh hmn lhshmyd 't khl hyhvdym 'shr bkhl mlkhvt 'chshvrvsh 'm mrdkhy
verses.translation: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ נִיסָ֔ן בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ הִפִּ֣יל פּוּר֩ ה֨וּא הַ/גּוֹרָ֜ל לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָמָ֗ן מִ/יּ֧וֹם לְ/י֛וֹם וּ/מֵ/חֹ֛דֶשׁ לְ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ אֲדָֽר
verses.translit: bchdsh hr'shvn hv' chdsh nysn bshnt shtym 'shrh lmlkh 'chshvrvsh hpyl pvr hv' hgvrl lpny hmn myvm lyvm vmchdsh lchdsh shnym 'shr hv' chdsh 'dr
verses.translation: In the first month, that is , the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is , the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הָמָן֙ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ יֶשְׁנ֣/וֹ עַם אֶחָ֗ד מְפֻזָּ֤ר וּ/מְפֹרָד֙ בֵּ֣ין הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים בְּ/כֹ֖ל מְדִינ֣וֹת מַלְכוּתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/דָתֵי/הֶ֞ם שֹׁנ֣וֹת מִ/כָּל עָ֗ם וְ/אֶת דָּתֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵינָ֣/ם עֹשִׂ֔ים וְ/לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֵין שֹׁוֶ֖ה לְ/הַנִּיחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmn lmlkh 'chshvrvsh yshnv 'm 'chd mpzr vmprd byn h'mym bkhl mdynvt mlkhvtkh vdtyhm shnvt mkhl 'm v't dty hmlkh 'ynm 'shym vlmlkh 'yn shvh lhnychm
verses.translation: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king’s laws: therefore it is not for the king’s profit to suffer them.

verses.original: אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב יִכָּתֵ֖ב לְ/אַבְּדָ֑/ם וַ/עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים כִּכַּר כֶּ֗סֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל֙ עַל יְדֵי֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה לְ/הָבִ֖יא אֶל גִּנְזֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: 'm 'l hmlkh tvb ykhtb l'bdm v'shrt 'lpym khkhr khsf 'shqvl 'l ydy 'shy hml'khh lhby' 'l gnzy hmlkh
verses.translation: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧סַר הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת טַבַּעְתּ֖/וֹ מֵ/עַ֣ל יָד֑/וֹ וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ֗/הּ לְ/הָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֛תָא הָ/אֲגָגִ֖י צֹרֵ֥ר הַ/יְּהוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vysr hmlkh 't tb'tv m'l ydv vytnh lhmn bn hmdt' h'ggy tsrr hyhvdym
verses.translation: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/הָמָ֔ן הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף נָת֣וּן לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הָ/עָ֕ם לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת בּ֖/וֹ כַּ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lhmn hkhsf ntvn lkh vh'm l'shvt bv khtvb b'ynykh
verses.translation: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּרְאוּ֩ סֹפְרֵ֨י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֣ר יוֹם֮ בּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יִּכָּתֵ֣ב כְּֽ/כָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה הָמָ֡ן אֶ֣ל אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵֽי הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ וְֽ/אֶל הַ/פַּח֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל מְדִינָ֣ה וּ/מְדִינָ֗ה וְ/אֶל שָׂ֤רֵי עַם֙ וָ/עָ֔ם מְדִינָ֤ה וּ/מְדִינָה֙ כִּ/כְתָבָ֔/הּ וְ/עַ֥ם וָ/עָ֖ם כִּ/לְשׁוֹנ֑/וֹ בְּ/שֵׁ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ֙ נִכְתָּ֔ב וְ/נֶחְתָּ֖ם בְּ/טַבַּ֥עַת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyqr'v spry hmlkh bchdsh hr'shvn bshlvshh 'shr yvm bv vykhtb khkhl 'shr tsvh hmn 'l 'chshdrpny hmlkh v'l hpchvt 'shr 'l mdynh vmdynh v'l shry 'm v'm mdynh vmdynh khkhtbh v'm v'm khlshvnv bshm hmlkh 'chshvrsh nkhtb vnchtm btb't hmlkh
verses.translation: Then were the king’s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king’s ring.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁל֨וֹחַ סְפָרִ֜ים בְּ/יַ֣ד הָ/רָצִים֮ אֶל כָּל מְדִינ֣וֹת הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ לְ/הַשְׁמִ֡יד לַ/הֲרֹ֣ג וּ/לְ/אַבֵּ֣ד אֶת כָּל הַ֠/יְּהוּדִים מִ/נַּ֨עַר וְ/עַד זָקֵ֜ן טַ֤ף וְ/נָשִׁים֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לְ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֑ר וּ/שְׁלָלָ֖/ם לָ/בֽוֹז
verses.translit: vnshlvch sprym byd hrtsym 'l khl mdynvt hmlkh lhshmyd lhrg vl'bd 't khl hyhvdym mn'r v'd zqn tf vnshym byvm 'chd bshlvshh 'shr lchdsh shnym 'shr hv' chdsh 'dr vshllm lbvz
verses.translation: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.

verses.original: פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַ/כְּתָ֗ב לְ/הִנָּ֤תֵֽן דָּת֙ בְּ/כָל מְדִינָ֣ה וּ/מְדִינָ֔ה גָּל֖וּי לְ/כָל הָֽ/עַמִּ֑ים לִ/הְי֥וֹת עֲתִדִ֖ים לַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: ptshgn hkhtb lhntn dt bkhl mdynh vmdynh glvy lkhl h'mym lhyvt 'tdym lyvm hzh
verses.translation: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.

verses.original: הָֽ/רָצִ֞ים יָצְא֤וּ דְחוּפִים֙ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/הַ/דָּ֥ת נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַ/בִּירָ֑ה וְ/הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/הָמָן֙ יָשְׁב֣וּ לִ/שְׁתּ֔וֹת וְ/הָ/עִ֥יר שׁוּשָׁ֖ן נָבֽוֹכָה
verses.translit: hrtsym yts'v dchvpym bdbr hmlkh vhdt ntnh bshvshn hbyrh vhmlkh vhmn yshbv lshtvt vh'yr shvshn nbvkhh
verses.translation: The posts went out, being hastened by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

verses.original: וּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֗י יָדַע֙ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרַ֤ע מָרְדֳּכַי֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּלְבַּ֥שׁ שַׂ֖ק וָ/אֵ֑פֶר וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יִּזְעַ֛ק זְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה וּ/מָרָֽה
verses.translit: vmrdkhy yd' 't khl 'shr n'shh vyqr' mrdkhy 't bgdyv vylbsh shq v'pr vyts' btvkh h'yr vyz'q z'qh gdlh vmrh
verses.translation: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֕וֹא עַ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֣י שַֽׁעַר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לָ/ב֛וֹא אֶל שַׁ֥עַר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּ/לְב֥וּשׁ שָֽׂק
verses.translit: vybv' 'd lpny sh'r hmlkh khy 'yn lbv' 'l sh'r hmlkh blbvsh shq
verses.translation: And came even before the king’s gate: for none might enter into the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל מְדִינָ֣ה וּ/מְדִינָ֗ה מְקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/דָת/וֹ֙ מַגִּ֔יעַ אֵ֤בֶל גָּדוֹל֙ לַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים וְ/צ֥וֹם וּ/בְכִ֖י וּ/מִסְפֵּ֑ד שַׂ֣ק וָ/אֵ֔פֶר יֻצַּ֖ע לָֽ/רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vbkhl mdynh vmdynh mqvm 'shr dbr hmlkh vdtv mgy' 'bl gdvl lyhvdym vtsvm vbkhy vmspd shq v'pr yts' lrbym
verses.translation: And in every province, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.original: וַ֠/תָּבוֹאינָה נַעֲר֨וֹת אֶסְתֵּ֤ר וְ/סָרִיסֶ֨י/הָ֙ וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔/הּ וַ/תִּתְחַלְחַ֥ל הַ/מַּלְכָּ֖ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֨ח בְּגָדִ֜ים לְ/הַלְבִּ֣ישׁ אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַ֗י וּ/לְ/הָסִ֥יר שַׂקּ֛/וֹ מֵ/עָלָ֖י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א קִבֵּֽל
verses.translit: vtbv'ynh n'rvt 'str vsrysyh vygydv lh vttchlchl hmlkhh m'd vtshlch bgdym lhlbysh 't mrdkhy vlhsyr shqv m'lyv vl' qbl
verses.translation: So Esther’s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרָא֩ אֶסְתֵּ֨ר לַ/הֲתָ֜ךְ מִ/סָּרִיסֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱמִ֣יד לְ/פָנֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תְּצַוֵּ֖/הוּ עַֽל מָרְדֳּכָ֑י לָ/דַ֥עַת מַה זֶּ֖ה וְ/עַל מַה זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vtqr' 'str lhtkh msrysy hmlkh 'shr h'myd lpnyh vttsvhv 'l mrdkhy ld't mh zh v'l mh zh
verses.translation: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king’s chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was , and why it was .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הֲתָ֖ךְ אֶֽל מָרְדֳּכָ֑י אֶל רְח֣וֹב הָ/עִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyts' htkh 'l mrdkhy 'l rchvb h'yr 'shr lpny sh'r hmlkh
verses.translation: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king’s gate.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֶּד ל֣/וֹ מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֑/הוּ וְ/אֵ֣ת פָּרָשַׁ֣ת הַ/כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר הָמָן֙ לִ֠/שְׁקוֹל עַל גִּנְזֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ ב/יהודיים בַּ/יְּהוּדִ֖ים לְ/אַבְּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vygd lv mrdkhy 't khl 'shr qrhv v't prsht hkhsf 'shr 'mr hmn lshqvl 'l gnzy hmlkh byhvdyym byhvdym l'bdm
verses.translation: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן כְּתָֽב הַ֠/דָּת אֲשֶׁר נִתַּ֨ן בְּ/שׁוּשָׁ֤ן לְ/הַשְׁמִידָ/ם֙ נָ֣תַן ל֔/וֹ לְ/הַרְא֥וֹת אֶת אֶסְתֵּ֖ר וּ/לְ/הַגִּ֣יד לָ֑/הּ וּ/לְ/צַוּ֣וֹת עָלֶ֗י/הָ לָ/ב֨וֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ לְ/הִֽתְחַנֶּן ל֛/וֹ וּ/לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֖י/ו עַל עַמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v't ptshgn khtb hdt 'shr ntn bshvshn lhshmydm ntn lv lhr'vt 't 'str vlhgyd lh vltsvvt 'lyh lbv' 'l hmlkh lhtchnn lv vlbqsh mlpnyv 'l 'mh
verses.translation: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֖וֹא הֲתָ֑ךְ וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י מָרְדֳּכָֽי
verses.translit: vybv' htkh vygd l'str 't dbry mrdkhy
verses.translation: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר אֶסְתֵּר֙ לַ/הֲתָ֔ךְ וַ/תְּצַוֵּ֖/הוּ אֶֽל מָרְדֳּכָֽי
verses.translit: vt'mr 'str lhtkh vttsvhv 'l mrdkhy
verses.translation: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

verses.original: כָּל עַבְדֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ וְ/עַם מְדִינ֨וֹת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ יֽוֹדְעִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּל אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבֽוֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֩ אֶל הֶ/חָצֵ֨ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֜ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יִקָּרֵ֗א אַחַ֤ת דָּת/וֹ֙ לְ/הָמִ֔ית לְ֠/בַד מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֽוֹשִׁיט ל֥/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת שַׁרְבִ֥יט הַ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/חָיָ֑ה וַ/אֲנִ֗י לֹ֤א נִקְרֵ֨אתי֙ לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ זֶ֖ה שְׁלוֹשִׁ֥ים יֽוֹם
verses.translit: khl 'bdy hmlkh v'm mdynvt hmlkh yvd'ym 'shr khl 'ysh v'shh 'shr ybv' 'l hmlkh 'l hchtsr hpnymyt 'shr l' yqr' 'cht dtv lhmyt lbd m'shr yvshyt lv hmlkh 't shrbyt hzhb vchyh v'ny l' nqr'ty lbv' 'l hmlkh zh shlvshym yvm
verses.translation: All the king’s servants, and the people of the king’s provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ לְ/מָרְדֳּכָ֔י אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י אֶסְתֵּֽר
verses.translit: vygydv lmrdkhy 't dbry 'str
verses.translation: And they told to Mordecai Esther’s words.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מָרְדֳּכַ֖י לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב אֶל אֶסְתֵּ֑ר אַל תְּדַמִּ֣י בְ/נַפְשֵׁ֔/ךְ לְ/הִמָּלֵ֥ט בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מִ/כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr mrdkhy lhshyb 'l 'str 'l tdmy bnpshkh lhmlt byt hmlkh mkhl hyhvdym
verses.translation: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king’s house, more than all the Jews.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישִׁי֮ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/זֹּאת֒ רֶ֣וַח וְ/הַצָּלָ֞ה יַעֲמ֤וֹד לַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ מִ/מָּק֣וֹם אַחֵ֔ר וְ/אַ֥תְּ וּ/בֵית אָבִ֖י/ךְ תֹּאבֵ֑דוּ וּ/מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֔עַ אִם לְ/עֵ֣ת כָּ/זֹ֔את הִגַּ֖עַתְּ לַ/מַּלְכֽוּת
verses.translit: khy 'm hchrsh tchryshy b't hz't rvch vhtslh y'mvd lyhvdym mmqvm 'chr v't vbyt 'bykh t'bdv vmy yvd' 'm l't khz't hg't lmlkhvt
verses.translation: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֖ר לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶֽל מָרְדֳּכָֽי
verses.translit: vt'mr 'str lhshyb 'l mrdkhy
verses.translation: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer ,

verses.original: לֵךְ֩ כְּנ֨וֹס אֶת כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֜ים הַֽ/נִּמְצְאִ֣ים בְּ/שׁוּשָׁ֗ן וְ/צ֣וּמוּ עָ֠לַ/י וְ/אַל תֹּאכְל֨וּ וְ/אַל תִּשְׁתּ֜וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ לַ֣יְלָה וָ/י֔וֹם גַּם אֲנִ֥י וְ/נַעֲרֹתַ֖/י אָצ֣וּם כֵּ֑ן וּ/בְ/כֵ֞ן אָב֤וֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא כַ/דָּ֔ת וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָבַ֖דְתִּי אָבָֽדְתִּי
verses.translit: lkh khnvs 't khl hyhvdym hnmts'ym bshvshn vtsvmv 'ly v'l t'khlv v'l tshtv shlsht ymym lylh vyvm gm 'ny vn'rty 'tsvm khn vbkhn 'bv' 'l hmlkh 'shr l' khdt vkh'shr 'bdty 'bdty
verses.translation: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ר מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוְּתָ֥ה עָלָ֖י/ו אֶסְתֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'br mrdkhy vy'sh khkhl 'shr tsvth 'lyv 'str
verses.translation: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וַ/תִּלְבַּ֤שׁ אֶסְתֵּר֙ מַלְכ֔וּת וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֞ד בַּ/חֲצַ֤ר בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/פְּנִימִ֔ית נֹ֖כַח בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ֠/הַ/מֶּלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֞ב עַל כִּסֵּ֤א מַלְכוּת/וֹ֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מַּלְכ֔וּת נֹ֖כַח פֶּ֥תַח הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy vtlbsh 'str mlkhvt vt'md bchtsr byt hmlkh hpnymyt nkhch byt hmlkh vhmlkh yvshb 'l khs' mlkhvtv bbyt hmlkhvt nkhch ptch hbyt
verses.translation: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, over against the king’s house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/רְא֨וֹת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֗ה עֹמֶ֨דֶת֙ בֶּֽ/חָצֵ֔ר נָשְׂאָ֥ה חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וַ/יּ֨וֹשֶׁט הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֗ר אֶת שַׁרְבִ֤יט הַ/זָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וַ/תִּקְרַ֣ב אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וַ/תִּגַּ֖ע בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/שַּׁרְבִֽיט
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt hmlkh 't 'str hmlkhh 'mdt bchtsr nsh'h chn b'ynyv vyvsht hmlkh l'str 't shrbyt hzhb 'shr bydv vtqrb 'str vtg' br'sh hshrbyt
verses.translation: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הּ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַה לָּ֖/ךְ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֑ה וּ/מַה בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛/ךְ עַד חֲצִ֥י הַ/מַּלְכ֖וּת וְ/יִנָּ֥תֵֽן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr lh hmlkh mh lkh 'str hmlkhh vmh bqshtkh 'd chtsy hmlkhvt vyntn lkh
verses.translation: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ ט֑וֹב יָב֨וֹא הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/הָמָן֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֥יתִי לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'str 'm 'l hmlkh tvb ybv' hmlkh vhmn hyvm 'l hmshth 'shr 'shyty lv
verses.translation: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַהֲרוּ֙ אֶת הָמָ֔ן לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת דְּבַ֣ר אֶסְתֵּ֑ר וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/הָמָ֔ן אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה אֶסְתֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh mhrv 't hmn l'shvt 't dbr 'str vyb' hmlkh vhmn 'l hmshth 'shr 'shth 'str
verses.translation: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ לְ/אֶסְתֵּר֙ בְּ/מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ/יַּ֔יִן מַה שְּׁאֵלָתֵ֖/ךְ וְ/יִנָּ֣תֵֽן לָ֑/ךְ וּ/מַה בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛/ךְ עַד חֲצִ֥י הַ/מַּלְכ֖וּת וְ/תֵעָֽשׂ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh l'str bmshth hyyn mh sh'ltkh vyntn lkh vmh bqshtkh 'd chtsy hmlkhvt vt'sh
verses.translation: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֥עַן אֶסְתֵּ֖ר וַ/תֹּאמַ֑ר שְׁאֵלָתִ֖/י וּ/בַקָּשָׁתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'n 'str vt'mr sh'lty vbqshty
verses.translation: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;

verses.original: אִם מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ ט֔וֹב לָ/תֵת֙ אֶת שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔/י וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת בַּקָּשָׁתִ֑/י יָב֧וֹא הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ וְ/הָמָ֗ן אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֣ה לָ/הֶ֔ם וּ/מָחָ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ/דְבַ֥ר הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: 'm mts'ty chn b'yny hmlkh v'm 'l hmlkh tvb ltt 't sh'lty vl'shvt 't bqshty ybv' hmlkh vhmn 'l hmshth 'shr ''shh lhm vmchr ''shh khdbr hmlkh
verses.translation: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א הָמָן֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא שָׂמֵ֖חַ וְ/ט֣וֹב לֵ֑ב וְ/כִ/רְאוֹת֩ הָמָ֨ן אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַ֜י בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/לֹא קָם֙ וְ/לֹא זָ֣ע מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֥א הָמָ֛ן עַֽל מָרְדֳּכַ֖י חֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' hmn byvm hhv' shmch vtvb lb vkhr'vt hmn 't mrdkhy bsh'r hmlkh vl' qm vl' z' mmnv vyml' hmn 'l mrdkhy chmh
verses.translation: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְאַפַּ֣ק הָמָ֔ן וַ/יָּב֖וֹא אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֛ח וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֶת אֹהֲבָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת זֶ֥רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyt'pq hmn vybv' 'l bytv vyshlch vyb' 't 'hbyv v't zrsh 'shtv
verses.translation: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפֵּ֨ר לָ/הֶ֥ם הָמָ֛ן אֶת כְּב֥וֹד עָשְׁר֖/וֹ וְ/רֹ֣ב בָּנָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר גִּדְּל֤/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְּׂא֔/וֹ עַל הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים וְ/עַבְדֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyspr lhm hmn 't khbvd 'shrv vrb bnyv v't khl 'shr gdlv hmlkh v't 'shr nsh'v 'l hshrym v'bdy hmlkh
verses.translation: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ הָמָן֒ אַ֣ף לֹא הֵבִיאָה֩ אֶסְתֵּ֨ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֧ה עִם הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֥ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖תָה כִּ֣י אִם אוֹתִ֑/י וְ/גַם לְ/מָחָ֛ר אֲנִ֥י קָֽרוּא לָ֖/הּ עִם הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmn 'f l' hby'h 'str hmlkhh 'm hmlkh 'l hmshth 'shr 'shth khy 'm 'vty vgm lmchr 'ny qrv' lh 'm hmlkh
verses.translation: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

verses.original: וְ/כָל זֶ֕ה אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ שֹׁוֶ֖ה לִ֑/י בְּ/כָל עֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ אֶת מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vkhl zh 'ynnv shvh ly bkhl 't 'shr 'ny r'h 't mrdkhy hyhvdy yvshb bsh'r hmlkh
verses.translation: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר ל/וֹ֩ זֶ֨רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֜/וֹ וְ/כָל אֹֽהֲבָ֗י/ו יַֽעֲשׂוּ עֵץ֮ גָּבֹ֣הַּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּה֒ וּ/בַ/בֹּ֣קֶר אֱמֹ֣ר לַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/יִתְל֤וּ אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַי֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וּ/בֹֽא עִם הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה שָׂמֵ֑חַ וַ/יִּיטַ֧ב הַ/דָּבָ֛ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָמָ֖ן וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/עֵֽץ
verses.translit: vt'mr lv zrsh 'shtv vkhl 'hbyv y'shv 'ts gbh chmshym 'mh vbbqr 'mr lmlkh vytlv 't mrdkhy 'lyv vb' 'm hmlkh 'l hmshth shmch vyytb hdbr lpny hmn vy'sh h'ts
verses.translation: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

verses.original: בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֔וּא נָדְדָ֖ה שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לְ/הָבִ֞יא אֶת סֵ֤פֶר הַ/זִּכְרֹנוֹת֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ נִקְרָאִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: blylh hhv' nddh shnt hmlkh vy'mr lhby' 't spr hzkhrnvt dbry hymym vyhyv nqr'ym lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּצֵ֣א כָת֗וּב אֲשֶׁר֩ הִגִּ֨יד מָרְדֳּכַ֜י עַל בִּגְתָ֣נָא וָ/תֶ֗רֶשׁ שְׁנֵי֙ סָרִיסֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מִ/שֹּׁמְרֵ֖י הַ/סַּ֑ף אֲשֶׁ֤ר בִּקְשׁוּ֙ לִ/שְׁלֹ֣חַ יָ֔ד בַּ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vymts' khtvb 'shr hgyd mrdkhy 'l bgtn' vtrsh shny srysy hmlkh mshmry hsf 'shr bqshv lshlch yd bmlkh 'chshvrvsh
verses.translation: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַֽה נַּעֲשָׂ֞ה יְקָ֧ר וּ/גְדוּלָּ֛ה לְ/מָרְדֳּכַ֖י עַל זֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתָ֔י/ו לֹא נַעֲשָׂ֥ה עִמּ֖/וֹ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh mh n'shh yqr vgdvlh lmrdkhy 'l zh vy'mrv n'ry hmlkh mshrtyv l' n'shh 'mv dbr
verses.translation: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מִ֣י בֶ/חָצֵ֑ר וְ/הָמָ֣ן בָּ֗א לַ/חֲצַ֤ר בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/חִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה לֵ/אמֹ֣ר לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לִ/תְלוֹת֙ אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַ֔י עַל הָ/עֵ֖ץ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִ֥ין לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh my bchtsr vhmn b' lchtsr byt hmlkh hchytsvnh l'mr lmlkh ltlvt 't mrdkhy 'l h'ts 'shr hkhyn lv
verses.translation: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הִנֵּ֥ה הָמָ֖ן עֹמֵ֣ד בֶּ/חָצֵ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: vy'mrv n'ry hmlkh 'lyv hnh hmn 'md bchtsr vy'mr hmlkh ybv'
verses.translation: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבוֹא֮ הָמָן֒ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַה לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת בָּ/אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֣ץ בִּ/יקָר֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הָמָן֙ בְּ/לִבּ֔/וֹ לְ/מִ֞י יַחְפֹּ֥ץ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת יְקָ֖ר יוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: vybv' hmn vy'mr lv hmlkh mh l'shvt b'ysh 'shr hmlkh chpts byqrv vy'mr hmn blbv lmy ychpts hmlkh l'shvt yqr yvtr mmny
verses.translation: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הָמָ֖ן אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ/יקָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmn 'l hmlkh 'ysh 'shr hmlkh chpts byqrv
verses.translation: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

verses.original: יָבִ֨יאוּ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ מַלְכ֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָֽבַשׁ בּ֖/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/ס֗וּס אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָכַ֤ב עָלָי/ו֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּ֛ן כֶּ֥תֶר מַלְכ֖וּת בְּ/רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: yby'v lbvsh mlkhvt 'shr lbsh bv hmlkh vsvs 'shr rkhb 'lyv hmlkh v'shr ntn khtr mlkhvt br'shv
verses.translation: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

verses.original: וְ/נָת֨וֹן הַ/לְּב֜וּשׁ וְ/הַ/סּ֗וּס עַל יַד אִ֞ישׁ מִ/שָּׂרֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַֽ/פַּרְתְּמִ֔ים וְ/הִלְבִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֣ץ בִּֽ/יקָר֑/וֹ וְ/הִרְכִּיבֻ֤/הוּ עַל הַ/סּוּס֙ בִּ/רְח֣וֹב הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/קָרְא֣וּ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו כָּ֚כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ/יקָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntvn hlbvsh vhsvs 'l yd 'ysh mshry hmlkh hprtmym vhlbyshv 't h'ysh 'shr hmlkh chpts byqrv vhrkhybhv 'l hsvs brchvb h'yr vqr'v lpnyv khkhh y'shh l'ysh 'shr hmlkh chpts byqrv
verses.translation: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ/הָמָ֗ן מַ֠הֵר קַ֣ח אֶת הַ/לְּב֤וּשׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/סּוּס֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וַֽ/עֲשֵׂה כֵן֙ לְ/מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔י הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ אַל תַּפֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lhmn mhr qch 't hlbvsh v't hsvs kh'shr dbrt v'shh khn lmrdkhy hyhvdy hyvshb bsh'r hmlkh 'l tpl dbr mkhl 'shr dbrt
verses.translation: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king’s gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח הָמָן֙ אֶת הַ/לְּב֣וּשׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/סּ֔וּס וַ/יַּלְבֵּ֖שׁ אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַ/יַּרְכִּיבֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/רְח֣וֹב הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו כָּ֚כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָפֵ֥ץ בִּ/יקָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch hmn 't hlbvsh v't hsvs vylbsh 't mrdkhy vyrkhybhv brchvb h'yr vyqr' lpnyv khkhh y'shh l'ysh 'shr hmlkh chpts byqrv
verses.translation: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב מָרְדֳּכַ֖י אֶל שַׁ֣עַר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/הָמָן֙ נִדְחַ֣ף אֶל בֵּית֔/וֹ אָבֵ֖ל וַ/חֲפ֥וּי רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: vyshb mrdkhy 'l sh'r hmlkh vhmn ndchf 'l bytv 'bl vchpvy r'sh
verses.translation: And Mordecai came again to the king’s gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפֵּ֨ר הָמָ֜ן לְ/זֶ֤רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֙ וּ/לְ/כָל אֹ֣הֲבָ֔י/ו אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֑/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֩אמְרוּ֩ ל֨/וֹ חֲכָמָ֜י/ו וְ/זֶ֣רֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ אִ֣ם מִ/זֶּ֣רַע הַ/יְּהוּדִ֡ים מָרְדֳּכַ֞י אֲשֶׁר֩ הַחִלּ֨וֹתָ לִ/נְפֹּ֤ל לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לֹא תוּכַ֣ל ל֔/וֹ כִּֽי נָפ֥וֹל תִּפּ֖וֹל לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyspr hmn lzrsh 'shtv vlkhl 'hbyv 't khl 'shr qrhv vy'mrv lv chkhmyv vzrsh 'shtv 'm mzr' hyhvdym mrdkhy 'shr hchlvt lnpl lpnyv l' tvkhl lv khy npvl tpvl lpnyv
verses.translation: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

verses.original: עוֹדָ/ם֙ מְדַבְּרִ֣ים עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/סָרִיסֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הִגִּ֑יעוּ וַ/יַּבְהִ֨לוּ֙ לְ/הָבִ֣יא אֶת הָמָ֔ן אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה אֶסְתֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'vdm mdbrym 'mv vsrysy hmlkh hgy'v vybhlv lhby' 't hmn 'l hmshth 'shr 'shth 'str
verses.translation: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king’s chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/הָמָ֔ן לִ/שְׁתּ֖וֹת עִם אֶסְתֵּ֥ר הַ/מַּלְכָּֽה
verses.translit: vyb' hmlkh vhmn lshtvt 'm 'str hmlkhh
verses.translation: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֜ר גַּ֣ם בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ בְּ/מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ/יַּ֔יִן מַה שְּׁאֵלָתֵ֛/ךְ אֶסְתֵּ֥ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֖ה וְ/תִנָּ֣תֵֽן לָ֑/ךְ וּ/מַה בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛/ךְ עַד חֲצִ֥י הַ/מַּלְכ֖וּת וְ/תֵעָֽשׂ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh l'str gm byvm hshny bmshth hyyn mh sh'ltkh 'str hmlkhh vtntn lkh vmh bqshtkh 'd chtsy hmlkhvt vt'sh
verses.translation: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֨עַן אֶסְתֵּ֤ר הַ/מַּלְכָּה֙ וַ/תֹּאמַ֔ר אִם מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ ט֑וֹב תִּנָּֽתֶן לִ֤/י נַפְשִׁ/י֙ בִּ/שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔/י וְ/עַמִּ֖/י בְּ/בַקָּשָׁתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'n 'str hmlkhh vt'mr 'm mts'ty chn b'ynykh hmlkh v'm 'l hmlkh tvb tntn ly npshy bsh'lty v'my bbqshty
verses.translation: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

verses.original: כִּ֤י נִמְכַּ֨רְנוּ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְ/עַמִּ֔/י לְ/הַשְׁמִ֖יד לַ/הֲר֣וֹג וּ/לְ/אַבֵּ֑ד וְ֠/אִלּוּ לַ/עֲבָדִ֨ים וְ/לִ/שְׁפָח֤וֹת נִמְכַּ֨רְנוּ֙ הֶחֱרַ֔שְׁתִּי כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין הַ/צָּ֛ר שֹׁוֶ֖ה בְּ/נֵ֥זֶק הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: khy nmkhrnv 'ny v'my lhshmyd lhrvg vl'bd v'lv l'bdym vlshpchvt nmkhrnv hchrshty khy 'yn htsr shvh bnzq hmlkh
verses.translation: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king’s damage.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֑ה מִ֣י ה֥וּא זֶה֙ וְ/אֵֽי זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר מְלָא֥/וֹ לִבּ֖/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'chshvrvsh vy'mr l'str hmlkhh my hv' zh v'y zh hv' 'shr ml'v lbv l'shvt khn
verses.translation: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אִ֚ישׁ צַ֣ר וְ/אוֹיֵ֔ב הָמָ֥ן הָ/רָ֖ע הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/הָמָ֣ן נִבְעַ֔ת מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/הַ/מַּלְכָּֽה
verses.translit: vt'mr 'str 'ysh tsr v'vyb hmn hr' hzh vhmn nb't mlpny hmlkh vhmlkhh
verses.translation: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ קָ֤ם בַּ/חֲמָת/וֹ֙ מִ/מִּשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ/יַּ֔יִן אֶל גִּנַּ֖ת הַ/בִּיתָ֑ן וְ/הָמָ֣ן עָמַ֗ד לְ/בַקֵּ֤שׁ עַל נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ מֵֽ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֔ה כִּ֣י רָאָ֔ה כִּֽי כָלְתָ֥ה אֵלָ֛י/ו הָ/רָעָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vhmlkh qm bchmtv mmshth hyyn 'l gnt hbytn vhmn 'md lbqsh 'l npshv m'str hmlkhh khy r'h khy khlth 'lyv hr'h m't hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ שָׁב֩ מִ/גִּנַּ֨ת הַ/בִּיתָ֜ן אֶל בֵּ֣ית מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ/יַּ֗יִן וְ/הָמָן֙ נֹפֵ֔ל עַל הַ/מִּטָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶסְתֵּ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הֲ֠/גַם לִ/כְבּ֧וֹשׁ אֶת הַ/מַּלְכָּ֛ה עִמִּ֖/י בַּ/בָּ֑יִת הַ/דָּבָ֗ר יָצָא֙ מִ/פִּ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/פְנֵ֥י הָמָ֖ן חָפֽוּ
verses.translit: vhmlkh shb mgnt hbytn 'l byt mshth hyyn vhmn npl 'l hmth 'shr 'str 'lyh vy'mr hmlkh hgm lkhbvsh 't hmlkhh 'my bbyt hdbr yts' mpy hmlkh vpny hmn chpv
verses.translation: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חַ֠רְבוֹנָה אֶחָ֨ד מִן הַ/סָּרִיסִ֜ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ גַּ֣ם הִנֵּה הָ/עֵ֣ץ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֪ה הָמָ֟ן לְֽ/מָרְדֳּכַ֞י אֲשֶׁ֧ר דִּבֶּר ט֣וֹב עַל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ עֹמֵד֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָמָ֔ן גָּבֹ֖הַּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ תְּלֻ֥/הוּ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr chrbvnh 'chd mn hsrysym lpny hmlkh gm hnh h'ts 'shr 'shh hmn lmrdkhy 'shr dbr tvb 'l hmlkh 'md bbyt hmn gbh chmshym 'mh vy'mr hmlkh tlhv 'lyv
verses.translation: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְלוּ֙ אֶת הָמָ֔ן עַל הָ/עֵ֖ץ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִ֣ין לְ/מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַ/חֲמַ֥ת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ שָׁכָֽכָה
verses.translit: vytlv 't hmn 'l h'ts 'shr hkhyn lmrdkhy vchmt hmlkh shkhkhh
verses.translation: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נָתַ֞ן הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ֙ לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֔ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית הָמָ֖ן צֹרֵ֣ר ה/יהודיים הַ/יְּהוּדִ֑ים וּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֗י בָּ֚א לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי הִגִּ֥ידָה אֶסְתֵּ֖ר מַ֥ה הוּא לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ntn hmlkh 'chshvrvsh l'str hmlkhh 't byt hmn tsrr hyhvdyym hyhvdym vmrdkhy b' lpny hmlkh khy hgydh 'str mh hv' lh
verses.translation: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews’ enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨סַר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת טַבַּעְתּ֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱבִיר֙ מֵֽ/הָמָ֔ן וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ֖/הּ לְ/מָרְדֳּכָ֑י וַ/תָּ֧שֶׂם אֶסְתֵּ֛ר אֶֽת מָרְדֳּכַ֖י עַל בֵּ֥ית הָמָֽן
verses.translit: vysr hmlkh 't tb'tv 'shr h'byr mhmn vytnh lmrdkhy vtshm 'str 't mrdkhy 'l byt hmn
verses.translation: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

verses.original: וַ/תּ֣וֹסֶף אֶסְתֵּ֗ר וַ/תְּדַבֵּר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/תִּפֹּ֖ל לִ/פְנֵ֣י רַגְלָ֑י/ו וַ/תֵּ֣בְךְּ וַ/תִּתְחַנֶּן ל֗/וֹ לְ/הַֽעֲבִיר֙ אֶת רָעַת֙ הָמָ֣ן הָֽ/אֲגָגִ֔י וְ/אֵת֙ מַֽחֲשַׁבְתּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖ב עַל הַ/יְּהוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vtvsf 'str vtdbr lpny hmlkh vtpl lpny rglyv vtbkh vttchnn lv lh'byr 't r't hmn h'ggy v't mchshbtv 'shr chshb 'l hyhvdym
verses.translation: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֤וֹשֶׁט הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אֵ֖ת שַׁרְבִ֣ט הַ/זָּהָ֑ב וַ/תָּ֣קָם אֶסְתֵּ֔ר וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyvsht hmlkh l'str 't shrbt hzhb vtqm 'str vt'md lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

verses.original: וַ֠/תֹּאמֶר אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ ט֜וֹב וְ/אִם מָצָ֧אתִי חֵ֣ן לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו וְ/כָשֵׁ֤ר הַ/דָּבָר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/טוֹבָ֥ה אֲנִ֖י בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו יִכָּתֵ֞ב לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב אֶת הַ/סְּפָרִ֗ים מַחֲשֶׁ֜בֶת הָמָ֤ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֨תָא֙ הָ/אֲגָגִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּתַ֗ב לְ/אַבֵּד֙ אֶת הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/כָל מְדִינ֥וֹת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'm 'l hmlkh tvb v'm mts'ty chn lpnyv vkhshr hdbr lpny hmlkh vtvbh 'ny b'ynyv ykhtb lhshyb 't hsprym mchshbt hmn bn hmdt' h'ggy 'shr khtb l'bd 't hyhvdym 'shr bkhl mdynvt hmlkh
verses.translation: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king’s provinces:

verses.original: כִּ֠י אֵיכָכָ֤ה אוּכַל֙ וְֽ/רָאִ֔יתִי בָּ/רָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר יִמְצָ֣א אֶת עַמִּ֑/י וְ/אֵֽיכָכָ֤ה אוּכַל֙ וְֽ/רָאִ֔יתִי בְּ/אָבְדַ֖ן מוֹלַדְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'ykhkhh 'vkhl vr'yty br'h 'shr ymts' 't 'my v'ykhkhh 'vkhl vr'yty b'bdn mvldty
verses.translation: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹשׁ֙ לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֔ה וּֽ/לְ/מָרְדֳּכַ֖י הַ/יְּהוּדִ֑י הִנֵּ֨ה בֵית הָמָ֜ן נָתַ֣תִּי לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֗ר וְ/אֹת/וֹ֙ תָּל֣וּ עַל הָ/עֵ֔ץ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖/וֹ ב/יהודיים בַּ/יְּהוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'chshvrsh l'str hmlkhh vlmrdkhy hyhvdy hnh byt hmn ntty l'str v'tv tlv 'l h'ts 'l 'shr shlch ydv byhvdyym byhvdym
verses.translation: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.

verses.original: וְ֠/אַתֶּם כִּתְב֨וּ עַל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֜ים כַּ/טּ֤וֹב בְּ/עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/חִתְמ֖וּ בְּ/טַבַּ֣עַת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּֽי כְתָ֞ב אֲשֶׁר נִכְתָּ֣ב בְּ/שֵׁם הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/נַחְתּ֛וֹם בְּ/טַבַּ֥עַת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֵ֥ין לְ/הָשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: v'tm khtbv 'l hyhvdym khtvb b'ynykhm bshm hmlkh vchtmv btb't hmlkh khy khtb 'shr nkhtb bshm hmlkh vnchtvm btb't hmlkh 'yn lhshyb
verses.translation: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּרְא֣וּ סֹפְרֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ בָּֽ/עֵת הַ֠/הִיא בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֜י הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ סִיוָ֗ן בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֣ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֮ בּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יִּכָּתֵ֣ב כְּֽ/כָל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה מָרְדֳּכַ֣י אֶל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֡ים וְ/אֶ֣ל הָ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנִֽים וְ/הַ/פַּחוֹת֩ וְ/שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/מְּדִינ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר מֵ/הֹ֣דּוּ וְ/עַד כּ֗וּשׁ שֶׁ֣בַע וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/מֵאָה֙ מְדִינָ֔ה מְדִינָ֤ה וּ/מְדִינָה֙ כִּ/כְתָבָ֔/הּ וְ/עַ֥ם וָ/עָ֖ם כִּ/לְשֹׁנ֑/וֹ וְ/אֶ֨ל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים כִּ/כְתָבָ֖/ם וְ/כִ/לְשׁוֹנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqr'v spry hmlkh b't hhy' bchdsh hshlyshy hv' chdsh syvn bshlvshh v'shrym bv vykhtb khkhl 'shr tsvh mrdkhy 'l hyhvdym v'l h'chshdrpnym vhpchvt vshry hmdynvt 'shr mhdv v'd khvsh shb' v'shrym vm'h mdynh mdynh vmdynh khkhtbh v'm v'm khlshnv v'l hyhvdym khkhtbm vkhlshvnm
verses.translation: Then were the king’s scribes called at that time in the third month, that is , the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֗ב בְּ/שֵׁם֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵרֹ֔שׁ וַ/יַּחְתֹּ֖ם בְּ/טַבַּ֣עַת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח סְפָרִ֡ים בְּ/יַד֩ הָ/רָצִ֨ים בַּ/סּוּסִ֜ים רֹכְבֵ֤י הָ/רֶ֨כֶשׁ֙ הָֽ/אֲחַשְׁתְּרָנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֖י הָֽ/רַמָּכִֽים
verses.translit: vykhtb bshm hmlkh 'chshvrsh vychtm btb't hmlkh vyshlch sprym byd hrtsym bsvsym rkhby hrkhsh h'chshtrnym bny hrmkhym
verses.translation: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לַ/יְּהוּדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/כָל עִיר וָ/עִ֗יר לְ/הִקָּהֵל֮ וְ/לַ/עֲמֹ֣ד עַל נַפְשָׁ/ם֒ לְ/הַשְׁמִיד֩ וְ/לַ/הֲרֹ֨ג וּ/לְ/אַבֵּ֜ד אֶת כָּל חֵ֨יל עַ֧ם וּ/מְדִינָ֛ה הַ/צָּרִ֥ים אֹתָ֖/ם טַ֣ף וְ/נָשִׁ֑ים וּ/שְׁלָלָ֖/ם לָ/בֽוֹז
verses.translit: 'shr ntn hmlkh lyhvdym 'shr bkhl 'yr v'yr lhqhl vl'md 'l npshm lhshmyd vlhrg vl'bd 't khl chyl 'm vmdynh htsrym 'tm tf vnshym vshllm lbvz
verses.translation: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

verses.original: בְּ/י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד בְּ/כָל מְדִינ֖וֹת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לְ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר הוּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ אֲדָֽר
verses.translit: byvm 'chd bkhl mdynvt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh bshlvshh 'shr lchdsh shnym 'shr hv' chdsh 'dr
verses.translation: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

verses.original: פַּתְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַ/כְּתָ֗ב לְ/הִנָּ֤תֵֽן דָּת֙ בְּ/כָל מְדִינָ֣ה וּ/מְדִינָ֔ה גָּל֖וּי לְ/כָל הָ/עַמִּ֑ים וְ/לִ/הְי֨וֹת ה/יהודיים הַ/יְּהוּדִ֤ים עתודים עֲתִידִים֙ לַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה לְ/הִנָּקֵ֖ם מֵ/אֹיְבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: ptshgn hkhtb lhntn dt bkhl mdynh vmdynh glvy lkhl h'mym vlhyvt hyhvdyym hyhvdym 'tvdym 'tydym lyvm hzh lhnqm m'ybyhm
verses.translation: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

verses.original: הָ/רָצִ֞ים רֹכְבֵ֤י הָ/רֶ֨כֶשׁ֙ הָֽ/אֲחַשְׁתְּרָנִ֔ים יָֽצְא֛וּ מְבֹהָלִ֥ים וּ/דְחוּפִ֖ים בִּ/דְבַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/הַ/דָּ֥ת נִתְּנָ֖ה בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַ/בִּירָֽה
verses.translit: hrtsym rkhby hrkhsh h'chshtrnym yts'v mbhlym vdchvpym bdbr hmlkh vhdt ntnh bshvshn hbyrh
verses.translation: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

verses.original: וּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֞י יָצָ֣א מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ בִּ/לְב֤וּשׁ מַלְכוּת֙ תְּכֵ֣לֶת וָ/ח֔וּר וַ/עֲטֶ֤רֶת זָהָב֙ גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וְ/תַכְרִ֥יךְ בּ֖וּץ וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֑ן וְ/הָ/עִ֣יר שׁוּשָׁ֔ן צָהֲלָ֖ה וְ/שָׂמֵֽחָה
verses.translit: vmrdkhy yts' mlpny hmlkh blbvsh mlkhvt tkhlt vchvr v'trt zhb gdvlh vtkhrykh bvts v'rgmn vh'yr shvshn tshlh vshmchh
verses.translation: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

verses.original: לַ/יְּהוּדִ֕ים הָֽיְתָ֥ה אוֹרָ֖ה וְ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְ/שָׂשֹׂ֖ן וִ/יקָֽר
verses.translit: lyhvdym hyth 'vrh vshmchh vshshn vyqr
verses.translation: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל מְדִינָ֨ה וּ/מְדִינָ֜ה וּ/בְ/כָל עִ֣יר וָ/עִ֗יר מְקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/דָת/וֹ֙ מַגִּ֔יעַ שִׂמְחָ֤ה וְ/שָׂשׂוֹן֙ לַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה וְ/י֣וֹם ט֑וֹב וְ/רַבִּ֞ים מֵֽ/עַמֵּ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ מִֽתְיַהֲדִ֔ים כִּֽי נָפַ֥ל פַּֽחַד הַ/יְּהוּדִ֖ים עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbkhl mdynh vmdynh vbkhl 'yr v'yr mqvm 'shr dbr hmlkh vdtv mgy' shmchh vshshvn lyhvdym mshth vyvm tvb vrbym m'my h'rts mtyhdym khy npl pchd hyhvdym 'lyhm
verses.translation: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנֵים֩ עָשָׂ֨ר חֹ֜דֶשׁ הוּא חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֗ר בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ בּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִגִּ֧יעַ דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/דָת֖/וֹ לְ/הֵעָשׂ֑וֹת בַּ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׂבְּר֜וּ אֹיְבֵ֤י הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ לִ/שְׁל֣וֹט בָּ/הֶ֔ם וְ/נַהֲפ֣וֹךְ ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁלְט֧וּ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֛ים הֵ֖מָּה בְּ/שֹׂנְאֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbshnym 'shr chdsh hv' chdsh 'dr bshlvshh 'shr yvm bv 'shr hgy' dbr hmlkh vdtv lh'shvt byvm 'shr shbrv 'yby hyhvdym lshlvt bhm vnhpvkh hv' 'shr yshltv hyhvdym hmh bshn'yhm
verses.translation: Now in the twelfth month, that is , the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king’s commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)

verses.original: נִקְהֲל֨וּ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֜ים בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֗ם בְּ/כָל מְדִינוֹת֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֳחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ לִ/שְׁלֹ֣חַ יָ֔ד בִּ/מְבַקְשֵׁ֖י רָֽעָתָ֑/ם וְ/אִישׁ֙ לֹא עָמַ֣ד לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי נָפַ֥ל פַּחְדָּ֖/ם עַל כָּל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: nqhlv hyhvdym b'ryhm bkhl mdynvt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh lshlch yd bmbqshy r'tm v'ysh l' 'md lpnyhm khy npl pchdm 'l khl h'mym
verses.translation: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

verses.original: וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/מְּדִינ֜וֹת וְ/הָ/אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/פַּח֗וֹת וְ/עֹשֵׂ֤י הַ/מְּלָאכָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מְנַשְּׂאִ֖ים אֶת הַ/יְּהוּדִ֑ים כִּֽי נָפַ֥ל פַּֽחַד מָרְדֳּכַ֖י עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl shry hmdynvt vh'chshdrpnym vhpchvt v'shy hml'khh 'shr lmlkh mnsh'ym 't hyhvdym khy npl pchd mrdkhy 'lyhm
verses.translation: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

verses.original: כִּֽי גָ֤דוֹל מָרְדֳּכַי֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/שָׁמְע֖/וֹ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ/כָל הַ/מְּדִינ֑וֹת כִּֽי הָ/אִ֥ישׁ מָרְדֳּכַ֖י הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְ/גָדֽוֹל
verses.translit: khy gdvl mrdkhy bbyt hmlkh vshm'v hvlkh bkhl hmdynvt khy h'ysh mrdkhy hvlkh vgdvl
verses.translation: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֤וּ הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ בְּ/כָל אֹ֣יְבֵי/הֶ֔ם מַכַּת חֶ֥רֶב וְ/הֶ֖רֶג וְ/אַבְדָ֑ן וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ בְ/שֹׂנְאֵי/הֶ֖ם כִּ/רְצוֹנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykhv hyhvdym bkhl 'ybyhm mkht chrb vhrg v'bdn vy'shv bshn'yhm khrtsvnm
verses.translation: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַ/בִּירָ֗ה הָרְג֤וּ הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ וְ/אַבֵּ֔ד חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vbshvshn hbyrh hrgv hyhvdym v'bd chmsh m'vt 'ysh
verses.translation: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֧ת פַּרְשַׁנְדָּ֛תָא וְ/אֵ֥ת דַּֽלְפ֖וֹן וְ/אֵ֥ת אַסְפָּֽתָא
verses.translit: v't prshndt' v't dlpvn v't 'spt'
verses.translation: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֧ת פּוֹרָ֛תָא וְ/אֵ֥ת אֲדַלְיָ֖א וְ/אֵ֥ת אֲרִידָֽתָא
verses.translit: v't pvrt' v't 'dly' v't 'rydt'
verses.translation: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֤ת פַּרְמַ֨שְׁתָּא֙ וְ/אֵ֣ת אֲרִיסַ֔י וְ/אֵ֥ת אֲרִדַ֖י וְ/אֵ֥ת וַיְזָֽתָא
verses.translit: v't prmsht' v't 'rysy v't 'rdy v't vyzt'
verses.translation: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

verses.original: עֲ֠שֶׂרֶת בְּנֵ֨י הָמָ֧ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֛תָא צֹרֵ֥ר הַ/יְּהוּדִ֖ים הָרָ֑גוּ וּ/בַ֨/בִּזָּ֔ה לֹ֥א שָׁלְח֖וּ אֶת יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shrt bny hmn bn hmdt' tsrr hyhvdym hrgv vbbzh l' shlchv 't ydm
verses.translation: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא בָּ֣א מִסְפַּ֧ר הַֽ/הֲרוּגִ֛ים בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַ/בִּירָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' b' mspr hhrvgym bshvshn hbyrh lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֗ה בְּ/שׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַ/בִּירָ֡ה הָרְגוּ֩ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֨ים וְ/אַבֵּ֜ד חֲמֵ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֗ישׁ וְ/אֵת֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת בְּנֵֽי הָמָ֔ן בִּ/שְׁאָ֛ר מְדִינ֥וֹת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ וּ/מַה שְּׁאֵֽלָתֵ/ךְ֙ וְ/יִנָּ֣תֵֽן לָ֔/ךְ וּ/מַה בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֥/ךְ ע֖וֹד וְ/תֵעָֽשׂ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh l'str hmlkhh bshvshn hbyrh hrgv hyhvdym v'bd chmsh m'vt 'ysh v't 'shrt bny hmn bsh'r mdynvt hmlkh mh 'shv vmh sh'ltkh vyntn lkh vmh bqshtkh 'vd vt'sh
verses.translation: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר אֶסְתֵּר֙ אִם עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב יִנָּתֵ֣ן גַּם מָחָ֗ר לַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/שׁוּשָׁ֔ן לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת כְּ/דָ֣ת הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ/אֵ֛ת עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת בְּנֵֽי הָמָ֖ן יִתְל֥וּ עַל הָ/עֵֽץ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'str 'm 'l hmlkh tvb yntn gm mchr lyhvdym 'shr bshvshn l'shvt khdt hyvm v't 'shrt bny hmn ytlv 'l h'ts
verses.translation: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/הֵֽעָשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּנָּתֵ֥ן דָּ֖ת בְּ/שׁוּשָׁ֑ן וְ/אֵ֛ת עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת בְּנֵֽי הָמָ֖ן תָּלֽוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lh'shvt khn vtntn dt bshvshn v't 'shrt bny hmn tlv
verses.translation: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ ה/יהודיים הַ/יְּהוּדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר בְּ/שׁוּשָׁ֗ן גַּ֠ם בְּ/י֣וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֔ר וַ/יַּֽהַרְג֣וּ בְ/שׁוּשָׁ֔ן שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וּ/בַ֨/בִּזָּ֔ה לֹ֥א שָׁלְח֖וּ אֶת יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqhlv hyhvdyym hyhvdym 'shr bshvshn gm byvm 'rb'h 'shr lchdsh 'dr vyhrgv bshvshn shlsh m'vt 'ysh vbbzh l' shlchv 't ydm
verses.translation: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר הַ/יְּהוּדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ בִּ/מְדִינ֨וֹת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ נִקְהֲל֣וּ וְ/עָמֹ֣ד עַל נַפְשָׁ֗/ם וְ/נ֨וֹחַ֙ מֵ/אֹ֣יְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הָרֹג֙ בְּ/שֹׂ֣נְאֵי/הֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּ/בַ֨/בִּזָּ֔ה לֹ֥א שָֽׁלְח֖וּ אֶת יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vsh'r hyhvdym 'shr bmdynvt hmlkh nqhlv v'md 'l npshm vnvch m'ybyhm vhrg bshn'yhm chmshh vshb'ym 'lf vbbzh l' shlchv 't ydm
verses.translation: But the other Jews that were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

verses.original: בְּ/יוֹם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לְ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֑ר וְ/נ֗וֹחַ בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ בּ֔/וֹ וְ/עָשֹׂ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ י֖וֹם מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה וְ/שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: byvm shlshh 'shr lchdsh 'dr vnvch b'rb'h 'shr bv v'shh 'tv yvm mshth vshmchh
verses.translation: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

verses.original: ו/ה/יהודיים וְ/הַ/יְּהוּדִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר בְּ/שׁוּשָׁ֗ן נִקְהֲלוּ֙ בִּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ בּ֔/וֹ וּ/בְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר בּ֑/וֹ וְ/נ֗וֹחַ בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ בּ֔/וֹ וְ/עָשֹׂ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ י֖וֹם מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה וְ/שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: vhyhvdyym vhyhvdym 'shr bshvshn nqhlv bshlshh 'shr bv vb'rb'h 'shr bv vnvch bchmshh 'shr bv v'shh 'tv yvm mshth vshmchh
verses.translation: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֞ן הַ/יְּהוּדִ֣ים ה/פרוזים הַ/פְּרָזִ֗ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִים֮ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הַ/פְּרָזוֹת֒ עֹשִׂ֗ים אֵ֠ת י֣וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֔ר שִׂמְחָ֥ה וּ/מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה וְ/י֣וֹם ט֑וֹב וּ/מִשְׁל֥וֹחַ מָנ֖וֹת אִ֥ישׁ לְ/רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'l khn hyhvdym hprvzym hprzym hyshbym b'ry hprzvt 'shym 't yvm 'rb'h 'shr lchdsh 'dr shmchh vmshth vyvm tvb vmshlvch mnvt 'ysh lr'hv
verses.translation: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח סְפָרִ֜ים אֶל כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/כָל מְדִינוֹת֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ הַ/קְּרוֹבִ֖ים וְ/הָ/רְחוֹקִֽים
verses.translit: vykhtb mrdkhy 't hdbrym h'lh vyshlch sprym 'l khl hyhvdym 'shr bkhl mdynvt hmlkh 'chshvrvsh hqrvbym vhrchvqym
verses.translation: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

verses.original: לְ/קַיֵּם֮ עֲלֵי/הֶם֒ לִ/הְי֣וֹת עֹשִׂ֗ים אֵ֠ת י֣וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲדָ֔ר וְ/אֵ֛ת יוֹם חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר בּ֑/וֹ בְּ/כָל שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: lqym 'lyhm lhyvt 'shym 't yvm 'rb'h 'shr lchdsh 'dr v't yvm chmshh 'shr bv bkhl shnh vshnh
verses.translation: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

verses.original: כַּ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר נָ֨חוּ בָ/הֶ֤ם הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ מֵ/א֣וֹיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הַ/חֹ֗דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר֩ נֶהְפַּ֨ךְ לָ/הֶ֤ם מִ/יָּגוֹן֙ לְ/שִׂמְחָ֔ה וּ/מֵ/אֵ֖בֶל לְ/י֣וֹם ט֑וֹב לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗/ם יְמֵי֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה וְ/שִׂמְחָ֔ה וּ/מִשְׁל֤וֹחַ מָנוֹת֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וּ/מַתָּנ֖וֹת לָֽ/אֶבְיוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: khymym 'shr nchv bhm hyhvdym m'vybyhm vhchdsh 'shr nhpkh lhm mygvn lshmchh vm'bl lyvm tvb l'shvt 'vtm ymy mshth vshmchh vmshlvch mnvt 'ysh lr'hv vmtnvt l'byvnym
verses.translation: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

verses.original: וְ/קִבֵּל֙ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר הֵחֵ֖לּוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת וְ/אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר כָּתַ֥ב מָרְדֳּכַ֖י אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vqbl hyhvdym 't 'shr hchlv l'shvt v't 'shr khtb mrdkhy 'lyhm
verses.translation: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָמָ֨ן בֶּֽן הַמְּדָ֜תָא הָֽ/אֲגָגִ֗י צֹרֵר֙ כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים חָשַׁ֥ב עַל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֖ים לְ/אַבְּדָ֑/ם וְ/הִפִּ֥יל פּוּר֙ ה֣וּא הַ/גּוֹרָ֔ל לְ/הֻמָּ֖/ם וּֽ/לְ/אַבְּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy hmn bn hmdt' h'ggy tsrr khl hyhvdym chshb 'l hyhvdym l'bdm vhpyl pvr hv' hgvrl lhmm vl'bdm
verses.translation: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is , the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

verses.original: וּ/בְ/בֹאָ/הּ֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ אָמַ֣ר עִם הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר יָשׁ֞וּב מַחֲשַׁבְתּ֧/וֹ הָ/רָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁ֥ב עַל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֖ים עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/תָל֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֖י/ו עַל הָ/עֵֽץ
verses.translit: vbb'h lpny hmlkh 'mr 'm hspr yshvb mchshbtv hr'h 'shr chshb 'l hyhvdym 'l r'shv vtlv 'tv v't bnyv 'l h'ts
verses.translation: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֡ן קָֽרְאוּ֩ לַ/יָּמִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֤לֶּה פוּרִים֙ עַל שֵׁ֣ם הַ/פּ֔וּר עַל כֵּ֕ן עַל כָּל דִּבְרֵ֖י הָ/אִגֶּ֣רֶת הַ/זֹּ֑את וּ/מָֽה רָא֣וּ עַל כָּ֔כָה וּ/מָ֥ה הִגִּ֖יעַ אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l khn qr'v lymym h'lh pvrym 'l shm hpvr 'l khn 'l khl dbry h'grt hz't vmh r'v 'l khkhh vmh hgy' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

verses.original: קִיְּמ֣וּ ו/קבל וְ/קִבְּל֣וּ הַ/יְּהוּדִים֩ עֲלֵי/הֶ֨ם וְ/עַל זַרְעָ֜/ם וְ/עַ֨ל כָּל הַ/נִּלְוִ֤ים עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲב֔וֹר לִ/הְי֣וֹת עֹשִׂ֗ים אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַ/יָּמִים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ/כְתָבָ֖/ם וְ/כִ/זְמַנָּ֑/ם בְּ/כָל שָׁנָ֖ה וְ/שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: qymv vqbl vqblv hyhvdym 'lyhm v'l zr'm v'l khl hnlvym 'lyhm vl' y'bvr lhyvt 'shym 't shny hymym h'lh khkhtbm vkhzmnm bkhl shnh vshnh
verses.translation: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ֠/אֵלֶּה נִזְכָּרִ֨ים וְ/נַעֲשִׂ֜ים בְּ/כָל דּ֣וֹר וָ/ד֗וֹר מִשְׁפָּחָה֙ וּ/מִשְׁפָּחָ֔ה מְדִינָ֥ה וּ/מְדִינָ֖ה וְ/עִ֣יר וָ/עִ֑יר וִ/ימֵ֞י הַ/פּוּרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה לֹ֤א יַֽעַבְרוּ֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים וְ/זִכְרָ֖/ם לֹא יָס֥וּף מִ/זַּרְעָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhymym h'lh nzkhrym vn'shym bkhl dvr vdvr mshpchh vmshpchh mdynh vmdynh v'yr v'yr vymy hpvrym h'lh l' y'brv mtvkh hyhvdym vzkhrm l' ysvf mzr'm
verses.translation: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

verses.original: וַ֠/תִּכְתֹּב אֶסְתֵּ֨ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֧ה בַת אֲבִיחַ֛יִל וּ/מָרְדֳּכַ֥י הַ/יְּהוּדִ֖י אֶת כָּל תֹּ֑קֶף לְ/קַיֵּ֗ם אֵ֣ת אִגֶּ֧רֶת הַ/פּוּרִ֛ים הַ/זֹּ֖את הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vtkhtb 'str hmlkhh bt 'bychyl vmrdkhy hyhvdy 't khl tqf lqym 't 'grt hpvrym hz't hshnyt
verses.translation: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח סְפָרִ֜ים אֶל כָּל הַ/יְּהוּדִ֗ים אֶל שֶׁ֨בַע וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/מֵאָה֙ מְדִינָ֔ה מַלְכ֖וּת אֲחַשְׁוֵר֑וֹשׁ דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם וֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: vyshlch sprym 'l khl hyhvdym 'l shb' v'shrym vm'h mdynh mlkhvt 'chshvrvsh dbry shlvm v'mt
verses.translation: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

verses.original: לְ/קַיֵּ֡ם אֵת יְמֵי֩ הַ/פֻּרִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה בִּ/זְמַנֵּי/הֶ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ קִיַּ֨ם עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם מָרְדֳּכַ֤י הַ/יְּהוּדִי֙ וְ/אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ/מַּלְכָּ֔ה וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר קִיְּמ֥וּ עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/ם וְ/עַל זַרְעָ֑/ם דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/צֹּמ֖וֹת וְ/זַעֲקָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lqym 't ymy hprym h'lh bzmnyhm kh'shr qym 'lyhm mrdkhy hyhvdy v'str hmlkhh vkh'shr qymv 'l npshm v'l zr'm dbry htsmvt vz'qtm
verses.translation: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed , according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

verses.original: וּ/מַאֲמַ֣ר אֶסְתֵּ֔ר קִיַּ֕ם דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/פֻּרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/נִכְתָּ֖ב בַּ/סֵּֽפֶר
verses.translit: vm'mr 'str qym dbry hprym h'lh vnkhtb bspr
verses.translation: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֶׂם֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אחשרש אֲחַשְׁוֵר֧וֹשׁ מַ֛ס עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/אִיֵּ֥י הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vyshm hmlkh 'chshrsh 'chshvrvsh ms 'l h'rts v'yy hym
verses.translation: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה תָקְפּ/וֹ֙ וּ/גְב֣וּרָת֔/וֹ וּ/פָרָשַׁת֙ גְּדֻלַּ֣ת מָרְדֳּכַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר גִּדְּל֖/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ הֲ/לוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֨פֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/יָּמִ֔ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּ/פָרָֽס
verses.translit: vkhl m'shh tqpv vgbvrtv vprsht gdlt mrdkhy 'shr gdlv hmlkh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy mdy vprs
verses.translation: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

verses.original: כִּ֣י מָרְדֳּכַ֣י הַ/יְּהוּדִ֗י מִשְׁנֶה֙ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וְ/גָדוֹל֙ לַ/יְּהוּדִ֔ים וְ/רָצ֖וּי לְ/רֹ֣ב אֶחָ֑י/ו דֹּרֵ֥שׁ טוֹב֙ לְ/עַמּ֔/וֹ וְ/דֹבֵ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לְ/כָל זַרְעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy mrdkhy hyhvdy mshnh lmlkh 'chshvrvsh vgdvl lyhvdym vrtsvy lrb 'chyv drsh tvb l'mv vdbr shlvm lkhl zr'v
verses.translation: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ הָיָ֥ה בְ/אֶֽרֶץ ע֖וּץ אִיּ֣וֹב שְׁמ֑/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֣ה הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֗וּא תָּ֧ם וְ/יָשָׁ֛ר וִ/ירֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/סָ֥ר מֵ/רָֽע
verses.translit: 'ysh hyh b'rts 'vts 'yvb shmv vhyh h'ysh hhv' tm vyshr vyr' 'lhym vsr mr'
verses.translation: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּ֥לְדוּ ל֛/וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥ה בָנִ֖ים וְ/שָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyvldv lv shb'h bnym vshlvsh bnvt
verses.translation: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י מִ֠קְנֵ/הוּ שִֽׁבְעַ֨ת אַלְפֵי צֹ֜אן וּ/שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֣י גְמַלִּ֗ים וַ/חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֤וֹת צֶֽמֶד בָּקָר֙ וַ/חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֲתוֹנ֔וֹת וַ/עֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יְהִי֙ הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא גָּד֖וֹל מִ/כָּל בְּנֵי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: vyhy mqnhv shb't 'lpy ts'n vshlsht 'lpy gmlym vchmsh m'vt tsmd bqr vchmsh m'vt 'tvnvt v'bdh rbh m'd vyhy h'ysh hhv' gdvl mkhl bny qdm
verses.translation: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

verses.original: וְ/הָלְכ֤וּ בָנָי/ו֙ וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ יוֹמ֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁלְח֗וּ וְ/קָרְאוּ֙ לִ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אחיתי/הם אַחְיֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּ֖וֹת עִמָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhlkhv bnyv v'shv mshth byt 'ysh yvmv vshlchv vqr'v lshlsht 'chytyhm 'chyvtyhm l'khl vlshtvt 'mhm
verses.translation: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כִּ֣י הִקִּיפֽוּ֩ יְמֵ֨י הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֜ה וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֧ח אִיּ֣וֹב וַֽ/יְקַדְּשֵׁ֗/ם וְ/הִשְׁכִּ֣ים בַּ/בֹּקֶר֮ וְ/הֶעֱלָ֣ה עֹלוֹת֮ מִסְפַּ֣ר כֻּלָּ/ם֒ כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אִיּ֔וֹב אוּלַי֙ חָטְא֣וּ בָנַ֔/י וּ/בֵרֲכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּ/לְבָבָ֑/ם כָּ֛כָה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אִיּ֖וֹב כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khy hqypv ymy hmshth vyshlch 'yvb vyqdshm vhshkhym bbqr vh'lh 'lvt mspr khlm khy 'mr 'yvb 'vly cht'v bny vbrkhv 'lhym blbbm khkhh y'shh 'yvb khl hymym
verses.translation: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְ/הִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּב֥וֹא גַֽם הַ/שָּׂטָ֖ן בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyb'v bny h'lhym lhtytsb 'l yhvh vybv' gm hshtn btvkhm
verses.translation: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֖ן מֵ/אַ֣יִן תָּבֹ֑א וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/שָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת יְהוָה֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר מִ/שּׁ֣וּט בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מֵֽ/הִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn m'yn tb' vy'n hshtn 't yhvh vy'mr mshvt b'rts vmhthlkh bh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD , and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֔ן הֲ/שַׂ֥מְתָּ לִבְּ/ךָ֖ עַל עַבְדִּ֣/י אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין כָּמֹ֨/הוּ֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְ/יָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/סָ֥ר מֵ/רָֽע
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn hshmt lbkh 'l 'bdy 'yvb khy 'yn khmhv b'rts 'ysh tm vyshr yr' 'lhym vsr mr'
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן הַ/שָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַֽ/חִנָּ֔ם יָרֵ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'n hshtn 't yhvh vy'mr hchnm yr' 'yvb 'lhym
verses.translation: Then Satan answered the LORD , and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹֽא את אַ֠תָּה שַׂ֣כְתָּ בַעֲד֧/וֹ וּ/בְעַד בֵּית֛/וֹ וּ/בְעַ֥ד כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ מִ/סָּבִ֑יב מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָי/ו֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּ/מִקְנֵ֖/הוּ פָּרַ֥ץ בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hl' 't 'th shkht b'dv vb'd bytv vb'd khl 'shr lv msbyb m'shh ydyv brkht vmqnhv prts b'rts
verses.translation: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

verses.original: וְ/אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח נָ֣א יָֽדְ/ךָ֔ וְ/גַ֖ע בְּ/כָל אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ אִם לֹ֥א עַל פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: v'vlm shlch n' ydkh vg' bkhl 'shr lv 'm l' 'l pnykh ybrkhkh
verses.translation: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה כָל אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ רַ֣ק אֵלָ֔י/ו אַל תִּשְׁלַ֖ח יָדֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ הַ/שָּׂטָ֔ן מֵ/עִ֖ם פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn hnh khl 'shr lv bydkh rq 'lyv 'l tshlch ydkh vyts' hshtn m'm pny yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/בָנָ֨י/ו וּ/בְנֹתָ֤י/ו אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְ/שֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּ/בֵ֖ית אֲחִי/הֶ֥ם הַ/בְּכֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vbnyv vbntyv 'khlym vshtym yyn bbyt 'chyhm hbkhvr
verses.translation: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.original: וּ/מַלְאָ֛ךְ בָּ֥א אֶל אִיּ֖וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַ/בָּקָר֙ הָי֣וּ חֹֽרְשׁ֔וֹת וְ/הָ/אֲתֹנ֖וֹת רֹע֥וֹת עַל יְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vml'kh b' 'l 'yvb vy'mr hbqr hyv chrshvt vh'tnvt r'vt 'l ydyhm
verses.translation: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

verses.original: וַ/תִּפֹּ֤ל שְׁבָא֙ וַ/תִּקָּחֵ֔/ם וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וָֽ/אִמָּ֨לְטָ֧/ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְ/בַדִּ֖/י לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vtpl shb' vtqchm v't hn'rym hkhv lpy chrb v'mlth rq 'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: And the Sabeans fell upon them , and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.original: ע֣וֹד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְ/זֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ אֵ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים נָֽפְלָה֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/תִּבְעַ֥ר בַּ/צֹּ֛אן וּ/בַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים וַ/תֹּאכְלֵ֑/ם וָ/אִמָּ֨לְטָ֧/ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְ/בַדִּ֖/י לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'vd zh mdbr vzh b' vy'mr 'sh 'lhym nplh mn hshmym vtb'r bts'n vbn'rym vt'khlm v'mlth rq 'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.original: ע֣וֹד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֗ר וְ/זֶה֮ בָּ֣א וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ כַּשְׂדִּ֞ים שָׂ֣מוּ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֗ים וַֽ/יִּפְשְׁט֤וּ עַל הַ/גְּמַלִּים֙ וַ/יִּקָּח֔וּ/ם וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים הִכּ֣וּ לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וָ/אִמָּ֨לְטָ֧/ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְ/בַדִּ֖/י לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'vd zh mdbr vzh b' vy'mr khshdym shmv shlshh r'shym vypshtv 'l hgmlym vyqchvm v't hn'rym hkhv lpy chrb v'mlth rq 'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.original: עַ֚ד זֶ֣ה מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְ/זֶ֖ה בָּ֣א וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֤י/ךָ אֹֽכְלִים֙ וְ/שֹׁתִ֣ים יַ֔יִן בְּ/בֵ֖ית אֲחִי/הֶ֥ם הַ/בְּכֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'd zh mdbr vzh b' vy'mr bnykh vbnvtykh 'khlym vshtym yyn bbyt 'chyhm hbkhvr
verses.translation: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ גְּדוֹלָ֜ה בָּ֣אָה מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר וַ/יִּגַּע֙ בְּ/אַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הַ/בַּ֔יִת וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל עַל הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים וַ/יָּמ֑וּתוּ וָ/אִמָּ֨לְטָ֧/ה רַק אֲנִ֛י לְ/בַדִּ֖/י לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhnh rvch gdvlh b'h m'br hmdbr vyg' b'rb' pnvt hbyt vypl 'l hn'rym vymvtv v'mlth rq 'ny lbdy lhgyd lkh
verses.translation: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קָם אִיּוֹב֙ וַ/יִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת מְעִל֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֖גָז אֶת רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vyqm 'yvb vyqr' 't m'lv vygz 't r'shv vypl 'rtsh vyshtchv
verses.translation: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ עָרֹ֨ם יצתי יָצָ֜אתִי מִ/בֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֗/י וְ/עָרֹם֙ אָשׁ֣וּב שָׁ֔מָ/ה יְהוָ֣ה נָתַ֔ן וַ/יהוָ֖ה לָקָ֑ח יְהִ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה מְבֹרָֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rm ytsty yts'ty mbtn 'my v'rm 'shvb shmh yhvh ntn vyhvh lqch yhy shm yhvh mbrkh
verses.translation: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD .

verses.original: בְּ/כָל זֹ֖את לֹא חָטָ֣א אִיּ֑וֹב וְ/לֹא נָתַ֥ן תִּפְלָ֖ה לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: bkhl z't l' cht' 'yvb vl' ntn tplh l'lhym
verses.translation: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְ/הִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּב֤וֹא גַֽם הַ/שָּׂטָן֙ בְּ/תֹכָ֔/ם לְ/הִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyb'v bny h'lhym lhtytsb 'l yhvh vybv' gm hshtn btkhm lhtytsb 'l yhvh
verses.translation: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֔ן אֵ֥י מִ/זֶּ֖ה תָּבֹ֑א וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/שָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת יְהוָה֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר מִ/שֻּׁ֣ט בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מֵ/הִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn 'y mzh tb' vy'n hshtn 't yhvh vy'mr msht b'rts vmhthlkh bh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD , and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֗ן הֲ/שַׂ֣מְתָּ לִבְּ/ךָ֮ אֶל עַבְדִּ֣/י אִיּוֹב֒ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין כָּמֹ֜/הוּ בָּ/אָ֗רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְ/יָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/סָ֣ר מֵ/רָ֑ע וְ/עֹדֶ֨/נּוּ֙ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּ/תֻמָּת֔/וֹ וַ/תְּסִיתֵ֥/נִי ב֖/וֹ לְ/בַלְּע֥/וֹ חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn hshmt lbkh 'l 'bdy 'yvb khy 'yn khmhv b'rts 'ysh tm vyshr yr' 'lhym vsr mr' v'dnv mchzyq btmtv vtsytny bv lbl'v chnm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן הַ/שָּׂטָ֛ן אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר ע֣וֹר בְּעַד ע֗וֹר וְ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/אִ֔ישׁ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּעַ֥ד נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'n hshtn 't yhvh vy'mr 'vr b'd 'vr vkhl 'shr l'ysh ytn b'd npshv
verses.translation: And Satan answered the LORD , and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

verses.original: אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח נָ֣א יָֽדְ/ךָ֔ וְ/גַ֥ע אֶל עַצְמ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶל בְּשָׂר֑/וֹ אִם לֹ֥א אֶל פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'vlm shlch n' ydkh vg' 'l 'tsmv v'l bshrv 'm l' 'l pnykh ybrkhkh
verses.translation: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל הַ/שָּׂטָ֖ן הִנּ֣/וֹ בְ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ אַ֖ךְ אֶת נַפְשׁ֥/וֹ שְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l hshtn hnv bydkh 'kh 't npshv shmr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ הַ/שָּׂטָ֔ן מֵ/אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֤ךְ אֶת אִיּוֹב֙ בִּ/שְׁחִ֣ין רָ֔ע מִ/כַּ֥ף רַגְל֖/וֹ עד וְ/עַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyts' hshtn m't pny yhvh vykh 't 'yvb bshchyn r' mkhf rglv 'd v'd qdqdv
verses.translation: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל֣/וֹ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לְ/הִתְגָּרֵ֖ד בּ֑/וֹ וְ/ה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/תוֹךְ הָ/אֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vyqch lv chrsh lhtgrd bv vhv' yshb btvkh h'pr
verses.translation: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ עֹדְ/ךָ֖ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּ/תֻמָּתֶ֑/ךָ בָּרֵ֥ךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָ/מֻֽת
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'shtv 'dkh mchzyq btmtkh brkh 'lhym vmt
verses.translation: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗י/הָ כְּ/דַבֵּ֞ר אַחַ֤ת הַ/נְּבָלוֹת֙ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי גַּ֣ם אֶת הַ/טּ֗וֹב נְקַבֵּל֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/אֶת הָ/רָ֖ע לֹ֣א נְקַבֵּ֑ל בְּ/כָל זֹ֛את לֹא חָטָ֥א אִיּ֖וֹב בִּ/שְׂפָתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh khdbr 'cht hnblvt tdbry gm 't htvb nqbl m't h'lhym v't hr' l' nqbl bkhl z't l' cht' 'yvb bshptyv
verses.translation: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֞וּ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֣י אִיּ֗וֹב אֵ֣ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֣ה הַ/זֹּאת֮ הַ/בָּ֣אָה עָלָי/ו֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִ/מְּקֹמ֔/וֹ אֱלִיפַ֤ז הַ/תֵּימָנִי֙ וּ/בִלְדַּ֣ד הַ/שּׁוּחִ֔י וְ/צוֹפַ֖ר הַ/נַּֽעֲמָתִ֑י וַ/יִּוָּעֲד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לָ/ב֥וֹא לָ/נֽוּד ל֖/וֹ וּֽ/לְ/נַחֲמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm'v shlsht r'y 'yvb 't khl hr'h hz't hb'h 'lyv vyb'v 'ysh mmqmv 'lypz htymny vbldd hshvchy vtsvpr hn'mty vyv'dv ychdv lbv' lnvd lv vlnchmv
