verses.translation: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֨וּ אֶת עֵינֵי/הֶ֤ם מֵ/רָחוֹק֙ וְ/לֹ֣א הִכִּירֻ֔/הוּ וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖/ם וַ/יִּבְכּ֑וּ וַֽ/יִּקְרְעוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְעִל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּזְרְק֥וּ עָפָ֛ר עַל רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם הַ/שָּׁמָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vysh'v 't 'ynyhm mrchvq vl' hkhyrhv vysh'v qvlm vybkhv vyqr'v 'ysh m'lv vyzrqv 'pr 'l r'shyhm hshmymh
verses.translation: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֤וּ אִתּ/וֹ֙ לָ/אָ֔רֶץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְ/שִׁבְעַ֣ת לֵיל֑וֹת וְ/אֵין דֹּבֵ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ דָּבָ֔ר כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּֽי גָדַ֥ל הַ/כְּאֵ֖ב מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyshbv 'tv l'rts shb't ymym vshb't lylvt v'yn dbr 'lyv dbr khy r'v khy gdl hkh'b m'd
verses.translation: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן פָּתַ֤ח אִיּוֹב֙ אֶת פִּ֔י/הוּ וַ/יְקַלֵּ֖ל אֶת יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'chry khn ptch 'yvb 't pyhv vyqll 't yvmv
verses.translation: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: And Job spake, and said,

verses.original: יֹ֣אבַד י֭וֹם אִוָּ֣לֶד בּ֑/וֹ וְ/הַ/לַּ֥יְלָה אָ֝מַ֗ר הֹ֣רָה גָֽבֶר
verses.translit: y'bd yvm 'vld bv vhlylh 'mr hrh gbr
verses.translation: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

verses.original: הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יְֽהִ֫י חֹ֥שֶׁךְ אַֽל יִדְרְשֵׁ֣/הוּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִ/מָּ֑עַל וְ/אַל תּוֹפַ֖ע עָלָ֣י/ו נְהָרָֽה
verses.translit: hyvm hhv' yhy chshkh 'l ydrshhv 'lvh mm'l v'l tvp' 'lyv nhrh
verses.translation: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

verses.original: יִגְאָלֻ֡/הוּ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ֭/צַלְמָוֶת תִּשְׁכָּן עָלָ֣י/ו עֲנָנָ֑ה יְ֝בַעֲתֻ֗/הוּ כִּֽמְרִ֥ירֵי יֽוֹם
verses.translit: yg'lhv chshkh vtslmvt tshkhn 'lyv 'nnh yb'thv khmryry yvm
verses.translation: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

verses.original: הַ/לַּ֥יְלָה הַ/הוּא֮ יִקָּחֵ֪/ה֫וּ אֹ֥פֶל אַל יִ֭חַדְּ בִּ/ימֵ֣י שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר יְ֝רָחִ֗ים אַל יָבֹֽא
verses.translit: hlylh hhv' yqchhv 'pl 'l ychd bymy shnh bmspr yrchym 'l yb'
verses.translation: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ֭/הוּא יְהִ֣י גַלְמ֑וּד אַל תָּבֹ֖א רְנָנָ֣ה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh hlylh hhv' yhy glmvd 'l tb' rnnh bv
verses.translation: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

verses.original: יִקְּבֻ֥/הוּ אֹרְרֵי י֑וֹם הָ֝/עֲתִידִ֗ים עֹרֵ֥ר לִוְיָתָֽן
verses.translit: yqbhv 'rry yvm h'tydym 'rr lvytn
verses.translation: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

verses.original: יֶחְשְׁכוּ֮ כּוֹכְבֵ֪י נִ֫שְׁפּ֥/וֹ יְקַו לְ/א֥וֹר וָ/אַ֑יִן וְ/אַל יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה בְּ/עַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר
verses.translit: ychshkhv khvkhby nshpv yqv l'vr v'yn v'l yr'h b'p'py shchr
verses.translation: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א סָ֭גַר דַּלְתֵ֣י בִטְנִ֑/י וַ/יַּסְתֵּ֥ר עָ֝מָ֗ל מֵ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy l' sgr dlty btny vystr 'ml m'yny
verses.translation: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה לֹּ֣א מֵ/רֶ֣חֶם אָמ֑וּת מִ/בֶּ֖טֶן יָצָ֣אתִי וְ/אֶגְוָֽע
verses.translit: lmh l' mrchm 'mvt mbtn yts'ty v'gv'
verses.translation: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ קִדְּמ֣וּ/נִי בִרְכָּ֑יִם וּ/מַה שָּׁ֝דַ֗יִם כִּ֣י אִינָֽק
verses.translit: mdv' qdmvny brkhym vmh shdym khy 'ynq
verses.translation: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

verses.original: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה שָׁכַ֣בְתִּי וְ/אֶשְׁק֑וֹט יָ֝שַׁ֗נְתִּי אָ֤ז יָנ֬וּחַֽ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th shkhbty v'shqvt yshnty 'z ynvch ly
verses.translation: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

verses.original: עִם מְ֭לָכִים וְ/יֹ֣עֲצֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַ/בֹּנִ֖ים חֳרָב֣וֹת לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: 'm mlkhym vy'tsy 'rts hbnym chrbvt lmv
verses.translation: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;

verses.original: א֣וֹ עִם שָׂ֭רִים זָהָ֣ב לָ/הֶ֑ם הַֽ/מְמַלְאִ֖ים בָּתֵּי/הֶ֣ם כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: 'v 'm shrym zhb lhm hmml'ym btyhm khsf
verses.translation: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

verses.original: א֤וֹ כְ/נֵ֣פֶל טָ֭מוּן לֹ֣א אֶהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝/עֹלְלִ֗ים לֹא רָ֥אוּ אֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'v khnpl tmvn l' 'hyh kh'llym l' r'v 'vr
verses.translation: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם רְ֭שָׁעִים חָ֣דְלוּ רֹ֑גֶז וְ/שָׁ֥ם יָ֝נ֗וּחוּ יְגִ֣יעֵי כֹֽחַ
verses.translit: shm rsh'ym chdlv rgz vshm ynvchv ygy'y khch
verses.translation: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

verses.original: יַ֭חַד אֲסִירִ֣ים שַׁאֲנָ֑נוּ לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ ק֣וֹל נֹגֵֽשׂ
verses.translit: ychd 'syrym sh'nnv l' shm'v qvl ngsh
verses.translation: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

verses.original: קָטֹ֣ן וְ֭/גָדוֹל שָׁ֣ם ה֑וּא וְ֝/עֶ֗בֶד חָפְשִׁ֥י מֵ/אֲדֹנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: qtn vgdvl shm hv' v'bd chpshy m'dnyv
verses.translation: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה יִתֵּ֣ן לְ/עָמֵ֣ל א֑וֹר וְ֝/חַיִּ֗ים לְ/מָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: lmh ytn l'ml 'vr vchyym lmry npsh
verses.translation: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

verses.original: הַֽ/מְחַכִּ֣ים לַ/מָּ֣וֶת וְ/אֵינֶ֑/נּוּ וַֽ֝/יַּחְפְּרֻ֗/הוּ מִ/מַּטְמוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: hmchkhym lmvt v'ynnv vychprhv mmtmvnym
verses.translation: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

verses.original: הַ/שְּׂמֵחִ֥ים אֱלֵי גִ֑יל יָ֝שִׂ֗ישׂוּ כִּ֣י יִמְצְאוּ קָֽבֶר
verses.translit: hshmchym 'ly gyl yshyshv khy ymts'v qbr
verses.translation: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

verses.original: לְ֭/גֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ נִסְתָּ֑רָה וַ/יָּ֖סֶךְ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בַּעֲדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lgbr 'shr drkhv nstrh vyskh 'lvh b'dv
verses.translation: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

verses.original: כִּֽי לִ/פְנֵ֣י לַ֭חְמִ/י אַנְחָתִ֣/י תָבֹ֑א וַֽ/יִּתְּכ֥וּ כַ֝/מַּ֗יִם שַׁאֲגֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy lpny lchmy 'nchty tb' vytkhv khmym sh'gty
verses.translation: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד פָּ֭חַדְתִּי וַ/יֶּאֱתָיֵ֑/נִי וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָ֝גֹ֗רְתִּי יָ֣בֹא לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy pchd pchdty vy'tyny v'shr ygrty yb' ly
verses.translation: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

verses.original: לֹ֤א שָׁלַ֨וְתִּי וְ/לֹ֖א שָׁקַ֥טְתִּי וְֽ/לֹא נָ֗חְתִּי וַ/יָּ֥בֹא רֹֽגֶז
verses.translit: l' shlvty vl' shqtty vl' nchty vyb' rgz
verses.translation: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽ/תֵּימָנִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'lypz htymny vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.original: הֲ/נִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַ/עְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝/מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל
verses.translit: hnsh dbr 'lykh tl'h v'tsr bmlyn my yvkhl
verses.translation: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְ/יָדַ֖יִם רָפ֣וֹת תְּחַזֵּֽק
verses.translit: hnh ysrt rbym vydym rpvt tchzq
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

verses.original: כּ֭וֹשֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּ/ן מִלֶּ֑י/ךָ וּ/בִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְע֣וֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ
verses.translit: khvshl yqymvn mlykh vbrkhym khr'vt t'mts
verses.translation: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ וַ/תֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗י/ךָ וַ/תִּבָּהֵֽל
verses.translit: khy 'th tbv' 'lykh vtl' tg' 'dykh vtbhl
verses.translation: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְ/ךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑/ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְ/ךָ֗ וְ/תֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hl' yr'tkh khsltkh tqvtkh vtm drkhykh
verses.translation: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

verses.original: זְכָר נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝/אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ
verses.translit: zkhr n' my hv' nqy 'bd v'yph yshrym nkhchdv
verses.translation: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְ/זֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: kh'shr r'yty chrshy 'vn vzr'y 'ml yqtsrhv
verses.translation: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

verses.original: מִ/נִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּ/מֵ/ר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣/וֹ יִכְלֽוּ
verses.translit: mnshmt 'lvh y'bdv vmrvch 'pv ykhlv
verses.translation: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

verses.original: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְ/ק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְ/שִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: sh'gt 'ryh vqvl shchl vshny khpyrym nt'v
verses.translation: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִ/בְּלִי טָ֑רֶף וּ/בְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ
verses.translit: lysh 'bd mbly trf vbny lby' ytprdv
verses.translation: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.

verses.original: וְ֭/אֵלַ/י דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַ/תִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗/י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְ/הֽוּ
verses.translit: v'ly dbr ygnb vtqch 'zny shmts mnhv
verses.translation: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

verses.original: בִּ֭/שְׂעִפִּים מֵ/חֶזְיֹנ֣וֹת לָ֑יְלָה בִּ/נְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל אֲנָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: bsh'pym mchzynvt lylh bnpl trdmh 'l 'nshym
verses.translation: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

verses.original: פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַ/נִי וּ/רְעָדָ֑ה וְ/רֹ֖ב עַצְמוֹתַ֣/י הִפְחִֽיד
verses.translit: pchd qr'ny vr'dh vrb 'tsmvty hpchyd
verses.translation: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

verses.original: וְ֭/רוּחַ עַל פָּנַ֣/י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַֽׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽ/י
verses.translit: vrvch 'l pny ychlf tsmr sh'rt bshry
verses.translation: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

verses.original: יַעֲמֹ֤ד וְֽ/לֹא אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗/הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְ/נֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑/י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָ/ק֣וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: y'md vl' 'khyr mr'hv tmvnh lngd 'yny dmmh vqvl 'shm'
verses.translation: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying ,

verses.original: הַֽ֭/אֱנוֹשׁ מֵ/אֱל֣וֹהַ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝/עֹשֵׂ֗/הוּ יִטְהַר גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: h'nvsh m'lvh ytsdq 'm m'shhv ythr gbr
verses.translation: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭/עֲבָדָי/ו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝/בְ/מַלְאָכָ֗י/ו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה
verses.translit: hn b'bdyv l' y'myn vbml'khyv yshym thlh
verses.translation: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

verses.original: אַ֤ף שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר בֶּ/עָפָ֥ר יְסוֹדָ֑/ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּ/ם לִ/פְנֵי עָֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'f shkhny bty chmr 'shr b'pr ysvdm ydkh'vm lpny 'sh
verses.translation: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

verses.original: מִ/בֹּ֣קֶר לָ/עֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִ/בְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָ/נֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: mbqr l'rb ykhtv mbly mshym lntsch y'bdv
verses.translation: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it .

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣/ם בָּ֑/ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: hl' ns' ytrm bm ymvtv vl' bchkhmh
verses.translation: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

verses.original: קְֽרָא נָ֭א הֲ/יֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑/ךָּ וְ/אֶל מִ֖י מִ/קְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה
verses.translit: qr' n' hysh 'vnkh v'l my mqdshym tpnh
verses.translation: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

verses.original: כִּֽי לֶֽ֭/אֱוִיל יַהֲרָג כָּ֑עַשׂ וּ֝/פֹתֶ֗ה תָּמִ֥ית קִנְאָֽה
verses.translit: khy l'vyl yhrg kh'sh vpth tmyt qn'h
verses.translation: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

verses.original: אֲֽנִי רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ וָ/אֶקּ֖וֹב נָוֵ֣/הוּ פִתְאֹֽם
verses.translit: 'ny r'yty 'vyl mshrysh v'qvb nvhv pt'm
verses.translation: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

verses.original: יִרְחֲק֣וּ בָנָ֣י/ו מִ/יֶּ֑שַׁע וְ/יִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝/שַּׁ֗עַר וְ/אֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: yrchqv bnyv mysh' vydkh'v bsh'r v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them .

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר קְצִיר֨/וֹ רָ֘עֵ֤ב יֹאכֵ֗ל וְ/אֶֽל מִ/צִּנִּ֥ים יִקָּחֵ֑/הוּ וְ/שָׁאַ֖ף צַמִּ֣ים חֵילָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr qtsyrv r'b y'khl v'l mtsnym yqchhv vsh'f tsmym chylm
verses.translation: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא יֵצֵ֣א מֵ/עָפָ֣ר אָ֑וֶן וּ֝/מֵ/אֲדָמָ֗ה לֹא יִצְמַ֥ח עָמָֽל
verses.translit: khy l' yts' m'pr 'vn vm'dmh l' ytsmch 'ml
verses.translation: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֭דָם לְ/עָמָ֣ל יוּלָּ֑ד וּ/בְנֵי רֶ֝֗שֶׁף יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ עֽוּף
verses.translit: khy 'dm l'ml yvld vbny rshf ygbyhv 'vf
verses.translation: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל אֵ֑ל וְ/אֶל אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'vlm 'ny 'drsh 'l 'l v'l 'lhym 'shym dbrty
verses.translation: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְ/אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: 'shh gdlvt v'yn chqr npl'vt 'd 'yn mspr
verses.translation: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

verses.original: הַ/נֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל פְּנֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝יִם עַל פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת
verses.translit: hntn mtr 'l pny 'rts vshlch mym 'l pny chvtsvt
verses.translation: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

verses.original: לָ/שׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְ/מָר֑וֹם וְ֝/קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע
verses.translit: lshvm shplym lmrvm vqdrym shgbv ysh'
verses.translation: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

verses.original: מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים וְֽ/לֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה יְ֝דֵי/הֶ֗ם תּוּשִׁיָּֽה
verses.translit: mpr mchshbvt 'rvmym vl' t'shynh ydyhm tvshyh
verses.translation: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

verses.original: לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּ/עָרְמָ֑/ם וַ/עֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים נִמְהָֽרָה
verses.translit: lkhd chkhmym b'rmm v'tst nptlym nmhrh
verses.translation: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

verses.original: יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝/כַ/לַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽ/צָּהֳרָֽיִם
verses.translit: yvmm ypgshv chshkh vkhlylh ymshshv btshrym
verses.translation: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣שַׁע מֵ֭/חֶרֶב מִ/פִּי/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִ/יַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: vysh' mchrb mpyhm vmyd chzq 'byvn
verses.translation: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֣י לַ/דַּ֣ל תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝/עֹלָ֗תָ/ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vthy ldl tqvh v'lth qptsh pyh
verses.translation: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶ֣/נּֽוּ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּ/מוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י אַל תִּמְאָֽס
verses.translit: hnh 'shry 'nvsh yvkhchnv 'lvh vmvsr shdy 'l tm's
verses.translation: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְ/יֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ ו/יד/ו וְ/יָדָ֥י/ו תִּרְפֶּֽינָה
verses.translit: khy hv' ykh'yb vychbsh ymchts vydv vydyv trpynh
verses.translation: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

verses.original: בְּ/שֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת יַצִּילֶ֑/ךָּ וּ/בְ/שֶׁ֓בַע לֹא יִגַּ֖ע בְּ/ךָ֣ רָֽע
verses.translit: bshsh tsrvt ytsylkh vbshb' l' yg' bkh r'
verses.translation: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

verses.original: בְּ֭/רָעָב פָּֽדְ/ךָ֣ מִ/מָּ֑וֶת וּ֝/בְ/מִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣/ידֵי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: br'b pdkh mmvt vbmlchmh mydy chrb
verses.translation: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

verses.original: בְּ/שׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵ֑א וְֽ/לֹא תִירָ֥א מִ֝/שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: bshvt lshvn tchb' vl' tyr' mshd khy ybv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

verses.original: לְ/שֹׁ֣ד וּ/לְ/כָפָ֣ן תִּשְׂחָ֑ק וּֽ/מֵ/חַיַּ֥ת הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ אַל תִּירָֽא
verses.translit: lshd vlkhpn tshchq vmchyt h'rts 'l tyr'
verses.translation: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עִם אַבְנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֣ה בְרִיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝/שָּׂדֶ֗ה הָשְׁלְמָה לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy 'm 'bny hshdh brytkh vchyt hshdh hshlmh lkh
verses.translation: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/יָדַעְתָּ כִּי שָׁל֣וֹם אָהֳלֶ֑/ךָ וּֽ/פָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְ/ךָ וְ/לֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא
verses.translit: vyd't khy shlvm 'hlkh vpqdt nvkh vl' tcht'
verses.translation: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/יָדַעְתָּ כִּי רַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑/ךָ וְ֝/צֶאֱצָאֶ֗י/ךָ כְּ/עֵ֣שֶׂב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyd't khy rb zr'kh vts'ts'ykh kh'shb h'rts
verses.translation: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.original: תָּב֣וֹא בְ/כֶ֣לַח אֱלֵי קָ֑בֶר כַּ/עֲל֖וֹת גָּדִ֣ישׁ בְּ/עִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tbv' bkhlch 'ly qbr kh'lvt gdysh b'tv
verses.translation: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

verses.original: הִנֵּה זֹ֭את חֲקַרְנ֥וּ/הָ כֶּֽן הִ֑יא שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗/נָּה וְ/אַתָּ֥ה דַֽע לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hnh z't chqrnvh khn hy' shm'nh v'th d' lkh
verses.translation: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: But Job answered and said,

verses.original: ל֗וּ שָׁק֣וֹל יִשָּׁקֵ֣ל כַּעְשִׂ֑/י ו/הית/י וְ֝/הַוָּתִ֗/י בְּֽ/מֹאזְנַ֥יִם יִשְׂאוּ יָֽחַד
verses.translit: lv shqvl yshql kh'shy vhyty vhvty bm'znym ysh'v ychd
verses.translation: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

verses.original: כִּֽי עַתָּ֗ה מֵ/ח֣וֹל יַמִּ֣ים יִכְבָּ֑ד עַל כֵּ֝֗ן דְּבָרַ֥/י לָֽעוּ
verses.translit: khy 'th mchvl ymym ykhbd 'l khn dbry l'v
verses.translation: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חִצֵּ֪י שַׁדַּ֡י עִמָּדִ֗/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲ֭מָתָ/ם שֹׁתָ֣ה רוּחִ֑/י בִּעוּתֵ֖י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַֽעַרְכֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: khy chtsy shdy 'mdy 'shr chmtm shth rvchy b'vty 'lvh y'rkhvny
verses.translation: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

verses.original: הֲ/יִֽנְהַק פֶּ֥רֶא עֲלֵי דֶ֑שֶׁא אִ֥ם יִגְעֶה שּׁ֝֗וֹר עַל בְּלִילֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hynhq pr' 'ly dsh' 'm yg'h shvr 'l blylv
verses.translation: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

verses.original: הֲ/יֵאָכֵ֣ל תָּ֭פֵל מִ/בְּלִי מֶ֑לַח אִם יֶשׁ טַ֝֗עַם בְּ/רִ֣יר חַלָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: hy'khl tpl mbly mlch 'm ysh t'm bryr chlmvt
verses.translation: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

verses.original: מֵאֲנָ֣ה לִ/נְגּ֣וֹעַ נַפְשִׁ֑/י הֵ֝֗מָּה כִּ/דְוֵ֥י לַחְמִֽ/י
verses.translit: m'nh lngv' npshy hmh khdvy lchmy
verses.translation: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

verses.original: מִֽי יִ֭תֵּן תָּב֣וֹא שֶֽׁאֱלָתִ֑/י וְ֝/תִקְוָתִ֗/י יִתֵּ֥ן אֱלֽוֹהַּ
verses.translit: my ytn tbv' sh'lty vtqvty ytn 'lvh
verses.translation: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

verses.original: וְ/יֹאֵ֣ל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ וִֽ/ידַכְּאֵ֑/נִי יַתֵּ֥ר יָ֝ד֗/וֹ וִֽ/יבַצְּעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'l 'lvh vydkh'ny ytr ydv vybts'ny
verses.translation: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

verses.original: וּ֥/תְהִי ע֨וֹד נֶ֘חָ֤מָתִ֗/י וַ/אֲסַלְּדָ֣ה בְ֭/חִילָה לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל כִּי לֹ֥א כִ֝חַ֗דְתִּי אִמְרֵ֥י קָדֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vthy 'vd nchmty v'sldh bchylh l' ychmvl khy l' khchdty 'mry qdvsh
verses.translation: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

verses.original: מַה כֹּחִ֥/י כִֽי אֲיַחֵ֑ל וּ/מַה קִּ֝צִּ֗/י כִּֽי אַאֲרִ֥יךְ נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: mh khchy khy 'ychl vmh qtsy khy ''rykh npshy
verses.translation: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

verses.original: אִם כֹּ֣חַ אֲבָנִ֣ים כֹּחִ֑/י אִֽם בְּשָׂרִ֥/י נָחֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: 'm khch 'bnym khchy 'm bshry nchvsh
verses.translation: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

verses.original: הַ/אִ֬ם אֵ֣ין עֶזְרָתִ֣/י בִ֑/י וְ֝/תֻשִׁיָּ֗ה נִדְּחָ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: h'm 'yn 'zrty by vtshyh ndchh mmny
verses.translation: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

verses.original: לַ/מָּ֣ס מֵרֵעֵ֣/הוּ חָ֑סֶד וְ/יִרְאַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲזֽוֹב
verses.translit: lms mr'hv chsd vyr't shdy y'zvb
verses.translation: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

verses.original: אַ֭חַ/י בָּגְד֣וּ כְמוֹ נָ֑חַל כַּ/אֲפִ֖יק נְחָלִ֣ים יַעֲבֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: 'chy bgdv khmv nchl kh'pyq nchlym y'brv
verses.translation: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

verses.original: הַ/קֹּדְרִ֥ים מִנִּי קָ֑רַח עָ֝לֵ֗י/מוֹ יִתְעַלֶּם שָֽׁלֶג
verses.translit: hqdrym mny qrch 'lymv yt'lm shlg
verses.translation: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

verses.original: בְּ֭/עֵת יְזֹרְב֣וּ נִצְמָ֑תוּ בְּ֝/חֻמּ֗/וֹ נִדְעֲכ֥וּ מִ/מְּקוֹמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: b't yzrbv ntsmtv bchmv nd'khv mmqvmm
verses.translation: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

verses.original: יִ֭לָּ֣פְתוּ אָרְח֣וֹת דַּרְכָּ֑/ם יַעֲל֖וּ בַ/תֹּ֣הוּ וְ/יֹאבֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: ylptv 'rchvt drkhm y'lv bthv vy'bdv
verses.translation: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

verses.original: הִ֭בִּיטוּ אָרְח֣וֹת תֵּמָ֑א הֲלִיכֹ֥ת שְׁ֝בָ֗א קִוּוּ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: hbytv 'rchvt tm' hlykht shb' qvv lmv
verses.translation: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

verses.original: בֹּ֥שׁוּ כִּֽי בָטָ֑ח בָּ֥אוּ עָ֝דֶ֗י/הָ וַ/יֶּחְפָּֽרוּ
verses.translit: bshv khy btch b'v 'dyh vychprv
verses.translation: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

verses.original: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה הֱיִ֣יתֶם לא ל֑/וֹ תִּֽרְא֥וּ חֲ֝תַ֗ת וַ/תִּירָֽאוּ
verses.translit: khy 'th hyytm l' lv tr'v chtt vtyr'v
verses.translation: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

verses.original: הֲֽ/כִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי הָ֣בוּ לִ֑/י וּ֝/מִ/כֹּחֲ/כֶ֗ם שִׁחֲד֥וּ בַעֲדִֽ/י
verses.translit: hkhy 'mrty hbv ly vmkhchkhm shchdv b'dy
verses.translation: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

verses.original: וּ/מַלְּט֥וּ/נִי מִ/יַּד צָ֑ר וּ/מִ/יַּ֖ד עָרִיצִ֣ים תִּפְדּֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: vmltvny myd tsr vmyd 'rytsym tpdvny
verses.translation: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

verses.original: ה֭וֹרוּ/נִי וַ/אֲנִ֣י אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ וּ/מַה שָּׁ֝גִ֗יתִי הָבִ֥ינוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: hvrvny v'ny 'chrysh vmh shgyty hbynv ly
verses.translation: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

verses.original: מַה נִּמְרְצ֥וּ אִמְרֵי יֹ֑שֶׁר וּ/מַה יּוֹכִ֖יחַ הוֹכֵ֣חַ מִ/כֶּֽם
verses.translit: mh nmrtsv 'mry yshr vmh yvkhych hvkhch mkhm
verses.translation: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

verses.original: הַ/לְ/הוֹכַ֣ח מִלִּ֣ים תַּחְשֹׁ֑בוּ וּ֝/לְ/ר֗וּחַ אִמְרֵ֥י נֹאָֽשׁ
verses.translit: hlhvkhch mlym tchshbv vlrvch 'mry n'sh
verses.translation: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

verses.original: אַף עַל יָת֥וֹם תַּפִּ֑ילוּ וְ֝/תִכְר֗וּ עַל רֵֽיעֲ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'f 'l ytvm tpylv vtkhrv 'l ry'khm
verses.translation: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

verses.original: וְ֭/עַתָּה הוֹאִ֣ילוּ פְנוּ בִ֑/י וְ/עַל פְּ֝נֵי/כֶ֗ם אִם אֲכַזֵּֽב
verses.translit: v'th hv'ylv pnv by v'l pnykhm 'm 'khzb
verses.translation: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

verses.original: שֻֽׁבוּ נָ֭א אַל תְּהִ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה ו/שבי וְ/שׁ֥וּבוּ ע֝וֹד צִדְקִ/י בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shbv n' 'l thy 'vlh vshby vshvbv 'vd tsdqy bh
verses.translation: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

verses.original: הֲ/יֵשׁ בִּ/לְשׁוֹנִ֥/י עַוְלָ֑ה אִם חִ֝כִּ֗/י לֹא יָבִ֥ין הַוּֽוֹת
verses.translit: hysh blshvny 'vlh 'm chkhy l' ybyn hvvt
verses.translation: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא צָבָ֣א לֶ/אֱנ֣וֹשׁ על עֲלֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כִ/ימֵ֖י שָׂכִ֣יר יָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hl' tsb' l'nvsh 'l 'ly 'rts vkhymy shkhyr ymyv
verses.translation: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

verses.original: כְּ/עֶ֥בֶד יִשְׁאַף צֵ֑ל וּ֝/כְ/שָׂכִ֗יר יְקַוֶּ֥ה פָעֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: kh'bd ysh'f tsl vkhshkhyr yqvh p'lv
verses.translation: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן הָנְחַ֣לְתִּי לִ֭/י יַרְחֵי שָׁ֑וְא וְ/לֵיל֥וֹת עָ֝מָ֗ל מִנּוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khn hnchlty ly yrchy shv' vlylvt 'ml mnv ly
verses.translation: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

verses.original: אִם שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וְ/אָמַ֗רְתִּי מָתַ֣י אָ֭קוּם וּ/מִדַּד עָ֑רֶב וְ/שָׂבַ֖עְתִּי נְדֻדִ֣ים עֲדֵי נָֽשֶׁף
verses.translit: 'm shkhbty v'mrty mty 'qvm vmdd 'rb vshb'ty nddym 'dy nshf
verses.translation: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

verses.original: לָ֘בַ֤שׁ בְּשָׂרִ֣/י רִ֭מָּה ו/גיש וְ/ג֣וּשׁ עָפָ֑ר עוֹרִ֥/י רָ֝גַ֗ע וַ/יִּמָּאֵֽס
verses.translit: lbsh bshry rmh vgysh vgvsh 'pr 'vry rg' vym's
verses.translation: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

verses.original: יָמַ֣/י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי אָ֑רֶג וַ֝/יִּכְל֗וּ בְּ/אֶ֣פֶס תִּקְוָֽה
verses.translit: ymy qlv mny 'rg vykhlv b'ps tqvh
verses.translation: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

verses.original: זְ֭כֹר כִּי ר֣וּחַ חַיָּ֑/י לֹא תָשׁ֥וּב עֵ֝ינִ֗/י לִ/רְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב
verses.translit: zkhr khy rvch chyy l' tshvb 'yny lr'vt tvb
verses.translation: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.

verses.original: לֹֽא תְ֭שׁוּרֵ/נִי עֵ֣ין רֹ֑אִי עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ בִּ֣/י וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: l' tshvrny 'yn r'y 'ynykh by v'ynny
verses.translation: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

verses.original: כָּלָ֣ה עָ֭נָן וַ/יֵּלַ֑ךְ כֵּ֥ן יוֹרֵ֥ד שְׁ֝א֗וֹל לֹ֣א יַעֲלֶֽה
verses.translit: khlh 'nn vylkh khn yvrd sh'vl l' y'lh
verses.translation: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more .

verses.original: לֹא יָשׁ֣וּב ע֣וֹד לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ וְ/לֹא יַכִּירֶ֖/נּוּ ע֣וֹד מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' yshvb 'vd lbytv vl' ykhyrnv 'vd mqmv
verses.translation: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

verses.original: גַּם אֲנִי֮ לֹ֤א אֶחֱשָׂ֫ךְ פִּ֥/י אֲֽ֭דַבְּרָה בְּ/צַ֣ר רוּחִ֑/י אָ֝שִׂ֗יחָה בְּ/מַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: gm 'ny l' 'chshkh py 'dbrh btsr rvchy 'shychh bmr npshy
verses.translation: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.original: הֲֽ/יָם אָ֭נִי אִם תַּנִּ֑ין כִּֽי תָשִׂ֖ים עָלַ֣/י מִשְׁמָֽר
verses.translit: hym 'ny 'm tnyn khy tshym 'ly mshmr
verses.translation: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֭מַרְתִּי תְּנַחֲמֵ֣/נִי עַרְשִׂ֑/י יִשָּׂ֥א בְ֝/שִׂיחִ֗/י מִשְׁכָּבִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'mrty tnchmny 'rshy ysh' bshychy mshkhby
verses.translation: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

verses.original: וְ/חִתַּתַּ֥/נִי בַ/חֲלֹמ֑וֹת וּֽ/מֵ/חֶזְיֹנ֥וֹת תְּבַעֲתַֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: vchttny bchlmvt vmchzynvt tb'tny
verses.translation: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְחַ֣ר מַחֲנָ֣ק נַפְשִׁ֑/י מָ֝֗וֶת מֵֽ/עַצְמוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vtbchr mchnq npshy mvt m'tsmvty
verses.translation: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

verses.original: מָ֭אַסְתִּי לֹא לְ/עֹלָ֣ם אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה חֲדַ֥ל מִ֝מֶּ֗/נִּי כִּי הֶ֥בֶל יָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: m'sty l' l'lm 'chyh chdl mmny khy hbl ymy
verses.translation: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

verses.original: מָֽה אֱ֭נוֹשׁ כִּ֣י תְגַדְּלֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/כִי תָשִׁ֖ית אֵלָ֣י/ו לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: mh 'nvsh khy tgdlnv vkhy tshyt 'lyv lbkh
verses.translation: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

verses.original: וַ/תִּפְקְדֶ֥/נּוּ לִ/בְקָרִ֑ים לִ֝/רְגָעִ֗ים תִּבְחָנֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vtpqdnv lbqrym lrg'ym tbchnnv
verses.translation: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

verses.original: כַּ֭/מָּה לֹא תִשְׁעֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑/נִּי לֹֽא תַ֝רְפֵּ֗/נִי עַד בִּלְעִ֥/י רֻקִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khmh l' tsh'h mmny l' trpny 'd bl'y rqy
verses.translation: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

verses.original: חָטָ֡אתִי מָ֤ה אֶפְעַ֨ל לָ/ךְ֮ נֹצֵ֪ר הָ/אָ֫דָ֥ם לָ֤/מָה שַׂמְתַּ֣/נִי לְ/מִפְגָּ֣ע לָ֑/ךְ וָ/אֶהְיֶ֖ה עָלַ֣/י לְ/מַשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: cht'ty mh 'p'l lkh ntsr h'dm lmh shmtny lmpg' lkh v'hyh 'ly lmsh'
verses.translation: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֤ה לֹא תִשָּׂ֣א פִשְׁעִ/י֮ וְ/תַעֲבִ֪יר אֶת עֲוֺ֫נִ֥/י כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה לֶ/עָפָ֣ר אֶשְׁכָּ֑ב וְ/שִׁ֖חֲרְתַּ֣/נִי וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: vmh l' tsh' psh'y vt'byr 't 'vny khy 'th l'pr 'shkhb vshchrtny v'ynny
verses.translation: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be .

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַ/שּׁוּחִ֗י וַ/יֹאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n bldd hshvchy vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.original: עַד אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/ר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּיר אִמְרֵי פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'd 'n tmll 'lh vrvch khbyr 'mry pykh
verses.translation: How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

verses.original: הַ֭/אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ/אִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּֽת צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: h'l y'vt mshpt v'm shdy y'vt tsdq
verses.translation: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

verses.original: אִם בָּנֶ֥י/ךָ חָֽטְאוּ ל֑/וֹ וַֽ֝/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗/ם בְּ/יַד פִּשְׁעָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'm bnykh cht'v lv vyshlchm byd psh'm
verses.translation: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;

verses.original: אִם אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל אֵ֑ל וְ/אֶל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן
verses.translit: 'm 'th tshchr 'l 'l v'l shdy ttchnn
verses.translation: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

verses.original: אִם זַ֥ךְ וְ/יָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥תָּה כִּי עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm zkh vyshr 'th khy 'th y'yr 'lykh vshlm nvt tsdqkh
verses.translation: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְ/ךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝/אַחֲרִיתְ/ךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vhyh r'shytkh mts'r v'chrytkh yshgh m'd
verses.translation: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

verses.original: כִּֽי שְׁאַל נָ֭א לְ/דֹ֣ר רִישׁ֑וֹן וְ֝/כוֹנֵ֗ן לְ/חֵ֣קֶר אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy sh'l n' ldr ryshvn vkhvnn lchqr 'bvtm
verses.translation: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

verses.original: כִּֽי תְמ֣וֹל אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְ/לֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣י/נוּ עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy tmvl 'nchnv vl' nd' khy tsl ymynv 'ly 'rts
verses.translation: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם י֭וֹרוּ/ךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑/ךְ וּ֝/מִ/לִּבָּ֗/ם יוֹצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים
verses.translit: hl' hm yvrvkh y'mrv lkh vmlbm yvts'v mlym
verses.translation: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

verses.original: הֲ/יִֽגְאֶה גֹּ֭מֶא בְּ/לֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה אָ֥חוּ בְלִי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: hyg'h gm' bl' btsh yshgh 'chv bly mym
verses.translation: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

verses.original: עֹדֶ֣/נּוּ בְ֭/אִבּ/וֹ לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָל חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'dnv b'bv l' yqtf vlpny khl chtsyr yybsh
verses.translation: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְ/תִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד
verses.translit: khn 'rchvt khl shkhchy 'l vtqvt chnf t'bd
verses.translation: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר יָק֥וֹט כִּסְל֑/וֹ וּ/בֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shr yqvt khslv vbyt 'khbysh mbtchv
verses.translation: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.

verses.original: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל בֵּ֭ית/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בּ֝֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: ysh'n 'l bytv vl' y'md ychzyq bv vl' yqvm
verses.translation: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

verses.original: רָטֹ֣ב ה֭וּא לִ/פְנֵי שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/עַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּת֗/וֹ יֹֽנַקְתּ֥/וֹ תֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: rtb hv' lpny shmsh v'l gntv ynqtv tts'
verses.translation: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

verses.original: עַל גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣י/ו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה
verses.translit: 'l gl shrshyv ysbkhv byt 'bnym ychzh
verses.translation: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

verses.original: אִם יְבַלְּעֶ֥/נּוּ מִ/מְּקוֹמ֑/וֹ וְ/כִ֥חֶשׁ בּ֝֗/וֹ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm ybl'nv mmqvmv vkhchsh bv l' r'ytykh
verses.translation: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying , I have not seen thee.

verses.original: הֶן ה֭וּא מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וּ֝/מֵ/עָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ
verses.translit: hn hv' mshvsh drkhv vm'pr 'chr ytsmchv
verses.translation: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

verses.original: הֶן אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס תָּ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּ/יַד מְרֵעִֽים
verses.translit: hn 'l l' ym's tm vl' ychzyq byd mr'ym
verses.translation: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers:

verses.original: עַד יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂח֣וֹק פִּ֑י/ךָ וּ/שְׂפָתֶ֥י/ךָ תְרוּעָֽה
verses.translit: 'd ymlh shchvq pykh vshptykh trv'h
verses.translation: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

verses.original: שֹׂנְאֶ֥י/ךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ בֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/אֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: shn'ykh ylbshv bsht v'hl rsh'ym 'ynnv
verses.translation: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said,

verses.original: אָ֭מְנָם יָדַ֣עְתִּי כִי כֵ֑ן וּ/מַה יִּצְדַּ֖ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'mnm yd'ty khy khn vmh ytsdq 'nvsh 'm 'l
verses.translation: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

verses.original: אִם יַ֭חְפֹּץ לָ/רִ֣יב עִמּ֑/וֹ לֹֽא יַ֝עֲנֶ֗/נּוּ אַחַ֥ת מִנִּי אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: 'm ychpts lryb 'mv l' y'nnv 'cht mny 'lf
verses.translation: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

verses.original: חֲכַ֣ם לֵ֭בָב וְ/אַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֑חַ מִֽי הִקְשָׁ֥ה אֵ֝לָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁלָֽם
verses.translit: chkhm lbb v'myts khch my hqshh 'lyv vyshlm
verses.translation: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

verses.original: הַ/מַּעְתִּ֣יק הָ֭רִים וְ/לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲפָכָ֣/ם בְּ/אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hm'tyq hrym vl' yd'v 'shr hpkhm b'pv
verses.translation: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

verses.original: הַ/מַּרְגִּ֣יז אֶ֭רֶץ מִ/מְּקוֹמָ֑/הּ וְ֝/עַמּוּדֶ֗י/הָ יִתְפַלָּצֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hmrgyz 'rts mmqvmh v'mvdyh ytpltsvn
verses.translation: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

verses.original: הָ/אֹמֵ֣ר לַ֭/חֶרֶס וְ/לֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ח וּ/בְעַ֖ד כּוֹכָבִ֣ים יַחְתֹּֽם
verses.translit: h'mr lchrs vl' yzrch vb'd khvkhbym ychtm
verses.translation: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

verses.original: נֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַ֣יִם לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/דוֹרֵ֗ךְ עַל בָּ֥מֳתֵי יָֽם
verses.translit: nth shmym lbdv vdvrkh 'l bmty ym
verses.translation: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

verses.original: עֹֽשֶׂה עָ֭שׁ כְּסִ֥יל וְ/כִימָ֗ה וְ/חַדְרֵ֥י תֵמָֽן
verses.translit: 'shh 'sh khsyl vkhymh vchdry tmn
verses.translation: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת עַד אֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר וְ/נִפְלָא֗וֹת עַד אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: 'shh gdlvt 'd 'yn chqr vnpl'vt 'd 'yn mspr
verses.translation: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעֲבֹ֣ר עָ֭לַ/י וְ/לֹ֣א אֶרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝/יַחֲלֹ֗ף וְֽ/לֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hn y'br 'ly vl' 'r'h vychlf vl' 'byn lv
verses.translation: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭חְתֹּף מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ מִֽי יֹאמַ֥ר אֵ֝לָ֗י/ו מַֽה תַּעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: hn ychtf my yshybnv my y'mr 'lyv mh t'shh
verses.translation: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

verses.original: אֱ֭לוֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑/וֹ תחת/ו תַּחְתָּ֥י/ו שָׁ֝חֲח֗וּ עֹ֣זְרֵי רָֽהַב
verses.translit: 'lvh l' yshyb 'pv tchtv tchtyv shchchv 'zry rhb
verses.translation: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑/נּוּ אֶבְחֲרָ֖ה דְבָרַ֣/י עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'f khy 'nkhy ''nnv 'bchrh dbry 'mv
verses.translation: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם צָ֭דַקְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶעֱנֶ֑ה לִ֝/מְשֹׁפְטִ֗/י אֶתְחַנָּֽן
verses.translit: 'shr 'm tsdqty l' ''nh lmshpty 'tchnn
verses.translation: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

verses.original: אִם קָרָ֥אתִי וַֽ/יַּעֲנֵ֑/נִי לֹֽא אַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּֽי יַאֲזִ֥ין קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm qr'ty vy'nny l' ''myn khy y'zyn qvly
verses.translation: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר בִּ/שְׂעָרָ֥ה יְשׁוּפֵ֑/נִי וְ/הִרְבָּ֖ה פְצָעַ֣/י חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: 'shr bsh'rh yshvpny vhrbh pts'y chnm
verses.translation: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִ֭תְּנֵ/נִי הָשֵׁ֣ב רוּחִ֑/י כִּ֥י יַ֝שְׂבִּעַ֗/נִי מַמְּרֹרִֽים
verses.translit: l' ytnny hshb rvchy khy yshb'ny mmrrym
verses.translation: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

verses.original: אִם לְ/כֹ֣חַ אַמִּ֣יץ הִנֵּ֑ה וְ/אִם לְ֝/מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מִ֣י יוֹעִידֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'm lkhch 'myts hnh v'm lmshpt my yv'ydny
verses.translation: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead ?

verses.original: אִם אֶ֭צְדָּק פִּ֣/י יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי תָּֽם אָ֝֗נִי וַֽ/יַּעְקְשֵֽׁ/נִי
verses.translit: 'm 'tsdq py yrshy'ny tm 'ny vy'qshny
verses.translation: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say , I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

verses.original: תָּֽם אָ֭נִי לֹֽא אֵדַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֗/י אֶמְאַ֥ס חַיָּֽ/י
verses.translit: tm 'ny l' 'd' npshy 'm's chyy
verses.translation: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

verses.original: אַחַ֗ת הִ֥יא עַל כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֑רְתִּי תָּ֥ם וְ֝/רָשָׁ֗ע ה֣וּא מְכַלֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'cht hy' 'l khn 'mrty tm vrsh' hv' mkhlh
verses.translation: This is one thing , therefore I said it , He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

verses.original: אִם שׁ֭וֹט יָמִ֣ית פִּתְאֹ֑ם לְ/מַסַּ֖ת נְקִיִּ֣ם יִלְעָֽג
verses.translit: 'm shvt ymyt pt'm lmst nqym yl'g
verses.translation: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ נִתְּנָ֬ה בְֽ/יַד רָשָׁ֗ע פְּנֵֽי שֹׁפְטֶ֥י/הָ יְכַסֶּ֑ה אִם לֹ֖א אֵפ֣וֹא מִי הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'rts ntnh byd rsh' pny shptyh ykhsh 'm l' 'pv' my hv'
verses.translation: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

verses.original: וְ/יָמַ֣/י קַ֭לּוּ מִנִּי רָ֑ץ בָּֽ֝רְח֗וּ לֹא רָא֥וּ טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vymy qlv mny rts brchv l' r'v tvbh
verses.translation: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

verses.original: חָ֭לְפוּ עִם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת אֵבֶ֑ה כְּ֝/נֶ֗שֶׁר יָט֥וּשׂ עֲלֵי אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: chlpv 'm 'nyvt 'bh khnshr ytvsh 'ly 'khl
verses.translation: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

verses.original: אִם אָ֭מְרִ/י אֶשְׁכְּחָ֣ה שִׂיחִ֑/י אֶעֶזְבָ֖ה פָנַ֣/י וְ/אַבְלִֽיגָה
verses.translit: 'm 'mry 'shkhchh shychy ''zbh pny v'blygh
verses.translation: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

verses.original: יָגֹ֥רְתִּי כָל עַצְּבֹתָ֑/י יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי לֹ֥א תְנַקֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ygrty khl 'tsbty yd'ty khy l' tnqny
verses.translation: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אֶרְשָׁ֑ע לָ/מָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל אִיגָֽע
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'rsh' lmh zh hbl 'yg'
verses.translation: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

verses.original: אִם הִתְרָחַ֥צְתִּי במו בְ/מֵי שָׁ֑לֶג וַ֝/הֲזִכּ֗וֹתִי בְּ/בֹ֣ר כַּפָּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm htrchtsty bmv bmy shlg vhzkhvty bbr khpy
verses.translation: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

verses.original: אָ֭ז בַּ/שַּׁ֣חַת תִּטְבְּלֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/תִֽעֲב֗וּ/נִי שַׂלְמוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'z bshcht ttblny vt'bvny shlmvty
verses.translation: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

verses.original: כִּי לֹא אִ֣ישׁ כָּמֹ֣/נִי אֶֽעֱנֶ֑/נּוּ נָב֥וֹא יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: khy l' 'ysh khmny ''nnv nbv' ychdv bmshpt
verses.translation: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

verses.original: לֹ֣א יֵשׁ בֵּינֵ֣י/נוּ מוֹכִ֑יחַ יָשֵׁ֖ת יָד֣/וֹ עַל שְׁנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: l' ysh bynynv mvkhych ysht ydv 'l shnynv
verses.translation: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

verses.original: יָסֵ֣ר מֵ/עָלַ֣/י שִׁבְט֑/וֹ וְ֝/אֵמָת֗/וֹ אַֽל תְּבַעֲתַֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: ysr m'ly shbtv v'mtv 'l tb'tny
verses.translation: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

verses.original: אַֽ֭דַבְּרָה וְ/לֹ֣א אִירָאֶ֑/נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא כֵ֥ן אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'dbrh vl' 'yr'nv khy l' khn 'nkhy 'mdy
verses.translation: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

verses.original: נָֽקְטָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗/י בְּ/חַ֫יָּ֥/י אֶֽעֶזְבָ֣ה עָלַ֣/י שִׂיחִ֑/י אֲ֝דַבְּרָה֗ בְּ/מַ֣ר נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: nqth npshy bchyy ''zbh 'ly shychy 'dbrh bmr npshy
verses.translation: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.original: אֹמַ֣ר אֶל אֱ֭לוֹהַּ אַל תַּרְשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי הֽ֝וֹדִיעֵ֗/נִי עַ֣ל מַה תְּרִיבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'mr 'l 'lvh 'l trshy'ny hvdy'ny 'l mh trybny
verses.translation: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

verses.original: הֲ/ט֤וֹב לְ/ךָ֨ כִּֽי תַעֲשֹׁ֗ק כִּֽי תִ֭מְאַס יְגִ֣יעַ כַּפֶּ֑י/ךָ וְ/עַל עֲצַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים הוֹפָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: htvb lkh khy t'shq khy tm's ygy' khpykh v'l 'tst rsh'ym hvp't
verses.translation: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

verses.original: הַ/עֵינֵ֣י בָשָׂ֣ר לָ֑/ךְ אִם כִּ/רְא֖וֹת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: h'yny bshr lkh 'm khr'vt 'nvsh tr'h
verses.translation: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

verses.original: הֲ/כִ/ימֵ֣י אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמֶ֑י/ךָ אִם שְׁ֝נוֹתֶ֗י/ךָ כִּ֣/ימֵי גָֽבֶר
verses.translit: hkhymy 'nvsh ymykh 'm shnvtykh khymy gbr
verses.translation: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man’s days,

verses.original: כִּֽי תְבַקֵּ֥שׁ לַ/עֲוֺנִ֑/י וּ֭/לְ/חַטָּאתִ֥/י תִדְרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: khy tbqsh l'vny vlcht'ty tdrvsh
verses.translation: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

verses.original: עַֽל דַּ֭עְתְּ/ךָ כִּי לֹ֣א אֶרְשָׁ֑ע וְ/אֵ֖ין מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֣ מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: 'l d'tkh khy l' 'rsh' v'yn mydkh mtsyl
verses.translation: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

verses.original: יָדֶ֣י/ךָ עִ֭צְּבוּ/נִי וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֑וּ/נִי יַ֥חַד סָ֝בִ֗יב וַֽ/תְּבַלְּעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ydykh 'tsbvny vy'shvny ychd sbyb vtbl'ny
verses.translation: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

verses.original: זְכָר נָ֭א כִּי כַ/חֹ֣מֶר עֲשִׂיתָ֑/נִי וְֽ/אֶל עָפָ֥ר תְּשִׁיבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: zkhr n' khy khchmr 'shytny v'l 'pr tshybny
verses.translation: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א כֶ֭/חָלָב תַּתִּיכֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/כַ/גְּבִנָּ֗ה תַּקְפִּיאֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hl' khchlb ttykhny vkhgbnh tqpy'ny
verses.translation: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

verses.original: ע֣וֹר וּ֭/בָשָׂר תַּלְבִּישֵׁ֑/נִי וּֽ/בַ/עֲצָמ֥וֹת וְ֝/גִידִ֗ים תְּסֹכְכֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'vr vbshr tlbyshny vb'tsmvt vgydym tskhkhny
verses.translation: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

verses.original: חַיִּ֣ים וָ֭/חֶסֶד עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּדִ֑/י וּ֝/פְקֻדָּתְ/ךָ֗ שָֽׁמְרָ֥ה רוּחִֽ/י
verses.translit: chyym vchsd 'shyt 'mdy vpqdtkh shmrh rvchy
verses.translation: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

verses.original: וְ֭/אֵלֶּה צָפַ֣נְתָּ בִ/לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּי זֹ֥את עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'lh tspnt blbbkh yd'ty khy z't 'mkh
verses.translation: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

verses.original: אִם חָטָ֥אתִי וּ/שְׁמַרְתָּ֑/נִי וּ֝/מֵ/עֲוֺנִ֗/י לֹ֣א תְנַקֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'm cht'ty vshmrtny vm'vny l' tnqny
verses.translation: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

verses.original: אִם רָשַׁ֡עְתִּי אַלְלַ֬י לִ֗/י וְ֭/צָדַקְתִּי לֹא אֶשָּׂ֣א רֹאשִׁ֑/י שְׂבַ֥ע קָ֝ל֗וֹן וּ/רְאֵ֥ה עָנְיִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm rsh'ty 'lly ly vtsdqty l' 'sh' r'shy shb' qlvn vr'h 'nyy
verses.translation: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

verses.original: וְ֭/יִגְאֶה כַּ/שַּׁ֣חַל תְּצוּדֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/תָשֹׁ֗ב תִּתְפַּלָּא בִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyg'h khshchl ttsvdny vtshb ttpl' by
verses.translation: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

verses.original: תְּחַדֵּ֬שׁ עֵדֶ֨י/ךָ נֶגְדִּ֗/י וְ/תֶ֣רֶב כַּֽ֭עַשְׂ/ךָ עִמָּדִ֑/י חֲלִיפ֖וֹת וְ/צָבָ֣א עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: tchdsh 'dykh ngdy vtrb kh'shkh 'mdy chlypvt vtsb' 'my
verses.translation: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

verses.original: וְ/לָ֣/מָּה מֵ֭/רֶחֶם הֹצֵאתָ֑/נִי אֶ֝גְוַ֗ע וְ/עַ֣יִן לֹא תִרְאֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vlmh mrchm hts'tny 'gv' v'yn l' tr'ny
verses.translation: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא הָיִ֣יתִי אֶהְיֶ֑ה מִ֝/בֶּ֗טֶן לַ/קֶּ֥בֶר אוּבָֽל
verses.translit: kh'shr l' hyyty 'hyh mbtn lqbr 'vbl
verses.translation: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא מְעַ֣ט יָמַ֣/י יחדל וַ/חֲדָ֑ל ישית וְ/שִׁ֥ית מִ֝מֶּ֗/נִּי וְ/אַבְלִ֥יגָה מְּעָֽט
verses.translit: hl' m't ymy ychdl vchdl yshyt vshyt mmny v'blygh m't
verses.translation: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם אֵ֭לֵךְ וְ/לֹ֣א אָשׁ֑וּב אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְ/צַלְמָֽוֶת
verses.translit: btrm 'lkh vl' 'shvb 'l 'rts chshkh vtslmvt
verses.translation: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ עֵיפָ֨תָ/ה כְּמ֥וֹ אֹ֗פֶל צַ֭לְמָוֶת וְ/לֹ֥א סְדָרִ֗ים וַ/תֹּ֥פַע כְּמוֹ אֹֽפֶל
verses.translit: 'rts 'ypth khmv 'pl tslmvt vl' sdrym vtp' khmv 'pl
verses.translation: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽ/נַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n tspr hn'mty vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

verses.original: הֲ/רֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְ/אִם אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק
verses.translit: hrb dbrym l' y'nh v'm 'ysh shptym ytsdq
verses.translation: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

verses.original: בַּ֭דֶּי/ךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁו וַ֝/תִּלְעַ֗ג וְ/אֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם
verses.translit: bdykh mtym ychryshv vtl'g v'yn mkhlm
verses.translation: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

verses.original: וַ֭/תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑/י וּ֝/בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vt'mr zkh lqchy vbr hyyty b'ynykh
verses.translation: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

verses.original: וְֽ/אוּלָ֗ם מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְ/יִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣י/ו עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'vlm my ytn 'lvh dbr vyptch shptyv 'mkh
verses.translation: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

verses.original: וְ/יַגֶּד לְ/ךָ֨ תַּֽעֲלֻמ֣וֹת חָכְמָה֮ כִּֽי כִפְלַ֪יִם לְֽ/ת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְ/דַ֡ע כִּֽי יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְ/ךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵ/עֲוֺנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vygd lkh t'lmvt chkhmh khy khplym ltvshyh vd' khy yshh lkh 'lvh m'vnkh
verses.translation: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth .

verses.original: הַ/חֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא
verses.translit: hchqr 'lvh tmts' 'm 'd tkhlyt shdy tmts'
verses.translation: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

verses.original: גָּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝/שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה תֵּדָֽע
verses.translit: gbhy shmym mh tp'l 'mqh msh'vl mh td'
verses.translation: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

verses.original: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑/הּ וּ֝/רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי יָֽם
verses.translit: 'rkhh m'rts mdh vrchbh mny ym
verses.translation: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

verses.original: אִם יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְ/יַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝/יַקְהִ֗יל וּ/מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'm ychlf vysgyr vyqhyl vmy yshybnv
verses.translation: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

verses.original: כִּי ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי שָׁ֑וְא וַ/יַּרְא אָ֝֗וֶן וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: khy hv' yd' mty shv' vyr' 'vn vl' ytbvnn
verses.translation: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it ?

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְ/עַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד
verses.translit: v'ysh nbvb ylbb v'yr pr' 'dm yvld
verses.translation: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.

verses.original: אִם אַ֭תָּ֗ה הֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/פָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣י/ו כַּפֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm 'th hkhynvt lbkh vprsht 'lyv khpkh
verses.translation: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

verses.original: אִם אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭/יָדְ/ךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑/הוּ וְ/אַל תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּ/אֹהָלֶ֣י/ךָ עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: 'm 'vn bydkh hrchyqhv v'l tshkhn b'hlykh 'vlh
verses.translation: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

verses.original: כִּי אָ֤ז תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣י/ךָ מִ/מּ֑וּם וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְ/לֹ֣א תִירָֽא
verses.translit: khy 'z tsh' pnykh mmvm vhyyt mtsq vl' tyr'
verses.translation: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

verses.original: כִּי אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּ/מַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר
verses.translit: khy 'th 'ml tshkhch khmym 'brv tzkhr
verses.translation: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

verses.original: וּֽ֭/מִ/צָּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָ/ה כַּ/בֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vmtshrym yqvm chld t'ph khbqr thyh
verses.translation: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

verses.translit: vbtcht khy ysh tqvh vchprt lbtch tshkhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/רָבַצְתָּ וְ/אֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְ/חִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣י/ךָ רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vrbtst v'yn mchryd vchlv pnykh rbym
verses.translation: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/עֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭/מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְ/הֶ֑ם וְ֝/תִקְוָתָ֗/ם מַֽפַּח נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'yny rsh'ym tkhlynh vmnvs 'bd mnhm vtqvtm mpch npsh
verses.translation: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: And Job answered and said,

verses.original: אָ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם עָ֑ם וְ֝/עִמָּ/כֶ֗ם תָּמ֥וּת חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: 'mnm khy 'tm 'm v'mkhm tmvt chkhmh
verses.translation: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

verses.original: גַּם לִ֤/י לֵבָ֨ב כְּֽמוֹ/כֶ֗ם לֹא נֹפֵ֣ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִ/כֶּ֑ם וְ/אֶת מִי אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: gm ly lbb khmvkhm l' npl 'nkhy mkhm v't my 'yn khmv 'lh
verses.translation: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

verses.original: שְׂחֹ֤ק לְ/רֵעֵ֨/הוּ אֶֽהְיֶ֗ה קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭/אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽ/יַּעֲנֵ֑/הוּ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים
verses.translit: shchq lr'hv 'hyh qr' l'lvh vy'nhv shchvq tsdyq tmym
verses.translation: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

verses.original: לַ/פִּ֣יד בּ֭וּז לְ/עַשְׁתּ֣וּת שַׁאֲנָ֑ן נָ֝כ֗וֹן לְ/מ֣וֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל
verses.translit: lpyd bvz l'shtvt sh'nn nkhvn lmv'dy rgl
verses.translation: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

verses.original: יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ אֹֽהָלִ֨ים לְ/שֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים וּֽ֭/בַטֻּחוֹת לְ/מַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yshlyv 'hlym lshddym vbtchvt lmrgyzy 'l l'shr hby' 'lvh bydv
verses.translation: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .

verses.original: וְֽ/אוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְ/תֹרֶ֑/ךָּ וְ/ע֥וֹף הַ֝/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/יַגֶּד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'vlm sh'l n' bhmvt vtrkh v'vf hshmym vygd lkh
verses.translation: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

verses.translit: 'v shych l'rts vtrkh vysprv lkh dgy hym
verses.translation: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

verses.original: מִ֭י לֹא יָדַ֣ע בְּ/כָל אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֥י יַד יְ֝הוָה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: my l' yd' bkhl 'lh khy yd yhvh 'shth z't
verses.translation: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭/יָד/וֹ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל חָ֑י וְ֝/ר֗וּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: 'shr bydv npsh khl chy vrvch khl bshr 'ysh
verses.translation: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝/חֵ֗ךְ אֹ֣כֶל יִטְעַם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hl' 'zn mlyn tbchn vchkh 'khl yt'm lv
verses.translation: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

verses.original: בִּֽ/ישִׁישִׁ֥ים חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/אֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים תְּבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: byshyshym chkhmh v'rkh ymym tbvnh
verses.translation: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

verses.original: עִ֭מּ/וֹ חָכְמָ֣ה וּ/גְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗/וֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּ/תְבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: 'mv chkhmh vgbvrh lv 'tsh vtbvnh
verses.translation: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְ/לֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל אִ֝֗ישׁ וְ/לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ
verses.translit: hn yhrvs vl' ybnh ysgr 'l 'ysh vl' yptch
verses.translation: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּ/מַּ֣יִם וְ/יִבָ֑שׁוּ וִֽ֝/ישַׁלְּחֵ֗/ם וְ/יַ֖הַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hn y'tsr bmym vybshv vyshlchm vyhpkhv 'rts
verses.translation: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.translit: 'mv 'z vtvshyh lv shgg vmshgh
verses.translation: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.original: מוֹלִ֣יךְ יוֹעֲצִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְֽ/שֹׁפְטִ֥ים יְהוֹלֵֽל
verses.translit: mvlykh yv'tsym shvll vshptym yhvll
verses.translation: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים פִּתֵּ֑חַ וַ/יֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּ/מָתְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: mvsr mlkhym ptch vy'sr 'zvr bmtnyhm
verses.translation: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

verses.original: מוֹלִ֣יךְ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְ/אֵֽתָנִ֣ים יְסַלֵּֽף
verses.translit: mvlykh khhnym shvll v'tnym yslf
verses.translation: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר שָׂ֭פָה לְ/נֶאֱמָנִ֑ים וְ/טַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים יִקָּֽח
verses.translit: msyr shph ln'mnym vt'm zqnym yqch
verses.translation: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

verses.original: שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל נְדִיבִ֑ים וּ/מְזִ֖יחַ אֲפִיקִ֣ים רִפָּֽה
verses.translit: shvpkh bvz 'l ndybym vmzych 'pyqym rph
verses.translation: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

verses.original: מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַ/יֹּצֵ֖א לָ/א֣וֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת
verses.translit: mglh 'mqvt mny chshkh vyts' l'vr tslmvt
verses.translation: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

verses.original: מַשְׂגִּ֣יא לַ֭/גּוֹיִם וַֽ/יְאַבְּדֵ֑/ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝/גּוֹיִ֗ם וַ/יַּנְחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: mshgy' lgvym vy'bdm shtch lgvym vynchm
verses.translation: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again .

verses.original: מֵסִ֗יר לֵ֭ב רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ֝/יַּתְעֵ֗/ם בְּ/תֹ֣הוּ לֹא דָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: msyr lb r'shy 'm h'rts vyt'm bthv l' drkh
verses.translation: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.original: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְ/לֹא א֑וֹר וַ֝/יַּתְעֵ֗/ם כַּ/שִּׁכּֽוֹר
verses.translit: ymshshv chshkh vl' 'vr vyt'm khshkhvr
verses.translation: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .

verses.original: הֶן כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑/י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗/י וַ/תָּ֥בֶן לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hn khl r'th 'yny shm'h 'zny vtbn lh
verses.translation: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this , mine ear hath heard and understood it.

verses.original: כְּֽ֭/דַעְתְּ/כֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם אָ֑נִי לֹא נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִ/כֶּֽם
verses.translit: khd'tkhm yd'ty gm 'ny l' npl 'nkhy mkhm
verses.translation: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְ/הוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ
verses.translit: 'vlm 'ny 'l shdy 'dbr vhvkhch 'l 'l 'chpts
verses.translation: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

verses.original: וְֽ/אוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'vlm 'tm tply shqr rp'y 'll khlkhm
verses.translation: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

verses.original: מִֽי יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּ/ן וּ/תְהִ֖י לָ/כֶ֣ם לְ/חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: my ytn hchrsh tchryshvn vthy lkhm lchkhmh
verses.translation: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑/י וְ/רִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣/י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ
verses.translit: shm'v n' tvkhchty vrbvt shpty hqshybv
verses.translation: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.original: הַ֭/לְ/אֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝/ל֗/וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה
verses.translit: hl'l tdbrv 'vlh vlv tdbrv rmyh
verses.translation: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

verses.original: הֲ/פָנָ֥י/ו תִּשָּׂא֑וּ/ן אִם לָ/אֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hpnyv tsh'vn 'm l'l trybvn
verses.translation: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

verses.original: הֲ֭/טוֹב כִּֽי יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם אִם כְּ/הָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝/אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: htvb khy ychqr 'tkhm 'm khhtl b'nvsh thtlv bv
verses.translation: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם אִם בַּ֝/סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hvkhch yvkhych 'tkhm 'm bstr pnym tsh'vn
verses.translation: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵת/וֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וּ֝/פַחְדּ֗/וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hl' sh'tv tb't 'tkhm vpchdv ypl 'lykhm
verses.translation: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

verses.original: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵי/כֶם מִשְׁלֵי אֵ֑פֶר לְ/גַבֵּי חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: zkhrnykhm mshly 'pr lgby chmr gbykhm
verses.translation: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

verses.original: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּ/נִּי וַ/אֲדַבְּרָה אָ֑נִי וְ/יַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣/י מָֽה
verses.translit: hchryshv mmny v'dbrh 'ny vy'br 'ly mh
verses.translation: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will .

verses.translit: 'l mh 'sh' bshry bshny vnpshy 'shym bkhpy
verses.translation: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵ/נִי לא ל֣/וֹ אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ דְּ֝רָכַ֗/י אֶל פָּנָ֥י/ו אוֹכִֽיחַ
verses.translit: hn yqtlny l' lv 'ychl 'kh drkhy 'l pnyv 'vkhych
verses.translation: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

verses.original: גַּם הוּא לִ֥/י לִֽ/ישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי לֹ֥א לְ֝/פָנָ֗י/ו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: gm hv' ly lyshv'h khy l' lpnyv chnf ybv'
verses.translation: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑/י וְ֝/אַֽחֲוָתִ֗/י בְּ/אָזְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'v shmv' mlty v'chvty b'znykhm
verses.translation: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק
verses.translit: hnh n' 'rkhty mshpt yd'ty khy 'ny 'tsdq
verses.translation: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

verses.original: מִי ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑/י כִּֽי עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְ/אֶגְוָֽע
verses.translit: my hv' yryb 'mdy khy 'th 'chrysh v'gv'
verses.translation: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

verses.original: אַךְ שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑/י אָ֥ז מִ֝/פָּנֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר
verses.translit: 'kh shtym 'l t'sh 'mdy 'z mpnykh l' 'str
verses.translation: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

verses.translit: khpkh m'ly hrchq v'mtkh 'l tb'tny
verses.translation: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

verses.original: וּ֭/קְרָא וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַ/הֲשִׁיבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vqr' v'nkhy ''nh 'v 'dbr vhshybny
verses.translation: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

verses.original: כַּ/מָּ֣ה לִ֭/י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְ/חַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥/י וְ֝/חַטָּאתִ֗/י הֹדִיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khmh ly 'vnvt vcht'vt psh'y vcht'ty hdy'ny
verses.translation: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

verses.original: לָֽ/מָּה פָנֶ֥י/ךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְ/תַחְשְׁבֵ֖/נִי לְ/אוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lmh pnykh tstyr vtchshbny l'vyb lkh
verses.translation: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

verses.original: הֶ/עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְ/אֶת קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף
verses.translit: h'lh ndf t'rvts v't qsh ybsh trdf
verses.translation: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

verses.original: כִּֽי תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣/י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝/תוֹרִישֵׁ֗/נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy tkhtb 'ly mrrvt vtvryshny 'vnvt n'vry
verses.translation: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

verses.original: וְ/תָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּ/סַּ֨ד רַגְלַ֗/י וְ/תִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל אָרְחוֹתָ֑/י עַל שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗/י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה
verses.translit: vtshm bsd rgly vtshmvr khl 'rchvty 'l shrshy rgly ttchqh
verses.translation: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

verses.original: וְ֭/הוּא כְּ/רָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝/בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣ל/וֹ עָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vhv' khrqb yblh khbgd 'khlv 'sh
verses.translation: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

verses.original: אָ֭דָם יְל֣וּד אִשָּׁ֑ה קְצַ֥ר יָ֝מִ֗ים וּֽ/שְׂבַֽע רֹֽגֶז
verses.translit: 'dm ylvd 'shh qtsr ymym vshb' rgz
verses.translation: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

verses.original: כְּ/צִ֣יץ יָ֭צָא וַ/יִּמָּ֑ל וַ/יִּבְרַ֥ח כַּ֝/צֵּ֗ל וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲמֽוֹד
verses.translit: khtsyts yts' vyml vybrch khtsl vl' y'mvd
verses.translation: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

verses.original: אַף עַל זֶ֭ה פָּקַ֣חְתָּ עֵינֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אֹ֘תִ֤/י תָבִ֖יא בְ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'f 'l zh pqcht 'ynkh v'ty tby' bmshpt 'mkh
verses.translation: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

verses.original: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן טָ֭הוֹר מִ/טָּמֵ֗א לֹ֣א אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: my ytn thvr mtm' l' 'chd
verses.translation: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

verses.original: אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים יָמָ֗י/ו מִֽסְפַּר חֳדָשָׁ֥י/ו אִתָּ֑/ךְ חק/ו חֻקָּ֥י/ו עָ֝שִׂ֗יתָ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'm chrvtsym ymyv mspr chdshyv 'tkh chqv chqyv 'shyt vl' y'bvr
verses.translation: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

verses.original: שְׁעֵ֣ה מֵ/עָלָ֣י/ו וְ/יֶחְדָּ֑ל עַד יִ֝רְצֶ֗ה כְּ/שָׂכִ֥יר יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: sh'h m'lyv vychdl 'd yrtsh khshkhyr yvmv
verses.translation: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֥שׁ לָ/עֵ֗ץ תִּ֫קְוָ֥ה אִֽם יִ֭כָּרֵת וְ/ע֣וֹד יַחֲלִ֑יף וְ֝/יֹֽנַקְתּ֗/וֹ לֹ֣א תֶחְדָּֽל
verses.translit: khy ysh l'ts tqvh 'm ykhrt v'vd ychlyf vynqtv l' tchdl
verses.translation: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

verses.original: אִם יַזְקִ֣ין בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ שָׁרְשׁ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בֶ/עָפָ֗ר יָמ֥וּת גִּזְעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm yzqyn b'rts shrshv vb'pr ymvt gz'v
verses.translation: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

verses.original: מֵ/רֵ֣יחַ מַ֣יִם יַפְרִ֑חַ וְ/עָשָׂ֖ה קָצִ֣יר כְּמוֹ נָֽטַע
verses.translit: mrych mym yprch v'shh qtsyr khmv nt'
verses.translation: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

verses.original: וְ/גֶ֣בֶר יָ֭מוּת וַֽ/יֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ וַ/יִּגְוַ֖ע אָדָ֣ם וְ/אַיּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vgbr ymvt vychlsh vygv' 'dm v'yv
verses.translation: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

verses.original: אָֽזְלוּ מַ֭יִם מִנִּי יָ֑ם וְ֝/נָהָ֗ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְ/יָבֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'zlv mym mny ym vnhr ychrb vybsh
verses.translation: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

verses.original: וְ/אִ֥ישׁ שָׁכַ֗ב וְֽ/לֹא יָ֫ק֥וּם עַד בִּלְתִּ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ וְ/לֹֽא יֵ֝עֹ֗רוּ מִ/שְּׁנָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'ysh shkhb vl' yqvm 'd blty shmym l' yqytsv vl' y'rv mshntm
verses.translation: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֵּ֨ן בִּ/שְׁא֬וֹל תַּצְפִּנֵ֗/נִי תַּ֭סְתִּירֵ/נִי עַד שׁ֣וּב אַפֶּ֑/ךָ תָּ֤שִׁ֥ית לִ֖/י חֹ֣ק וְ/תִזְכְּרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: my ytn bsh'vl ttspnny tstyrny 'd shvb 'pkh tshyt ly chq vtzkhrny
verses.translation: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

verses.original: אִם יָמ֥וּת גֶּ֗בֶר הֲ/יִ֫חְיֶ֥ה כָּל יְמֵ֣י צְבָאִ֣/י אֲיַחֵ֑ל עַד בּ֝֗וֹא חֲלִיפָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm ymvt gbr hychyh khl ymy tsb'y 'ychl 'd bv' chlypty
verses.translation: If a man die, shall he live again ? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

verses.original: תִּ֭קְרָא וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑/ךָּ לְֽ/מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣י/ךָ תִכְסֹֽף
verses.translit: tqr' v'nkhy ''nkh lm'shh ydykh tkhsf
verses.translation: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

verses.original: כִּֽי עַ֭תָּה צְעָדַ֣/י תִּסְפּ֑וֹר לֹֽא תִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹר עַל חַטָּאתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th ts'dy tspvr l' tshmvr 'l cht'ty
verses.translation: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

verses.original: חָתֻ֣ם בִּ/צְר֣וֹר פִּשְׁעִ֑/י וַ֝/תִּטְפֹּ֗ל עַל עֲוֺנִֽ/י
verses.translit: chtm btsrvr psh'y vttpl 'l 'vny
verses.translation: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

verses.original: וְ֭/אוּלָם הַר נוֹפֵ֣ל יִבּ֑וֹל וְ֝/צ֗וּר יֶעְתַּ֥ק מִ/מְּקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'vlm hr nvpl ybvl vtsvr y'tq mmqmv
verses.translation: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

verses.original: אֲבָנִ֤ים שָׁ֥חֲקוּ מַ֗יִם תִּשְׁטֹֽף סְפִיחֶ֥י/הָ עֲפַר אָ֑רֶץ וְ/תִקְוַ֖ת אֱנ֣וֹשׁ הֶאֱבַֽדְתָּ
verses.translit: 'bnym shchqv mym tshtf spychyh 'pr 'rts vtqvt 'nvsh h'bdt
verses.translation: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

verses.translit: ttqphv lntsch vyhlkh mshnh pnyv vtshlchhv
verses.translation: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

verses.original: יִכְבְּד֣וּ בָ֭נָי/ו וְ/לֹ֣א יֵדָ֑ע וְ֝/יִצְעֲר֗וּ וְֽ/לֹא יָבִ֥ין לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: ykhbdv bnyv vl' yd' vyts'rv vl' ybyn lmv
verses.translation: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

verses.original: אַךְ בְּ֭שָׂר/וֹ עָלָ֣י/ו יִכְאָ֑ב וְ֝/נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ עָלָ֥י/ו תֶּאֱבָֽל
verses.translit: 'kh bshrv 'lyv ykh'b vnpshv 'lyv t'bl
verses.translation: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽ/תֵּימָנִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'lypz htymny vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

verses.original: הֶֽ/חָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת ר֑וּחַ וִֽ/ימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hchkhm y'nh d't rvch vyml' qdym btnv
verses.translation: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭/דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝/מִלִּ֗ים לֹא יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: hvkhch bdbr l' yskhvn vmlym l' yv'yl bm
verses.translation: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

verses.original: אַף אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְ/תִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִ/פְנֵי אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'f 'th tpr yr'h vtgr' shychh lpny 'l
verses.translation: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲוֺנְ/ךָ֣ פִ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים
verses.translit: khy y'lf 'vnkh pykh vtbchr lshvn 'rvmym
verses.translation: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

verses.original: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲ/ךָ֣ פִ֣י/ךָ וְ/לֹא אָ֑נִי וּ֝/שְׂפָתֶ֗י/ךָ יַעֲנוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yrshy'kh pykh vl' 'ny vshptykh y'nv bkh
verses.translation: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

verses.original: הֲ/רִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ
verses.translit: hr'yshvn 'dm tvld vlpny gb'vt chvllt
verses.translation: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

verses.original: הַ/בְ/ס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְ/תִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: hbsvd 'lvh tshm' vtgr' 'lykh chkhmh
verses.translation: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

verses.original: מַה יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְ/לֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽ/לֹא עִמָּ֥/נוּ הֽוּא
verses.translit: mh yd't vl' nd' tbyn vl' 'mnv hv'
verses.translation: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

verses.original: גַּם שָׂ֣ב גַּם יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑/נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵ/אָבִ֣י/ךָ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: gm shb gm yshysh bnv khbyr m'bykh ymym
verses.translation: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

verses.original: הַ/מְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּ/ךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝/דָבָ֗ר לָ/אַ֥ט עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hm't mmkh tnchmvt 'l vdbr l't 'mkh
verses.translation: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

verses.original: מַה יִּקָּחֲ/ךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑/ךָ וּֽ/מַה יִּרְזְמ֥וּ/ן עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mh yqchkh lbkh vmh yrzmvn 'ynykh
verses.translation: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

verses.original: כִּֽי תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הֹצֵ֖אתָ מִ/פִּ֣י/ךָ מִלִּֽין
verses.translit: khy tshyb 'l 'l rvchkh vhts't mpykh mlyn
verses.translation: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

verses.original: מָֽה אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְ/כִֽי יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: mh 'nvsh khy yzkhh vkhy ytsdq ylvd 'shh
verses.translation: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן ב/קדש/ו בִּ֭/קְדֹשָׁי/ו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝/שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hn bqdshv bqdshyv l' y'myn vshmym l' zkhv b'ynyv
verses.translation: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
