verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽ/נֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַ/מַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: 'f khy nt'b vn'lch 'ysh shth khmym 'vlh
verses.translation: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

verses.original: אֲחַוְ/ךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑/י וְ/זֶֽה חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַ/אֲסַפֵּֽרָה
verses.translit: 'chvkh shm' ly vzh chzyty v'sprh
verses.translation: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְ/לֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵ/אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr chkhmym ygydv vl' khchdv m'bvtm
verses.translation: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

verses.original: לָ/הֶ֣ם לְ֭/בַדָּ/ם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לֹא עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lhm lbdm ntnh h'rts vl' 'br zr btvkhm
verses.translation: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

verses.original: כָּל יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶ/עָרִֽיץ
verses.translit: khl ymy rsh' hv' mtchvll vmspr shnym ntspnv l'ryts
verses.translation: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

verses.original: קוֹל פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּ/אָזְנָ֑י/ו בַּ֝/שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: qvl pchdym b'znyv bshlvm shvdd ybv'nv
verses.translation: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

verses.original: לֹא יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ ו/צפו וְ/צָפ֖וּי ה֣וּא אֱלֵי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: l' y'myn shvb mny chshkh vtspv vtspvy hv' 'ly chrb
verses.translation: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

verses.original: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַ/לֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע כִּֽי נָכ֖וֹן בְּ/יָד֣/וֹ יֽוֹם חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: ndd hv' llchm 'yh yd' khy nkhvn bydv yvm chshkh
verses.translation: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

verses.original: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻ/הוּ צַ֣ר וּ/מְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗/הוּ כְּ/מֶ֤לֶךְ עָתִ֬יד לַ/כִּידֽוֹר
verses.translit: yb'thv tsr vmtsvqh ttqphv khmlkh 'tyd lkhydvr
verses.translation: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

verses.original: כִּֽי נָטָ֣ה אֶל אֵ֣ל יָד֑/וֹ וְ/אֶל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר
verses.translit: khy nth 'l 'l ydv v'l shdy ytgbr
verses.translation: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

verses.original: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣י/ו בְּ/צַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝/עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: yrvts 'lyv btsv'r b'by gby mgnyv
verses.translation: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

verses.original: כִּֽי כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣י/ו בְּ/חֶלְבּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי כָֽסֶל
verses.translit: khy khsh pnyv bchlbv vy'sh pymh 'ly khsl
verses.translation: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑/מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְ/גַלִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshkhvn 'rym nkhchdvt btym l' yshbv lmv 'shr ht'tdv lglym
verses.translation: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

verses.original: לֹֽא יֶ֭עְשַׁר וְ/לֹא יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא יִטֶּ֖ה לָ/אָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: l' y'shr vl' yqvm chylv vl' yth l'rts mnlm
verses.translation: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

verses.original: לֹֽא יָס֨וּר מִנִּי חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּ/וֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝/יָס֗וּר בְּ/ר֣וּחַ פִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' ysvr mny chshkh ynqtv tybsh shlhbt vysvr brvch pyv
verses.translation: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

verses.original: אַל יַאֲמֵ֣ן ב/שו בַּ/שָּׁ֣יו נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l y'mn bshv bshyv nt'h khy shv' thyh tmvrtv
verses.translation: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

verses.original: בְּֽ/לֹא י֭וֹמ/וֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝/כִפָּת֗/וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה
verses.translit: bl' yvmv tml' vkhptv l' r'nnh
verses.translation: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

verses.translit: ychms khgpn bsrv vyshlkh khzyt ntstv
verses.translation: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

verses.original: כִּֽי עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝/אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי שֹֽׁחַד
verses.translit: khy 'dt chnf glmvd v'sh 'khlh 'hly shchd
verses.translation: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

verses.original: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְ/יָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝/בִטְנָ֗/ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: hrh 'ml vyld 'vn vbtnm tkhyn mrmh
verses.translation: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said,

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְ/אֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'ty kh'lh rbvt mnchmy 'ml khlkhm
verses.translation: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

verses.original: הֲ/קֵ֥ץ לְ/דִבְרֵי ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְ/ךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: hqts ldbry rvch 'v mh ymrytskh khy t'nh
verses.translation: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

verses.original: גַּ֤ם אָנֹכִי֮ כָּ/כֶ֪ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗/י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵי/כֶ֣ם בְּ/מִלִּ֑ים וְ/אָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵי/כֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: gm 'nkhy khkhm 'dbrh lv ysh npshkhm tcht npshy 'chbyrh 'lykhm bmlym v'ny'h 'lykhm bmv r'shy
verses.translation: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

verses.original: אֲאַמִּצְ/כֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ פִ֑/י וְ/נִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣/י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ
verses.translit: ''mtskhm bmv py vnyd shpty ychshkh
verses.translation: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief .

verses.original: אִֽם אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑/י וְ֝/אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה מִ/נִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ
verses.translit: 'm 'dbrh l' ychshkh kh'by v'chdlh mh mny yhlkh
verses.translation: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

verses.original: אַךְ עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑/נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל עֲדָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'kh 'th hl'ny hshmvt khl 'dty
verses.translation: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

verses.original: וַֽ֭/תִּקְמְטֵ/נִי לְ/עֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֥קָם בִּ֥/י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗/י בְּ/פָנַ֥/י יַעֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vtqmtny l'd hyh vyqm by khchshy bpny y'nh
verses.translation: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

verses.original: אַפּ֤/וֹ טָרַ֨ף וַֽ/יִּשְׂטְמֵ֗/נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣/י בְּ/שִׁנָּ֑י/ו צָרִ֓/י יִלְט֖וֹשׁ עֵינָ֣י/ו לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'pv trf vyshtmny chrq 'ly bshnyv tsry yltvsh 'ynyv ly
verses.translation: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

verses.original: פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨/י בְּ/פִי/הֶ֗ם בְּ֭/חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑/י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥/י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: p'rv 'ly bpyhm bchrph hkhv lchyy ychd 'ly ytml'vn
verses.translation: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

verses.original: יַסְגִּירֵ֣/נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְ/עַל יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ysgyrny 'l 'l 'vyl v'l ydy rsh'ym yrtny
verses.translation: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

verses.original: שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי וַֽ/יְפַרְפְּרֵ֗/נִי וְ/אָחַ֣ז בְּ֭/עָרְפִּ/י וַֽ/יְפַצְפְּצֵ֑/נִי וַ/יְקִימֵ֥/נִי ל֝֗/וֹ לְ/מַטָּרָֽה
verses.translit: shlv hyyty vyprprny v'chz b'rpy vyptsptsny vyqymny lv lmtrh
verses.translation: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

verses.original: יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨/י רַבָּ֗י/ו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַ/י וְ/לֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִ/י
verses.translit: ysbv 'ly rbyv yplch khlyvty vl' ychmvl yshpkh l'rts mrrty
verses.translation: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

verses.original: יִפְרְצֵ֣/נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל פְּנֵי פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣/י כְּ/גִבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: yprtsny prts 'l pny prts yrts 'ly khgbvr
verses.translation: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

verses.original: שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑/י וְ/עֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶ/עָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: shq tprty 'ly gldy v'llty b'pr qrny
verses.translation: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

verses.original: פָּנַ֣/י חמרמרה חֳ֭מַרְמְרוּ מִנִּי בֶ֑כִי וְ/עַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣/י צַלְמָֽוֶת
verses.translit: pny chmrmrh chmrmrv mny bkhy v'l 'p'py tslmvt
verses.translation: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

verses.original: עַ֭ל לֹא חָמָ֣ס בְּ/כַפָּ֑/י וּֽ/תְפִלָּתִ֥/י זַכָּֽה
verses.translit: 'l l' chms bkhpy vtplty zkhh
verses.translation: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑/י וְֽ/אַל יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְ/זַעֲקָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'rts 'l tkhsy dmy v'l yhy mqvm lz'qty
verses.translation: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

verses.original: גַּם עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה בַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑/י וְ֝/שָׂהֲדִ֗/י בַּ/מְּרוֹמִֽים
verses.translit: gm 'th hnh bshmym 'dy vshhdy bmrvmym
verses.translation: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

verses.original: מְלִיצַ֥/י רֵעָ֑/י אֶל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽ/י
verses.translit: mlytsy r'y 'l 'lvh dlph 'yny
verses.translation: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹכַ֣ח לְ/גֶ֣בֶר עִם אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽ/בֶן אָדָ֥ם לְ/רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyvkhch lgbr 'm 'lvh vbn 'dm lr'hv
verses.translation: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

verses.original: כִּֽי שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְ/אֹ֖רַח לֹא אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ
verses.translit: khy shnvt mspr y'tyv v'rch l' 'shvb 'hlkh
verses.translation: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

verses.original: רוּחִ֣/י חֻ֭בָּלָה יָמַ֥/י נִזְעָ֗כוּ קְבָרִ֥ים לִֽ/י
verses.translit: rvchy chblh ymy nz'khv qbrym ly
verses.translation: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א הֲ֭תֻלִים עִמָּדִ֑/י וּ֝/בְ/הַמְּרוֹתָ֗/ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm l' htlym 'mdy vbhmrvtm tln 'yny
verses.translation: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

verses.original: שִֽׂימָ/ה נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣/נִי עִמָּ֑/ךְ מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְ/יָדִ֥/י יִתָּקֵֽעַ
verses.translit: shymh n' 'rbny 'mkh my hv' lydy ytq'
verses.translation: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

verses.original: כִּֽי לִ֭בָּ/ם צָפַ֣נְתָּ מִּ/שָּׂ֑כֶל עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹ֣א תְרֹמֵֽם
verses.translit: khy lbm tspnt mshkhl 'l khn l' trmm
verses.translation: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them .

verses.original: לְ֭/חֵלֶק יַגִּ֣יד רֵעִ֑ים וְ/עֵינֵ֖י בָנָ֣י/ו תִּכְלֶֽנָה
verses.translit: lchlq ygyd r'ym v'yny bnyv tkhlnh
verses.translation: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/הִצִּגַ/נִי לִ/מְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים וְ/תֹ֖פֶת לְ/פָנִ֣ים אֶֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vhtsgny lmshl 'mym vtpt lpnym 'hyh
verses.translation: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

verses.translit: vtkhh mkh'sh 'yny vytsry khtsl khlm
verses.translation: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

verses.original: יָשֹׁ֣מּוּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים עַל זֹ֑את וְ֝/נָקִ֗י עַל חָנֵ֥ף יִתְעֹרָֽר
verses.translit: yshmv yshrym 'l z't vnqy 'l chnf yt'rr
verses.translation: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

verses.original: וְ/יֹאחֵ֣ז צַדִּ֣יק דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וּֽ/טֳהָר יָ֝דַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף אֹֽמֶץ
verses.translit: vy'chz tsdyq drkhv vthr ydym ysyf 'mts
verses.translation: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

verses.original: וְֽ/אוּלָ֗ם כֻּלָּ֣/ם תָּ֭שֻׁבוּ וּ/בֹ֣אוּ נָ֑א וְ/לֹֽא אֶמְצָ֖א בָ/כֶ֣ם חָכָֽם
verses.translit: v'vlm khlm tshbv vb'v n' vl' 'mts' bkhm chkhm
verses.translation: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

verses.original: יָמַ֣/י עָ֭בְרוּ זִמֹּתַ֣/י נִתְּק֑וּ מ֖וֹרָשֵׁ֣י לְבָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: ymy 'brv zmty ntqv mvrshy lbby
verses.translation: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

verses.original: לַ֭יְלָה לְ/י֣וֹם יָשִׂ֑ימוּ א֝֗וֹר קָר֥וֹב מִ/פְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: lylh lyvm yshymv 'vr qrvb mpny chshkh
verses.translation: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

verses.original: אִם אֲ֭קַוֶּה שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתִ֑/י בַּ֝/חֹ֗שֶׁךְ רִפַּ֥דְתִּי יְצוּעָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm 'qvh sh'vl byty bchshkh rpdty ytsv'y
verses.translation: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

verses.original: לַ/שַּׁ֣חַת קָ֭רָאתִי אָ֣בִ/י אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥/י וַ֝/אֲחֹתִ֗/י לָֽ/רִמָּֽה
verses.translit: lshcht qr'ty 'by 'th 'my v'chty lrmh
verses.translation: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

verses.original: וְ֭/אַיֵּה אֵפ֣וֹ תִקְוָתִ֑/י וְ֝/תִקְוָתִ֗/י מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'yh 'pv tqvty vtqvty my yshvrnh
verses.translation: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

verses.original: בַּדֵּ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ל תֵּרַ֑דְנָה אִם יַ֖חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר נָֽחַת
verses.translit: bdy sh'l trdnh 'm ychd 'l 'pr ncht
verses.translation: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַ/שֻּׁחִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n bldd hshchy vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.original: עַד אָ֤נָה תְּשִׂימ֣וּ/ן קִנְצֵ֣י לְ/מִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְ/אַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'd 'nh tshymvn qntsy lmlyn tbynv v'chr ndbr
verses.translation: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mdv' nchshbnv khbhmh ntmynv b'ynykhm
verses.translation: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

verses.original: טֹֽרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ בְּ/אַ֫פּ֥/וֹ הַ֭/לְמַעַנְ/ךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יֶעְתַּק צ֝֗וּר מִ/מְּקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: trf npshv b'pv hlm'nkh t'zb 'rts vy'tq tsvr mmqmv
verses.translation: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

verses.original: גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְ/לֹֽא יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: gm 'vr rsh'ym yd'kh vl' ygh shbyb 'shv
verses.translation: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

verses.original: א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּ/אָהֳל֑/וֹ וְ֝/נֵר֗/וֹ עָלָ֥י/ו יִדְעָֽךְ
verses.translit: 'vr chshkh b'hlv vnrv 'lyv yd'kh
verses.translation: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

verses.original: יֵֽ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑/וֹ וְֽ/תַשְׁלִיכֵ֥/הוּ עֲצָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ytsrv ts'dy 'vnv vtshlykhhv 'tstv
verses.translation: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

verses.original: כִּֽי שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּ/רֶ֣שֶׁת בְּ/רַגְלָ֑י/ו וְ/עַל שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ
verses.translit: khy shlch brsht brglyv v'l shbkhh ythlkh
verses.translation: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

verses.original: יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּ/עָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣י/ו צַמִּֽים
verses.translit: y'chz b'qb pch ychzq 'lyv tsmym
verses.translation: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

verses.original: טָמ֣וּן בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑/וֹ וּ֝/מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗/וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב
verses.translit: tmvn b'rts chblv vmlkhdtv 'ly ntyb
verses.translation: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

verses.original: סָ֭בִיב בִּֽעֲתֻ֣/הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶ/הֱפִיצֻ֥/הוּ לְ/רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: sbyb b'thv blhvt vhpytshv lrglyv
verses.translation: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

verses.original: יְהִי רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑/וֹ וְ֝/אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְ/צַלְעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhy r'b 'nv v'yd nkhvn ltsl'v
verses.translation: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

verses.original: יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑/וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗י/ו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: y'khl bdy 'vrv y'khl bdyv bkhvr mvt
verses.translation: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

verses.original: יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭/אָהֳל/וֹ מִבְטַח֑/וֹ וְ֝/תַצְעִדֵ֗/הוּ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת
verses.translit: yntq m'hlv mbtchv vtts'dhv lmlkh blhvt
verses.translation: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

verses.original: תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭/אָהֳל/וֹ מִ/בְּלִי ל֑/וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל נָוֵ֣/הוּ גָפְרִֽית
verses.translit: tshkhvn b'hlv mbly lv yzrh 'l nvhv gpryt
verses.translation: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

verses.original: מִ֭/תַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣י/ו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝/מִ/מַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mtcht shrshyv ybshv vmm'l yml qtsyrv
verses.translation: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

verses.original: זִֽכְר/וֹ אָ֭בַד מִנִּי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לֹא שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗/וֹ עַל פְּנֵי חֽוּץ
verses.translit: zkhrv 'bd mny 'rts vl' shm lv 'l pny chvts
verses.translation: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

verses.original: יֶ֭הְדְּפֻ/הוּ מֵ/א֣וֹר אֶל חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽ/מִ/תֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: yhdphv m'vr 'l chshkh vmtbl yndhv
verses.translation: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.original: לֹ֘א נִ֤ין ל֣/וֹ וְ/לֹא נֶ֣כֶד בְּ/עַמּ֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּ/מְגוּרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' nyn lv vl' nkhd b'mv v'yn shryd bmgvryv
verses.translation: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

verses.original: עַל י֭וֹמ/וֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝/קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר
verses.translit: 'l yvmv nshmv 'chrnym vqdmnym 'chzv sh'r
verses.translation: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

verses.original: אַךְ אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝/זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹא יָדַֽע אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'kh 'lh mshkhnvt 'vl vzh mqvm l' yd' 'l
verses.translation: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said,

verses.original: עַד אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּ/ן נַפְשִׁ֑/י וּֽ/תְדַכְּאוּ/נַ֥נִי בְ/מִלִּֽים
verses.translit: 'd 'nh tvgyvn npshy vtdkh'vnny bmlym
verses.translation: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

verses.original: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּ/נִי לֹֽא תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: zh 'shr p'mym tkhlymvny l' tbshv thkhrv ly
verses.translation: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

verses.original: וְ/אַף אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗/י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'f 'mnm shgyty 'ty tlyn mshvgty
verses.translation: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

verses.original: אִם אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣/י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְ/תוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗/י חֶרְפָּתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm 'mnm 'ly tgdylv vtvkhychv 'ly chrpty
verses.translation: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

verses.original: דְּֽעוּ אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑/נִי וּ֝/מְצוּד֗/וֹ עָלַ֥/י הִקִּֽיף
verses.translit: d'v 'pv khy 'lvh 'vtny vmtsvdv 'ly hqyf
verses.translation: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְ/לֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְ/אֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: hn 'ts'q chms vl' ''nh 'shv' v'yn mshpt
verses.translation: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

verses.original: אָרְחִ֣/י גָ֭דַר וְ/לֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְ/עַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗/י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: 'rchy gdr vl' ''bvr v'l ntybvty chshkh yshym
verses.translation: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

verses.original: כְּ֭בוֹדִ/י מֵ/עָלַ֣/י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝/יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: khbvdy m'ly hpshyt vysr 'trt r'shy
verses.translation: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

verses.original: יִתְּצֵ֣/נִי סָ֭בִיב וָ/אֵלַ֑ךְ וַ/יַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝/עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: yttsny sbyb v'lkh vys' kh'ts tqvty
verses.translation: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣/י אַפּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּחְשְׁבֵ֖/נִי ל֣/וֹ כְ/צָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vychr 'ly 'pv vychshbny lv khtsryv
verses.translation: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

verses.original: יַ֤חַד יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗י/ו וַ/יָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣/י דַּרְכָּ֑/ם וַ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְ/אָהֳלִֽ/י
verses.translit: ychd yb'v gdvdyv vyslv 'ly drkhm vychnv sbyb l'hly
verses.translation: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

verses.original: אַ֭חַ/י מֵ/עָלַ֣/י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝/יֹדְעַ֗/י אַךְ זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: 'chy m'ly hrchyq vyd'y 'kh zrv mmny
verses.translation: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

verses.original: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑/י וּֽ/מְיֻדָּעַ֥/י שְׁכֵחֽוּ/נִי
verses.translit: chdlv qrvby vmyd'y shkhchvny
verses.translation: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

verses.original: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣/י וְ֭/אַמְהֹתַ/י לְ/זָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑/נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: gry byty v'mhty lzr tchshbny nkhry hyyty b'ynyhm
verses.translation: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

verses.original: לְ/עַבְדִּ֣/י קָ֭רָאתִי וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ פִ֝֗/י אֶתְחַנֶּן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'bdy qr'ty vl' y'nh bmv py 'tchnn lv
verses.translation: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

verses.original: ר֭וּחִֽ/י זָ֣רָה לְ/אִשְׁתִּ֑/י וְ֝/חַנֹּתִ֗י לִ/בְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: rvchy zrh l'shty vchnty lbny btny
verses.translation: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.

verses.original: גַּם עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑/י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַ/יְדַבְּרוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: gm 'vylym m'sv by 'qvmh vydbrv by
verses.translation: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

verses.original: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּ/נִי כָּל מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑/י וְ/זֶֽה אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: t'bvny khl mty svdy vzh 'hbty nhpkhv by
verses.translation: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

verses.original: בְּ/עוֹרִ֣/י וּ֭/בִ/בְשָׂרִ/י דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑/י וָ֝/אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗/ה בְּ/ע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽ/י
verses.translit: b'vry vbbshry dbqh 'tsmy v'tmlth b'vr shny
verses.translation: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

verses.original: חָנֻּ֬/נִי חָנֻּ֣/נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑/י כִּ֥י יַד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: chnny chnny 'tm r'y khy yd 'lvh ng'h by
verses.translation: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

verses.original: לָ֭/מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣/נִי כְמוֹ אֵ֑ל וּ֝/מִ/בְּשָׂרִ֗/י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: lmh trdpny khmv 'l vmbshry l' tshb'v
verses.translation: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

verses.original: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְ/יִכָּתְב֣וּ/ן מִלָּ֑/י מִֽי יִתֵּ֖ן בַּ/סֵּ֣פֶר וְ/יֻחָֽקוּ
verses.translit: my ytn 'pv vykhtbvn mly my ytn bspr vychqv
verses.translation: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

verses.original: בְּ/עֵט בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְ/עֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝/עַ֗ד בַּ/צּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: b't brzl v'prt l'd btsvr ychtsbvn
verses.translation: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִ/י חָ֑י וְ֝/אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: v'ny yd'ty g'ly chy v'chrvn 'l 'pr yqvm
verses.translation: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽ/י נִקְּפוּ זֹ֑את וּ֝/מִ/בְּשָׂרִ֗/י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ
verses.translit: v'chr 'vry nqpv z't vmbshry 'chzh 'lvh
verses.translation: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י אֶֽחֱזֶה לִּ֗/י וְ/עֵינַ֣/י רָא֣וּ וְ/לֹא זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣/י בְּ/חֵקִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shr 'ny 'chzh ly v'yny r'v vl' zr khlv khlyty bchqy
verses.translation: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

verses.original: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה נִּרְדָּף ל֑/וֹ וְ/שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא בִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy t'mrv mh nrdf lv vshrsh dbr nmts' by
verses.translation: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

verses.original: גּ֤וּרוּ לָ/כֶ֨ם מִ/פְּנֵי חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּ/ן ש/דין שַׁ/דּֽוּן
verses.translit: gvrv lkhm mpny chrb khy chmh 'vnvt chrb lm'n td'vn shdyn shdvn
verses.translation: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַ/נַּֽעֲמָתִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n tspr hn'mty vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

verses.original: לָ֭/כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣/י יְשִׁיב֑וּ/נִי וּ֝/בַ/עֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁ/י בִֽ/י
verses.translit: lkhn sh'py yshybvny vb'bvr chvshy by
verses.translation: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣/י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝/ר֗וּחַ מִֽ/בִּינָתִ֥/י יַעֲנֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mvsr khlmty 'shm' vrvch mbynty y'nny
verses.translation: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

verses.original: הֲ/זֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hz't yd't mny 'd mny shym 'dm 'ly 'rts
verses.translation: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

verses.original: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִ/קָּר֑וֹב וְ/שִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי רָֽגַע
verses.translit: khy rnnt rsh'ym mqrvb vshmcht chnf 'dy rg'
verses.translation: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

verses.original: אִם יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑/וֹ וְ֝/רֹאשׁ֗/וֹ לָ/עָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ
verses.translit: 'm y'lh lshmym shy'v vr'shv l'b ygy'
verses.translation: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

verses.original: כְּֽ֭/גֶלֲל/וֹ לָ/נֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗י/ו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khgllv lntsch y'bd r'yv y'mrv 'yv
verses.translation: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

verses.original: כַּ/חֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְ/לֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּ/הוּ וְ֝/יֻדַּ֗ד כְּ/חֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: khchlvm y'vf vl' ymts'vhv vydd khchzyvn lylh
verses.translation: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

verses.original: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּ/וּ וְ/לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְ/לֹא ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥/נּוּ מְקוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'yn shzptv vl' tvsyf vl' 'vd tshvrnv mqvmv
verses.translation: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

verses.original: בָּ֭נָי/ו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝/יָדָ֗י/ו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bnyv yrtsv dlym vydyv tshbnh 'vnv
verses.translation: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

verses.original: עַ֭צְמוֹתָי/ו מָלְא֣וּ עלומ/ו עֲלוּמָ֑י/ו וְ֝/עִמּ֗/וֹ עַל עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: 'tsmvtyv ml'v 'lvmv 'lvmyv v'mv 'l 'pr tshkhb
verses.translation: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

verses.original: אִם תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּ/פִ֣י/ו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗/נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm tmtyq bpyv r'h ykhchydnh tcht lshvnv
verses.translation: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

verses.original: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶי/הָ וְ/לֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑/נָּה וְ֝/יִמְנָעֶ֗/נָּה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ychml 'lyh vl' y'zbnh vymn'nh btvkh chkhv
verses.translation: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

verses.original: לַ֭חְמ/וֹ בְּ/מֵעָ֣י/ו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lchmv bm'yv nhpkh mrvrt ptnym bqrbv
verses.translation: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

verses.original: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַ/יְקִאֶ֑/נּוּ מִ֝/בִּטְנ֗/וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥/נּוּ אֵֽל
verses.translit: chyl bl' vyq'nv mbtnv yvrshnv 'l
verses.translation: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

verses.original: רֹאשׁ פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗/הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה
verses.translit: r'sh ptnym yynq thrghv lshvn 'p'h
verses.translation: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

verses.original: אַל יֵ֥רֶא בִ/פְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְ/חֶמְאָֽה
verses.translit: 'l yr' bplgvt nhry nchly dbsh vchm'h
verses.translation: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְ/לֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּ/חֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס
verses.translit: mshyb yg' vl' ybl' khchyl tmvrtv vl' y'ls
verses.translation: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .

verses.original: כִּֽי רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְ/לֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: khy rtsts 'zb dlym byt gzl vl' ybnhv
verses.translation: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּ/בִטְנ֑/וֹ בַּ֝/חֲמוּד֗/וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט
verses.translit: khy l' yd' shlv bbtnv bchmvdv l' ymlt
verses.translation: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

verses.original: אֵין שָׂרִ֥יד לְ/אָכְל֑/וֹ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'yn shryd l'khlv 'l khn l' ychyl tvbv
verses.translation: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

verses.original: בִּ/מְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְק/וֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑/וֹ כָּל יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: bml'vt shpqv ytsr lv khl yd 'ml tbv'nv
verses.translation: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

verses.original: יְהִ֤י לְ/מַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗/וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח בּ֭/וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑/וֹ וְ/יַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗י/מוֹ בִּ/לְחוּמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhy lml' btnv yshlch bv chrvn 'pv vymtr 'lymv blchvmv
verses.translation: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

verses.original: יִ֭בְרַח מִ/נֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗/הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: ybrch mnshq brzl tchlphv qsht nchvshh
verses.translation: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

verses.original: שָׁלַף֮ וַ/יֵּצֵ֪א מִ/גֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭/בָרָק מִֽ/מְּרֹרָת֥/וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥י/ו אֵמִֽים
verses.translit: shlf vyts' mgvh vbrq mmrrtv yhlkh 'lyv 'mym
verses.translation: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

verses.original: כָּל חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִ/צְפּ֫וּנָ֥י/ו תְּ֭אָכְלֵ/הוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּ/אָהֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl chshkh tmvn ltspvnyv t'khlhv 'sh l' npch yr' shryd b'hlv
verses.translation: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

verses.original: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑/וֹ וְ֝/אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yglv shmym 'vnv v'rts mtqvmmh lv
verses.translation: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

verses.original: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑/וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּ/י֣וֹם אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ygl ybvl bytv ngrvt byvm 'pv
verses.translation: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/נַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣/וֹ מֵ/אֵֽל
verses.translit: zh chlq 'dm rsh' m'lhym vnchlt 'mrv m'l
verses.translation: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: But Job answered and said,

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑/י וּ/תְהִי זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shm'v shmv' mlty vthy z't tnchvmtykhm
verses.translation: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

verses.original: שָׂ֭אוּ/נִי וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְ/אַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣/י תַלְעִֽיג
verses.translit: sh'vny v'nkhy 'dbr v'chr dbry tl'yg
verses.translation: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

verses.original: הֶ֭/אָנֹכִי לְ/אָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑/י וְ/אִם מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽ/י
verses.translit: h'nkhy l'dm shychy v'm mdv' l' tqtsr rvchy
verses.translation: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled?

verses.original: פְּנוּ אֵלַ֥/י וְ/הָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְ/שִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל פֶּֽה
verses.translit: pnv 'ly vhshmv vshymv yd 'l ph
verses.translation: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.original: וְ/אִם זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְ/נִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְ/אָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗/י פַּלָּצֽוּת
verses.translit: v'm zkhrty vnbhlty v'chz bshry pltsvt
verses.translation: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

verses.original: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל
verses.translit: mdv' rsh'ym ychyv 'tqv gm gbrv chyl
verses.translation: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

verses.original: זַרְעָ֤/ם נָכ֣וֹן לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑/ם וְ֝/צֶאֱצָאֵי/הֶ֗ם לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: zr'm nkhvn lpnyhm 'mm vts'ts'yhm l'ynyhm
verses.translation: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

verses.original: בָּתֵּי/הֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִ/פָּ֑חַד וְ/לֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: btyhm shlvm mpchd vl' shbt 'lvh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

verses.original: שׁוֹר֣/וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְ/לֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל
verses.translit: shvrv 'br vl' yg'l tplt prtv vl' tshkhl
verses.translation: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭/צֹּאן עֲוִילֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ֝/יַלְדֵי/הֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: yshlchv khts'n 'vylyhm vyldyhm yrqdvn
verses.translation: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּ/תֹ֣ף וְ/כִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝/יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְ/ק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב
verses.translit: ysh'v khtf vkhnvr vyshmchv lqvl 'vgb
verses.translation: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

verses.original: יבלו יְכַלּ֣וּ בַ/טּ֣וֹב יְמֵי/הֶ֑ם וּ֝/בְ/רֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ
verses.translit: yblv ykhlv btvb ymyhm vbrg' sh'vl ychtv
verses.translation: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭/אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/דַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗י/ךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv l'l svr mmnv vd't drkhykh l' chptsnv
verses.translation: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

verses.original: מַה שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי נַֽעַבְדֶ֑/נּוּ וּ/מַה נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mh shdy khy n'bdnv vmh nv'yl khy npg' bv
verses.translation: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְ/יָדָ֣/ם טוּבָ֑/ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: hn l' bydm tvbm 'tst rsh'ym rchqh mny
verses.translation: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.original: כַּ/מָּ֤ה נֵר רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְ/יָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣י/מוֹ אֵידָ֑/ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּ/אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khmh nr rsh'ym yd'kh vyb' 'lymv 'ydm chblym ychlq b'pv
verses.translation: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

verses.original: יִהְי֗וּ כְּ/תֶ֥בֶן לִ/פְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּ֝/כְ/מֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּ/וּ סוּפָֽה
verses.translit: yhyv khtbn lpny rvch vkhmts gnbtv svph
verses.translation: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

verses.original: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן לְ/בָנָ֥י/ו אוֹנ֑/וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣י/ו וְ/יֵדָֽע
verses.translit: 'lvh ytspn lbnyv 'vnv yshlm 'lyv vyd'
verses.translation: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it .

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ עינ/ו עֵינָ֣י/ו כִּיד֑/וֹ וּ/מֵ/חֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: yr'v 'ynv 'ynyv khydv vmchmt shdy yshth
verses.translation: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה חֶפְצ֣/וֹ בְּ/בֵית֣/וֹ אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וּ/מִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣י/ו חֻצָּֽצוּ
verses.translit: khy mh chptsv bbytv 'chryv vmspr chdshyv chtstsv
verses.translation: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

verses.original: הַ/לְ/אֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד דָּ֑עַת וְ֝/ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט
verses.translit: hl'l ylmd d't vhv' rmym yshpvt
verses.translation: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

verses.original: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּ/עֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑/וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗/וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְ/שָׁלֵֽיו
verses.translit: zh ymvt b'tsm tmv khlv shl'nn vshlyv
verses.translation: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

verses.original: עֲ֭טִינָי/ו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּ/מֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣י/ו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'tynyv ml'v chlb vmch 'tsmvtyv yshqh
verses.translation: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּ/טּוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vzh ymvt bnpsh mrh vl' 'khl btvbh
verses.translation: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

verses.original: יַ֭חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝/רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: ychd 'l 'pr yshkhbv vrmh tkhsh 'lyhm
verses.translation: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ֝/מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥/י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ
verses.translit: hn yd'ty mchshbvtykhm vmzmvt 'ly tchmsv
verses.translation: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית נָדִ֑יב וְ֝/אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: khy t'mrv 'yh byt ndyb v'yh 'hl mshkhnvt rsh'ym
verses.translation: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝/אֹתֹתָ֗/ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: hl' sh'ltm 'vbry drkh v'ttm l' tnkhrv
verses.translation: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

verses.original: כִּ֤י לְ/י֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְ/י֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ
verses.translit: khy lyvm 'yd ychshkh r' lyvm 'brvt yvblv
verses.translation: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

verses.original: מִֽי יַגִּ֣יד עַל פָּנָ֣י/ו דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וְ/הֽוּא עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my ygyd 'l pnyv drkhv vhv' 'shh my yshlm lv
verses.translation: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

verses.original: וְ֭/הוּא לִ/קְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽ/עַל גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhv' lqbrvt yvbl v'l gdysh yshqvd
verses.translation: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

verses.original: מָֽתְקוּ ל֗/וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭/אַחֲרָי/ו כָּל אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝/לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: mtqv lv rgby nchl v'chryv khl 'dm ymshvkh vlpnyv 'yn mspr
verses.translation: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

verses.original: וְ֭/אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּ/נִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝/תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר מָֽעַל
verses.translit: v'ykh tnchmvny hbl vtshvbtykhm nsh'r m'l
verses.translation: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽ/תֵּמָנִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'lypz htmny vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.original: הַ/לְ/אֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣י/מוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל
verses.translit: hl'l yskhn gbr khy yskhn 'lymv mshkhyl
verses.translation: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

verses.original: הַ/חֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭/שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְ/אִם בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hchpts lshdy khy ttsdq v'm bts' khy ttm drkhykh
verses.translation: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him , that thou makest thy ways perfect?

verses.translit: hmyr'tkh ykhychkh ybv' 'mkh bmshpt
verses.translation: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֣א רָעָֽתְ/ךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְ/אֵֽין קֵ֝֗ץ לַ/עֲוֺנֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hl' r'tkh rbh v'yn qts l'vntykh
verses.translation: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

verses.original: כִּֽי תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣י/ךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּ/בִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט
verses.translit: khy tchbl 'chykh chnm vbgdy 'rvmym tpshyt
verses.translation: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.original: לֹא מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝/מֵ/רָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: l' mym 'yf tshqh vmr'b tmn' lchm
verses.translation: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣/וֹ הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/נְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'ysh zrv' lv h'rts vnshv' pnym yshb bh
verses.translation: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

verses.original: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּ/זְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא
verses.translit: 'lmnvt shlcht ryqm vzr'vt ytmym ydkh'
verses.translation: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣י/ךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝/יבַהֶלְ/ךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם
verses.translit: 'l khn sbybvtykh pchym vybhlkh pchd pt'm
verses.translation: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

verses.original: אוֹ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽ/שִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'v chshkh l' tr'h vshp't mym tkhskh
verses.translation: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

verses.original: הֲֽ/לֹא אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּ/רְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי רָֽמּוּ
verses.translit: hl' 'lvh gbh shmym vr'h r'sh khvkhbym khy rmv
verses.translation: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.original: וְֽ֭/אָמַרְתָּ מַה יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַ/בְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט
verses.translit: v'mrt mh yd' 'l hb'd 'rpl yshpvt
verses.translation: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

verses.original: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר ל֭/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ/ח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ
verses.translit: 'bym str lv vl' yr'h vchvg shmym ythlkh
verses.translation: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

verses.original: הַ/אֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: h'rch 'vlm tshmr 'shr drkhv mty 'vn
verses.translation: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר קֻמְּט֥וּ וְ/לֹא עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr qmtv vl' 't nhr yvtsq ysvdm
verses.translation: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

verses.original: הָ/אֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭/אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וּ/מַה יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: h'mrym l'l svr mmnv vmh yp'l shdy lmv
verses.translation: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

verses.original: וְ/ה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּי/הֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַ/עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: vhv' ml' btyhm tvb v'tst rsh'ym rchqh mny
verses.translation: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְ/יִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝/נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: yr'v tsdyqym vyshmchv vnqy yl'g lmv
verses.translation: The righteous see it , and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑/נוּ וְ֝/יִתְרָ֗/ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'm l' nkhchd qymnv vytrm 'khlh 'sh
verses.translation: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

verses.original: הַסְכֶּן נָ֣א עִמּ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁלם בָּ֝/הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְ/ךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: hskhn n' 'mv vshlm bhm tbv'tkh tvbh
verses.translation: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

verses.original: קַח נָ֣א מִ/פִּ֣י/ו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְ/שִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗י/ו בִּ/לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qch n' mpyv tvrh vshym 'mryv blbbkh
verses.translation: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

verses.original: אִם תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵ/אָהֳלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm tshvb 'd shdy tbnh trchyq 'vlh m'hlkh
verses.translation: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁית עַל עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּ/בְ/צ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר
verses.translit: vshyt 'l 'pr btsr vbtsvr nchlym 'vpyr
verses.translation: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/כֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh shdy btsrykh vkhsf tv'pvt lkh
verses.translation: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

verses.original: כִּי אָ֭ז עַל שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְ/תִשָּׂ֖א אֶל אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'z 'l shdy tt'ng vtsh' 'l 'lvh pnykh
verses.translation: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

verses.original: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָי/ו וְ/יִשְׁמָעֶ֑/ךָּ וּ/נְדָרֶ֥י/ךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: t'tyr 'lyv vyshm'kh vndrykh tshlm
verses.translation: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

verses.original: וְֽ/תִגְזַר א֭וֹמֶר וְ/יָ֣קָם לָ֑/ךְ וְ/עַל דְּ֝רָכֶ֗י/ךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר
verses.translit: vtgzr 'vmr vyqm lkh v'l drkhykh ngh 'vr
verses.translation: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְ/שַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ
verses.translit: khy hshpylv vt'mr gvh vshch 'ynym yvsh'
verses.translation: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

verses.original: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי נָקִ֑י וְ֝/נִמְלַ֗ט בְּ/בֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ymlt 'y nqy vnmlt bbr khpykh
verses.translation: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered and said,

verses.original: גַּם הַ֭/יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑/י יָ֝דִ֗/י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל אַנְחָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: gm hyvm mry shchy ydy khbdh 'l 'nchty
verses.translation: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

verses.original: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְ/אֶמְצָאֵ֑/הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד תְּכוּנָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my ytn yd'ty v'mts'hv 'bv' 'd tkhvntv
verses.translation: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

verses.original: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝/פִ֗/י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: ''rkhh lpnyv mshpt vpy 'ml' tvkhchvt
verses.translation: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.original: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑/נִי וְ֝/אָבִ֗ינָה מַה יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'd'h mlym y'nny v'bynh mh y'mr ly
verses.translation: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

verses.original: הַ/בְּ/רָב כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑/י לֹ֥א אַךְ ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: hbrb khch yryb 'mdy l' 'kh hv' yshm by
verses.translation: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

verses.original: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/אֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝/נֶ֗צַח מִ/שֹּׁפְטִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm yshr nvkhch 'mv v'plth lntsch mshpty
verses.translation: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְ/אֵינֶ֑/נּוּ וְ֝/אָח֗וֹר וְֽ/לֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hn qdm 'hlkh v'ynnv v'chvr vl' 'byn lv
verses.translation: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

verses.original: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּ/עֲשֹׂת֣/וֹ וְ/לֹא אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְ/לֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: shm'vl b'shtv vl' 'chz y'tf ymyn vl' 'r'h
verses.translation: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

verses.original: כִּֽי יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑/י בְּ֝חָנַ֗/נִי כַּ/זָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: khy yd' drkh 'mdy bchnny khzhb 'ts'
verses.translation: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

verses.original: בַּ֭/אֲשֻׁר/וֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑/י דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְ/לֹא אָֽט
verses.translit: b'shrv 'chzh rgly drkhv shmrty vl' 't
verses.translation: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

verses.original: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָי/ו וְ/לֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝/חֻקִּ֗/י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי פִֽי/ו
verses.translit: mtsvt shptyv vl' 'mysh mchqy tspnty 'mry pyv
verses.translation: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .

verses.original: וְ/ה֣וּא בְ֭/אֶחָד וּ/מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַ/יָּֽעַשׂ
verses.translit: vhv' b'chd vmy yshybnv vnpshv 'vth vy'sh
verses.translation: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

verses.original: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑/י וְ/כָ/הֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy yshlym chqy vkhhnh rbvt 'mv
verses.translation: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֭ן מִ/פָּנָ֣י/ו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְ/אֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'l khn mpnyv 'bhl 'tbvnn v'pchd mmnv
verses.translation: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

verses.original: וְ֭/אֵל הֵרַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑/י וְ֝/שַׁדַּ֗י הִבְהִילָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'l hrkh lby vshdy hbhylny
verses.translation: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

verses.original: כִּֽי לֹ֣א נִ֭צְמַתִּי מִ/פְּנֵי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּ֝/מִ/פָּנַ֗/י כִּסָּה אֹֽפֶל
verses.translit: khy l' ntsmty mpny chshkh vmpny khsh 'pl
verses.translation: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

verses.original: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭/שַּׁדַּי לֹא נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים ו/ידע/ו וְ֝/יֹדְעָ֗י/ו לֹא חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: mdv' mshdy l' ntspnv 'tym vyd'v vyd'yv l' chzv ymyv
verses.translation: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

verses.original: גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַ/יִּרְעֽוּ
verses.translit: gblvt yshygv 'dr gzlv vyr'v
verses.translation: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof .

verses.original: חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה
verses.translit: chmvr ytvmym ynhgv ychblv shvr 'lmnh
verses.translation: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

verses.original: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִ/דָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ytv 'byvnym mdrkh ychd chb'v 'nyy 'rts
verses.translation: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים בַּֽ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭/פָעֳלָ/ם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַ/טָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥/וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַ/נְּעָרִֽים
verses.translit: hn pr'ym bmdbr yts'v bp'lm mshchry ltrf 'rbh lv lchm ln'rym
verses.translation: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

verses.original: בַּ֭/שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣/וֹ יקצירו יִקְצ֑וֹרוּ וְ/כֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: bshdh blylv yqtsyrv yqtsvrv vkhrm rsh' ylqshv
verses.translation: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִ/בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְ/אֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּ/קָּרָֽה
verses.translit: 'rvm ylynv mbly lbvsh v'yn khsvt bqrh
verses.translation: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

verses.original: מִ/זֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽ/מִ/בְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ צֽוּר
verses.translit: mzrm hrym yrtbv vmbly mchsh chbqv tsvr
verses.translation: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

verses.original: יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִ/שֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽ/עַל עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ
verses.translit: ygzlv mshd ytvm v'l 'ny ychblv
verses.translation: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝/רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר
verses.translit: 'rvm hlkhv bly lbvsh vr'bym nsh'v 'mr
verses.translation: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

verses.original: בֵּין שׁוּרֹתָ֥/ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַ/יִּצְמָֽאוּ
verses.translit: byn shvrtm ytshyrv yqbym drkhv vytsm'v
verses.translation: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

verses.original: מֵ֘/עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְ/נֶֽפֶשׁ חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝/אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה
verses.translit: m'yr mtym yn'qv vnpsh chllym tshv' v'lvh l' yshym tplh
verses.translation: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them .

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה הָיוּ֮ בְּֽ/מֹרְדֵ֫י א֥וֹר לֹֽא הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּ/נְתִיבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hmh hyv bmrdy 'vr l' hkhyrv drkhyv vl' yshbv bntybtyv
verses.translation: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

verses.original: לָ/א֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל עָנִ֥י וְ/אֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝/בַ/לַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַ/גַּנָּֽב
verses.translit: l'vr yqvm rvtsch yqtl 'ny v'byvn vblylh yhy khgnb
verses.translation: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

verses.original: וְ/עֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭/אמֹר לֹא תְשׁוּרֵ֣/נִי עָ֑יִן וְ/סֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: v'yn n'f shmrh nshf l'mr l' tshvrny 'yn vstr pnym yshym
verses.translation: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

verses.original: חָתַ֥ר בַּ/חֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ לָ֗/מוֹ לֹא יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר
verses.translit: chtr bchshkh btym yvmm chtmv lmv l' yd'v 'vr
verses.translation: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣/מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת
verses.translit: khy ychdv bqr lmv tslmvt khy ykhyr blhvt tslmvt
verses.translation: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

verses.original: קַֽל ה֤וּא עַל פְּנֵי מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣/ם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים
verses.translit: ql hv' 'l pny mym tqll chlqtm b'rts l' ypnh drkh khrmym
verses.translation: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

verses.original: צִיָּ֤ה גַם חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ
verses.translit: tsyh gm chm ygzlv mymy shlg sh'vl cht'v
verses.translation: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

verses.original: יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤/הוּ רֶ֨חֶם מְתָ֘ק֤/וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַ/תִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּ/עֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: yshkhchhv rchm mtqv rmh 'vd l' yzkhr vtshbr kh'ts 'vlh
verses.translation: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝/אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב
verses.translit: r'h 'qrh l' tld v'lmnh l' yytyb
verses.translation: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּ/כֹח֑/וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽ/לֹא יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽ/חַיִּֽין
verses.translit: vmshkh 'byrym bkhchv yqvm vl' y'myn bchyyn
verses.translation: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

verses.original: יִתֶּן ל֣/וֹ לָ֭/בֶטַח וְ/יִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝/עֵינֵ֗י/הוּ עַל דַּרְכֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: ytn lv lbtch vysh'n v'ynyhv 'l drkhyhm
verses.translation: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

verses.original: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט וְֽ/אֵינֶ֗/נּוּ וְֽ/הֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּ/כֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּ/ן וּ/כְ/רֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: rvmv m't v'ynnv vhmkhv khkhl yqptsvn vkhr'sh shblt ymlv
verses.translation: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other , and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑/נִי וְ/יָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝/אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'm l' 'pv my ykhzybny vyshm l'l mlty
verses.translation: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

verses.original: וַ֭/יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַ/שֻּׁחִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n bldd hshchy vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.original: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָ/פַ֣חַד עִמּ֑/וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּ/מְרוֹמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hmshl vpchd 'mv 'shh shlvm bmrvmyv
verses.translation: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

verses.original: הֲ/יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִ/גְדוּדָ֑י/ו וְ/עַל מִ֝֗י לֹא יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: hysh mspr lgdvdyv v'l my l' yqvm 'vrhv
verses.translation: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

verses.original: וּ/מַה יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵ֑ל וּ/מַה יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vmh ytsdq 'nvsh 'm 'l vmh yzkhh ylvd 'shh
verses.translation: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן עַד יָ֭רֵחַ וְ/לֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝/כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hn 'd yrch vl' y'hyl vkhvkhbym l' zkhv b'ynyv
verses.translation: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּ/בֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה
verses.translit: 'f khy 'nvsh rmh vbn 'dm tvl'h
verses.translation: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: But Job answered and said,

verses.original: מֶה עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְ/לֹא כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא עֹֽז
verses.translit: mh 'zrt ll' khch hvsh't zrv' l' 'z
verses.translation: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

verses.original: מַה יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְ/לֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝/תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָ/רֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: mh y'tst ll' chkhmh vtvshyh lrb hvd't
verses.translation: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

verses.original: אֶת מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְ/נִשְׁמַת מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 't my hgdt mlyn vnshmt my yts'h mmkh
verses.translation: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

verses.original: הָ/רְפָאִ֥ים יְחוֹלָ֑לוּ מִ/תַּ֥חַת מַ֝֗יִם וְ/שֹׁכְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hrp'ym ychvllv mtcht mym vshkhnyhm
verses.translation: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.original: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽ/אֲבַדּֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'rvm sh'vl ngdv v'yn khsvt l'bdvn
verses.translation: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

verses.original: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל בְּלִי מָֽה
verses.translit: nth tspvn 'l thv tlh 'rts 'l bly mh
verses.translation: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

verses.original: צֹרֵֽר מַ֥יִם בְּ/עָבָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹא נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: tsrr mym b'byv vl' nbq' 'nn tchtm
verses.translation: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

verses.original: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣י/ו עֲנָנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: m'chz pny khsh prshz 'lyv 'nnv
verses.translation: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

verses.original: חֹֽק חָ֭ג עַל פְּנֵי מָ֑יִם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: chq chg 'l pny mym 'd tkhlyt 'vr 'm chshkh
verses.translation: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

verses.original: עַמּוּדֵ֣י שָׁמַ֣יִם יְרוֹפָ֑פוּ וְ֝/יִתְמְה֗וּ מִ/גַּעֲרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'mvdy shmym yrvppv vytmhv mg'rtv
verses.translation: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

verses.original: בְּ֭/כֹח/וֹ רָגַ֣ע הַ/יָּ֑ם ו/ב/תובנת/ו וּ֝/בִ/תְבוּנָת֗/וֹ מָ֣חַץ רָֽהַב
verses.translit: bkhchv rg' hym vbtvbntv vbtbvntv mchts rhb
verses.translation: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

verses.original: בְּ֭/רוּח/וֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗/וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ
verses.translit: brvchv shmym shprh chllh ydv nchsh brych
verses.translation: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

verses.original: הֶן אֵ֤לֶּה קְצ֬וֹת דרכ/ו דְּרָכָ֗י/ו וּ/מַה שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע בּ֑/וֹ וְ/רַ֥עַם גבורת/ו גְּ֝בוּרוֹתָ֗י/ו מִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: hn 'lh qtsvt drkhv drkhyv vmh shmts dbr nshm' bv vr'm gbvrtv gbvrvtyv my ytbvnn
verses.translation: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vysf 'yvb sh't mshlv vy'mr
verses.translation: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

verses.original: חַי אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑/י וְ֝/שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: chy 'l hsyr mshpty vshdy hmr npshy
verses.translation: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

verses.original: כִּֽי כָל ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣/י בִ֑/י וְ/ר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּ/אַפִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy khl 'vd nshmty by vrvch 'lvh b'py
verses.translation: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

verses.original: אִם תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣/י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝/לְשׁוֹנִ֗/י אִם יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה
verses.translit: 'm tdbrnh shpty 'vlh vlshvny 'm yhgh rmyh
verses.translation: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

verses.original: חָלִ֣ילָ/ה לִּ/י֮ אִם אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְ/כֶ֥ם עַד אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣/י מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: chlylh ly 'm 'tsdyq 'tkhm 'd 'gv' l' 'syr tmty mmny
verses.translation: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

verses.original: בְּ/צִדְקָתִ֣/י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑/הָ לֹֽא יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗/י מִ/יָּמָֽ/י
verses.translit: btsdqty hchzqty vl' 'rph l' ychrf lbby mymy
verses.translation: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

verses.original: יְהִ֣י כְ֭/רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑/י וּ/מִתְקוֹמְמִ֥/י כְ/עַוָּֽל
verses.translit: yhy khrsh' 'yby vmtqvmmy kh'vl
verses.translation: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy mh tqvt chnf khy ybts' khy yshl 'lvh npshv
verses.translation: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

verses.original: הַֽ֭/צַעֲקָת/וֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל כִּֽי תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣י/ו צָרָֽה
verses.translit: hts'qtv yshm' 'l khy tbv' 'lyv tsrh
verses.translation: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

verses.original: אִם עַל שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּ/כָל עֵֽת
verses.translit: 'm 'l shdy yt'ng yqr' 'lvh bkhl 't
verses.translation: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

verses.original: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֣ם בְּ/יַד אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד
verses.translit: 'vrh 'tkhm byd 'l 'shr 'm shdy l' 'khchd
verses.translation: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

verses.original: הֵן אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּ/כֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְ/לָ/מָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: hn 'tm khlkhm chzytm vlmh zh hbl thblv
verses.translation: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

verses.original: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע עִם אֵ֑ל וְֽ/נַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִ/שַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: zh chlq 'dm rsh' 'm 'l vnchlt 'rytsym mshdy yqchv
verses.translation: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

verses.original: אִם יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣י/ו לְמוֹ חָ֑רֶב וְ֝/צֶאֱצָאָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: 'm yrbv bnyv lmv chrb vts'ts'yv l' yshb'v lchm
verses.translation: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

verses.original: שריד/ו שְׂ֭רִידָי/ו בַּ/מָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝/אַלְמְנֹתָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה
verses.translit: shrydv shrydyv bmvt yqbrv v'lmntyv l' tbkhynh
verses.translation: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

verses.original: אִם יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּ/עָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝/כַ/חֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: 'm ytsbr kh'pr khsf vkhchmr ykhyn mlbvsh
verses.translation: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

verses.original: יָ֭כִין וְ/צַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝/כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק
verses.translit: ykhyn vtsdyq ylbsh vkhsf nqy ychlq
verses.translation: He may prepare it , but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

verses.original: בָּנָ֣ה כָ/עָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑/וֹ וּ֝/כְ/סֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר
verses.translit: bnh kh'sh bytv vkhskhh 'shh ntsr
verses.translation: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְ/לֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖י/ו פָּקַ֣ח וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'shyr yshkhb vl' y'sf 'ynyv pqch v'ynnv
verses.translation: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

verses.original: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣/הוּ כַ֭/מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּ/וּ סוּפָֽה
verses.translit: tshyghv khmym blhvt lylh gnbtv svph
verses.translation: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

verses.original: יִשָּׂאֵ֣/הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְ/יֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝/ישָׂעֲרֵ֗/הוּ מִ/מְּקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ysh'hv qdym vylkh vysh'rhv mmqmv
verses.translation: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

verses.original: וְ/יַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָי/ו וְ/לֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝/יָּד֗/וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח
verses.translit: vyshlkh 'lyv vl' ychml mydv brvch ybrch
verses.translation: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

verses.original: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣י/מוֹ כַפֵּ֑י/מוֹ וְ/יִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗י/ו מִ/מְּקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yshpq 'lymv khpymv vyshrq 'lyv mmqmv
verses.translation: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַ/כֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝/מָק֗וֹם לַ/זָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ
verses.translit: khy ysh lkhsf mvts' vmqvm lzhb yzqv
verses.translation: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it .

verses.original: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵ/עָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝/אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: brzl m'pr yqch v'bn ytsvq nchvshh
verses.translation: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

verses.original: קֵ֤ץ שָׂ֤ם לַ/חֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽ/לְ/כָל תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְ/צַלְמָֽוֶת
verses.translit: qts shm lchshkh vlkhl tkhlyt hv' chvqr 'bn 'pl vtslmvt
verses.translation: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

verses.original: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל מֵֽ/עִם גָּ֗ר הַֽ/נִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵ/אֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ
verses.translit: prts nchl m'm gr hnshkhchym mny rgl dlv m'nvsh n'v
verses.translation: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

verses.original: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥/נָּה יֵֽצֵא לָ֑חֶם וְ֝/תַחְתֶּ֗י/הָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'rts mmnh yts' lchm vtchtyh nhpkh khmv 'sh
verses.translation: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

verses.original: מְקוֹם סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑י/הָ וְ/עַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mqvm spyr 'bnyh v'prt zhb lv
verses.translation: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

verses.original: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא יְדָ֣ע/וֹ עָ֑יִט וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּ/וּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה
verses.translit: ntyb l' yd'v 'yt vl' shzptv 'yn 'yh
verses.translation: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:

verses.original: לֹֽא הִדְרִיכֻ֥/הוּ בְנֵי שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣י/ו שָֽׁחַל
verses.translit: l' hdrykhhv bny shchts l' 'dh 'lyv shchl
verses.translation: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

verses.original: בַּֽ֭/חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑/וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִ/שֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים
verses.translit: bchlmysh shlch ydv hpkh mshrsh hrym
verses.translation: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

verses.original: בַּ֭/צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְ/כָל יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: btsvrvt y'rym bq' vkhl yqr r'th 'ynv
verses.translation: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

verses.original: מִ֭/בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝/תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר
verses.translit: mbkhy nhrvt chbsh vt'lmh yts' 'vr
verses.translation: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/הַ/חָכְמָה מֵ/אַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְ/אֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: vhchkhmh m'yn tmts' v'y zh mqvm bynh
verses.translation: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.original: לֹא יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑/הּ וְ/לֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ/חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: l' yd' 'nvsh 'rkhh vl' tmts' b'rts hchyym
verses.translation: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

verses.original: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִ/י הִ֑יא וְ/יָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: thvm 'mr l' by hy' vym 'mr 'yn 'mdy
verses.translation: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

verses.original: לֹא יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑י/הָ וְ/לֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: l' ytn sgvr tchtyh vl' yshql khsf mchyrh
verses.translation: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

verses.original: לֹֽא תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּ/כֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּ/שֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְ/סַפִּֽיר
verses.translit: l' tslh bkhtm 'vpyr bshhm yqr vspyr
verses.translation: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

verses.original: לֹא יַעַרְכֶ֣/נָּה זָ֭הָב וּ/זְכוֹכִ֑ית וּ/תְמ֖וּרָתָ֣/הּ כְּלִי פָֽז
verses.translit: l' y'rkhnh zhb vzkhvkhyt vtmvrth khly pz
verses.translation: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭/גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּ/מֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִ/פְּנִינִֽים
verses.translit: r'mvt vgbysh l' yzkhr vmshkh chkhmh mpnynym
verses.translation: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

verses.original: לֹֽא יַ֭עַרְכֶ/נָּה פִּטְדַת כּ֑וּשׁ בְּ/כֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה
verses.translit: l' y'rkhnh ptdt khvsh bkhtm thvr l' tslh
verses.translation: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

verses.original: וְֽ֭/הַ/חָכְמָה מֵ/אַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְ/אֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: vhchkhmh m'yn tbv' v'y zh mqvm bynh
verses.translation: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.original: וְֽ֭/נֶעֶלְמָה מֵ/עֵינֵ֣י כָל חָ֑י וּ/מֵ/ע֖וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה
verses.translit: vn'lmh m'yny khl chy vm'vf hshmym nstrh
verses.translation: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

verses.original: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭/מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝/אָזְנֵ֗י/נוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'bdvn vmvt 'mrv b'znynv shm'nv shm'h
verses.translation: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑/הּ וְ֝/ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת מְקוֹמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'lhym hbyn drkhh vhv' yd' 't mqvmh
verses.translation: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

verses.original: כִּי ה֭וּא לִ/קְצוֹת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: khy hv' lqtsvt h'rts ybyt tcht khl hshmym yr'h
verses.translation: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

verses.original: לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ/ר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝/מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּ/מִדָּֽה
verses.translit: l'shvt lrvch mshql vmym tkhn bmdh
verses.translation: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲשֹׂת֣/וֹ לַ/מָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝/דֶ֗רֶךְ לַ/חֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: b'shtv lmtr chq vdrkh lchzyz qlvt
verses.translation: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

verses.original: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָ/הּ וַֽ/יְסַפְּרָ֑/הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗/הּ וְ/גַם חֲקָרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'z r'h vysprh hkhynh vgm chqrh
verses.translation: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָֽ/אָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָ/י הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/ס֖וּר מֵ/רָ֣ע בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr l'dm hn yr't 'dny hy' chkhmh vsvr mr' bynh
verses.translation: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vysf 'yvb sh't mshlv vy'mr
verses.translation: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

verses.original: מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֥/נִי כְ/יַרְחֵי קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝/ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: my ytnny khyrchy qdm khymy 'lvh yshmrny
verses.translation: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

verses.original: בְּ/הִלּ֣/וֹ נֵ֭ר/וֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑/י לְ֝/אוֹר/וֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: bhlv nrv 'ly r'shy l'vrv 'lkh chshkh
verses.translation: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּ/ימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑/י בְּ/ס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽ/י
verses.translit: kh'shr hyyty bymy chrpy bsvd 'lvh 'ly 'hly
verses.translation: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

verses.original: בְּ/ע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑/י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣/י נְעָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: b'vd shdy 'mdy sbybvty n'ry
verses.translation: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

verses.original: בִּ/רְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣/י בְּ/חֵמָ֑ה וְ/צ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗/י פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: brchts hlykhy bchmh vtsvr ytsvq 'mdy plgy shmn
verses.translation: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

verses.original: בְּ/צֵ֣אתִ/י שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝/רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽ/י
verses.translit: bts'ty sh'r 'ly qrt brchvb 'khyn mvshby
