verses.translation: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

verses.original: רָא֣וּ/נִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְ/נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝/ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ
verses.translit: r'vny n'rym vnchb'v vyshyshym qmv 'mdv
verses.translation: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

verses.original: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְ/מִלִּ֑ים וְ֝/כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְ/פִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shrym 'tsrv bmlym vkhf yshymv lpyhm
verses.translation: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

verses.original: קוֹל נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝/לְשׁוֹנָ֗/ם לְ/חִכָּ֥/ם דָּבֵֽקָה
verses.translit: qvl ngydym nchb'v vlshvnm lchkhm dbqh
verses.translation: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽ/תְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑/נִי וְ/עַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַ/תְּעִידֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy 'zn shm'h vt'shrny v'yn r'th vt'ydny
verses.translation: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me:

verses.original: כִּֽי אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝/יָת֗וֹם וְֽ/לֹא עֹזֵ֥ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'mlt 'ny mshv' vytvm vl' 'zr lv
verses.translation: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

verses.original: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣/י תָּבֹ֑א וְ/לֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן
verses.translit: brkht 'bd 'ly tb' vlb 'lmnh 'rnn
verses.translation: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

verses.original: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַ/יִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑/נִי כִּֽ/מְעִ֥יל וְ֝/צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽ/י
verses.translit: tsdq lbshty vylbshny khm'yl vtsnyf mshpty
verses.translation: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

verses.original: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽ/עִוֵּ֑ר וְ/רַגְלַ֖יִם לַ/פִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי
verses.translit: 'ynym hyyty l'vr vrglym lpsch 'ny
verses.translation: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

verses.original: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽ/אֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְ/רִ֖ב לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'b 'nkhy l'byvnym vrb l' yd'ty 'chqrhv
verses.translation: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

verses.original: וָֽ֭/אֲשַׁבְּרָ/ה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝/מִ/שִּׁנָּ֗י/ו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף
verses.translit: v'shbrh mtl'vt 'vl vmshnyv 'shlykh trf
verses.translation: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

verses.original: וָ֭/אֹמַר עִם קִנִּ֣/י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝/כַ/ח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'mr 'm qny 'gv' vkhchvl 'rbh ymym
verses.translation: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

verses.original: שָׁרְשִׁ֣/י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי מָ֑יִם וְ֝/טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּ/קְצִירִֽ/י
verses.translit: shrshy ptvch 'ly mym vtl ylyn bqtsyry
verses.translation: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

verses.original: כְּ֭בוֹדִ/י חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑/י וְ֝/קַשְׁתִּ֗/י בְּ/יָדִ֥/י תַחֲלִֽיף
verses.translit: khbvdy chdsh 'mdy vqshty bydy tchlyf
verses.translation: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

verses.original: לִֽ/י שָׁמְע֥וּ וְ/יִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝/יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: ly shm'v vychlv vydmv lmv 'tsty
verses.translation: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִ/י לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝/עָלֵ֗י/מוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'chry dbry l' yshnv v'lymv ttf mlty
verses.translation: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽחֲל֣וּ כַ/מָּטָ֣ר לִ֑/י וּ֝/פִי/הֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְ/מַלְקֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vychlv khmtr ly vpyhm p'rv lmlqvsh
verses.translation: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

verses.original: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵ/הֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְ/א֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗/י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'shchq 'lhm l' y'mynv v'vr pny l' ypylvn
verses.translation: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

verses.original: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּ/ם֮ וְ/אֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭/אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ בַּ/גְּד֑וּד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם
verses.translit: 'bchr drkhm v'shb r'sh v'shkhvn khmlkh bgdvd kh'shr 'blym ynchm
verses.translation: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֤ה שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַ/י֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗/נִּי לְ/יָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם לָ֝/שִׁ֗ית עִם כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th shchqv 'ly ts'yrym mmny lymym 'shr m'sty 'bvtm lshyt 'm khlby ts'ny
verses.translation: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

verses.original: גַּם כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵי/הֶם לָ֣/מָּה לִּ֑/י עָ֝לֵ֗י/מוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח
verses.translit: gm khch ydyhm lmh ly 'lymv 'bd khlch
verses.translation: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

verses.original: בְּ/חֶ֥סֶר וּ/בְ/כָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽ/עֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּ/מְשֹׁאָֽה
verses.translit: bchsr vbkhpn glmvd h'rqym tsyh 'msh shv'h vmsh'h
verses.translation: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

verses.original: הַ/קֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי שִׂ֑יחַ וְ/שֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַ/חְמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hqtpym mlvch 'ly shych vshrsh rtmym lchmm
verses.translation: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

verses.original: מִן גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗י/מוֹ כַּ/גַּנָּֽב
verses.translit: mn gv ygrshv yry'v 'lymv khgnb
verses.translation: They were driven forth from among men , (they cried after them as after a thief;)

verses.original: בַּ/עֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִ/שְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְ/כֵפִֽים
verses.translit: b'rvts nchlym lshkhn chry 'pr vkhpym
verses.translation: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

verses.original: בֵּין שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: byn shychym ynhqv tcht chrvl yspchv
verses.translation: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי נָ֭בָל גַּם בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bny nbl gm bny bly shm nkh'v mn h'rts
verses.translation: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

verses.original: וְ֭/עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣/ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָ/אֱהִ֖י לָ/הֶ֣ם לְ/מִלָּֽה
verses.translit: v'th ngyntm hyyty v'hy lhm lmlh
verses.translation: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

verses.original: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּ/נִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑/נִּי וּ֝/מִ/פָּנַ֗/י לֹא חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק
verses.translit: t'bvny rchqv mny vmpny l' chshkhv rq
verses.translation: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

verses.original: כִּֽי יתר/ו יִתְרִ֣/י פִ֭תַּח וַ/יְעַנֵּ֑/נִי וְ֝/רֶ֗סֶן מִ/פָּנַ֥/י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ
verses.translit: khy ytrv ytry ptch vy'nny vrsn mpny shlchv
verses.translation: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

verses.original: עַל יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥/י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַ/יָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗/י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l ymyn prchch yqvmv rgly shlchv vyslv 'ly 'rchvt 'ydm
verses.translation: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

verses.original: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥/י לְ/הַוָּתִ֥/י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: ntsv ntybty lhvty y'ylv l' 'zr lmv
verses.translation: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

verses.original: כְּ/פֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: khprts rchb y'tyv tcht sh'h htglglv
verses.translation: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .

verses.original: הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗/י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭/רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑/י וּ֝/כְ/עָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hhpkh 'ly blhvt trdf khrvch ndbty vkh'b 'brh ysh'ty
verses.translation: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַ/י תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑/י יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּ/נִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי
verses.translit: v'th 'ly tshtpkh npshy y'chzvny ymy 'ny
verses.translation: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

verses.original: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַ/י נִקַּ֣ר מֵ/עָלָ֑/י וְ֝/עֹרְקַ֗/י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: lylh 'tsmy nqr m'ly v'rqy l' yshkhbvn
verses.translation: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

verses.original: בְּ/רָב כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑/י כְּ/פִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣/י יַֽאַזְרֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: brb khch ytchpsh lbvshy khpy khtnty y'zrny
verses.translation: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

verses.original: הֹרָ֥/נִי לַ/חֹ֑מֶר וָ֝/אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּ/עָפָ֥ר וָ/אֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: hrny lchmr v'tmshl kh'pr v'pr
verses.translation: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

verses.original: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶי/ךָ וְ/לֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑/נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַ/תִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shv' 'lykh vl' t'nny 'mdty vttbnn by
verses.translation: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not .

verses.original: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְ/אַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑/י בְּ/עֹ֖צֶם יָדְ/ךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: thpkh l'khzr ly b'tsm ydkh tshtmny
verses.translation: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

verses.original: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣/נִי אֶל ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑/נִי וּ֝/תְמֹגְגֵ֗/נִי תשוה תּוּשִׁיָּֽה
verses.translit: tsh'ny 'l rvch trkhybny vtmggny tshvh tvshyh
verses.translation: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑/נִי וּ/בֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְ/כָל חָֽי
verses.translit: khy yd'ty mvt tshybny vbyt mv'd lkhl chy
verses.translation: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֹא בְ֭/עִי יִשְׁלַח יָ֑ד אִם בְּ֝/פִיד֗/וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ
verses.translit: 'kh l' b'y yshlch yd 'm bpydv lhn shv'
verses.translation: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִ/קְשֵׁה י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗/י לָ/אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'm l' bkhyty lqshh yvm 'gmh npshy l'byvn
verses.translation: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַ/יָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽ/אֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝/א֗וֹר וַ/יָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל
verses.translit: khy tvb qvyty vyb' r' v'ychlh l'vr vyb' 'pl
verses.translation: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

verses.original: מֵעַ֖/י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְ/לֹא דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥/נִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי
verses.translit: m'y rtchv vl' dmv qdmny ymy 'ny
verses.translation: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

verses.original: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּ/לֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַ/קָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: qdr hlkhty bl' chmh qmty bqhl 'shv'
verses.translation: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

verses.original: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְ/תַנִּ֑ים וְ֝/רֵ֗עַ לִ/בְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: 'ch hyyty ltnym vr' lbnvt y'nh
verses.translation: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

verses.original: ע֭וֹרִ/י שָׁחַ֣ר מֵ/עָלָ֑/י וְ/עַצְמִ/י חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי חֹֽרֶב
verses.translit: 'vry shchr m'ly v'tsmy chrh mny chrb
verses.translation: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לְ֭/אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑/י וְ֝/עֻגָבִ֗/י לְ/ק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy l'bl khnry v'gby lqvl bkhym
verses.translation: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

verses.original: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְ/עֵינָ֑/י וּ/מָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל בְּתוּלָֽה
verses.translit: bryt khrty l'yny vmh 'tbvnn 'l btvlh
verses.translation: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֤ה חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִ/מָּ֑עַל וְֽ/נַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִ/מְּרֹמִֽים
verses.translit: vmh chlq 'lvh mm'l vnchlt shdy mmrmym
verses.translation: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא אֵ֥יד לְ/עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝/נֵ֗כֶר לְ/פֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: hl' 'yd l'vl vnkhr lp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑/י וְֽ/כָל צְעָדַ֥/י יִסְפּֽוֹר
verses.translit: hl' hv' yr'h drkhy vkhl ts'dy yspvr
verses.translation: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

verses.original: אִם הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם שָׁ֑וְא וַ/תַּ֖חַשׁ עַל מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm hlkhty 'm shv' vtchsh 'l mrmh rgly
verses.translation: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

verses.original: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥/נִי בְ/מֹאזְנֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְ/יֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽ/י
verses.translit: yshqlny bm'zny tsdq vyd' 'lvh tmty
verses.translation: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.

verses.original: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִ/י֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫/דָּ֥רֶךְ וְ/אַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַ/י הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑/י וּ֝/בְ/כַפַּ֗/י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם
verses.translit: 'm tth 'shry mny hdrkh v'chr 'yny hlkh lby vbkhpy dbq m'vm
verses.translation: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

verses.original: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְ/אַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽ/צֶאֱצָאַ֥/י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: 'zr'h v'chr y'khl vts'ts'y yshrshv
verses.translation: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

verses.original: אִם נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּ/י עַל אִשָּׁ֑ה וְ/עַל פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣/י אָרָֽבְתִּי
verses.translit: 'm npth lby 'l 'shh v'l ptch r'y 'rbty
verses.translation: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;

verses.original: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְ/אַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑/י וְ֝/עָלֶ֗י/הָ יִכְרְע֥וּ/ן אֲחֵרִֽין
verses.translit: ttchn l'chr 'shty v'lyh ykhr'vn 'chryn
verses.translation: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

verses.original: כִּי הוא הִ֥יא זִמָּ֑ה ו/היא וְ֝/ה֗וּא עָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים
verses.translit: khy hv' hy' zmh vhy' vhv' 'vn plylym
verses.translation: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽ/בְ/כָל תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣/י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy 'sh hy' 'd 'bdvn t'khl vbkhl tbv'ty tshrsh
verses.translation: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

verses.original: אִם אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּ/י וַ/אֲמָתִ֑/י בְּ֝/רִבָ֗/ם עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm 'm's mshpt 'bdy v'mty brbm 'mdy
verses.translation: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

verses.original: וּ/מָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְ/כִֽי יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vmh ''shh khy yqvm 'l vkhy ypqd mh 'shybnv
verses.translation: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

verses.original: הֲֽ֝/לֹא בַ֭/בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣/נִי עָשָׂ֑/הוּ וַ֝/יְכֻנֶ֗/נּוּ בָּ/רֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: hl' bbtn 'shny 'shhv vykhnnv brchm 'chd
verses.translation: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

verses.original: אִם אֶ֭מְנַע מֵ/חֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְ/עֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'm 'mn' mchpts dlym v'yny 'lmnh 'khlh
verses.translation: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

verses.original: וְ/אֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣/י לְ/בַדִּ֑/י וְ/לֹא אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'khl pty lbdy vl' 'khl ytvm mmnh
verses.translation: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֭/נְּעוּרַ/י גְּדֵלַ֣/נִי כְ/אָ֑ב וּ/מִ/בֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣/י אַנְחֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: khy mn'vry gdlny kh'b vmbtn 'my 'nchnh
verses.translation: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)

verses.original: אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִ/בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְ/אֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָ/אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'm 'r'h 'vbd mbly lbvsh v'yn khsvt l'byvn
verses.translation: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּ/נִי חלצ/ו חֲלָצָ֑י/ו וּ/מִ/גֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂ/י יִתְחַמָּֽם
verses.translit: 'm l' brkhvny chltsv chltsyv vmgz khbshy ytchmm
verses.translation: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

verses.original: אִם הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑/י כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝/שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm hnypvty 'l ytvm ydy khy 'r'h bsh'r 'zrty
verses.translation: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

verses.translit: khtpy mshkhmh tpvl v'zr'y mqnh tshbr
verses.translation: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

verses.original: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַ/י אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝/מִ/שְּׂאֵת֗/וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל
verses.translit: khy pchd 'ly 'yd 'l vmsh'tv l' 'vkhl
verses.translation: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

verses.original: אִם שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑/י וְ֝/לַ/כֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm shmty zhb khsly vlkhtm 'mrty mbtchy
verses.translation: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

verses.original: אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑/י וְ/כִֽי כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm 'shmch khy rb chyly vkhy khbyr mts'h ydy
verses.translation: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;

verses.original: אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝/יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: 'm 'r'h 'vr khy yhl vyrch yqr hlkh
verses.translation: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

verses.translit: vypt bstr lby vtshq ydy lpy
verses.translation: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

verses.original: גַּם ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָ/אֵ֣ל מִ/מָּֽעַל
verses.translit: gm hv' 'vn plyly khy khchshty l'l mm'l
verses.translation: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.

verses.original: אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּ/פִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑/י וְ֝/הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי מְצָ֥א/וֹ רָֽע
verses.translit: 'm 'shmch bpyd mshn'y vht'rrty khy mts'v r'
verses.translation: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

verses.original: וְ/לֹא נָתַ֣תִּי לַ/חֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑/י לִ/שְׁאֹ֖ל בְּ/אָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' ntty lcht' chkhy lsh'l b'lh npshv
verses.translation: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑/י מִֽי יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝/בְּשָׂר֗/וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע
verses.translit: 'm l' 'mrv mty 'hly my ytn mbshrv l' nshb'
verses.translation: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

verses.original: בַּ֭/חוּץ לֹא יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗/י לָ/אֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח
verses.translit: bchvts l' ylyn gr dlty l'rch 'ptch
verses.translation: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

verses.original: אִם כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְ/אָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑/י לִ/טְמ֖וֹן בְּ/חֻבִּ֣/י עֲוֺֽנִ/י
verses.translit: 'm khsyty kh'dm psh'y ltmvn bchby 'vny
verses.translation: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּ/בוּז מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑/נִי וָ֝/אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח
verses.translit: khy ''rvts hmvn rbh vbvz mshpchvt ychtny v'dm l' 'ts' ptch
verses.translation: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּן לִ֨/י שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗/י הֶן תָּ֭וִ/י שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑/נִי וְ/סֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽ/י
verses.translit: my ytn ly shm' ly hn tvy shdy y'nny vspr khtb 'ysh ryby
verses.translation: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֣א עַל שִׁ֭כְמִ/י אֶשָּׂאֶ֑/נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖/נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm l' 'l shkhmy 'sh'nv ''ndnv 'trvt ly
verses.translation: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

verses.original: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַ/י אַגִּידֶ֑/נּוּ כְּמוֹ נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mspr ts'dy 'gydnv khmv ngyd 'qrbnv
verses.translation: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

verses.original: אִם עָ֭לַ/י אַדְמָתִ֣/י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝/יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥י/הָ יִבְכָּיֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'm 'ly 'dmty tz'q vychd tlmyh ybkhyvn
verses.translation: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

verses.original: אִם כֹּ֭חָ/הּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי כָ֑סֶף וְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣י/הָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי
verses.translit: 'm khchh 'khlty bly khsf vnpsh b'lyh hpchty
verses.translation: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְ/תַֽחַת שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
verses.translit: tcht chth yts' chvch vtcht sh'rh b'shh tmv dbry 'yvb
verses.translation: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭/אֵלֶּה מֵ/עֲנ֣וֹת אֶת אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshbtv shlsht h'nshym h'lh m'nvt 't 'yvb khy hv' tsdyq b'ynyv
verses.translation: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַ/בּוּזִי֮ מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭/אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑/וֹ עַֽל צַדְּק֥/וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗/וֹ מֵ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vychr 'f 'lyhv' bn brkh'l hbvzy mmshpcht rm b'yvb chrh 'pv 'l tsdqv npshv m'lhym
verses.translation: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָי/ו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥/וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝/יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת אִיּֽוֹב
verses.translit: vbshlsht r'yv chrh 'pv 'l 'shr l' mts'v m'nh vyrshy'v 't 'yvb
verses.translation: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

verses.original: וֶֽ/אֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב בִּ/דְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ לְ/יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'lyhv chkhh 't 'yvb bdbrym khy zqnym hmh mmnv lymym
verses.translation: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭/פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַ/יִּ֥חַר אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyhv' khy 'yn m'nh bpy shlsht h'nshym vychr 'pv
verses.translation: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַ/בּוּזִ֗י וַ/יֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭/יָמִים וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽ/אִירָ֓א מֵ/חַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣/י אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyhv' bn brkh'l hbvzy vy'mr ts'yr 'ny lymym v'tm yshyshym 'l khn zchlty v'yr' mchvt d'y 'tkhm
verses.translation: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

verses.original: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְ/רֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: 'mrty ymym ydbrv vrb shnym ydy'v chkhmh
verses.translation: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ הִ֣יא בֶ/אֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְ/נִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'khn rvch hy' b'nvsh vnshmt shdy tbynm
verses.translation: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

verses.original: לֹֽא רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝/זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: l' rbym ychkhmv vzqnym ybynv mshpt
verses.translation: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָ/ה לִּ֑/י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣/י אַף אָֽנִי
verses.translit: lkhn 'mrty shm'h ly 'chvh d'y 'f 'ny
verses.translation: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽ/דִבְרֵי/כֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם עַֽד תַּחְקְר֥וּ/ן מִלִּֽין
verses.translit: hn hvchlty ldbrykhm 'zyn 'd tbvntykhm 'd tchqrvn mlyn
verses.translation: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

verses.original: וְ/עָֽדֵי/כֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְ/אִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣י/ו מִ/כֶּֽם
verses.translit: v'dykhm 'tbvnn vhnh 'yn l'yvb mvkhych 'vnh 'mryv mkhm
verses.translation: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

verses.original: פֶּן תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣/נּוּ לֹא אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: pn t'mrv mts'nv chkhmh 'l ydpnv l' 'ysh
verses.translation: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣/י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝/בְ/אִמְרֵי/כֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vl' 'rkh 'ly mlyn vb'mrykhm l' 'shybnv
verses.translation: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

verses.original: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵ/הֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים
verses.translit: chtv l' 'nv 'vd h'tyqv mhm mlym
verses.translation: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

verses.original: וְ֭/הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhvchlty khy l' ydbrv khy 'mdv l' 'nv 'vd
verses.translation: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

verses.original: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑/י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣/י אַף אָֽנִי
verses.translit: ''nh 'f 'ny chlqy 'chvh d'y 'f 'ny
verses.translation: I said , I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

verses.original: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְ/נִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy mlty mlym htsyqtny rvch btny
verses.translation: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה בִטְנִ֗/י כְּ/יַ֥יִן לֹא יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּ/אֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ
verses.translit: hnh btny khyyn l' yptch kh'bvt chdshym ybq'
verses.translation: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

verses.original: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְ/יִֽרְוַֽח לִ֑/י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣/י וְ/אֶֽעֱנֶֽה
verses.translit: 'dbrh vyrvch ly 'ptch shpty v''nh
verses.translation: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

verses.original: אַל נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ/אֶל אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'l n' 'sh' pny 'ysh v'l 'dm l' 'khnh
verses.translation: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝/מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥/נִי עֹשֵֽׂ/נִי
verses.translit: khy l' yd'ty 'khnh khm't ysh'ny 'shny
verses.translation: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

verses.original: וְֽ/אוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑/י וְֽ/כָל דְּבָרַ֥/י הַאֲזִֽינָ/ה
verses.translit: v'vlm shm' n' 'yvb mly vkhl dbry h'zynh
verses.translation: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑/י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣/י בְ/חִכִּֽ/י
verses.translit: hnh n' ptchty py dbrh lshvny bchkhy
verses.translation: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

verses.original: יֹֽשֶׁר לִבִּ֥/י אֲמָרָ֑/י וְ/דַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗/י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ
verses.translit: yshr lby 'mry vd't shpty brvr mllv
verses.translation: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

verses.original: רֽוּחַ אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְ/נִי וְ/נִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: rvch 'l 'shtny vnshmt shdy tchyny
verses.translation: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

verses.original: אִם תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑/נִי עֶרְכָ֥/ה לְ֝/פָנַ֗/י הִתְיַצָּֽבָ/ה
verses.translit: 'm tvkhl hshybny 'rkhh lpny htytsbh
verses.translation: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

verses.original: הֵן אֲנִ֣י כְ/פִ֣י/ךָ לָ/אֵ֑ל מֵ֝/חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם אָֽנִי
verses.translit: hn 'ny khpykh l'l mchmr qrtsty gm 'ny
verses.translation: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִ/י לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑/ךָּ וְ֝/אַכְפִּ֗/י עָלֶ֥י/ךָ לֹא יִכְבָּֽד
verses.translit: hnh 'mty l' tb'tkh v'khpy 'lykh l' ykhbd
verses.translation: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

verses.original: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְ/אָזְנָ֑/י וְ/ק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: 'kh 'mrt b'zny vqvl mlyn 'shm'
verses.translation: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying ,

verses.original: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְ/לֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: zkh 'ny bly psh' chf 'nkhy vl' 'vn ly
verses.translation: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣/י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖/נִי לְ/אוֹיֵ֣ב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hn tnv'vt 'ly ymts' ychshbny l'vyb lv
verses.translation: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּ/סַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑/י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל אָרְחֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: yshm bsd rgly yshmr khl 'rchty
verses.translation: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

verses.original: הֶן זֹ֣את לֹא צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑/ךָּ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵ/אֱנֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: hn z't l' tsdqt ''nkh khy yrbh 'lvh m'nvsh
verses.translation: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

verses.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣י/ו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל דְּ֝בָרָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: mdv' 'lyv rybvt khy khl dbryv l' y'nh
verses.translation: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

verses.original: כִּֽי בְ/אַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר אֵ֑ל וּ֝/בִ/שְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: khy b'cht ydbr 'l vbshtym l' yshvrnh
verses.translation: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

verses.original: בַּ/חֲל֤וֹם חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּ/נְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝/תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: bchlvm chzyvn lylh bnpl trdmh 'l 'nshym btnvmvt 'ly mshkhb
verses.translation: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּ/בְ/מֹ֖סָרָ֣/ם יַחְתֹּֽם
verses.translit: 'z yglh 'zn 'nshym vbmsrm ychtm
verses.translation: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

verses.original: לְ֭/הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְ/גֵוָ֖ה מִ/גֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה
verses.translit: lhsyr 'dm m'shh vgvh mgbr ykhsh
verses.translation: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

verses.translit: ychshkh npshv mny shcht vchytv m'br bshlch
verses.translation: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

verses.original: וְ/הוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭/מַכְאוֹב עַל מִשְׁכָּב֑/וֹ ו/ריב וְ/ר֖וֹב עֲצָמָ֣י/ו אֵתָֽן
verses.translit: vhvkhch bmkh'vb 'l mshkhbv vryb vrvb 'tsmyv 'tn
verses.translation: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

verses.original: וְ/זִֽהֲמַ֣תּ/וּ חַיָּת֣/וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝/נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה
verses.translit: vzhmtv chytv lchm vnpshv m'khl t'vh
verses.translation: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

verses.original: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣/וֹ מֵ/רֹ֑אִי ו/שפי וְ/שֻׁפּ֥וּ עַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ
verses.translit: ykhl bshrv mr'y vshpy vshpv 'tsmvtyv l' r'v
verses.translation: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרַ֣ב לַ/שַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וְ֝/חַיָּת֗/וֹ לַֽ/מְמִתִֽים
verses.translit: vtqrb lshcht npshv vchytv lmmtym
verses.translation: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

verses.original: אִם יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨י/ו מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי אָ֑לֶף לְ/הַגִּ֖יד לְ/אָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm ysh 'lyv ml'kh mlyts 'chd mny 'lf lhgyd l'dm yshrv
verses.translation: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

verses.original: וַ/יְחֻנֶּ֗/נּוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵ/הוּ מֵ/רֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר
verses.translit: vychnnv vy'mr pd'hv mrdt shcht mts'ty khpr
verses.translation: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

verses.original: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣/וֹ מִ/נֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִ/ימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: rtpsh bshrv mn'r yshvb lymy 'lvmyv
verses.translation: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:

verses.original: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל אֱל֨וֹהַּ וַ/יִּרְצֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָי/ו בִּ/תְרוּעָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝/אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: y'tr 'l 'lvh vyrtshv vyr' pnyv btrv'h vyshb l'nvsh tsdqtv
verses.translation: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

verses.original: יָשֹׁ֤ר עַל אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְ/יָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְ/לֹא שָׁ֥וָה לִֽ/י
verses.translit: yshr 'l 'nshym vy'mr cht'ty vyshr h'vyty vl' shvh ly
verses.translation: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

verses.original: פָּדָ֣ה נפש/י נַ֭פְשׁ/וֹ מֵ/עֲבֹ֣ר בַּ/שָּׁ֑חַת ו/חית/י וְ֝/חַיָּת/וֹ בָּ/א֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: pdh npshy npshv m'br bshcht vchyty vchytv b'vr tr'h
verses.translation: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

verses.original: הֶן כָּל אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: hn khl 'lh yp'l 'l p'mym shlvsh 'm gbr
verses.translation: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

verses.original: לְ/הָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁ/וֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝/א֗וֹר בְּ/א֣וֹר הַֽ/חַיִּים
verses.translit: lhshyb npshv mny shcht l'vr b'vr hchyym
verses.translation: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

verses.original: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑/י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְ/אָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: hqshb 'yvb shm' ly hchrsh v'nkhy 'dbr
verses.translation: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

verses.original: אִם יֵשׁ מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑/נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'm ysh mlyn hshybny dbr khy chptsty tsdqkh
verses.translation: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

verses.original: אִם אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑/י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַ/אֲאַלֶּפְ/ךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: 'm 'yn 'th shm' ly hchrsh v''lpkh chkhmh
verses.translation: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyhv' vy'mr
verses.translation: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑/י וְ֝/יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm'v chkhmym mly vyd'ym h'zynv ly
verses.translation: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

verses.original: כִּי אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝/חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶ/אֱכֹֽל
verses.translit: khy 'zn mlyn tbchn vchkh yt'm l'khl
verses.translation: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה לָּ֑/נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣י/נוּ מַה טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: mshpt nbchrh lnv nd'h bynynv mh tvb
verses.translation: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֭מַר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝/אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'mr 'yvb tsdqty v'l hsyr mshpty
verses.translation: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

verses.original: עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֥/י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣/י בְלִי פָֽשַׁע
verses.translit: 'l mshpty 'khzb 'nvsh chtsy bly psh'
verses.translation: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

verses.original: מִי גֶ֥בֶר כְּ/אִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה לַּ֥עַג כַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: my gbr kh'yvb yshth l'g khmym
verses.translation: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

verses.original: וְ/אָרַ֣ח לְ֭/חֶבְרָה עִם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝/לָ/לֶ֗כֶת עִם אַנְשֵׁי רֶֽשַׁע
verses.translit: v'rch lchbrh 'm p'ly 'vn vllkht 'm 'nshy rsh'
verses.translation: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝/רְצֹת֗/וֹ עִם אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'mr l' yskhn gbr brtstv 'm 'lhym
verses.translation: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֤ן אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥/י חָלִ֖לָ/ה לָ/אֵ֥ל מֵ/רֶ֗שַׁע וְ/שַׁדַּ֥י מֵ/עָֽוֶל
verses.translit: lkhn 'nshy lbb shm'v ly chllh l'l mrsh' vshdy m'vl
verses.translation: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

verses.original: כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם ל֑/וֹ וּֽ/כְ/אֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy p'l 'dm yshlm lv vkh'rch 'ysh ymts'nv
verses.translation: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

verses.original: אַף אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝/שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: 'f 'mnm 'l l' yrshy' vshdy l' y'vt mshpt
verses.translation: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

verses.original: מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣י/ו אָ֑רְצָ/ה וּ/מִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: my pqd 'lyv 'rtsh vmy shm tbl khlh
verses.translation: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?

verses.original: אִם יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣י/ו לִבּ֑/וֹ רוּח֥/וֹ וְ֝/נִשְׁמָת֗/וֹ אֵלָ֥י/ו יֶאֱסֹֽף
verses.translit: 'm yshym 'lyv lbv rvchv vnshmtv 'lyv y'sf
verses.translation: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

verses.original: יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝/אָדָ֗ם עַל עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: ygv' khl bshr ychd v'dm 'l 'pr yshvb
verses.translation: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָ/ה זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָ/ה לְ/ק֣וֹל מִלָּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'm bynh shm'h z't h'zynh lqvl mly
verses.translation: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

verses.original: הַ/אַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְ/אִם צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: h'f shvn' mshpt ychbvsh v'm tsdyq khbyr trshy'
verses.translation: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

verses.original: הַ/אֲמֹ֣ר לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל נְדִיבִֽים
verses.translit: h'mr lmlkh bly'l rsh' 'l ndybym
verses.translation: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא נָשָׂ֨א פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְ/לֹ֣א נִכַּר שׁ֭וֹעַ לִ/פְנֵי דָ֑ל כִּֽי מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣י/ו כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr l' nsh' pny shrym vl' nkhr shv' lpny dl khy m'shh ydyv khlm
verses.translation: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

verses.original: רֶ֤גַע יָמֻתוּ֮ וַ/חֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְ/יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ/יָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְ/יָֽד
verses.translit: rg' ymtv vchtsvt lylh yg'shv 'm vy'brv vysyrv 'byr l' byd
verses.translation: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

verses.original: כִּי עֵ֭ינָי/ו עַל דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְֽ/כָל צְעָדָ֥י/ו יִרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: khy 'ynyv 'l drkhy 'ysh vkhl ts'dyv yr'h
verses.translation: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

verses.original: אֵֽין חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְ/אֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְ/הִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: 'yn chshkh v'yn tslmvt lhstr shm p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַ/הֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל אֵ֝֗ל בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: khy l' 'l 'ysh yshym 'vd lhlkh 'l 'l bmshpt
verses.translation: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.

verses.original: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא חֵ֑קֶר וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: yr' khbyrym l' chqr vy'md 'chrym tchtm
verses.translation: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְ/יִדַּכָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: lkhn ykhyr m'bdyhm vhpkh lylh vydkh'v
verses.translation: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗/ם בִּ/מְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים
verses.translit: tcht rsh'ym spqm bmqvm r'ym
verses.translation: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽ/אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וְ/כָל דְּ֝רָכָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ
verses.translit: 'shr 'l khn srv m'chryv vkhl drkhyv l' hshkhylv
verses.translation: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

verses.original: לְ/הָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָי/ו צַֽעֲקַת דָּ֑ל וְ/צַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: lhby' 'lyv ts'qt dl vts'qt 'nyym yshm'
verses.translation: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

verses.original: וְ/ה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט וּ/מִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְ/יַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּ/מִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/עַל גּ֖וֹי וְ/עַל אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד
verses.translit: vhv' yshqt vmy yrsh' vystr pnym vmy yshvrnv v'l gvy v'l 'dm ychd
verses.translation: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

verses.original: מִ֭/מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִ/מֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם
verses.translit: mmlkh 'dm chnf mmqshy 'm
verses.translation: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֶל אֵ֭ל הֶ/אָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל
verses.translit: khy 'l 'l h'mr nsh'ty l' 'chbl
verses.translation: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more:

verses.original: בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑/נִי אִֽם עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף
verses.translit: bl'dy 'chzh 'th hrny 'm 'vl p'lty l' 'syf
verses.translation: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

verses.original: הַֽ/מֵ/עִמְּ/ךָ֬ יְשַׁלְמֶ֨/נָּה כִּֽי מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְ/לֹא אָ֑נִי וּֽ/מַה יָדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: hm'mkh yshlmnh khy m'st khy 'th tbchr vl' 'ny vmh yd't dbr
verses.translation: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑/י וְ/גֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nshy lbb y'mrv ly vgbr chkhm shm' ly
verses.translation: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

verses.original: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא בְ/דַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝/דְבָרָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א בְ/הַשְׂכֵּֽיל
verses.translit: 'yvb l' bd't ydbr vdbryv l' bhshkhyl
verses.translation: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

verses.original: אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד נֶ֑צַח עַל תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּ/אַנְשֵׁי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: 'by ybchn 'yvb 'd ntsch 'l tshbt b'nshy 'vn
verses.translation: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

verses.original: כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל חַטָּאת֣/וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣י/נוּ יִסְפּ֑וֹק וְ/יֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣י/ו לָ/אֵֽל
verses.translit: khy ysyf 'l cht'tv psh' bynynv yspvq vyrb 'mryv l'l
verses.translation: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּ וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyhv vy'mr
verses.translation: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

verses.original: הֲ֭/זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥/י מֵ/אֵֽל
verses.translit: hz't chshbt lmshpt 'mrt tsdqy m'l
verses.translation: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God’s?

verses.original: כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר מַה יִּסְכָּן לָ֑/ךְ מָֽה אֹ֝עִ֗יל מֵֽ/חַטָּאתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy t'mr mh yskhn lkh mh ''yl mcht'ty
verses.translation: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and , What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֲשִֽׁיבְ/ךָ֣ מִלִּ֑ין וְֽ/אֶת רֵעֶ֥י/ךָ עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ny 'shybkh mlyn v't r'ykh 'mkh
verses.translation: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

verses.original: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּ/רְאֵ֑ה וְ/שׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: hbt shmym vr'h vshvr shchqym gbhv mmkh
verses.translation: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

verses.original: אִם חָ֭טָאתָ מַה תִּפְעָל בּ֑/וֹ וְ/רַבּ֥וּ פְ֝שָׁעֶ֗י/ךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm cht't mh tp'l bv vrbv psh'ykh mh t'shh lv
verses.translation: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

verses.original: אִם צָ֭דַקְתָּ מַה תִּתֶּן ל֑/וֹ א֥וֹ מַה מִ/יָּדְ/ךָ֥ יִקָּֽח
verses.translit: 'm tsdqt mh ttn lv 'v mh mydkh yqch
verses.translation: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

verses.original: לְ/אִישׁ כָּמ֥וֹ/ךָ רִשְׁעֶ֑/ךָ וּ/לְ/בֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם צִדְקָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l'ysh khmvkh rsh'kh vlbn 'dm tsdqtkh
verses.translation: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

verses.original: מֵ֭/רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִ/זְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: mrb 'shvqym yz'yqv yshv'v mzrv' rbym
verses.translation: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.original: וְֽ/לֹא אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑/י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vl' 'mr 'yh 'lvh 'shy ntn zmrvt blylh
verses.translation: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

verses.original: מַ֭לְּפֵ/נוּ מִ/בַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּ/מֵ/ע֖וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: mlpnv mbhmvt 'rts vm'vf hshmym ychkhmnv
verses.translation: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝/פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים
verses.translit: shm yts'qv vl' y'nh mpny g'vn r'ym
verses.translation: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

verses.original: אַךְ שָׁ֭וְא לֹא יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל וְ֝/שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: 'kh shv' l' yshm' 'l vshdy l' yshvrnh
verses.translation: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

verses.original: אַ֣ף כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑/נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝/פָנָ֗י/ו וּ/תְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'f khy t'mr l' tshvrnv dyn lpnyv vtchvll lv
verses.translation: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כִּי אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֖ע בַּ/פַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v'th khy 'yn pqd 'pv vl' yd' bpsh m'd
verses.translation: But now, because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

verses.original: וְ֭/אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה פִּ֑י/הוּ בִּ/בְלִי דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר
verses.translit: v'yvb hbl yptsh pyhv bbly d't mlyn ykhbr
verses.translation: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vysf 'lyhv' vy'mr
verses.translation: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

verses.original: כַּתַּר לִ֣/י זְ֭עֵיר וַ/אֲחַוֶּ֑/ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶ/אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים
verses.translit: khtr ly z'yr v'chvkh khy 'vd l'lvh mlym
verses.translation: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִ/י לְ/מֵ/רָח֑וֹק וּ֝/לְ/פֹעֲלִ֗/י אֶֽתֵּֽן צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: 'sh' d'y lmrchvq vlp'ly 'tn tsdq
verses.translation: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָ֭מְנָם לֹא שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑/י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy 'mnm l' shqr mly tmym d'vt 'mkh
verses.translation: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

verses.original: הֶן אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְ/לֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב
verses.translit: hn 'l khbyr vl' ym's khbyr khch lb
verses.translation: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

verses.original: לֹא יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
verses.translit: l' ychyh rsh' vmshpt 'nyym ytn
verses.translation: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִגְרַ֥ע מִ/צַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶת מְלָכִ֥ים לַ/כִּסֵּ֑א וַ/יֹּשִׁיבֵ֥/ם לָ֝/נֶ֗צַח וַ/יִּגְבָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: l' ygr' mtsdyq 'ynyv v't mlkhym lkhs' vyshybm lntsch vygbhv
verses.translation: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּ/זִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּ/ן בְּ/חַבְלֵי עֹֽנִי
verses.translit: v'm 'svrym bzqym ylkhdvn bchbly 'ny
verses.translation: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לָ/הֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑/ם וּ֝/פִשְׁעֵי/הֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ
verses.translit: vygd lhm p'lm vpsh'yhm khy ytgbrv
verses.translation: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָ/ם לַ/מּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝/יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי יְשֻׁב֥וּ/ן מֵ/אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: vygl 'znm lmvsr vy'mr khy yshbvn m'vn
verses.translation: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

verses.original: אִֽם יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽ/יַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵי/הֶ֣ם בַּ/טּ֑וֹב וּ֝/שְׁנֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּ/נְּעִימִֽים
verses.translit: 'm yshm'v vy'bdv ykhlv ymyhm btvb vshnyhm bn'ymym
verses.translation: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּ/שֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝/יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּ/בְלִי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: v'm l' yshm'v bshlch y'brv vygv'v khbly d't
verses.translation: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

verses.original: וְֽ/חַנְפֵי לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vchnpy lb yshymv 'f l' yshv'v khy 'srm
verses.translation: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

verses.translit: tmt bn'r npshm vchytm bqdshym
verses.translation: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

verses.original: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְ/עָנְי֑/וֹ וְ/יִ֖גֶל בַּ/לַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ychlts 'ny b'nyv vygl blchts 'znm
verses.translation: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

verses.original: וְ/אַ֤ף הֲסִיתְ/ךָ֨ מִ/פִּי צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑י/הָ וְ/נַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְ/ךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן
verses.translit: v'f hsytkh mpy tsr rchb l' mvtsq tchtyh vncht shlchnkh ml' dshn
verses.translation: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

verses.original: וְ/דִין רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ
verses.translit: vdyn rsh' ml't dyn vmshpt ytmkhv
verses.translation: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee .

verses.original: כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה פֶּן יְסִֽיתְ/ךָ֣ בְ/סָ֑פֶק וְ/רָב כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל יַטֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khy chmh pn ysytkh bspq vrb khpr 'l ytkh
verses.translation: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

verses.original: הֲ/יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲ/ךָ לֹ֣א בְ/צָ֑ר וְ֝/כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי כֹֽחַ
verses.translit: hy'rkh shv'kh l' btsr vkhl m'mtsy khch
verses.translation: Will he esteem thy riches? no , not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

verses.original: אַל תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה לַ/עֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l tsh'f hlylh l'lvt 'mym tchtm
verses.translation: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

verses.original: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי עַל זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵ/עֹֽנִי
verses.translit: hshmr 'l tpn 'l 'vn khy 'l zh bchrt m'ny
verses.translation: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

verses.original: הֶן אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּ/כֹח֑/וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣/הוּ מוֹרֶֽה
verses.translit: hn 'l yshgyb bkhchv my khmhv mvrh
verses.translation: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

verses.original: מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣י/ו דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וּ/מִֽי אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה
verses.translit: my pqd 'lyv drkhv vmy 'mr p'lt 'vlh
verses.translation: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

verses.original: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: zkhr khy tshgy' p'lv 'shr shrrv 'nshym
verses.translation: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

verses.original: כָּל אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ ב֑/וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵ/רָחֽוֹק
verses.translit: khl 'dm chzv bv 'nvsh ybyt mrchvq
verses.translation: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

verses.original: הֶן אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְ/לֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣י/ו וְ/לֹא חֵֽקֶר
verses.translit: hn 'l shgy' vl' nd' mspr shnyv vl' chqr
verses.translation: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

verses.original: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְ/אֵדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ygr' ntpy mym yzqv mtr l'dv
verses.translation: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

verses.original: אֲשֶֽׁר יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י אָדָ֬ם רָֽב
verses.translit: 'shr yzlv shchqym yr'pv 'ly 'dm rb
verses.translation: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

verses.original: אַ֣ף אִם יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'f 'm ybyn mprshy 'b tsh'vt skhtv
verses.translation: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

verses.original: הֵן פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣י/ו אוֹר֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַ/יָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה
verses.translit: hn prsh 'lyv 'vrv vshrshy hym khsh
verses.translation: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

verses.original: כִּי בָ֭/ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן אֹ֥כֶל לְ/מַכְבִּֽיר
verses.translit: khy bm ydyn 'mym ytn 'khl lmkhbyr
verses.translation: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

verses.original: עַל כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה א֑וֹר וַ/יְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣י/הָ בְ/מַפְגִּֽיעַ
verses.translit: 'l khpym khsh 'vr vytsv 'lyh bmpgy'
verses.translation: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

verses.original: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣י/ו רֵע֑/וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל עוֹלֶֽה
verses.translit: ygyd 'lyv r'v mqnh 'f 'l 'vlh
verses.translation: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

verses.original: אַף לְ֭/זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑/י וְ֝/יִתַּ֗ר מִ/מְּקוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'f lz't ychrd lby vytr mmqvmv
verses.translation: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּ/רֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑/וֹ וְ֝/הֶ֗גֶה מִ/פִּ֥י/ו יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: shm'v shmv' brgz qlv vhgh mpyv yts'
verses.translation: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑/הוּ וְ֝/אוֹר֗/וֹ עַל כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: tcht khl hshmym yshrhv v'vrv 'l khnpvt h'rts
verses.translation: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

verses.original: אַחֲרָ֤י/ו יִשְׁאַג ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּ/ק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗/ם כִּֽי יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'chryv ysh'g qvl yr'm bqvl g'vnv vl' y'qbm khy yshm' qvlv
verses.translation: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

verses.original: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭/קוֹל/וֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְ/לֹ֣א נֵדָֽע
verses.translit: yr'm 'l bqvlv npl'vt 'shh gdlvt vl' nd'
verses.translation: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לַ/שֶּׁ֨לַג יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְ/גֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝/גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy lshlg y'mr hv' 'rts vgshm mtr vgshm mtrvt 'zv
verses.translation: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

verses.original: בְּ/יַד כָּל אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝/דַ֗עַת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂ/הוּ
verses.translit: byd khl 'dm ychtvm ld't khl 'nshy m'shhv
verses.translation: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ אָ֑רֶב וּ/בִ/מְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣י/הָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן
verses.translit: vtb' chyh bmv 'rb vbm'vntyh tshkhn
verses.translation: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

verses.original: מִן הַ֭/חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽ/מִ/מְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה
verses.translit: mn hchdr tbv' svph vmmzrym qrh
verses.translation: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

verses.original: מִ/נִּשְׁמַת אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן קָ֑רַח וְ/רֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּ/מוּצָֽק
verses.translit: mnshmt 'l ytn qrch vrchb mym bmvtsq
verses.translation: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

verses.original: אַף בְּ֭/רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'f bry ytrych 'b ypyts 'nn 'vrv
verses.translation: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

verses.original: וְ/ה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ ב/תחבולת/ו בְּ/תַחְבּוּלֹתָ֣י/ו לְ/פָעֳלָ֑/ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓/ם עַל פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vhv' msbvt mthpkh btchbvltv btchbvltyv lp'lm khl 'shr ytsvm 'l pny tbl 'rtsh
verses.translation: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

verses.original: אִם לְ/שֵׁ֥בֶט אִם לְ/אַרְצ֑/וֹ אִם לְ֝/חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'm lshbt 'm l'rtsv 'm lchsd ymts'hv
verses.translation: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָ/ה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְ/הִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל
verses.translit: h'zynh z't 'yvb 'md vhtbvnn npl'vt 'l
verses.translation: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

verses.original: הֲ֭/תֵדַע בְּ/שׂוּם אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ֝/הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: htd' bshvm 'lvh 'lyhm vhvpy' 'vr 'nnv
verses.translation: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

verses.original: הֲ֭/תֵדַע עַל מִפְלְשֵׂי עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים
verses.translit: htd' 'l mplshy 'b mpl'vt tmym d'ym
verses.translation: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר בְּגָדֶ֥י/ךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּ/הַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִ/דָּרֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'shr bgdykh chmym bhshqt 'rts mdrvm
verses.translation: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?

verses.original: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּ/וֹ לִ/שְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּ/רְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק
verses.translit: trqy' 'mv lshchqym chzqym khr'y mvtsq
verses.translation: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

verses.original: ה֭וֹדִיעֵ/נוּ מַה נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑/וֹ לֹ֥א נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִ/פְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: hvdy'nv mh n'mr lv l' n'rkh mpny chshkh
verses.translation: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

verses.original: הַֽ/יְסֻפַּר ל֭/וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע
verses.translit: hyspr lv khy 'dbr 'm 'mr 'ysh khy ybl'
verses.translation: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֤ה לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּ/שְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְ/ר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽ/תְּטַהֲרֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th l' r'v 'vr bhyr hv' bshchqym vrvch 'brh vtthrm
verses.translation: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

verses.original: מִ֭/צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד
verses.translit: mtspvn zhb y'th 'l 'lvh nvr' hvd
verses.translation: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

verses.original: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא מְ֭צָאנֻ/הוּ שַׂגִּיא כֹ֑חַ וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְ/רֹב צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה
verses.translit: shdy l' mts'nhv shgy' khch vmshpt vrb tsdqh l' y'nh
verses.translation: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

verses.original: לָ֭/כֵן יְרֵא֣וּ/הוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: lkhn yr'vhv 'nshym l' yr'h khl chkhmy lb
verses.translation: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ ה/סערה מִ֥ן הַ/סְּעָרָ֗ה וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh 't 'yvb mn hs'rh mn hs'rh vy'mr
verses.translation: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

verses.original: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְ/מִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: my zh mchshykh 'tsh bmlyn bly d't
verses.translation: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

verses.original: אֱזָר נָ֣א כְ/גֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/אֶשְׁאָלְ/ךָ֗ וְ/הוֹדִיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'zr n' khgbr chltsykh v'sh'lkh vhvdy'ny
verses.translation: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

verses.original: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּ/יָסְדִ/י אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה
verses.translit: 'yph hyyt bysdy 'rts hgd 'm yd't bynh
verses.translation: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

verses.original: מִי שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּי/הָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣י/הָ קָּֽו
verses.translit: my shm mmdyh khy td' 'v my nth 'lyh qv
verses.translation: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

verses.original: עַל מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣י/הָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'l mh 'dnyh htb'v 'v my yrh 'bn pnth
verses.translation: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

verses.original: בְּ/רָן יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝/יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: brn ychd khvkhby bqr vyry'v khl bny 'lhym
verses.translation: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣סֶךְ בִּ/דְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝/גִיח֗/וֹ מֵ/רֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: vyskh bdltym ym bgychv mrchm yts'
verses.translation: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

verses.original: בְּ/שׂוּמִ֣/י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑/וֹ וַ֝/עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bshvmy 'nn lbshv v'rpl chtltv
verses.translation: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣י/ו חֻקִּ֑/י וָֽ֝/אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּ/דְלָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'shbr 'lyv chqy v'shym brych vdltym
verses.translation: And brake up for it my decreed place , and set bars and doors,

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר עַד פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְ/לֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּ/פֹ֥א יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּ/גְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'mr 'd ph tbv' vl' tsyf vp' yshyt bg'vn glykh
verses.translation: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

verses.original: הְֽ֭/מִ/יָּמֶי/ךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר ידעתה שחר יִדַּ֖עְתָּה הַ/שַּׁ֣חַר מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hmymykh tsvyt bqr yd'th shchr yd'th hshchr mqmv
verses.translation: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

verses.original: לֶ֭/אֱחֹז בְּ/כַנְפ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: l'chz bkhnpvt h'rts vyn'rv rsh'ym mmnh
verses.translation: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

verses.original: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּ/חֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝/יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: tthpkh khchmr chvtm vytytsbv khmv lbvsh
verses.translation: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

verses.original: וְ/יִמָּנַ֣ע מֵ/רְשָׁעִ֣ים אוֹרָ֑/ם וּ/זְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר
verses.translit: vymn' mrsh'ym 'vrm vzrv' rmh tshbr
verses.translation: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

verses.original: הֲ֭/בָאתָ עַד נִבְכֵי יָ֑ם וּ/בְ/חֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ
verses.translit: hb't 'd nbkhy ym vbchqr thvm hthlkht
verses.translation: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

verses.original: הֲ/נִגְל֣וּ לְ֭/ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי מָ֑וֶת וְ/שַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: hnglv lkh sh'ry mvt vsh'ry tslmvt tr'h
verses.translation: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

verses.original: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד רַחֲבֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: htbnnt 'd rchby 'rts hgd 'm yd't khlh
verses.translation: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

verses.original: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭/דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן א֑וֹר וְ֝/חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'y zh hdrkh yshkhn 'vr vchshkh 'y zh mqmv
verses.translation: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶ/נּוּ אֶל גְּבוּל֑/וֹ וְ/כִֽי תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tqchnv 'l gbvlv vkhy tbyn ntybvt bytv
verses.translation: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

verses.original: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּ/מִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣י/ךָ רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: yd't khy 'z tvld vmspr ymykh rbym
verses.translation: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

verses.original: הֲ֭/בָאתָ אֶל אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְ/אֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: hb't 'l 'tsrvt shlg v'tsrvt brd tr'h
verses.translation: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר חָשַׂ֥כְתִּי לְ/עֶת צָ֑ר לְ/י֥וֹם קְ֝רָ֗ב וּ/מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'shr chshkhty l't tsr lyvm qrb vmlchmh
verses.translation: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

verses.original: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭/דֶּרֶךְ יֵחָ֣לֶק א֑וֹר יָפֵ֖ץ קָדִ֣ים עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'y zh hdrkh ychlq 'vr ypts qdym 'ly 'rts
verses.translation: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

verses.original: מִֽי פִלַּ֣ג לַ/שֶּׁ֣טֶף תְּעָלָ֑ה וְ֝/דֶ֗רֶךְ לַ/חֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת
verses.translit: my plg lshtf t'lh vdrkh lchzyz qlvt
verses.translation: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

verses.original: לְ֭/הַמְטִיר עַל אֶ֣רֶץ לֹא אִ֑ישׁ מִ֝דְבָּ֗ר לֹא אָדָ֥ם בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lhmtyr 'l 'rts l' 'ysh mdbr l' 'dm bv
verses.translation: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

verses.original: לְ/הַשְׂבִּ֣יעַ שֹׁ֭אָה וּ/מְשֹׁאָ֑ה וּ֝/לְ/הַצְמִ֗יחַ מֹ֣צָא דֶֽשֶׁא
verses.translit: lhshby' sh'h vmsh'h vlhtsmych mts' dsh'
verses.translation: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

verses.original: הֲ/יֵשׁ לַ/מָּטָ֥ר אָ֑ב א֥וֹ מִי ה֝וֹלִ֗יד אֶגְלֵי טָֽל
verses.translit: hysh lmtr 'b 'v my hvlyd 'gly tl
verses.translation: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַ/קָּ֑רַח וּ/כְפֹ֥ר שָׁ֝מַיִם מִ֣י יְלָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mbtn my yts' hqrch vkhpr shmym my yldv
verses.translation: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

verses.original: כָּ֭/אֶבֶן מַ֣יִם יִתְחַבָּ֑אוּ וּ/פְנֵ֥י תְ֝ה֗וֹם יִתְלַכָּֽדוּ
verses.translit: kh'bn mym ytchb'v vpny thvm ytlkhdv
verses.translation: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

verses.original: הַֽ֭/תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה אֽוֹ מֹשְׁכ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל תְּפַתֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: htqshr m'dnvt khymh 'v mshkhvt khsyl tptch
verses.translation: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

verses.original: הֲ/תֹצִ֣יא מַזָּר֣וֹת בְּ/עִתּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/עַ֗יִשׁ עַל בָּנֶ֥י/הָ תַנְחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: httsy' mzrvt b'tv v'ysh 'l bnyh tnchm
verses.translation: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

verses.original: הֲ֭/יָדַעְתָּ חֻקּ֣וֹת שָׁמָ֑יִם אִם תָּשִׂ֖ים מִשְׁטָר֣/וֹ בָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hyd't chqvt shmym 'm tshym mshtrv b'rts
verses.translation: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

verses.original: הֲ/תָרִ֣ים לָ/עָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑/ךָ וְֽ/שִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: htrym l'b qvlkh vshp't mym tkhskh
verses.translation: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

verses.original: הַֽ/תְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְ/יֵלֵ֑כוּ וְ/יֹאמְר֖וּ לְ/ךָ֣ הִנֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: htshlch brqym vylkhv vy'mrv lkh hnnv
verses.translation: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are ?

verses.original: מִי שָׁ֭ת בַּ/טֻּח֣וֹת חָכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי נָתַ֖ן לַ/שֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה
verses.translit: my sht btchvt chkhmh 'v my ntn lshkhvy bynh
verses.translation: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

verses.original: מִֽי יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּ/חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/נִבְלֵ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם מִ֣י יַשְׁכִּֽיב
verses.translit: my yspr shchqym bchkhmh vnbly shmym my yshkhyb
verses.translation: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

verses.original: בְּ/צֶ֣קֶת עָ֭פָר לַ/מּוּצָ֑ק וּ/רְגָבִ֥ים יְדֻבָּֽקוּ
verses.translit: btsqt 'pr lmvtsq vrgbym ydbqv
verses.translation: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

verses.original: הֲ/תָצ֣וּד לְ/לָבִ֣יא טָ֑רֶף וְ/חַיַּ֖ת כְּפִירִ֣ים תְּמַלֵּֽא
verses.translit: httsvd llby' trf vchyt khpyrym tml'
verses.translation: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

verses.original: כִּי יָשֹׁ֥חוּ בַ/מְּעוֹנ֑וֹת יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַ/סֻּכָּ֣ה לְמוֹ אָֽרֶב
verses.translit: khy yshchv bm'vnvt yshbv bskhh lmv 'rb
verses.translation: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

verses.original: מִ֤י יָכִ֥ין לָ/עֹרֵ֗ב צֵ֫יד֥/וֹ כִּֽי ילד/ו יְ֭לָדָי/ו אֶל אֵ֣ל יְשַׁוֵּ֑עוּ יִ֝תְע֗וּ לִ/בְלִי אֹֽכֶל
verses.translit: my ykhyn l'rb tsydv khy yldv yldyv 'l 'l yshv'v yt'v lbly 'khl
verses.translation: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

verses.original: הֲ/יָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֭ת לֶ֣דֶת יַעֲלֵי סָ֑לַע חֹלֵ֖ל אַיָּל֣וֹת תִּשְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: hyd't 't ldt y'ly sl' chll 'ylvt tshmr
verses.translation: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

verses.original: תִּסְפֹּ֣ר יְרָחִ֣ים תְּמַלֶּ֑אנָה וְ֝/יָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֣ת לִדְתָּֽ/נָה
verses.translit: tspr yrchym tml'nh vyd't 't ldtnh
verses.translation: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

verses.original: תִּ֭כְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵי/הֶ֣ן תְּפַלַּ֑חְנָה חֶבְלֵי/הֶ֥ם תְּשַׁלַּֽחְנָה
verses.translit: tkhr'nh yldyhn tplchnh chblyhm tshlchnh
verses.translation: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.

verses.original: יַחְלְמ֣וּ בְ֭נֵי/הֶם יִרְבּ֣וּ בַ/בָּ֑ר יָ֝צְא֗וּ וְ/לֹא שָׁ֥בוּ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: ychlmv bnyhm yrbv bbr yts'v vl' shbv lmv
verses.translation: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

verses.original: מִֽי שִׁלַּ֣ח פֶּ֣רֶא חָפְשִׁ֑י וּ/מֹסְר֥וֹת עָ֝ר֗וֹד מִ֣י פִתֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: my shlch pr' chpshy vmsrvt 'rvd my ptch
verses.translation: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֣מְתִּי עֲרָבָ֣ה בֵית֑/וֹ וּֽ/מִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֥י/ו מְלֵֽחָה
verses.translit: 'shr shmty 'rbh bytv vmshkhnvtyv mlchh
verses.translation: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂחַק לַ/הֲמ֣וֹן קִרְיָ֑ה תְּשֻׁא֥וֹת נ֝וֹגֵ֗שׂ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: yshchq lhmvn qryh tsh'vt nvgsh l' yshm'
verses.translation: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

verses.original: יְת֣וּר הָרִ֣ים מִרְעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/אַחַ֖ר כָּל יָר֣וֹק יִדְרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: ytvr hrym mr'hv v'chr khl yrvq ydrvsh
verses.translation: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

verses.original: הֲ/יֹ֣אבֶה רֵּ֣ים עָבְדֶ֑/ךָ אִם יָ֝לִ֗ין עַל אֲבוּסֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hy'bh rym 'bdkh 'm ylyn 'l 'bvskh
verses.translation: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?

verses.original: הֲֽ/תִקְשָׁר רֵ֭ים בְּ/תֶ֣לֶם עֲבֹת֑/וֹ אִם יְשַׂדֵּ֖ד עֲמָקִ֣ים אַחֲרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: htqshr rym btlm 'btv 'm yshdd 'mqym 'chrykh
verses.translation: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

verses.original: הֲֽ/תִבְטַח בּ֭/וֹ כִּי רַ֣ב כֹּח֑/וֹ וְ/תַעֲזֹ֖ב אֵלָ֣י/ו יְגִיעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: htbtch bv khy rb khchv vt'zb 'lyv ygy'kh
verses.translation: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

verses.original: הֲ/תַאֲמִ֣ין בּ֭/וֹ כִּי ישוב יָשִׁ֣יב זַרְעֶ֑/ךָ וְֽ/גָרְנְ/ךָ֥ יֶאֱסֹֽף
verses.translit: ht'myn bv khy yshvb yshyb zr'kh vgrnkh y'sf
verses.translation: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?

verses.original: כְּנַף רְנָנִ֥ים נֶעֱלָ֑סָה אִם אֶ֝בְרָ֗ה חֲסִידָ֥ה וְ/נֹצָֽה
verses.translit: khnf rnnym n'lsh 'm 'brh chsydh vntsh
verses.translation: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

verses.original: כִּֽי תַעֲזֹ֣ב לָ/אָ֣רֶץ בֵּצֶ֑י/הָ וְֽ/עַל עָפָ֥ר תְּחַמֵּֽם
verses.translit: khy t'zb l'rts btsyh v'l 'pr tchmm
verses.translation: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

verses.original: וַ֭/תִּשְׁכַּח כִּי רֶ֣גֶל תְּזוּרֶ֑/הָ וְ/חַיַּ֖ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֣ה תְּדוּשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vtshkhch khy rgl tzvrh vchyt hshdh tdvshh
verses.translation: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

verses.original: הִקְשִׁ֣יחַ בָּנֶ֣י/הָ לְּ/לֹא לָ֑/הּ לְ/רִ֖יק יְגִיעָ֣/הּ בְּלִי פָֽחַד
verses.translit: hqshych bnyh ll' lh lryq ygy'h bly pchd
verses.translation: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;

verses.original: כִּֽי הִשָּׁ֣/הּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/לֹא חָ֥לַק לָ֝֗/הּ בַּ/בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: khy hshh 'lvh chkhmh vl' chlq lh bbynh
verses.translation: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

verses.original: כָּ֭/עֵת בַּ/מָּר֣וֹם תַּמְרִ֑יא תִּֽשְׂחַ֥ק לַ֝/סּ֗וּס וּ/לְ/רֹֽכְבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: kh't bmrvm tmry' tshchq lsvs vlrkhbv
verses.translation: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

verses.original: הֲ/תִתֵּ֣ן לַ/סּ֣וּס גְּבוּרָ֑ה הֲ/תַלְבִּ֖ישׁ צַוָּאר֣/וֹ רַעְמָֽה
verses.translit: httn lsvs gbvrh htlbysh tsv'rv r'mh
verses.translation: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

verses.original: הְֽ֭/תַרְעִישֶׁ/נּוּ כָּ/אַרְבֶּ֑ה ה֖וֹד נַחְר֣/וֹ אֵימָֽה
verses.translit: htr'yshnv kh'rbh hvd nchrv 'ymh
verses.translation: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

verses.original: יַחְפְּר֣וּ בָ֭/עֵמֶק וְ/יָשִׂ֣ישׂ בְּ/כֹ֑חַ יֵ֝צֵ֗א לִ/קְרַאת נָֽשֶׁק
verses.translit: ychprv b'mq vyshysh bkhch yts' lqr't nshq
verses.translation: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.

verses.original: יִשְׂחַ֣ק לְ֭/פַחַד וְ/לֹ֣א יֵחָ֑ת וְ/לֹֽא יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִ/פְּנֵי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: yshchq lpchd vl' ycht vl' yshvb mpny chrb
verses.translation: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

verses.original: עָ֭לָי/ו תִּרְנֶ֣ה אַשְׁפָּ֑ה לַ֖הַב חֲנִ֣ית וְ/כִידֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'lyv trnh 'shph lhb chnyt vkhydvn
verses.translation: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

verses.original: בְּ/רַ֣עַשׁ וְ֭/רֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לֹֽא יַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּי ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
