verses.translit: br'sh vrgz ygm' 'rts vl' y'myn khy qvl shvpr
verses.translation: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

verses.original: בְּ/דֵ֤י שֹׁפָ֨ר יֹ֘אמַ֤ר הֶאָ֗ח וּֽ֭/מֵ/רָחוֹק יָרִ֣יחַ מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥עַם שָׂ֝רִים וּ/תְרוּעָֽה
verses.translit: bdy shpr y'mr h'ch vmrchvq yrych mlchmh r'm shrym vtrv'h
verses.translation: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

verses.original: הֲֽ֭/מִ/בִּינָ֣תְ/ךָ יַֽאֲבֶר נֵ֑ץ יִפְרֹ֖שׂ כנפ/ו כְּנָפָ֣י/ו לְ/תֵימָֽן
verses.translit: hmbyntkh y'br nts yprsh khnpv khnpyv ltymn
verses.translation: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

verses.original: אִם עַל פִּ֭י/ךָ יַגְבִּ֣יהַּ נָ֑שֶׁר וְ֝/כִ֗י יָרִ֥ים קִנּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm 'l pykh ygbyh nshr vkhy yrym qnv
verses.translation: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?

verses.original: סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְ/יִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַֽל שֶׁן סֶ֝֗לַע וּ/מְצוּדָֽה
verses.translit: sl' yshkhn vytlnn 'l shn sl' vmtsvdh
verses.translation: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

verses.original: מִ/שָּׁ֥ם חָֽפַר אֹ֑כֶל לְ֝/מֵ/רָח֗וֹק עֵינָ֥י/ו יַבִּֽיטוּ
verses.translit: mshm chpr 'khl lmrchvq 'ynyv ybytv
verses.translation: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

verses.original: ו/אפרח/ו וְ/אֶפְרֹחָ֥י/ו יְעַלְעוּ דָ֑ם וּ/בַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֲ֝לָלִ֗ים שָׁ֣ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'prchv v'prchyv y'l'v dm vb'shr chllym shm hv'
verses.translation: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are , there is she.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת אִיּ֗וֹב וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh 't 'yvb vy'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,

verses.original: הֲ֭/רֹב עִם שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: hrb 'm shdy ysvr mvkhych 'lvh y'nnh
verses.translation: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb 't yhvh vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered the LORD , and said,

verses.original: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑/ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗/י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ פִֽ/י
verses.translit: hn qlty mh 'shybkh ydy shmty lmv py
verses.translation: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

verses.original: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝/שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְ/לֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף
verses.translit: 'cht dbrty vl' ''nh vshtym vl' 'vsyf
verses.translation: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ סערה מִ֥ן סְעָרָ֗ה וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh 't 'yvb mn s'rh mn s'rh vy'mr
verses.translation: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

verses.original: אֱזָר נָ֣א כְ/גֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑י/ךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְ/ךָ֗ וְ/הוֹדִיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'zr n' khgbr chltsykh 'sh'lkh vhvdy'ny
verses.translation: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

verses.original: הַ֭/אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑/י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗/נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק
verses.translit: h'f tpr mshpty trshy'ny lm'n ttsdq
verses.translation: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

verses.original: וְ/אִם זְר֖וֹעַ כָּ/אֵ֥ל לָ֑/ךְ וּ֝/בְ/ק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥/הוּ תַרְעֵֽם
verses.translit: v'm zrv' kh'l lkh vbqvl khmhv tr'm
verses.translation: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

verses.original: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹן וָ/גֹ֑בַהּ וְ/ה֖וֹד וְ/הָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'dh n' g'vn vgbh vhvd vhdr tlbsh
verses.translation: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

verses.original: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/רְאֵ֥ה כָל גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְ/הַשְׁפִּילֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: hpts 'brvt 'pkh vr'h khl g'h vhshpylhv
verses.translation: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה כָל גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑/הוּ וַ/הֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: r'h khl g'h hkhny'hv vhdkh rsh'ym tchtm
verses.translation: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

verses.original: טָמְנֵ֣/ם בֶּ/עָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵי/הֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּ/טָּמֽוּן
verses.translit: tmnm b'pr ychd pnyhm chbsh btmvn
verses.translation: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑/ךָּ כִּֽי תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְ/ךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vgm 'ny 'vdkh khy tvsh' lkh ymynkh
verses.translation: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑/ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּ/בָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh n' bhmvt 'shr 'shyty 'mkh chtsyr khbqr y'khl
verses.translation: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.

verses.original: הִנֵּה נָ֣א כֹח֣/וֹ בְ/מָתְנָ֑י/ו וְ֝/אֹנ֗/וֹ בִּ/שְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh n' khchv bmtnyv v'nv bshryry btnv
verses.translation: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

verses.original: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣/וֹ כְמוֹ אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פחד/ו פַחֲדָ֣י/ו יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ
verses.translit: ychpts znbv khmv 'rz gydy pchdv pchdyv yshrgv
verses.translation: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

verses.original: עֲ֭צָמָי/ו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗י/ו כִּ/מְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: 'tsmyv 'pyqy nchvshh grmyv khmtyl brzl
verses.translation: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

verses.original: ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי אֵ֑ל הָ֝/עֹשׂ/וֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hv' r'shyt drkhy 'l h'shv ygsh chrbv
verses.translation: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .

verses.original: כִּֽי ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ ל֑/וֹ וְֽ/כָל חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝/שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: khy bvl hrym ysh'v lv vkhl chyt hshdh yshchqv shm
verses.translation: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּ/סֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּ/בִצָּֽה
verses.translit: tcht ts'lym yshkhb bstr qnh vbtsh
verses.translation: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

verses.original: יְסֻכֻּ֣/הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑/וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּ/הוּ עַרְבֵי נָֽחַל
verses.translit: yskhhv ts'lym tsllv ysbvhv 'rby nchl
verses.translation: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח כִּֽי יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל פִּֽי/הוּ
verses.translit: hn y'shq nhr l' ychpvz ybtch khy ygych yrdn 'l pyhv
verses.translation: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

verses.original: בְּ/עֵינָ֥י/ו יִקָּחֶ֑/נּוּ בְּ֝/מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב אָֽף
verses.translit: b'ynyv yqchnv bmvqshym ynqb 'f
verses.translation: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

verses.original: הֵן תֹּחַלְתּ֥/וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲ/גַ֖ם אֶל מַרְאָ֣י/ו יֻטָֽל
verses.translit: hn tchltv nkhzbh hgm 'l mr'yv ytl
verses.translation: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

verses.original: לֹֽא אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑/נּוּ וּ/מִ֥י ה֝֗וּא לְ/פָנַ֥/י יִתְיַצָּֽב
verses.translit: l' 'khzr khy y'vrnv vmy hv' lpny ytytsb
verses.translation: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

verses.original: מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַ/נִי וַ/אֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם לִ/י הֽוּא
verses.translit: my hqdymny v'shlm tcht khl hshmym ly hv'
verses.translation: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?

verses.original: לא לֽ/וֹ אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑י/ו וּ/דְבַר גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְ/חִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' lv 'chrysh bdyv vdbr gbvrvt vchyn 'rkhv
verses.translation: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

verses.original: מִֽי גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑/וֹ בְּ/כֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗/וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: my glh pny lbvshv bkhpl rsnv my ybv'
verses.translation: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

verses.original: דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָי/ו מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ סְבִיב֖וֹת שִׁנָּ֣י/ו אֵימָֽה
verses.translit: dlty pnyv my ptch sbybvt shnyv 'ymh
verses.translation: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

verses.original: גַּ֭אֲוָה אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָֽגִנִּ֑ים סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר
verses.translit: g'vh 'pyqy mgnym sgvr chvtm tsr
verses.translation: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

verses.original: אֶחָ֣ד בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ וְ֝/ר֗וּחַ לֹא יָב֥וֹא בֵֽינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'chd b'chd ygshv vrvch l' ybv' bynyhm
verses.translation: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

verses.original: אִישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֥י/הוּ יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ
verses.translit: 'ysh b'chyhv ydbqv ytlkhdv vl' ytprdv
verses.translation: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

verses.original: עֲֽ֭טִישֹׁתָי/ו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝/עֵינָ֗י/ו כְּ/עַפְעַפֵּי שָֽׁחַר
verses.translit: 'tyshtyv thl 'vr v'ynyv kh'p'py shchr
verses.translation: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

verses.original: מִ֭/פִּי/ו לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי אֵ֝֗שׁ יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ
verses.translit: mpyv lpydym yhlkhv khydvdy 'sh ytmltv
verses.translation: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

verses.original: מִ֭/נְּחִירָי/ו יֵצֵ֣א עָשָׁ֑ן כְּ/ד֖וּד נָפ֣וּחַ וְ/אַגְמֹֽן
verses.translit: mnchyryv yts' 'shn khdvd npvch v'gmn
verses.translation: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁ/וֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝/לַ֗הַב מִ/פִּ֥י/ו יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: npshv gchlym tlht vlhb mpyv yts'
verses.translation: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

verses.original: בְּֽ֭/צַוָּאר/וֹ יָלִ֣ין עֹ֑ז וּ֝/לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו תָּד֥וּץ דְּאָבָֽה
verses.translit: btsv'rv ylyn 'z vlpnyv tdvts d'bh
verses.translation: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

verses.original: מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣/וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗י/ו בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: mply bshrv dbqv ytsvq 'lyv bl ymvt
verses.translation: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

verses.original: לִ֭בּ/וֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ אָ֑בֶן וְ֝/יָצ֗וּק כְּ/פֶ֣לַח תַּחְתִּֽית
verses.translit: lbv ytsvq khmv 'bn vytsvq khplch tchtyt
verses.translation: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

verses.original: מִ֭/שֵּׂת/וֹ יָג֣וּרוּ אֵלִ֑ים מִ֝/שְּׁבָרִ֗ים יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: mshtv ygvrv 'lym mshbrym ytcht'v
verses.translation: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

verses.original: מַשִּׂיגֵ֣/הוּ חֶ֭רֶב בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְ/שִׁרְיָֽה
verses.translit: mshyghv chrb bly tqvm chnyt ms' vshryh
verses.translation: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.original: יַחְשֹׁ֣ב לְ/תֶ֣בֶן בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְ/עֵ֖ץ רִקָּב֣וֹן נְחוּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: ychshb ltbn brzl l'ts rqbvn nchvshh
verses.translation: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

verses.original: לֹֽא יַבְרִיחֶ֥/נּוּ בֶן קָ֑שֶׁת לְ֝/קַ֗שׁ נֶהְפְּכוּ ל֥/וֹ אַבְנֵי קָֽלַע
verses.translit: l' ybrychnv bn qsht lqsh nhpkhv lv 'bny ql'
verses.translation: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

verses.original: כְּ֭/קַשׁ נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ תוֹתָ֑ח וְ֝/יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְ/רַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן
verses.translit: khqsh nchshbv tvtch vyshchq lr'sh khydvn
verses.translation: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

verses.original: תַּ֭חְתָּי/ו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי טִֽיט
verses.translit: tchtyv chdvdy chrsh yrpd chrvts 'ly tyt
verses.translation: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.

verses.original: יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּ/סִּ֣יר מְצוּלָ֑ה יָ֝֗ם יָשִׂ֥ים כַּ/מֶּרְקָחָֽה
verses.translit: yrtych khsyr mtsvlh ym yshym khmrqchh
verses.translation: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

verses.original: אַ֭חֲרָי/ו יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְ/שֵׂיבָֽה
verses.translit: 'chryv y'yr ntyb ychshb thvm lshybh
verses.translation: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .

verses.original: אֵֽין עַל עָפָ֥ר מָשְׁל֑/וֹ הֶ֝/עָשׂ֗וּ לִ/בְלִי חָֽת
verses.translit: 'yn 'l 'pr mshlv h'shv lbly cht
verses.translation: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

verses.original: אֵֽת כָּל גָּבֹ֥הַּ יִרְאֶ֑ה ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל כָּל בְּנֵי שָֽׁחַץ
verses.translit: 't khl gbh yr'h hv' mlkh 'l khl bny shchts
verses.translation: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יֹּאמַֽר
verses.translit: vy'n 'yvb 't yhvh vy'mr
verses.translation: Then Job answered the LORD , and said,

verses.original: ידעת יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי כֹ֣ל תּוּכָ֑ל וְ/לֹא יִבָּצֵ֖ר מִמְּ/ךָ֣ מְזִמָּֽה
verses.translit: yd't yd'ty khy khl tvkhl vl' ybtsr mmkh mzmh
verses.translation: I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

verses.original: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַעְלִ֥ים עֵצָ֗ה בְּֽלִ֫י דָ֥עַת לָ/כֵ֣ן הִ֭גַּדְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין נִפְלָא֥וֹת מִ֝מֶּ֗/נִּי וְ/לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע
verses.translit: my zh m'lym 'tsh bly d't lkhn hgdty vl' 'byn npl'vt mmny vl' 'd'
verses.translation: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֭א וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֶ֝שְׁאָלְ/ךָ֗ וְ/הוֹדִיעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shm' n' v'nkhy 'dbr 'sh'lkh vhvdy'ny
verses.translation: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

verses.original: לְ/שֵֽׁמַע אֹ֥זֶן שְׁמַעְתִּ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/עַתָּ֗ה עֵינִ֥/י רָאָֽתְ/ךָ
verses.translit: lshm' 'zn shm'tykh v'th 'yny r'tkh
verses.translation: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֭ן אֶמְאַ֣ס וְ/נִחַ֑מְתִּי עַל עָפָ֥ר וָ/אֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: 'l khn 'm's vnchmty 'l 'pr v'pr
verses.translation: Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחַ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אֶל אִיּ֑וֹב וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל אֱלִיפַ֣ז הַ/תֵּֽימָנִ֗י חָרָ֨ה אַפִּ֤/י בְ/ךָ֙ וּ/בִ/שְׁנֵ֣י רֵעֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛/י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּ/עַבְדִּ֥/י אִיּֽוֹב
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr dbr yhvh 't hdbrym h'lh 'l 'yvb vy'mr yhvh 'l 'lypz htymny chrh 'py bkh vbshny r'ykh khy l' dbrtm 'ly nkhvnh kh'bdy 'yvb
verses.translation: And it was so , that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath .

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה קְחֽוּ לָ/כֶ֣ם שִׁבְעָֽה פָרִים֩ וְ/שִׁבְעָ֨ה אֵילִ֜ים וּ/לְכ֣וּ אֶל עַבְדִּ֣/י אִיּ֗וֹב וְ/הַעֲלִיתֶ֤ם עוֹלָה֙ בַּֽעַדְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אִיּ֣וֹב עַבְדִּ֔/י יִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֧י אִם פָּנָ֣י/ו אֶשָּׂ֗א לְ/בִלְתִּ֞י עֲשׂ֤וֹת עִמָּ/כֶם֙ נְבָלָ֔ה כִּ֠י לֹ֣א דִבַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֵלַ֛/י נְכוֹנָ֖ה כְּ/עַבְדִּ֥/י אִיּֽוֹב
verses.translit: v'th qchv lkhm shb'h prym vshb'h 'ylym vlkhv 'l 'bdy 'yvb vh'lytm 'vlh b'dkhm v'yvb 'bdy ytpll 'lykhm khy 'm pnyv 'sh' lblty 'shvt 'mkhm nblh khy l' dbrtm 'ly nkhvnh kh'bdy 'yvb
verses.translation: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֩ אֱלִיפַ֨ז הַ/תֵּֽימָנִ֜י וּ/בִלְדַּ֣ד הַ/שּׁוּחִ֗י צֹפַר֙ הַ/נַּ֣עֲמָתִ֔י וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א יְהוָ֖ה אֶת פְּנֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
verses.translit: vylkhv 'lypz htymny vbldd hshvchy tspr hn'mty vy'shv kh'shr dbr 'lyhm yhvh vysh' yhvh 't pny 'yvb
verses.translation: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת שבית שְׁב֣וּת אִיּ֔וֹב בְּ/הִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖/וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וַ֧/יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/אִיּ֖וֹב לְ/מִשְׁנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhvh shb 't shbyt shbvt 'yvb bhtpllv b'd r'hv vysf yhvh 't khl 'shr l'yvb lmshnh
verses.translation: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵ֠לָי/ו כָּל אֶחָ֨י/ו וְ/כָל אחיתי/ו אַחְיוֹתָ֜י/ו וְ/כָל יֹדְעָ֣י/ו לְ/פָנִ֗ים וַ/יֹּאכְל֨וּ עִמּ֣/וֹ לֶחֶם֮ בְּ/בֵית/וֹ֒ וַ/יָּנֻ֤דוּ ל/וֹ֙ וַ/יְנַחֲמ֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֥יא יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְּנוּ ל֗/וֹ אִ֚ישׁ קְשִׂיטָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְ/אִ֕ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם זָהָ֖ב אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lyv khl 'chyv vkhl 'chytyv 'chyvtyv vkhl yd'yv lpnym vy'khlv 'mv lchm bbytv vyndv lv vynchmv 'tv 'l khl hr'h 'shr hby' yhvh 'lyv vytnv lv 'ysh qshyth 'cht v'ysh nzm zhb 'chd
verses.translation: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֗ה בֵּרַ֛ךְ אֶת אַחֲרִ֥ית אִיּ֖וֹב מֵ/רֵאשִׁת֑/וֹ וַֽ/יְהִי ל֡/וֹ אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר אֶ֜לֶף צֹ֗אן וְ/שֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ גְּמַלִּ֔ים וְ/אֶֽלֶף צֶ֥מֶד בָּקָ֖ר וְ/אֶ֥לֶף אֲתוֹנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhvh brkh 't 'chryt 'yvb mr'shtv vyhy lv 'rb'h 'shr 'lf ts'n vshsht 'lpym gmlym v'lf tsmd bqr v'lf 'tvnvt
verses.translation: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי ל֛/וֹ שִׁבְעָ֥נָה בָנִ֖ים וְ/שָׁל֥וֹשׁ בָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy lv shb'nh bnym vshlvsh bnvt
verses.translation: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם הָֽ/אַחַת֙ יְמִימָ֔ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית קְצִיעָ֑ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית קֶ֥רֶן הַפּֽוּךְ
verses.translit: vyqr' shm h'cht ymymh vshm hshnyt qtsy'h vshm hshlyshyt qrn hpvkh
verses.translation: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א נָשִׁ֥ים יָפ֛וֹת כִּ/בְנ֥וֹת אִיּ֖וֹב בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֧ם אֲבִי/הֶ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' nmts' nshym ypvt khbnvt 'yvb bkhl h'rts vytn lhm 'byhm nchlh btvkh 'chyhm
verses.translation: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֤י אִיּוֹב֙ אַֽחֲרֵי זֹ֔את מֵאָ֥ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה ו/ירא וַ/יִּרְאֶ֗ה אֶת בָּנָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֣י בָנָ֔י/ו אַרְבָּעָ֖ה דֹּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vychy 'yvb 'chry z't m'h v'rb'ym shnh vyr' vyr'h 't bnyv v't bny bnyv 'rb'h drvt
verses.translation: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת אִיּ֔וֹב זָקֵ֖ן וּ/שְׂבַ֥ע יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vymt 'yvb zqn vshb' ymym
verses.translation: So Job died, being old and full of days.
